Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Gemeentelijke websites vaak beperkt toegankelijk’

Two MPs asked the ministers about the accessibility of municipal websites for visually and hearing-impaired people, after a report that about two-thirds remain inaccessible. State Secretary Knops answered that a new legal duty to publish accessibility statements applies from 23 September 2020, that municipal councils and provinces handle supervision with existing legal tools, and that he will urge municipalities to improve, referring to the helpdesk and existing communication.
I will hold municipalities and other authorities to their responsibility.
Ik zal gemeenten en andere overheden aanspreken op hun verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘De zorgverleners worden niet voldoende beschermd’

An MP asks the health minister about reports that care workers are insufficiently protected, questioning the RIVM guideline relaxations on protective equipment, the inspectorate's role, and supply infrastructure. The answer states that all written questions were answered in the minister's COVID-19 status letter to the House, with a footnote to the press report.
The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) (2020Z06769) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) ( 2020Z06769 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief <COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken>
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Nederland faalde zelf bij aanschaf foute mondkapjes’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government checked the certification of the Chinese supplier of 1.3 million face masks, of which about 600,000 failed quality requirements, and what is being done to prevent such failures. The answer merely refers to a letter on the general COVID-19 situation, without addressing the specific questions.
The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to Minister van Rijn (Medical Care) have been answered by means of a letter on the COVID-19 update on the state of affairs.
De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan Minister van Rijn (Medische Zorg) ( 2020Z06930 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief <COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken>
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Onrust bij thuiszorg en wijkverpleging om gebrek aan bescherming’.

An MP asks the Minister of Health about reports of unrest among home-care and nursing staff over inadequate protective equipment during the COVID-19 crisis, and whether the situation is unsafe for patients and workers. The answer is a cross-reference to a separate letter on the COVID-19 situation, with no substantive response to the questions in this document.
The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) (2020Z06302) have been answered by means of the letter <COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs>.
De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) ( 2020Z06302 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief <COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken>
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de uitbreiding van vliegbasis Leeuwarden

An MP asked whether Leeuwarden air base lacks the required permits yet continues to expand, and whether the ministry follows the law. The state secretary acknowledges missing items and an overdue revision request, says a nature permit is expected by 1 October 2020, and states that projects proceed only once the required permissions are obtained.
For these projects, the necessary permits have been requested on behalf of Defence by the Central Government Real Estate Agency and issued by the competent authority.
Voor deze projecten zijn de benodigde toestemmingen namens Defensie door het Rijkvastgoedbedrijf aangevraagd en door het bevoegd gezag afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over doorbetaling van het zorgvervoer

Member Kerstens (PvdA) asked the Minister of Health about financial distress in the patient transport sector during the COVID-19 crisis, including reports of double-loading patients, whether transporters should be kept solvent, and whether clients should pay for cancelled trips and extra protocol costs. The minister answered by referring to a separate letter on the COVID-19 situation, without answering the questions directly.
The written questions from member Kerstens (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update state of affairs'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Zorgverlening zonder afdoende persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen'

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether he had noted a KNMG report that care workers were providing care without adequate protective equipment, and whether he agreed that such work could not be expected and that risks were too high. The answer refers the reader to a separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) where the questions were answered.
The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘VWS bezig met reddingsplan zorg: Niemand failliet’

An MP asked the Health Minister about reports of a rescue plan so that care providers do not go bankrupt during the COVID-19 crisis, including whether non-contracted providers qualify, whether the anti-assignment rule is lifted, and whether municipalities will be obliged and compensated to pay providers. The minister replied that insurers have set up a continuity contribution scheme open to all providers, that the cessation ban will not be lifted, and that the government will monitor municipalities and compensate them for extra costs.
With contracted care providers, insured persons always have the guarantee that the bill is reimbursed via the health insurer.
Bij gecontracteerde zorgaanbieders hebben verzekerden altijd de garantie dat de rekening via de zorgverzekeraar vergoed wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul, Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about measures during the coronavirus crisis across care, education, housing, debt, and the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered most questions by referring to earlier letters, while giving substantive answers on mantelzorg communication, eviction restrictions, and utility disconnection protections.
Because there may be obvious reasons for eviction, such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance, the cabinet is not willing to impose a moratorium.
Omdat er evidente redenen kunnen zijn om tot huisuitzetting over te gaan, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast, is het kabinet niet bereid om tot een moratorium over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Defensie-medewerkers mogen werkelijke schade chroom-6 claimen'

MP Kerstens asked whether the State Secretary of Defence would forgo further appeal against a court ruling that chromium-6 victims may claim actual damages beyond the flat-rate compensation, and whether that ruling would be applied to all recipients, and asked how much of the reserved budget has been paid out. The State Secretary answered that the government is still studying the ruling and cannot yet decide on appeal, that individual claims beyond the flat rate will be assessed case by case, and that 2.7 million euro (Coulance scheme) and 1.6 million euro (Uitkeringsregeling) net has been paid out, with the reserved budget being an estimate rather than a maximum.
Defence is still studying the ruling, however, and I cannot yet say whether or not an appeal will be lodged.
Defensie bestudeert de uitspraak echter nog en ik kan nog geen uitspraak doen over het al dan niet instellen van een rechtsmiddel.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de berichten 'De corona-angst achter de dichte deuren van het verpleeghuis» en «Frankrijk moet dodenlijst bijstellen: honderden ouderen overleden in verpleeghuizen'

The MP Kerstens asks the Minister of Health about reports on COVID-19 deaths in nursing homes, including whether the true number of infected residents and deaths is known, whether all residents and staff with symptoms are tested, how many locations have reported cases, whether protective equipment is sufficient, and whether maatwerk on visits is possible. The minister's reply refers to a broader COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Kerstens (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z06121) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kerstens (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z06121 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over antisemitische uitingen tijdens Ajax-PSV

MPs Kerstens, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice and Health ministers about antisemitic chants at the Ajax-PSV match, whether they are punishable, why the match was not stopped, whether stadium bans will follow, and the status of the anti-racism action plan. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the chants were condemned, PSV stewards intervened, one person was handed to police and the public prosecutor is reviewing the file, and that the KNVB and partners are implementing the action plan including a persoonsgerichte aanpak and a smart-technology challenge.
No report is known to the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Er is geen aangifte bekend bij het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens, Van Dijk, Moorlag en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het Coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party (PvdA) asked the ministers of health, social affairs, economic affairs and the state secretary of justice about IC bed capacity, care for budget holders, immigration detention during the coronavirus crisis, temporary worker and self-employed income support, Schiphol security staff conditions, childcare leave and state support for firms. The minister answered most questions substantively, describing measures and plans, while declining to commit to a fixed IC bed scenario beyond referring to earlier letters and saying the 40-hour norm and PBM supplies were still under review.
I refer you to that for brevity.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het door gemeenten en zorgverzekeraars (niet) doorbetalen van zorgaanbieders die als gevolg van de coronacrisis bijvoorbeeld geconfronteerd worden met ‘afbestelde’ zorg en ond

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether care providers facing cancelled care during the corona crisis will be paid by municipalities and health insurers, and whether the minister will hold them to account and compensate municipalities. The minister says the VNG and insurers have committed to continued payment through 1 June, will monitor implementation, use interbestuurlijk toezicht if municipalities neglect their duties, and will compensate municipalities for direct extra costs, while details for non-contracted providers are still under discussion.
Should it turn out that municipalities do not do this, or not sufficiently, and there is neglect of duty in this respect, the instruments of interadministrative supervision will be deployed.
Mocht blijken dat gemeenten dit niet of in onvoldoende mate doen en er in dit opzicht sprake is van taakverwaarlozing, dan zal het instrumentarium van interbestuurlijk toezicht worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

PvdA MPs asked the health ministers how far the Netherlands follows WHO advice on testing for COVID-19, whether test kits, staff, laboratory capacity and protective equipment are sufficient, and how ICU capacity, public information and distancing rules are handled. The minister answered that testing is targeted due to global shortages under a national guideline with a taskforce, that protective equipment is distributed under a central procurement and regional distribution structure, and that information is clear and updated, while largely restating existing policy and referring to a separate Kamerbrief for ICU capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Gezelschap over het bericht ‘Elise moet door haar spierziekte extra oppassen voor Corona’

MPs Kerstens and Laan-Gezelschap asked the Health Minister about a news report on a child with muscular disease at extra risk from coronavirus, and whether care-indication renewals by insurers should be paused for families under strain. The minister answered that the parties agreed a protocol under which current indications can be extended by three months, while renewals remain possible where care needs change.
On re-indication when the care input has not changed, the advice summarised briefly states that the current indication can be extended by three months or as much shorter as applicable.
Over herindicatie wanneer de zorginzet niet gewijzigd is, stelt het advies kort samengevat dat de huidige indicatie met drie maanden verlengd kan worden of zoveel korter als van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de problemen bij de regionale zorgcentrale Centrale24 in Eindhoven

An MP asked the minister about serious problems at the regional care call centre Centrale24 in Eindhoven, including night-time client safety, IT outages, use of unqualified students, and a culture discouraging reporting of misconduct. The minister answered that care providers are responsible for night-time safety and staffing, pointed to a knowledge-sharing platform, said providers must have internal incident reporting and serious incidents must be reported to the IGJ, and left open the question of a further inspection investigation.
It is the responsibility of every care provider to ensure this, whether it concerns deploying staff or using technology as an aid.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van iedere zorgaanbieder om daarin te voorzien, of het nu gaat om de inzet van personeel of het gebruik van technologie als hulpmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Friesland op achterste benen om laagvliegroute F-35’

MP Kerstens asked the State Secretary for Defence why the province of Friesland was not consulted before the dormant low-flying route Linkroute-10A was to be reactivated for F-35 training, and whether Defence would hold open consultation and inform Parliament. The State Secretary answered that a Natura 2000 effects analysis is still pending, that the route was suspended in 2002 due to safety and noise concerns which remain, that a decision on its future is promised before 1 June 2020 after informing the provinces and stakeholders, and that the questions could not be answered before the 4 February consultation meeting.
At the consultation meeting of 18 February I promised your House to provide clarity on the future of Linkroute-10A before 1 June 2020.
Tijdens het VAO op 18 februari heb ik uw kamer toegezegd om voor 1 juni 2020 duidelijkheid te bieden over de toekomst van de Linkroute-10A.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht dat 23 ouderen hun huis kwijtraken door een commerciële overname

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked about 23 elderly residents losing their homes after a commercial takeover of their care-housing provider, including the inspectorate's assessment of the building and the legality of the tenant stopping rent payments. The minister said the inspectorate found the building unfit for 24-hour care, that the courts found stopping rent unjustified, and that residents were relocated, compensated for moving, and given tenancy protections, while declining to judge the complex dispute in detail.
I am therefore reticent in my judgement because I do not wish to intervene in the court's assessment and do not know all the details.
Dit maakt dat ik terughoudend ben in mijn oordeel omdat ik niet wil treden in de beoordeling van de rechter en niet alle details ken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars, Per Saldo, V&VN en VWS maken afspraken over indicatieproces kindzorg thuis’

Two MPs asked the minister why the parent organisation BVIKZ was not included in agreements on the indication process for child home care, and whether parents' maatwerk and the indication norms were changed. The minister answered that the agreements rest with the Zvw-pgb parties, that BVIKZ is involved in the wider process, that the policy is unchanged, and that no extra meetings are currently planned.
I was, am and remain willing to involve BVIKZ in the solutions on this file; the parliamentary questions asked are, in my view, separate from that.
Ik was, ben en blijf bereid om BVIKZ te betrekken bij de oplossingen op dit dossier, de gestelde Kamervragen staan hier wat mij betreft los van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het Veteranenontmoetingscentrum (VOC) de Ouwestomp in Den Bosch

An MP from the Labour party asked the Defence Minister about the municipality of Den Bosch's handling of the Ouwestomp veterans' meeting centre, including its plan to change the site's use and alternative housing. The Minister answered that the municipality wants to find a joint solution, that VOCs are private initiatives not financed by Defence, that there are no fixed criteria for such centres, and that the municipality has confirmed it will offer suitable support, with the location and form left to local authorities.
It is up to the municipal administration to weigh the various local interests.
Het is immers aan het gemeentebestuur om de afweging te maken tussen de diverse lokale belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over mensen met een stoornis in het autistische spectrum die hun plaats in een woonvorm dreigen te verliezen door korte indicaties

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether short Wmo assessments for people with autism spectrum disorder, a lifelong condition, threaten their place in a supported housing arrangement, and what is being done with VNG and client organisations. The minister says short indications are not appropriate for permanent limitations, that municipalities are encouraged to issue longer decisions, and that Leeuwarden's policy grants 2-3 year indications and no contact is needed for now.

It is the responsibility of the municipality of Leeuwarden, in consultation with these people and individually, taking into account the characteristics of the person and their situation, to determine what support is appropriate for them.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Leeuwarden om in samenspraak met deze mensen, individueel, rekening houdend met de kenmerken van de persoon en diens situatie, te bezien wat voor hen passende ondersteuning is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de gedwongen verhuizing van mensen met een handicap uit Woerden

An MP asked the health minister about the forced relocation of seven disabled residents from a Woerden care facility, many over 150 km away, due to staff shortages, and about pressure on residents and whether the minister would monitor the transfers. The minister acknowledged the hardship, said the care provider could no longer deliver adequate nursing care in Woerden, reported that residents were offered alternatives elsewhere, and said the ministry is monitoring developments with the Inspectorate.
I have closely followed developments together with the Inspectorate for Health Care and Youth and have consulted with various involved parties.
Ik heb de ontwikkelingen samen met de Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg en Jeugd intensief gevolgd en ben met verschillende betrokken partijen in overleg gegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Geselschap over het feit dat belangenbehartigers niet worden betrokken bij de kwestie van lagere pgb’s voor ouders die hun zieke kind thuis zelf verzorgen

MPs Kerstens and Laan-Geselschap asked why patient representatives were not involved in talks on lower personal budgets (pgb) for parents caring for their seriously ill child at home. The minister replied that representative organisations are consulted, that different meetings with different goals took place from 4 to 7 February, and that he will answer the written questions as soon as possible.

Consultation with interest representatives such as Per Saldo, Stichting Kind en Ziekenhuis, Spierziekten Nederland, Kenniscentrum Kinderpalliatieve Zorg and the Belangenvereniging Intensieve Kindzorg does indeed take place.

Er vindt wel degelijk overleg plaats met belangenbehartigers zoals Per Saldo, Stichting Kind en Ziekenhuis, Spierziekten Nederland, Kenniscentrum Kinderpalliatieve Zorg en de Belangenvereniging Intensieve Kindzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Ouders die thuis voor ernstig ziek kind zorgen, krijgen minder geld’

MPs Kerstens and Laan-Geselschap asked the Minister of Health about reports that parents caring for a seriously ill child at home receive less personal budget (pgb) funding, and about the conduct of KinderThuisZorg, the handling of such care as 'usual care', and related questions. The minister answered that the rules have not changed, that the cited passage is meant to clarify practice, that above-usual care remains reimbursable to parents at the informal tariff, and that VWS is monitoring insurers and practice variation.
VWS is in consultation with the professional group V&VN to look into unexplained practice variation in needs assessments.
VWS is met de beroepsgroep V&VN in overleg om te kijken naar onverklaarbare praktijkvariatie bij indicatiestellingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over haperend ziekenvervoer in Overijssel

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about disrupted patient transport to hospitals in Overijssel after insurers Zilveren Kruis and Eno switched ambulance-transport provider, and whether insurers meet their duty of care and should open a dedicated phone line. The Minister said the insurers have taken measures such as extra phone lines and alternative booking options, that the supervisor NZa must judge compliance with the duty of care, and that the Minister has been in regular contact with the insurers and will not open a special line but notes an existing Vervoerslijn number.
It is up to the supervisor of health insurers, the Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets' healthcare arm NZa, to assess whether Zilveren Kruis and Eno have met their statutory duty of care.
Het is aan de toezichthouder op zorgverzekeraars, de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit, om te beoordelen of Zilveren Kruis en Eno aan hun wettelijke zorgplicht hebben voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Drenthe dwingt Cosis kwetsbare cliënten op straat te zetten’

MP Kerstens asked the state secretary about a report that a dispute between Drenthe municipalities and care provider Cosis could leave vulnerable clients on the street, and whether other such cases are known. The state secretary said clients should not suffer from such disputes, cited a court-extended transition period in Assen, and pointed to national housing investments and a broad homelessness approach while acknowledging no national overview of shortages exists.
I do not have a national overview of possible bottlenecks regarding available housing for sheltered living.
Ik heb geen landelijk overzicht van mogelijke knelpunten op het gebied van beschikbare woonruimte voor beschermd wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat 23 ouderen hun huis kwijtraken vanwege een commerciële overname

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked the ministers of Health and Interior about reports that 23 elderly residents of De Keizershof must leave after a commercial takeover, and whether this is acceptable, legally sound, and comparable to the Careyn case. The minister answered that the building was never a care location, the care provider and property owner disputed who pays for adaptations, the rent stopped and the lease was dissolved by court, and that the ministers have contacted the parties to help residents find new housing, committing to no formal structural change.
I find it very unfortunate that these elderly residents have ended up in this situation.
Ik vind het heel vervelend dat deze ouderen in deze situatie terecht zijn gekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Bosman, Kerstens, Bruins, Voordewind en Stoffer over de berichtgeving ‘Nieuwe onderzeeboten: Nederlandse marine-industrie dreigt alleen kruimels te krijgen’

MPs from several parties asked the Defence, Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about press reports that the Dutch naval shipbuilding industry risks getting only scraps from the new submarine order, and about risks to knowledge retention, intellectual property, competition and the Defence Industry Strategy. The government answered at length, largely restating its procurement approach: competitive selection under Article 346 TFEU, IP and maintenance guarantees to be negotiated in the next phase, and no decision yet on a single preferred bidder.
As I stated in the B-letter, I will implement the Bruins Slot et al. motion.
Zoals ik in de B-brief heb vermeld zal ik uitvoering geven aan de motie Bruins Slot c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over tekortschietende hulp in woonzorgcentrum Het Schild

An MP asked the minister why care quality at nursing home Het Schild remains deficient more than a year after the first inspection, and whether residents should be protected by intervention or extra funding. The minister confirmed the inspectorate has imposed heightened supervision, will reassess the situation and take further measures if needed, and that the health insurer's care office is discussing measures and possible extra funding with the home.
The inspectorate has imposed heightened supervision to closely monitor the situation within Het Schild.
De inspectie heeft verscherpt toezicht ingesteld om de situatie binnen Het Schild nauwlettend te kunnen volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de berichten ‘Puinhoop bij Arnhems verpleeghuis; inspectie grijpt in’ en ‘All Day moet cliënten van Dunya Zorggroep na twee maanden alweer overdragen aan goede zorgpartij’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that the inspectorate intervened at an Arnhem nursing home run by Dunya Zorggroep and that clients were transferred twice in two months, asking how the quality and continuity of care were checked, what the standard transfer procedure is, and whether the operator's history warrants new rules. The minister answered that the inspectorate ordered the transfers, found the handover to All Day unacceptable and unplanned, announced a new licensing law (Wtza) and a separate bill on integrity of operations, and noted that Dunya Woonzorg was declared bankrupt by the court.
The bill on the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders (Wtza), submitted to your House for plenary debate, introduces a notification duty and a licensing requirement.
Het wetsvoorstel Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders (Wtza), dat door uw Kamer is aangemeld voor plenaire behandeling, introduceert een meldplicht en een vergunningplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat veel gemeenten laks omgaan met VN-verdrag

An MP asked the health minister whether it is troubling that most municipalities pay insufficient attention to people with disabilities in their policy plans and whether gemeenten should be monitored and given inspraak mechanisms such as Danish disability councils. The minister acknowledges gaps, points to monitoring by Movisie and VNG projects and plans, and says gemeenten are already legally required to involve clients, leaving the form of inspraak to each municipality.
I consider it important that municipalities pay attention to people with a disability when developing policy.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat gemeenten bij de totstandkoming van beleid aandacht besteden aan mensen met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over de sluiting van een afdeling in het OLVG Oost door personeelstekort

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the minister why the OLVG Oost hospital closed its haematology and oncology ward due to staff shortages, what the consequences for patients and quality of care are, whether the ministry was informed beforehand, and whether it will address housing and pay conditions for care staff. The minister confirmed the closure, said care remains available nearby at OLVG West within 10 km, said the ministry was not informed beforehand since insurers hold the duty of care, and pointed to housing priority schemes, existing pay funds and the Werken in de Zorg programme without committing to new funds.
The health insurer has a duty of care and is therefore responsible for providing accessible, good-quality care.
De zorgverzekeraar heeft zorgplicht en is daarmee verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van toegankelijk en kwalitatief goede zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kerstens over het bericht dat door Oost NL gesteunde Chinese spookbedrijven verdacht worden van uitbuiting van illegale werknemers

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked whether government-backed regional agency Oost NL supported Chinese companies suspected of exploiting illegal workers, and what action will be taken. The minister acknowledged serious labour-law violations found by the Inspectorate SZW, said Oost NL will pause expansion support and that municipalities decide on closures, and largely deflected responsibility to the companies, the inspectorate and municipalities.
Because this information is commercially confidential, RVO.nl does not disclose specific company information for tax schemes, guarantees, indirect financing arrangements and suretyships.

Vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie geldt voor fiscale regelingen, garantstellingen, indirecte financieringsregelingen en borgstellingen dat RVO.nl geen specifieke bedrijfsinformatie openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de gevolgen van het cao-akkoord VVT voor de continuïteit van zorg

An MP asked the health minister whether the new VVT collective agreement could cause financial trouble or bankruptcies among home-care organisations and how continuity of care would be guaranteed. The minister answered that there is no reason to assume care continuity is at risk, that municipalities are primarily responsible under the Wmo 2015, and described the conditions for ministry intervention and the ongoing evaluation of the reasonable-price rule.
If continuity of support under the Wmo 2015 is ever at stake, it is primarily up to municipalities to intervene.
Indien continuïteit van ondersteuning op grond van de Wmo 2015 op enig moment in het geding komt, is het primair aan gemeenten om in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het bericht dat zorginstelling Pluryn kinderen die specialistische hulp nodig hebben weigert

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about reports that youth care provider Pluryn is refusing children needing specialist help, its financial difficulties, a recovery plan shifting to residential care, and staff workload. The Minister answered that Pluryn says no acute cases are refused, that funding is a municipal matter, that no subsidy clawback is currently planned, and that the Minister monitors the situation as system steward while pointing to broader reform and labour-market measures.
Municipalities have a duty to provide youth care and are responsible for the availability of appropriate youth care.
Gemeenten hebben een jeugdhulpplicht en zijn verantwoordelijk voor de beschikbaarheid van passende jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over de administratieve lasten in de zorg die blijven stijgen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister why administrative burdens in care keep rising, how the (Ont)Regel de Zorg programme will deliver relief, and whether overhead in youth and social care is avoidable. The minister acknowledged the rise, said the programme must become more effective, committed to intensified local and national action and an in-depth KPMG study, but declined to commission a data-based mapping of coordination processes.
That is why we are currently carrying out an in-depth study on insight into the spending of youth care funds.
Daarom voeren we op dit moment een diepteonderzoek «inzicht in besteding jeugdzorgmiddelen» uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de toename van het aantal kinderen dat in een crisisopvang woont

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked the government about the rising number of children living in crisis shelters, including whether gezinnen should get priority for housing and whether the issue will be addressed in an upcoming homelessness action plan. The minister answered that children should not grow up in shelters, that no recent data exists so a study will be commissioned, that housing allocation is a municipal responsibility, and that a homelessness action plan is being prepared.
There are no recent substantiated figures on the number of children currently living in women's or social shelters.
Er zijn geen recente onderbouwde cijfers bekend over het aantal kinderen dat momenteel in de vrouwen- of maatschappelijke opvang woont.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Streep door gehate wet over rol verpleegkundigen’

An MP asked whether employers may unilaterally introduce functiedifferentiatie (differentiation of nursing roles) and whether the related research should proceed without nurses' involvement, and asked the minister to halt it. The minister answered that the statutory BIG-II regulation has been shelved for lack of support, that employers may develop their functiegebouw in consultation with works councils, and that the research involves nurses closely, so no halt is needed.
The statutory regulation has now definitively been taken off the table due to the lack of support for it.
Inmiddels is de wettelijke regeling definitief van tafel, wegens het ontbreken van draagvlaak hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over de patiëntenstop van Zilveren Kruis-verzekerden bij ziekenhuisgroep ZGT

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the Minister for Medical Care about a patient stop imposed by hospital group ZGT on Zilveren Kruis insured patients, its consequences for access and quality, and what could be done for affected patients. The minister answered that referrals of Zilveren Kruis patients with new elective care needs are temporarily routed to insurer-brokered care, that this is a matter between the parties under the care duty which the NZa monitors, and that he is watchful but not directly worried about recurring patient stops.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Meerjarig onderzoek naar functiedifferentiatie verpleegkundigen van start’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a multi-year research project on functional differentiation of nurses, its timing relative to the stalled BIG-II bill and the ongoing Rinnooy Kan exploration, and nurses' trust and pay. The minister replied that the research stems from a 2018 hospital-sector agreement, is complementary to the bill, will involve nurses, and that pay is set by sector parties with additional funds and the Werken in de Zorg programme.
That such a study would take place was already reported in my letter to parliament of 4 June 2018.
Dat een dergelijk onderzoek zou plaats gaan vinden is reeds gemeld in mijn kamerbrief van 4 juni 2018
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over de verdubbeling van het aantal daklozen

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about the reported doubling of the number of homeless people in the Netherlands, including the state's duty to provide housing, the causes, the adequacy of social assistance, shelter capacity and broader societal effects. The state secretary answered that housing and health are constitutional social rights shared with municipalities and housing corporations, that the government will present an additional plan this autumn, and that CBS research on the rise is pending.
That is why the Cabinet, together with other (local) parties, will come this autumn with an additional plan to significantly reduce the number of homeless people in the coming years.
Daarom komt het Kabinet dit najaar samen met andere (lokale) partijen met een aanvullend plan om het aantal dak- en thuislozen de komende jaren fors terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Driekwart ziekenhuispersoneel overweegt vertrek’

An MP asked the minister for health about a report that three quarters of hospital staff are considering leaving, and about pay, workload and work-life balance, the failure of the Werken in de Zorg action programme to reduce departures, and whether the minister will take concrete measures. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to regional exit research, sector-wide cao negotiations and existing funding, but gives no new concrete extra pay measures.
I hope that they, as in other care sectors such as the UMCs, GGZ, youth care and VVT, manage to reach good agreements that contribute to this.
Ik hoop dat ze net als in andere sectoren in de zorg, zoals de UMC’s, GGZ, Jeugdzorg en VVT, lukt om tot goede afspraken te komen, die hieraan bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de artikelen over PrivaZorg van Follow the Money en Trouw

A Labour MP asked the health minister about investigative reports on PrivaZorg, including tax information not shared with care supervisors, a whistleblower's treatment, governance and accountant roles, and whether criminal complaints were filed. The minister answered that the IGJ has tightened oversight, the IKZ information-sharing will be improved by a forthcoming bill, governance measures are being prepared, and no criminal complaint was deemed likely to succeed.
During an ongoing investigation, the IGJ does not provide informants with information about the content of the investigation.
Gedurende een lopend onderzoek verschaft de IGJ geen informatie over de inhoud van het onderzoek aan melders.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over diverse berichten inzake de berichten 'Duizenden ouderen wachten op verpleeghuisplek of thuiszorg', 'Route naar verpleeghuis zit verstopt' en '36 huizen afbellen voor één pati

An MP from the Labour party asks the Minister of Health about press reports on elderly people waiting for nursing home places or home care, and whether the government takes responsibility and will act with extra measures and money. The Minister acknowledges the scale of the challenge, gives no waiting-list numbers for home care, points to public waiting-list overviews for nursing homes, and defers the substantive answers on responsibility, measures and funding to a letter before the budget debate.
For the further answers to these questions I refer to my letter that I will send before the budget debate.
Voor de verdere beantwoording op deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief die ik zal sturen vóór de begrotingsbehandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de sluiting van een Pro Persona-locatie in Ede

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the reported closure of a Pro Persona mental health location in Ede, its effects on patients, waiting lists, and other locations. The State Secretary replied that the provider is responsible for its finances, that a phased reduction of beds in Ede (over one to two years) is being explored rather than an immediate closure, that care continuity is assured, and that regulators (NZa, IGJ) monitor the situation, while declining to answer questions about other providers.
I cannot answer this question. It is the responsibility of care providers themselves to take timely measures to address financial problems.
Ik kan deze vraag niet beantwoorden. Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders zelf om tijdig maatregelen te nemen om financiële problemen aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de zorggroep Aventura

MP Kerstens (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about care provider Aventura, including large management fees possibly circumventing the Wet normering topinkomens, the reasonableness of a monthly rate per client, corporate structures, misuse of institutional logos, and supervision of sheltered-housing providers by municipalities. The State Secretary answered that the CIBG is investigating the fees, that maximum tariffs would conflict with the Wmo 2015 aim of tailored support, that municipalities are responsible for Wmo supervision and that more focus and support for supervision is planned, but declined to commit to a new action plan or to extend the Wtza to Wmo providers.
The CIBG, the care sector supervisor for compliance with the Wnt, has very recently launched an investigation into Aventura.
Het CIBG, de toezichthouder in de zorg op de naleving van de Wet normering topinkomens (Wnt), heeft Aventura zeer recent in onderzoek genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over de toegankelijkheid van de tijdelijke huisvesting van de Tweede Kamer voor blinden en slechtzienden

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Interior whether blind and visually impaired people will have good access to the Tweede Kamer's temporary accommodation, including an audio model of the chamber, and which other facilities will be provided. The State Secretary agreed access should be good, but said placing the audio model is a matter for the Tweede Kamer organisation, suggested it be moved over, and said the public areas will meet the ITs Publiek accessibility standard while other areas keep existing facilities.

Placing an audio model as part of the facilities in the temporary accommodation is, however, due to the division of roles between the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the users of the temporary accommodation, a matter for the Tweede Kamer organisation.

Het plaatsen van een audiomaquette als onderdeel van de voorzieningen in de tijdelijke huisvesting is echter vanwege de rolverdeling tussen het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf en de gebruikers van de tijdelijke huisvesting, een zaak van de Tweede Kamerorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat gemeenten massaal korten op het sociaal domein

MP Kerstens asked whether it is not troubling that municipal budget shortfalls lead to cuts in the social domain that hit the most vulnerable, and when the limit of responsible execution of the decentralisations would be reached. Minister De Jonge answered that the survey of municipalities is not evidence of actual shortfalls, that the government and municipalities keep talking, that extra youth-care funds were provided, and that municipal execution is not irresponsible.
There can be no question of irresponsible execution by municipalities.
Er kan geen sprake zijn van een onverantwoorde uitvoering door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat hulpverleners afhaken door te lage zorgtarieven

An MP asked the health minister whether low personal-budget care tariffs and slow renewal procedures in Eindhoven are driving care providers out and leaving clients without support. The minister said municipalities must justify their tariffs and follow legal deadlines, that Eindhoven has taken effective measures, and that he will talk with the VNG about tariff justification.
I will therefore enter into discussion with the VNG to examine whether municipalities sufficiently justify their tariffs, as the legal frameworks imply.
Met de VNG zal ik daarom in gesprek treden om te bezien of gemeenten hun tarieven voldoende onderbouwen, zoals de wettelijke kaders impliceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat ouderen nauwelijks geld overhouden

An MP asked the health and social affairs ministers about reports that older people have little money left after paying care costs, including Regioplan findings, example budgets, the earlier start of the high own contribution, and whether financial reasons push people away from thuis care into nursing homes. The minister disputes the Regioplan scope, gives partial calculations as percentages of disposable income, says the situation is hard to quantify, and promises an advisory report from a committee at end 2019.
It is impossible to determine exactly how much money older people have left, because this amount depends heavily on the personal preferences and choices of the individual client.
Het is hierbij onmogelijk te bepalen welk bedrag ouderen precies overhouden, omdat dit bedrag sterk afhankelijk is van de persoonlijke voorkeuren en keuzes van de individuele cliënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de problematiek rondom rolstoelen en scootmobielen

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about long repair waits and insufficient tailoring for wheelchair and scooter users, and whether the government would act on a Patiëntenfederatie/Ieder(in) recommendation. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to a follow-up study and VNG agreements, and said he would commission a bureau to help implement the recommendations, reporting back next year.
I intend to give a bureau the assignment to help implement the recommendations.
Ik ben voornemens een bureau de opdracht te geven om te helpen de aanbevelingen te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden en Kuiken over het bericht 'Relatie zorgfraude en terrorisme onderzocht'

Two MPs asked whether suspicious financial transactions linked to care fraud, and a possible link with terrorism financing, were detected and acted upon by the FIU-Nederland, including how many transactions there were and whether earlier years were investigated. The minister replied that over 1,300 unusual transactions related to care fraud were reported in 2018, that many remain under investigation so no concrete figures are yet available, and that no further retrospective investigation is planned.
As a result, no concrete statements can yet be made about the number of transactions declared suspicious by the FIU-Nederland that may be related to care fraud, or the amount involved.

Hierdoor kunnen er nog geen concrete uitspraken worden gedaan over het aantal door de FIU-Nederland verdacht verklaarde transacties dat mogelijk te relateren is aan zorgfraude alsmede het bedrag dat daarmee gemoeid is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het toenemende aantal signalen dat werkgevers in de zorg vooruitlopen op het (nog niet ingediende en mogelijk nooit ingediend wordende) wetsvoorstel BIG-II

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that employers in healthcare are acting as if the draft BIG-II bill is already law, reassigning nurse tasks and lowering grading, and whether a ban on staff commenting on the transition scheme is acceptable. The Minister said the examples are not always directly caused by the draft bill, that opining on the scheme cannot be forbidden, and that he will await an advisory report from Rinnooy Kan in early October 2019 before deciding how to proceed with the bill.
As I have previously announced, I do not see the bill on the nurse practitioner in its current form getting off the ground.
Zoals ik al eerder heb aangekondigd zie ik het wetsvoorstel rondom de regieverpleegkundige in de huidige vorm niet vliegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over fraude in de zorg

An MP asks the Health Minister about a Twente care bureau lending care funds, whether such loans can be made unlawful, and how fraud in municipal care will be tracked. The minister says the Bevorderen samenwerking en rechtmatige zorg bill will improve signal-sharing and a warning register, that loans are undesirable and stricter internal and external oversight is being prepared, and that municipalities are responsible for registering their own non-compliance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Gemeentepolis minima staat onder druk’

Labour MP Kerstens asked the Health Minister and State Secretary of Social Affairs about a CPB report on municipal health insurance collectives (gemeentepolis) for low-income people and whether improvement options such as better risk-equalisation compensation, choice aids and a no-claim alternative to the deductible will be pursued. The government says the polis can help but depends on design, points to the voorzieningenwijzer and ongoing risk-equalisation improvements, stresses municipalities and insurers are free to offer collectives, and commits to further review of chronic-illness compensation without a full policy overhaul.
Municipalities and insurers are free to decide whether or not to conclude collectives.
Gemeenten en verzekeraars zijn vrij om wel of geen collectiviteiten af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het gebrekkige toezicht op de data van patiënten

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked how patient data is protected, whether a US company had access to anonymised data, whether patients are informed about research use, and about monopoly risks in digital care. The minister answered that responsibility lies mainly with care providers, that the software in question is not used in the Netherlands, that anonymised or consented research is the rule, and promised further letters and debate.
Hospitals themselves bear responsibility for their patient management software and what they agree with suppliers in their contracts.
Ziekenhuizen dragen zelf de verantwoordelijkheid voor hun software voor patiëntenbeheer en hetgeen ze afspreken met de leveranciers in hun contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over brandveiligheid in seniorenwoningen

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about fire safety in senior housing complexes after a news report on evacuation risks, asking about past signals, measures on smoke spread and escape route length, and whether existing rules fall short. The minister answered that stricter fire safety requirements for residential buildings are planned, with TNO research and a draft amendment to the Besluit bouwwerken leefomgeving to follow, and that municipalities can already impose new-build standards on existing complexes but the minister is still considering how to encourage this.
In this letter I report that I intend to tighten the fire safety requirements for residential buildings.
Ik meld in deze brief dat ik voornemens ben om de brandveiligheidseisen voor woongebouwen aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Verpleegkundigen zien komst superverpleegkundige als degradatie.’

MP Kerstens asks whether the minister's willingness to pursue a sector-agreed arrangement covers the introduction of the regieverpleegkundige role itself, including dropping the MBO/HBO distinction, given nurses' unrest. The minister replies that the bill is being reconsidered, that alternatives such as CAO or quality standards are open, and that Rinnooy Kan will explore support and talk with the action committee.
As I have previously made known, the bill came about at the request of, and after extensive consultation with, among others, representatives of the profession, employers and employees.
Zoals ik eerder kenbaar heb gemaakt is het wetsvoorstel op verzoek van en na veel overleg met onder andere vertegenwoordigers van de beroepsgroep, werkgevers en werknemers tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Inspectie: Lentis-kliniek voldoet niet aan voorwaarden voor goede zorg’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about an Inspectorate finding that the Lentis clinic failed to meet conditions for good care due to staff shortages, and about how risks to care continuity and safety are guaranteed and monitored. The State Secretary replied that providers are responsible for safe care, that the Inspectorate monitors this and will report on calamities linked to staff shortages in early 2020.
This year the IGJ will, for each closed calamity report in mental health care, examine whether staff shortages played a role in the patient's residential situation at the time of the calamity.

De IGJ zal dit jaar per afgesloten melding van een calamiteit in de ggz inventariseren of personeelstekorten een rol hebben gespeeld in de verblijfssituatie van de patiënt ten tijde van de calamiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht “Dutchbat veteraan: excuses zouden ons enorm goed doen”

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a news report on Dutchbat-III veterans who want apologies, the timeline for the research and commission results, whether concrete steps will follow, and how veterans will be kept informed. The minister answered that a research project led by ARQ Nationaal Psychotrauma Centrum runs until mid-2020 under an independent commission, that follow-up steps depend on its findings, and that contact with the Dutchbat-III association and a low-threshold contact point will keep veterans informed.
The concrete follow-up steps are explicitly linked to the outcomes of the research.
De concrete vervolgstappen zijn nadrukkelijk verbonden aan de uitkomsten van het onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Bonden: CAO-actievoerders ziekenhuizen last van intimidatie’

An MP asked the health minister whether hospital employers intimidating staff taking part in CAO strike actions breaches the right to collective action, and what the government would say to such employers. The minister answered that the right to collective action is protected by the European Social Charter, that courts must judge whether it was violated, and that the parties should resume CAO talks.
To what extent there is a violation of this right in this case is for the court to assess.
In hoeverre er in dit geval sprake is van schending van dit recht, is aan de rechter om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over Wmo indicaties die voor bepaalde tijd gelden

An MP asked the minister about Rucphen municipality issuing time-limited Wmo indications without actively contacting clients for reassessment, risking abrupt end of care. The minister said the law does not prescribe indication duration, that long-term indications should generally be issued for lasting disabilities, that the municipality should proactively inform clients, and that the municipality has been asked to notify clients with pre-2019 indications.
I consider the failure to inform citizens with a chronic condition vulnerable and unacceptable.
Ik vind het niet informeren van burgers met een chronische aandoening kwetsbaar en niet aanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de inspectie van de IGJ bij Stichting OnderDak

MP Kerstens asked the health minister why the inspectorate visited Stichting OnderDak with notice, how representative five client interviews are, why repeated investigations led to no binding consequences, and what lessons are drawn. The minister answered that the visit was pre-announced for practical reasons, the five interviews were an impression rather than a representative sample, the inspectorate ordered improvements with a deadline of 16 September 2019, and it will consider further steps if needed.
The inspectorate has instructed the organisation to draw up an action plan based on the identified shortcomings and to implement improvement measures.
De inspectie heeft opdracht gegeven een plan van aanpak op te stellen op basis van de geconstateerde tekortkomingen en verbetermaatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over Limburgse zorgaanbieders die onterecht miljoenenwinsten opstreken

An MP asked the Minister of Health about Limburg care providers who allegedly earned excessive profits, the delayed financial settlement for 2015-2016, follow-up on about 50 providers, the lawsuits, and transparency towards the Maastricht council. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for oversight and contracting, the council has been informed and is handling it, and that fraud is hard to quantify while the government will report on its anti-fraud programme in September.
Municipalities are responsible for the lawful implementation of the Wmo 2015 and the Youth Act.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de rechtmatige uitvoering van de Wmo 2015 en de Jeugdwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Geen gemeentepolis meer voor Heerder minima: we zijn teleurgesteld en kwaad’

An MP asks the health minister why Menzis is ending the municipal health insurance package for benefit recipients in Heerde and whether insurers and the government will ensure collective coverage. The minister replies that the municipal package is not an end in itself, points to alternatives, and declines to start talks with insurers or to compensate municipalities.
I see the municipal collectivity, however, as a means and not an end in itself.
Ik zie de gemeentelijke collectiviteit hiervoor echter als een middel en geen doel op zich.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Bijna één op drie ziekenhuisvacatures moeilijk te vervullen’

Kerstens and Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that nearly a third of hospital vacancies are hard to fill, and about hospital staff turnover and collective labour agreement offers. Minister Bruins acknowledged hard-to-fill vacancies, provided turnover figures showing a net inflow of about 1,900 workers, and said that pay is a matter for social partners while the ministry provides extra funds for pay growth.
It is up to social partners to make good agreements on attractive collective labour agreements given this room.
Het is aan sociale partners om gegeven deze ruimte goede afspraken te maken over aantrekkelijke cao's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel ‘Zembla doet onderzoek naar Tuindorp-Oost: Careyn zette inspectie op het verkeerde been’

An MP asked the health minister whether the Inspectorate's announced visit to Careyn's Tuindorp-Oost complex, its limited interviewees and its failure to consult residents and the client council were consistent with its policy on unannounced inspections. The minister defended the visit as a scoped quality-and-safety check, said the Inspectorate chooses its own methods, denied that the Inspectorate endorsed Careyn's decision, and declined to characterise Careyn's conduct.
Supervision is tailor-made. The IGJ weighs in each situation what the right setting is to receive relevant information.
Toezicht is maatwerk. De IGJ maakt in elke situatie de afweging wat de juiste setting is om relevante informatie te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Miljoenen weggesluisd uit thuiszorgorganisatie Privazorg’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that millions were siphoned from home-care provider Privazorg, including the conduct and pay of its former director, and whether the Governance Code and oversight tools are adequate. The minister called the situation unacceptable, said the Governance Code is voluntary and that he is examining stronger internal and external oversight, possibly including legal anchoring of parts of the code, and said there is no current reason to fear for continuity of care.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over onrust onder BIG geregistreerde verpleegkundigen met een diploma van voor 2012

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked the Minister about unrest among experienced nurses with pre-2012 diplomas who must take a course or test to register as regieverpleegkundige under the Wet BIG II, and about attrition, competencies and recognition of prior learning. The Minister defends the 2012 cut-off and the transitional scheme as broadly supported, says the test or course is needed to show competencies, and says the EVC option will be examined.
The possibilities for this still need to be examined during the development of the training programme.
De mogelijkheden hiervan dienen nog te worden onderzocht tijdens de ontwikkeling van het scholingsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over de belastbaarheid van de premiebijdrage aan Gemeentepolis

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked whether the Tax Authority's plan to tax the part of the municipal Gemeentepolis premium covering the statutory deductible is legally justified and whether it is undesirable. The government replied that, after consultation between departments, taxing that part will not arise, and the social affairs ministry will inform municipalities.
After consultation between the departments concerned, it has been established that taxing the said part of the municipal contribution will not arise.
Na overleg tussen de betrokken departementen is vastgesteld dat het belasten van voornoemd deel van de gemeentelijke bijdrage niet aan de orde zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een gevaarlijk dieet tegen kanker

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Gerson-style anti-cancer diet, whether doctors prescribing it should be struck from the register, whether such providers exist, and whether the Inspectorate supervises them. The Minister says such diets are alternative therapies that are permitted if they cause no harm, that doctors can be sanctioned via disciplinary or criminal law, that the Inspectorate handles reports but takes no view on efficacy, and that existing enforcement tools are sufficient.
The legal enforcement instruments are therefore sufficient.
Het wettelijk handhavingsinstrumentarium is hiermee toereikend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over gemeenten die zich niet aan de AMvB reële prijs houden

Kerstens (PvdA) asked the health minister why many municipalities do not apply the AMvB reële prijs, so care providers cannot pay staff under the VVT collective agreement, and about the state of tariff adjustments. The minister disputes the claim that half of municipalities fail, cites a limited number of investigated complaints, acknowledges indexation difficulties, and points to sector agreements on national indexation guidelines and a forthcoming evaluation.
I do note that indexation is a frequently occurring point of discussion between providers and municipalities.
Ik constateer wel dat indexatie een veel voorkomend punt van discussie is tussen aanbieders en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over te dure huurwoningen voor zorgcliënten in Zwolle

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked whether the government knows of care clients forced to move because their rent is too high for their income in Zwolle, and whether rent for care housing is monitored. The minister replied that she had no such signals, explained the tenancy protection rules for care housing, said rent is not monitored against client income, and will await the municipality's study before considering further steps.
No, rent is not supervised in relation to the income of tenants (who may also be care clients).
Nee, op huurprijzen wordt geen toezicht gehouden in relatie tot het inkomen van huurders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over ondervoeding bij thuiswonende ouderen

An MP asked the health and education ministers about malnutrition among community-dwelling elderly and whether screening, training and GP guidance should be strengthened. The minister said prevention is shared with carers and professionals, pointed to existing tools and education modules, and declined to mandate structural screening or GP checks.
However, I will raise attention to these education modules in consultations with representatives of relevant training programmes.
Wel zal ik in overleggen met de vertegenwoordigers van relevante opleidingen aandacht vragen voor deze onderwijsmodules.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de berichten ‘Enschedese zorgbureau Samen Sterk speelde bank voor familie en bekenden’ en ‘Zorggeld lenen aan familie: het mag van de Twentse gemeenten’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that care providers in Enschede lent care funds to relatives and acquaintances, and whether municipalities can exclude such providers. The Minister called this undesirable, said he had no oversight data but saw no reason to investigate, and said municipalities have existing powers under the Wmo 2015 and the contract was terminated, so no further action is planned.
I have no insight into this, but I have no reason to assume this is a common practice.
Ik heb hier geen zicht op, maar ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat dit een gangbare praktijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over berichten dat foute zorgondernemers makkelijk door aanbestedingsprocedures komen

An MP asked the health minister whether fraudulent care providers can easily win new contracts after aanbesteding, given differing municipal rules in the Twente region. The minister acknowledged the fraud problem, pointed to a planned bill creating a warning register and information-sharing hub for care fraud, and said municipalities are responsible for contracting, with a VNG support programme and Twente toolbox as tools.
Therefore I am preparing legislation to improve cooperation between different bodies in tackling care fraud.
Daarom bereid ik wetgeving voor om de samenwerking tussen verschillende instanties bij het aanpakken van zorgfraude te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Alsof het journaal in het Frans wordt voorgelezen’

Two MPs asked whether the government had noticed reports that deaf and hard-of-hearing people could not follow broadcast news, and whether sign-language interpreters would be used in live crisis communication. The ministers confirmed awareness and said a plan of action to improve crisis communication for vulnerable groups, including sign-language interpreting, would be sent to parliament after the summer.
For the concrete elaboration we are drawing up a plan of action, in line with the request of the House of Representatives.
Voor de concrete uitwerking maken we een plan van aanpak, conform het verzoek van de Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over erkenning en compensatie van getraumatiseerde veteranen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about delays in medical assessments for traumatised veterans and the handling of compensation claims, and whether Defence is unwilling to cooperate. The minister answered that re-assessments were postponed due to staffing shortages, outlined temporary capacity measures, denied that Defence is uncooperative, and announced an evaluation of the compensation scheme and a review of the PTSS protocol.
In addition, we are working on revising the PTSS protocol, which examines whether the final medical situation can be determined earlier.
Daarnaast zijn wij bezig met de herziening van het PTSS-protocol dat kijkt of eerder de medische eindsituatie kan worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Dunya Zorggroep weigert dossiers te verstrekken na beslag: ‘Ik ben bang dat er mensen gaan sterven’

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Health whether it is unacceptable that Dunya Zorggroep refused to transfer patient files after seizure, what powers the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) has to enforce transfer, whether it has been enforced, whether sanctions were imposed, and how often such situations occur. The minister answered that the IGJ issued an order and instruction, then a penalty payment order with a two-day compliance period, is monitoring closely, and that the situation is exceptional.
The IGJ first issued an order and then gave an instruction to the care provider to enforce a careful transfer of the client files.
De IGJ heeft eerst een bevel opgelegd en daarna een aanwijzing gegeven aan de zorgaanbieder om een zorgvuldige overdracht van de cliëntdossiers af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over woonvormen voor dementerenden

An MP asked the ministers about shortages of suitable housing for seniors and people with dementia, whether government will stimulate initiatives like those in the Aedes agenda, and whether lessons from Germany will be applied. The minister answered that existing programmes (Woonagenda, Langer thuis) support housing and care for older people, that support is available, and that the government does not itself initiate such housing forms, without committing to new binding agreements.
Municipalities are encouraged to map the challenge of housing and care for older people and to make a plan to ensure people do not end up living unsuitably.
Gemeenten worden gestimuleerd om de opgave met betrekking tot wonen en zorg voor ouderen in beeld te brengen en een plan te maken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Avirazorg mag van inspectie geen cliënten meer aannemen, maar gaat door onder andere naam’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that home-care provider Avirazorg, barred by the inspectorate from taking new clients, continued under another name, and about overlapping board members across regional care providers. The minister called the situation undesirable, said the provider has now ceased and the inspectorate is considering further steps, and described the inspectorate's supervision approach for home care.
If care is in fact organised in the same way, I consider that undesirable.
Als de zorg feitelijk op dezelfde manier is georganiseerd, dan vind ik dat onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over de schrijnende werkwijze van de sociale dienst Laborijn

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked how the state views social services whose conduct frightens benefit recipients, whether the legal framework should be tightened, what training staff receive, and whether the state will follow up a pending investigation into Laborijn. The Secretary of State answered that recipients must be treated respectfully and privacy protected under existing law, that no national register of training exists, and that the Laborijn investigation is a local matter outside national involvement.
The announced investigation is primarily a local matter, in which involvement from central government is not at issue.
Het aangekondigde onderzoek is primair een lokale aangelegenheid, waarbij bemoeienis vanuit het Rijk niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het faillissement van zorginstelling Siza Nova Me

An MP asked the health minister about the bankruptcy of care provider Siza Nova Me, the managing director's 'brilliant failure' remark, whether the ministry would investigate, and whether the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders would prevent similar cases. The minister said the curator is responsible for investigating the causes, that the ministry sees no reason for its own investigation, and that the bill does not assess business cases.
I see no reason to conduct independent investigation of this bankruptcy in addition to the curator's investigation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om in aanvulling op het onderzoek door de curator eigenstandig onderzoek te doen naar dit faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het monddood maken van de sociaal domein cliëntenraad in Eindhoven

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether dismissals of five critical members of the Eindhoven social domain client council amounted to silencing the council and whether monitoring of municipal client councils was planned. The minister said the dismissals were reviewed by an independent objections committee which found them justified, described the municipality's clearer mandate for the council, and saw no reason for action.
I contacted the municipality of Eindhoven to inform myself about the situation.
Ik heb contact opgenomen met de gemeente Eindhoven om mij te informeren over de situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Nijboer over drempels bij het gebruik van de blijverslening

MPs Kerstens and Nijboer asked why the Blijverslening, a municipal loan for home adaptations for older residents, has been granted only 75 times since 2015, and what conditions and awareness exist. The minister confirmed the figure, attributed low uptake to limited awareness and reluctance to plan future housing needs, and said municipalities decide whether to offer the loan and on what terms, promising continued support and awareness campaigns without a new binding step.
It is up to municipalities and provinces themselves to determine to what extent the set conditions sufficiently match local needs and policy objectives.
Het is aan gemeenten en provincies zelf om te bepalen in hoeverre de gestelde voorwaarden voldoende aansluiten op de lokale behoefte en beleidsdoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht  dat dagbesteding voor gehandicapten onder druk staat (ingezonden 4 april 2019)

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that day-care services for disabled people are under pressure, with shrinking choice, closures and cuts, and whether client input and choice are being respected. The Minister acknowledged the findings, said the statutory guarantees remain, outlined a transport budget increase and NZa rule adjustment, and listed programmes to strengthen client control and independent client support.
The renewal of long-term care has not detracted from the principle that people who depend on care must receive it.
Met de vernieuwing van de langdurige zorg is geen afbreuk gedaan aan het uitgangspunt dat mensen die zijn aangewezen op zorg, deze ook moeten krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Klachten over Tuindorp-Oost gegrond: onzorgvuldig, onfatsoenlijk, geen compassie’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the Careyn complaints committee's harsh finding on the relocation of Tuindorp-Oost residents, and related Zembla reporting, indicate a pattern and what the minister thinks of it. The minister said care providers must show compassion and careful relocation support, that he has no role in individual complaints, and that IGJ inspections found no broader pattern, with the enforcement order already lifted.
I have no indications that the actions of Careyn about which the complaint was filed are part of a broader pattern.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de handelingen van Careyn waarover de klacht is ingediend, onderdeel zijn van een breder patroon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat toezichthouders een rem willen op BV-constructies

PvdA MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Health whether opaque financial BV structures in healthcare, which the NVTZ and others say hamper supervision, should be curbed and what tools IGJ and NZa have. The minister acknowledges the problem, promises to strengthen external oversight of business operations and inform parliament around summer, notes existing WTZi rules and the TIB programme, but defends such structures as sometimes legitimate.
As indicated, I am therefore working together with the IGJ and NZa on further strengthening the supervision of the business operations of healthcare providers.
Zoals aangegeven werk ik daarom samen met de IGJ en NZa aan het verder versterken van het toezicht op de bedrijfsvoering van zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over toegang tot zorg voor dementerende ouderen met een migratieachtergrond

An MP from the PvdA asked the health minister about access to care for elderly migrant dementia patients, including whether they stay at home too long and whether culture-specific nursing home care is adequate. The minister answered that no broad campaign is planned, that a Noom guideline for culture-specific nursing care will be added to the 'Thuis in het verpleeghuis' programme per an adopted motion, and that a SCP study will report in 2021.
The motion's intent is that the guideline be added to the 'Thuis in het verpleeghuis' programme.
De motie heeft als strekking dat de leidraad aan het programma «Thuis in het verpleeghuis» wordt toegevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over de uitzending van het tv-programma Kassa over de hoge afhandelingskosten van medicijnrollen

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked the minister about a Kassa broadcast on high fees for weekly medication packaging and whether prices could be justified and made transparent. The minister said weekly dispensing fees average about €3.50 and vary by pharmacy, that the NZa is reviewing a possible flat-fee model, and that a decision is expected before summer.
The NZa is reviewing this with all parties involved. I am awaiting this exercise.
De NZa bekijkt dit met alle betrokken partijen. Ik wacht deze exercitie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over onveiligheid in woonzorginstellingen

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about safety problems and weak oversight in supported-housing institutions housing ex-offenders and former TBS patients, following local media reports. The minister answered that municipalities supervise Wmo-funded supported housing, the IGJ and Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid have limited roles, no national picture is planned, and the government will send a forensic-expertise study and publish municipal oversight reports.
I do not have a national registration of the actual use by municipalities of the enforcement instruments available to them.
Ik beschik niet over een landelijke registratie van het feitelijke gebruik door gemeenten van het hun ter beschikking staande handhavingsinstrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Rijk verdeelt wmo-gelden anders: Gelderse gemeenten krijgen miljoenen minder’
