MP Kerstens asked the ministers whether the proposed new allocation model for protected housing (beschermd wonen) funds under the Wmo, which reportedly cuts funds for Gelderland municipalities, is unjust, could discourage municipalities from hosting providers, threatens access to care, and whether the government will talk with municipalities, revise the model, add money, or assign a role to provinces. The minister replied that the model follows the Toekomst Beschermd Wonen commission advice, that regional implementation agreements and consultations with the VNG are underway, that the model will be reviewed in 2019 with a final decision in spring 2020 and introduction planned for 2021 via a phased transition, and that municipalities are responsible so no provincial role is foreseen.
In spring 2020 the definitive decision on the allocation model and the timing of its introduction will be taken.
In het voorjaar van 2020 vindt definitieve besluitvorming plaats over het verdeelmodel en het moment van invoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het bericht dat 28 Gelderse gemeenten kampen met grote tekorten op de jeugdzorg

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked whether the minister shares concern that 28 Gelderland municipalities face large youth care deficits, whether children's care is at risk, and whether municipalities are adequately compensated. The minister acknowledges the signals, points to municipalities' statutory youth care duty and the council's oversight role, and refers to the ongoing 'Onderzoek Jeugd' that will turn signals into facts before deciding on measures.
Municipalities have the youth care obligation. This means they must offer timely and appropriate help to children who need it.
Gemeenten hebben de jeugdhulpplicht. Dit houdt in dat zij kinderen die dit nodig hebben tijdig passende hulp moeten bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over zich ADO-supporters noemende personen die onder ander het monument De Dokwerker in Amsterdam hebben beklad

MPs Kuiken, Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about ADO Den Haag supporters who defaced the De Dokwerker monument in Amsterdam, including criminal investigation, camera footage, administrative measures, stadium bans and antisemitism in sport. The government answered that a report was filed and is with the Public Prosecution Service, declined to discuss the investigation or evidence, pointed to the mayor's powers and the KNVB's private-law stadium bans, and described existing anti-discrimination policy in football.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het bericht dat lipfillers worden verstrekt aan minderjarigen door zowel artsen als onbevoegden

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about reports that lip fillers are administered to minors by doctors and unqualified providers, and about the IGJ's supervision. The Minister acknowledged concern, reported several signals and two notifications received by the IGJ, explained the risk-based and complaint-based supervision approach, and said the IGJ has sufficient enforcement powers and that the BIG law now explicitly covers cosmetic treatments from 1 April 2019.
In addition, the IGJ takes into account in its risk-based supervision whether fillers are placed in patients under 18 without medical necessity.
Daarnaast neemt de IGJ in haar risicotoezicht mee of fillers worden geplaatst bij patiënten onder de 18 jaar zonder medische noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de ontoegankelijkheid van de zorg

An MP asks the health minister how vulnerable people can find the right care and support, whether people lacking funds to advance equipment costs are left stranded, and what action has been taken on Ombudsman signals. The minister acknowledges the problems, commits to pushing a 'no wrong door' principle and ongoing programmes, while pointing to municipalities and insurers for equipment provision and promising to inform the House on pending evaluations.
I will work in the coming period to ensure that the 'no wrong door' principle becomes the standard in daily implementation practice.
Ik zal mij er de komende periode voor inzetten dat het principe van «no wrong door» ook in de praktijk van de dagelijkse uitvoering de standaard wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over foutieve inning eigen bijdrage door het CAK

An MP asked the Health Minister about incorrect collection of patient co-payments by the CAK and whether it has been put right; the minister answered that internal processes are being improved, that he will shorten retroactive correction periods to twelve months for serious CAK or chain-partner failures, and that the CAK will draft a plan with external advice under ministerial monitoring. The answers are substantive but give no detailed timeline and partly reframe the CAK problems as a structural challenge rather than a deterioration.
The Ministry of VWS will make agreements with the CAK to keep progress on track.
Het Ministerie van VWS zal daarbij met het CAK afspraken maken om de voortgang op koers te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over schrijnende werkwijze van de sociale dienst Laborijn

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked the state secretary about reports that the Laborijn social services agency in the Achterhoek intrudes excessively on benefit recipients, including checking fridges and shower times, and about its costs. The state secretary replied that enforcement is a municipal responsibility subject to objection and appeal, that no national intervention is warranted, and that Laborijn's board has commissioned an independent external investigation.

Within its decentralised context, it is primarily the municipal executive's responsibility to ensure the correct implementation of the Participation Act and to account for it to the municipal council.

Binnen haar gedecentraliseerde context, is het primair aan het college van B&W om zorg te dragen voor een juiste uitvoering van de Participatiewet en om daarover verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat de paarse krokodil Apeldoornse coöperatie bij hulp in laatste levensfase belemmert

An MP asked the minister about reports that the Paarse Krokodil care cooperative in Apeldoorn is hampered in providing home palliative end-of-life care by insurers' prior-authorisation requirements, and whether such barriers are being imposed deliberately. The minister finds this distressing, defends prior authorisation as a tool against unjustified care use, and points to contracting efforts and bureaucracy reduction, promising no new national inventory of barriers.
Health insurers must have purchased sufficient care to meet their duty of care.
Zorgverzekeraar moeten voldoende zorg ingekocht hebben om aan hun zorgplicht te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de brand in de serviceflat Oranjeparkflat

An MP asked the health minister about a fatal fire in a service flat for elderly residents, the results of the investigation, how fire safety supervision of such housing is organised, and whether earlier incidents led to changes. The minister answered that the cause was an accident and fire safety was in order, outlined the division of responsibilities among owners, operators, residents and municipalities, and pointed to a risk-based fire safety model and extra attention to fire safety in the health inspectorate's supervision.
The IGJ will ask care providers offering residential care, in its supervision, to explicitly pay attention to building fire safety in their risk inventory and evaluation.

De IGJ zal de zorgaanbieders die intramurale zorg aanbieden in haar toezicht vragen om in hun risico-inventarisatie en evaluatie ook nadrukkelijk aandacht te besteden aan de brandveiligheid van het gebouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat overeenkomsten worden afgekeurd door het zorgkantoor omdat de zorgverlener nog een andere baan heeft

An MP asked the minister whether it is acceptable that care-office approval of personal-budget care contracts is refused when a carer has another job, and whether low tariffs are hindering recruitment. The minister says the care office checks the 40-hour cap and may consider side jobs, but a side job alone is not grounds for rejection, and he will consult on how this is applied; he sees no structural signals that the tariff caps are too low.
However, the existence of side activities in itself cannot by definition be a reason to reject a care agreement.
Het bestaan van nevenwerkzaamheden op zich kan echter niet per definitie een reden zijn om een zorgovereenkomst af te keuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over lakse afhandeling getraumatiseerde veteraan

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Defence about the mishandling of a traumatised veteran and reservist, including repeated misconduct, failure to assess his fitness for deployment, and inadequate complaint handling. The minister acknowledged the ombudsman's criticism, listed measures taken (new pre-deployment selection, a Sociaal Medisch Team, centralised complaint coordination, an external evaluation of the complaints regulation) and rejected an independent complaints body for now, pointing to the Meldpunt Integriteit Defensie and the inspectorate.
A selection procedure has been introduced prior to a deployment.
Zo is er een selectieprocedure ingesteld voorafgaande aan een uitzending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat de monitoring eigen bijdrage Wmo tekort schiet

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the monitor of the Wmo co-payment shortfall and municipal compensation for the subscription tariff was adequate. The minister said the CPB estimates are based on CAK data, municipalities are fully compensated for estimated costs, and an independent monitor will track effects.
However, I consider it important to closely follow the more precise effects of introducing the subscription tariff in practice through a monitor.
Wel vind ik het van belang om de meer precieze effecten van de introductie van het abonnementstarief in de praktijk nauwlettend te volgen via een monitor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Meldpunt moet onafhankelijk van Defensie zijn'

An MP asked the Defence Minister why Defence recorded only four sick-soldier reports while a former staff member's own burn-pit reporting point received 122, and whether the reporting system should be reviewed, and asked for an independent reporting point. The minister replied that Defence does not know the content of the outside reports, opened an independent reporting point on 4 February 2019, and said an independent investigation will follow if reports warrant it.
For reasons of confidentiality I will not go into the contacts Defence has had with Mr Van de Nadort.
Ik ga omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid niet in op de contacten die Defensie heeft gehad met dhr. Van de Nadort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat verzekeraars 170 miljoen onbenut laten voor wijkverpleging

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether insurers leaving 170 million euro of wijkverpleging funds unspent threatens their duty of care, and whether insurers should be pressed or obliged to use the money for staff and better wages. The minister answered that contract terms are a local matter, encouraged quality and multi-year contracts, and pointed to 1.7 billion euro extra for wages in 2019 while leaving collective agreements to social partners.
The contract between health insurers and care providers is the place to make agreements about what is needed to continue delivering the right care.
Het contract tussen zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders is de plek om afspraken te maken over wat er nodig is om de juiste zorg te kunnen blijven leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis Bronovo dicht door tekort aan personeel'

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked about the closure of Bronovo hospital due to staff shortages, requesting an overview of hospitals with staff-related service cuts, vacancy and self-employed figures, and measures to address shortages. The minister said staffing is one cause among several in HMC's consolidation to two sites, cited national capacity data without a list of affected hospitals, and pointed to funding and the Werken in de Zorg programme as measures.
There is no overview of hospitals that must postpone or relocate care due to a staff shortage.
Er is geen overzicht van ziekenhuizen die zorg moeten uitstellen of verplaatsen vanwege een tekort aan personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘1,7 Miljard euro aan pgb’s onzeker of foutief’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that EUR 1.7 billion in personal budgets (pgb) may be unlawful or uncertain, and about signals on the SVB. The minister acknowledged the problems, attributed them mainly to monthly fixed payments lacking a legal basis (now fixed retroactively) and difficulty verifying delivered care, denied that fraud is the main issue, and promised further talks and a later update.
To resolve this I amended the Regulation on Long-term Care, Wmo 2015 and the Youth Act with retroactive effect from 1 January 2018, creating a legal basis for monthly payments.

Om dat op te lossen heb ik de Regeling Langdurige Zorg, Wmo 2015 en Jeugdwet met terugwerkende kracht vanaf 1 januari 2018 aangepast waarmee een wettelijke grondslag voor maandbetalingen is gecreëerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Kerstens en Den Boer over politiek verlof voor militairen om uitzending mogelijk te maken

MPs Belhaj, Kerstens and Den Boer asked whether soldiers can get political leave to attend council or assembly meetings, and whether elected councillors can temporarily transfer their seat to enable deployment abroad. The government answered that soldiers can get extraordinary leave for council duties, but that the Kieswet and Constitution allow temporary seat replacement only for pregnancy, childbirth and illness, so a constitutional amendment would be needed and it is not convinced this is necessary.
An extension of the replacement option for military deployments abroad therefore requires an amendment of the Constitution.
Een uitbreiding van de vervangingsmogelijkheid bij buitenlandse missies van militairen vereist dus een wijziging van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Vast Wmo-tarief mag niet leiden tot verschraling zorg’

MP Kerstens asked whether the fixed Wmo subscription tariff could harm vulnerable, low-income people and whether the government would guarantee no harm and compensate those affected before monitoring results appear. Minister De Jonge answered that the Wmo 2015 provides legal safeguards, municipalities are compensated for the estimated costs, and an effects monitor will follow the measure, without committing to advance guarantees or compensation.
The introduction of the subscription tariff for the Wmo co-payment may not lead to people who are dependent on it not receiving or insufficiently receiving the support they need.
De invoering van het abonnementstarief voor de eigen bijdrage Wmo kan en mag er niet toe leiden dat mensen die daarop zijn aangewezen niet of onvoldoende de ondersteuning krijgen die ze nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Landelijke tarieven moeten Wmo betaalbaar houden’

Kerstens (PvdA) asks the minister whether home-care wage increases under the VVT collective agreement are paid on time, whether the state compensates municipalities enough, and whether a higher national minimum Wmo tariff should be introduced. De Jonge answers that employers and municipalities bear primary responsibility, that municipalities are compensated, that the abonnementstarief effects will be monitored, and that a national minimum tariff is undesirable because it would limit local tailoring and innovation.
I consider the introduction of a national minimum tariff, as described in the article, undesirable.
Ik acht een invoering van een landelijk minimumtarief, zoals beschreven in het artikel, niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht '369.334 euro voor een rapport van honderd pagina's dat in een la ligt'

An MP asked ministers about a press report that a health-sector foundation paid about 369,000 euro for a 100-page report, allegedly as a disguised golden handshake for a former executive via a WNT-evading construction. The minister disputes the press framing, says the WNT does not apply to this private foundation, and states the cabinet sees no reason to add an anti-abuse clause to the WNT.
It is up to the commissioning party of the research, in this case Espria, to judge that.
Het is aan de opdrachtgever van het onderzoek, in dit geval Espria, om daarover te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Toeloop verwacht voor zorg van de gemeente door nieuwe regeling’

An MP asked the health minister whether the new Wmo income-based subscription tariff will harm low-income people and whether gemeenten are sufficiently compensated, with extra demand expected. The minister says gemeenten are compensated, the Wmo 2015 gives adequate safeguards, and an agreed monitor will track effects with a power to adjust rules by AMvB if needed.
With the VNG I have therefore agreed to closely monitor the effects in practice using a monitor, and to act on it if the monitor's results give cause to do so.
Met de VNG heb ik dan ook afgesproken om de effecten in de praktijk met behulp van een monitor nauwlettend te volgen én als de resultaten van de monitor hiertoe aanleiding geven, hierop te acteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over een misbruikdrama in de atletiekwereld

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked why a 2009 report of boundary-crossing conduct by an athletics coach led to no investigation, whether the athletics federation should have reported to police, whether criminal complaints were filed, and whether tuchtrecht rulings should feed into criminal prosecution and VOG screening. The minister said the police-led investigation covers the earlier report and cannot be discussed, that criminal law takes precedence over disciplinary law, that the Centrum Seksueel Geweld and Slachtofferhulp can help victims, and that linking sports disciplinary lists to the VOG is not desirable.
To get a good picture of the matters at issue, the police investigation team led by the Public Prosecution Service gathers as much relevant information as possible.
Om een goed beeld te krijgen van de zaken die spelen en gespeeld hebben, vergaart het onderzoeksteam van politie onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) zoveel mogelijk relevante informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over onvoldoende bescherming voor leden van cliëntenraden vanuit de Participatiewet

Two PvdA MPs asked whether members of client councils under the Participation Act can be dismissed by municipal boards for being too political, and whether the law protects them adequately. The state secretary said the matter is for the municipality and gemeenteraad, that the law sufficiently anchors client participation, and that no legislative change is planned, pointing instead to a Movisie project and the evaluation due end 2019.
I do not intend to amend the Participation Act.
Ik ben niet voornemens de Participatiewet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Waarschuwing voor flinke tegenvaller gemeenten'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that municipalities may receive at least 100 million euro less from the municipal fund than assumed, and whether this would worsen their finances in social domain services and shift burdens onto vulnerable residents. The Minister denied that the figure was correct, said the definitive figure will come with the May 2019 circular, rejected the claim of a budget-driven shift onto vulnerable citizens, and promised a joint analysis of youth care with the VNG reported in spring 2019 plus monitoring of the Wmo co-payment change.
The cabinet is currently jointly conducting an in-depth study of youth care with the VNG.
Het kabinet voert momenteel gezamenlijk met de VNG een verdiepend onderzoek naar jeugdhulp uit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Fataal defect crash Mali niet door ontwerp maar verbogen onderdeel’

An MP asked the Defence minister about press reports that the Mali Apache crash was caused by a bent component during maintenance by an external US party, and whether the full crash report and liability claims would be shared or pursued. The minister confirmed the component was bent but that the cause of bending could not be established, declined to share the full confidential report citing ITAR and personal data, and said liability was excluded under FMS conditions.
The report is confidential because it contains, among other things, technical data falling under International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) export control rules.

Het rapport heeft een vertrouwelijk karakter, omdat het rapport onder andere technische gegevens bevat die vallen onder International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)-regelgeving voor exportcontrole.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Zorg-zzp’er verdringt verpleging in vaste dienst’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that self-employed care workers (zzp'ers) are displacing permanent nursing staff, including trends, reasons for self-employment, rates and pension coverage. The minister acknowledged the signals as worrying, announced an action-oriented study by VWS and referred to the Actieprogramma Werken in de Zorg, while providing available figures and noting that some data could not be verified.
Given my wish to quickly have insight into a realistic course of action, VWS will shortly commission an (action-oriented) study in which all relevant aspects are mapped out.

Gegeven mijn wens om snel zicht te hebben op een reëel handelingsperspectief zal VWS op korte termijn een (actiegericht) onderzoek laten uitzetten, waarbij alle relevante aspecten in kaart worden gebracht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de erbarmelijke staat van de vliegschool in Woensdrecht

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the poor condition of the flight school buildings at Woensdrecht, including mould, the decision to sign a new-build permit, chromium-6 paint, meteorological systems and airfield closures, and whether a property overview would be given. The government answered that the new build is delayed, interim repairs are underway with no unsafe conditions found, the chromium-6 risk is limited, a property plan will follow by June 2019, and that the questions could not be answered before the budget debate.
As promised in, among others, the WGO-P, the House will receive the Strategic Real Estate Plan by 1 June 2019 at the latest.
Zoals u is toegezegd in o.a. het WGO-P, krijgt de Kamer uiterlijk 1 juni 2019 het Strategisch Vastgoed Plan toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel ‘Veldhovense wethouder: Budgetplafonds Eindhoven gaan in tegen de wet'

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether municipal budget caps on youth care and social support providers conflict with the municipal duty of care under the Jeugdwet and Wmo 2015, and whether the Minister would intervene in Eindhoven. The Minister replied that budget caps are not per se incompatible with the law, that municipal councils are first responsible for controlling the executive, and that he sees no reason to intervene in Eindhoven at present.

If the executive fails to meet its legal responsibilities, in this case contracting sufficient providers to meet demand for support, the municipal council is first in line to scrutinise and correct the executive.

Mocht het college nalaten om aan de wettelijke verantwoordelijkheden, in dit geval het voldoende gecontracteerd hebben van aanbieders om aan de vraag om ondersteuning te kunnen voldoen, dan is in eerste instantie de gemeenteraad aan zet om het college hierop te controleren en bij te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel ‘Geweerde zorgbureaus slepen in andere Twentse gemeenten nieuw contract in de wacht’

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health about reports that excluded home-care agencies were winning new contracts in other Twente municipalities, asking whether the IGJ would investigate and whether municipalities are taking unacceptable risks with care funds. The minister replied that the IGJ has no ongoing investigation into these agencies, that municipalities bear primary responsibility for contracting and quality checks, and that he sees no reason to act against the municipalities concerned.
Currently, an investigation by the social investigation service is still ongoing.
Op dit moment loopt nog onderzoek van de sociale recherche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over tekortschietend onderzoek naar ongewenst gedrag

MP Kerstens asked the Defence Minister whether the government will act on the Giebels commission's finding that inquiries into unwanted conduct within Defence are inadequate, including whether it will consider an external reporting point and how it will restore staff trust. The state secretary replied that a central independent reporting point will be placed with COID and be operational early next year, that a broader policy response will follow by end 2018, and that concrete plans for social safety will come later this year.
This independent central reporting point will be housed at the Central Organisation for Integrity Defence (COID) and will be operational early next year.
Dit onafhankelijke centrale meldpunt zal worden belegd bij de Centrale Organisatie Integriteit Defensie (COID) en is begin volgend jaar operationeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Bescherming Defensiepersoneel tegen chroom-6 onvoldoende’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about internal documents and a media report stating that protection of defence personnel against chromium-6 remains insufficient despite earlier commitments, and whether this undermines Defence's credibility as an employer. The State Secretary answered that concrete measures are underway, that remaining exposures above limit values are handled with personal protective equipment, that delays are due to capacity and industry dependence, and that Defence has failed in its duty of care in the past.
Defence naturally aims to improve working conditions so that wearing respiratory protection is no longer necessary.
Defensie streeft er uiteraard naar om de werksituaties zodanig te verbeteren dat het dragen van adembescherming niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de berichten ‘Oproep aan ouders en personeel Arduin: spreek je samen uit’ en ‘Arduin is in nood, maar raad van toezicht verhoogt eigen beloning flink’

An MP asked the health minister about reports of a fear culture at care provider Arduin, dismissals of staff who spoke out, and a large pay rise for its supervisory board. The minister said the IGJ monitors Arduin closely, that the board's raise was unwise, and asked CIBG to check compliance with the top-income standards.
I have asked the agency CIBG to investigate whether there is a violation of the Top Income Standards Act in this case.
Ik heb het agentschap CIBG gevraagd te onderzoeken of in dit geval sprake is van een overtreding van de Wet Normering Topinkomens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de ernstig vervuilde grond van het beoogd terrein voor de Marinierskazerne in Vlissingen

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the planned Vlissingen Marine barracks site is seriously contaminated, since when Defence and the province knew, and whether the Marines' unions were informed. The State Secretary answered that contamination was known at the 2012 siting decision, that the site will be remediated where needed to meet regulations, and that the unions and works council were informed through studies and meetings.
We will ensure that during the further consultation with the TRMC, the works council is kept informed of further developments in the soil file.
We zullen er zorg voor dragen dat gedurende het vervolg van het overleg met de TRMC de medezeggenschap over de verdere ontwikkelingen in het gronddossier op de hoogte wordt gehouden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over falend toezicht en ongeschoold personeel in de thuiszorg

MP Kerstens asked the health minister why the inspectorate does not intervene against thuiszorg providers failing basic requirements and employing unqualified staff, and what will be done about it. The minister acknowledges the findings, says the IGJ demands improvement with follow-up visits and escalates enforcement where needed, and points to the Wtza bill and the Werken in de Zorg programme.
The IGJ therefore demands further improvement from those care providers.
De IGJ eist daarom verdere verbetering bij die zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel 'Gemor over steun aan majoor Kroon'

MP Kerstens asked the Defence State Secretary whether a newspaper report about Defence paying legal costs for Major Kroon was accurate, whether the agreements were precedent-setting, and how such payments are justified to other staff. The minister confirmed the agreements, said they were based on AMAR article 115 and assessed case by case, and declined to provide an overview of legal-cost payments because Defence keeps no central registration.
Defence does not apply a uniform and central form of registration of the costs of legal assistance provided.
Defensie hanteert geen eenduidige en centrale vorm van registratie van de kosten van juridische bijstand die verleend wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Duizenden minima dreigen voordelige zorgverzekering kwijt te raken’

MPs Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the minister whether Menzis's plan to end collective health insurance for low-income groups outside its core regions, and the resulting possible loss of cheaper cover, was acceptable and how it affects trust in insurers. The minister answered that it is primarily up to municipalities and insurers to shape cooperation, that Menzis extends some contracts to 2020, that alternatives exist, and that the matter will be discussed with insurers and municipalities without committing to concrete new measures.
It is primarily a responsibility of municipalities and insurers themselves to shape cooperation for specific target groups.
Het is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en verzekeraars zelf om samenwerking voor specifieke doelgroepen vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Chroom-6 verf aangetroffen op speedboten Koninklijke Marine’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence how the government will respond to reports that chromium-6 paint was found on Royal Netherlands Navy FRISC speedboats, whether affected staff will be contacted, whether the existing compensation scheme covers them, and whether RIVM research will be extended. The State Secretary says staff were informed and can register, workshops were closed and cleaned, a calamity procedure applies, the compensation scheme currently covers only POMS-location workers, and RIVM research on other defence locations is being prepared with the joint committee to set its scope.
Once the research design and timeline have been set by the joint committee, I will inform your House in the usual way.
Zodra de onderzoeksopzet en de tijdsplanning voor dit onderzoek door de paritaire commissie is vastgesteld zal ik uw Kamer hierover op de gebruikelijke manier informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de blootstelling aan chroom-6 bij de Koninklijke Marine

The MP asked whether the supplier of Navy FRISC boats guaranteed the vessels were free of Chromium-6, what follows if chromium-6 was found, and whether future purchase contracts will ban chromium-6 paint. The State Secretary confirmed the supplier declared no carcinogenic substances would be used, that an investigation into chromium-6 treatment is ongoing with liability and maintenance measures to follow, and that Defence already restricts chromium-6 coatings in procurement, with a few aviation-related exceptions.
An investigation is currently underway into which components have been treated with chromium-6.
Op dit moment wordt onderzocht welke onderdelen met chroom-6 zijn behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de tekorten aan wijkverpleegkundigen in de zomer

An MP asked the Minister of Health about shortages of district nurses in summer 2018, including reports that office staff were deployed to cover gaps and whether the shortfall was underestimated. The minister said the shortage is structural across care and welfare, pointed to the Actieprogramma Werken in de Zorg, the 2018-2021 Hoofdlijnenakkoord Wijkverpleging, and the Inspectie's monitoring of non-care staff use, while declining to confirm the one-in-three figure or the vacancy count.
I cannot confirm the number of open care vacancies mentioned in the article.
Het in het artikel genoemde aantal openstaande zorgvacatures kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het achterblijven van verhoogde thuiszorgtarieven

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether most municipalities are lagging in raising home-care tariffs to match the new VVT collective agreement and whether this threatens providers and care access. The minister answered that it is too early to judge, that municipalities have until 1 January 2019 to agree new tariffs, that the monitoring group and an evaluation study are ongoing, and that the tariff map's picture of widespread lagging is not supported.
It is still too early to establish nationally how municipalities have translated this year's collective agreements for nursing, care and home care into municipal care tariffs.

Het is nog te vroeg om landelijk vast te stellen op welke wijze gemeenten de cao-afspraken, die dit jaar voor de verpleging, verzorging en thuiszorg zijn gemaakt, hebben vertaald naar de gemeentelijke zorgtarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de grootverdieners in de zorgsector

An MP asks the health minister about a report of very high profits in home-care provision funded by public money, the absence of follow-up checks on care delivery in Almelo, extending the Wet toelating zorginstellingen to Wmo services, options to curb profits in extramural care, and whether owners fall under the planned top-income legislation. The minister points to a forthcoming letter on profit distribution with results by early 2019, explains that municipalities are responsible for checking Wmo providers, rejects extending the WTZi to Wmo services, and says owners acting as top functionaries are already covered by the WNT.
In my view, bringing Wmo 2015 under the WTZi does not fit the decentralised system in which municipalities are responsible for implementing the Wmo 2015.
Naar mijn oordeel past het onder de WTZi brengen van de Wmo 2015 niet in het gedecentraliseerde stelsel waarin gemeenten verantwoordelijk zijn voor de uitvoering van de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Trillende handen aan het bed’ (uitbuiting in de thuiszorg)

MPs Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about exploitation of Bulgarian live-in home-care workers by Care4You and related firms, and about municipal underpayment for home care. The ministers said inspections are ongoing, enforcement rests with labour and care inspectorates, and reviews of the reasonable-price decree are underway with results due in 2019.
I have asked the care offices to further investigate the roughly ten cases in this case in which PGB care is purchased.
Ik heb de zorgkantoren gevraagd om het tiental zaken waarin in deze casus pgb-zorg wordt ingekocht nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de frauduleuze praktijken van NAVO’s cateraar Suprême

MP Kerstens asked the Defence Minister about alleged fraudulent practices by NATO catering contractor Supreme Group, including contracting choices, a 2013 US Senate hearing, the EUR 2.8 million overpayment, integrity reporting, liability for private contractors, and why the contract ran until December 2017. The minister answered that audits found overcharging which was repaid, no criminal referral was deemed necessary, contract terms were revised, and provisions were procured via pragmatic and procurement-based decisions with some questions left unanswered or referred elsewhere.
Given the nature of the findings and the fact that the overpaid amount was repaid to Defence, the ADR judged there was no reason for a criminal report.
Vanwege de aard van de bevindingen en het feit dat het te veel betaalde bedrag is terugbetaald aan Defensie, heeft de ADR geoordeeld dat er geen aanleiding was voor aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de verwarring die is ontstaan over het marineterrein in Amsterdam

An MP asked the Defence Minister about conflicting reports over whether the navy site in Amsterdam will be handed to the city, its link to the defence budget, the costs of keeping it, and its security role. The state secretary answered that Defence wants to keep part of the site for public order and security reasons, estimated savings of up to 4.2 million euros per year from divesting it, and promised to inform parliament once talks with the property agency and the city conclude.
Only once agreement is reached with the other parties on which part of the site Defence keeps can the effect on operating costs be calculated.
Pas als met de andere partijen is overeengekomen welk terreindeel Defensie behoudt, kan worden berekend wat dit betekent voor de exploitatielasten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij Arduin in Zeeland

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of high workload and staff shortages at Arduin, a disability care provider in Zeeland, including whether the inspectorate knew, whether the change process caused the complaints, and high sick leave. The minister said the inspectorate found shortcomings, held a meeting with the board in January 2018, chose not to impose enforcement measures, and is monitoring the change process through quarterly reports and unannounced visits.
The inspectorate therefore decided not to take enforcement measures and to closely monitor the change process.
De inspectie heeft daarom besloten niet over te gaan tot handhavingsmaatregelen en het verandertraject nauwlettend te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens en Van den Hul over de studentenstop bij zorgopleidingen terwijl er een personeelstekort is in de zorg

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked why nursing schools impose an intake cap (studentenstop) while the care sector faces staff shortages, whether the vicious circle of shortages and too few placements is recognised, whether stipends for placement supervision are being negotiated, and whether trainees are used as full-time staff. The minister replied that hogescholen are dropping the numerus fixus for nursing from 2019/2020, that regional action plans, the SectorplanPlus and the Stagefonds are the instruments used, that no negotiation on supervision fees is taking place, and that using trainees as full staff is undesirable and left to schools and care institutions to resolve.
I financially support this programme with the SectorplanPlus.
Dit programma ondersteun ik financieel met het SectorplanPlus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat Defensie klagers nog altijd niet serieus neemt

An MP asks whether Defence still fails to take complaints from current and former staff seriously, as the Veterans Ombudsman reported little improvement since 2016, and about registering oral complaints, protection of complainants against reprisals, and the effect on Defence's image. The minister acknowledges remaining shortcomings, lists new complaint-registration and reporting measures, defends limiting oral complaint registration, and promises an external evaluation of complaint handling.
To enable further improvement, an external party will be asked to carry out an evaluation of complaint handling.
Om een verdere verbetering mogelijk te maken, zal een externe partij worden gevraagd een evaluatie van de klachtbehandeling uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel ‘Zorgtop verdient aanzienlijk minder dan vijf jaar geleden’

An MP asked whether the government will ensure the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) is applied in spirit, not just letter, after hospital Nij Smellinghe reportedly gave two directors large severance payments without disclosure because they were not formally 'topfunctionarissen'. The minister replied that WNT compliance is good, that the disclosure duty for non-top-officials' severance was removed in 2017, and that institutions decide what transparency is appropriate, without committing to new action.
Within the limits the law sets, it is up to the institutions themselves to determine what an appropriate degree of disclosure is.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet stelt, is het aan de instellingen zelf om te bepalen wat een passende mate van openbaarmaking is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over fors duurder wordend zorgvervoer

An MP asked whether the abolition of the BPM refund scheme for taxis would make patient transport (wheelchair users, dialysis patients) substantially more expensive and reduce available transport. The minister denied a large cost increase, pointing to greening incentives, indexation of contracts, municipal duty of care and health insurance reimbursement, without committing to a new measure.
With the abolition of the BPM refund scheme for taxis, the cabinet aims to further green taxi transport.
Met de afschaffing van de BPM-teruggaveregeling voor taxi's beoogt het kabinet het taxivervoer verder te vergroenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Volp over de website www.werkenmetwajong.nl.

MPs Kerstens and Volp asked the State Secretary about the website werkenmetwajong.nl, which promotes side jobs, including in sex work, to Wajong beneficiaries and gives an impression of official government information, including links to UWV and the national government. The State Secretary said the site is not a government site, the national government's link was removed on request, UWV was asked to inform staff, and the operator was asked to stop targeting Wajongers but declined.
I have therefore asked UWV to actively inform its internal staff who deal with Wajongers about this.
Ik heb daarom UWV verzocht om intern UWV medewerkers die te maken hebben met Wajongers hierover actief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kerstens over misstanden bij het ziekteverzuimbedrijf Acture

MPs Karabulut and Kerstens asked the minister about reports of abuses at sick-leave company Acture, including pressure on doctors and re-examinations declaring workers recovered. The minister answered that such pressure is unacceptable, strengthened occupational doctors' independence and a second-opinion right, explained UWV's oversight role, and declined to order an Inspectorate investigation on the broadcast alone.
Sick people may not be pressured to return to work if, for medical reasons, they are not yet able to do so.
Zieke mensen mogen niet onder druk worden gezet om weer aan het werk te gaan indien zij daar – wegens medische redenen – nog niet toe in staat zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Kerstens over de recycling van afgedankte smartphones

MPs Cegerek and Kerstens asked about recycling of discarded smartphones, Greenpeace's call on manufacturers, collection volumes, repair incentives, collection actions and the role of shops, recycling targets, and jobs. The state secretary answered that roughly half of about 900,000 discarded phones yearly are estimated to be recycled through certified channels, that existing producer collection and WEEE targets apply, and that circular-economy measures are under development, with a KPMG jobs study due in 2017.
No recent figures are known for this.
Hier zijn geen recente cijfers van bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Van Laar en Kerstens over korting van het pensioenfonds Caribisch Nederland

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior and the State Secretary of Social Affairs about planned pension cuts at the Caribbean Netherlands pension fund PCN, including a 3.5% cut in April 2017 and possible further cuts in 2018 under DNB supervision rules, and the reduced recovery period. The government confirmed the 3.5% cut and that further cuts depend on funding levels, explained the different recovery rules for Caribbean Netherlands, said it will work on targeted support measures, and declined to answer the question on PCN's 2010 capitalisation because the matter is before the court.
The cabinet, as an employer, is one of the social partners and is involved in talks about PCN's financial situation in that role.
Het kabinet is als werkgever één van de sociale partners, en is vanuit die rol betrokken bij de gesprekken over de financiële situatie van PCN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jacobi over het bericht 'Onderbetaling bij aanleg Centrale As'

MPs Kerstens and Jacobi asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of underpayment and sham constructions on the Centrale As project, and whether the province of Friesland as principal client should act and whether it could hide behind the timing of the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies. The minister said the province had engaged the contractor and FNV, that the Inspectie SZW report is for the complainant only, that liability runs through the employer chain, and that government clients will receive further awareness outreach.
It is therefore not for me to share information from this report with your House.
Het is dan ook niet aan mij om informatie uit dit rapport met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij de Primark in Groningen

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported working conditions at the Primark store in Groningen, including workload, intimidation, ignored health complaints, unpaid overtime, and missing works councils, and whether the Labour Inspectorate would inspect and act. The minister said he could not confirm the signals, that the Inspectorate has accepted a union request for further investigation, that earlier inspections led to limited action, and that the company has announced it will set up a works council, with the ministry to raise the legal duty with the clothing sector.
FNV has shared its findings with the Labour Inspectorate and recently requested a further investigation into working conditions at Primark.
FNV heeft haar bevindingen met de Inspectie SZW gedeeld en heeft recent aan de Inspectie een verzoek gedaan tot een nader onderzoek naar de arbeidsomstandigheden bij Primark.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over verspilling van belasting- en premiegeld voor een afkoopsom van een directeur van een zorginstelling die nooit als zodanig heeft gewerkt

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why a 65,000 euro severance payment to a care-institution director who never actually worked there was acceptable, and whether such payments should be banned. The minister called it regrettable but an isolated incident, said the WNT supervisor found no similar cases, and rejected a statutory ban, leaving such disputes to the parties or courts.
I regard it as an incident.
Ik beschouw het als een incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de werkomstandigheden van heiwerkers in Kampen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of pile-driving workers falling ill from contaminated construction sites in Kampen, asking how often the Inspectorate halts work for this reason, what rules apply, and whether client and contractor compliance will be improved. The minister gave the 2015 and 2016 figures on stop orders, described the Arbeidsomstandighedenbesluit duties of employers and clients, and listed recent measures such as updated building-process rules and a client-responsibility web page.
In 2015 the Labour Inspectorate halted work on contaminated soil nine times.
De Inspectie SZW heeft in 2015 negen keer de werkzaamheden stilgelegd bij werkzaamheden in verontreinigde grond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over ontslaguitkeringen voor NS-managers

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the 565,956 euro in termination payments for two NS managers was justified, on what criteria, and whether the state as sole shareholder could approve, limit or prevent such payments. The minister answered that the payments were agreed individually due to the loss of suitable posts, that the shareholder only has powers over appointment, dismissal and pay of board members, and that the WNT does not apply to NS.
Under company law, as shareholder I only have powers regarding the appointment, dismissal and remuneration of the members of the executive board and supervisory board.

Op basis van het vennootschapsrecht komen mij als aandeelhouder alleen bevoegdheden toe op het gebied van benoeming, ontslag en beloning van de leden van de raad van bestuur en de raad van commissarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Marcouch over discriminatie bij Amsterdamse uitzendbureaus

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported discrimination by Amsterdam temp agencies and whether such agencies could be excluded from public contracts. The minister acknowledged discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to complaint bodies, anti-discrimination contract clauses and awareness campaigns, declined to take specific action on Amsterdam agencies, and said the Inspectorate SZW targets temp agencies by risk without naming inspected agencies.
Following your question, I will specifically draw the attention of the municipality of Amsterdam to this.
Naar aanleiding van uw vraag zal ik de gemeente Amsterdam hier nog specifiek op attenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over grote werkgevers die bewust werknemers ‘slapend’ in dienst houden

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether large employers keep sick workers on 'sleeping' contracts to avoid paying the transition payment, and what should be done. The minister agreed it is improper but said courts have not treated it as culpable conduct, and pointed to forthcoming legislation compensating employers for these payments, with a 1 January 2019 start that cannot be brought forward.
I am of the view that keeping an employee on the payroll solely to avoid paying a transition payment yet does not reflect decent employership.
Ik ben van mening dat het enkel in dienst houden van een werknemer om (nog) geen transitievergoeding te hoeven betalen niet getuigt van fatsoenlijk werkgeverschap
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een afkoopsom voor een directeur van een zorginstelling die daar nooit gewerkt heeft

An MP asked the minister whether a 65,000 euro severance payment to a care-institution director who never actually started work is permitted under the WNT pay-cap law, and whether the regulator would investigate. The minister answered that the WNT caps severance at one year's salary (max 75,000 euro), that the regulator sees no reason to investigate, that the payment is a wasteful but legal settlement under the employment contract, and that no general anti-abuse provision is needed.
I consider the whole course of events a regrettable waste of care money.
Ik acht de hele gang van zaken een betreurenswaardige verspilling van zorggeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over "misstanden in de schoonmaaksector"

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that over half of 156 cleaning companies inspected in 2016 breached labour laws and a third were fined, and asked when full inspection results would be sent, which other sectors are risky, whether additional measures are needed, and what the Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag achieves. The minister confirmed the figures, promised the 2016 annual report around May 2017 and a letter on the cleaning programme in spring, described ongoing sector-level interventions and risk-based inspections, and said the Code appears to have a positive effect while only cautiously concluding so.
On the findings of the 2016 Cleaning Programme I will inform your House this spring.
Over de bevindingen van het Programma Schoonmaak in 2016 zal ik uw Kamer dit voorjaar informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over tijdelijk werken vanuit de bijstand

MP Kerstens asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about making temporary work easier for people on welfare benefits (bijstand) and what the government would do to remove bureaucratic obstacles. The State Secretary answered that temporary and part-time work can be a stepping stone, that the earnings exemption was extended to six non-consecutive months from April 2016, and that gross-based benefit payment was not desirable for now, while promising continued monitoring and experiments from 2017.
I will continue to monitor and evaluate the implementation of the Participation Act to see where improvements are possible.
Ik blijf de uitvoering van de Participatiewet monitoren en evalueren om te bezien waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het bericht 'DHL: overheid dwingt ons tot aannemen zelfstandige bezorgers'

MPs Mei Li Vos and Kerstens asked the ministers whether the postal sector's reliance on self-employed couriers, and the postponed enforcement of the Wet DBA, encourages sham self-employment and unfair competition, and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that businesses may freely choose employment forms, that enforcement is postponed to at least 1 January 2018 with a review of criteria planned, and that the low-income employer allowance and Wet werk en zekerheid reduce cost and status gaps, but did not commit to new concrete measures against sham self-employment in postal work.
Enforcement of the Wet DBA is suspended until at least 1 January 2018, unless there are malicious actors.
Handhaving van de Wet DBA is opgeschort tot in ieder geval 1 januari 2018, tenzij sprake is van kwaadwillenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Voortman en Karabulut over schoonmakers die werken bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse zaken

MPs asked whether the government will act on cleaners at the Foreign Affairs ministry who may lose jobs after the move to Rijnstraat 8, including whether the government as client will protect their security, alternative work, and a permanent post at the Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie. The minister says the contractor ISS has no legal obligation to take over staff, no specific employment requirements were set, a social plan with partial takeover (9 of 21) was contractually agreed, and the Social Affairs minister is examining priority placement in other government buildings.
I will have the implementation of this plan supervised.
Ik zal toezicht laten houden op de uitvoering van dit plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Niet iedereen blij met baan plus bijstand'

An MP asked whether the Flextensie scheme, which lets welfare recipients work temporarily while keeping benefits at a low hourly rate, avoids displacing regular paid jobs, and about duration, voluntariness, sanctions and outcomes. The state secretary answered that municipalities have discretion and must prevent displacement under the Participation Act, that work is voluntary with a time limit of three to six months, and that an impact study is planned while no special agreements were made with Flextensie.
Municipalities themselves decide for which target group they wish to use Flextensie.
Gemeenten maken zelf de afweging voor welke doelgroep zij een beroep willen doen op Flextensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over de berichten ‘Helft websites overheid onveilig’ en ‘Veel overheid websites onnodig onveilig’

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked the ministers whether government websites are insecure, whether over half lack encrypted connections, and what risks this poses, and whether UWV's sites are affected. Minister Plasterk answered that organisations are responsible for securing their sites, that agreed targets require HTTPS on sensitive pages by end 2017, that progress is being measured, and that UWV sensitive data is adequately protected.
Each government organisation is ultimately itself responsible for securing its own government websites.
Elke overheidsorganisatie is uiteindelijk zelf verantwoordelijk voor het beveiligen van de eigen overheidswebsites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het bericht 'Nieuwe opwinding over GIEL-salaris'

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked whether a reported salary of 560,000 euros for a public broadcaster's radio presenter is reasonable and whether non-top staff in the public sector should fall under the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT). The State Secretary called such a salary unreasonable and said the WNT-3 bill extending the pay norm to non-top staff, including presenters, is expected to go to the Council of State for advice soon.
The cabinet also wants the statutory pay norm to apply to non-top officials in the (semi-)public sector, including presenters, programme makers and radio DJs at the public broadcaster.
Het kabinet wil daarnaast dat de wettelijke bezoldigingsnorm ook op niet-topfunctionarissen in de (semi)publieke sector van toepassing wordt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het topinkomen van een radiomaker

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about reports that a public broadcasting radio presenter earns about 560,000 euro a year, and whether public-broadcaster staff should fall under the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) salary cap of 181,000 euro. The government says it cannot verify the reported salary from WNT disclosures, finds such pay undesirable, has demanded concrete follow-up from the broadcaster, and says a WNT-3 bill extending the cap to non-top officials is in preparation.
I have ordered the public broadcaster to inform me shortly which concrete follow-up steps it intends to take regarding a more responsible hiring and remuneration policy.
Ik heb de publieke omroep gesommeerd mij op korte termijn te laten weten welke concrete vervolgstappen zij voornemens is te zetten op het terrein van een meer verantwoord inhuur- en beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Wolbert over de Wet Normering topinkomens voor de zorgsector

MPs Kerstens and Wolbert asked whether the WNT pay cap applies to self-employed healthcare professionals such as GPs, dentists and pharmacists, and about the CIBG questionnaire. The minister answered that the WNT applies by law based on organisational form, that CIBG designates no institutions, that the questionnaire was halted to allow consultation, and that medical specialists will be excluded from the WNT via a bill in preparation.
The CIBG does not designate any institutions.
Het CIBG wijst geen instellingen aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over het bericht dat jaaropgaven van 1712 cliënten van enkele Groningse sociale diensten per ongeluk aan een andere cliënt zijn toegestuurd

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked about the misdirected sending of 1,712 income statements of clients of Groningen social services, the data leak risk, the number of municipal data leaks, security of municipal systems and readiness for the new GDPR. Minister Plasterk answered that the incident is a data leak reported to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, that municipalities remain responsible for their own information security, and that VNG and KING provide support, while the DPA does not comment on investigations.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority does not make statements about possible investigations.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens doet geen mededelingen over eventuele onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Kerstens over de gemeente Haarlem en Tilburg die op basis van payrolling mensen in dienst nemen

MPs Vermeij and Kerstens asked about municipalities such as Haarlem and Tilburg hiring staff via payrolling for structural work and whether the government will act. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own employment policy, that social partners are already examining the issue, and that the central government sees no need for further action; payrolling rose slightly among municipalities and has ended in central government.
Municipalities are themselves competent and responsible, within the framework of general legislation and collective agreements, for their employment conditions policy and business operations.
Gemeenten zijn namelijk zelf bevoegd en verantwoordelijk binnen de kaders van algemene wetgeving en cao's voor hun arbeidsvoorwaardenbeleid en bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Hoe Ajax en Feyenoord flirten met te jonge buitenlandse talenten’

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked whether Ajax and Feyenoord evade FIFA and Dutch rules when recruiting very young foreign football talents, and whether rules should change. The minister replied that FIFA article 19 and the Wav already give strict safeguards, no unlawful transfers are known, a referee-style intermediary quality mark is being developed, and no further talks are needed.
Moreover, I am not aware of any cases of unlawful transfers of (too) young talented football players.
Overigens zijn bij mij geen gevallen bekend van onrechtmatige transfers van (te) jonge talentvolle voetbalspelers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Kerstens over het arrest van de Hoge Raad dat payrolling synoniem staat voor uitzendwerk

MPs Vermeij and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Supreme Court ruling that payrolling falls under the temporary-agency rules and whether this will lead to more insecure contracts. The minister confirmed awareness, said the rules apply to triangular relations and that legislative change is needed but will not come in this cabinet period, deferring to a future coalition agreement.
However, a legislative amendment will not be achievable within this cabinet period.
Een wetswijziging zal echter niet meer in deze kabinetsperiode verwezenlijkt kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Kerstens over flexwerkers die aanzienlijk minder verdienen dan collega’s in vaste dienst

MPs Vermeij and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about CBS findings that flex workers earn much less than permanent staff, and whether this violates equal pay. The minister acknowledged the gap, noted that controlling only for hours and tenure leaves differences, said equal pay for equal work is legally required but that courts, not the minister, judge violations, and said the Wwz reforms will be evaluated in 2018 and 2020.
Whether the above legal provisions are being violated, I cannot assess on the basis of the outcomes of this research.
Of in strijd wordt gehandeld met bovengenoemde wettelijke bepalingen kan ik aan de hand van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over de uitbuiting van zeelieden

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Council of State ruling that the seafarers' union Nautilus is an interested party entitled to appeal the rejection of its enforcement request concerning exploitation of seafarers. The minister said the ruling concerns standing rather than exploitation itself, that the Inspectorate found a violation by a different company and fined it, and that the ruling will be applied immediately.
The ruling makes clear that Nautilus must be regarded as an interested party within the meaning of the General Administrative Law Act (Awb) regarding the enforcement request.
De uitspraak maakt duidelijk dat Nautilus moet worden beschouwd als belanghebbende in de zin van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht (Awb) bij het handhavingsverzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Overname levert NXP-topman 391 miljoen op’

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Minister of Finance about reports that the NXP executive would receive about 391 million euros from the takeover, questioning the pay level, short-termism, pay ratios, possible repayment of about 50 million euros in subsidies, variable pay limits, and whether the Tang-Irrgang conflict-of-interest rules apply. The government replied that it has no opinion on the amount, points to existing corporate governance code rules and pending EU and Dutch legislation on pay transparency, explains that NXP received 96 million euros in innovation subsidies with no grounds for repayment, notes financial-sector pay rules differ from other sectors, and states the conflict-of-interest provision in Article 2:129a BW bars executive directors from deciding on their own pay.
Reclaiming the subsidy is therefore not an issue.
Terugvordering van subsidie is daarom niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Kerstens over het recht op een werkloosheidsuitkering voor Nederlanders die in Caribisch Nederland werkzaam zijn geweest

Two MPs asked whether Dutch nationals whose last job was on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius or Saba can claim unemployment benefit under the Werkloosheidswet, and whether this should be changed. The minister confirmed that such workers are excluded from the European-Dutch unemployment insurance, pointed to the one-off Cessentiawet BES benefit on the islands, and refused to change the rules.

No. Employees whose last work was in Caribbean Netherlands can claim a one-off benefit under the Cessentiawet BES, if they become unemployed through no fault of their own and meet the other conditions.
Nee. Werknemers die laatstelijk werkzaam zijn geweest in Caribisch Nederland kunnen aanspraak maken op een eenmalige uitkering op grond van de Cessentiawet BES
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het persbericht van Promovendi Netwerk Nederland dat 10% van alle promovendi een dubieuze aanstelling aangeboden krijgt

MPs Mei Li Vos and Kerstens asked the ministers about a PNN press release claiming 10% of PhD candidates receive dubious short or part-time contracts that may evade the Wwz. The minister replied that such contracts are lawful, reflect tailored PhD tracks, and that she will keep talking with PNN and send a letter on careers.
The PNN research concerns vacancy texts.
Het onderzoek van het Promovendi Netwerk Nederland (PNN) heeft betrekking op vacatureteksten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes  en Kerstens over Uitbuiting van personeel bij de Qatarese ambassade

MPs Servaes and Kerstens asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs about reported labour exploitation of staff at the Qatari embassy and how the government supervises working conditions at embassies. The minister said privacy prevents discussing individual cases, described a monitoring system for domestic staff and a mediation practice for local staff, noted that embassies cannot be forced to comply with court rulings, and said staff can access legal aid.
Due to privacy considerations, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot address individual cases.
Vanwege privacyoverwegingen kan het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over gemeenten die niet toetsen op verdringing van betaalde arbeid

An MP asked the State Secretary whether municipalities that do not check for displacement of regular paid work by welfare recipients doing tegenprestatie labour are acting unlawfully, and what action will be taken. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for preventing displacement under existing rules, that she will not impose stricter binding rules on municipalities, and that she has only encouraged them through letters, meetings and asking Divosa for support.
I do not consider it desirable to restrict the policy freedom of municipalities by imposing stricter binding rules.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk om de beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten te beperken door dwingender regels op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het inkomen van de topman van Omroep West

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether Omroep West compensated its director for scrapping his performance bonus with a higher fixed pay, and whether the director's withdrawal of a 1,000 euro allowance was driven by publicity. The minister confirmed the arrangement (bonus replaced by a taxable monthly allowance of 8.5% of gross salary), gave total remuneration figures for 2013 to 2015 within the WNT norm, and left the compensation decisions to the supervisory board.
According to media reports, the Supervisory Board of Omroep West made arrangements with the director to stop the performance-related bonus from 1 January 2014.
De Raad van Commissarissen van Omroep West heeft volgens de berichtgeving met de directeur afspraken gemaakt over het per 1 januari 2014 stopzetten van de prestatieafhankelijke bonus
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over de beloningen bij de Bank Nederlandse Gemeenten

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Finance Minister about the high pay of BNG Bank's board chair, the 2009 pay policy, and whether semi-public banks should pay less. The minister said the 2009 policy applies only to newly appointed board members, that a new policy cutting the maximum to EUR 301,000 was adopted on 5 October 2016, and that state holdings are private companies whose pay must reflect specialist labour markets.
For the level of pay of the chair and other members of the board of BNG Bank, I refer you to the public annual reports of BNG Bank.
Voor de hoogte van de beloning van de voorzitter en overige leden van de rvb van BNG Bank verwijs ik u naar de openbare jaarverslagen van BNG Bank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Afgunst en bonje kost Oost-Groningen miljoenen’

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked whether the state will make the promised funds available so workers in East Groningen are not harmed by the dispute over the Akkoord van Westerlee. The Secretary of State replied that a maximum of 10 million euros is available for 2016-2018 and that the Akkoord will be implemented with the municipalities that remain willing, keeping the door open for the others.
I indicated that a maximum of 10 million euros is available for implementation in the years 2016, 2017 and 2018.
Ik heb aangegeven dat ten behoeve van de uitvoering in de jaren 2016, 2017 en 2018 maximaal 10 mln euro beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Winkelpersoneel McGregor dupe van doorstart’

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether McGregor's doorstart, which replaced older long-serving staff with temporary agency workers, was acceptable and whether bankruptcy law was misused. The minister said assessing the case is for the curator and courts, noted limits on age discrimination and workers' remedies, and said the bankruptcy law review and labour position of workers in insolvency will be examined in consultation with the Justice Minister.
It is not for me but for the curator and possibly the court to give a judgement on this concrete practical case.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de curator en eventueel aan de rechter om hierover in dit concrete praktijkgeval een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de toename van dodelijke ongevallen in de bouw

Kerstens (PvdA) asked the minister why fatal accidents in construction rose, how flexible labour and language barriers affect safety, and what the sector and government will do. The minister answered that the rise is provisional, linked to higher construction output and fragmented site responsibilities, and promised tighter construction-process rules and continued monitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Kerstens over het bericht dat miljoenen euro’s in zakken van zorgdirecteuren verdwijnen

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked the government about reports that millions of euros of public care funds flow to care directors as dividends, and how this is permitted and controlled. The State Secretary answered that the WTZi bans profit distribution in institutional care but allows it in some outpatient care, that internal supervisors, insurers and municipalities oversee this, and that existing rules are sufficient, while promising to fight abuse via the governance code and inspections.
In the first instance, it is up to the supervisory body of the care provider concerned to assess whether paying out dividends is in the interest of the provider's continuity and patient care.

Het is in eerste instantie aan het toezichthoudend orgaan van de betreffende zorgaanbieder om te beoordelen of het uitkeren van dividend in het belang is van de continuïteit van de aanbieder en de zorgverlening aan patiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Albert de Vries over de beloning van directeuren van woningcorporaties boven de wettelijke norm

Two PvdA MPs asked whether housing corporation directors earning above the WNT pay norm, including those not covered by the transitional rules, would be brought under the norm and whether the norm is justified. The minister answered that accountant reports for 2015 will be checked by the Autoriteit woningcorporaties, that transitional rules protect existing contracts, and that the current maxima are considered appropriate.

When checking the 2015 accountant reports of the various corporations, it will be determined whether the top officials mentioned in the article still fall under the transitional rules based on the annual reports approved by the accountant.

Antwoord 2 Bij de controle van de accountantsrapporten over 2015 van de verschillende corporaties zal worden vastgesteld of de in het artikel genoemde topfunctionarissenvallen op grond van de door de account goedgekeurde jaarverslagen nog steeds onder het overgangsrecht vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over een inbraak in de database van de gemeente Ede

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked about a hack of the Ede municipal database exposing residents' data, whether a police report was filed, the Data Protection Authority's role, municipal hack statistics, and whether a central municipal secure portal should be created. The minister confirmed a police report and ongoing investigation, declined to comment on the specific case, reported 147 municipal breach notifications in early 2016, and pointed to existing municipal cooperation and a possible KING proof of concept.
An investigation is currently ongoing. Therefore no statements can be made about this.
Er loopt momenteel een onderzoek. Derhalve kunnen hieromtrent geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘FNV: Slachterij Hilckmann weigert vergoeding aan ex-werknemers’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Hilckmann slaughterhouse closed, dismissing about 300 workers, and refused to pay transition allowances despite earlier agreements with Nijmegen municipality. The minister said the courts, not government, must judge the alleged agreements, noted that about 50 workers have settled and the owner is willing to pay the remaining transition allowances, and described UWV's reemployment support for former workers.
It is not for me, but for the court, to judge whether alleged agreements between the company and the municipality of Nijmegen were honoured.
Het is niet aan mij, maar aan de rechter, om te oordelen over het wel of niet naleven van vermeende afspraken tussen het bedrijf en de gemeente Nijmegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Monasch en Jacobi over de verscherpte Stempelplicht Opvarenden van de Zeehavenpolitie Rotterdam

MPs Kerstens, Monasch and Jacobi asked whether the Rotterdam Seaport Police has tightened application of the Schengen Borders Code, shortening stays of foreign crew and limiting shipowners' freedom to deploy their crews, and why existing practice was abandoned. The government answers that the police apply the Code no more strictly than before, that exit stamps are given only when departure is imminent (about 300 persons were not stamped), and that it will work with the sector until 1 October to reach a workable implementation.
The Rotterdam Seaport Police does not apply the Schengen Borders Code more strictly than before.
De Zeehavenpolitie Rotterdam past de Schengengrenscode niet strikter toe dan voorheen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht “Top slechte verpleegtehuizen verdient meer dan balkenendenorm”

MPs Kerstens and Volp asked whether it is appropriate that executives of underperforming nursing homes earn more than the Balkenende norm, and whether boards should hold back salary increases and urge reductions. The state secretary answered that the WNT sets the maximum, that supervisory boards must weigh pay case by case, that salaries are already public, and that the CIBG enforces the WNT if violations occur.
Within the limits set by the WNT, it is up to the internal supervisors to determine what an appropriate remuneration for the executive(s) concerned is.
Binnen de grenzen die de WNT stelt, is het aan de interne toezichthouders om te bepalen wat een passende beloning voor de betrokken bestuurder(s) is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Monasch en Jacobi over ‘Toezichthouders MCL gaan er fors op vooruit’ (HERDRUK)

MPs Kerstens, Monasch and Jacobi asked whether the Wet normering topinkomens, which raised the maximum pay for supervisory board members, invites supervisors to rush to the new maximum, especially in healthcare, and whether the stated reason for the increase (compensating for lower executive pay) was accurate. The minister answered that the increase reflects broader supervisory roles and greater actual time spent, that individual agreements must stay within the law, and that the increase was separately motivated in the legislative process.
Any increases in remuneration must also be seen in the context of this broadening of roles, responsibilities and time commitment.
Eventuele verhogingen van de bezoldiging moeten ook in het kader van deze verruiming van de rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en tijdsbesteding worden gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over topinkomens bij Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (HERDRUK)

MPs Kerstens and Monasch asked how top-salary rules (WNT) apply to top officials at Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland after the organisation's management team structure was changed, and whether the rules can be circumvented.
