Minister Blok answered that the WNT applies based on actual leadership rather than formal structure, that the supervisor is the Eenheid toezicht WNT, that a legislative extension to all employees is in preparation, and that enforcement will follow if formal changes do not reflect actual practice.
Only if it is established that the officials concerned in practice have continued to provide leadership will enforcement action be taken.
Alleen indien komt vast te staan dat de betrokken functionarissen in de praktijk gewoon leiding zijn blijven geven, kan en zal handhavend worden optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ulenbelt over de politie die actievoerende brandweerlieden intimideert

MPs Kerstens and Ulenbelt asked whether police contacting, phoning or visiting firefighters ahead of a union action intimidates them and whether this is acceptable given the right to strike. The government confirmed that police may seek information about planned actions as part of public order duties, denied that the approach was intimidation, and condemned any intimidation of strikers as a breach of the right to strike.
Actively contacting the persons involved in response to such signals by the police is one of the possibilities for this and forms part of normal police work.
Het actief contact opnemen door de politie met betrokkene(n) naar aanleiding van dergelijke signalen is daartoe een van de mogelijkheden en maakt deel uit van het normale politiewerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over de uitbuiting van Filipijnse truckers door een Limburgs transportbedrijf

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked the Minister of Social Affairs about exploitation of Filipino truck drivers by a Limburg transport company, including whether Dutch firms rely on them due to a driver shortage, the use of a foreign-based subcontracting construction, and possible exclusion from public tenders. The minister said the sector is recruiting young Dutch drivers, pointed to the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies and a bill extending chain liability to road transport, declined to comment on the inspection investigation, and stated no current plans to change public procurement rules.
I do not make statements about individual investigations by the Inspectorate SZW, in line with the normal procedure.
Over individuele onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW doe ik conform de normale werkwijze geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kerstens over het verkrijgen van raadsinformatie via een Wob- verzoek (Wet openbaarheid van bestuur)

Members Leijten and Kerstens asked why two parties in Oude IJsselstreek must file a Wob request to obtain information on contracts for home-visit (keukentafel) assessments, and whether bonus-malus arrangements tied to outcomes are acceptable and used elsewhere. The state secretary said council information rights under the Gemeentewet are broader than Wob, rejected bonus-malus arrangements as inconsistent with the Wmo 2015, and reported that no other municipalities are known to use them.
That accountability and information duty is broader than the disclosure duty arising from the Wob, because the Wob regulates citizens' right to government information.

Die verantwoordings- en informatieplicht is breder dan de openbaarmakingsplicht die uit de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob) voortvloeit, omdat de Wob het recht van burgers op overheidsinformatie regelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over de uitbuiting van Nederlandse voetbaltrainers in China

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked whether reports that Dutch football coaches in China receive little pay and return disillusioned, and any related exploitation, corruption or deception, warrant government action and whether the KNVB should warn coaches of the risks. The minister said the individual case is unknown, coaches should prepare themselves, Dutch embassy advised seeking a lawyer, the government sees no direct role beyond the courts, and the KNVB will be consulted on informing coaches.
Since I do not know the individual case, I cannot make a statement about it.
Aangezien ik de individuele casus niet ken kan ik hier geen uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Grote misstanden bij aanleg Friese autoweg’

MPs Kerstens, Jacobi and Monasch asked Minister Asscher about FNV reports of systematic underpayment of workers on the Friesland road project 'De Centrale As', and about the responsibilities of contracting authorities under the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies. The minister said he could not judge the allegations, pointed to social partners and the Inspectorate SZW as the proper investigators, and described contractor liability and existing information efforts for lower governments, while committing to monitoring the law but not to new action.
It is extremely difficult for me to form a judgement on the FNV's allegations of underpayment by parties involved in the construction of 'De Centrale As'.
Het is voor mij buitengewoon lastig om mij een oordeel te vormen over de door de FNV gedane beweringen t.a.v. onderbetaling door partijen die bij de aanleg van «De Centrale As» zijn betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over huishoudelijke hulpen die vaker zwart werken

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether domestic helpers increasingly work informally and why the RDaH scheme has little uptake and weaker legal protection for short-hours workers. The minister said informal work is not known, described an information campaign on RDaH, defended the scheme's differentiated rules, and noted municipal use of the Huishoudelijke Hulptoelage.
Whether there is undeclared work involved is not known to us.
Of hierbij sprake is van zwart werk, is ons niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht dat de alternatieve arbeidsinkomensquote momenteel relatief laag is

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the government about DNB's finding that the alternative labour income share is currently low, its historical position, the role of self-employment, and whether wages lag productivity. Minister Asscher answered that the measures differ mainly due to bank mortgage profits and self-employed income treatment, that a longer series and a common method are needed, and that wage-setting is for social partners, while the government will keep urging them to use available wage room.

I therefore follow with interest the hearing on wage developments and the labour income share to be held after the recess at the initiative of MP Voortman, and I invite the parties involved to agree on a uniform method for presenting the labour income share.

Ik volg dan ook met interesse de hoorzitting over de ontwikkeling van de lonen en het AIQ die op initiatief van het lid Voortman zal plaatsvinden na het reces, en nodig de betrokken partijen uit om met een uniforme methode te komen om de AIQ te presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en van Laar over de discrepantie tussen het door banken gestelde beleid met betrekking tot arbeidsrechten en de misstanden in de kleding- en elektronicasector

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a gap between banks' stated policies on labour rights and abuses in the garment and electronics sectors, and what the government will do about it. The minister said the banks' policies are largely adequate but their practice (engagement with clients) needs improvement, and that a responsible-business covenant with the banking sector, which the government supports, is expected to be signed after the summer.
It is expected that the covenant will be signed after the summer.
Het is de verwachting dat het convenant na de zomer ondertekend zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over alfahulpen in de thuiszorg

Kerstens (PvdA) asked the state secretary about alfahulpen in home care, including the Oude IJsselstreek municipality's reaction, whether the promised legislation would come, and workers' insurance and income. Van Rijn answered that the municipality is reconsidering its plans, that the quoted remark was inaccurate, that gemeenten should inform citizens about labour-law aspects, and described the voluntary insurance options under the Regeling dienstverlening aan huis.
I consulted the municipality and this turns out to be an incorrect quotation.
Ik heb de gemeente geconsulteerd en dit blijkt een onjuist citaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over "Asbestkennis bij Bakkersland".

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about asbestos incidents at Bakkersland, the timeline of the incidents, whether workers were informed, the risk of inhalation and any asbestos-related occupational diseases. The minister answered that three incidents were known to the Inspectorate, no violations were found, air measurements stayed below the norm, workers were informed via the works council, and only a small number of asbestos victims are linked to the bakery sector.
No violations were found, and the way the company handled the incidents met the requirements for a proper asbestos inventory and remediation.
Er zijn geen overtredingen geconstateerd en de wijze waarop de incidenten door het bedrijf zijn aangepakt voldeed aan de eisen die horen bij een deugdelijke asbestinventarisatie en sanering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Kerstens over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat Haagse subsidieregels die topsalarissen verbieden in strijd zijn met de wet

MPs Koolmees and Kerstens asked the Minister of the Interior how he responds to the Council of State ruling that The Hague's subsidy rules banning top salaries violate the General Administrative Law Act, and whether he will amend the law. The minister says the ruling limits subsidy conditions to the purpose of the subsidy, that the Awb already allows conditions on top incomes, and that a legal basis for municipal salary caps would not resolve municipalities' objections because the WNT transitional rules would still apply.
Therefore the objections of municipalities cannot be met by creating a legal basis for top income caps by local governments in any law.
Er kan dus niet aan de bezwaren van gemeenten tegemoet worden gekomen door in enige wet een wettelijke basis te creëren voor topinkomensnormering door decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over de topinkomens in de zorg

Two PvdA MPs asked whether it is troubling that healthcare executives earn above the minister's salary, and whether executives should voluntarily forgo pay above the WNT norm, and whether they are paid in line with the WNT. The minister answered that pay limits are set by the WNT, that institutions and supervisors make a societal assessment within those limits, that pay is a recurring topic with employer organisations, and that CIBG supervises WNT compliance and enforces where needed.
CIBG, the supervisory body in healthcare, monitors compliance with the WNT and enforces it where necessary.
Het CIBG, de toezichthouder in de zorg, ziet toe op de naleving van de WNT en treedt, indien nodig, handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over veiligheid in de elektrabranche

An MP asked the ministers about alarming safety conditions in the electrical installation trade, citing reports of incompetent electricians and falling installer skill levels. The government replied that electrocution risks in homes are rare, that working conditions and training in the branch are adequately organised, and that the response to the Safety Board's carbon monoxide report and the Building Quality Act would follow separately.
Safety-oriented training instructions are available for installers in the form of the ARBO handbook "Blauwe Boekje".
Voor installateurs zijn op veiligheid gerichte scholingsinstructies beschikbaar in de vorm van het ARBO handboekje «Blauwe Boekje»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Van Rijn gaat ingrijpen bij ‘foute’ gemeenten’

Kerstens (PvdA) asked whether the state should intervene in municipalities that fail to tailor Participatiewet reintegration support to individuals' circumstances, as the Wmo minister announced. Staatssecretaris Klijnsma answered that municipalities have discretion under the law, that the Rijk only intervenes in serious unlawful conduct, and that individuals can appeal decisions through bezwaar and beroep.
Only if there is serious unlawful action or inaction by the college regarding national rules can the Rijk interfere with choices made at local level.

Alleen indien sprake is van een ernstig onrechtmatig handelen of nalaten door het college ten aanzien van rijksvoorschriften, kan het Rijk zich bemoeien met de keuzen die op lokaal niveau worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over overtreding van de Arbowet door PostNL

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether PostNL's use of self-employed parcel couriers to circumvent Arbo rules is common in the parcel sector, what the general state of compliance is, and whether sector-level agreements are appropriate. The minister confirmed the reported violations, said other operators also use self-employed couriers to varying degrees, noted ongoing Inspectorate enforcement tracks including one at PostNL, and said further action would be considered if improvements remain insufficient.
If these do not lead to sufficient improvement, I will consider further action.
Mochten die niet leiden tot voldoende verbetering, dan zal ik nadere actie overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over het gebruik van chroom-6 verf bij de NS-Werkplaats in Tilburg

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked the ministers about chromium-6 paint exposure among re-integration participants at the NS workshop in Tilburg, including health symptoms, protection, liability and an independent medical examination. The minister answered that the employer is primarily responsible, that liability is for civil courts, that a medical consultation is available via CAOP, and that NedTrain's internal review found chromium-6 risks at several current sites with additional measures taken.
Who is civilly liable for any damage suffered in this case is a matter that can be assessed by the civil judge.
Wie er in dit geval civielrechtelijk aansprakelijk is voor eventueel geleden schade is een kwestie die door de civiele rechter kan worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een ongeval met een hoogwerker

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a fatal accident with a boom lift in Zaltbommel, how many similar serious accidents occurred, what training and certification rules apply, and whether further safety research and industry consultation would follow. The minister answered that no comparable incidents are known, described the general Arbo rules on instruction and competence, said no mandatory certificate exists for operators, and stated that the Inspectie SZW is investigating and it is too early to announce measures.
The Labour Inspectorate is investigating the accident. It is too early now to give an explanation of the cause of the accident or to make statements about any actions or measures to be taken.
De Inspectie SZW onderzoekt het ongeval. Het is nu te vroeg om duiding te geven over de oorzaak van het ongeval en uitspraken te doen over eventueel te ondernemen acties of te treffen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Voortman en Karabulut over de arbeidsomstandigheden van de beveiliging op Schiphol

Three MPs asked whether working conditions for airport security staff at Schiphol had improved despite earlier promises, whether TNO's dwell-time recommendations were implemented, and whether Schiphol as client should be held to account, including whether security should return to a public body. Minister Asscher answered that employers and CAO parties are responsible, that the Inspectorate has received no complaints, that a new TNO report recommends a 120-minute dwell limit under review by June, and that no public body is needed.

Schiphol and the security companies have indicated that, until the new TNO report's recommendations are translated into practical and feasible dwell-time agreements, the current CAO norm of a maximum dwell time of 150 minutes is strictly observed.

Schiphol en de beveiligingsbedrijven hebben aangegeven dat, totdat de aanbevelingen uit het nieuwe TNO-rapport zijn vertaald in praktische en haalbare afspraken over statijden, de norm die in de huidige CAO staat – een maximale statijd van 150 minuten – strikt wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het artikel ‘Minder uren, meer zelf doen en meer alfahulpen’

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health about a municipality's preference for 'alfahulpen' (publicly funded assistants in home care) and the continued use of this arrangement despite the planned ban. The State Secretary answered that the arrangement is undesirable, that the municipality has been advised against continuing it, that a bill banning alfahulpen in the general provision is forthcoming, and that municipalities are responsible for continuity of care.
The number of municipalities providing home support with the help of alfahulpen is not registered nationally.
Het aantal gemeenten dat thuisondersteuning verleent met behulp van alfahulpen wordt landelijk niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jadnanansing over financiële ondersteuning voor volwassen scholieren

MPs Kerstens and Jadnanansing asked what financial support exists for adult pupils aged 18 and over who are not yet in a vocational or higher education programme, whether they face income loss, and what municipalities can do. The state secretary explained the DUO pupil allowance, the rules for the period before study finance and general assistance, and said municipalities hold individual discretion, while not holding data on municipal practice.
I do not have information on how municipalities deal with adult pupils who have not yet started an education programme.
Ik beschik niet over informatie hoe gemeenten omgaan met de volwassen scholieren die nog niet aan een opleiding zijn begonnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de uitbuiting van Roemeense scheepsbouwers

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the minister about Romanian shipyard workers paid around 1 euro per hour via A1 posting certificates, questioning the legality and fairness of wage gaps and the scale of posting. The minister said the case may be a sham construction, that wage-cost differences under the posting directive are undesirable, and outlined EU-level work on A1 misuse while noting the system does not record sector and a meldingsplicht is planned.
An A1 certificate cannot record which sector an employee or self-employed person is active in.
Op een A1-verklaring kan niet worden ingevuld welke sector een werknemer of zelfstandige actief is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermue en Albert de Vries over het inkomen van de algemeen directeur van energiebedrijf Delta

PvdA MPs asked whether the salary increase for Delta's general director, which staff opposed, is acceptable given losses and public ownership, and whether shareholders should intervene. The government answered that Delta is exempt from the WNT pay cap because it is a company, that shareholders should act, that the WNT scope will be revised, and that the company's network split leaves WNT application unchanged.
Government shareholdings in NVs and BVs have been kept outside the WNT by the legislator, on the reasoning that the government could sufficiently influence pay policy through its shareholding.

Overheidsdeelnemingen in NV's en BV's zijn door de wetgever (in algemene zin) buiten de WNT gehouden op grond van de overweging dat de overheid via de lijn van het aandeelhouderschap het beloningsbeleid voldoende zou kunnen beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Kerstens over de beloningen in dienstverlenende non-profit organisaties in het onderwijs

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Education about reported salaries of top executives at education-serving non-profit organisations, some above the minister's pay, and whether these fit the WNT pay cap and whether organisations publish annual accounts. The minister replied that the salaries were within the 2014 norm, that the WNT applies uniformly, that transitional rules explain remaining excesses, and that she has urged transparency and compliance.
I attach importance to this transparency and closely monitor compliance with it.
Ik hecht aan deze transparantie en houd de naleving daarvan nauwlettend in het oog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het gebruik van de Cyprusroute door AFMB Limited

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about continued use of the Cyprus route and sham constructions by AFMB Limited, including past SVB action, possible new investigation, NIWO licence withdrawal and EU measures. The minister said the pending court case limits information, AFMB has no NIWO licence to withdraw, and the government is pursuing enforcement tools and EU reforms.
In the interest of the ongoing appeal case and possible follow-up actions, no information can be provided on the content of possible investigations.
In het belang van de lopende beroepszaak en eventuele vervolgacties kan over de inhoud van mogelijke onderzoeken echter geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Kerstens over minder plek voor rolstoelgebruikers in bussen in Arnhem

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Kerstens asked why newly purchased Arnhem trolleybuses offer less space for large electric wheelchairs despite accessible stops, and whether EU rules were responsible. The state secretary answered that the bus operator is testing a new layout with wheelchair users, that the EU vehicle rules apply but the EU accessibility act is not yet law, and that no further European review is currently planned.

Given the efforts of the transport company and the concession holder to reach a solution, I currently see no reason to review with my colleague of infrastructure and environment the European guidelines on safety in public transport.

Gelet op de inspanningen van het vervoerbedrijf en de concessiehouder teneinde tot een oplossing te komen, heb ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om met mijn collega van infrastructuur en milieu de richtlijnen uit Europa te bekijken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal, Hoogland en Kerstens over het verloren gaan van 45 duizend gezonde levensjaren als gevolg van het VW-schandaal

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Volkswagen emissions scandal really caused 45,000 lost healthy life-years, and what it means for public health and mechanics' occupational risk. The State Secretary disputes that conclusion, says the extra NOx emissions are not quantified, notes that air quality limits are largely met, and points to the Air Quality Action Plan and EU efforts on real-driving emissions testing.
It is not known how much the emission of nitrogen oxides increases as a result of the software fraud as found at Volkswagen.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel de emissie van stikstofoxiden toeneemt als gevolg van de softwarefraude zoals die bij Volkswagen is geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht 'Falende topambtenaren snel weer aan topbaan geholpen'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Housing and Civil Service whether senior civil servants who failed are rarely dismissed and instead quickly reappointed, and how this is treated differently from other staff. The minister replied that performance assessment applies to all civil servants, that top officials' 7-year terms and departures reflect various circumstances, and that no forced dismissals occurred at top level in 2011 to date, with 24 top-level departures reported.
The exact circumstances of each individual case are confidential personnel matters.
De exacte toedracht per individuele casus is personeelsvertrouwelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kerstens over de uitspraken van het bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis en de MC Groep over het inkomen boven de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) en geld verdienen in de zo

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about the Slotervaart hospital board's remarks on earnings above the WNT pay cap, personal investments, loans to the hospital at attractive rates, and volume growth. The minister answered that the CIBG supervisor must assess individual WNT compliance, that the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek loans were ordinary commercial arrangements, that the profit-distribution ban is not known to be breached, and that new patient volume reflects healthy competition rather than inflation, with supervision by NZa and insurers.
It is the task of the supervisor to check whether the WNT has been complied with in an individual case.
Het is de taak van de toezichthouder om te toetsen of in een individueel geval de WNT is nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over de situatie bij het Europees Octrooibureau

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked about the dismissal of union members who criticised conditions at the European Patent Office, the letter from the Administrative Council chair to the EPO president, and whether the Netherlands will support it. The State Secretary confirmed Dutch concern, said the Netherlands co-sponsors a draft resolution to be voted on in the Administrative Council, and reported a meeting with the EPO president that did not change his position, while declining to share the confidential letter's details.
Dit document heeft de status confidentieel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over "misleidende informatie van opleidingen over de arbeidsmarktpositie van hun afgestudeerden"

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about study programmes presenting misleading labour-market outcomes for graduates, and about abuse of internships. The minister acknowledges an error in the Studie in Cijfers indicator, promises a repaired version, and says internship abuse will be examined based on concrete reports.
It is regrettable that this happened, because the study fact sheet was only recently established.
Het is betreurenswaardig dat dit gebeurd is, want de studiebijsluiter is pas recent tot stand gekomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over de fusie tussen Ziggo en Vodafone

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Ziggo-Vodafone joint venture, its market shares, which authority would review it, possible remedies, job losses and access regulation for fixed networks. The minister said the joint venture is a 50-50 arrangement under review by the Commission or ACM, that remedies and any market dominance are for the competition authorities to decide, and that he would press for continued access to both fixed networks in the EU telecom framework.
Both companies hold 50 percent of the shares in that enterprise.
Beide ondernemingen zijn voor 50 procent aandeelhouder in die onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de topinkomens van het bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis en de MC groep in relatie tot de Wet normering topinkomens

Two PvdA MPs asked about the executive pay of boards at the Slotervaart hospital and MC Groep, the Balkenende-norm style WNT cap, delayed repayment of municipal and provincial loans, profit distribution and NZa oversight. The minister answered that no ministry had approved the salary, that CIBG will investigate deeptime fraction issues within about eight weeks, that the WNT will be tightened in future legislation, and that the IGZ sees no quality risk.
The cabinet is currently preparing new legislation following the evaluation of the law to sharpen its effectiveness where necessary.
Het kabinet bereidt thans in vervolg op de wetsevaluatie nieuwe wetgeving voor om de effectiviteit van de wet waar nodig aan te scherpen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over verdringing van vast personeel door vrijwilligers

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked the state secretary about volunteers replacing paid staff at the Dukenburg swimming pool, and what rules prevent such displacement of paid work. The state secretary said existing Participation Act rules and guidance already address displacement, that the local council must judge the risk case by case, and that no stronger national rules are needed for now.
It is not for me to interfere in the local discussion about how the swimming pool is operated.
Het is niet aan mij om me te mengen in de lokale discussie over de wijze van exploitatie van het zwembad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Kerstens naar aanleiding van berichten in de media over misstanden bij kinderopvang De Sterrenberg in Arnhem

MPs Yücel and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported serious misconduct and safety problems at childcare centre De Sterrenberg in Arnhem, including its history of inspections and why sanctions were not imposed immediately. The minister answered that municipalities and their GGD inspectors are responsible for supervision and enforcement, outlined the eleven inspections since 2011 and the warnings and instructions issued, and explained the enforcement instruments available to municipalities.
As Minister of SZW, I do not concern myself with specific cases.
Als Minister van SZW ga ik niet over specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over geweld op het werk

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about workplace violence and bullying, its costs, how workers can seek protection, and whether a concrete follow-up to government action is planned. The minister answered with survey figures, outlined complaint routes via the Labour Inspectorate and courts, rejected extending the LKOG complaints commission's powers, and committed to informing parliament before summer 2016 on further measures.
I will inform the House before summer 2016 on how employers and employees can be further encouraged and facilitated to take timely measures to effectively counter bullying at work.

Ik zal de Tweede Kamer voor de zomer 2016 informeren op welke wijze werkgevers en werknemers verder gestimuleerd en gefaciliteerd kunnen worden om tijdig maatregelen te nemen om pesten op het werk effectief tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de aantrekkelijkheid van Nederland voor buitenlandse investeerders

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment whether Dutch talent attraction and technical skills shortages deter foreign investors, the student numbers in technical fields, and whether the knowledge migrant scheme should be widened. The minister acknowledged a mid-ranking index position, pointed to existing technical education and technology pacts, reported growth in technical student intake, and announced measures to make the Netherlands more attractive to knowledge workers.

That is why the cabinet recently announced that the admission scheme for foreign investors will be changed as of 1 July 2016 to attract more foreign investors who contribute positively to the Dutch economy.

Daarom heeft het kabinet onlangs aangekondigd dat de toelatingsregeling voor buitenlandse investeerders per 1 juli 2016 gewijzigd wordt om meer buitenlandse investeerders aan te trekken die positief bijdragen aan de Nederlandse economie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over basisartsen die met een ‘spoedcursus’ bedrijfsarts kunnen worden

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked whether Arbobutler's plan to deploy unqualified junior doctors as occupational health providers after a short course is acceptable and how the shortage of occupational physicians will be addressed. The minister replied that junior doctors lack the registered qualifications required under the Arbo Act, so employers cannot satisfy their duty with them, that employers are responsible for verifying provider quality, and that a campaign and a kwartiermaker will be launched to boost training intake.
The junior doctor does not have the same qualifications as the registered occupational physician.
De basisarts heeft niet dezelfde kwalificaties als de geregistreerde bedrijfsarts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over de toename van het aantal beroepsziekten

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about two companies sued over occupational disease, whether these cases reflect a pattern, and about market competition in occupational health services, measurement of occupational disease targets, and Inspectorate powers. The minister answered that the Inspectorate runs a multi-year programme on hazardous substances, learns lessons from inspections and complaints, and will publish reports, while defending the private occupational health system and committing only to better monitoring of occupational disease figures.
Systematic learning from the findings has therefore already been implemented by the Inspectorate SZW.
Het systematisch leren van de bevindingen is door de Inspectie SZW dus reeds geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermeij en Mei Li Vos over universiteiten en hogescholen die de Wet werk en zekerheid ontduiken met knutselcontracten

MPs asked whether universities and universities of applied sciences use combined permanent-plus-temporary 'knutselcontracten' to evade the Wwz and whether this breaches the cao, and what the government will do. The minister says the cao and Wwz have already curbed such contracts, that cao compliance is for the parties and courts, and that the government agrees permanent contracts should be the norm, while noting some combinations will remain legitimate.
It is not for us to judge whether these contracts comply with the provisions of the cao, but for the cao parties themselves and ultimately the courts.
Het is niet aan ons om te oordelen of deze contracten in overeenstemming zijn met de bepalingen uit de genoemde cao maar aan cao-partijen zelf en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het bericht Pakket kopzorgen PostNL

Two MPs from the PvdA asked whether the Tax Authority (Belastingdienst) favours PostNL by failing to enforce against false self-employment of its parcel couriers, and whether UWV and PostNL are linked. The State Secretary answered that enforcement has been ineffective under the VAR regime, that the Wet DBA will allow stricter enforcement from 2016-2017, and that UWV and PostNL have no referral arrangement.
Enforcement by the Tax Authority at the client is therefore currently futile.
Handhaving door de Belastingdienst bij de opdrachtgever is nu dus vruchteloos.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Marcouch over de hoge salarissen van de top bij de politie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police leadership salaries exceeding a minister's pay, whether the 2013 request to waive part of salaries was honored, and whether the top can be made to lower incomes. The minister answered that no top officials exceeded the WNT salary norm in 2013 or 2014, that no legal means exist to force reductions for non-top staff, and that he is willing to talk with the officials concerned.
Legal possibilities are therefore lacking to enforce a reduction.
Juridische mogelijkheden ontbreken derhalve om verlaging af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over respect voor het stakingsrecht in het grootmetaal

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he would condemn alleged intimidation and implicit dismissal threats against striking metal-sector workers and have the Labour Inspectorate investigate. The minister said the collective agreement is a matter for social partners, that the Inspectorate had received no reports of strike-right violations, and so saw no reason for an investigation.
No reports have been made to the Labour Inspectorate that the right to strike has been violated. I therefore see no reason to have the Labour Inspectorate investigate.
Er zijn bij de Inspectie SZW geen meldingen gedaan dat het stakingsrecht zou worden geschonden. Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om de Inspectie SZW onderzoek te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over de inhuur van een interimmer door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about the hiring of an interim director by Rijkswaterstaat at a rate above the Balkenende norm, covering reimbursed living costs, non-publication in annual reports and the absence of a tender. The minister acknowledges the rate exceeded the norm for five months in 2013 and that it was not reported in the 2013 annual report, but defends the arrangement as a justified exception and promises stricter reporting of deviations.
I will monitor more strictly that such deviations are consistently reported to the House of Representatives.
Ik zal strakker toezien op het consequent melden van dergelijke afwijkingen aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Recourt over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep over boetes voor bijstandsfraude

MPs Kerstens and Recourt asked the government how it responds to Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings requiring that social assistance fraud fines take account of the offender's financial capacity, and what this means for fine policy and legislation. Minister Asscher answered that fines must be proportionate to income and assets, that the ruling does not require changing the law or regulation now, and that a bill amending the social security acts on administrative fines was sent to parliament.
In its ruling, the CRvB holds that an administrative fine may not disproportionately affect a person's income and assets.
In zijn uitspraak oordeelt de CRvB dat een bestuurlijke boete een betrokkene niet onevenredig in zijn inkomen en vermogen mag treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het aan werk helpen van bijstandsgerechtigden

An MP asked the minister whether unemployed welfare recipients could fill jobs currently filled by Eastern European workers, and whether a Nijmegen approach and a parliamentary motion on employing disabled workers were being followed up. The state secretary answered that case-by-case matching applies, that Nijmegen's outreach is welcomed as part of municipal duties, and that the 2013 motion is implemented through the social accord and the Participation Act and quota law, with progress monitored.
The efforts are continuously monitored by me; of course the House of Representatives will be informed about this.
De inspanningen worden door mij voortdurend gevolgd; uiteraard wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kerstens inzake de onlangs afgesloten schikking van woningcorporatie Vestia met een oud-bestuurder

MPs Albert de Vries and Kerstens asked the minister how the settlement between Vestia and former CEO Staal was reached and whether it is an acceptable outcome given the damage. The minister acknowledges the damage and the unsatisfying outcome, but argues the settlement is the maximum achievable and that the Vestia board, under supervision, made a reasoned decision; he has no means to undo it and points to existing supervisory principles.
I have no means to undo such civil-law settlements.
Ik heb geen middelen om dergelijke civielrechtelijke schikkingen ongedaan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermeij en Monasch over het faillissement van Dolcis, Invito, Manfield, Pro Sport en Steve Madden

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about the bankruptcy of Dolcis, Invito, Manfield, Pro Sport and Steve Madden, and whether the government would help preserve jobs and engage the retail sector. The minister said the ministry is actively involved behind the scenes, that sales of much of the Macintosh group are advanced, and that retail partners are exploring acceleration of the Retailagenda and transition support for workers.
My ministry has been involved in the bankruptcy process since late December and takes an active stance behind the scenes.
Mijn ministerie is sinds eind december betrokken bij het faillissementsproces en neemt achter de schermen een actieve houding aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kerstens over de topinkomens van het bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis en de MC groep in relatie tot de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT)

MPs Bouwmeester and Kerstens asked about executive pay at Slotervaart hospital and the MC group in relation to the WNT pay cap, including dual board roles, part-time factors above full time and governance concerns. The minister said the WNT supervisor CIBG and the accountant are responsible for assessing compliance, referred the matter to them, and said the IGZ found no grounds for stricter enforcement.
As part of its regular supervision under the WNT, the CIBG will examine this case.
In het kader van zijn reguliere toezicht op de WNT zal het CIBG deze casus onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Marcouch over het bericht dat de nieuwe korpschef van de Nationale Politie € 75.000 compensatie voor salarisverlies krijgt

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Marcouch asked about the reported €75,000 compensation for salary loss given to the new national police chief, and why it was paid as a severance under the civil service rules rather than a WNT exception. The ministers answered that it is a discretionary payment under the civil service regulation capped at €75,000 by the WNT, justified by the public interest in filling the post quickly, with any further compensation to be arranged within police employment rules.
In order to remove this obstacle, it was examined whether there was a possibility to compensate.
Ten einde deze belemmering weg te nemen, is bezien of er een mogelijkheid was te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Maij over arbeidsmigratie binnen Europa

MPs Kerstens and Maij asked the minister whether intra-EU labour migration problems such as underpayment, unfair competition and displacement should be tackled urgently at EU level, how the Posting of Workers Directive revision would be advanced, and what the Netherlands would do on bogus self-employment, the temporary agency convention and the A1 form. The minister answered that the Commission shares the concern, that the Netherlands will push the Labour Mobility Package once published, and that these issues are complex with no easy solutions, promising to inform parliament once clarity exists.
As soon as there is clarity on this, I will inform the House of Representatives together with the State Secretary of Finance.
Zodra er duidelijkheid over is zal ik, samen met de Staatssecretaris van Financiën, de Tweede Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij, Kerstens en Nijboer over de oud -eigenaar Sun Capital die mogelijk betrokken is bij een doorstart van V&D

MPs Vermeij, Kerstens and Nijboer asked about former owner Sun Capital's possible role in a V&D going-concern restart after bankruptcy, and whether bankruptcy was misused against staff and creditors. Minister Asscher answered that the court and curators are responsible, that the curators' report will show Sun Capital's role, and that research into works council positions in takeovers will be completed before summer.
It is not for me to make statements about the background to this bankruptcy and the financial situation of the company.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over de achtergronden bij dit faillissement en de financiële situatie van de onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij de distributiecentra van Albert Heijn en Jumbo

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about poor working conditions, pressure and intimidation, and unsafe situations at Albert Heijn and Jumbo distribution centres after a broadcast, and about the position of flexible workers and possible sanctions. The minister said there is no evidence of a structural problem, that complaints will be considered in upcoming inspections, and that sanctions range from warnings to closure and fines, but committed to no specific inspection of the distribution centres.
The signals from the EenVandaag broadcast will be taken into account in the preparation of (re)inspections.
De signalen uit de uitzending van EenVandaag zullen meegenomen worden in de voorbereiding van (her)inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Owtin van Dijk en Tanamal over het bericht ‘Zorgadviseur” strijkt 68.000 euro op’

MPs Kerstens, Owtin van Dijk and Tanamal asked whether a former board chair of care institution Reinier van Arkel received about 368,000 euro as an adviser after leaving in 2013, whether this complied with the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT), and whether the arrangement amounted to a disguised continuation of the top role. The minister confirmed the pay figures in the annual accounts, said the WNT does not cap pay of former top officials, referred the case to the regulator CIBG for routine supervision, and stated no sham arrangement had been established.
The WNT regulator for the care sector, the CIBG, will examine this case within the regular supervision of the WNT.
De toezichthouder van de WNT voor de zorgsector, het CIBG, zal deze casus in het kader van het reguliere toezicht op de WNT onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Otwin van Dijk en Monasch over het bericht “Salaris bobo's Friese thuiszorg verdubbeld”

MPs asked the government about reports that supervisory board pay at home-care organisation Patyna had doubled and whether this complies with the Wet Normering Topinkomens. The minister answered that the board pay was reversed, stays at prior levels, falls within WNT limits as far as applicable, and that setting pay and consulting staff are the organisation's own responsibility.
Within the limits set by law, in particular the WNT, it is for the institution and the top official to determine what constitutes appropriate remuneration.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet, in het bijzonder de WNT, stelt is het aan de instelling en de topfunctionaris om te bepalen wat een passende beloning is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Albert de Vries over de wijze waarop hypotheekverstrekkers omgaan met herbeoordelingen van het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Kerstens and De Vries asked whether mortgage lenders are excluding the full Wajong benefit from income calculations because of possible 5% reductions under the Participatiewet, and whether the minister would negotiate with lenders. The state secretary replied that a reduction would not justify excluding the whole benefit, that the NHG website was corrected, that 53 NHG loans with Wajong income were granted in 2015, and that banks generally count benefits that are permanent or guaranteed for their duration.
I share your view that the possible reduction of the Wajong benefit from 2018 should not lead to the entire benefit no longer being counted in a mortgage granting.
Ik deel uw mening dat de mogelijke verlaging van de Wajong uitkering vanaf 2018 er niet toe zou moeten leiden dat de gehele uitkering niet meer wordt meegenomen bij een hypotheekverstrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Kerstens over het bericht dat steeds meer kinderen opgroeien in de bijstand

MPs Yücel and Kerstens asked the state secretary about reports that more children are growing up on social assistance, and what is being done to prevent child poverty and support children's participation. The state secretary answered that the rise is mainly due to the economic crisis and divorce, pointed to work as the main route out of poverty, described municipal child packages and extra funding, and promised to alert municipalities and fund projects.

I will actively draw municipalities' attention in the next collective letter to the findings of the research on experiences with the child package, and call on them to pay special attention to involving children in child-oriented poverty policy and reaching children.

Ik zal gemeenten in de volgende verzamelbrief actief attenderen op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar de ervaringen met het kindpakket en hen daarbij oproepen om speciale aandacht te besteden aan het betrekken van kinderen bij het kindgericht armoedebeleid en aan het bereiken van kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Kerstens en Van Dekken over de exorbitante gouden handdruk voor de vertrekkend directeur van Buma

MPs Oosenbrug, Kerstens and Van Dekken asked whether the large severance payment to the departing Buma/Stemra director, who refused to moderate pay under the WNT, is acceptable, and whether the rules could prevent such payments. The minister answered that pre-WNT contracts fall under transitional law, that the College van Toezicht examined the arrangement, that the contract's content is a matter between private parties, and that no change to transitional rules is planned.
Beyond that, it is not for me to disclose the content of the employment contract between two private parties.
Het is voor het overige niet aan mij om mededeling te doen over de inhoud van de arbeidsovereenkomst tussen twee private partijen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermuë over een werkbezoek aan sw-bedrijf Dethon

MPs Kerstens and Vermue asked whether the ban on wage deductions in the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies would unintentionally hinder sheltered-employment firms from deducting rent from workers' pay, and whether action would be taken. Minister Asscher answered that the ban is not meant to harm sheltered workers, that he will seriously consider an exception, and that deductions remain permitted until 1 July 2016, with a letter to parliament promised in early 2016.
Therefore I will also seriously consider an exception for this group.
Daarom zal ik een uitzondering voor deze groep ook serieus overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over een ziekenhuisbestuurder die vindt dat ziekenhuisbestuurders meer moeten verdienen dan een minister

Two MPs asked the health minister whether the WNT pay cap should still apply to hospital directors after a hospital chair argued directors should earn more than a minister. The minister answered that the WNT norm of 178,000 euro is maintained, with lower pay maxima for healthcare from 2016, and that institutions and directors make their own choices within the law.
The cabinet considers capping the income of healthcare executives desirable. That is why it has been laid down in law.
Het kabinet vindt normering van het inkomen van zorgbestuurders wenselijk. Daarom is dat wettelijk vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over jongeren die na het afstuderen geen baan kunnen vinden en onderbetaald aan de slag gaan

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether graduates are being underpaid through internships and work placements that amount to regular employment, and whether enforcement against such misuse is adequate. The minister answered that genuine internships need no pay but work without a learning focus must pay at least the minimum wage, that the Inspectie SZW has opened 12 investigations since December 2014 with two fines issued, and that a letter on handling reports from FNV Jong's complaint point will follow before 1 April.
The misuse of work placements has the attention of the Inspectie SZW.
Het misbruik van werkervaringplekken heeft de aandacht van de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over een verbod op kamperende vrachtwagenchauffeurs

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked whether Dutch truck drivers are forced to spend weekend rest in their cabs at unserviced parking areas, whether stricter rules in neighbouring countries drive them to Dutch parking spots, and whether the government will adopt a national ban on sleeping in trucks as proposed by CNV, or pursue harmonised EU enforcement. The minister answered that no figures exist on forced cab rest, that a ban conflicts with the policy of using secured truck parkings, and that the government supports EU harmonisation, with a Commission road package expected in 2016.
The cabinet is in favour of clear European policy, so that uniform interpretation and enforcement is achieved across the various EU member states.
Het kabinet is voorstander van een duidelijk Europees beleid, zodat eenduidige interpretatie en handhaving in de diverse EU-lidstaten wordt bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij Klesch Aluminium Delfzijl

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions and reduced pay after the Klesch Aluminium Delfzijl rescue of a bankrupt firm, and about similarities to pre-pack bankruptcies like Estro and Princen. The minister declined to judge the individual case, said the Labour Inspectorate sees no reason to investigate, and pointed to pending legislation (Wet continuïteit ondernemingen I) to regulate pre-pack practice.
I do not judge the concrete facts and circumstances of the individual case.
Ik oordeel niet over de concrete feiten en omstandigheden van het individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over winstuitkeringen aan bestuurder/eigenaar van een thuiszorginstelling

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked whether dividend payouts to the owner of a home-care provider (Breederzorg) comply with the WNT pay-cap and other rules, and whether tighter rules are needed on owner-managers and profit distributions in publicly funded care. The state secretary replied that dividends are not governed by the WNT, that CIBG will examine the case under routine supervision, and that existing law and the governance code provide sufficient safeguards.
CIBG will, as the responsible supervisor, examine this further within regular WNT supervision of the institution.
Het CIBG zal dit als verantwoordelijk toezichthouder nader onderzoeken in het kader van het reguliere WNT-toezicht op de instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Oosenbrug over stopgezette uitkeringen als gevolg van onderzoeken van externe bureaus ingehuurd door gemeenten

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary whether municipal outsourcing of benefit fraud investigations to commercial bureaus led to wrongly stopped benefits, clawbacks and fines, and whether those decisions should be reconsidered. The State Secretary said Article 7(4) of the Participatiewet bars outsourcing the establishment of rights and duties, that Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings confirm outsourcing of investigation is not allowed, that colleges may revise earlier decisions, and that she will ask municipalities with signals of unlawful outsourcing for information and may issue a binding instruction if needed.
It is up to the colleges of mayor and aldermen to consider, in appropriate cases, how they deal with 'old' cases.
Het is aan de colleges van burgemeester en wethouders om in voorkomende gevallen te bezien hoe zij omgaan met «oude» gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over declaratieproblemen tolken gebarentaal

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked why UWV introduced a new centralised invoicing system for sign-language interpreters, leaving deaf users and interpreters without timely payment, and how future communication will be improved. The state secretary acknowledges the late and incomplete notification, admits about 2400 misrouted invoices were paid, restores the old process temporarily, and promises a review with the Dovenschap, though she gives no figures on September declarations.
Up to and including 9 October, 2400 invoices that had ended up in the wrong place were traced.
Tot en met 9 oktober zijn er 2400 facturen achterhaald die verkeerd terecht waren gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over arbeidsomstandigheden bij het Europees Octrooibureau (EOB)

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked about working conditions and reported suicides at the European Patent Office, including whether a social dialogue has improved things and whether an independent Inspectorate SZW investigation can be arranged. The Staatssecretaris answers that the dialogue is difficult and not yet producing results, that the Inspectorate lacks powers due to EPO immunity and would only inspect at the request of management, and that the Administrative Council has no independent power to order such an investigation.
The labour inspectorate is willing to carry out an inspection at the EPO should a request be received, provided management asks for it and commits to it.
De inspectie SZW is bereid een inspectie uit te voeren bij het EOB mocht een verzoek daartoe ontvangen worden vooropgesteld dat het management daarom vraagt en zich eraan committeert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Kerstens over het niet aanpassen van de clausule voor het beslechten van investeringsgeschillen in het handelsverdrag met Canada, genaamd CETA

Two MPs asked why the ISDS investor-state dispute clause in the CETA trade deal with Canada has not been changed, and whether the Commission should reopen the CETA negotiations given work on an alternative for TTIP. The minister says the Commission does not want to reopen CETA but will align the investment chapter with TTIP reforms through technical changes in legal revision, that CETA already contains improvements, and that the text may still be adjusted before European Parliament approval.
Once the legal revision process is concluded, the agreement will be submitted to the Council for approval and signature and will also have to be approved by the European Parliament.

Als het proces van juridische revisie is afgesloten, zal het akkoord ter goedkeuring en ondertekening worden voorgelegd aan de Raad en zal het ook moeten worden goedgekeurd door het Europees parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over de inkomensbescherming van slachtoffers van arbeidsongevallen en beroepsziekten

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked whether Dutch income protection for victims of workplace accidents and occupational diseases falls short of international standards, and whether the WIA meets ILO Convention 121 and whether employers take enough safety measures. The minister answers that Dutch protection compares favourably with other EU countries, that the ILO committee's 2011 findings of breaches on eight points were disputed by the previous government on six of them, and that employers and workers are encouraged through existing programmes.
With policy and inspection I will continue to encourage employers and workers to make more or better efforts on healthy and safe work.
Met beleid en inspectie blijf ik werkgevers en werknemers aansporen om meer of beter werk te maken van gezond en veilig werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Kerstens en Voortman over de risico’s voor het personeel als gevolg van de nieuwe beveiliging op Schiphol

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of dangerous situations, overtime breaches, and poor working conditions for security staff at Schiphol after a new central security concept, and whether the tender cut hours despite rising workload. The minister said working conditions are the employer's responsibility, the Inspectorate SZW saw no reason for project research, and that Schiphol decides on tendering and contractors while the private Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag and CAO partners handle enforcement.
The Inspectorate SZW has recently not conducted any investigation into security companies at Schiphol or elsewhere in the country.
Er heeft recentelijk geen onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW plaatsgevonden naar beveiligingsbedrijven op Schiphol of elders in het land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over het verruimen van de regels voor vrijwilligerswerk

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked why unemployed people receiving WW benefits may only do traditional volunteer work, why the ANBI/SBBI status requirement applies, and how police volunteers and the Tour de France exception relate to benefit rules. The minister defended the restrictions against displacement of paid work, said the rules will be evaluated with results expected in early 2016, but did not provide quantitative effectiveness measures.
I will evaluate whether the said regulation indeed does what is intended.
Ik zal evalueren of genoemde regeling inderdaad doet wat is beoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over de afkoopsom voor een oud-bestuurder van ggz-instelling Rivierduinen

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked the ministers whether a severance payment equal to half a year's salary given to a former Rivierduinen mental health board member, despite few years of service, was justified and whether the WNT tightening should apply. The minister said CIBG will examine whether the arrangement complied with the WNT, that the WNT's severance cap does not apply to pre-existing contracts under transitional law, and that dismissals follow the CAO GGZ.
The CIBG will investigate whether this severance arrangement was implemented in accordance with the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT).
Het CIBG zal onderzoeken of deze ontslagregeling conform de Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) is uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over het bericht 'Netbeheerder Alliander gunt top een graaisalaris'

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked whether grid operator Alliander's arrangement, which may have a top executive earning above the WNT pay cap, amounts to a scheme to circumvent the Wet normering topinkomens and what the minister will do about it. Minister Plasterk answered that the WNT applies to grid operators, that suitable candidates exist within the cap, that the WNT supervisor is investigating who actually led Alliander in 2014, and that the broader law evaluation and the outcome of that investigation will determine any further action.
For that reason the WNT supervision unit of my ministry has started further investigation into who actually led the organisation during 2014 and must be regarded as a top official under the WNT.

Daarom is de Eenheid toezicht WNT van mijn ministerie nader onderzoek gestart naar wie gedurende het jaar 2014 feitelijk leiding gaf aan de organisatie en voor de WNT als topfunctionaris moet worden aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het schrappen van een boete voor ‘illegaal’ werk door de rechtbank Zeeland-West Brabant

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that struck down fines for illegal work by Bulgarian and Romanian workers, and about its consequences, the transitional labour regime and measures against exploitation. The minister said the state has appealed, the question is pending before the Council of State, the transitional regime is justified by high unemployment, and listed further anti-abuse measures.
I have therefore lodged an appeal against the aforementioned ruling.
Ik heb dan ook hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de voornoemde uitspraak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over de berichten ‘Boete voor wachtende chauffeurs’ en ‘Verstopt tussen bloemen en wasmachines; Hoek van Holland geliefde startplaats gelukszoekers’

MPs Hoogland and Kerstens asked whether truck drivers are fined under driving and rest-time rules although the stowaway problem at Calais and Hoek van Holland makes compliance unreasonable, and what is being done about port controls and infrastructure. The government says enforcement of rest times is a priority, that exceptional situations allow deviation, that the minister has raised concerns with the EU Commissioner and French and British counterparts, and that enhanced intelligence-led controls by the Marechaussee are in place without infrastructure measures for now.
It is up to the carrier to draw up a schedule within the limits of this regulation.
Het is aan de vervoerder om binnen de grenzen van deze regelgeving een planning te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over misstanden bij de Europese Octrooiorganisatie

Two MPs asked the government about alleged misconduct and poor working conditions at the European Patent Organisation, including sick-leave rules, a union lawsuit and non-compliance with a court ruling. The State Secretary replied that Nederland has no enforcement power over the EPO under international law, that worker protection rests with the EPO and its ILO tribunal, and that the Netherlands has pushed for careful implementation and a social dialogue within the Administrative Council.
However, under international law the Netherlands does not have the authority to enforce action against the EPO.
Nederland heeft echter onder internationaal recht niet de bevoegdheid handhavend op te treden jegens de EOO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over subsidievoorwaarden ten aanzien van topinkomens

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether municipalities may attach income caps for executives of subsidised institutions to subsidy conditions, and whether the law should change given a Council of State ruling on Eindhoven and Novadic-Kentron. The minister answers that existing law already offers options, that no legislative change is needed, and that a model approach with VNG and IPO is in draft and will be sent shortly.
As indicated, there are possibilities within existing legal frameworks to impose such subsidy conditions.
Zoals aangegeven zijn er binnen bestaande wettelijke kaders mogelijkheden om dergelijke subsidievoorwaarden te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Bewijs voor onderbetaling bouwvakkers aan Sontbrug'

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of underpayment of construction workers at Sontbrug and Groningen Forum, and about the role of the Labour Inspectorate and contracting authorities under the new anti-sham-construction law. The minister answered that the Inspectorate runs an average eight-month investigation process on union requests, that contracting authorities are expected to address misconduct through contracts, and that a civil procedure may follow for the Groningen case.
My ministry will do what is necessary to support them in this.
Mijn ministerie zal het nodige doen om hen daarbij te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over sw-bedrijf Hameland

MP Kerstens asked the state secretary about the sheltered workplace Hameland, covering whether workers with a sw-indication keep their rights, whether the municipalities' care duty remains, financial effects of not renewing fixed-term contracts, and access to sectoral plans and ESF funding. The state secretary confirmed workers keep their legal rights, stated the care duty lapsed with the Participatiewet, explained the budget and cost consequences for municipalities, and listed ESF subsidy arrangements without committing to new action.
I can confirm that employees with a sw-indication who are employed indefinitely by a sw-company retain their statutory rights.
Ik kan bevestigen dat medewerkers met een sw-indicatie, die voor onbepaalde tijd in dienst zijn van een sw-bedrijf, hun wettelijke rechten behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Angstcultuur bij vervoersbedrijf Hermes’

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about reports of a fear-based culture at bus operator Hermes, the government's responsibilities, and whether concession-holders can be selected on social criteria. The minister replied that the report is not yet published, that personnel policy is the operator's responsibility, that the province and Inspectie SZW can act if concession terms or labour law are breached, and that social aspects may be included in tenders within legal limits.
At this moment the report has not yet been published, so it is not yet known what the facts are regarding the corporate culture of bus operator Hermes.
Op dit moment is het rapport nog niet gepubliceerd en is het dus nog niet bekend wat de feiten zijn rondom de bedrijfscultuur van het vervoersbedrijf Hermes.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht dat een oud-topman van een zorginstelling na zijn vertrek nog 235.000 bij dezelfde instelling verdiende

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked whether a former Pleyade care-institution director received €235,000 after leaving in 2013, including a six-month continued salary and a €75,000 severance, and whether this circumvented WNT rules, while 200 staff were dismissed. The ministers said the figures in the annual accounts show a 2013 salary of €125,393 plus €75,000 severance and a 2014 project-role salary of €59,793, that the WNT supervisor CIBG will examine the case, and that they lack detailed insight into staff severance.
This case will be assessed against the WNT by the WNT supervisor for care, the CIBG.
Deze casus zal aan de WNT worden getoetst door de toezichthouder van de WNT voor de zorg, het CIBG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kerstens over de conclusie in een Europese rapport dat er wijdverbreid in de EU ernstige uitbuiting van werknemers plaatsvindt

MPs Maij and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an EU FRA report finding widespread severe labour exploitation, and what the government will do about enforcement, victim protection, the Posted Workers Directive and EU action. The minister accepts the risk sectors, declines to estimate prevalence, and outlines training, prevention, enforcement, victim support and planned EU initiatives, including the Dutch EU Presidency priorities.
The report, however, makes no statements about the extent of labour exploitation.
Het rapport doet echter geen uitspraken over de omvang van arbeidsuitbuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht dat een oud-directeur van een belastingkantoor voor waterschappen bijna 9 ton als afkoopsom heeft gekregen

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked whether a former director of the Hefpunt tax office for water boards could keep receiving large annual payments and a 9 million euro severance, and about the timing, contract basis, job-search obligation, and transparency under the WNT pay-cap law. Minister Plasterk replied that negotiations took place in early 2014, that the legality of the severance is still under investigation by the WNT supervision unit which has access to the contract, and that he will report back on the outcome without yet giving a verdict.
If the investigation shows that the severance arrangement is wholly or partly in breach of the WNT, it is - for the non-compliant part - void by operation of law.
Als het onderzoek uitwijst dat de vertrekregeling geheel of gedeeltelijk in strijd is met WNT, is deze – voor het niet-conforme deel – van rechtswege nietig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over re-integratie-projecten van gemeenten

MP Kerstens (PvdA) asks whether municipalities such as Aalten displace regular paid work by placing welfare recipients in unpaid or low-paid positions while keeping benefits, and what the state will do about it. The Secretary of State answers that re-integration is a local matter under municipal discretion, that the risk of displacement can only be judged locally, and that she relies on municipalities and existing guidance without committing to new rules.
I do not have information on the nature of the contracts and changes in them. This is a local matter.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de aard van de contracten en de wijzigingen hierin. Dit is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over ‘spelregels tegen verdringing’

MP Kerstens asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about rules against displacement of paid work by municipal reintegration activities, and whether a Rotterdam advisory council should be made mandatory. The State Secretary agreed displacement must be guarded against and that it is a municipal task, said the Programme Council drafted voluntary guidelines, and declined to require municipalities to set up advisory councils.
Reintegration policy is a task whose implementation has been left to the municipality.
Het re-integratiebeleid is een taak waarbij de invulling is overgelaten aan de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over re-integratie in Rotterdam

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about reports that re-integration practice in Rotterdam amounted to intimidation of benefit recipients, and whether the state would act on the ombudsman's recommendations. State Secretary Klijnsma answered that under the Participatiewet implementation is a municipal responsibility, the municipal council is the proper overseer, no contact with the Rotterdam ombudsman is planned, and the issue is being handled locally.

Given the decentralisation of responsibilities under the Participatiewet, it is for the municipality to decide how it shapes its policy on the Participatiewet, labour market reintegration and the counter-performance.

Gezien de decentralisatie van verantwoordelijkheden in de Participatiewet is het aan de gemeente om te bepalen op welke wijze zij hun beleid met betrekking tot de Participatiewet en daarmee de arbeidstoeleiding van werkzoekenden en de tegenprestatie willen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de beleidsvrijheid van gemeentes bij fraudebestrijding

Kerstens (PvdA) asked whether current rules leave municipalities too little room for tailored sanctions and for distinguishing real fraudsters from people making honest mistakes, and whether the minister will accommodate their objections. Minister Asscher replied that uniform sanctioning is needed for legal certainty, that planned Fraudewet changes give municipalities more discretion (warnings, lower fines, waiving sanctions in individual cases), and that existing maatregel rules already allow weighing personal circumstances, without committing to new measures.
In view of legal certainty and equal treatment, a certain uniformity in sanctioning policy is desirable.
Met het oog op rechtszekerheid en rechtsgelijkheid is een zekere uniformiteit in het sanctiebeleid gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over ‘Portugese timmerlieden Waalbrug jarenlang onderbetaald’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Portuguese carpenters on the Waalbrug project were underpaid through a staffing agency with questionable history, including whether government as client should check certification, exclude the firm, and whether the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies would have prevented this. The minister answered that certification gives no guarantee and is not checked during contract execution, that exclusion grounds exist and new EU-based rules are being implemented, that the new law would have given workers joint liability and payment controls, and that the Binnenhof renovation tender will follow current rules.
I am not aware whether checks were carried out on these construction projects.
Het is mij niet bekend of controle bij deze bouwprojecten is uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Verhuur sloopwoningen lonend voor Avenue2’

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that a subcontractor charged excessive rent for housing to underpaid workers, and whether the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies would stop such deductions. The minister said the deductions are too high and he dislikes employers profiting from worker housing, but explained the law only requires payment of the statutory minimum wage in full and does not prohibit deductions above it, relying on enforcement and social partners.
Legislation alone, however, is not enough to tackle abuses.
Wetgeving alleen is echter niet genoeg om misstanden aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Oosenbrug over de inhuur door gemeenten van externe bureaus op no cure no pay basis voor onderzoek naar uitkeringsfraude

MPs Kerstens and Oosenbrug asked about municipalities hiring external firms on a no-cure-no-pay basis to investigate benefit fraud, including the 'unpaid civil servant' arrangement and the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling. The State Secretary said she lacks data on how widely the practice is used, rejects it, holds that core benefit-investigation tasks cannot be outsourced, and promises a letter to municipalities and possible instructions under article 76 of the Participatiewet.
The implementation practice as addressed in the broadcast is something I reject.
De uitvoeringspraktijk zoals die in de betreffende uitzending aan de orde is gekomen wijs ik af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het heroverwegen van boetes die op grond van de te versoepelen Fraudewet zijn opgelegd

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether municipalities should reconsider fines imposed under the Fraud Act, now being relaxed, and whether the minister would ask implementing bodies not to reopen final fine decisions. The minister answered that municipalities may reconsider decisions at their own cost but that there is no legal obligation to reopen final fines, and that doing so would create a precedent and be costly.
There is no legal obligation to reassess previously imposed fines against which no remedy (objection or appeal) remains open.
Er is geen juridische verplichting om eerder opgelegde boetes waar geen rechtsmiddel meer tegen open staat (bezwaar of beroep) opnieuw te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ypma over de positie van leerlingen in het praktijkonderwijs in de Participatiewet

Two MPs asked whether pupils in practical secondary education (praktijkonderwijs) risk falling through the cracks under the Participatiewet, and whether they can be automatically listed in the target-group register for guaranteed jobs. The government answered that pupils will stay in view through handover of Wajong networks to municipalities, information campaigns, and a UWV procedure allowing direct applications for target-group assessment, with financing centralized at UWV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Recourt over "het flitsfaillissement bij Princen Transmission"

MPs Kerstens and Recourt asked the ministers about the Princen TransMission flash bankruptcy, the pre-pack method, the alleged selection of workers by health records, and whether the planned bankruptcy fraud law should address this misuse. Minister Asscher answered that pre-pack is a court practice aimed at preparing bankruptcy, that dismissal protection is lost through bankruptcy rather than pre-pack, that the curator and judge-commissioner should safeguard creditors including workers, and that a study on workers in bankruptcy will be sent before summer.
I will send that study to your House before the summer.
Dat onderzoek zal ik voor de zomer aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Zorgdirecteuren weigeren hulp aan loonsverlaging’

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked why the sector association NVZD refuses to cooperate on a ministerial salary-cap regulation (staffel) for healthcare executives under the WNT, and whether the government will act despite this. The minister regrets the NVZD's stance, says consultation continues with the NVTZ and VWS so unilateral action is not needed, and commits to publishing the sector regulation in November 2015.
