For that reason, unilateral adjustment of the regulation is not currently on the table.
Om die reden is eenzijdige aanpassing van de regeling op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over de WNT-staffel voor de sector woningcorporaties

Two MPs asked the government about the WNT pay-cap staffel (salary scale) for housing corporations, including whether talks with Aedes had taken place and whether the staffel would be published by 1 June. The minister answered that the sector bodies had submitted a proposal within the lowered WNT norm and that the Chamber would be informed in June, with formal adoption in November.
For the housing corporations, I expect to be able to give your Chamber and the sector clarity on the staffel for 2016 in June.
Voor wat betreft de woningcorporaties, zal ik uw Kamer en de sector naar verwachting in juni duidelijkheid kunnen bieden over de staffel voor 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Kerstens over het Trans-Atlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) en arbeidsnormen, REACH, REFIT en chemische ontsmetting van kippenvlees

MPs Jan Vos and Kerstens asked the government about TTIP and labour standards (ILO conventions, enforcement), REACH and REFIT, and chemical decontamination of chicken with peracetic acid. The minister answered that ILO core conventions are an essential element of the trade chapter, that REACH and national labour rules are not on the table, that REFIT runs separately from TTIP, and that any peracetic acid approval must follow EU risk assessment and member state voting.
I will ask the Social and Economic Council (SER) for advice on this.
Ik zal de sociaaleconomische Raad (SER) hierover om advies vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over "gedwongen zzp-erschap bij Sensire"

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked the ministers about reports that care provider Sensire wanted to dismiss 600 home-care workers and rehire them as self-employed, questioning whether this amounts to disguised self-employment and whether unions should be involved. Minister Asscher answered that pressuring employees into self-employment is undesirable, that UWV and courts assess individual cases, that UWV refuses dismissal permits where the aim is to avoid employee status, and pointed to the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies and the 2013 action plan.
In general terms, it is for the courts to assess the facts and circumstances of the individual case and rule on them.
In algemene zin is het aan de rechter om de feiten en omstandigheden van het individuele geval te beoordelen en daar een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Maij over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof van Den Haag over het Europese Octrooibureau

MPs Kerstens and Maij asked the Justice Minister about the Hague Court of Appeal ruling on labour conditions at the European Patent Office and whether the government would enforce it. The minister answered that the EPO's immunity from execution is absolute under its protocol, so the government has issued a notice barring bailiffs from enforcing the ruling, and that it will raise the matter with the EPO's Administrative Council and the Dutch-hosted EPO without ruling out further steps.
The Minister of Security and Justice can then notify the bailiff that enforcement of the judgment would violate the Kingdom's international legal obligations.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie kan vervolgens de gerechtsdeurwaarder aanzeggen dat tenuitvoerlegging van het vonnis in strijd is met volkenrechtelijke verplichtingen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jan Vos over de brandveiligheid van windmolens

Two PvdA MPs asked about fire safety of wind turbines after a fire at Ooltgensplaat, and whether investigations were still pending. The government answered that forensic, fire brigade and labour inspectorate investigations are ongoing, with results expected around summer 2015, and that the Chamber will be informed of outcomes.
Publication of the reports will follow as soon as possible, insofar as the Public Prosecution Service does not object because of criminal law aspects.
Publicatie van de rapportages volgt zo spoedig mogelijk, voor zover het Openbaar Ministerie dit niet bezwaarlijk acht vanwege de strafrechtelijke aspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat de gemeente Arnhem zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp)-schijnconstructies creëert

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the municipality of Arnhem dismissed civil servants and rehired them as self-employed contractors, and what the government thinks of such bogus self-employment. The minister declined to judge the individual case, said such practices are undesirable and that combating sham self-employment is a government priority, and pointed to the 2013 action plan and the newly adopted Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies.
As Minister of SZW, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Als Minister van SZW kan ik geen uitspraken doen over individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht "Uitzendbureau werkt onderzoek Arbeidsinspectie tegen"

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that a temp agency obstructed an Inspectorate investigation into underpayment at construction projects in Groningen, and about contractor responsibility. The minister answered that clients must ensure lawful supply chains, that the pending Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies adds chain liability, that the agency's SNA certificate was withdrawn, and that the evaluation of self-regulation is expected before summer.
I do not make statements about a specific case.
Over een specifieke casus doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Zorginstelling betaalt 3 ton voor interimmer’

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked whether a care institution's interim director, placed via agency Boer&Croon, was paid above the WNT pay cap by signing a contract in December 2012 before the law took effect. The minister confirmed the pay exceeded the norm but said transitional law applies, so no recovery is possible, and that the CIBG has looked into the case.
There is an excess over the maximum pay norm of the WNT, but because the pay was agreed before the law entered into force, it falls under transitional law.
Er is sprake van een overschrijding van de maximum bezoldigingsnorm van de WNT, maar omdat de bezoldiging voor de inwerkingtreding van de wet is overeengekomen, valt deze onder het overgangsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over de bezoldiging van de directie van Buma/ Stemra

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked whether the government would ensure that Buma/Stemra's director pay is capped under the WNT, after reports that the director was trying to block a salary cut to a minister's level. The state secretary replied that the WNT applies via article 25a of the Wet toezicht, that the College van Toezicht Auteursrecht monitors pay and can issue directions or penalties, and saw no reason to revisit the cap.
Since 1 July 2013 the College closely monitors the remuneration of the board and other senior officials of Buma/Stemra and other collective management organisations.
Sinds 1 juli 2013 houdt het College nauwlettend toezicht op de hoogte van de bezoldiging van de directie en de overige topfunctionarissen van Buma/Stemra en andere collectieve beheersorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Tilburg dreigt zorgbedrijven met topinkomens’

Two MPs asked whether Tilburg will stop subsidising care institutions with staff paid above a minister's salary from 2016, and what central government is doing to support local pay caps. The minister confirmed Tilburg's plan, said the WNT norm of 178,000 euro is decent, and reported an interbureaucratic network with VNG and IPO preparing model approaches due by 1 June 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het sluiten van sociale werkplaatsen

An MP asked the state secretary about five municipalities planning to close sheltered workshops (sociale werkplaatsen) without clear alternatives, and about the position of current Wsw employees. The state secretary answered that this is a decentralised municipal responsibility, that current Wsw employees keep their rights, and that municipalities have a broad instrumentarium under the Participatiewet.
It concerns a decentralised responsibility in which the municipal council and the college of mayor and aldermen make the decisions.
Het betreft een decentrale verantwoordelijkheid waarbij de gemeenteraad en het college van burgemeester en wethouders besluitvormend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over werken over de grens

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about provinces and municipalities planning pilots to place unemployed Dutch workers in jobs across the German border, and whether obligations to take such work should be enforced before obstacles are removed. The minister confirmed the initiatives, said cross-border work is possible and that the Participatiewet allows sollicitatieplicht across the border, promised to work with border regions via the GROS network under a motion, and said no one can be forced to accept work abroad though benefits can be sanctioned for refusing to apply.
No one in the Netherlands can be forced to accept work.
Niemand in Nederland kan gedwongen worden werk te aanvaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het wegnemen van belemmeringen om over de grens te werken

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs how the motion on mapping the fiscal and social security consequences for cross-border workers is implemented, what information is available to residents of the border region, and whether regional initiatives such as a helpdesk for working in Germany will be supported. The minister points to the grensinfo.nl website, the Belastingtelefoon and the cross-border tax team, Benelux information portals, and periodic cabinet reporting to parliament, and says the cabinet will consult VNG on whether a border counter is needed.
You will be further informed about the outcome of this consultation.
U wordt over de uitkomst van dit overleg nog nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over uitblijven besluit beschutte werkplekken

An MP asked the State Secretary how she views Cedris figures showing many municipalities have not yet decided on sheltered work and whether they can exclude instruments in advance, and whether municipalities can be forced to create sheltered jobs at wage. The State Secretary answered that municipalities have policy freedom under the Participatiewet, that the monitoring is ongoing and she will talk with municipalities if results lag, but she will not impose a minimum number of sheltered jobs.
If the monitor shows that results lag behind what the Participatiewet intends, I will enter into discussions with municipalities and other relevant organisations.
Als uit de monitor blijkt dat de resultaten achterblijven bij wat de Participatiewet beoogt, ga ik in gesprek met gemeenten en andere betrokken organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het door de Nederlandse Kamer van Koophandel georganiseerde seminar over buitenlandse uitzendkrachten

An MP asked ministers about a seminar on importing foreign temporary agency workers for agricultural firms, promoted as 'free staff from Slovakia', and whether it fits the fight against sham constructions. The minister answered that the seminar was organised by the bilateral Netherlands Chamber of Commerce in Slovakia, not the Dutch KvK, and that the government supports the country-of-work principle and a targeted review of the posting directive.
The seminar in question was not organised by the Dutch Chamber of Commerce but by 'The Netherlands Chamber of Commerce in The Slovak Republic'.
Het genoemde seminar werd niet georganiseerd de Nederlandse Kamer van Koophandel, maar door «The Netherlands Chamber of Commerce in The Slovak Republic»

Antwoord schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kerstens en Groot (Beiden PvdA) en het lid Pieter Heerma (CDA) over het convenant dat de uitzendsector heeft gesloten met de Belastingdienst waardoor oneerlijke concurrentie en

Three MPs (Kerstens, Groot of PvdA and Pieter Heerma of CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a covenant between the Tax Authority and the staffing sector that allegedly enables unfair competition and displacement through extraterritorial cost allocation, and asked about oversight, the estimated EUR 250 million revenue loss and whether the covenant should be terminated. The answer was not given in this text: it only states that the questions were answered by letter on a related request from another MP, so the substance of the answers is not present.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Kerstens en Servaes over het bericht ‘FIFA: Welzijn arbeiders Qatar niet onze zaak’

PvdA MPs asked whether the government would press the KNVB, the ITUC and FIFA's president to take responsibility for migrant worker conditions building World Cup 2022 stadiums in Qatar. The minister said the government is concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, wants FIFA to publish its bid report, and considers the KNVB proactive and the ITUC capable of acting itself, but said it cannot compel FIFA's president to explain publicly.
I note a proactive attitude from the KNVB regarding the position of migrant workers and will remain in discussion with them about it.
Ik constateer een pro-actieve houding van de KNVB over de positie van arbeidsmigranten en blijf hierover met hen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Kerstens over de gevolgen van het Trans-Atlantic Trade and Investment Partnership voor de werkgelegenheid

MPs Jan Vos and Kerstens asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a Tufts working paper claiming TTIP would cause large job losses and a negative trade balance, and about related methodological criticism. The minister rejected the paper's key assumptions, argued the CGE model is the best available tool, cited Commission and Ecorys estimates of positive effects, and agreed to invite its author for a meeting.
I will invite Capaldo for a conversation.
Ik zal Capaldo uitnodigen voor een gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over het bericht ‘Zorgbestuurder vangt twee ton voor maand werk’

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked about a report that a mental-health care board member received about 200,000 euros for one month of work in 2013, and how this fits the WNT pay-cap law. The minister disputes the figure, states the total remuneration was 181,722 euros, explains the former top official was not subject to the 2013 cap beyond January, and says the interim-norm decree will come in mid-2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over het SOMO-onderzoek naar misstanden op bouwprojecten waarvan Rijkswaterstaat de opdrachtgever is

MPs Hoogland and Kerstens asked whether Rijkswaterstaat, as client, checks compliance with labour rules and minimum wage/cao obligations in subcontracting chains on road projects, and whether standard contracts should refer to them. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat requires compliance with statutory rules and checks Arbeidsomstandighedenwet and foreign-worker rules, but lacks powers over cao wage compliance, which lies with cao parties, the Inspectie SZW and sectoral bodies, so no change to standard contracts or project screening is planned beyond supporting competent authorities.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kerstens over het ontslag van bijna 2000 medewerkers van Thebe

MPs Wolbert and Kerstens asked about the bankruptcy of home-care provider Thebe, which left nearly 2,000 workers jobless, and what municipalities and the Wmo framework do to keep clients and workers in place. The state secretary answered that the curator, municipalities and other providers (TSN, Tzorg) are securing continuity for most clients and offering jobs, that some municipalities have revised their policies, and that the government is following developments closely without committing to new measures.
We closely follow the efforts and progress of the municipalities concerned.
Wij volgen de inspanningen en vorderingen van de betrokken gemeenten nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kerstens over het sluiten van de Philipsvestiging te Emmen

Two MPs asked the ministers about Philips' decision to close its Emmen site and move work to Poland and Spain, including tax benefits, regional jobs support, and reshoring. The government regrets the closure but says companies must decide location on business grounds, cannot comment on individual tax matters, and will work through employer federations and reshoring initiatives.
Because of the tax confidentiality obligation, the cabinet cannot make statements about the tax affairs of individual taxpayers such as Philips.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan het kabinet echter geen uitspraken doen over belastingaangelegenheden van individuele belastingplichtigen zoals Philips.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Poolse werknemers uitgebuit ; vakbond FNV Bouw meldt flinke reeks misstanden bij verbreding A15’

Two PvdA MPs asked the Infrastructure and Environment and Social Affairs ministers about reports of exploitation of Polish workers on the A15 widening, including underpayment, lack of insurance and unpaid overtime. The minister said the allegations could not yet be confirmed, that the Labour Inspectorate had inspected the site in April 2014 without finding minimum-wage or working-time violations, and that investigations and new contractor-liability rules were underway.

These cases are currently being investigated by the special team of the Labour Inspectorate responsible for tackling sham constructions and supporting social partners in enforcing collective agreement conditions.

Deze zaken worden thans onderzocht door het speciale team van de Inspectie SZW dat belast is met de aanpak van schijnconstructies en de ondersteuning van sociale partners bij de handhaving van de cao-voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over de salarissen van bestuurders van woningcorporaties

MPs Kerstens and Monasch asked the government about housing corporation executive salaries exceeding WNT norms, salary increases in 2013, transitional rules, and whether bonuses were paid unlawfully. The Minister answered that 44 of 728 top officials exceeded the 2013 norm, that the 2013 regulation was set aside so some pay rises were lawful under transitional rules, that no unlawful bonuses are known, and that the government will not interfere with transitional rights but welcomes voluntary restraint.
I have received no information showing that there are unlawful bonuses.
Mij heeft geen informatie bereikt waaruit blijkt dat er sprake is van onrechtmatige bonussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het bericht “Burgemeester 'geeft' Omroep West-baas bonus”

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about reports that a mayor approved a 13,844 euro bonus for the director of regional broadcaster Omroep West, which may breach the WNT pay-cap law, and about related questions on the L1 case, oversight and subsidy conditions. The minister says the Commissariaat voor de Media found the bonus was paid, that a fuller WNT compliance investigation is underway with results expected within six weeks, that bonuses are generally barred under the WNT, and that proactive checks at other regional broadcasters will follow.
It is expected that the entire investigation can be completed within six weeks.
Naar verwachting kan het hele onderzoek binnen zes weken worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over mogelijke vertraging rondom de inwerkingtreding van de nieuwe Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector

MP Kerstens asks the Minister of Interior whether the delayed entry into force of the new WNT salary cap for top officials will let executives raise salaries before the cap applies, and what measures will prevent this. The government answers only by referring to a separate letter on the Wet verlaging bezoldigingsmaximum WNT, with no substantive answer in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kerstens over de kritiek van de vakbonden op TNT

MPs Gesthuizen and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about union criticism of TNT, including reports that dismissed workers were rehired via subcontractors while receiving unemployment benefits. The Minister said he had no evidence of rule violations, pointed to ongoing Inspectorate monitoring and the pending anti-sham-construction bill, and deemed TNT's voluntary-departure policy a matter for employers.
I currently have no indications that the rules are being broken. I am therefore awaiting the further findings of the Inspectorate SZW.
Ik heb vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen dat de regels overtreden worden. Ik wacht daarom de nadere bevindingen van de Inspectie SZW af
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over het onderzoek van Imtech naar fraude bij de bouw van de energiecentrale van Essent in de Eemshaven

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Labour Inspectorate has investigated labour abuses in building the Essent power plant at Eemshaven, whether it has contact with Imtech about the company's fraud probe, and whether it will investigate further. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has no targeted inspections of Essent, has no contact with Imtech, which is a competition matter referred to the ACM, and has no independent role in cao compliance beyond requests from cao parties.
However, no inspections have taken place that were specifically aimed at Essent, because Essent itself was not a responsible party in the chain of clients for the construction.
Er hebben echter geen inspecties plaatsgevonden die specifiek waren gericht op Essent, omdat Essent zelf geen verantwoordelijke partij was in de keten van opdrachtgevers van de bouw.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kerstens en Vermeij over de app Helpling voor de schoonmaakmarkt

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked whether the Helpling app, which matches households with cleaners, falls under the domestic-services regulation and how workers' minimum wage, sick pay, liability and collective agreements are protected. Minister Asscher said courts decide employment status case by case, referred the tax aspect to the Tax Administration, and saw no reason to consult the Labour Foundation.
It is for the court to give a legal characterisation of an employment relationship in individual cases.
Het is aan de rechter om in individuele gevallen een juridische duiding aan een arbeidsrelatie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over een advertentie van BDU Media waarin zij ‘werkervaringsplekken’ als verwerkend redacteur aanbieden

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a BDU Media advert offering unpaid-or-low-paid 'work experience' editor posts at 350 euro, questioning whether such posts must pay the statutory minimum wage. The minister explained the stage versus employment distinction, said the advert lacked learning structure, and pointed to the Inspectorate SZW for enforcement and complaints.
The Inspectorate SZW is charged with supervising compliance with the Minimum Wage and Minimum Holiday Allowance Act.
De Inspectie SZW is belast met het toezicht op de naleving van de Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Kerstens en Van Dekken over de misstanden bij de aanleg van de bouw- en infraprojecten voor het WK 2022 in Qatar

MPs Servaes, Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Foreign Minister about serious labour abuses, including deaths, in preparations for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, and what the government has done about them. The minister answered that the government remains concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, plans a human rights ambassador visit to Qatar in 2015 with a report to parliament, supports the ILO investigation, and has contact with the KNVB without detailing outcomes.
In 2015 a visit by the Human Rights Ambassador to Qatar is envisaged, where labour rights will also be discussed. A report of this visit will be provided to the House of Representatives.
In 2015 wordt een bezoek van de Mensenrechtenambassadeur aan Qatar beoogd waar het onderwerp arbeidsrechten ook besproken zal worden. Van dit bezoek zal verslag worden gedaan aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht dat op bouwplaatsen van de NAM en Shell mogelijk sprake is van het ontduiken van de cao in de steigerbouwsector

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that collective agreement (cao) evasion may occur in scaffolding construction at NAM and Shell sites, including cao-shopping by temp agencies. The minister said cao compliance is primarily the responsibility of social partners, that SNCU investigations found roughly EUR 1 million in underpayment with recovery payments and a director-liability procedure, that the Inspectorate has received no formal request under article 10, and that a bill on sham constructions with chain liability is forthcoming.
The Labour Inspectorate supports the cao parties in the civil-law enforcement of the cao through compliance investigations.
De Inspectie SZW ondersteunt de cao-partijen bij de civielrechtelijke handhaving van de cao met nalevingsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht van onderbetaling van uitzendkrachten bij bouwprojecten die door de gemeente Groningen zijn aanbesteed

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked the minister whether the Inspectie SZW would investigate reported underpayment of temp workers on Groningen municipal construction projects and whether the municipality should be held accountable as client. The minister replied that cao compliance is primarily for cao parties and the Inspectie can only investigate minimum wage evasion, and promised the forthcoming Wet aanpak schijnconstructies would address underpayment in the chain.
Supervision of compliance with collective labour agreements is primarily a matter for the cao parties.
Toezicht op de naleving van cao’s is in eerste plaats een zaak van cao-partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Pestcultuur onder ambtenaren komt door gouden kooi’

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked about a report attributing bullying among civil servants to job security and a 'golden cage', and about mobility, top-down anti-bullying measures and financial sanctions for bullies. Minister Plasterk answered that bullying is a workplace matter for individual employers, cited survey figures, outlined mobility initiatives and existing disciplinary options, but declined a top-down approach.
It is primarily up to employers to ensure the safety and health of employees.
Het is primair aan de werkgevers om zorg te dragen voor de veiligheid en gezondheid van werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over beloningen bij zorgverzekeraars

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked whether pension contributions for top officials at health insurers fall within the sectoral pay norm, and how their size is kept in check. The minister answered that the employer pension contribution is normed qualitatively, matched to the sector pension fund's standard entitlements, and declined to add a quantitative cap.
One quantitative norm for the employer share of the pension premium could therefore not be laid down in a generic regulation.
Eén kwantitatieve norm voor het werkgeversdeel van de pensioenpremie was hierdoor niet in een generieke regeling vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Albert de Vries over de problemen met weekendverblijf van vrachtwagenchauffeurs in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

MPs Kerstens and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about problems with lorry drivers spending weekend rest periods on Zeeland-Flanders car parks, whether this breaches EU and municipal rules, whether the ILT will investigate, whether Belgian stricter rules cause a waterbed effect, and how municipalities will be involved. The minister answered that spending a long rest on a car park is not in itself an infringement, that the ILT checks for alternatives and warns drivers, that the ILT has consulted Belgian authorities, and that municipalities and police are primarily responsible for public order.
Within the framework of public order and safety, the municipality and police are in the first instance responsible for taking measures where necessary.
Het is in het in het kader van openbare orde en veiligheid in eerste instantie een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeente en politie om indien nodig maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Mohandis en Segers over het bericht “Bonus directeur regionale omroep L1 onder de loep”

MPs Kerstens, Mohandis and Segers asked whether regional broadcaster L1 paid a director a bonus of over 26,000 euro, whether bonuses fall under WNT transitional law, and how unlawful bonuses are recovered and sanctioned. The Minister answered that the Commissariaat voor de Media is investigating, that bonuses agreed after 6 December 2011 are unlawful and must be recovered via a set procedure with penalty orders, and that he will consult VNG and IPO on model subsidy rules.
The Commissariaat voor de Media is currently investigating this.
Het Commissariaat voor de Media onderzoekt dit momenteel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Kerstens over het gebruik van PX-10 door Defensie

Two MPs (Eijsink and Kerstens, PvdA) asked the Minister of Defence why the Ministry kept using PX-10 despite known health risks since 1976, why Parliament was not informed earlier, and what measures would follow an EenVandaag broadcast. The Minister answered that documentation dates from 1980, phasing out occurred 1981–1996, Parliament was informed 2008–2011, internal documents were already public, and the RIVM independently handles any counter-expertise, while personnel can contact helplines.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het sluiten van de metaalafdeling van Synergon

MPs Kerstens, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the State Secretary about the closure of Synergon's metal department, the failed takeover talks, the long uncertainty for staff and possible support for an external investigation. The State Secretary said responsibility for the Wsw lies with the municipalities, so she cannot comment on the company's operations, but pointed to a sector-wide Cedris programme, a provincial independent inquiry and regional funding.
Responsibility for implementing the Wsw is assigned to the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van de Wsw is belegd bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over tijdelijke contracten in de sociale werkvoorziening

MP Kerstens asks the state secretary whether temporary contracts for sheltered-work employees are being left unrenewed in some municipalities, whether an income drop for WIA recipients is accurate, and what concrete steps will secure the priority placement and sheltered-work budget. The state secretary says renewal is possible but municipalities decide themselves, cites the budget effects and placement efforts, and says work on WAO/WIA measures is ongoing.
They therefore decide for themselves, as has always been the case over recent decades, on matters including whether to renew temporary contracts or convert them into permanent ones.
Zij beslissen dus zelf, zoals de afgelopen decennia ook steeds het geval is geweest, over onder meer het wel of niet verlengen van tijdelijke contracten c.q. het omzetten daarvan in vaste contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jadnanansing over het bericht “Arcus College betaalt tonnen voor langdurige interimmer”

MPs Kerstens and Jadnanansing asked the Minister of Interior whether an interim manager paid over 300,000 euros by Arcus College, apparently beyond WNT pay limits under transitional rules, amounts to excessive pay or a sham construction. The minister answered that the Inspectorate of Education is still investigating compliance with the WNT, that transitional rules can apply if agreements predate 2013, that overpayment would have to be reclaimed, and that enforcement lies with the education minister and the inspectorate.

On the basis of further investigation of the annual report data and any notification from the institutional accountant, the Inspectorate of Education, on behalf of the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, supervises compliance with the WNT.

Op grond van nader onderzoek op basis van de gegevens in het jaarverslag, en een eventuele melding van de instellingsaccountant, oefent de Inspectie van het Onderwijs, namens de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, het toezicht uit op de naleving van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht «Salariseis bestuurder verboden in aanbesteding»

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked whether municipalities may impose salary limits in Wmo tenders, and how this relates to a parliamentary amendment and a motion on local top-income norms. The minister replied that salary demands must meet the proportionality principle under the Aanbestedingswet, that the WNT maxima apply in any case, and that talks with VNG and IPO on local top-income norms are ongoing.
Imposing salary requirements as such does not appear to meet this.
Het stellen van salariseisen als zodanig lijkt hier niet aan te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Cegerek over louche asbestverwijderaars.

MPs Kerstens and Cegerek asked whether the government can stop asbestos removal firms that re-apply for certification through new legal entities after losing a certificate, and whether certification rules and oversight should change. Minister Asscher acknowledged about five firms tried to circumvent the rules, committed to tightening the certification scheme and intensifying Inspectorate enforcement, while rejecting a shift to a different oversight system for now.
I find it unacceptable that companies or persons, after a certificate has been withdrawn, continue their work in the same way under another certificate.
Ik vind het onaanvaardbaar dat bedrijven of personen na het intrekken van een certificaat onder een ander certificaat hun werkzaamheden op dezelfde manier voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over het kwijtraken van pensioen bij bijstand in Enschede

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked the state secretary about Enschede's plan to require early cashing-in of occupational pension before claiming social assistance, and whether the Wet werk en bijstand permits this. The secretary called the plan undesirable, noted Enschede has withdrawn it, and promised a proposal to prevent municipalities forcing early pension withdrawal, plus a call to municipalities in the next letter.
Social assistance recipients should not be forced by municipalities to take their second-pillar pension early within the framework of assistance.
Bijstandsgerechtigden zouden – in het kader van de bijstand – niet door gemeenten verplicht moeten worden om hun 2 e pijler pensioen vervroegd in te laten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie over een boete voor energieleverancier Essent

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a European Court ruling (Essent) that work permits for third-country workers posted by an EU-based provider are not required, and how enforcement under the Wav and the Posting Directive would be affected. The minister said the ruling removes the permit requirement under conditions, will extend the notification duty to cover these workers to aid enforcement, and that Dutch room to amend the Posting Directive is limited, though efforts will continue.
To be able to check these conditions, I am extending the notification obligation, which already applies to other forms of service provision, to the category of workers covered by the Essent ruling.

Om deze voorwaarden te kunnen controleren, breid ik de notificatieplicht zoals die nu al geldt voor andere vormen van dienstverlening, uit tot de categorie van werknemers die door het arrest Essent wordt bestreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over beloningen bij zorgverzekeraars

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked ministers about executive pay at health insurers such as VGZ and Achmea, including whether the sectoral pay norm under the WNT is being respected, why severance payments and interim pension premiums are so high, and whether annual reports disclose pension costs. The ministers answered that pay falls within a sectoral norm with transitional rules, that a review of the sector regime has only just started, that the severance was contractually based, and that a data error in Menzis reporting is being corrected.
On the impact of WNT-2 on pay in the second WNT regime, VWS has asked the health insurance sector for attention.
Over de impact van WNT-2 voor de beloningen in het tweede WNT-regime heeft VWS aandacht gevraagd aan de sector zorgverzekeraars.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Kerstens en Karabulut over het bericht dat een ondernemer een boete heeft gekregen van €12.000,- , omdat hij niet beschikte over de vereiste tewerkstellingvergunning

MPs Schouten, Kerstens and Karabulut asked why a Veenendaal employer was fined 12,000 euro for employing a Wajong youth without the required work permit, although UWV had mediated the placement, and whether the fine should be waived or the law changed. The minister acknowledged UWV's error, reduced the fine by 100% on objection, agreed with UWV to alert employers, and promised a warning option in the Wav.
I regret this state of affairs. It would have been desirable if UWV WERKbedrijf had pointed the employer, in the July 2012 conversation, to the obligation to apply for a work permit.
Ik betreur deze gang van zaken. Het was wenselijk geweest als UWV WERKbedrijf de werkgever in het gesprek in juli 2012 had gewezen op de verplichting een tewerkstellingsvergunning aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Dikkers over het bericht dat uitzendkrachten in de pluimveesector structureel worden onderbetaald

MPs Kerstens and Dikkers asked Minister Asscher about reports that temporary agency workers in the poultry sector are structurally underpaid, and whether the Inspectorate SZW and the SNCU have acted. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has run 229 poultry inspections since 2009 with fines mainly for working conditions, none for minimum wage violations, that the SNCU lacks jurisdiction over agencies mainly active in poultry, and that the Inspectorate will investigate three recent formal cao-compliance requests and may discuss the issue with sectoral social partners.
The Inspectorate SZW recently received three formal requests to start a cao-compliance investigation in the poultry sector.
Recentelijk heeft de Inspectie SZW een drietal formele verzoeken ontvangen om een cao-nalevingsonderzoek te starten in de pluimveesector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kerstens en Karabulut over overtredingen van de TNO-normen voor statijden bij de luchthavenbeveiliging op Schiphol

MPs asked the minister whether maximum standing times for airport security staff at Schiphol, based on TNO norms, are an adequate protection against health risks and whether the state as shareholder should press Schiphol after FNV found an average overrun of 81 minutes per worker per day. The minister said responsibility lies primarily with security firms as employers, that TNO norms are useful, and that he is exploring ways to encourage clients to consider safe work, promising further discussion with parliament.
I am exploring options to encourage clients to take healthy and safe working by contractors into account.
Ik ben bezig met een verkenning van mogelijkheden om opdrachtgevers te stimuleren om rekening te houden met gezond een veilig werken bij de opdrachtnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kerstens en Groot over mogelijkheden de Wet Normering Topinkomens te omzeilen

MPs Kerstens and Groot asked whether topfunctionarissen could exceed the WNT pay norm by shifting pay into tax-free work expenses, and whether such schemes should be made unlawful. The minister replied that no gap exists, citing the gebruikelijkheidscriterium and a practical €2,400 threshold, and promised to examine tightening the criterion and clarifying the WNT framework.
The State Secretary of Finance has committed to examining whether the customary-practice criterion needs further tightening in this context.
De Staatssecretaris van Financiën heeft toegezegd te onderzoeken of het gebruikelijkheidscriterium in dit kader nadere aanscherping behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de bevinden van FNV Bondgenoten, dat op de Nederlandse wegen opmerkelijk veel vrachtwagenchauffeurs van buiten de EU zijn aangetroffen.

An MP asked the ministers whether FNV's finding of many non-EU truck drivers on Dutch roads is accurate, whether they hold Polish work permits and whether this is a sham construction, and what enforcement, cooperation and legislative steps are planned. The government replies that no data show such numbers, gives Polish permit figures without knowing how many worked in the Netherlands, and points to expanded ILT enforcement, Inspectie SZW support for collective agreement enforcement, EU-level action and the forthcoming Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies.
There are no figures available showing that a remarkably large number of truck drivers from outside the European Union are driving on Dutch roads.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar waaruit blijkt dat opmerkelijk veel vrachtwagenchauffeurs van buiten de Europese Unie op de Nederlandse wegen rondrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over het omzeilen van de Nederlandse wet door IKEA

MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether IKEA circumvents Dutch wage law by using Slovak drivers paid partly through allowances, and whether the minister will hold principal clients like IKEA accountable and have the Inspectorate investigate. The minister said the Inspectorate lacks a legal basis to examine clients, that the client's responsibility is being studied within the anti-sham-constructions action plan, and pointed to planned measures in the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies.
The ILT has no legal basis for conducting such an investigation.
De ILT heeft geen wettelijke basis voor het doen van dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht «Ziekenhuis betaalt fop-adviseur vier ton»

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked the minister about a report that a hospital paid a consultant 382,400 euros via a fee-avoiding interim construction to evade the WNT pay cap. The minister, on behalf of the health minister, answered that the CIBG found the person was a top official but that no actual breach occurred in 2013 due to transitional rules, while the hospital is asked to report the pay correctly.
Following the report, this matter was examined by the CIBG in line with the supervisory procedure.
Naar aanleiding van het bericht is deze kwestie conform de toezichtprocedure door het CIBG onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over "gemeente mag subsidie niet korten om topinkomens"

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities should be able to weigh executive pay norms when contracting providers, given a Council of State ruling that municipalities may not use subsidy cuts to enforce income limits. The minister said such norms are desirable and can be weighed at the front end of subsidy decisions, but he will not amend the legislation and will send the VNG and IPO a letter with conclusions.
I therefore do not intend to amend the legislation.
Ik ben daarom niet voornemens de wetgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Ex-manager ziekenhuis krijgt 3,4 ton mee’

An MP asked ministers whether a hospital manager's €340,000 severance payment falls under the Wet normering topinkomens, why it exceeds the usual cantonal-judge formula, and what steps will be taken against the hospital and the sector. The minister confirmed the payment, said the manager is not a top official under the Wnt so the pay cap does not apply, pointed to a planned extension of the cap to all (semi)public-sector staff with a conclusion expected in 2015, and said no rules were broken so no action is needed.
The cabinet is currently carrying out a policy exploration in preparation for that bill.
Het kabinet voert op dit moment een beleidsverkenning uit als voorbereiding op dat wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Woede om gouden handdruk manager'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Interior and Social Affairs ministers about a reported €294,476 severance payment to a unit manager of the Amersfoort sheltered-work body, whether municipal aldermen knew, and whether it breaches the WNT pay-cap law. The minister answered that the manager was not a top official under the WNT so the cap did not apply, the payment was reported and explained, the board was only informed afterwards and is discussing it with management, and no action to reclaim the payment was announced.
Strictly speaking, this question should not be directed at the ministers of BZK and SZW.
Deze vraag hoort strikt genomen niet te worden gericht aan de bewindspersonen van BZK en SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Half miljoen vertrekregeling voor bestuurder VUmc’

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked about a severance arrangement of over 300,000 euro, plus eight months of continued pay, for a former VUmc board member, and whether it breaches the WNT, who will recover it, and why it was not published earlier. The government answers that the arrangement was agreed before the WNT entered into force, so transitional law applies, that it is reported in the annual report as required, and that it does not intend to reopen the transitional rules.
Because the agreements were made before this law entered into force, they probably fall under the transitional law.
Omdat de afspraken hierover voor de inwerkingtreding van deze wet zijn gemaakt, vallen deze waarschijnlijk onder het overgangsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jan Vos over beloningen bij netbeheerder Liander

MPs Kerstens and Jan Vos asked the ministers about reports that 34 Liander staff, including eleven large severance payments, exceeded the WNT pay norm in 2013. Minister Plasterk answered that seven top officials and 17 others exceeded the maximum, that the top officials fall under transitional law, and that the sector will be judged on the WNT, with a report to parliament by end 2014.
The number of salaries above the WNT norm at present is a consequence of the historical development of salaries in the public and semi-public sector.
Het aantal salarissen boven de WNT-norm op dit moment is een gevolg van de historische ontwikkeling van salarissen in de publieke en semipublieke sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Maij over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij het Europees Octrooibureau

MPs Kerstens and Maij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alleged harsh working conditions at the European Patent Office in Rijswijk, including limits on strikes, communication with unions and suspensions. The minister said he could not confirm the characterisation, that the EPO has functional immunity and its own staff rules, and that the Labour Inspectorate cannot inspect the premises without the President's consent, so it held only a talk with management.
The European Patent Office is an international organisation with the corresponding diplomatic immunity.
Het Europees Octrooibureau is een internationale organisatie met de bijbehorende diplomatieke immuniteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over het misbruik van een faillissement

MPs Recourt and Kerstens asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether 'flash bankruptcies' (pre-pack practice) are used to cheaply dismiss staff and disadvantage creditors. The Minister defended the pre-pack practice as beneficial for creditors and employment, said abuse would be refused by courts, and pointed to a forthcoming bill and a civil director ban and shareholder register.

Moreover, when the power to file for bankruptcy is used for a purpose other than the one it is meant for – for example to reduce staff quickly and 'cheaply' – this constitutes abuse of rights according to settled case law.

Daarnaast geldt dat wanneer de bevoegdheid tot het doen van een faillissementsaanvraag wordt gebruikt met een ander doel dan waarvoor zij is bedoeld – bijvoorbeeld om het personeelsbestand snel en « goedkoop » te kunnen terugbrengen – dit volgens vaste jurisprudentie misbruik van recht oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Otwin van Dijk en Fokke over het bericht «Venlo eist salarisverlaging top Zorggroep»

MPs Kerstens, Van Dijk and Fokke asked about a 5% salary increase for the chair of the Zorggroep Noord- en Midden-Limburg board, its link to the Venlo council's demand for a salary cut, and whether the government would back the executive's stance and coordinate with VNG and IPO on local pay norms. Minister Plasterk answered that the increase was lawful under the WNT transitional rules, that voluntary pay cuts are encouraged, and that the case will be raised with VNG and IPO, which are still in talks.
I will include the case in the consultation with VNG and IPO.
Ik zal de casus betrekken bij het overleg met VNG en IPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over misstanden bij de sociale dienst Midden-Drenthe

An MP asked the State Secretary about reported misconduct at the Midden-Drenthe social services, whether municipalities should pause placing benefit recipients with firms under inspection, for individual plans and for rules preventing displacement. The State Secretary said the municipality remains responsible, has commissioned a review of its re-integration policy, and that the matter of pausing placements is for municipalities to decide.
It is not for me to judge whether municipalities should, as a precaution, refrain from placing benefit recipients with a company under investigation under the Working Conditions Act.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen of gemeenten uit voorzorg geen bijstandsgerechtigden moeten plaatsen bij een bedrijf dat onderzocht wordt op grond van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over de verhoging van het vaste salaris van de ABN AMRO top

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked whether ABN AMRO's 20% fixed-salary increase for its senior management, and its cost-to-income ratio, are acceptable given the minister's call for bank pay moderation. The minister replied that the salary rise is the bank's own responsibility, that the executive board decided without prior notice to him or NLFI, that pay can be lowered but wage setting belongs to employers and employees, and that Dutch personnel costs and cost-to-income ratios are high relative to the EU average.
As a shareholder, I am concerned with the remuneration policy of the executive board, not with the remuneration policy of senior management.
Als aandeelhouder ga ik over het beloningsbeleid van de RvB en niet over het beloningsbeleid van het senior management.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over de fors gestegen lonen van bankiers

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Finance Minister why bank staff pay rose sharply, whether bonus caps are circumvented by higher fixed salaries, and whether talent-retention arguments justify this. The minister said pay setting is for employers and employees, that the bill targets variable pay rather than fixed pay, and that the talent argument is overstated, while giving limited data on how banks compensated staff.
Wage formation, however, is reserved for employers and employees. The government in principle plays no role in this.
De loonvorming is echter voorbehouden aan werkgevers en werknemers. De overheid speelt daar in beginsel geen rol bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kerstens over de dreiging van een artikel 12-status voor de gemeenten Oldambt, Pekela en Bellingwedde

MPs Fokke and Kerstens asked whether Oldambt, Pekela and Bellingwedde risk an article 12 financial-supervision status, what causes it, and what the new municipal fund and participation budget models mean for them. The minister answered that the province sees no current basis for the concern, pointed to efficiency cuts and the new participation budget, and listed existing support measures for weak labour-market regions.
Once there is insight into the effects of the objective models in the social domain, the need for a possible transitional arrangement will be considered.
Als er zicht is op de effecten van de objectieve modellen binnen het sociaal domein, wordt de noodzaak van een eventuele overgangsregeling bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het stimuleren van grensoverschrijdende arbeid door het slechten van barrières

Kerstens (PvdA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he agrees that unemployment in border regions could largely be solved by removing cross-border barriers, and when the Chamber will receive the response to the Bruls advisory report and the 16 December 2013 conference results. The minister answered that the government sent its reaction on 13 June, which incorporates the conference results, and that a GROS progress report will follow later this year.
The cabinet sent the Chamber its response on 13 June regarding the Bruls advice on removing practical obstacles to cross-border labour.
Het kabinet heeft op 13 juni jl. een reactie naar uw Kamer gestuurd over het advies «wegnemen praktische belemmeringen bij grensoverschrijdende arbeid» van de heer Bruls.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht dat Nederlandse bedrijven indirect betrokken zijn bij schendingen van de arbeidsrechten bij de bouw van faciliteiten voor het WK 2022 in Qa

MPs asked whether Dutch banks, pension funds and companies invest in firms accused of labour rights abuses in building Qatar's 2022 World Cup facilities, and what the government will do about it. The government said it lacks such investment data, will raise labour rights in the ILO and OECD frameworks and with Qatar, and reported on sports-human rights steps.
The government does not have this kind of information and therefore cannot make statements about it.
De regering beschikt niet over dit soort informatie en kan derhalve geen uitspraken hierover doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het bericht dat kledingmerken nog steeds hongerloon betalen aan kledingarbeiders

MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a Schone Kleren Campagne report finding that none of 171 clothing brands pay a living wage in their supply chains, and what the government would do. The minister called the findings disappointing but not new, pointed to the national textile action plan, a planned living-wage conference and a future textile covenant, but offered no binding commitments on companies.
The report indicates that none of the companies examined currently pays a living wage in the supply chain concerned.
Het rapport geeft aan dat geen van de onderzochte bedrijven op dit moment leefbaar loon in de betrokken toeleveringsketen betaalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over stijging van de inkomens van zorgbestuurders

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether top executive pay in elderly care rose 19% in 2013, whether the WNT transitional rules allow this, and how to prevent further rises during the reform. The government said it cannot yet confirm the figure, that no accountant has reported a WNT breach, that it agrees top pay should not outpace sector wages, and that it will act through supervision and reclaim undue payments if needed.
Moreover, I have not received any reports from the accountants that the WNT has been breached.
Overigens heb ik op dit moment geen meldingen binnen gekregen van de accountants dat de Wnt zou zijn overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kerstens over integriteitsschendingen door ambtenaren

MPs Fokke and Kerstens asked the Minister of Interior about a survey finding that about a quarter of civil servants perceived a misconduct, and about the actual extent and trend of integrity violations. The Minister said the survey is perception-based and a useful signal, that Rijk registrations (around 500 to 650 confirmed violations a year since 2010) show no significant rise, and pointed to existing integrity policy and the Ambtenarenwet obligations, promising continued encouragement of integrity efforts.
Organisations in the public administration are themselves responsible for registering integrity violations.
Organisaties in het openbaar bestuur zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het registreren van integriteitsschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de verkeersveiligheid op de A15

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the minister about road safety on the A15 after fatal and serious truck crashes, the high casualty count over ten years, and when measures would be taken. The minister answered that risk on the A15 is below average for motorways, announced a local traffic detection system, extra traffic inspectors, a planned overtaking ban for trucks and improved road markings.
Following research, as promised during the MIRT debate in autumn 2013, I have decided to install a local traffic detection system on the Deil towards Valburg road section.
Na onderzoek, zoals toegezegd bij de behandeling van het MIRT in het najaar van 2013, heb ik besloten om een locaal filedetectiesysteem te plaatsen op het weggedeelte Deil richting Valburg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over het bericht ‘Netbeheerder Alliander wil hoger loon topman dan nu is toegestaan’

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked whether grid operator Alliander, which falls under the WNT pay cap, should be exempt, why state-owned TenneT and Gasunie are outside the WNT, and whether Alliander's German expansion is a loophole. The minister replied that Alliander remains under the WNT, that the draft bill keeps regional grid operators covered, that state holdings follow a separate pay framework, and that international activity is not a loophole.
Alliander falls under the WNT. As a result, it is not permitted to offer a salary above the WNT pay maximum.
Alliander valt onder de WNT. Daardoor is het niet toegestaan om een bezoldiging boven het bezoldigingsmaximum van de WNT aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over de loonverdubbeling bij het overheidsbedrijf Enexis

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked the government about a reported salary doubling for the Enexis board, whether Enexis faces competition, whether it is a fully public company, and whether the WNT pay cap applies. The minister answered that Enexis falls under the 130% WNT cap, that the board letter was a consultation response on lowering the cap that some read as a pay-doubling proposal (which Enexis denies), that the grid operator is a regulated monopoly with tariffs set by the ACM, and that the company is a regular private-law NV owned by provinces and municipalities.
In any case, under the WNT it is not possible to set a salary increase that exceeds the maximum remuneration norm.
Het is op basis van de WNT in ieder geval niet mogelijk om een loonsverhoging vast te stellen waarmee de maximale bezoldigingsnorm wordt overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Adviespunt Klokkenluiders: de ambtenaar is niet goed beschermd’

MPs Fokke and Kerstens asked whether many Dutch municipalities lack public whistleblower schemes, whether weak scheme visibility reflects poor integrity, and what happened to around a hundred whistleblowers who contacted the Expert Group. Minister Plasterk answered that municipalities must have a procedure by law, that public visibility is desirable though not tracked, and that the government has no insight into the individual cases while pointing to existing support bodies and an evaluation planned for 2014.
The cabinet has no insight into the fate of the hundred whistleblowers who reported to the Expert Group Whistleblowers over the past two years.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de lotgevallen van de honderd klokkenluiders die zich de afgelopen twee jaar bij de Expertgroep Klokkenluiders hebben gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over topinkomens bij goede doelen loterijen

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked about top incomes at lottery operators for good causes, whether lottery revenue flows to founders, whether licensing imposes pay conditions, and the enforcement against an unlicensed British lottery and illegal operators. The Secretary of State answered that the statutory 50% pay-out to good causes is met, that the regulator sets no pay conditions yet, that the British site could not be verified, and that persistent illegal operators will be excluded from licences.
The gambling authority has informed me that, when granting licences, it currently sets no requirements regarding the remuneration policy of lotteries that finance good causes.

De kansspelautoriteit heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten bij het verlenen van vergunningen momenteel geen eisen te stellen ten aanzien van het beloningsbeleid van loterijen die goede doelen financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens en van het lid Pieter Heerma over de inschakeling van bijstandsgerechtigden tijdens de kerstdrukte bij PostNL

MPs Kerstens and Pieter Heerma asked whether jobseekers on welfare were placed at PostNL during the Christmas peak through a temporary agency, whether this was a stepping stone or a benefit obligation, and whether municipalities should agree rules to prevent displacement of regular workers. The State Secretary answered that these were regular temporary jobs paid at the normal wage with benefit offset, not a tegenprestatie, that no displacement occurred, and that rules to prevent displacement are expected by spring.
There is no displacement but regular temporary paid work by welfare recipients.
Er is geen sprake van verdringing maar van regulier tijdelijk betaald werk door bijstandsgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Hamer en Yücel over het voornemen van het concern AKZO om de productieafdeling van de vestiging Deventer naar het buitenland te verplaatsen

MPs Kerstens, Hamer and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about AkzoNobel's plan to move production from Deventer abroad, costing about 215 jobs, and what the government could do. The minister replied that the decision is a business-economic one the government cannot interfere with, pointed to general business-climate policy and R&D retention in Deventer, and said the ministry had discussed the decision with the company's management.
However, the cabinet cannot interfere in the business-economic decisions of companies.
Het kabinet kan zich echter niet mengen in bedrijfseconomische beslissingen van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht “Veel misstanden bouw stadions Brazilië”

MPs Servaes, Van Dekken and Kerstens asked the minister about reports of labour violations, safety breaches and intimidation in building World Cup stadiums in Brazil, and whether the government would act, raise it with Brazil, and implement a motion on human rights in sports event awarding. The minister answered that the conclusions are FNV's responsibility, that Brazil is handling labour issues, that no direct talks are planned, and that the sports minister is pursuing human rights in sports awarding via NOC*NSF and a European letter.
The conclusions FNV draws from this research are FNV's own responsibility.
De conclusies die FNV trekt op basis van dit onderzoek zijn voor rekening van FNV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het verbeteren van de mogelijkheden van werkzoekenden in de Nederlandse grensregio’s om over de grens te werken

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about institutional barriers to cross-border work in the Dutch border regions, how regulation could be simplified, how job vacancies in neighbouring Germany and Belgium are made known to Dutch jobseekers, and whether an inventory of regional needs would be carried out. The minister answered that barriers are acknowledged, pointed to existing information websites, the EURES network and earlier inventories, and said a further inventory is not needed now but a conference and an advisory report will be followed up with the Chamber in spring.
The Chamber will be further informed in the spring about this advice, the results of the conference of 16 December and the cabinet's response to it.
De Kamer wordt in het voorjaar nader geïnformeerd over dit advies, de resultaten van de conferentie van 16 december en de reactie van het kabinet hier op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Kuiken en Fokke over uitbuiting van werknemers die werken aan de A2-tunnel in Maastricht

MPs from the PvdA asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Infrastructure about exploitation of foreign workers on the A2 tunnel project in Maastricht, and about whether public bodies should screen contractors and prevent unfair competition. The minister says the Inspectorate SZW is investigating, an expert committee found likely violations of the Bouw cao, and he points to planned chain liability and a study on displacement, while rejecting a change to selection criteria and the Rijkswaterstaat procurement role.
Now that there is a report from the expert committee, it is becoming clearer what is going on.
Nu er een rapport ligt van de expertcommissie wordt inzichtelijker wat er aan de hand is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin Van Dijk over het korten van topinkomens in de zorg

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether the government supports Rotterdam's plan to cap top salaries at care providers through subsidy conditions, and how municipalities can be encouraged to do so. Minister Plasterk answered that excessive pay is undesirable, that the WNT does not prevent stricter subsidy conditions but may conflict with transitional law, and that he will consult the VNG to align central and local policy and report on the model subsidy regulation.
Although I do not wish to restrict the freedom of local government to make its own choices, it seems sensible to align the policies of central and local government.
Hoewel ik niet de vrijheid van het lokaal bestuur wil beperken om eigen keuzes te maken, lijkt het mij verstandig om het beleid van de centrale en de decentrale overheden op elkaar af te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de brandveiligheid van windmolens in Nederland

An MP from the Labour party asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about the fire safety of wind turbines in the Netherlands and whether training, permitting and sector measures should change. The minister replied that Inspectie SZW, the forensic institute, police and the Rotterdam fire service are investigating, that improvements will be considered after those findings, and that the findings will be sent to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over het bericht dat de SER-Commissie Arbeidsomstandigheden positief heeft geoordeeld over ratificatie van ILO-verdrag 170

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he had noted the SER Working Conditions Committee's positive advice on ratifying ILO Convention 170 on chemicals, and whether he would adopt it and when ratification would follow. The minister confirmed he had noted the advice and said the decision rests with the Council of Ministers, which would be presented with the government's position as soon as possible.
The intentions regarding this advice will be submitted to the Council of Ministers as soon as possible.
De voornemens met betrekking tot dit advies zullen zo spoedig mogelijk aan de Rijksministerraad worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Zorgconsultant Humanitas kreeg ton voor maand werk’

MPs Kerstens and Otwin asked whether a care consultant hired by Humanitas DMH who declared about 95,000 euro for one month's work, and an assistant declaring over 35,000 euro per month, could be curbed under the Wet normering topinkomens (Wnt), and whether rules on consultant rates should follow. The minister answered that the case will be enforced under the Wnt, that the consultant's excessive remuneration is not justified, and that a separate bill extending the pay cap to all staff is planned, but declined to set rate limits or provide a registry of such contracts now.
In this case, enforcement will take place in accordance with the law.
In deze casus zal conform de wet worden gehandhaafd.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Kerstens over het advies van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens aan het kabinet om mensen met een beperking meer kansen te geven in onderwijs, werk en maatschappelijk l

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Kerstens asked whether the government agrees that the draft laws for ratifying the UN disability convention give too few guarantees for an inclusive society, whether other laws should contain such guarantees, and whether a national action plan should be drawn up. The state secretary agreed to consult stakeholders on a plan of action, said the Participation Act and social support bill will be considered against the convention, and deferred final judgement to parliament.
In that context I intend to soon consult these parties to consider how to give shape to the implementation of the convention.
In dat kader wil ik binnenkort met deze partijen in overleg treden om te bezien hoe vorm kan worden gegeven aan de tenuitvoerlegging van het verdrag.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over ‘een uitspraak van de Raad van State over schijnconstructies met zogeheten MOE-landers’

The MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked the minister how the Inspectorate SZW will respond to a Council of State ruling on sham constructions using Polish workers, and whether the ruling makes such constructions unacceptable. The minister answered that the ruling clarified the distinction between genuine cross-border services and posting of workers, that the Inspectorate has incorporated its criteria into its working method, and that the action plan on sham constructions addresses service-based constructions.
The Inspectorate SZW has incorporated the criteria from this ruling into its existing working method.
De Inspectie SZW heeft de criteria uit deze uitspraak verwerkt in de bestaande werkwijze.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de verkeersveiligheid op de A15

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about the many accidents on the A15 motorway and what could improve road safety there. The minister attributed the accidents to diverse causes, outlined measures such as road markings, local traffic detection and lane-overtaking changes, and said matrix signalling was not cost-effective.
To improve road safety, Rijkswaterstaat is examining the possibility of applying chevron stripes on the road surface.
Om de verkeersveiligheid te verbeteren onderzoekt Rijkswaterstaat de mogelijkheid om zogenaamde chevronstrepen op het wegdek aan te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over het stimuleren van «reshoring» en de mogelijkheden daarbij in het kader van de Participatiewet

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether reshoring of production to the Netherlands creates jobs for people with a distance to the labour market under the Participatiewet and what measures could stimulate it. The ministers replied that reshoring complements the Participatiewet, pointed to wage-cost subsidies and sector plans, and said the government will promote reshoring's job potential during implementation.

In implementing the Participatiewet, the State Secretary for Social Affairs will explicitly promote the opportunities reshoring offers for creating employment, particularly for people with a distance to the labour market.

Bij de implementatie van de participatiewet gaat de Staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken expliciet uitdragen welke kansen «reshoring» biedt voor het creëren van werkgelegenheid, met name voor mensen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over berichten dat vrijwilligerswerk ouderen aan een nieuwe baan kan helpen

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked whether volunteering helps older people find paid work, whether government policy should change, and whether the Inspectorate's review of reintegration and tegenprestatie should consider it. State Secretary Klijnsma acknowledged volunteering can help job seekers but said existing reintegration tools are sufficient, and promised to inform the House after the Inspectorate's findings expected in October.
I am of the view that the current range of reintegration instruments is sufficient to guide people to work.
Ik ben van oordeel dat het huidige palet aan re-integratie-instrumenten voldoende is om mensen naar werk te begeleiden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over de toegenomen exitpremies van zorgbestuurders

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked about rising severance payments to healthcare executives and whether pay rose before the WNT pay-cap law took effect, and whether the government would act faster or retroactively. The minister answered that 2012 pay data will come in the December 2013 report, that the WNT transition period is kept as adopted, and that retroactive changes are undesirable given property rights and legal certainty.
For the public and semi-public sectors it will not be possible to answer this question and similar questions on actual developments in top incomes for the year 2012.
Voor de publieke en semipublieke sectoren zal het niet mogelijk zijn over het jaar 2012 deze vraag en vergelijkbare vragen over feitelijke ontwikkelingen in verband met topinkomens te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over "het bericht dat arbobedrijven vertrouwelijke informatie van zieke werknemers delen met hun werkgever"

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked the minister about reports that occupational health companies shared confidential information on sick employees with employers, and about the privacy tension with the Wet verbetering poortwachter. The minister said the CBP is considering enforcement against one arbodienst, that the verzuimbedrijf has adjusted, and that he will write to the sector to urge compliance with the Wbp.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) is considering enforcement measures against the occupational health service concerned.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) overweegt handhavende maatregelen bij de betreffende arbodienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de dreigende sluiting van de sociale werkplaats in Groningen

MPs Kerstens, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether the Secretary of State was aware of reports on the threatened closure of the Groningen sheltered workshop, whether she agreed with the term 'sterfhuisconstructie', and whether a regional-differences motion would be implemented. The Secretary answered yes to awareness, explained that the Participatiewet closes Wsw inflow from 2015 without the state closing workshops, and confirmed regional factors will be weighed in the new budget distribution.
The central government is not closing any sw-bedrijven.
Het Rijk sluit daarbij geen sw-bedrijven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de opleiding van heftruckchauffeurs

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the minister whether forklift training is of poor quality and whether minimum standards, certification or legal obligations are needed given many forklift accidents. The minister acknowledged the seriousness of the signals but said no widespread problem was reported, relied on employers and industry bodies (including a quality-criteria handbook), and only committed to raising the issue with sector organisations.
However, the ministry has not received signals that the mentioned problems with forklift training are widespread.
Het ministerie heeft echter geen signalen ontvangen dat de genoemde problemen met heftruckopleidingen wijdverbreid zijn.
Antwoord vragen Kerstens en Kuzu over stijgende bewindvoerderskosten ten laste van de bijzondere bijstand

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary about rising court-appointed administrator costs (beschermingsbewind) consuming municipal special assistance budgets. The government confirmed the rise is mostly driven by more people placed under administration, said it is analysing the signals with VNG, Divosa and NVVK, and pointed to a pending bill giving municipalities power to request administration orders.
We are currently analysing the various signals received. On that basis it will be examined whether and what actions or research are needed.
Momenteel analyseren we de verschillende ontvangen signalen. Aan de hand daarvan zal bekeken worden of en zo ja welke acties of onderzoek nodig zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Groot en Kerstens over zzp'ers die door de Bbz-regeling in de knel raken

MPs asked whether self-employed people on Bbz benefits are being pushed into financial trouble when a Bbz loan is converted into a non-repayable benefit, causing loss of allowances, and how the tax office and municipalities handle the annual statement and this conversion. The minister answered that the conversion is taxed in the year of definitive determination, that individual cases fall to municipalities and the tax secrecy duty, suggested adjusting income estimates for allowances, and said he will ask the state secretary to explore options and inform the House.
However, I have persuaded the state secretary of Finance to explore other options to mitigate or remove the described effects.
Wel heb ik de staatssecretaris van Financiën bereid gevonden andere mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om de geschetste effecten te matigen dan wel weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over giftige gassen in vliegtuigen

MPs Kerstens and Kuiken asked the state secretary whether the Zembla broadcast on toxic gases in aircraft cabins and cockpits warranted further investigation, what was done after the 2010 broadcast, and whether the issue would be raised internationally. The government answered that EASA is primarily responsible, that prior inquiries found no grounds for new rules, that REACH analysis of TCP is scheduled for 2014, and that EASA will report semi-annually and Parliament will be informed of developments.
