I note that various parties continue to want to be kept informed about developments regarding TCP.
Ik constateer dat er bij diverse partijen behoefte blijft om op de hoogte te blijven over de ontwikkelingen in het kader van TCP.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over aan het werk gaan vanuit de bijstand

MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether bureaucratic obstacles deter benefit recipients from accepting temporary agency work and whether temporary work is a good stepping stone to a permanent job. The state secretary acknowledged knowledge bottlenecks in rules and municipal practice, said the government is working with municipalities and agencies to reduce them, and said measures on flexible work and payrolling will be pursued.
We are currently working with municipalities, as announced in the cover letter to this study, to examine the bottlenecks they experience in this area, with temp agencies also involved.

Momenteel zijn wij, zoals aangekondigd in de aanbiedingsbrief bij dit onderzoek, samen met gemeenten bezig de door hen ervaren knelpunten op dit terrein te bezien, waarbij ook uitzendorganisaties zijn betrokken.
Antwoord vragen Kerstens en Hamer over fraude bij de inzet van buitenlandse arbeidskrachten

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about press reports of wage fraud through cross-border posting of foreign workers, including whether a single lead enforcement body should be created. The minister answered that whether such arrangements are unlawful depends on the facts, that enforcement bodies cooperate where needed, and that a broader integrated approach will consider prevention and responsibility allocation among agencies.
Part of the integrated approach is first to examine how illegal or undesirable constructions can be prevented.
Onderdeel van de geïntegreerde aanpak is ten eerste dat wordt bezien op welke wijze illegale of ongewenste constructies kunnen worden voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Kerstens over "beëindiging uitkering van kankerpatiënte omdat vriend te vaak langskwam"

MPs Van Weyenberg and Kerstens asked the state secretary whether it is undesirable that a cancer patient's benefit was stopped because her partner visited too often, and how far law or case law requires this. The state secretary declined to judge the individual case, explained that the WWB is decentralised to municipalities and that cohabitation is assessed case by case, and said she has confidence in municipalities, councils and the courts.
The WWB is decentralised and implemented by the municipalities.
De WWB is gedecentraliseerd en wordt uitgevoerd door de gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Kerstens en Hamer over ‘het onderzoek naar de arbeidsomstandigheden in de Nederlandse pakketdienstensector’.

MPs Mei Li Vos, Hamer and Kerstens asked ministers about working conditions and bogus self-employment among parcel couriers, including PostNL subcontracting, VAR certificates, and whether the Inspectorates and competition authority should intervene. The government acknowledged the problems are undesirable, said bogus self-employment should be prevented and an action plan would follow, announced inspections and an exploratory study, and declined to disclose details of agreements with specific taxpayers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over "de kwetsbare positie van jongeren op de werkvloer

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked the minister whether young workers are more often victims of workplace accidents and whether flexible employment explains this, and asked what extra attention is given. The minister disputes the claim using the TNO Monitor showing no higher accident risk for young workers, notes existing youth-focused safety measures and campaigns, and reports no clear link between flexible contracts and accidents.
I do not reach the same conclusion.
Ik kom niet tot dezelfde conclusie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hilkens en Kerstens over discriminatie van vrouwen bij schadevergoeding na letselschade

MPs Hilkens and Kerstens asked whether insurers may factor a hypothetical childbearing wish or work-care combination into injury compensation, which disadvantages women, and what the government will do about it. The minister says such differential treatment is already prohibited under equal-treatment law, that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens has raised this with the insurance sector, and that affected persons can petition the College or go to court, without committing to new measures.
Discrimination on grounds of sex is already prohibited in this area under the General Equal Treatment Act and the Equal Treatment Decree.
Discriminatie op grond van geslacht is voor dit terrein reeds verboden op grond van de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling en het Besluit gelijke behandeling.
Antwoord vragen Kerstens over het spreekverbod bij SW-bedrijf Pantar

MP Kerstens asked the state secretary whether a gag order on all Pantar employees speaking to municipal councillors was justified, and whether it restricted workers' and councillors' rights during a planned reorganisation. The state secretary answered that no blanket ban exists: employees may speak in a personal capacity, while speaking on behalf of Pantar or by the works council is not allowed, and the matter is for Pantar to handle.
Pantar has indicated that the rights of the works council members are not in question and that every employee has the right to speak in a personal capacity.
Pantar heeft laten weten dat de rechten van de leden van de COR niet ter discussie staan en dat iedere medewerker het recht heeft om op persoonlijke titel te spreken.
Antwoord vragen Kerstens over ‘Mogelijke schijnconstructie met Poolse arbeiders’

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether a scheme combining low wages with a tax-free expense allowance for Polish workers breaches equal pay and whether the minister will end such constructions and intensify action against malicious temp agencies. The minister says the news report is too thin to judge, the scheme may or may not breach the law depending on the allowance, and announces an intensified approach to sham constructions with an integrated plan to parliament by 1 May 2013.
As I wrote to you in my letter of 14 January, I will intensify the approach to sham constructions.
Zoals ik u in mijn brief van 14 januari jl. heb geschreven ga ik de aanpak van schijnconstructies intensiveren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over het bericht dat er jaarlijks ongeveer voor 1 miljard euro faillissementsfraude wordt gepleegd

MPs Recourt and Kerstens asked ministers whether they recognise the estimate of about 1 billion euro yearly losses from bankruptcy fraud, whether the 2.5% detection rate is adequate, and what has been done since the last committee debate. Minister Opstelten answered that about 700 million euro of the 4 billion euro in bankruptcy debts stems from fraud, that the FIOD handles about 40 complex cases a year, and referred to a letter of 27 November 2012 for the measures taken.
For that reason I am of the view that the detection rate must go up further and work on this is under way.
Mede daarom ben ik van mening dat de pakkans verder omhoog moet en wordt daar ook volop aan gewerkt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over de gebrekkige handhaving van de wet controle rechtspersonen en faillissementsfraude

Two MPs asked why the Wet controle rechtspersonen and its Radar system, meant to block convicted bankruptcy fraudsters from founding companies, have produced only about ten referrals, why costs rose to 18.7 million euro, and whether the law is a paper tiger. The minister replied that the system was deliberately started small, that Radar already can analyse other legal persons, that risk reports are valued by users, and that a separate letter on bankruptcy fraud was sent on 27 November 2012.

Supervision of legal persons was started in a limited and controlled way, in consultation with the supervisory and investigative bodies, and was tailored as far as possible to the needs of the receiving parties.
Het toezicht op rechtspersonen is, in overleg met de toezichthoudende en opsporende instanties, beperkt en beheerst gestart en is zoveel mogelijk toegesneden op de behoefte van de afnemende partijen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kerstens over het feit dat mannelijke Wajongeren vaker een baan vinden dan vrouwelijke

An MP asked the state secretary about research showing male Wajongeren find jobs more often than female ones, and about the role of diagnosis, motivation, parents, schools and the UWV. The state secretary said support should be equal for men and women, that UWV applies no gender distinction, and that the research findings have caveats, without committing to new action.
Furthermore, I have no indications that the support of female and male Wajongers by the UWV differs.
Ik heb voorts geen aanwijzingen dat de begeleiding van vrouwelijke en mannelijke Wajongers door het UWV verschilt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht over misstanden bij de sociale werkplaats in Schiedam

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretary about a report of bullying and belittling of vulnerable workers at a sheltered workplace in Schiedam, and whether this is a structural problem. The state secretary called such conduct unacceptable, said Inspectie SZW can investigate complaints, noted no complaint had been filed and that the municipality had started its own investigation, and said the cao is not for him to decide.
I am not a party to the agreements around the collective labour agreement.
In de afspraken rond de cao ben ik geen partij.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer, Kerstens en Monasch over "Bouwbedrijven rommelen met faillissementen"

MPs Hamer, Kerstens and Monasch asked minister Kamp whether he would act on reports of construction firms abusing bankruptcies, dismissals of workers rehired as self-employed, and threats to collective sector agreements. The minister answered that government has no active role in preventing bankruptcy fraud beyond criminal enforcement, that dismissal permits are granted only for genuine self-employed workers, and that no signals of endangered sector arrangements exist, with an SER advice pending.
As already indicated in answering earlier parliamentary questions on bankruptcy fraud, the government has no role in preventing and combating bankruptcy fraud.
Zoals bij de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen over het onderwerp faillissementsfraude al is aangegeven heeft de overheid geen rol bij het voorkomen en bestrijden van faillissementsfraude.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens, Hamer en Timmermans over de aanvraag van uitstel van betaling door SW-bedrijf Licom

MPs asked the state secretary about Licom, a sheltered-employment (Wsw) company seeking suspension of payments after its municipal shareholders withdrew funding, and about its impact on staff, sector-wide deficits, and the ministry's role. The state secretary answered that responsibility for Wsw implementation and oversight lies with municipalities and their councils, so the ministry cannot provide a sector-wide overview and sees no direct role, while noting municipalities pledged to guarantee jobs and wages and that the ministry will monitor developments.
Municipalities are responsible for implementing the Wsw and for sound financial management.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de Wsw en een verantwoord financieel beheer.

m: Motie van het lid Schouten over risico's bij uitwisseling van data met buitenlandse diensten
Asks the government to have the CTIVD investigate risks of data exchange with foreign intelligence services and inform the House about it.
requests the government to ask the CTIVD to investigate such risks in the exchange of data with foreign services
verzoekt de regering, de CTIVD te vragen onderzoek te doen naar dergelijke risico's bij de uitwisseling van data met buitenlandse diensten
Motie van het lid Schouten over extra middelen voor de CTIVD
Asks the government to propose extra funding for the intelligence oversight bodies CTIVD and TIB in view of their new powers.
requests the government to come with a concrete proposal in the Spring Memorandum for extra funds for the CTIVD and TIB
verzoekt de regering, bij de Voorjaarsnota met een concreet voorstel te komen voor extra middelen voor de CTIVD en de TIB
Subamendement van het lid Schouten over goedkeuring van de Tweede Kamer voor staking van de vermoedelijk onrechtmatige uitoefening van een bevoegdheid
Subamendment requiring that a CTIVD-ordered halt to a suspected unlawful intelligence power be submitted immediately to the Tweede Kamer for approval, and resumed if the Kamer does not approve.
A decision as referred to in the first paragraph is immediately submitted to the House of Representatives for approval.
Een beslissing als bedoeld in het eerste lid wordt onmiddellijk ter goedkeuring aan de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal voorgelegd.
Motie van het lid Schouten over internationaal vergelijkend onderzoek naar de vormgeving van de parlementaire controle
Asks the government to commission international comparative research on how parliamentary oversight of the intelligence and security services is designed, with models to strengthen it.
requests the government to conduct international comparative research specifically into the design of parliamentary control of the work of the services
verzoekt de regering, een internationaal vergelijkend onderzoek te doen, specifiek naar de vormgeving van de parlementaire controle van het werk van de diensten
Motie van de leden Bisschop en Schouten over wijziging van het stelsel van toekenning van reststemmen
Asks the government to propose changing the allocation of remainder seats so it uses actual remainder votes rather than averages.
requests the government to come with proposals to change the system for allocating remainder votes
verzoekt de regering, te komen met voorstellen tot wijziging van het stelsel van toekenning van reststemmen
Amendement van het lid Schouten over verhoging van de kinderbijslag
Amendment raises the child benefit budget by 400 million euro, funded from an income windfall, to give every family with children an extra allowance.
The income windfall serves as the funding.
Amendement van de leden Schouten en Dijkgraaf ter vervanging van nr. 4 over verhoging van de kinderbijslag
Raises the child benefit budget by 400 million euro, funded by the revenue windfall, to increase per-child amounts.
This extra budget is used to proportionally raise the amounts per child.
Dit extra budget wordt gebruikt om de bedragen per kind evenredig te verhogen.
Amendement van het lid Schouten over extra budget voor de zorgtoeslag
Amendment adding 400 million euros to the childcare allowance budget to slow its phase-out and reduce the marginal burden on recipients.
In article 8 Specific cost allowance, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by € 400,000 (x € 1,000).
In artikel 8 Tegemoetkoming specifieke kosten worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 400.000 (x € 1.000).
Motie van het lid Schouten over het ten spoedigste vervangen van de modelovereenkomsten door de VAR
Asks the government to replace the model contracts with the VAR classification as soon as possible.
requests the government to replace the model agreements as soon as possible with the VAR
verzoekt de regering, de modelovereenkomsten ten spoedigste te vervangen door de VAR
Motie van de leden Schouten en Pieter Heerma over een onderzoek naar groepen die niet door het armoedebeleid bereikt worden
Asks the government, with municipalities, to research why certain groups are not reached by poverty policy and propose improvements.
requests the government, together with municipalities, to investigate how it is that certain groups are not reached by poverty policy
verzoekt de regering, met gemeenten te onderzoeken hoe het kan dat bepaalde groepen door het armoedebeleid niet bereikt worden
Motie van het lid Schouten over verkleining van het verschil tussen tijdelijke en vaste contracten
Motion asking the government to examine allowing employers three temporary contract renewals with a half-year longer term each time.
requests the government to examine giving employers room to offer three temporary contracts.
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheid te onderzoeken om werkgevers de ruimte te geven om drie keer een tijdelijk contract aan te bieden
Motie van de leden Schouten en Vermeij over een werkgelegenheidsaanpak in de regio Drechtsteden
Asks the government, with municipalities and social partners, to build an employment approach and set up a mobility centre in the Drechtsteden region to address 2,000 threatened jobs.
requests the government, together with the municipalities and social partners, to work towards an employment approach and set up a mobility centre in the region
verzoekt de regering, samen met de betrokken gemeenten en sociale partners tot een werkgelegenheidsaanpak te komen en in de regio een mobiliteitscentrum op te zetten
Motie van het lid Schouten over de bekostiging van SW-bedrijven en beschut werk
Asks the government, in close consultation with Cedris and the VNG, to find a solution in the Spring Memorandum for funding sheltered employment (SW) companies and protected work.
requests the government, in close consultation with Cedris and the VNG, to reach a solution in the Spring Memorandum
verzoekt de regering, in nauw overleg met Cedris en de VNG bij de Voorjaarsnota tot een oplossing te komen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Pieter Heerma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het invoeren van een evaluatiebepaling
Adds an evaluation clause requiring the minister to report to parliament in 2019 on the effectiveness of the sheltered work law.
Our Minister of Social Affairs and Employment sends the States General a report in 2019 on the effectiveness and effects of this law
Onze Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid zendt in 2019 aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet
Amendement van de leden Pieter Heerma en Schouten over het invoeren van een evaluatiebepaling
Adds an evaluation clause requiring the minister to report to parliament within two years on the effectiveness of the Participation Act's sheltered work measures.
Our Minister of Social Affairs and Employment shall send the States General a report within two years of entry into force on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice.

Onze Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid zendt binnen twee jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Amendement van het lid Schouten waarmee o.a. de kloof tussen een- en tweeverdieners wordt verkleind
Changes the income tax and wage tax tables and the combination credit to reduce the gap between single-earner and dual-earner households.
With this amendment the gap between single-earner and dual-earner households becomes smaller, the marginal burden lower and employment promoted.
Met dit amendement wordt de kloof tussen een- en tweeverdieners kleiner, de marginale druk lager en wordt de werkgelegenheid bevorderd.
Amendement van het lid Schouten over een impuls aan het verduurzamen van huurwoningen
Adds tax changes on tobacco excise and a landlord levy reduction to fund energy renovation of rental homes, a fiscal measure without a clear check on executive power.
In the Excise Act, from 1 April 2017 the first and second amounts in article 35 paragraph 1 under b are increased
In de Wet op de accijns worden met ingang van 1 april 2017 in artikel 35, eerste lid, onderdeel b, het eerste en het tweede bedrag verhoogd
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over intrekken van het wetsvoorstel Wet fiscale maatregelen rijksmonumenten en scholing
Asks the government to withdraw the bill on tax measures for listed monuments and education, rather than pursue an alternative scheme.
requests the government to withdraw the bill Wet fiscale maatregelen rijksmonumenten en scholing
verzoekt de regering, het wetsvoorstel Wet fiscale maatregelen rijksmonumenten en scholing in te trekken
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over een gesprek met veldpartijen over financiële steun voor het onderhouden van rijksmonumenten
Asks the government to consult stakeholders on financial support for listed monuments and training without treating a cut as the starting point.
requests the government to enter into talks with stakeholders on the design of financial support for maintaining listed monuments
verzoekt de regering, met veldpartijen in gesprek te gaan om de vormgeving van financiële ondersteuning voor het onderhouden van rijksmonumenten
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Omtzigt en Schouten ter vervanging van nr. 9 over de bedrijfopvolgingsregeling
Amendment narrows the business succession scheme by treating indirect holdings under 5% as business assets only when linked to the holding's operations, with budget impact.
This amendment ensures the business succession scheme remains applicable to an indirect interest of 5% or less
Dit amendement bewerkstelligt dat de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling (BOR) van toepassing blijft op een indirect belang van 5% of minder
Amendement van de leden Omtzigt en Schouten over terugdraaien verlaging accijns op alcohol
Reverses the planned cut in alcohol excise on sparkling wine, wine above 15% and intermediate products, raising revenue.
The submitters consider it undesirable to lower the excise duty on alcohol.
Indieners achten het onwenselijk om de accijns op alcohol te verlagen.
Amendement van de leden Omtzigt en Schouten over de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling

Amends the business succession scheme so that holdings of 5% or less in another company are attributed to the holding company, treating indirect stakes below and above 5% alike, and funds this by cancelling planned excise cuts.
This amendment ensures that the business succession scheme (BOR) continues to apply to an indirect interest of 5% or less
Dit amendement bewerkstelligt dat de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling (BOR) van toepassing blijft op een indirect belang van 5% of minder
Motie van het lid Van Laar c.s. over het invoeren van een kindgebonden budget in Caribisch Nederland

Asks the government to investigate when and how a child-related budget could be introduced in Caribbean Netherlands, its bottlenecks and implementation costs, reporting to parliament before the 2017 budget debate.
requests the government to investigate by when a child-related budget could be introduced in Caribbean Netherlands
verzoekt de regering om, te onderzoeken op welke termijn een kindgebonden budget ingevoerd kan worden in Caribisch Nederland
Motie van het lid Schouten over de energiedoelen als onderdeel van de woonvisie
Asks the government to make the energy targets in PJ per year part of municipal housing visions for housing corporations.
requests the government to make the energy targets (in PJ per year) part of the housing vision
verzoekt de regering, de te behalen energiedoelen (in PJ per jaar) onderdeel te laten zijn van de woonvisie
Motie van het lid Ronnes c.s. over het realiseren van voldoende middeldure huurwoningen
Asks the government to draw up a concrete action plan with municipalities, stakeholders, banks and pension funds to realise enough middle-rent housing quickly.
also to draw up a concrete action plan together with municipalities, stakeholders, business, banks and pension funds
ook een concreet actieplan op te stellen samen met gemeenten, belanghebbenden, bedrijfsleven, banken en pensioenfondsen
Motie van de leden Schouten en Bashir over het laten vervallen van de bestuursverklaring voor mensen in doorstroomwoningen
Asks the government to abolish the administrative declaration (bestuursverklaring) for people moving into transitional housing via reception institutions and amend the implementing decree.
to abolish the administrative declaration for people in transitional housing via social reception institutions
de bestuursverklaring voor mensen in doorstroomwoningen via maatschappelijke opvanginstellingen te laten vervallen
Motie van de leden Koolmees en Schouten over de grote regionale verschillen op de woningmarkt
Asks the government to map options to address regional housing market differences so workers can live where they work.
requests the government to map out the possibilities to do something about these regional differences
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheden in kaart te brengen om iets aan deze regionale verschillen te doen
Motie van de leden Mei Li Vos en Schouten over heroverwegen van de modelovereenkomst voor zelfstandige pakketbezorgers van PostNL
Asks the government to reconsider the model contract for self-employed PostNL parcel couriers that the Tax Authority had already approved, citing the aim of the DBA law to end sham self-employment.
requests the government to reconsider the model contract for self-employed parcel couriers of PostNL already approved by the Tax Authority
verzoekt de regering, de reeds door de Belastingdienst goedgekeurde modelovereenkomst voor zelfstandige pakketbezorgers van PostNL te heroverwegen
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over niet opleggen van naheffingen tenzij de opdrachtgever duidelijk niet van goede wil is
Asks the government not to impose back-payment assessments on clients unless the client is clearly not acting in good faith.
requests the government not to impose back-payment assessments unless the client clearly is not acting in good faith
verzoekt de regering om geen naheffingen op te leggen, tenzij de betreffende opdrachtgever duidelijk niet van goede wil is
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over voor 1 november een voortgangsrapportage aan de Kamer sturen
Asks the government to send a progress report by 1 November and a final report and status update on the DBA law by 12 December, with a decision on the law's progress.
requests the government to send a progress report on 1 November
verzoekt de regering, op 1 november een voortgangsrapportage te sturen
Motie van het lid Vermue c.s. over een onderzoek ter versterking van het budgetrecht van de Staten-Generaal
Asks for a study to strengthen the House's budget authority over premium-financed spending, including information position and audit of legality and efficiency, reported by March 2017.
to conduct a study to strengthen the budget authority of the States General, including improving the information position and audit of legality and efficiency
een onderzoek in te stellen ter versterking van het budgetrecht van de Staten-Generaal, inclusief de verbetering van de informatiepositie en de controle op rechtmatigheid en doelmatigheid
Motie van de leden Amhaouch en Schouten over een volgsysteem voor de uitvoering van moties
Asks the Presidium to propose a tracking system in which the government states within a set period whether and how it has acted on each motion, with a planned timeline.
requests the presidium to make proposals for a system in which the government within a certain period explains whether and how it has taken up the implementation of a motion
verzoekt het presidium, voorstellen te doen voor een systeem waarin de regering binnen een bepaalde termijn beredeneerd aangeeft of en hoe zij de uitvoering van een motie ter hand genomen heeft
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Schouten ter vervanging van nr. 19 dat regelt dat met betrekking tot een bestuurlijke boete onder voorwaarden kan worden meegewerkt aan een schuldregeling

Lets the employee insurance implementing agency (UWV or UWV-equivalent body) remit administrative fines in full or part as part of a debt settlement, if no intent or gross negligence was involved and no repeat violation occurs within a year.
the Employee Insurance Implementation Agency is authorised, at the request of the person fined, to remit the administrative fine in whole or in part
is het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen bevoegd op verzoek van degene aan wie de bestuurlijke boete is opgelegd, de bestuurlijke boete geheel of gedeeltelijk kwijt te schelden

Keeps the rule that people must be told at each direct marketing contact about their right to object, which governs private firms' conduct toward citizens.
Article 41(4) of the Wbp provides that the data subject is informed each time he is approached for direct marketing of the possibility to object.
Artikel 41, lid 4, Wbp, regelt dat betrokkene elke keer dat hij in verband met direct marketing wordt benaderd wordt gewezen op de mogelijkheid tot het doen van verzet.
Amendement van het lid Schouten ter vervanging van nr. 10 strekkende tot het handhaven van de eis dat bij direct marketing burgers telkens worden gewezen op de mogelijkheden tot het doen van verzet
Proposes keeping the rule under the Dutch data protection act that direct marketing contacts must always inform people of their right to object.
Article 41, paragraph 4, of the Wbp provides that the data subject is informed of the right to object each time he is approached in connection with direct marketing.
Artikel 41, lid 4, Wbp, regelt dat betrokkene elke keer dat hij in verband met direct marketing wordt benaderd wordt gewezen op de mogelijkheid tot het doen van verzet.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouten over dubbele kinderbijslag voor ouders met kinderen met autisme

MPs Van Weyenberg and Schouten asked the minister about double child benefit for parents of children with autism, including diagnosis mix, how parents demonstrate intensive care needs, the CIZ assessment framework and evaluation, and handling of parental letters. The minister answered that most approved children have only an autism diagnosis, explained the assessment criteria and procedure, reported a parent meeting, and announced process improvements and a policy review.
Exact numbers cannot be given because the information cannot be retrieved directly from the automated systems.
Exacte aantallen zijn niet te geven omdat de informatie niet rechtreeks uit de geautomatiseerde systemen is te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Bruins over de mogelijkheden om grenswerkers als expats te behandelen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether cross-border workers (grenswerkers) suffer financial disadvantage, such as missing child benefit or sick pay, and whether tax advantages could stimulate cross-border work. The State Secretary answered that financial effects depend on personal circumstances, that information provision via grensinfo.nl and a cross-border tax team is being strengthened, that existing tax compensation schemes and EU coordination rules largely avoid disadvantage, and that no extra fiscal stimulus is planned.
That is why the Cross-Border Economy and Labour Action Team formulated, as an action in its report, making the financial consequences of cross-border work transparent.

Daarom heeft het Actieteam Grensoverschrijdende Economie en Arbeid in het rapport Grenzen slechten, regio’s verbinden, mensen bewegen 2 als actie geformuleerd het inzichtelijk maken van de financiële gevolgen van werken over de grens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht ‘Koolmonoxidevergiftiging kinderen door barbecue in ijskoud huis’

An MP asked the State Secretary about a case where children were poisoned by carbon monoxide from a barbecue in a cold house, and asked whether utilities and evictions for debt should be restricted when children are present. The government answered that existing rules already protect vulnerable households, that no new ban on disconnections or evictions is needed, and that it will keep discussing gaps with local bodies without committing to a formal report.
On the basis of the current policy described above, the cabinet is of the view that the disconnection policy, in particular for vulnerable households, requires no amendment.
Op basis van bovenstaand omschreven huidig beleid is het kabinet van mening dat het afsluitbeleid, in het bijzonder het afsluitbeleid bij kwetsbare huishoudens, geen aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de mogelijkheden voor ontwikkelingswerkers om zich vrijwillig te verzekeren voor AOW en Anw tegen een minimumpremie

MP Schouten asked whether development workers, aid workers and missionaries abroad who receive only expense reimbursements can insure voluntarily for AOW and Anw at the minimum premium, and whether current barriers exist. The State Secretary confirmed the situation, agreed that the minimum premium should not be a barrier, said individual questions can go to the SVB or a court, and announced no plans to change the voluntary insurance system.
I currently have no intention to make changes to the voluntary insurance system.
Ik heb op dit moment geen voornemen om verandering in het systeem voor vrijwillige verzekering aan te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de protestactie van ouders met autistische kinderen die geen dubbele kinderbijslag kunnen krijgen

An MP asked whether parents of autistic children who previously received the TOG allowance are losing double child benefit, how many were affected, and what the government will do. The minister says the total number of children receiving intensive-care double child benefit stayed roughly constant, that a shift in target group cannot be excluded, and that he will consult CIZ and SVB on whether parent information on the procedure is adequate.
I am therefore consulting with CIZ and SVB to see whether the information provided to parents about the procedure is sufficiently adequate.
Ik overleg daarom met CIZ en SVB om te bezien of de voorlichting aan ouders over de procedure voldoende adequaat is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het door kerken uitgebrachte rapport ‘Armoede in Nederland 2016’

A Christian Union MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about a 2016 report by Dutch churches on poverty and church-based aid, including bureaucracy, waiting times and the need for coordinated support. The State Secretary welcomed the report, pointed to existing measures (beslagvrije voet simplification, debt-register expansion, legal moratorium, subsidies) and to municipalities' responsibility, and committed to forwarding the report to municipalities and answering before the budget debate.
I will bring the report to the attention of municipalities in the collective letter to municipalities.
Ik zal in de verzamelbrief aan gemeenten het rapport onder de aandacht brengen van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten over "over het ontbreken van het beroep ‘leraar basisonderwijs’ op de kansberoepenlijst van het UWV "

MPs Bruins and Schouten asked why primary-school teacher is not on UWV's list of opportunity occupations despite projected shortages from 2016 and 2020, and whether the government will consult stakeholders and answer quickly. The minister replied that current supply is sufficient (about 7,800 unemployed in primary education in 2015), so the occupation is excluded, that the list is updated twice yearly and could be revised, and that he will inform parliament in November.
I will inform your House in November about the latest state of affairs on the education labour market.
Ik zal uw Kamer in november informeren over de laatste stand van zaken op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over Driezorg in Zwolle en de Wet normering topinkomens

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked about a 426,113 euro severance payment to the former director of Driezorg in Zwolle and whether it complies with the WNT pay cap. The state secretary answered that the amount exceeds the WNT limit but that pre-WNT agreements apply until four years after 2013, that the accountant found no violations, and that the CIBG will nonetheless investigate.
Nevertheless, the CIBG will carry out an investigation to ensure there is no question of violations.
Desondanks zal het CIBG een onderzoek uitvoeren om zeker te stellen dat er geen sprake is van overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten over het ontbreken van het beroep ‘leraar basisonderwijs’ op de kansberoepenlijst van het UWV

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why the profession of primary school teacher is absent from UWV's list of opportunity occupations, despite expected shortages in 2017-2019. The minister answered that teacher shortages are expected mainly in the four big cities, that current job losses and available unemployed teachers mean enough qualified candidates exist, and that UWV will reassess the list twice yearly.
If it turns out that the profession of primary school teacher meets the criteria, it will be included on the list of opportunity occupations.
Indien daarbij blijkt dat het beroep «leraar basisonderwijs» aan de criteria voldoet, zal dit op de lijst met kansberoepen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de vorming van woningmarktregio’s

An MP asks the Minister for Housing whether housing associations can effectively veto the housing market regions municipalities prefer by refusing exemptions or splits, and whether the Minister will intervene or change the law. The Minister answers that municipalities propose regions, exemptions are a separate procedure with criteria, the Minister will not steer the regional proposals, and he will not legislate forced splits because that would violate property rights.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de sloop van krakkemikkige gebouwen

MP Schouten asks whether demolition of dilapidated buildings can cost a plot its residential zoning without planning compensation, and whether VAT on building land deters demolition compared with transfer tax. The minister replies that demolition does not itself remove zoning, that existing procedural safeguards and planning damage compensation rules are adequate, and that the VAT exemption is fixed by EU directive so the law cannot be changed.
Demolition does not automatically lead to a plot losing its residential zoning.
Sloop leidt er niet toe dat een perceel vanzelf zijn woonbestemming verliest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Segers over de BTW-plicht van gemeenten bij ambtelijke fusies

MPs Schouten and Segers asked why municipalities merging their civil service must pay VAT on services from the joint organisation, and whether an exemption would be introduced. The Staatssecretaris confirmed awareness, explained the cooperation exemption's conditions, and announced a policy change extending the exemption to services used 70% or more for non-taxed municipal activities, largely solving the problem.
I will publish this policy change in the usual way, whereby under the Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht the past will not be revisited ex officio.
Ik zal deze beleidswijziging op de gebruikelijke wijze publiceren, waarbij conform het Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht ambtshalve niet op het verleden wordt teruggekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Schouten over het verdwijnen van de blauwe envelop, het gebruik van de berichtenbox en de ouderenservice van de ouderenbonden

MPs Omtzigt and Schouten asked about complaints over abolishing the paper blue envelope, digital-only delivery via the Berichtenbox, and the future of the elderly tax-help service run by senior unions. Secretary Wiebes answered that support for less digitally capable people will continue, that the elderly service receives a one-year 2016 contribution, and that the first digital-only letter is the 2016 allowance continuation notice with a 6-week objection period preserved.
To ensure the first fully digital delivery of allowance messages in the Berichtenbox takes place responsibly, the Tax Administration starts with the notice on continuation of allowances.

Om te zorgen dat de eerste volledig digitale bezorging van toeslagberichten in de Berichtenbox ook verantwoord plaatsvindt, begint de Belastingdienst met het bericht over de continuering van toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes c.s. over de inhoud van de prospectus voor beursgang ABN AMRO

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister whether the ABN AMRO prospectus for its stock market listing shows share-linked bonuses that conflict with earlier assurances and the Merkies/Nijboer amendment, and about conflicts of interest of two board members. The minister answered that identified staff may receive variable pay in non-cash form, that the top 7 board members and 25 senior managers are barred from variable pay while the state holds a stake, that the amendment is complied with, and that the bonus decisions rest with ABN AMRO itself.
ABN AMRO as a company itself bears responsibility for drawing up a variable pay scheme within the legal framework.
ABN AMRO heeft als vennootschap zelf de verantwoordelijkheid om binnen het wettelijke kader een variabele beloningsregeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Segers over het onterecht in rekening brengen van informatie- en executiekosten door gerechtsdeurwaarders

MPs asked whether bailiffs wrongly charge information and execution costs, including unjustified bank attachments, and how often tax-authority attachments are pointless. The minister answered that the KBvG reported four disciplinary complaints and the BFT three investigations in five years, that no further consultation is needed, and that roughly 130,000 to 135,000 attachments are levied yearly with electronic information requests and the VISH index used to reduce pointless attachments.
In view of the information provided by the BFT and the KBvG, I see no reason to enter into additional discussions on this matter.
Gelet op de verstrekte informatie van het BFT en de KBvG zie ik geen aanleiding aanvullende gesprekken hierover aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Koser-Kaya, Karabulut en Schouten over de brief ‘Eerste tussenmeting banenafspraak’

MPs asked about Wsw sheltered-employment placements, waiting-list trends, hours worked and job counts under the banenafspraak (jobs agreement) for disabled workers in 2013-2014. The state secretary answered with Panteia and UWV figures, showing a shift from sheltered workshops to external placements and an increase of 7,304 unique extra jobs, and said the 2015 results would follow around summer 2016.
You will receive the answers in advance of the General Consultation on the Participation Act of 29 October.
U ontvangt de antwoorden voorafgaand aan het Algemeen overleg Participatiewet van 29 oktober.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat het vaderschapsverlof verlengd moet worden

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch paternity leave (2 days paid, 3 days unpaid) is too short compared with other European countries, and whether a paid extension to ten days would be considered. The minister acknowledged Dutch leave is below average, pointed to other arrangements for combining work and care, and said a further extension is desirable but gave no commitment on new measures, referring to a pending SER advice.
An extension of leave at the birth of the child is therefore desirable.
Een verruiming van het verlof bij de geboorte van het kind is dan ook wenselijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Jasper van Dijk, Rog en Bisschop inzake de berekeningen van de VSNU dat het studievoorschot bij lange na geen 1 miljard euro oplevert en de komende tien jaar zelfs nauwelijks ext

MPs Schouten, Van Dijk, Rog and Bisschop asked the Minister of Education about VSNU calculations showing the student tuition-investment package yields far less than 1 billion euro and barely adds investment over ten years. The minister replied that up to 1 billion euro becomes available by 2026, that institutions will pre-invest 200 million euro yearly in 2015-2017, and that the investment will vary by institution, with details reported only at sector level.
I expect institutions to make the allocation of their pre-investments transparent and to discuss them well internally.
Ik verwacht van de instellingen dat zij de bestemming van de voorinvesteringen inzichtelijk maken en intern goed bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over 375 ontslagen bij FrieslandCampina in Beilen en Leeuwarden

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about 375 layoffs at FrieslandCampina in Beilen and Leeuwarden, including the lack of early notice to local government and plans for reemployment. The minister answered that the company's internal decision-making comes first, that the sector and regional plans support job transitions, and that the Dutch Dairy Chain programme continues unchanged.
I trust that FrieslandCampina will actively, together with the parties involved such as the trade unions and regional governments, work to help employees move from job to job.

Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat FrieslandCampina zich actief, samen met de betrokken partijen als de vakorganisaties en de regionale overheden, zullen inzetten om werknemers van werk naar werk te begeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het opleggen van een werkstraf aan een uitkeringsgerechtigde vanwege het niet opgeven van vrijwilligerswerk

MP Schouten asks whether a benefit recipient given a community-service sentence for not reporting unpaid volunteer church work should prompt a review of the anti-fraud law, and whether guidance to volunteers should be improved. The Secretary of State answers that no review is needed because volunteering involves no income so cannot be fraud, though failing to report it can breach reporting duties, and sees no reason for new guidance with municipalities.
I see no reason in this context to examine how the fraud law works.
Ik zie in dit verband geen reden om naar de werking van de fraudewet te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Verhoeven over het clusteren van werkzaamheden bij een aanbesteding door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Schouten and Verhoeven asked whether Rijkswaterstaat's combined multi-year maintenance tender for the West-Nederland-Zuid area breached the Aanbestedingswet's ban on unnecessary clustering and disadvantaged SMEs. The government answered that a complaint was upheld, the tender was withdrawn and split into three smaller lots, and it will evaluate the law's clustering rules in the summer.
Rijkswaterstaat found the complaint well-founded and withdrew the tender.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft de klacht gegrond bevonden en heeft de aanbesteding ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de berichten dat mantelzorgers overbelast raken

An MP asks whether working carers overburdened by combining paid work with caregiving face health risks and what barriers and remedies exist. The minister answers that intensive caregiving raises reported health complaints and sick leave, cites prevention campaigns, expanded leave rights from July 2015, and an upcoming SER advisory request and awareness campaign.
Government policy is therefore aimed at preventing people from becoming exhausted and overburdened by combining work and care and subsequently possibly stopping work.
Het kabinetsbeleid is er dan ook op gericht te voorkomen dat mensen door de combinatie van werk en zorg oververmoeid en overbelast raken en vervolgens mogelijk stoppen met werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de naleving van de beslagvrije voet door schuldeisers

MP Schouten (ChristenUnie) asked whether creditors are routinely breaching the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) and what the government will do, including faster government connection to the attachment register and Tax Authority repayment with retroactive effect. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem is substantial, announced simplification of the calculation rules, a phased connection of bailiffs to the register with government connection still requiring preparation, and said the Tax Authority generally does not repay retroactively unless the debtor is not at fault.
I do not have data showing how many people must live on an income below the applicable protected minimum.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens waaruit blijkt hoeveel mensen moeten rondkomen van een inkomen onder de voor hen van toepassing zijnde beslagvrije voet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen en Schouten over de uitspraak van het Hof Arnhem-Leeuwarden, die de Belastingdienst in het ongelijk stelde en bepaalde dat deelkwalificaties wel in aanmerking k

MPs Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen and Schouten asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education about a Court of Appeal ruling that part-qualifications qualify for the education wage-tax reduction, including whether the Tax Service's corrections will be suspended, how firms are compensated, and whether bankruptcies or dropouts resulted. The government answered that it will file a cassation appeal before 29 January 2015, that corrections can be held pending the Supreme Court ruling on objection request, that refunds follow any Supreme Court outcome, and that it has no data on affected firms, students or bankruptcies.
I intend to file a cassation appeal against this ruling.
Ik ben voornemens om tegen deze uitspraak in cassatie te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over een mogelijke uittreding van Griekenland uit de Eurozone

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether a Greek exit from the eurozone would be manageable, as suggested by the German government, and whether the cabinet has a contingency scenario for such an exit. The minister answered that the priority is keeping Greece in the eurozone, that speculation about an exit is not appropriate, and that no 'Greece out of the eurozone' scenario is available.
A scenario 'Greece out of the eurozone' is not available.
Een scenario «Griekenland uit de eurozone» is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius en Yücel over de medewerking van het kabinet aan het plan om de werkloosheid in Twente aan te pakken

MPs Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether the cabinet will cooperate with the Twente 'Twente Werkt' action plan against high unemployment, and referred to earlier motions on regional economic renewal and border regions. Minister Kamp replied that the ministries already participate in the plan, pointed to earlier letters, acknowledged a skills mismatch in Twente and said no substantial changes to government jobs in the region are foreseen, while leaving the specific contribution per action line to a later letter.
The ministries of Social Affairs and Employment and Economic Affairs are already actively participating in the 'Twente Werkt!' action plan.
De ministeries van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Economische Zaken werken al actief mee aan het Actieplan «Twente Werkt!.»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Karabulut en Yücel over de invordering van belasting- en toeslagschulden door de Belastingdienst

MPs Schouten, Karabulut and Yücel asked whether the Tax Authority's recovery of tax and benefit debts ignores personal circumstances and the subsistence allowance (beslagvrije voet), pushing people deeper into debt, and how the motion on respecting the subsistence allowance will be implemented. The State Secretary acknowledged the Tax Authority cannot always account for personal circumstances, pointed to payment arrangements and the duty of debtors to act, exempted single parents from set-off against the child budget, and promised to discuss the report's recommendations with the LOSR and inform parliament.
The Tax Authority makes every effort to respect the subsistence allowance in line with the Schouten et al. motion.
De Belastingdienst spant zich maximaal in om conform de motie Schouten c.s. de beslagvrije voet te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Schouten over schulden voorkomen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether he knew of CNV union debt-prevention courses for employees, whether he would engage employers and unions on debt prevention and wage garnishment, and whether he would research the effect of financial problems on sickness absence. The State Secretary answered yes to all three, citing sector initiatives such as aviation, subsidies to Hogeschool Utrecht, ongoing talks with Nibud and Divosa, and a 2012 study on sickness absence.
Yes, I am certainly willing to do so.
Ja, daar ben ik zeker toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Schouten over onoplosbare schulden

MPs Yücel and Schouten asked about the Jungmann report on unsolvable debt situations, including eligibility criteria for debt rescheduling, municipal barriers, behavioural factors and alternative help. The state secretary answered that the report's exclusion practices conflict with the Wgs, that municipal help should be client-oriented, and that a broader range of support exists beyond debt rescheduling, with a letter on the debt policy and the land debt register promised for December.
Excluding debtors does not solve the underlying problem.
Het uitsluiten van schuldenaren lost de eigenlijke problematiek niet op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over "de berichten dat huishoudens met financiële problemen de samenleving jaarlijks elf miljard euro kosten"

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about Nibud findings that over-indebted households cost society eleven billion euros a year, and whether debt prevention should be strengthened in policy and law. The State Secretary answered that the figures rest on existing research, that prevention is already anchored in law and municipal policy, and that she will support municipalities through platform meetings and further monitoring.
I endorse the importance Nibud attaches to a broad approach to debt prevention, with specific attention to making people self-reliant and to insight into behaviour.
Ik onderschrijf het belang dat Nibud hecht aan een brede aanpak van preventie van schulden met daarin specifieke aandacht voor het zelfredzaam maken van mensen en inzicht in het gedrag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Kerstens en Karabulut over het bericht dat een ondernemer een boete heeft gekregen van €12.000,- , omdat hij niet beschikte over de vereiste tewerkstellingvergunning

MPs Schouten, Kerstens and Karabulut asked why a Veenendaal employer was fined €12,000 for employing a Bulgarian worker without a work permit, although UWV had mediated the worker, and whether the fine should be withdrawn and the fraud law amended. The Minister says UWV should have warned the employer, the fine was reduced by 100% on objection, UWV has agreed to flag permit requirements, and a warning option will be introduced in the Wav.
It would have been desirable if UWV WERKbedrijf had pointed the employer, in the July 2012 conversation, to the obligation to apply for a work permit.
Het was wenselijk geweest als UWV WERKbedrijf de werkgever in het gesprek in juli 2012 had gewezen op de verplichting een tewerkstellingsvergunning aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de toepassing van de uitzondering op de maximale periode van 10 jaar voor de vrijwillige verzekering van de AOW

MP Schouten asked whether the SVB wrongly excludes volunteers sent abroad by designated development organisations from the exception to the 10-year limit on voluntary AOW insurance, how many are affected, and what group the exception targets. The State Secretary replied that the SVB applies the exception to all qualifying development workers, including volunteers and interns, provided the placement is under a designated Dutch organisation, and agreed that longer voluntary insurance for such volunteers is desirable.
All development workers who meet the conditions set out in the regulations are eligible for the exception to the maximum duration of voluntary AOW insurance.
Alle ontwikkelingswerkers die aan de in de regelgeving genoemde voorwaarden voldoen komen in aanmerking voor toepassing van de uitzondering op de maximale duur van de vrijwillige AOW-verzekering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Voortman over het bericht dat overheden ervoor zorgen dat langdurige werklozen en arbeidsgehandicapten een hevige concurrentiestrijd leveren aan de onderkant van de arbeidsmark

MPs Schouten and Voortman asked whether social return in public tenders disadvantages social enterprises employing people far from the labour market, and whether government will support social entrepreneurship. The government answered that social return targets only extra placements, that social and regular firms face similar obstacles, that municipalities are responsible for their own tenders, and that it has asked the SER for advice due in early 2015.
Regarding the case in the article, the municipality concerned is responsible for the tenders it issues and the social conditions it sets. I have no insight into that.

Ten aanzien van de casus in het artikel geldt dat de betreffende gemeente verantwoordelijk is voor de aanbestedingen die zij doet en de sociale voorwaarden die zij daarbij stelt. Ik heb daar geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het weigeren van studiefinanciering voor een master na een gecombineerde bacheloropleiding Pabo (HBO) en Pedagogische Wetenschappen (WO)

An MP asked why students who completed a combined HBO Pabo and WO Pedagogical Sciences bachelor in nominal time are denied a performance grant for a master, and whether the minister would make an exception. The minister refused any exception, stating students have four years of entitlement, pointed to funded professional masters and teacher grants, and said the current rules remain unchanged for next year.
I do not want to make an exception to the existing regulations for the group of academic Pabo students.
Ik wil voor de groep studenten van de academische pabo geen uitzondering maken op de bestaande regelgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Kuzu over de berichten dat het rijk schulden erger maakt door het inhouden van toeslagen en de stijging van het aantal mensen dat onder beschermingsbewind is geplaatst

MPs Schouten and Kuzu asked whether the state worsens household debts by clawing back excess childcare and other benefit advances, and about the rise in people placed under protective administration (beschermingsbewind). The state secretary acknowledged the repayment problem, described repayment arrangements and the protection of the subsistence allowance, said the Rijksincassovisie would address it, and referred to a separate letter for the protective administration questions.
If the benefit applicant cannot pay the amount under the standard payment arrangement, he can ask for a tailored payment arrangement.
Wanneer de toeslagaanvrager het bedrag van de standaard betalingsregeling niet kan opbrengen, kan hij om een betalingsregeling op maat vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Schouten over het bericht dat miljardenwinst door dwangarbeid en seks behaald wordt

MPs Segers and Schouten asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Security and Justice how the government responds to an ILO report on forced labour profits, its size in the EU and the Netherlands, migrant share, enforcement capacity, and international cooperation. Minister Asscher answered that the government is doing all it can, cites rising human trafficking prosecutions, says reliable victim estimates are lacking, and states support for the new ILO forced labour protocol.
It is my intention to ratify the new instrument as soon as possible, after going through the usual procedure.
Het is mijn intentie om het nieuwe instrument, na daartoe de gebruikelijke procedure te hebben doorlopen, zo spoedig mogelijk te ratificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over het bericht dat de Voedselbank EU-geld voor armoedebestrijding opeist

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked why the government is using EU food-aid fund FEAD for 2014-2020, whether consultation occurred, and how food surpluses could better reach food banks. The state secretary answered that the funds are reallocated from ESF/EFRO rather than additional, that the fund targets social inclusion, and that gemeenten and the AVV-Voedselbanken cooperation are being engaged, with promises of further talks and support.
It is correct that for the 2014-2020 programme period the Netherlands will deploy 3.5 million euros for the EU Fund for European Aid to the Most Deprived (FEAD).
Het klopt dat Nederland voor de programmaperiode 2014–2020 3,5 miljoen euro zal inzetten voor het Fonds voor Europese hulp aan de meestbehoeftigen (FEAD).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de berichten dat het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) geen toestemming geeft voor vrijwilligerswerk

Member Schouten (ChristenUnie) asks the minister whether UWV's restrictions on volunteer work by benefit recipients are too strict and whether they will be loosened. The minister agrees volunteering can help job prospects, says benefit recipients must still meet job-search obligations, and announces proposals before summer to widen the possibility of volunteering while keeping WW benefits.
I will make proposals before the summer for widening the possibility of performing volunteer work while retaining WW benefits.
Ik zal voor de zomer voorstellen doen voor verruiming van de mogelijkheid om vrijwilligerswerk te verrichten met behoud van WW-uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over een open brief van de Evangelische Hogeschool

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Minister of Education whether she will respond to an open letter from the Evangelische Hogeschool about uncertainty over the student loan system and provide clarity before 1 May, and whether she has followed up on a promised meeting with institutions offering gap years. The Minister says a new integral proposal on the social loan system will be presented before summer 2014, that the promised meeting will be scheduled once there is more clarity, and that the question on students' decision-making timing is answered in her reply to question 2.
I have promised your House that I will present a new integral proposal to the House before the summer of 2014.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd nog voor de zomer van 2014 een nieuw integraal voorstel aan de Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Lucas over het bericht dat een grote scheepsbouworder mogelijk naar een Spaanse scheepsbouwer gaat

MPs Schouten and Lucas asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Texel ferry operator TESO's provisional choice of a Spanish shipyard, despite Dutch innovation in the design, reflects unfair Spanish state subsidies and what the government will do to recover the order. The minister answered that Spain is bound by the EU shipbuilding aid framework, that the Commission has acted against past Spanish tax-lease aid, that he has no signals of current unlawful aid, and that he sees no reason to intervene because the order appears to be won on normal commercial terms.
At present I have no indications that the Spanish government is giving support to shipyards that leads to unfair competition.
Thans heb ik geen aanwijzingen dat de Spaanse overheid steun geeft aan werven die tot oneerlijke concurrentie leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de gevaren van open verbrandingstoestellen

Schouten (ChristenUnie) asks the Minister of Housing about deaths and hospitalisations from carbon monoxide poisoning by open combustion appliances and whether the phase-out period of about 10 years should be shortened, and whether mandatory CO detectors should be introduced. The Minister answers that existing measures (maintenance, CO detectors, a 2009 handbook and a convenant with landlords) are sufficient, that CO detectors will not be made mandatory because enforcement behind front doors is difficult, and that no new agreements will be made.
I am of the opinion that the central government is currently doing sufficient in this regard.
Ik ben van mening dat hiermee vanuit de Rijksoverheid op dit moment voldoende wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Schouten over de realisatie van de doelstelling om te komen tot 5000 politievrijwilligers in 2015

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about reaching the target of 5,000 police volunteers by 2015, including recruitment, retention, displacement of paid work, unemployment-benefit rules, allowances, and volunteers' powers. The minister answered that recruitment is on track through planned campaigns, that the government will align volunteer status and powers with policy, and that displacement of paid labour must be avoided.
The deployment of police volunteers must not lead to displacement of paid labour.
Het inzetten van politievrijwilligers mag niet leiden tot verdringing van arbeid.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber en Schouten over mantelzorgers die weinig steun hebben aan hun baas

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked whether the government recognises that informal carers receive little support from their employers, whether it will convene social partners to improve workplace arrangements, and what further measures it will take. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to a planned labour-and-care summit with social partners in autumn and to extended leave rules, and said the carers letter would address the work-care link only briefly.
In the coming period we will work together with the minister and state secretary of OCW to prepare a 'labour-and-care summit' which is expected to take place in the autumn.
De komende tijd werken wij samen met de minister en staatssecretaris van OCW een «arbeid-en-zorgtop» uit die naar verwachting in het najaar zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Dik-Faber over het meetellen van het persoonsgebonden budget in box 3

MPs Schouten and Dik-Faber asked whether unspent personal budget (PGB) advances count as box 3 wealth, lowering the fairness of the AWBZ own-contribution rules, and whether the government will investigate alternatives. The government confirmed PGB advances count as liquid assets, noted that payment timing by two care offices can create a small effect, and promised a letter after the Spring Memorandum on possible remedies.

During the debate of 4 April 2013 on the unintended effects of the wealth income add-on, I committed to indicate in a letter following the Spring Memorandum whether there are options to remedy the identified effects of the PGB on the wealth income add-on for the AWBZ own contribution.

Tijdens het debat van 4 april 2013 over de ongewenste effecten van de vermogensinkomensbijtelling heb ik toegezegd dat ik in een brief naar aanleiding van de Voorjaarsnota zal aangeven of er mogelijkheden zijn om de geconstateerde gevolgen van het PGB voor de vermogensinkomensbijtelling voor de eigen bijdrage AWBZ te verhelpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat er meer huurders uit huis worden gezet

Parliamentary member Schouten asked about reports that more tenants are being evicted, including whether debt counselling and debt rescheduling are offered often enough to prevent evictions and whether early warning of debts can be improved. State Secretary Klijnsma answered that evictions rose about 10% in 2012 per housing association survey, that corporations prevent evictions where they can and cooperate with municipalities, and that the government will raise the issue with Aedes and municipalities and explore expanding early-warning and credit-registration systems with concrete proposals before summer.
I have taken note of the report.
Ik heb kennis genomen van het bericht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het te laag vaststellen van de beslagvrije voet door deurwaarders en overheidsinstanties

An MP asked the state secretary whether the beslagvrije voet (protected minimum income from wage/benefit garnishment) is set too low by bailiffs and agencies such as UWV and SVB, and what will be done about it. The government replied that the protected amount must be respected by all creditors, that there is no registration of garnishments so the scale cannot be estimated, and that information, communication and the Paritas Passé study will be addressed in a forthcoming cabinet response.
There is no register recording garnishments imposed on a debtor and/or comparable collection measures.
Er is geen registratie waarin ten laste van een schuldenaar gelegde beslagen en/of daarmee vergelijkbare invorderingsmaatregelen worden geadministreerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over de studenten OV-chipkaart

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why students cannot use the temporary replacement and refund arrangements available to other OV-chipkaart holders, and whether one uniform scheme could be created. The minister replied that student data protection rules prevent carriers from verifying students, so the differences remain, though the government judges the refund process not unduly complicated.
For privacy reasons, individual carriers may never have access to students' personal data.
Om privacyredenen zullen individuele vervoerders nooit over de persoonsgegevens van studenten mogen beschikken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht “doof meisje kan geen journaliste worden”

An MP asked the state secretary for Education whether a deaf student denied the ability to finish journalism training met the duty to make reasonable accommodations under equal-treatment law, and whether accreditation checked accessibility. The state secretary answered that institutions must make adequate adjustments in consultation with the student, that accessibility is now an accreditation element checked at institutional level, and that disputes can go to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
This autumn the NVAO will check at institutional level (institutional audit) whether and how Hogeschool Utrecht has introduced policy for students with a disability.
Dit najaar toetst de NVAO op instellingsniveau (instellingstoets) of en op welke wijze de Hogeschool Utrecht beleid ten aanzien van studenten met een functiebeperking heeft ingevoerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber en Schouten over de subsidietoekenning 2013-2016 aan Slot Loevestein

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked the state secretary whether cutting the 2013-2016 subsidy to Slot Loevestein, which may close the castle to the public, fits his earlier praise for its cultural entrepreneurship, and why such entrepreneurship is penalised. The state secretary replied that the subsidy follows his policy priorities and the Raad voor Cultuur advice, that the lower grant is not a punishment, and that whether the monument stays open is for the castle's management to decide.
I follow the substantive advice of the Raad voor Cultuur and want to secure the preservation and management of the state collection through subsidy.
Ik volg het inhoudelijk advies van de Raad voor Cultuur en wil het behoud en beheer van de rijkscollectie zeker stellen door middel van subsidie.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn en Schouten over corruptie van politici op Bonaire

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Schouten asked why the government did not act on long-standing corruption rumours on Bonaire, why the international corruption investigation was halted, and how public integrity will be strengthened. The minister replied that the Public Prosecution Service is pursuing criminal investigations, that earlier reports were forwarded to prosecutors, that the case was dismissed in 2011 but partly revived by a court in 2012, and that integrity is primarily the responsibility of the local administration with ministry-set preconditions.

On 13 September 2012 the Court declared the complaint well-founded for two dossiers forming part of the total investigation and instructed the Public Prosecution Service to prosecute the suspects for those offences.

Het Hof heeft deze klacht op 13 september 2012 gegrond verklaard voor twee dossiers die deel uitmaakten van het totale onderzoek, en het OM opgedragen de verdachten alsnog voor die feiten te vervolgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat studenten die door ziekte studievertraging hebben opgelopen, een langstudeerboete krijgen opgelegd

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether students who fell behind due to illness are being charged the higher tuition under the long-study penalty despite a promised exemption for chronically ill students. The state secretary answered that the law was amended to extend the exemption to chronically ill and disabled students without study finance, that students can apply to the institutional hardship fund, and that any affected students have since been helped.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat banken de geldkraan voor veelbelovende bedrijven dichtdraaien

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether banks are blocking credit to promising technology firms, whether the December agreements with banks are being kept, and what will be done about financing obstacles. The minister says financing is a priority, points to existing schemes (Innovatiefonds MKB+, innovation contracts, OKD, information campaigns) and rejects extending the willekeurige afschrijving tax measure on budgetary grounds.
The cabinet is in principle in favour of measures that stimulate investment by businesses.
Het kabinet is in principe voorstander van maatregelen die investeringen door het bedrijfsleven stimuleren.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn en Schouten over gedetineerden uit Saba en St. Eustatius in Bonaire

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Schouten asked the Dutch government about prisoners from Saba and St. Eustatius being held and tried on Bonaire, covering defence-lawyer access, video-link problems, prison conditions, juvenile offenders, reintegration, family visits and the facility location. Minister Opstelten largely rejected the critiques, said conditions are equal to other prisons and improving, and promised a new prison on St. Eustatius by 2014 and an examination of weekly video contact for families.

Since 10 October 2010 a slightly different situation has arisen, namely that suspects detained longer than 18 days are now transferred to Bonaire instead of St. Maarten, but the suspect's detention rights have remained unchanged.

Sinds 10 oktober 2010 is weliswaar een iets andere situatie ontstaan dan daarvoor, namelijk dat verdachten die langer dan 18 dagen gedetineerd zijn nu naar Bonaire worden overgebracht in plaats van naar St. Maarten, maar de rechten van de verdachte in het kader van detentie zijn onveranderd gebleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat Nederland kampt met een nijpend tekort aan hoogopgeleide technici

MP Schouten asked the ministers about reports of a severe shortage of highly educated technicians, the ROA labour market forecast, and whether the social loan system for masters students deters bèta students. The minister acknowledged serious technical labour shortages, outlined joint public-private measures and a Masterplan due to be sent to cabinet, and argued the masters loan burden is limited and unlikely to deter students.
By 2 April at the latest, your House will be informed about the cabinet's ambitions.
Uiterlijk 2 april a.s. wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de ambities van het kabinet.
Vragen van het lid Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financien over het BTW-nummer voor een eenmanszaak dat gelijk is aan het burgerservicenummer (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why a sole proprietor's VAT number equals their citizen service number (BSN), which must appear on invoices, and what safeguards exist against identity fraude. The State Secretary confirmed the link, explained that the sofinummer was chosen as a neutral number, and argued that the BSN carries no rights or obligations so no problems are foreseen, while noting that the BSN is meant to fight identity fraud.
Given the fact that a citizen service number grants no right and imposes no obligation, I foresee no problems.
Gegeven het feit dat een burgerservicenummer geen enkel recht geeft, noch een plicht oplegt, voorzie ik geen problemen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouten (ChristenUnie), Ferrier (CDA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Dijkhoff (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP), Dikkers (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Hachchi (D66)

Ten MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour in Turkish hazelnut harvesting one year after it was first reported, including whether enforcement is adequate, whether companies are meeting their responsibilities, and the status of various studies and working groups. The government answered that the problem lies mainly with Turkey, that the embassy raised it with Turkish authorities and funds a study, that industry bodies have adopted guidelines and a Turkish action plan exists, but that it could not confirm concrete results of the Turkish working group and could not answer in time for the scheduled debate.
The cabinet will continue to raise this issue within the EU framework, including in the Council conclusions.
Het kabinet zal hier in EU-kader aandacht voor blijven vragen, ook in de Raadsconclusies.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Neppérus (VVD), Van Vliet (PVV), Koolmees (D66), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het rechtstreeks overmaken van kinderopvang

Six MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance whether childcare allowance should be paid directly to childcare providers to prevent parental arrears, and whether a system with certified payee parties would be designed with stakeholders. The State Secretary said government should in principle not intervene, that a single bank account per taxpayer is planned with an exception for childcare centres under strict conditions, and that the Minister of Social Affairs will consult the sector and report to parliament.

As I indicated at the legislative consultation of 7 November regarding the Tax Package 2012, I will include an exception for childcare centres to the mandatory use of a single bank account via an amendment.

Zoals ik in het wetgevingsoverleg van 7 november jl. over het Belastingpakket 2012 heb aangegeven, zal ik bij nota van wijziging voor kindercentra een uitzondering op het verplicht gebruik van één rekeningnummer opnemen.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Schouten (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de positie van de woningcorporatie op Bonaire (

ChristenUnie MPs asked whether the turnover tax (ABB) and the introduction of the US dollar on Bonaire make social rents unaffordable for tenants of the local housing corporation, and whether the state will investigate or grant an exemption. The state secretary answered that the ABB is in principle more favourable than the former turnover tax, that no exemption is legally possible, that no separate study will be launched beyond an existing interdepartmental economic study, and that cost control is the corporation's responsibility.
I will not start a specific investigation into the impact of the ABB as such on the cost price of new-build homes.
Ik zal geen specifiek onderzoek starten naar de invloed van de ABB als zodanig op de kostprijs van nieuwbouwwoningen.
