Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de grote gevolgen van schaalvergroting in de supermarktbranche voor kleine

MPs Gesthuizen, Dijkgraaf and Schouten asked the economy minister whether expanded Sunday opening harms small supermarket owners relative to chains and whether it should be reversed. The minister replied that the 2011 tightening of the tourism exemption is expected to help small shops, that Sunday opening is only one factor among several, and that no new measures are planned.
No, as I have already indicated, the expanded Sunday opening is only one of the factors contributing to the declining turnover and number of small supermarkets.
Nee, zoals ik reeds heb aangegeven is de ruimere openstelling op zondag slechts één van de factoren die een rol spelen bij de dalende trend van de omzet en aantal van kleine supermarkten.

Vragen van het lid Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat een ontslaggolf dreigt door verhoging van het btw-tarief i

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether the temporary VAT reduction for construction renovation would be continued, given job losses feared from its expiry. The state secretary answered that the measure was temporary, that the reduced rate ends for new work from 1 July 2011 with a transition until 1 October 2011, and that the cabinet sees no reason to reverse the decision.
The cabinet sees no reason to reverse the decision, which was taken with the agreement of a majority of your House.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de besluitvorming, die met instemming van een meerderheid van uw Kamer tot stand is gekomen, terug te draaien.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), Ulenbelt (SP), Klaver (Groenlinks), Koolmees (D66), Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP), Van den Besselaar (PVV) en Thieme (Partij

Ten MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a reported 450 million euro fee paid by pension funds (PME and another fund) to Mn Services for asset management, and about transparency and remedies for members. The minister said the fee passage in the court ruling contained a typo, that supervisors alone may request such information and are bound by confidentiality, that members can raise concerns with the accountability body and as a last resort the Ondernemingskamer, and that a cost-reporting guideline is due in November 2011.
The Pension Act provides that only the supervisors, DNB and AFM, have the authority to request information from pension funds.
In de Pensioenwet is bepaald dat alleen de toezichthouders, DNB en AFM, de bevoegdheid hebben om informatie op te vragen bij pensioenfondsen.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Gesthuizen (SP) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht da

MPs asked the government about reports that shop staff in Zoetermeer are pressured into Sunday work, and whether this reflects a wider trend, whether workers can enforce their rights, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate compliance. The minister answered that the Zoetermeer decision meets the legal tourism criteria subject to a pending appeal, that workers can invoke the Working Hours Act and Civil Code before the courts, and that the government will not have the Labour Inspectorate supervise collective agreement provisions.
The judge has the final say in assessing whether the municipality of Zoetermeer rightly used the tourism provision.
De rechter heeft het laatste woord bij de beoordeling van de vraag of de gemeente Zoetermeer terecht gebruik heeft gemaakt van de toerismebepaling.

Vragen van de leden Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het raadsbesluit om in Zoetermeer 52 koopzondagen toe te staan (ingezonden

Three MPs asked the minister whether Zoetermeer's council decision to allow 52 Sunday shopping days under the tourism exemption of the Shop Opening Hours Act was lawful, given that the exemption should be interpreted strictly, the tourism must be autonomous and substantial, and workers' interests must be weighed. The minister answered that the municipality's assessment is its own responsibility, that an objection and possible appeal are pending before the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal, and that the courts have the final word.
The judge has the last word in assessing whether the municipality of Zoetermeer rightly used the tourism exemption.
De rechter heeft het laatste woord bij de beoordeling van de vraag of de gemeente Zoetermeer terecht gebruik heeft gemaakt van de toerismebepaling.
Vragen van het lid Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de ANBI-status (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about uncertainty over ANBI (charitable public benefit) status and the tax-facilitated fundraising status, including whether charities may house commercial activities in a BV while keeping ANBI status. The state secretary says the Tax Authority applies the rules in line with the earlier explanation, that a separate BV does not in principle affect ANBI status, and that the government will revise the rules in the Geefwet and Belastingplan 2012.
Incidentally, it should be noted that any liability to corporate income tax is separate from ANBI status.
Overigens zij opgemerkt dat eventuele belastingplicht voor de vennootschapsbelasting losstaat van de ANBI-status.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palmen over "het hanteren van een te lage beslagvrije voet voor ouderen bij de verrekening van schulden"

An MP asked why the SVB keeps applying a beslagvrije voet to AOW recipients that the Centrale Raad van Beroep and a district court found too low, and whether the government will raise it. The state secretary answers that the SVB now uses two calculation methods, that no specific increase for AOW recipients is justified by the new research, and that the rules will not be changed for this group, though the government will reconsider the wider system.
In the reconsideration requested by the CRvB, I therefore conclude that nothing will be changed in the Regulation on this point.
In de door de CRvB gevraagde heroverweging kom ik dan ook tot de conclusie op dit punt in de Regeling niets te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het bericht ‘BKR brengt vele duizenden mensen in problemen door ze onterecht te registreren als wanbetaler’

An MP asked the government about reports that BKR credit registrations wrongly label people as payment defaulters, and whether people can easily get negative registrations removed. The minister answered that BKR registrations have no binding legal status, that the government does not use them in its dealings with citizens, that a Wet stelsel kredietregistratie is in preparation, and that BKR and lenders must weigh removal requests case by case under the GDPR while the minister will discuss the refusal practice with BKR.
The register is currently managed by the private foundation BKR without any statutory rules on its management and supervision.
Het register wordt nu beheerd door de private stichting BKR zonder dat over het beheer en toezicht daarop wettelijk iets is geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het noodgedwongen stoppen van het lokale beleid inzake beschermingsbewind in de gemeente Groningen

MP Van Kent (SP) asks why Groningen municipality had to stop steering people to its non-commercial municipal trustee for debt administration after a court ruling, and whether the government will act to restore local control over bewind. The State Secretary answers that the court ruling is respected, the choice of trustee rests with the sub-district judge, municipalities may still offer bewind, a study on public organisation of bewind is planned for Q2 2025, and the advisory right and convenant options will be evaluated.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, we respect the court's judgment in the Groningen case.
Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 1 respecteren we het oordeel van de rechter in de casus Groningen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het antwoord van de minister op vraag 25 uit Aanhangsel Handelingen II, vergaderjaar 2023-2024, nr. 766 over Kamerstuk 32 043, nr 628, over de buffer van pensioenfondsen onder a

An MP asks the Minister for Pensions whether, after the Wtp amendment of article 129 Pensioenwet, DNB's view that the buffer below that threshold must benefit existing accrued rights still stands, and whether using the buffer to fund transition compensation amounts to prohibited repayment. The minister confirms the DNB memo, says it is a supervisory interpretation rather than a DNB opinion, and states that article 129 no longer applies to compensation at transition, leaving the choice on compensation to social partners.

For completeness, I note that the document referred to does not represent a view, opinion or otherwise of DNB but an interpretation of the supervisory framework regarding the legal provisions then in force.
Volledigheidshalve merk ik op dat het genoemde document geen visie, mening of anderszins van DNB betreft maar een duiding van het toezichtskader aangaande de toen geldende wettelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mohandis over het bericht 'Incassobedrijf gebruikt AI om kwetsbare schuldenaar te spotten: 'Kan bizarre situaties opleveren''

MPs Kathmann and Mohandis asked about reports that debt collector Intrum uses AI to scan correspondence of vulnerable debtors, raising risks of discrimination, privacy breaches and lack of transparency. The minister acknowledged the risks, said the government cannot guarantee AI use is optional for consumers, and pointed to existing GDPR and WKI rules and the forthcoming EU AI Act, while stating the details of Intrum's practices are not yet known and a meeting with Intrum is planned.
From the article, the precise methods or working practices of Intrum are not clear to me.
Uit het artikel worden de precieze methoden of werkwijzen van Intrum mij niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Ceder over de noodzaak tot verplichte leeftijdscontrole bij BNPL-diensten

MPs Mohandis and Ceder asked the government about minors using Buy Now, Pay Later services, the lack of mandatory age verification, the effect of the revised Consumer Credit Directive, fees, and sanctions. The minister acknowledged the risks, reported that BNPL providers committed from 1 June to verify all users' age, and said the government is still working out how to make age verification legally mandatory and will report after the summer.
The cabinet is currently working out how age verification can be made mandatory.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment uit hoe leeftijdscontrole verplicht gesteld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht ‘Veel ergernis over rechtszaken over verplicht pensioen: ’Dit is niet te doen voor ondernemers’’

MP Aartsen (VVD) asked the minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about court disputes over mandatory industry pension participation, including criteria used in mandatory-participation decisions, retroactivity, faillissement and scope-definition problems. The minister declined to provide lists or counts she does not hold, stated that the scope is for social partners to define, and rejected a generic uniformity requirement while pointing to advisory tools.
Procedures conducted between a mandatory industry pension fund and an employer are procedures to which my ministry is not a party.
Procedures die worden gevoerd tussen een verplichtgesteld bedrijfstakpensioenfonds en een werkgever zijn procedures waar mijn ministerie geen partij bij is.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat gepensioneerden zich niet serieus genomen voelen

An SP MP asked the minister how she responds to complaints by pensioner organisations that they are not taken seriously in the ABP pension transition plan, whether gepensioneerden are properly involved through the hearing right, and whether they have the information needed to assess the plan. The minister says the hearing right is a statutory safeguard, that social partners are responsible for giving it substance and have held discussions with the associations, and that she expects information to be shared but notes some information may belong to a later phase.
It is up to the social partners to give substance to the hearing right.
Het is aan de sociale partners om het hoorrecht vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de P-scenariosets en hun impact op pensioencommunicatie en beleggingsbeleid

Member Joseph (NSC) asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about DNB's P-scenario sets, including interest-rate dips, the sharp rise in long-term equity volatility, and their effects on pension communication and risk-appetite tests. The Minister defended the Commissie Parameters methodology as objective and replicable, attributed the changes mainly to fund-specific choices, and declined to modify the sets or open the model code, while promising a DNB summary of changes each quarter.
I therefore see no reason to doubt the correctness of the scenario sets.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om te twijfelen aan de correctheid van de scenariosets.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman getiteld ‘Hoe eerder, hoe beter.Vroegsignalering van schulden door gemeenten’

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about the Ombudsman's report on municipal early detection of debt problems, including uniformity, minimum standards, reach and knowledge sharing. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to a fuller government response in May, a Wgs evaluation due early 2025, a forthcoming action plan on basic service provision, and existing measures to raise reach.
In mid-May I will send a comprehensive government response to the Ombudsman's report and then address the specific recommendations in more detail.
Medio mei kom ik met een uitgebreide kabinetsreactie op het rapport van de ombudsman en dan ga ik nader in op de specifieke aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Nationale ombudsman vindt aanvraagprocedure Noodfonds Energie oneerlijk'

An SP MP asked the ministers about the National Ombudsman's criticism that the digital application procedure for the Temporary Energy Emergency Fund was unfair, excluding people without DigiD, guardianship cases and those with block connections. The minister defended the fund's targeting and accessibility support, said the fund is now closed, and offered no new fund or rule changes beyond promises to consult energy suppliers on future support.
The Emergency Fund is a private initiative that, within the limits of implementation possibilities and budget, reached as large a share of this target group as possible.
Daarnaast is het Noodfonds een privaat initiatief dat binnen de kaders van de uitvoeringsmogelijkheden en het uitvoeringsbudget een zo groot mogelijk aandeel van deze doelgroep heeft bereikt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Synhaeve, Mohandis, Van Kent, Ceder en Koekkoek over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Den Haag dat de Nederlandse Staat en twee drinkwaterbedrijven onrechtmatig handelen door niet al het r

MPs asked the government to respond to a Hague Court of Appeal ruling that the State and two water companies acted unlawfully by not preventing children from losing access to drinking water, and about measures, a water fund and changes to disconnection rules. The minister answered that the companies will restore supply to occupied homes with children, that a study on child protection including a water fund will be sent to parliament before summer, and that the disconnection regulation will be reviewed.
The judgment calls for action in two areas.
Het arrest vraagt om actie op twee gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Vermeer over de brief van 6 februari ‘Gelijke aanpassingen met spreiden in de uitkeringsfase’

Two MPs (Joseph and Vermeer) asked 30 detailed questions about the minister's letter on equal adjustments with smoothing in the pension payout phase of solidarity schemes, including methods, transparency and the Palland amendment. The minister answered that the forthcoming Decree will give legal clarity on conditions for equal adjustments with smoothing, while many answers defer detailed design to pension funds and the forthcoming Decree.
The implementation framework from the letter will result in the Decree, which will be submitted for internet consultation in April, and I will inform your House about it.
Het uitvoeringskader uit de Kamerbrief resulteert in het Besluit wat in april ter internetconsultatie zal worden voorgelegd en waar ik uw Kamer over zal infomeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Westerveld over de individuele studietoeslag

MPs Mohandis and Westerveld asked how municipalities grant the individual study allowance under the Participatiewet, whether it is withheld when students spend part of a compulsory curriculum abroad, and whether it should continue in that case. The minister explains the allowance's purpose, notes the government lacks a full picture of municipal decisions, states that a student keeps the right abroad unless the main residence has moved, and says students with a disability should be enabled to gain study-related experience abroad without unnecessary barriers.
It is up to the municipality to assess this.
Het is aan de gemeente om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en White over het meenemen van de AOW-uitkering naar het buitenland

MPs Stultiens and White asked why AOW pensions can be fully exported to some countries with enforcement treaties but only at the married rate to others, how many people are affected, which countries lack treaties, and whether new treaties are planned. The minister explains that export rules follow the Wet BEU and enforcement treaties, lists about 36 treaty jurisdictions plus EU/EER/Switzerland and Caribbean arrangements, reports roughly 0.04% of AOW recipients are affected, and says a 2015 motion to seek treaties with eight countries has not succeeded because the countries declined negotiation.
Should these countries wish to enter negotiations in the future, a new assessment would have to be made per country on whether that is desirable.
Mochten deze landen in de toekomst alsnog in onderhandeling willen treden dan zal per land een nieuwe weging gemaakt moeten worden over de wenselijkheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de inlichtingenplicht in de bijstand

An MP asked the minister whether the benefit information duty (inlichtingenplicht) leads to harsh outcomes, such as large repayments and fines for incomplete information, and whether personal conversations should replace direct sanctions. The minister agreed that fines must not be imposed lightly, said municipalities must investigate carefully and give people a chance to explain, and pointed to planned changes in the Participatiewet in Balans program while keeping the information duty in place.
It is therefore important that imposing a claim and fine does not happen lightly.
Het is dan ook belangrijk dat het opleggen van een vordering en boete niet lichtvaardig gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de AOW-leeftijd en de ontwikkeling van de levensverwachting

MP Van Kent asks why the AOW pension age is raised even though life expectancy is no longer expected to rise, and whether the law can be changed so the age can also fall. The minister says the age is linked to CBS forecasts, that lowering it would require a law change which the cabinet will not pursue, and that the pension-age link is set five years ahead to give certainty.
If desired, the AOW age can only be lowered to 67 for 2028 and 2029 through a one-off law amendment.
Indien gewenst, kan de AOW-leeftijd alleen per wetswijziging eenmalig voor 2028 en 2029 verlaagd worden naar 67 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over uitingen van de AFM over onrealistische verwachtingen van het nieuwe pensioenstelsel

An MP asks the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about AFM/DNB warnings that participants may hold unrealistic expectations of the new pension system, including very high optimistic-scenario projections in transition plans, and about the legal robustness and responsibilities for those plans. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says the AFM consultation is ongoing, states that transition decisions are legally valid if made properly, and places responsibility for transition plans with social partners and pension providers.
The AFM is consulting with pension federations, SZW and other pension parties on this subject.
De AFM voert overleg met pensioenkoepels, SZW en andere pensioenpartijen over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het bericht dat verantwoordingsorganen (VO’s) meer initiatief kunnen nemen

MP Synhaeve (D66) asked the minister about reports that accountability bodies (verantwoordingsorganen) of pension funds could take more initiative, including the share of elected versus appointed members, diversity, continuity, and their role in investment policy. The minister answered that such composition data are not kept, pointed to existing governance codes, diversity task force plans and a planned follow-up governance study, and stated that accountability bodies can already give opinions on fund policy.
Such data are not kept. The requested overview therefore cannot be provided.
Dergelijke gegevens worden niet bijgehouden. Het gevraagde overzicht kan dan ook niet worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht ‘Geen plek meer in daklozenopvang in Utrecht en Amersfoort: 'Mensen slapen noodgedwongen op straat'

MP Kat asks how landlords select tenants, whether they may run credit checks and BKR queries, and whether people under protective administration (beschermingsbewind) are wrongly refused housing and how this is protected. The minister answers that landlords must follow the Wet goed verhuurderschap and anti-discrimination law, that protective administration is not a protected characteristic and is not a valid reason for refusal per sector bodies, and that no legal change is needed.
Having a protective administrator is moreover not discrimination. It is not a legally protected personal characteristic.
Het hebben van een beschermingsbewindvoerder is bovendien geen discriminatie. Het betreft geen persoonskenmerk dat wettelijk is beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Idsinga over het artikel 'Aantal huishoudens met schulden door toeslagen in vijf jaar verdubbeld'

Two MPs asked the government about a news report that the number of households with problematic debts from childcare and other benefit allowances (toeslagen) doubled in five years, and about the causes, support for affected households, and the future of the allowance system. The State Secretary answered that the rise is mainly due to the pause in toeslag debt collection during COVID and to rising allowance payments, outlined support measures and the upcoming final report on the future of the system, and declined to give a firm timetable for quick fixes.
The cabinet has announced that from 2025 the 27-year age limit for first-degree blood relatives in the allowance partnership will be abolished.
Het kabinet heeft aangekondigd om per 2025 de 27-jaarsgrens voor eerstegraadsbloedverwanten in het toeslagpartnerschap af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over het bericht 'Geldproblemen door chronisch ziek kind: 'Ik voel me een schooier''

MPs Westerveld and Mohandis asked about a family with a chronically ill child forced to move because municipal refusal to fully fund home adaptations and rising care costs, and about VN-verdrag Handicap compliance. The minister says Wmo 2015 allows adaptations and municipalities weigh alternatives including relocation allowances, declines to change the law, and gives no data on parents' financial problems or on how many use each scheme.
No, as stated in my answer to question 2, home adaptations can be reimbursed under the Wmo 2015.
Nee, zoals aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 kunnen vanuit de Wmo 2015 woningaanpassingen worden vergoed.
Antwoord op van het lid Palland over doorwerken na AOW-leeftijd naaraanleiding van het commissiedebat Pensioenonderwerpen d.d. 21 juni 2023

An MP from the CDA asked how employment law and collective agreement pay scales apply when employees keep working for the same employer after reaching the AOW pension age, including whether prior service counts. The minister answers that these terms are for employer and employee to agree within collective agreements, that the government offers public information campaigns, and that it sees no role in discussing the matter with social partners.
It is important that employer and employee discuss the options for working after the AOW age in good time, if this is the wish of one or both.
Het is belangrijk dat werkgever en werknemer tijdig het gesprek aangaan over de mogelijkheden om na de AOW-leeftijd door te werken, als dit de wens van (één van) beide is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over “het advies van de landsadvocaat over invaren in het nieuwe pensioenstelsel”

Opposition MP Van Kent asked the minister, citing a professor's concerns and the state law adviser's advice, whether invaren under the new pensions system can violate property rights and cut pensions by 5-10%, and how many funds have low coverage ratios and how many are closed. The minister answered that invaren is legally defensible under the three property-rights criteria, that cuts are possible depending on coverage ratio, that DNB reports one fund below 100%, and that 22 closed funds cover about 200,000 people; she refers individuals with grievances to the fund, the pension disputes body or the courts.
It nevertheless cannot be ruled out that an individual may experience a disproportionately heavy burden as a result of invaren.
Het blijft evenwel niet uitgesloten dat een individu als gevolg van het invaren een onevenredig zware last ervaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de geklapte onderhandelingen over de regeling voor zware beroepen om op tijd te kunnen stoppen met werken

An SP MP asks the minister why negotiations on an early-retirement scheme for heavy occupations collapsed, whether a structural rather than temporary scheme is needed, and how many workers use the RVU. The minister says social partners are responsible, talks are paused, she will inform parliament in spring 2024, and she declines to set overarching criteria for heavy work.
Drawing up overarching minimum criteria from the government is therefore not appropriate.
Het opstellen van overkoepelende minimumcriteria vanuit de overheid is dan ook niet passend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over monitoring doelen transitie Wet toekomst pensioenen

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about transition plans under the Wet toekomst pensioenen for many pension funds, covering premiums, pension targets, projected pensions, investment mix, partner pensions and risks. The Minister answered that transition plans are the responsibility of social partners and funds, provided factual summaries of publicly available plans, and explained that comparisons are limited and risks largely fall on participants.
It is up to social partners to make collective labour agreements and record them in the transition plan.
Het is aan sociale partners om arbeidsvoorwaardelijke afspraken te maken en deze vast te leggen in het transitieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Omtzigt over "de invaaradviezen"

MPs Joseph and Omtzigt asked the minister why legal advice on pension-transition (invaren) would only be available confidentially, whether counsel and the public could see it, and asked for the advice and internal correspondence to be published. The minister refused to publish the advice because it concerns the state's litigation position, offered confidential inspection to MPs, declined to release counsel correspondence, and agreed only to inventory internal correspondence on invaren advice from 2020 with an update expected by end of March.
Advice concerning the state's litigation position is not suitable for publication.
Adviezen die betrekking hebben op de procespositie lenen zich niet voor openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de openbaarmaking van interne adviezen aan bewindspersoon rond invaren in het kader van de Wet toekomst pensioenen

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about the disclosure of internal advice on invaren (collective transfer of accrued pension rights) under the Wet toekomst pensioenen, including the legal tests for property rights under the ECHR, the feasibility of a phased 'ingroei' alternative, and why fiscal indexation limits were kept. The minister answered at length that invaren meets the ECHR criteria, that the ingroei variant does not achieve the same goals, and that some advice is confidential and not disclosed.
The content of this communication falls under the confidentiality of communications between lawyer and client. I will not make this communication public.
De inhoud van deze communicatie valt onder de vertrouwelijkheid van de communicatie tussen advocaat en cliënt. Ik zal deze communicatie niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht ''Arnhemse Werkbrigade' slaat aan: begeleid werk via Scalabor leidt tot vaste baan'

An MP asked the minister about the Arnhem Werkbrigade pilot run by Scalabor that places long-term unemployed people in paid part-time jobs, and how the Palland/Kathmann motion on base jobs with regular employers will be implemented. The minister described the pilot's pay and results, said a follow-up on the motion will come in Q2 2024, and pointed to a broader infrastructure package for social development companies.
In the second quarter of 2024 I will inform your House further.
In het tweede kwartaal van 2024 zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aanstelling van de regeringscommissaris voor de pensioentransitie

An MP asks the minister to explain the role, mandate, recruitment and independence of the government commissioner for the pensions transition, including concerns about board positions and past advisory roles. The minister answers that the commissioner advises on process only, describes the appointment safeguards and declared side roles, and dismisses concerns about parameter sets and IT risks.
Given the confidentiality of the procedure, it is not appropriate to provide detailed information.
Het is gelet op de vertrouwelijkheid van de procedure niet opportuun om gedetailleerde informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een aanvullende randvoorwaarde over het invaren van pensioenen in het coronaherstelfonds

Omtzigt asks the Finance and Pensions ministers about an added condition in the Dutch recovery plan requiring that 66% of participants' pensions be transferred (invaren) to the new pension system by 2026, and why this was not communicated to parliament earlier. Minister Schouten answers that the condition is an operationalisation of existing recovery-plan commitments needed because the pension transition was extended to 2028, that the decision on invaren remains with social partners and fund boards, and that a list of legal advice on invaren will be shared in November.
On 4 July there was not yet an agreed proposal that could be shared with the Chamber.
Op 4 juli lag er nog geen afgesproken voorstel dat gedeeld kon worden met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht ‘Bankroet schuldhandelaar dupeert mogelijk tienduizenden consumenten met schulden’

MP Kat asks whether the government will press BKR and the pledgeholder to permanently remove outdated credit registrations left by the bankrupt debt trader DPS, and what it will do for consumers denied mortgages. The minister answers that BKR has temporarily removed DPS registrations, the government wants DPS's administration updated rather than deleted, and the curator is responsible for handling data-deletion requests, while the Wki regulating debt-collection services is planned for 1 January 2024.
Permanently deleting all of DPS's credit data at present is undesirable to me, given the risk that legitimate BKR registrations would also be removed.
Het momenteel definitief verwijderen van alle kredietgegevens van DPS vind ik onwenselijk gelet op het risico dat er dan mogelijk ook terechte BKR-registraties worden verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Thijssen over kwijtschelding van de waterschapsbelasting

MPs Kathmann and Thijssen asked whether water boards can grant remission of the water board levy to people earning above the welfare norm, whether a progressive levy should be studied, and about social collection practices. The minister answered that boards already may extend remission (cost-of-living norm up to 100% of the welfare norm, higher asset threshold) and that a progressive levy will not be studied because the levy principles of the water system must be preserved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Paulusma over het bericht '4 op de 10 mensen met laag inkomen verwachten problemen met betalen van zorgverzekering

MPs Kat and Paulusma asked the government about reports that many low-income people expect trouble paying health insurance premiums, rising premiums, unused healthcare allowance, and access to municipal collective health insurance. The minister acknowledged the concerns, gave premium and take-up figures, and listed existing and planned measures, without committing to new structural steps beyond monitoring and ongoing policy.
I will keep a close eye on the situation.
Ik blijf vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Warmerdam over cao’s met afspraken over zelfstandigen

Two D66 MPs asked the government about collective agreements (cao's) that set terms for self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including whether such terms restrict contractual freedom, how many workers and self-employed are affected, whether these agreements belong in cao's, and how member participation and enforcement against false self-employment work. The minister answers that the competition-law exception allows collective bargaining for vulnerable self-employed, that only a small number of cao's contain such provisions, that enforcement and a legal presumption against false self-employment are being pursued, and that the questions could not be answered by the requested deadline.
Exact numbers of self-employed workers in the sectors are not available.
Exacte aantallen van zelfstandigen in de branches zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de sociale werkplaatsen met grote tekorten kampen

An SP MP asks the minister about reported large financial and staffing shortfalls at sheltered workshops (sociale werkplaatsen) and why extra funding covers only a fifth of the gap. The minister replies that municipalities are primarily responsible, cites a €2,157 per-place increase for sheltered work and a €63.9 million reserve, and states that a full picture of the shortfall cannot be given.
As also indicated in the answer to question 3, a complete picture of the financial result and any shortfalls cannot be given.
Zoals ook is aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 3, is geen volledig beeld te geven van het financieel resultaat en eventuele tekorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over een AOW-gat voor AOW-gerechtigden die enkele jaren in voormalig Nederlands Nieuw-Guinea hebben gewoond

An MP asked the minister why former Dutch New Guinea residents (about 740 AOW recipients, a 11 million euro missed-contribution gap) should not receive a one-off compensation like the Surinamese group, given no transfer agreement existed. The minister replied that the Surinamese recognition gesture reflects a unique combination of circumstances and that extending compensation to other groups would have far-reaching consequences for the AOW system, so no compensation is planned.
Compensation for incomplete AOW accrual for people who were then residents of the Kingdom of the Netherlands would have far-reaching consequences for the AOW system.
Compensatie voor een onvolledige AOW-opbouw voor mensen die destijds ingezetenen van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden waren zou vergaande gevolgen hebben voor het stelsel van de AOW.

Antwoord op van het lid Omtzigt over "10.000 gezinnen (vaak met een parttime werkende en/of gedeeltelijk arbeidsongeschikte) die onder het bijstandsniveau leven, omdat de fiscale en sociale regels ernstig in hun nadeel w

Omtzigt asked the ministers why about 10,000 households, often with a part-time or partly disabled earner, fall below the social assistance level because of tax and benefit rules, and why they are not being proactively contacted for a top-up, citing the 2022 Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling and earlier warnings from the National Ombudsman. The ministers answered that a new approach is being prepared, about 6,400 households are affected in 2023, some municipalities have started active outreach, and no national overview of contacts exists, with broader communication postponed to avoid overloading municipalities.
There is no national picture of the number of households that have been contacted or have already been helped.
Er is geen landelijk beeld van het aantal huishoudens waarmee inmiddels contact is of dat inmiddels geholpen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over afkalvende bestaanszekerheid voor mensen met publieke beroepen door kostenstijgingen en loonbeslag

An MP from the PvdA asked several ministers about falling financial security among care and public-sector workers, including reports that many skip doctor or dentist visits and that some have wage garnishments. The government answered that it lacks sector-specific garnishment data, that such garnishments are not shown to be more common in the public sector, and pointed to existing debt-relief measures and the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet, with no change to the exempt amount planned.

The cabinet does not have figures on wage garnishment in (subsectors of) care and cannot say whether the share of employees with a wage garnishment among district nurses and nursing home staff is larger than among other occupational groups or branches within care.

Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers over loonbeslag in (subsectoren van) de zorg en kan dus ook niet zeggen of het percentage medewerkers met loonbeslag onder wijkverpleegkundigen en zorgpersoneel in verpleeghuizen groter is dan onder andere beroepsgroepen dan wel branches binnen de zorg.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Sahla en Wuite over "over de vertraagde invoering van bijna-gratis kinderopvang op de BES-eilanden"

Two D66 MPs asked why the introduction of near-free childcare (4% parental contribution) on the Caribbean Netherlands islands was delayed, and whether capacity problems justified this, given the Ministers' differing positions. The government answered that the phased approach aligns the Caribbean parental contribution with the Dutch schedule toward 4% by 2027, that capacity and quality concerns exist but did not justify postponing the Wet kinderopvang BES, and that the bill's content and timing remain open to parliamentary amendment.
Members of the House of Representatives can influence the content of the bill and the related implementing regulations through motions or amendments.
De Tweede Kamerleden kunnen door middel van moties of amendementen invloed uitoefenen op de inhoud van het wetsvoorstel en de bijbehorende uitvoeringsregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "een juridisch advies van de landsadvocaat over het invaren van pensioenen in de pensioenwet”

MP Omtzigt asked the minister to publish a 2011 landsadvocaat advice on invaren of pensions, and to list and disclose internal and external legal advice on invaren since 2010, and to describe the legal risks. The minister refused to publish the 2011 concept advice (pre-dating the July 2021 disclosure policy and possibly relevant to state litigation), promised a list of advice by November, and argued the legal risks were addressed in the explanatory memorandum and Council of State advice.
I will not make the requested draft advice public.
Het gevraagde concept-advies maak ik niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het advies van de landsadvocaat over invaren in het nieuwe pensioencontract

Deputy Omtzigt asked why a 2011 concept advice from the State Advocate on invaren (transferring accrued pension rights into the new contract) was shown to union and employer leaders but not to parliament, and asked for all advice on invaren to be listed and sent. The minister answered that the two individuals viewed the concept once under supervision, that the advice's content was incorporated into public documents, that advice given before July 2021 is not published, and that an inventory of written advice would be shared in November.
The concept advice, in light of ongoing or possible proceedings, is not made public, because the interest of the State, as stated in Article 68 of the Constitution, stands in the way.

Dat neemt niet weg dat het concept-advies in het licht van lopende of mogelijke procedures niet openbaar wordt gemaakt, omdat het belang van de Staat, zoals genoemd in artikel 68 van de Grondwet, daaraan in de weg staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘de snel stijgende dierenartskosten, waardoor essentiële dierkundige zorg voor velen onbetaalbaar wordt’

MP Wassenberg asks the government about rising veterinary costs that may make animal care unaffordable, linking this to the duty of care in the Animal Welfare Act, the 21% VAT rate, takeovers of clinics by foreign chains, and possible regulation. The minister acknowledges the concerns, announces a study of price increases, states VAT rules and competition law limits, and rejects intervention in the free market for now.
I want to set up this study carefully, which requires the cooperation of many parties and takes time.
Ik wil dit onderzoek gedegen opzetten waarbij de medewerking van vele partijen nodig is, wat tijd kost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het bericht 'Na Zaanstad start ook Tilburg proef met 'gratis geld' voor 150 bijstandsgezinnen'

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy whether Zaanstad and Tilburg's pilots giving 150 euro monthly gifts to benefit families, funded by the private Kansfonds, breach the Participatiewet and undermine work incentives. The minister replied that the gifts are private, municipalities may disregard gifts case by case under existing rules, and a planned 1,200 euro yearly gift exemption will be introduced.
So it is not the municipality that makes a gift, and there is therefore no question of active income policy by the municipality in this case.
Het is dus niet de gemeente die een gift doet en er is dus ook geen sprake van actieve inkomenspolitiek door de gemeente in dit geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over heldere en toegankelijke publiekscommunicatie over de Wet toekomst pensioenen

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about unclear public communication on the Wet toekomst pensioenen, misconceptions among citizens, the campaign plan, information for vulnerable elderly, derde pijler coverage and checking contact data. The minister answered that a phased, partner-based campaign will run from 2023 to 2026 via Pensioenduidelijkheid.nl, FAQs, offline information points, and pension-fund outreach, and committed to tightening the campaign based on questions received.
Together with trade unions, employers' organisations and pension administrators I have developed a campaign to inform people aged 18 and over about the new pension rules.
Samen met vakbonden, werkgeversorganisaties en de pensioenuitvoerders heb ik een campagne ontwikkeld om personen van 18 jaar en ouder te informeren over de nieuwe pensioenregels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over "berichten omtrent maandelijks beslag op bijstand in strijd met de wet"

An MP asked the minister about a court ruling that monthly garnishment of social assistance by a municipality breached the subsistence protection, and about extra enforcement costs and municipal practice. The minister agreed to urge municipalities to pay holiday allowance monthly when garnishing, to favour annual payment where possible, and to consider support with VNG, but declined to compensate costs in general.
I will, together with the VNG, call on municipalities to take this into account in implementation.
Ik zal in samenwerking met de VNG gemeenten oproepen om hiermee rekening te houden in de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het migratiepakket

An MP asks the state secretary of Justice and Security for a list of migration measures considered during failed coalition talks, of measures the four parties could agree on, and of measures the demissionary cabinet plans to implement, and whether a package can still be agreed. The government answers that no list of agreed measures exists, that the demissionary cabinet is exercising restraint so no list can be given, and that agreement on a package is not expected, while pointing to earlier letters containing internal documents.
Anticipating that, it is not possible to provide a list of measures or to give a precise date.
Vooruitlopend daarop is het niet mogelijk een lijst van maatregelen te bieden of een precieze datum aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het onderzoek ‘Verkenning grijze vlek binnen DC-regelingen’

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about the AFM study on the 'grey zone' in defined-contribution pensions, including contribution levels, the adequacy of pension accrual, the effect of the halving of the 'white zone', awareness, and a pension label. The minister answered that pension is a bargaining matter for social partners, declined to judge adequacy, pointed to awareness campaigns and information tools, and rejected a mandatory pension label.
It is up to employers' associations and employees' associations (hereafter social partners) to make agreements on the pension employment condition in conjunction with the other employment conditions.

Het is aan de (verenigingen van) werkgever(s) en (verenigingen van) werknemers (hierna sociale partners) om afspraken te maken over de arbeidsvoorwaarde pensioen in samenhang met de andere arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat het BKR de bewaartermijn van BKR-registraties bekort

The MPs asked why the BKR shortens registration of debt-relief only to six months after a completed debt-relief trajectory while full debt repayment keeps credit data for five years, and why that is not equal treatment. The minister confirmed the change, explained that debt-relief registrations are separate from credit registrations, said the credit retention period will be set in a bill to be shortened from five to three years, and rejected a general shortening for everyone who repays in full.
Keeping credit registered for a longer period allows credit providers to consult this data when assessing whether granting a new credit is responsible.
Het langere tijd geregistreerd laten staan van krediet stelt de kredietverstrekkers in staat om deze gegevens te raadplegen bij de beoordeling of het verstrekken van een nieuw krediet verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Onderzoek in Drents-Groningse Veenkoloniën wijst uit: veel meer geld en aandacht nodig om kinderen uit armoede te loodsen'

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about a study finding that intergenerational poverty in the Veenkoloniën needs much more money and attention, and about recommendations for national, local and regional actors. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to existing programmes, the minimum wage increase, the wealth-taxation measures and the Aanpak Geldzorgen, but gave no new commitments beyond ongoing and planned measures.
The cabinet is considering, together with the VNG and Divosa, how the findings of the study, including the preconditions, can be brought to the attention of municipalities and local organisations.
Het kabinet beziet samen met de VNG en Divosa hoe de uitkomsten van het onderzoek inclusief de randvoorwaarden onder de aandacht van gemeenten en lokale organisaties gebracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de stakingen bij de sociale werkvoorziening

An SP MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about strikes at sheltered employment, including demands for a 10.15% wage rise, a higher travel allowance and equal treatment with municipal staff, and what meeting these would cost the central government. The minister replied that the central government is not a party to the collective agreements, that the VNG and Cedris must negotiate them, and that municipalities decide how to spend the general fund on them, while giving headcount estimates and funding compensation figures.
The central government is not a party to the collective agreements.
De Rijksoverheid is geen partij in de cao's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het onderzoek ‘Betalingsregelingen bij uitvoeringsorganisaties van het Rijk’

An MP from D66 asked the minister how Dutch government implementation bodies (CJIB, CAK, Belastingdienst) can avoid pushing citizens into financial trouble, ensure minimum subsistence in custom payment arrangements, and improve transparency about them, following an Algemene Rekenkamer report. The minister acknowledged the shortcomings, promised communication and work-instruction changes, explored a uniform subsistence norm and legislative options, and cited ongoing collaborative initiatives, though some answers note privacy constraints and ongoing reviews.

Yes, I find it worrying that government organisations still insufficiently think along with people with debt concerns about tailored payment arrangements and insufficiently observe the subsistence minimum.
Ja, ik vind het zorgelijk dat overheidsorganisaties nog onvoldoende meedenken met mensen met geldzorgen over betalingsregelingen op maat en daarbij het bestaansminimum onvoldoende in acht nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het onderzoek van de Algemene Rekenkamer 'Betalingsregelingen bij uitvoeringsorganisaties van het Rijk

MP Ceder asks how the government views the Court of Audit finding that people with tailored payment arrangements may still fall into hardship because the subsistence minimum is insufficiently protected, and what will be done about it, including common norms, automatic insight into debts, and ways to reduce the effort required. The minister commits to working with agencies on protecting the subsistence minimum, exploring legal changes for shared debt visibility, and developing a government debt overview, while the Tax Authority says it cannot yet guarantee the minimum due to limited information on private debts.
I want to investigate whether it is possible to amend the laws and regulations on this point.
Ik wil onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om de wet- en regelgeving op dit punt aan te passen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de miljarden aan kosten voor de pensioenen van militairen en politieke ambtsdragers waarvoor geen voorziening is getroffen is en waardoor er geld bijgestort zal moeten worden

MP Omtzigt asked about billions in unfunded pensions for military personnel and political office holders, including whether reserves were set aside, the cost of pre-funding the APPA pensions, and why the Wet toekomst pensioenen memorandum lacked estimates. The minister answered that military pensions are budgeted via a reserve, APPA pensions are not yet reserved pending a separate legislative process, municipalities and provinces are urged to build adequate provisions, and the facts study will be repeated.
During this year I will, together with the subnational governments, repeat the factual study into the provisions already made in the budgets.
In de loop van dit jaar zal ik samen met de medeoverheden het feitenonderzoek herhalen naar de al getroffen voorzieningen op de begrotingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder het niveau van een bijstandsuitkering omdat de regelingen niet op elkaar aansluiten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the government about thousands of households living below the social assistance level because income schemes do not align, asking for structural fixes, the effects of the double general tax credit reduction, and compensation options. The ministers answered that a structural solution is urgently needed, that options are being explored with a report due before June 2023, and that the answers include detailed budget and income calculations for example households.
As promised in the letter of 29 March, we will inform the House before June 2023 about progress in searching for solution directions.
Zoals toegezegd in de brief van 29 maart 1 zullen wij de Kamer vóór juni 2023 informeren over de vorderingen van het zoeken naar oplossingsrichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over “het artikel ‘Utrecht zet versoepeld bijstandsregime voor jongeren voort, 'geen aanzuigende werking'’

An MP asks the Minister of Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about Utrecht's relaxed welfare regime for young people, which waives the four-week job-search requirement, and whether it encourages dependence. The Minister answers that the four-week rule is ineffective for many young people with multiple problems, that the Participatiewet targets participation, and that she is discussing the Utrecht case with the municipality and planning a 'kan'-provision allowing municipalities discretion.
I am in discussion with the municipality to get a better picture of the target group that benefits from not applying the four-week job-search period.
Ik ben met de gemeente in gesprek om een beter beeld te krijgen van de doelgroep die juist baat heeft bij het buiten toepassing laten van de vierweken zoekperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over problemen met de uitkering van de energietoeslag 2023 vanwege voorschotten op de energietoeslag 2022

MP Kathmann asked whether municipalities that paid €500 of the 2023 energy allowance early as 2022 payments can still pay that amount, and how new 2023 recipients who received nothing earlier would be treated. The minister answered that the €500 is a shift of 2023 funds into 2022, not an advance, that municipalities have policy discretion and must decide whether to top up from their own funds, and that no compensation from the national government will be provided.
Deze toezegging kan ik niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Weyenberg over het niet kunnen openen van een betaalrekening door kwetsbare mensen

MPs Kat and Van Weyenberg asked whether vulnerable people, including young victims of money mules, can open a payment account and why banks demand debt counselling or guardianship first. The Minister of Finance explains the Basic Bank Account Convenant and the EU directive, says the requirements are for banks to judge case by case, and promises to discuss improved communication and tailored treatment with banks.
Yes, I will discuss this with banks and will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Ja, ik zal hierover met banken in gesprek gaan en zal uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de toenemende kinderarmoede

The SP MP Van Kent asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about rising child poverty, the CPB forecast of higher poverty in 2024, the link to corporate dividends, profits and taxes, and food affordability, and whether the government would halve child poverty. The minister answered that the government remains committed to halving child poverty by 2025, points to income measures and the minimum wage increase, says further decisions on 2024 purchasing-power measures come in August, and says it will inform parliament about the poverty strategy in May.
As Minister for Poverty Policy I remain committed to halving the number of children growing up in poverty.
Als Minister voor Armoedebeleid blijf ik mij inzetten voor het halveren van het aantal kinderen dat in armoede opgroeit.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Stoffer en Maatoug over 'de ondergrensindicatie bij Wet sociale werkvoorziening (Wsw-)werknemers'

MPs Stoffer and Maatoug ask about rising WIA applications among Wsw workers, the criteria and frequency of 'ondergrens' (lower limit) indications, and why such workers lose the transition payment and often cannot access an incapacity benefit. The minister answers with figures, explains the criteria and the difference between a lower-limit indication and incapacity, says ambtelijke verkenning of changes is ongoing, and states she is not in favour of abolishing periodic re-indications but will review them with UWV.
However, I want to further explore whether the right routes are available in all cases for people to get the support that fits their situation.
Ik wil echter nader verkennen of in alle gevallen de juiste routes beschikbaar zijn voor mensen om de ondersteuning te krijgen die bij hun situatie past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over achterblijvende lonen en lage reiskostenvergoeding van werknemers van sociaal ontwikkelbedrijven

An MP asked the minister about low wages and a 10-cent-per-km travel allowance for sheltered-employment workers under the SW and Aan de Slag collective agreements, and whether government funding or action could improve them. The minister answered that the central government is not a party to these agreements, that municipalities receive funding they can use, that the cao parties must decide on changes, and that talks with VNG and Cedris are ongoing with a letter to the House after the summer recess.
The cao parties themselves are primarily responsible for complying with the agreements in the collective agreements.
Het is primair aan de cao-partijen zelf om afspraken uit de cao's na te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de financiële situatie van gezinnen

An MP asked the ministers about child poverty and family financial support, citing Dutch rankings on family benefits and the rise in cost of living. The ministers answered that child poverty fell from 10.2% in 2013 to 6.8% in 2022, that the child benefit was substantially raised, that the government is committed to halving child poverty, and that a Commission on the social minimum and a study of family policy abroad are underway.
The cabinet remains firmly committed to achieving the target of halving child poverty.
Het kabinet blijft onverminderd gemotiveerd om de doelstelling om kinderarmoede te halveren te behalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about the Temporary Energy Emergency Fund: application numbers and budget spent, whether the application window stays open, whether households with block heating can get support, and how application problems are being fixed. The minister reported about 70,000 applications, €42 million reserved, a planned scheme for block-heating households opening 25 April, and a computer version of the application that reduced complaints.
The cabinet wants people with a block connection to also benefit from support, in the form of an appropriate compensation.
Het kabinet wil dat ook mensen met een blokafsluiting kunnen profiteren van steun, in de vorm van een passende tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Kathmann over de brief van artsenfederatie KNMG over het effect van armoede op ziekte

MPs Bushoff and Kathmann asked the government how it will respond to the KNMG's warning that poverty drives illness, including whether it will reduce health inequalities, target prevention where needed, and act on the KNMG's four recommendations. The state secretaries answered that health gaps are being addressed through existing agreements and programmes, that the KNMG recommendations are under discussion, and that legally anchoring health targets was rejected in a vote, leaving the response largely to policy programmes.
The cabinet is currently holding talks with the KNMG about these recommendations.
Het kabinet voert op dit moment gesprekken met de KNMG over deze aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Maatoug over het gevolg van een hogere instroom van jonge pensioendeelnemers voor het opbouwpercentage

MPs Nijboer and Maatoug asked whether an influx of young pension participants could lower the fiscal maximum accrual rate and pension premiums, and whether the fiscal limits should be changed. The minister answered that individual fiscal limits apply, that premiums need not fall, that no change to the law is needed, and listed the few pension schemes without a franchise.
No, that is not correct. For each participant in the pension scheme, the room for pension accrual must be determined separately.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Voor elke deelnemer aan de pensioenregeling dient afzonderlijk de ruimte voor pensioenopbouw te worden bepaald.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.

Antwoord op vragenvan het lid Omtzigt over de LSI-verslagen, de uitspraak van het Europese Hof d.d. 12 januari 2023 over informatie over het verstrekken van data over persoonsgegevens, alsmede de uitspraak van de Raad va

An MP asks the government about GDPR access rights to recipients of personal data (CJEU ruling), whether a 'code 88' fraud-list marking is personal data, and whether individuals may access the reasons for fraud investigations (Council of State ruling), plus questions on LSI intervention-team records, risk lists, home-entry consent and related documents. The government largely answers that access rights are subject to limits and that code 88 becomes personal data only within a dataset, gives limited information where records no longer exist, and commits to a FSV letter and an LSI evaluation.
For that reason, the information provided to the data subject must be as precise as possible.
Daarom dient de verstrekte informatie aan de betrokkene zo nauwkeurig mogelijk te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Vakbonden zoeken naar nieuwe varianten voor opbouw vroegpensioen'

An MP from D66 asked the minister about union efforts to build early-retirement entitlements, and how this fits with lifelong learning and extended working lives. The minister answered that employers, employees and unions bear primary responsibility for lifelong learning, outlined existing public and sectoral budgets, and noted the temporary early-exit allowance and the planned pension reform.
Employers and employees are primarily responsible for lifelong learning.
Werkgevers en werknemers zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor een leven lang ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over de uitzending van Tegenlicht van donderdag 26 januari en het initiatief Collectief Kapitaal

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the Collectief Kapitaal initiative, which gives cash payments to participants and holds ANBI status as a knowledge institution, is treated as income, and about related policy. The government answered that tax treatment depends on the facts, that it cannot disclose details of an individual ANBI under secrecy rules, and that it will follow such small private initiatives and consult municipalities.
Because the Tax Administration is bound by the secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), no further information can be provided about individual institutions.

Omdat de Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan geen nadere informatie worden verstrekt over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over "Reactie op brief LOSR over samenloop regelingen en effect op toeslagen"

An MP asks why resolving the overlap between social assistance and tax-based allowances (toeslagen) for households at the social minimum has taken so long, since the Ombudsman raised it in 2016 and the Central Council of Appeal ruled on it. The minister answers that several options were examined without a solution free of serious drawbacks, that a compensation route is under study, that municipalities are advised to compensate in the meantime via special assistance, and that Parliament will be informed before summer 2023.
The exact number of households is not known.
Het exacte aantal huishoudens is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht "Vrijwilligers in de knel door regels fiscus voor vergoeding: "Gedwongen om te stoppen""

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Landelijke Cliëntenraad report showing that rules on volunteer expense allowances are unclear and can harm people on benefits, asking whether the rules should be simplified and the hardships addressed in the Tax Plan 2024. The government acknowledged the concerns but declined to change the scheme now, stating the flat-rate allowance is a cost-reimbursement rule meant to reduce administrative burden, pointing to better communication, and promising the Minister of Social Affairs will consider simplification of the WW and WIA and the Minister for Poverty Policy will alert municipalities to incorrect implementation under the Participatiewet.
On the other hand, it is also important not to lose sight of the character of the scheme, a cost-reimbursement scheme.
Aan de andere kant is het ook van belang om het karakter van de regeling, een kostenvergoedingsregeling, niet uit het oog te verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Sneller over het bericht 'Een witbrood stelen om de kinderen te laten eten: de oneindige spiraal van schulden en criminaliteit'

MPs Kat and Sneller asked about a press report linking debt to recidivism, the share of prisoners with debts and access to debt assistance, CJIB debt-relief rules, and judges' knowledge of defendants' finances. The minister acknowledges the debt-crime link and describes existing debt-support routes and reclassering initiatives, but gives no current figures on prisoners receiving debt help and says a fuller answer on the probation thesis' recommendations will follow by end 2023.
There is no recent data available on the total percentage of detainees who struggle with debts.
Er zijn geen recente gegevens bekend over het totale percentage gedetineerden dat kampt met schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het voorgestelde keuze- en shoprecht voor gepensioneerden na invaren vanuit een uitkeringsovereenkomst naar een flexibele premieovereenkomst

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about the choice and shop right for retirees moved from a defined-benefit scheme into a flexible premium scheme, including whether insurers will offer such products and whether a carve-out or AFM advice is warranted. The Minister confirmed the one-time choice and shop right, said insurance market availability depends on pension capital, declined to seek AFM advice now, and promised to monitor the need for a carve-out during transition.
In my view, the current legal framework provides sufficient means to ensure that participants and retirees can make a well-considered choice between a fixed or variable benefit form.

Naar mijn mening biedt het huidige wettelijke kader voldoende mogelijkheden om ervoor te zorgen dat deelnemers/gepensioneerden een weloverwogen keuze kunnen maken voor een vaste of variabele uitkeringsvorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong, Sneller en Kat over het bericht 'Gokbedrijven probeerden ondanks verbod via wk-pools nieuwe klanten te lokken'

MPs Romke de Jong, Sneller and Kat asked the government about reports that gambling firms, including state holding Nederlandse Loterij, advertised via World Cup pools despite a ban, and about the state's oversight as shareholder. The government answered that it was unaware of the World Cup pool ads, that the Gaming Authority fined Nederlandse Loterij for advertising aimed at young adults, that it has voiced concerns to the holdings, and that it is evaluating the shareholding while declining to disclose the number of young players.
This information is not known to me or to my colleague the Minister for Legal Protection because it concerns confidential business information.
Deze informatie is bij mij of mijn collega de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming niet bekend omdat dit vertrouwelijke bedrijfsinformatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug  over het spoedig uitkeren van de energietoeslag 2023

MPs Kathmann and Maatoug asked the minister why municipalities were told they must wait until about June 2023 to pay the 2023 energy allowance, despite earlier urging to pay early, and about funding shortfalls and continuity of local processes. The minister replied that anticipating the not-yet-enacted law is not justified this year given other income measures, that the 2022 budget via the municipal fund has no evidence of insufficiency, and promised to pursue a faster legislative process.
In my view, there are currently insufficient reasons to justify anticipating the new law.
In mijn ogen zijn er nu onvoldoende redenen die het anticiperen op de nieuwe wet rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht ‘Telefoonlijnen roodgloeiend bij uitkerende instanties over tegenvallende AOW-uitkering’

An MP asked the minister why AOW recipients were not proactively informed that the increase would be smaller than 10% and whether they would be compensated for inflation. The minister said information was published on government and SVB websites, that call volumes rose less than 5%, and pointed to existing income measures such as the energy price cap and higher rent and care allowances.
So proactive communication did take place about the AOW increase, though I understand not everyone received this message.
Er is dus proactief gecommuniceerd over de stijging van de AOW-uitkering, tegelijk begrijp ik dat niet iedereen deze boodschap heeft ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over misstanden bij Weener XL

An SP MP asked the minister about reported abuses at sheltered employer Weener XL, including pressure to work through illness, withheld wages, intimidation, and unaddressed complaints, and about the legality of wage deductions for benefit recipients. The minister called the reports worrying, pointed to an independent investigation commissioned by the 's-Hertogenbosch municipality, and said oversight of sanctions and the company lies with the municipality and the employer rather than the national government.
It is therefore for them, and not for me, to judge the number of disciplinary measures imposed and whether this is in line with legislation and policy.
Het is daarom aan hen- en niet aan mij- om een oordeel te vellen over het aantal opgelegde disciplinaire maatregelen en of dit in lijn is met wetgeving en beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over Buy Now, Pay Later betaaldiensten

MP Kathmann asks the Minister about Buy Now, Pay Later services such as Klarna, which may draw young people into debt through high reminder fees and handovers to debt collectors. The Minister acknowledges the risks, says providers must check age and that BNPL will be brought under EU consumer credit rules, and promises talks with providers and a regulatory response.
The cabinet wants to sit down with BNPL providers in the short term to reinforce this call.
Het kabinet wil op korte termijn met de aanbieders van BNPL-betaaldiensten om tafel om deze oproep kracht bij te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Mensen met schulden merken niets van hogere lonen en uitkeringen'

An MP asked the ministers whether debt-relief recipients benefit from the higher minimum wage through an adjusted beslagvrije voet, and about fee indexation for bewindvoerders. The government answered that recalculation happens during 2023 on request or annually, promised a proactive joint approach with the enforcement chain, and explained that trustee fees are not indexed in 2023 due to the formula's reference year.
We are urgently taking steps to ensure that financially vulnerable people quickly feel the effects of the minimum wage increase in their wallets.
Wij zetten met urgentie stappen om te bewerkstelligen dat financieel kwetsbare mensen de gevolgen van de stijging van het wettelijk minimumloon snel merken in hun portemonnee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Boulakjar en Kat over het bericht 'BKR wil hypotheken registreren en gegevens delen met belwinkels en postorderbedrijven'

MPs from D66 asked the Finance Minister, on behalf of other ministers, about BKR's plan to register mortgages and share data with phone-shop and mail-order firms, including its legal basis, public oversight, proportionality and privacy. The minister answered that no positive mortgage registration is planned for now, that a bill will be consulted on in early 2023 to give credit registration a statutory basis and ministerial powers, and that the government is in talks with BKR.
In the bill, credit registration becomes a statutory task, with corresponding powers for the Minister of Finance.
In het wetsvoorstel wordt kredietregistratie een wettelijke taak, met overeenkomstige bevoegdheden voor de Minister van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over de vergunningsaanvragen in de visserijsector

MPs Valstar and Van Campen (VVD) asked about expiring Wnb nature permits for the shrimp fishing sector, the late deadline for new permit applications, the Brexit adjustment subsidy, the existence of an acquired right, and the delayed emissions-reduction subsidy. The minister answered that permits expire on 1 January 2023, applications were submitted on 30 June 2022 but required supplementation, the Landsadvocaat advised that no acquired right exists, and a subsidy is expected to open in January 2023 with a possible nine-month tolerance arrangement.
The Landsadvocaat considers it highly uncertain whether the specific requirements for claiming such an acquired right can be met.
De Landsadvocaat acht het uiterst onzeker of de specifieke vereisten voor het kunnen claimen van een dergelijk bestaand recht zijn in te vullen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij, Den Haan, Van Kent, Léon de Jong en Ephraim over onbegrijpelijke en op het eerste oog onjuiste scenario’s die DNB gemaakt heeft op basis van de adviezen van de commi

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Pensions why the 2022 Parameter Committee lowered the expected stock return while DNB's scenario charts appeared to show higher returns, and about standard deviation, validation and the release of draft DNB calculations. The minister answered that the scenarios follow the committee's advice, that the charts are consistent with it, and declined to share draft DNB reports, citing the value of confidential expert exchange, while committing to answer by a set date.
I do not consider it appropriate to share draft reports with your House.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om conceptrapportages met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Smals over het artikel 'Tien jaar stilstand reden recordkrapte'

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Poverty, Participation and Pensions about labour shortages and how to get people with a distance from the labour market or older workers into work, including the no-risk policy, employer support points, the labour market infrastructure, dismissal and sick-pay rules, and cao provisions. The ministers answered that the government is pursuing employer incentives, a pilot for a no-risk policy, a regional 'Werkcentrum' plan due by summer 2023, and further reports on flexible contracts and sick-pay reform, while declining to give some figures yet.
In recent years, since the jobs agreement, there has been a lot of attention to the importance of hiring people with a disability.
Er is de afgelopen jaren, sinds de banenafspraak, veel aandacht geweest voor het belang van het aannemen van mensen met een arbeidsbeperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Gemeenten willen stekker uit Kredietbank in Assen trekken'

MPs asked the minister about possible closure of the Gemeenschappelijke Kredietbank (GKB) in Assen, including risks to debt-relief continuity, costs, and availability of loans. The minister answered that municipalities would re-tender debt assistance and keep loan products available, noting no other Kredietbanken are known to be in deficit.
The municipalities concerned would, in case of dissolution of the KBG, carry out a new tender for their debt assistance and the provision of debt-restructuring loans.
De betreffende gemeenten zullen in het geval van opheffing van de KBG een nieuwe aanbesteding doen voor hun schuldhulpverlening en de verstrekking van saneringskredieten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het rapport 'Sociale minima in de knel' van de Nationale ombudsman

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked the minister for poverty policy about the Nationale ombudsman's report on social minima, covering benefit levels, under-claiming and clawback fears, trust in government, and the 15-euro minimum wage. The minister acknowledges the report, points to a 10% minimum wage increase and a Commissie Sociaal Minimum due by June 2023, and outlines planned measures (proactive outreach, the Participatiewet in Balans track, and an Aanpak geldzorgen) but rejects further minimum-wage increases.
I endorse this recommendation of the Nationale Ombudsman.
Ik onderschrijf deze aanbeveling van de Nationale Ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het prudent persons principle en het beleggen met geleend geld in de Wet toekomst pensioenen
