MP Omtzigt asks the minister whether lifting the borrowing restriction in the Wet toekomst pensioenen, combined with individual allocation of returns, is compatible with the prudent person principle, and questions the 150% equity exposure for young members, the history of the 150% cap, and whether flexible contracts are covered. The minister answers that the prudent person principle is an open norm that funds must substantiate themselves, that a 150% statutory cap on equity exposure is now being added via an amendment, and that the earlier draft and the flexible-contract position were stated in a way the minister considers consistent with the bill.
I have previously stated to your House that my exchange of views with your House on this subject has convinced me that capping the borrowing restriction is a desirable addition to the bill.

Ik heb eerder in uw Kamer uitgesproken dat mijn gedachtewisseling met uw Kamer over dit onderwerp mij ervan heeft overtuigd dat een maximering van de leenrestrictie een wenselijke toevoeging aan het wetsvoorstel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Voedselbank Almere kan drukte bijna niet aan'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about reports that the Almere food bank cannot cope with rising demand, including whether local organisations and municipalities have enough resources, whether working people above the poverty line are affected, and how ESF+ funds are being spent. The minister answered that rising energy prices and inflation have increased demand, pointed to new national measures, a 35 million euro allocation to municipalities in 2022 and 200 million euro for debt and poverty in 2022-2024, and said the ESF+ funds for food aid have not yet been spent and will be allocated via an open call.
Question 9: Can you give insight into how the European Social Fund (ESF+) funds made available for support to food banks have been spent?
Vraag 9 Kunt u inzicht geven in hoe de Europees Sociaal Fonds (ESF+-)gelden die beschikbaar zijn gekomen voor steun aan de voedselbanken zijn besteed?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het artikel ‘Provincies bleven op grote schaal vergunningen verlenen voor controversiële ‘stikstofarme’ stallen'

An MP from GroenLinks asks whether provinces should suspend permits for low-emission barn systems whose emission reduction courts and researchers have questioned, and what follows for subsidies, permits and the nitrogen policy. The minister answers that provinces are the competent authority, that a further letter on permit-granting will follow in November, that subsidy recovery is not warranted merely because innovative systems underperform, and that the Council of State's rulings do not change total emission figures.
Provinces are the competent authority under the Nature Conservation Act to assess whether permits can be granted in that context and to decide whether permit-granting is suspended.
Provincies zijn op grond van de Wnb het bevoegde gezag om te beoordelen of er in dat kader vergunningen verleend kunnen worden en te bepalen of de vergunningverlening wordt opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smolders over 'het bericht dat de helft van de Brabanders kampt met geldzorgen'

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about reports that half of Brabanders face money worries, with health complaints, poverty by province, a plan to tackle poverty in Brabant, shame around money problems, child hunger in schools and low trust in government measures. The minister acknowledged the link between money worries and health, pointed to income support, debt-prevention and school meal measures, provided national and municipal poverty data, and declined to redirect development aid to domestic poverty.
The cabinet is therefore not willing to deploy development cooperation funds elsewhere.
Het kabinet is daarom niet bereid om de middelen voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking elders in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Boucke over het artikel 'Energieleveranciers laten bewoners met betaalproblemen massaal stikken: Schuldhulpverleners luiden noodklok'

MPs Kat and Boucke asked whether energy suppliers refuse payment arrangements for customers with payment problems, risking disconnection and derailing debt relief, and what the government will do. Minister Schouten answered that suppliers sometimes refuse arrangements, that amended disconnection rules from 26 October 2022 require suppliers to make extra efforts to reach customers and offer reasonable arrangements, and that a temporary emergency fund and a planned court-imposed payment arrangement bill are in preparation.

If a debt counsellor's proposal receives no response, the debt counsellor can point to the energy supplier's obligation to make extra efforts to reach customers and offer a reasonable and appropriate payment arrangement.

Indien er niet wordt gereageerd op een voorstel van een schuldhulpverlener, kan de schuldhulpverlener wijzen op de verplichting die de energieleverancier heeft om een extra inspanning te leveren om contact te krijgen met de klanten en om een redelijke en passende betalingsregeling aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gündoğan over 'de inkomens- en vermogensgrenzen van de eenmalige energietoeslag'

An MP asks the Minister of Poverty Policy about income and asset limits for the one-off energy allowance, including why municipalities apply different thresholds and deductions for pensioners. The minister answers that municipalities have wide policy discretion under decentralised special assistance, the national advice is 120% of the social minimum, and the government will not prescribe asset or income limits, though it will study municipal practice in early 2023.
The national government does not have an official overview of municipalities that do or do not apply an asset limit when granting the one-off energy allowance.
Het Rijk beschikt niet over een officieel overzicht van gemeenten die al dan niet een vermogensgrens hanteren bij de toekenning van de eenmalige energietoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat in Arnhem mensen na aanvraag 14 weken moeten wachten voor ze energietoeslag ontvangen

An SP MP asked the minister about reported waiting times of up to 14 weeks for the energy allowance in Arnhem and related delays in Doetinchem, and whether gemeenten should receive extra funds. The minister answered that waiting times in Arnhem have fallen to four weeks, that gemeenten bear the implementation burden and staff shortages, and that she remains in talks with the VNG without committing to new funding.
I am and remain in discussion with the VNG and municipalities about the implementation.
Ik ben en blijf met de VNG en gemeenten in gesprek over de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de inbeslagname van een varken in de achtertuin van een woonhuis omwille van dierenwelzijn

MP Vestering asks the minister whether the seizure of a pig kept in a small backyard shed reflects poor welfare standards, and why pigs in commercial farming have far lower housing requirements than companion pigs. The minister defends the separate regulatory frameworks, says the LID's assessment is its own call, declines to discuss the ongoing case, and pledges to push for stricter EU welfare standards and a convenant with the sector.
This concerns an ongoing case. No statements can be made about ongoing cases in the interest of the legal proceedings.
Het betreft hier een lopende zaak. Over lopende zaken kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan in het kader van het procesbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de brief van 6 juli 2022 inzake de aankondiging van de huis- en hobbydierenlijst

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why deer species were left off the proposed pet and hobby animal list, which would end deer farming and deer parks, and why industry concerns, a 2002 expert report, Skal certification and the Adviescollege's advice on house rules were not reflected. The Minister answered that the list rests on welfare and human-safety risk assessments, that a transition regime and sector consultation are underway, and that the list is consistent with the Andibel ruling.
I understand the concerns of this sector.
Ik begrijp de zorgen van deze sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebrek aan handhaving op de paardenmarkt in Heeten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about lax enforcement at the Heeten horse market, including missing water and feed, undocumented horses and possible illegal trade. The minister acknowledged one case of rough handling and a documentation breach caused by an unclear NVWA notice, said no enforcement was taken on documentation, and gave a mostly rebuttal-style answer while promising no concrete new action.
No enforcement action was taken regarding documentation because earlier this year an NVWA trade notice mistakenly gave incorrect information about the obligation.

Ten aanzien van de documentatie is niet handhavend opgetreden omdat eerder dit jaar een vakbericht vanuit de NVWA is uitgegaan waarin abusievelijk niet de juiste informatie was gegeven over de verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen die van het lid Haverkort over de campagne ‘Drafsport? Onsportief!’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Dier&Recht campaign against harness aids and bits in harness racing, citing a Finnish study on mouth injuries. The minister acknowledged the concerns, noted a correlation rather than causation, said the sector's rules are being reviewed and that a research institute is inventorying welfare risks, but declined to commit to a ban and said the NVWA supervises animal welfare mainly on complaints.
I can agree with this call. Aids that carry a high risk of harm to animal welfare should not be used.
Ik kan me vinden in deze oproep. Hulpmiddelen waarbij er een groot risico is op welzijnsaantasting zouden niet gebruikt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat ver 'het artikel Jamal Oulel zet met zijn fintech Socialdebt incassobureaus buitenspel'

An MP asked the minister whether the Socialdebt fintech, which takes over young people's debts without fees, could be scaled up and supported alongside the national guarantee fund and innovative financing. The minister said early intervention is promising but the pilot is too new to judge effectiveness, so scaling will wait for evaluation, with no regulatory barriers identified.
I will continue to stay in close contact with Socialdebt and the municipality of Rotterdam to be able to establish this.
Ik blijf hiertoe nauw contact houden met Socialdebt en de gemeente Rotterdam om dit te kunnen vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Nijboer over schuldhulpverlening en het krijgen van een baan

MPs Kathmann and Nijboer asked whether people in debt assistance must have their wages paid to a trustee, whether this deters employers, and how to remove that barrier to work. The minister explained that wages go to a account in the debtor's own name managed by a trustee, that this need not stigmatise, and that the government promotes employer support for debt-stressed employees.
As explained, debt assistance and/or the payment of wages into a management account need not be an obstacle to finding work.
Zoals uitgelegd hoeft schuldhulpverlening en/of de uitbetaling van het loon op een beheerrekening geen drempel te zijn bij het vinden van werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het artikel ‘Een kleine koe die minder krachtvoer eet is ook een vorm van innovatie’

An MP asked whether the Dutch nitrogen accounting treats all cows alike at 13 kg ammonia per year regardless of management measures, and whether management measures that reduce emissions will be added to the approved low-emission list. The ministers answered that management and feed measures are already partly reflected in the rules and monitoring, that more reliable, verifiable farm-level data is needed before further measures are recognised, and that they will explore incentives for farmers who reduce emissions.
I am examining the possibilities to demonstrate that for other management measures too, ammonia emissions at farm level decrease with sufficient certainty.
Ik onderzoek de mogelijkheden om aan te tonen dat ook bij andere managementmaatregelen de ammoniakemissie met voldoende zekerheid afneemt op bedrijfsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voorgestelde wijzigingen inzake het nabestaandenpensioen en over berekeningen hoe het nieuwe stelsel dit jaar gewerkt zou hebben

MP Omtzigt asked the minister about survivors' pension rules under the Wet toekomst pensioenen, including the cost of voluntary continuation, the effects of a pre-retirement death, the transition and the 2022 Confident calculations. The minister largely confirmed the cited figures, said the scheme is an improvement and that details are left to social partners, and declined to give a half-year performance estimate, arguing that such a short horizon is inadequate.
A calculation period of half a year is in my view too short to properly compare contract performance and to make a well-considered choice about introducing the new system.

Een berekeningsperiode van een half jaar acht ik te kort om de prestaties van contracten goed met elkaar te kunnen vergelijken en om een weloverwogen keuze te kunnen maken over de invoering van het nieuwe stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Palland over het aanblijvende gebrek aan voortgang bij de unaniem aangenomen motie aanpak AOW-hiaat

MPs Van Kent and Palland asked why the unanimously adopted motion on the AOW-gap for self-employed people who were already ill before the AOW age rise has seen no progress, and when the initiators would be involved. The minister acknowledges the delay, states that a two-year extension of the Overbruggingsuitkering is proposed as the solution, and promises a technical briefing and letters to affected people.
I regret the delay that has arisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over ‘Gokken in casino leidt minder snel tot terugvordering volledige bijstandsuitkering’

An MP asks the minister about a court ruling that gambling winnings by welfare recipients need not lead to full benefit recovery, and about gambling-related debt among welfare recipients. The minister says the courts' judgment is not for her to assess, that no data exist on recoveries for gambling, and that gambling protections (limits, CRUKS self-exclusion) exist but municipalities cannot register gambling welfare recipients for privacy reasons.
Figures on this are not available. Municipalities do not record the reason for recovery at such a detailed level.
Cijfers op dit vlak zijn niet beschikbaar. Gemeenten registreren de reden van terugvordering niet op een dergelijk gedetailleerd niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht dat de rechtbank heeft geoordeeld dat burgers in het buitengebied onvoldoende worden beschermd tegen stank uit de veehouderij

An MP from D66 asked the government how it will respond to a court ruling that residents of rural areas are insufficiently protected against livestock odour, including its plans for the Biesheuvel commission's recommendations and whether it will appeal. The state secretary answered that the ruling is being studied, promised a letter before the 10 November debate, and noted that municipalities already have tools under the Crisis- and herstelwet and the Omgevingswet.
At this moment the ruling is being studied. I take the ruling and the problem very seriously for all those involved.
Op dit moment wordt de uitspraak bestudeerd. Ik neem de uitspraak en de problematiek voor alle betrokkenen zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Molen en Geurts over het bericht 'Nieuwe dreun voor boeren: burgers die last hebben van stank hebben recht op schadevergoeding'

CDA MPs asked ministers about a Hague court ruling holding the State liable to residents exposed to excessive odour from livestock farms, and its effects on farms, permits, and costs. The government replied that the ruling is still being studied, promised a letter before the 10 November debate, and gave no cost estimate.
At this moment the ruling is being studied.
Op dit moment wordt de uitspraak bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het illegaal aanbieden van een pony als prijs in een loterij op een paarden- en ponymarkt

MP Wassenberg asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a pony raffled as a prize at the Denekamp horse and pony market, which the Animal Act prohibits, and about NVWA enforcement at such markets. The minister confirmed the prohibition and that organisers should know the rules, but said the NVWA was not present at the Denekamp market, that its supervision is risk-based and mostly complaint-driven, and that the largest supervisory capacity gaps include markets with horses.
The NVWA carries out its supervision on a risk basis and is not present at all events involving live animals.
De NVWA voert haar toezicht risicogebaseerd uit en is niet op alle evenementen met levende dieren aanwezig.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Boswijk over grote onduidelijkheid voor akkerbouwers rondom het 7e Actieprogramma (7e AP) en addendum met daarbij de aanvullende voorwaarden uit de derogatiebeschikking, het nie

MPs Grinwis and Boswijk asked the Minister of Agriculture about the uncertainty for arable farmers caused by the 7th Action Programme, the derogation conditions, the new CAP and the ANLb, including buffer strips, harvest and sowing timing, the eco-scheme and communication. The Minister acknowledged the timing problems, committed to working with RVO on implementation, a reduced entry requirement and a 2023 learning year, but declined to adjust the derogation-based buffer strip rules or to set a transition year for several measures.
Work is being done closely with RVO to enable timely elaboration of the necessary regulations and communication about them.
Er wordt nauw samengewerkt met RVO om tijdige uitwerking van de benodigde regelgeving en communicatie daarover mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikht over het artikel ‘Nederland houdt Caribische staatsburgers al twaalf jaar arm’

An MP asks the government why minimum wages, benefits and living costs on the Caribbean Netherlands islands remain far below the European Netherlands despite parliamentary motions and advice from the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights and the Ombudsman, and asks for a fixed social minimum and comparative data. The minister acknowledges high poverty, outlines a phased wage and benefit increase and a social-minimum target for 2025, but gives no firm date for formally setting the minimum and lacks data on housing and comparative costs.

The cabinet is working hard within the context and socio-economic conditions of the Caribbean Netherlands to move towards a level of livelihood security equivalent to that of the European Netherlands.

Het kabinet zet zich hard in om binnen de context en de sociaaleconomische omstandigheden in Caribisch Nederland verder toe werken naar een, ten opzichte van Europees Nederland, gelijkwaardig niveau van bestaanszekerheid in Caribisch Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Haverkort over de campagne 'Koop geen kortsnuit'

MPs Wassenberg and Haverkort asked the minister about the 'Koop geen kortsnuit' campaign, criteria for breeding, Cambridge-method screening, and Raad van Beheer pedigrees issued to brachycephalic dogs bred contrary to law. The minister supports the campaign and information efforts, says criteria are still being developed with the EGD, and says the pedigree issuing is a private matter the government cannot prohibit.
Issuing pedigrees is a private matter for which there is no statutory regulation.
Het afgeven van stambomen is een private aangelegenheid waarvoor geen wettelijke regeling geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over een onvolledige AOW-uitkering voor stellen die lager uitkomt dan een AOW-uitkering voor alleenstaanden

An MP asked why couples with one partner having incomplete AOW accrual can receive less pension than a single-person full AOW benefit, how many households are affected, and what the budgetary cost of compensating them would be. The minister confirmed about 4,389 such couples, explained the cause (short residence), pointed to AIO means-tested support and information channels, and declined compensation as it would breach equality principles and the couple-scale logic.
On 1 July 2022 there were 4,389 cohabiting couples whose total AOW benefit was lower than a single-person benefit because one partner had an incomplete AOW benefit.
Op 1 juli 2022 waren er 4.389 samenwonende paren waarvan de totale AOW-uitkering lager uitkomt dan een alleenstaande uitkering doordat één van de partners een onvolledige AOW-uitkering heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport ‘Meedoen zonder beperkingen’ van de Nationale ombudsman

Christian Union MP Ceder asked the government to respond to the National Ombudsman's report on young people with disabilities and the Participation Act, including whether expectations of self-reliance are realistic and whether the law should be changed. Minister Schouten answered that a reply to the report will follow, cited measures such as the Breed Offensief bill, the planned raise of earnings thresholds and a 10% minimum wage increase, but rejected a structural system change for this group.
This cabinet's coalition agreement does not provide for a systemic change of the kind referred to in question 6.
In het Coalitieakkoord van dit kabinet is niet voorzien in een stelselverandering zoals bedoeld in vraag 6.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de maximale temperatuur bij diertransporten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about maximum temperatures for animal transports after heat stress cases in summer 2022, and referred to EFSA advice setting upper temperature limits per species. The minister answered that EU rules currently lack such limits, that the NVWA is evaluating summer inspections, and that the government is considering a national policy rule based on the EFSA findings, to be communicated to parliament.
That is why I am currently examining the possibilities of applying the EFSA findings in a policy rule, similar to how I drew up the Policy rule for animal transport at high temperatures in 2020.

Daarom bezie ik momenteel de mogelijkheden om de EFSA-uitkomsten toe te passen in een beleidsregel, vergelijkbaar met hoe ik in 2020 de Beleidsregel voor diertransport bij hoge temperaturen heb opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Veel financieel kwetsbare ouderen maken geen gebruik van inkomensvoorzieningen’ van de Nationale Ombudsman

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions how elderly people are informed about supplementary income schemes after reaching pension age, following a National Ombudsman report on non-take-up of benefits. The minister answered that the SVB and municipalities inform people, that proactive approaches and simpler application procedures and data exchange are being pursued, and that a legal basis for data sharing is planned.
Countering non-take-up has my priority and is part of the approach to money worries, poverty and debt.
Het tegengaan van niet-gebruik heeft mijn prioriteit en maakt deel uit van de aanpak van geldzorgen, armoede en schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Werner over kwetsbare ouderen die vaak geen gebruik maken van inkomensvoorzieningen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Ministers for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions and for Long-term Care and Sport about vulnerable older people who often do not claim income support, citing a National Ombudsman report on complexity, distance from government and low trust. Minister Schouten largely agreed with the analysis, estimated roughly 30% potential non-take-up of the AIO (about 20,000 households), announced a data-exchange pilot between SVB and UWV/Tax Authority, and defended current application procedures while saying automatic allocation is complex and only sometimes feasible.
I broadly share the analysis of the National Ombudsman.
Ik deel de analyse van de Nationale ombudsman in grote lijnen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over huidige verlagingen van variabele pensioenuitkeringen met wel 10%, de brief van de Commissie Parameters en de tussenliggende periode tot mogelijke ingangsdatum van de Wet toeko

Omtzigt asks the Minister whether variable pension payouts in the new system could fall by around 10% during high inflation, whether the solidarity contract and parameter commission timing leave people and employers unclear, and whether the Minister will extend the temporary indexation and vrijstelling rules. The Minister argues variable payouts can be stabilised by solidarity reserves and spreading, that the 10% drop is unlikely, and that the Wet toekomst pensioenen start date will be postponed to 1 July, while indicating no extension of the indexation rules is planned for now.
The bill offers earlier prospects for a more purchasing-power-proof pension, and pension accrual also becomes more personal and transparent.
Het wetsvoorstel biedt namelijk eerder perspectief op een koopkrachtiger pensioen, en ook de pensioenopbouw wordt persoonlijker en transparanter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het rapport ‘Van schuld naar schone lei’

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about the RVS report 'From debt to clean slate', covering government language on debt, minimum wage timing, debt relief schemes, creditor practices and prevention. The minister answered broadly, committing to pilots, a collective debt arrangement approach, new studies and further talks, without addressing several specific demands directly.

I will discuss with municipalities how we can offer standard guidance to clients of municipal debt assistance before and during a wsnp procedure in all municipalities, and inform the House about this this autumn.

Ik zal met gemeenten bespreken hoe we de begeleiding van cliënten door de gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening naar en tijdens een wsnp-traject in alle gemeenten standaard kunnen aanbieden en uw Kamer daar dit najaar over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Laan over het bericht 'Rechter: gemeente mag student niet uitsluiten van € 800 energietoeslag'

Two MPs asked the minister how a court ruling that a municipality may not exclude a student from the energy allowance affects national guidance excluding students as a group. The minister maintains that categorical exclusion is justified, directs individual students to individual special assistance, and notes extra funding for municipalities.
The national guidelines will be supplemented with a more extensive justification for not granting the one-off energy allowance to students on a categorical basis.
De landelijke richtlijnen zullen worden aangevuld met een uitgebreidere motivering voor het niet categoriaal verstrekken van de eenmalige energietoeslag aan studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Toezichthouder onderzoekt meldingen torenhoge kosten schuldhulp'

An MP from D66 asked the minister about reports of commercial debt mediation that circumvents the statutory ban, including via lawyers, trustees and curators, and about enforcement and complaint routes. The minister acknowledged the problem, announced stronger administrative enforcement, a complaints desk, stricter requirements for trustees and clearer rules, while stating that data on circumvention is not kept and that the ban's exceptions for regulated professions remain supervised by their own bodies.
We do not have statistics on circumventing the ban on debt mediation.
We beschikken niet over statistieken over het omzeilen van het verbod op schuldbemiddeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over uitsluiting studenten energietoeslag is onrechtmatig

An MP asks the Minister for Poverty Policy whether excluding students from the one-off energy allowance is unlawful and why students are referred to individual special assistance instead. The minister defends the exclusion as justified given the diversity of student housing, notes limited municipal funds (EUR 35 million extra), and rejects changing the law or using DUO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over Rechter: studenten mogen niet als hele groep worden uitgesloten van eenmalige energietoeslag

MP Kathmann asked why the minister has not extended the one-off energy allowance to students following a court ruling that students cannot be excluded as a group, and whether a class action is needed. The minister maintains that excluding students as a group is justified because housing situations vary, points students to individual special assistance, says DUO cannot implement the allowance quickly, and offers extra municipal funds.
I maintain my advice not to give students group access to the one-off energy allowance.
Ik blijf bij mijn advies om studenten niet als groep toegang te geven tot de eenmalige energietoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over de uitspraak inzake de energietoeslag voor studenten

An MP asks the Minister for Poverty Policy about a court ruling that Nijmegen wrongly excluded all students from the one-off energy allowance, and about what it means for other municipalities, co-ordination with VNG, DUO implementation and extra funding. The Minister keeps the advice that students be excluded as a group, points to individual special assistance as the alternative, and refuses to issue binding rules to municipalities, citing their policy discretion.
Because municipalities have policy discretion within special assistance, I cannot make binding statements about this.
Omdat gemeenten binnen de bijzondere bijstand over beleidsvrijheid beschikken, kan ik hier geen bindende uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht 'Kantonrechter ontslaat Langhenkel als bewindvoerder'

MP Kat asked the ministers about the dismissal of bewindvoerder Langhenkel and related oversight failures, including court actions, complaint and fraud statistics, and quality-control outcomes. The government answered that it regrets the situation, that six liability claims arose (three settled, three judgments), and that many data points are not held by the judiciary, with a promised follow-up on stricter standards and court oversight.
In how many cases since 2019 has the client or successor bewindvoerder objected to the final account of the (ex officio) dismissed bewindvoerder?
In hoeveel gevallen vanaf 2019 tot heden heeft de cliënt of opvolgend bewindvoerder bezwaar gemaakt tegen de eindafrekening en -verantwoording van de (ambtshalve) ontslagen bewindvoerder?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over de brief Instellingsbesluit Commissie Sociaal Minimum d.d. 8 juli 2022

An MP asked whether the Commission Sociaal Minimum review of the social minimum covers the Caribbean Netherlands islands and whether they will be added, and whether the government applies comply-or-explain there. The minister acknowledges comply-or-explain, explains that the Caribbean islands will be reviewed in a separate trajectory with a 2024 study and a 2025 target, and does not add them to the commission's mandate.
For the Caribbean Netherlands, the cabinet chooses a separate trajectory ("explain").
Voor Caribisch Nederland kiest het kabinet voor een separaat traject («explain»).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Haverkort over het bericht 'Grote giftige spin rukt op: in hele land gesignaleerd'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about a newspaper report on the false wolf spider spreading across the Netherlands, its danger to humans, and whether it should count as an invasive alien species. The minister answered that the spider poses little danger to humans, that it has established itself in the Netherlands through human-assisted introduction, that it is not on the EU invasive species list, and that the ministry works with other governments on prevention, control and restoration.
This spider poses no danger to humans.
Deze spin vormt voor mensen geen gevaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de indexatie van verkeersboetes

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked whether the government will index traffic fines to inflation during a cost-of-living crisis and whether it will exempt them, and how many fines were imposed, unpaid, or led to debt. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that fines are indexed annually to correct for price erosion, that the government will address inflation impacts through other means, and that a review of the indexation method is planned.
I have instructed my department to review the long-standing system for indexing Wahv fines based on inflation.
Wel heb ik mijn departement opdracht gegeven om de reeds lang bestaande systematiek voor de indexering van Wahv-boetes gebaseerd op de inflatie tegen het licht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van der Woude en De Kort over het artikel 'Minister Schouten wil terugkeer schooltandarts'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of health and of education about a news report that the minister wanted to bring back the school dentist, and about dentist shortages and the plans for children's dental care. The government answered that it is consulting dental organisations on a plan to increase children's dental visits, that preventive measures beyond school dentists are also being considered, and that a letter on dental care will follow by early October 2022.

I will explain the proposals for measures to encourage visits to the dental care provider in my letter on dental care, which I will send to the House of Representatives by early October 2022 at the latest.
Ik zal de voorstellen voor maatregelen om het bezoek aan de mondzorgverlener te stimuleren, toelichten in mijn brief over mondzorg die ik uiterlijk begin oktober 2022 aan de Tweede Kamer zal sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Den Haan over het nader verslag inzake wijziging van de Pensioenwet, de Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 en enige andere wetten in verband met herziening va

MPs Palland, Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Den Haan asked whether the government's pension projection table ignores the 1.5% projection return, whether pensions can keep pace with 2%, 4% or 6% inflation, and whether more detailed scenario tables are possible. The minister admitted the table was a simplified example with an implicit zero nominal projection return and that the assumptions should have been stated more clearly, argued the new contract offers earlier prospects of indexation than the current one, and promised supplementary DNB calculations before the 12 September hearing.
I acknowledge that the answer could have been clearer about the assumptions underlying the projection return used.
Ik erken dat in de beantwoording duidelijker had kunnen worden aangegeven van welke veronderstellingen bij het gehanteerde projectierendement is uitgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de nieuwe scenarioset in de pensioenwet, waarop zeer veel besluiten gebaseerd zijn, maar die nog steeds niet gepubliceerd is

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions why the new scenario set for the pension law, on which many decisions rest, has still not been published, and sought the effects of parameter changes on pension outcomes and transition distributions. The Minister answered that the Parameters committee has an extended mandate to 30 November 2022, that scenario changes do not alter the statutory framework, and that transition outcomes depend on fund-level decisions, while committing to share the committee's advice and DNB sensitivity analyses with the Chamber.
In that context I have already extended the mandate until 30 November 2022.
Ik heb in dat kader het mandaat reeds verlengd tot 30 november 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Laan over “het bericht 'Uitsluiting studenten energietoeslag is onrechtmatig, zeggen juristen'

MPs Podt and Van der Laan asked whether excluding students from the categorical energy allowance is justified, given reports that lawyers call it unlawful. The minister defends advising municipalities to exclude students, citing the diversity of student housing, and points to individual special assistance and a planned DUO communication.
I cannot state how many students are facing a higher energy bill.
Ik kan niet aangeven hoeveel studenten te maken hebben met een hogere energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Wel minimum inkomen, uitgesloten van compensatie: de eindjes aan elkaar knopen is voor studenten nu wel heel lastig'

MPs Kwint asked the ministers about reports that students struggle to make ends meet and whether government will raise support, cap student loan interest, extend energy allowances and housing benefit, or address student housing costs. The government answered that the basic grant returns from 2023/2024, the minimum wage will rise, a national student housing action plan is being drafted, and it sees no room to increase funding or extend housing benefit to rented rooms for now.
I am always willing to enter into discussion with students.
Ik ben altijd bereid om in gesprek te gaan met studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint over het bericht 'stagiair wordt te vaak ingezet als goedkope arbeidskracht

An SP MP asks the ministers whether internships are misused as cheap labour, whether a minimum internship allowance and enforcement are needed, and about internship shortages and 'green plucking' of students. The minister says employers are not legally required to pay internship allowances, promises talks with education and employers, notes the Labour Inspectorate can fine employers for regular work done by interns, and says the government sees no role in covering employers' costs.
The Netherlands Labour Inspectorate checks whether interns are improperly deployed and can fine a company if this is the case.
De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie controleert of er sprake is van oneigenlijke inzet van stagiairs en kan een boete uitdelen aan een bedrijf als hier sprake van is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Grote woorden winnen in politiek Maastricht van sympathie’

MPs Palland and Koekkoek asked about a Maastricht council debate on a court ruling concerning the Tozo scheme for cross-border entrepreneurs, appeals, EU free-movement concerns and cross-border policy testing. The minister said the matter is for the municipality, that appeals were lodged and the ministry joins them, that the CRvB will rule, and that the Tozo's non-export rule follows the territoriality principle.
That is why it is good that the higher administrative court now assesses this case in an independent and impartial manner.
Daarom is het goed dat nu de hogere (bestuurs)rechter deze zaak op een onafhankelijke en onpartijdige wijze gaat beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over natuurlijke personen die zijn opgenomen in het curatele- en bewindsregister maar desondanks zonder toestemming van de bewindvoerder een bedrijf kunnen starten bij de Kamer van K

An MP asked the ministers whether it is undesirable that persons under guardianship or administration can start a business at the Chamber of Commerce without the administrator's approval, and whether the KvK should check the central register before registration. The minister agreed it is undesirable, and said the KvK and ministries will explore a systematic check by autumn, without committing to a concrete change.
It is not desirable that natural persons under guardianship or administration can carry out such acts without the required approval of their guardian or administrator.
Het is niet wenselijk dat natuurlijke personen die onder curatele of bewind staan dergelijke handelingen kunnen verrichten zonder de (vereiste) goedkeuring van hun curator of bewindvoerder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Kat  over het bericht ‘Weer minder mensen in de wettelijke schuldsanering’ van het CBS

MPs Ceder and Kat asked the government why the number of people admitted to the statutory debt restructuring regime (Wsnp) keeps falling and whether the entry threshold is too high, and whether it will consult municipalities and others. The minister answers that admission criteria are applied too strictly, points to a pending bill to loosen them, and says advice will be sought from practitioners, with a letter to parliament planned for September 2022.
It is not intended that people who would benefit from a Wsnp procedure remain in a municipal debt assistance procedure if it is clear that this offers no solution to their debt problem.

Het is niet de bedoeling dat mensen, die gebaat zijn bij een Wsnp-traject, in een gemeentelijk schuldhulpverleningstraject blijven indien duidelijk is dat dit geen oplossing biedt voor de schuldenproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over het dreigend belastingdrama voor zzp’ers

An MP asked whether self-employed workers using the fiscal old-age reserve (FOR) are at risk of a large tax bill because they do not set aside money for it, and whether the reserve should be tied to a requirement to save the funds separately. The State Secretary answered that about 300,000 entrepreneurs hold a FOR, that a high tax claim is possible on release, and that the government will propose abolishing the FOR from 2023 in the Tax Plan 2023.
As part of the Tax Plan 2023, it will be proposed to abolish the FOR.
Als onderdeel van het Belastingplan 2023 zal worden voorgesteld de FOR af te schaffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over de arbeidsparticipatie van blinden en slechtzienden

The MP asks the minister about the reported drop in employment among blind and visually impaired people, the need for specialist expertise, and the Zichtbaar in Werk pilot. The minister acknowledges the findings, describes the pilot and follow-up, and commits to a bill transferring work provisions for visually impaired people to UWV, to be submitted by end of year.
I aim to submit the bill to the House of Representatives by the end of this year.
Ik streef ernaar het wetsvoorstel eind dit jaar bij de Tweede Kamer in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Ginneken over het artikel 'Zo werd Myrthe Reuver de dupe van haar data: ‘Ze geloven in eerste instantie het systeem’'

MPs Kat and Van Ginneken asked the ministers about a newspaper report on credit assessments by credit-information bureaus based on general data, possibly including incorrect data from former residents, and about notification, objection, retention periods and BKR registrations. The government answered that such assessments on general data are undesirable, that incorrect data processing is unlawful, that GDPR rights apply, that the Dutch industry code sets an 8-year retention, and that the BKR retention period of five years is retained while a draft law on credit registration is prepared.
Processing incorrect personal data to arrive at the score is therefore unlawful.
Het verwerken van foutieve persoonsgegevens om tot de score te komen is dan ook onrechtmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport ‘Zelfstandigen over de drempel’ van de Nationale Ombudsman

MPs asked the minister about the Ombudsman's report on uneven debt-relief access for self-employed people across municipalities, and whether national government should enforce minimum standards and prepare for a post-COVID inflow of indebted entrepreneurs. The minister acknowledges the unevenness, says municipalities are responsible for implementation while the national government sets the framework, and promises further talks with VNG and a response letter before summer recess.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for organising debt assistance for self-employed entrepreneurs.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijke voor de inrichting van de schuldhulpverlening aan zelfstandig ondernemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Sneller over het artikel 'Rechters maken schulden van de zwakkeren juist erger'

MPs Kat and Sneller asked whether courts handle around 5,000 default debt collection judgments weekly, why debtors fail to appear, and what has been done with the Raad voor de rechtspraak's recommendations on debt cases. The minister says default judgments have fallen below that level, outlines reforms such as a planned legal basis for courts to impose payment arrangements, a debt officer pilot, lower court fees and a shorter good-faith test, and commits to further letters on cost stacking and experiments.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Kent en Alkaya over de compensatie voor de gestegen energie- en brandstofprijzen

SP MPs asked why the 120% of social minimum income test for the one-off energy allowance counts the single-parent supplement of the child-related budget as income while excluding the child budget itself, and questioned how income is defined and applied across municipalities. The minister explained that the child budget including the single-parent supplement is excluded from income under the Participatiewet, acknowledged that the concept of income is hard for citizens to grasp, and said municipalities have discretion in specialist assistance while the wage increase was not feasible in time.
For social assistance benefits, a supplement under the child-related budget is a benefit within the meaning of the General Act on Income-Dependent Schemes.
Voor bijstandsuitkeringen geldt dat een toeslag in het kader van het kindgebonden budget een tegemoetkoming is in de zin van de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Grinwis over de technische correcties van de CO2-doelen voor de glastuinbouwsector

MPs Valstar and Grinwis asked about technical corrections to CO2 emission ceilings for the greenhouse horticulture sector for 2018 to 2020, including delays and financial consequences. The ministers confirmed a correction for 2018 in line with the covenant criteria, said 2019 and 2020 ceilings would also be corrected and published, and committed to a new individual system and covenant 2021–2030.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kat over het artikel ‘Bewindvoerder steelt 160.000 euro van cliënten’

An MP asked the government about a court-appointed administrator (bewindvoerder) who embezzled client funds, including how many similar cases exist, how supervision and complaints worked, and how client recovery and quality rules are being tightened. The minister answered that three similar cases are known since 2019, that the administrator was suspended and dismissed promptly by the Limburg court once signals arose, and outlined existing supervision, criminal complaints, client damage recovery and ongoing reform of quality requirements.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over inflatie en de Wet toekomst pensioenen

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions how the extremely high 2022 inflation affects the Wet toekomst pensioenen, which was calibrated on stable inflation of about 2%, and requested scenario sets, calculations and transition effects. Minister Schouten answered that the new contract offers more inflation protection via the solidarity reserve, that transition effects are not expected to shift hundreds of billions, and that a commission of experts is developing new scenario sets, while deferring answers on the bill itself.
Given the complexity and technical nature of the questions, I informed your House on 30 March that I could not answer the questions before the Toekomst Pensioenen bill is submitted.
Gegeven de complexiteit en technische aard van de vragen heb ik uw Kamer 30 maart jl. laten weten de vragen niet voor indiening van het wetsvoorstel Toekomst Pensioenen te kunnen beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Palland over gebrek aan voortgang bij de unaniem aangenomen motie aanpak AOW-hiaat

MPs Van Kent (SP) and Palland (CDA) asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions why a unanimously adopted motion on compensating self-employed people affected by the AOW-gap has made no visible progress, and whether the initiators have been informed. The answer notes the questions were already answered during question hour on 19 April 2022, pointing to a separate reply rather than providing substance here.

The written questions from MP Van Kent (SP) to the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions on the lack of progress on the unanimously adopted motion on the AOW-gap were answered during question hour on 19 April 2022.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Kent (SP) aan de Minister voor Armoedebeleid, Participatie en Pensioenen over gebrek aan voortgang bij de unaniem aangenomen motie aanpak AOW-hiaat ( 2022Z03459 ) zijn beantwoord tijdens het vragenuur van 19 april 2022 ( 2022Z07752 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Romke de Jong over pensioenopbouw door zzp’ers

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Romke de Jong asked about pension accrual by self-employed workers (zzp'ers) during and after the coronavirus crisis, including the role of home equity as a pension provision, administrative burdens and withdrawal flexibility. Minister Schouten answered that the proposed Wetsvoorstel toekomst pensioenen raises the tax-facilitated savings room for the self-employed, that home equity is not designed as a pension provision and will not be promoted specifically, and that an experiment will ease access to second-pillar schemes.
The cabinet is of the view that pension accrual for self-employed workers will thereby be better facilitated.
Het kabinet is van mening dat pensioenopbouw voor zelfstandigen hierdoor beter wordt gefaciliteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Maatoug over werkenden zonder pensioenopbouw

MPs Van Dijk and Maatoug asked the minister about the roughly 936,000 employees without pensions (the 'white spot'), Wajong workers under loondispensatie, procurement conditions, and pension experiments for self-employed. The minister answered that data updates and a further CBS study are planned, that social partners' action plan is being pursued, that legal limits block pension requirements in public tenders, and that the experimental pension-saving rules for self-employed are being prepared within the pension reform bill.
I intend to have the next CBS study carried out with figures for 2022.
Ik ben voornemens om het volgende CBS-onderzoek te laten uitvoeren met cijfers over 2022
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over “compensatie hoge energierekening voor lagere inkomens”

An MP asks why low-income households have not yet received the energy price compensation, whether delays are causing debt, when municipalities will get funds, whether benefit recipients can receive it without deductions, and whether the enforceable minimum (beslagvrije voet) should be raised for higher energy costs. The minister outlines the bill and budget increase, encourages municipalities to pay early and points to individual special assistance, but gives no firm date and says the beslagvrije voet system is unchanged.
I have called on municipalities, in anticipation of the bill's entry into force, to already proceed to pay the one-off energy allowances.
Ik heb gemeenten opgeroepen vooruitlopend op de inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel al tot de betaling van de eenmalige energietoeslagen over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de financiële ondersteuning op de BES-eilanden van ouders met een zorgintensief kind

An MP asked the ministers why parents of children needing intensive care on the Caribbean Netherlands islands do not receive the double child benefit available in Europe, and whether this gap is justified. The minister acknowledged the gap, said a supplementary allowance is being worked out with implementation and legal aspects under study, and pointed to other ministries' measures on care and education.
I believe that an allowance for parents of children with intensive care needs must also be introduced in the Caribbean Netherlands.
Ik vind dat er ook een tegemoetkoming voor ouders van kinderen met een intensieve zorgbehoefte in Caribisch Nederland moet komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Smals over “het bericht dat UWV op illegale wijze wachtlijsten wegwerkt: uitkeringen worden verstrekt zonder de beoordeling van een arts”

MPs De Kort and Smals asked the minister whether UWV unlawfully granted disability benefits without medical assessment in a pilot to clear waiting lists, and what follow-up is planned. The minister called the pilot undesirable and not in line with the law, said UWV's board admitted the decision process went wrong, and promised to inform parliament by spring after an evaluation.
I find it undesirable that such pilots are started without my knowledge and that of your House.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat dergelijke proeven zonder mijn medeweten en dat van uw Kamer worden gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Romke de Jong over het bericht 'Aantal startende ondernemers 'nog steeds erg hoog''

MPs Kat and Romke de Jong asked how persons under debt restructuring, debt administration or guardianship can register as entrepreneurs at the Chamber of Commerce without consent, and how the Chamber checks this. The minister answers that unauthorised registration is not intended, that the Chamber checks authority and records only in doubtful cases, that no statistics are kept, and that the Chamber will update its information for vulnerable groups.
Such data are not kept, neither for the debt restructuring procedure nor for protective administration or guardianship.
Dergelijke gegevens worden niet bijgehouden, noch voor de schuldsaneringsprocedure, noch voor het beschermingsbewind of de curatele.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over werken zonder loon en verdringing van betaalde arbeid bij WerkSaam

An SP MP asked the minister about FNV allegations of unpaid work and displacement of paid jobs at the social development company WerkSaam, and about the financial incentives behind such schemes. The minister answered that municipalities bear responsibility for supervising these companies, that a Berenschot study commissioned by motion is nearly finished, that the Labour Inspectorate investigates only sector-level risks, and that the government will share the findings and a Divosa handreiking with municipalities.
It is therefore for the mayors and aldermen and municipal councils to make statements about the functioning of individual social development companies.
Het is daarom aan de colleges van burgemeester en wethouders en gemeenteraden om uitspraken te doen over het functioneren van individuele sociaal ontwikkelbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over problemen bij beslag op minimumuitkeringen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked whether minimum benefit recipients are left below subsistence when enforcement agents collect small positive differences after indexation, and how often this happens. The minister replied that borrowers can ask for the protected allowance to be recalculated after a structural income change, that the issue will be reviewed in the evaluation of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet in 2022/2023, and that the suggested legislative fixes are not adequate.
A citizen, but also their debt assistant or protective administrator, can ask the enforcing parties to recalculate the protected allowance after a structural change in their circumstances.

Een burger, maar ook diens schuldhulpverlener of beschermingsbewindvoerder, kan bij een structurele wijziging van zijn omstandigheden de beslagleggende partijen vragen om de beslagvrije voet opnieuw vast te stellen.
Antwoord op van het lid Kat over het artikel ‘Ik ben drie jaar van mijn leven verloren’

An MP asks the Minister for Poverty Policy about reports that PLANgroep, a debt-relief provider contracted by municipalities, delayed help and mishandled cases, and about how municipalities can oversee and correct contractors. The minister says municipalities hold the information and oversight tools, that the quality framework is adequate, and that municipalities must handle the problems with PLANgroep.
The municipalities that engaged PLANgroep for debt relief know how many people have been affected. The national government has no information on this.
De gemeenten die PLANgroep hebben ingeschakeld voor schuldhulpverlening weten hoeveel mensen zijn getroffen. De rijksoverheid heeft hierover geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de bescherming van het koraal tegen de zandstorting van het Chogogo Dive and Beach Resort op Bonaire

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked ministers about a sand dumping project by Chogogo resort on Bonaire that allegedly lacked a permit and damaged coral, including a verbal tolerance decision and an unpaid penalty. The government answered that a natural permit was belatedly granted in January 2022 with conditions, that the island authority is responsible for enforcement and collecting the penalty, and that enforcement programmes will be strengthened, though impacts on coral are still unknown.
The public body is responsible for this.
Het openbaar lichaam is hiervoor verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over onrecht in de bijstand

MP Gijs van Dijk asks the Minister for Poverty Policy and Participation about injustice in social assistance (bijstand): giving exemptions, home visits, water-use evidence, administrative duties, the vague duty to report changes, labelling people as fraudsters, and the mandatory recovery of overpayments. The Minister answers that municipalities have discretion within the law, that a broader review of the means rules and an overall policy plan are underway, and that no legal definition of fraud is planned, while committing to address some issues in the policy review.
I have no insight into the number of unannounced home visits that municipalities carry out.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de aantallen onaangekondigde huisbezoeken die gemeenten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat en Podt over het artikel 'Zorgwekkende’ cijfers uit achterstandswijken: ‘Schrok van armoede onder de Syriërs’'

Two MPs asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about reports that Syrian status holders face high poverty and debt yet rarely use debt relief, and about DUO loan forgiveness, debt rescheduling and support measures. The Minister answered that loans are forgiven if integration obligations are met, partial forgiveness applies in case of late completion, debt restructuring loans are available, and that the government will work with municipalities on earlier debt support and a debt-policy programme due in 2022.
It is difficult to answer this question because we do not have specific information about it.
Het is lastig een antwoord te geven op deze vraag, omdat wij hier geen specifieke informatie over hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over chaos bij budgetbeheer Plangroep

An MP asked the minister about chaos at budget manager Plangroep, including unreachability, late payment of living allowances, and failure to pay client bills, and about gas/water/electricity disconnection rules, municipal responsibility, and quality control of budget managers. The minister acknowledged serious errors, said municipalities and Plangroep are fixing them and compensating clients, and pointed to existing rules and the Kwaliteitskader, but declined to provide the number of clients or municipalities involved.
I do not have the information to answer this question. Municipalities have the task of providing debt assistance to residents of the municipality.
Ik heb niet de informatie om deze vraag te beantwoorden. Gemeenten hebben de taak om schuldhulpverlening aan de inwoners van de gemeente te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over arbeidsongeschikte mensen in de bijstand

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about long-term sick people on social assistance with no prospect of work, their restrictions on gifts, savings and household income, and whether a new safety net for them is possible. The minister said the Participation Act evaluation shows many beneficiaries cannot work, cited CBS figures, defended the safety-net character of assistance, and promised a policy plan in spring 2022 and review of hardships in the WIA.
In the spring I want to send your House a policy plan presenting the first outcomes of this process, including reconsiderations regarding the safety-net character of the law.

In het voorjaar wil ik uw Kamer een beleidsplan doen toekomen, waarin ik de eerste uitkomsten van dit traject met daarbij ook de heroverwegingen met betrekking tot het vangnetkarakter van de wet, wil presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Bisschop over de procedure bij een geconstateerde overtreding door de NVWA met betrekking tot dierenwelzijn

MPs Van der Plas and Bisschop asked the minister how the NVWA follows up detected animal welfare violations, including delays of months before fines are announced, fine escalation and inconsistent inspection. The minister explains the two-step procedure, says steps have been taken to shorten delays and says the fine system will be evaluated.
The NVWA does not keep this data in this way.
De NVWA houdt deze gegevens niet op deze wijze bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de plannen tot halvering van de jonggehandicaptenkorting

An SP MP asked whether the cabinet still plans to halve the young disabled persons' tax credit (jonggehandicaptenkorting) to 415 euro by 2025, arguing it increases inequality and poverty for Wajong recipients, and asked the government to drop it. The minister answered that the decision will be taken in the spring budget process based on the CPB forecast, that minimum wage increases will pass through to Wajong benefits, and that she invited activist Anne Houtsma to discuss her experiences with the ministry.
The cabinet will make a final decision on the young disabled persons' tax credit during the spring budget decision-making.
Het kabinet neemt een definitief besluit over de jonggehandicaptenkorting tijdens de voorjaarsbesluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Gemeenteraad besluit over individuele studietoeslag en bouwplan ROC Mondriaan in Leidschenveen'

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions whether municipalities may no longer deviate from harmonised national individual study allowance amounts from 1 April 2022, and about transitional rules, budget effects and the removal of the youth norm. The minister replied that national age-based amounts are being set by AMvB, that existing higher allowances are protected for their duration, that the youth norm link is retained for allowance design, and that budget effects cannot be precisely estimated.
The national government does not collect information on the amount of the individual study allowance in individual municipalities.
De rijksoverheid verzamelt geen informatie over de hoogte van de individuele studietoeslag in afzonderlijke gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga, Ephraim en Smolders over juridisch bindende overeenkomsten met het World Economic Forum en aanverwante zaken

MPs Van Haga, Ephraim and Smolders asked whether the government has binding agreements with the World Economic Forum and whether Parliament can inspect them. The minister confirmed binding implementation agreements and grants under Dutch law, said the subsidy decisions are attached, and stated that the WEF is a private Swiss foundation and that the agreements fall within the budget Parliament approves.
Annex 3 contains the subsidy decisions issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to the WEF.
In de bijlage 3 treft u de aan het WEF verstrekte subsidiebeschikkingen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Mogelijk grote rol voor zonne-energie op de Noordzee'

An MP asked the government about TNO research and pilots for solar energy on the North Sea, its alignment with the Routekaart Zon op water, ecological effects and possible tenders combining wind and solar. The government answered that ecological effects are not yet known, that only small pilots exist, that NWO research and monitoring are planned, and that it will discuss the matter in the Noordzeeoverleg.
There is still much unknown about the ecological effects of solar energy on water.
Er is nog veel onbekend over de ecologische effecten van zon op water.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bontenbal over CO2-levering aan de glastuinbouw

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked why the Amsterdam waste-energy company AEB chose CCS without supplying captured CO2 to greenhouse horticulture, and what barriers and government role exist for CO2 supply and combined CCS/CCU. The minister acknowledges the choice, says the sector needs about 2.5 Mton externally sourced CO2 and that the SDE++ and CO2 allocation pilot still have flexibility and legal-clarity barriers, while committing to a new convenant and a possible roadmap before summer.
If necessary, agreements can also be made there to draw up a roadmap. We will come back to this before the summer.
Zo nodig kunnen daar ook afspraken in worden gemaakt om roadmap op te stellen. Hier komen we voor de zomer op terug.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het artikel 'Stikstofnormen boerensloten veel strenger in Nederland'

MP Edgar Mulder asked the minister whether nutrient standards for farm ditches in the Netherlands are stricter than in Germany and Belgium, whether cross-border river inflows drive exceedances, and whether an impact analysis would be sent to parliament. The minister answered that standards are set per water type and are mid-range internationally, that cross-border influence varies by region and is addressed in river commissions, and saw no need for an additional impact analysis.
I therefore see no need for an additional impact analysis.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak tot een extra impactanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de registratie van geitenlammetjes

The MP Vestering asked whether the seven-day registration duty for goat kids since 1 November 2020 is enforced and asked for mortality and inspection figures. The Minister confirms the duty, explains that late registrations are flagged but not verifiable for accuracy, reports 319 holdings with late registrations, and promises to answer the mortality questions in April 2022.
Based on the notification of a birth in the I&R system, it is not possible to check the accuracy of the stated birth date.
Op basis van de melding van een geboorte in het I&R-systeem is geen controle mogelijk op de juistheid van de opgegeven geboortedatum.
