Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de plannen van dierentuinen om gorilla’s te doden

An MP asks the minister whether EAZA plans to cull, castrate or solitarily house male gorillas and whether Dutch zoos, which are EAZA members, would do so, and asks the minister to oppose such practices. The minister says Dutch EAZA zoos have no plans to kill or isolate male gorillas, calls prolonged solitary housing unacceptable, and points to ongoing NVD research into alternatives, without committing to a new formal step.
There are seven zoos in the Netherlands that are EAZA members and keep gorillas.
Er zijn zeven dierentuinen in Nederland die lid zijn van EAZA en die gorilla’s houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over de berichten 'Vogelgriepuitbraken ondanks ophokplicht, strop pluimveesector dreigt» en «Europa kampt met zwaarste vogelgriepuitbraak ooit'

MP Van Campen asked the minister about rising avian influenza outbreaks despite the housing order, how infections enter farms, enforcement and reporting of dead wild birds, the case for regional lifting of the housing order, vaccination, free-range egg labelling, and the EU animal health regulation. The minister answered that transmission is mainly via wild birds, that enforcement is by sampling with written warnings so far, that a new risk assessment by the expert group will be requested, and that vaccination and free-range egg rules are under consideration.
I am asking the expert group for a new risk assessment in the short term.
Ik vraag de deskundigengroep op korte termijn om een nieuwe risicobeoordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over zwendelkruiden

An MP asked the state secretary and minister whether herb mixes containing very little actual herb, and high salt and sugar, amount to consumer deception and what steps will be taken. The minister replied that the labels comply with EU food information rules, that producers should be transparent, that a review of enforceable product-improvement agreements is underway, and that the Warenwet adequately protects consumer perception.
I am currently having an official exploration carried out into options to make agreements on product improvement legally enforceable, should this be desirable in the future.
Ook laat ik momenteel een ambtelijke verkenning uitvoeren naar opties om afspraken over productverbetering ook juridisch afdwingbaar te maken, mocht dit in de toekomst wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het rapport 'Ecosystem effects of large upscaling of offshore wind on the North Sea'

An MP asks the minister about a report finding ecosystem effects of large-scale offshore wind on the North Sea, and about accountability, cumulative assessment, international cooperation, cables, and mitigation. The minister answers that cumulative effects are considered at each planning and permitting stage, that responsibility is divided among ministries and Rijkswaterstaat, and that further research (Wozep, MONS, ElasmoPower) is underway.

It is now important to gain more insight into these effects in time. For this reason, follow-up research is already planned within the Wozep and the Programme Monitoring and Research Nature Restoration and Species Protection (MONS).

Het is nu van belang om tijdig nog meer inzicht te krijgen in deze effecten. Daarom is al vervolgonderzoek voorzien in het kader van het Wozep en het Programma Monitoring en Onderzoek Natuurherstel en Soortenbescherming (MONS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Bromet over het bericht 'Treinverkeer in Nederland heeft last van slappe bodem'

MPs Bouchallikh and Bromet asked the government about rail track stability on soft peat soils and whether it can keep up with frequency and climate ambitions. The state secretary replied that ProRail is studying baanstabiliteit and climate adaptation, with results expected in 2022, but gave no commitment to new funding.
Maintenance of the railway is of great importance.
Het onderhoud van het spoor is van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Oost-Brabant m.b.t. de kolencentrale Geertruidenberg en MOB

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about a district court ruling on the Geertruidenberg coal plant and MOB, questioning whether nitrogen rights and offsetting are still valid and what the ruling means for other projects and for Schiphol. The Minister declined to comment on the specific ruling under appeal, said the provinces and government are examining the consequences of latent permit space, and promised to share that exploration after the summer.
I do not consider it opportune to comment on the ruling in this specific case, against which the province of Noord-Brabant has lodged an appeal.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om commentaar te leveren op de uitspraak in deze specifieke zaak, waartegen de provincie Noord-Brabant hoger beroep heeft ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'GLB-steun voor kalverhouders'

MP Van der Plas asks whether the EUR 60 million pledged in 2014 to make veal farming more sustainable has been spent, whether EUR 30 million remains owed to the sector, and whether the money will reach farms and deadlines be extended. The minister replies that EUR 50 million has been allocated, a final EUR 10 million scheme is forthcoming, unspent EU funds return to the EU rather than the state, and no general deadline extension is planned, only individual extensions.
I will inform your House of the outlines of the subsidy scheme and the conditions attached to it once more is known about it.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de contouren van de subsidieregeling en de randvoorwaarden daarbij, wanneer daar meer over bekend is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over mogelijke verwarring die recent is ontstaan op een antwoord op eerdere vragen over het karakter van, en de relaties van kabinetsleden met, het World Economic Forum (WEF

An MP asked whether the minister's role in the World Economic Forum was clarified after confusion arose over a cabinet answer, and requested an overview of WEF meetings and initiatives the minister attended, with documentation. The minister replied that the Rutte III minister never attended a WEF meeting, the ministry is involved in WEF-initiated Food Innovation Hubs, and additional documentation was attached.
The Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (Rutte III) has never attended a meeting of the World Economic Forum (WEF).
De Minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (LNV) (Rutte III) is nooit bij een bijeenkomst van het World Economic Forum (WEF) geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht 'Stop op boorvergunningen moet einde tijdperk olie en gas inluiden'

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked whether the government will coordinate with Germany and Denmark on Wadden Sea World Heritage management, the UNESCO letter, and a joint halt to fossil extraction there. The minister said the trilateral conference is planned for late 2022, the UNESCO reply was coordinated with partners, and she is willing to explore extending the coalition's no-new-licences ambition to the trilateral Wadden Sea.

I am willing to explore together with Germany and Denmark whether the coalition agreement's ambition to issue no new gas extraction licences under the Wadden Sea after the Ternaard procedure is completed can also apply to the trilateral Wadden Sea.

Ik ben bereid om samen met Duitsland en Denemarken te verkennen of de ambitie uit het coalitieakkoord 2 om na afronding van de procedure voor Ternaard geen nieuwe vergunningen voor gaswinning onder de Waddenzee af te geven ook kan gelden voor de trilaterale Waddenzee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over het bericht 'Risico’s gaswinning onder Waddenzee vanuit Ternaard onvoldoende onderzocht'

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Boucke (D66) asked the minister about reports that the environmental impact assessment for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea from Ternaard was incomplete, and whether a permit could lawfully be granted, including compensation and UNESCO/IUCN issues. The minister answered that the NAM was asked to supplement the MER, that the advice and objections will be weighed before a decision expected in March 2022, and that no new IUCN advice is needed, but she declined to pre-judge the permit decision or any compensation liability.
Following the advice of the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment (m.e.r.), the previous Minister of EZK and my predecessor asked the NAM to supplement the Environmental Impact Report (MER)

Naar aanleiding van het advies van de Commissie voor de milieueffectrapportage (m.e.r.) hebben de vorige Minister van EZK en mijn voorganger de NAM verzocht om de Milieueffectrapportage (MER) aan te vullen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over bedrijven die nauwelijks gecontroleerd worden op milieudelicten

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether companies are hardly inspected or fined for environmental offences, how often omgevingsdiensten should visit polluting firms, and about ammonia emissions by cacao factory Cargill Aurora in Zaandam that were not reported to the RIVM for 2010-2018. The State Secretary answered that inspection frequency is risk-based, that the Landelijke Handhavingsstrategie and the VTH reform are being used, that Cargill's unreported emissions were discovered in 2019 and are being addressed through a planned last onder dwangsom, and that the omission does not create new nitrogen effects.

I find this a worrying conclusion, and it was partly the reason for my predecessor to inform you, in the letter on strengthening the VTH system, about the actions planned to follow up the recommendations of the Van Aartsen committee.

Dit vind ik een zorgwekkende conclusie en het is voor mijn voorganger mede aanleiding geweest om u met de Kamerbrief versterking VTH-stelsel 5 te informeren over de acties die worden voorzien om de aanbevelingen van de commissie Van Aartsen op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over ammoniakuitstoot van het bedrijf Aurora (onderdeel van Cargill) in Zaandam

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether a Cargill subsidiary's undisclosed ammonia emissions in Zaandam were a sign of gaps in emission reporting and enforcement, and what consequences and actions followed. The answers say the regional environmental service knew of the emissions, that a possible emission-norm breach for one sub-process is under a pending enforcement order, and that the reporting system relies on self-reporting with sampling checks plus a correction mechanism, with improvements planned.

As previously stated in the answer to question 5 from the D66 faction, the Noordzeekanaalgebied environmental service was aware of the ammonia emissions by Cargill Aurora and these are also permitted under certain conditions.

Zoals eerder bij het antwoord op vraag 5 van de D66-fractie aangeven was de omgevingsdienst Noordzeekanaalgebied op de hoogte van de uitstoot van ammoniak door Cargill Aurora en is deze ook toegestaan onder bepaalde voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over ammoniakuitstoot van het bedrijf Aurora (onderdeel van Cargill) in Zaandam

An MP asked how the cocoa industry's ammonia emissions are regulated, whether it is included in the structural nitrogen approach, and whether underestimated industrial ammonia emissions could explain the RIVM model correction. The state secretary answered that a 30 mg/Nm3 emission limit applies via the Activiteitenbesluit, that a tightening to 5 mg/Nm3 is expected in 2026 under the new BAL, and that industry's contribution is too small to explain the model correction.

The RIVM does not expect that industrial ammonia emissions are a possible underlying cause of the correction to the nitrogen calculation models related to the spatial calibration based on measurement data.

Het RIVM verwacht niet dat de industriële ammoniakuitstoot een mogelijke onderliggende oorzaak is van de correctie van de stikstofrekenmodellen in verband met de ruimtelijke kalibratie op basis van meetgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer: ‘waar is de grutto?’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether the Court of Audit's finding that meadow bird policy failed, with grutto numbers still declining, justifies that conclusion, and how ANLb subsidies will be kept effective. The minister acknowledged the report, rejected the 'failed policy' conclusion while accepting that results have not yet reversed the decline, and pointed to monitoring and a 2023 ecological evaluation without committing to new structural changes.
I do not share this conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel 'Vogelgriep grijpt heftiger dan ooit om zich heen’

MP Tjeerd de Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports of more severe bird flu symptoms, whether dead birds are cleared by municipalities and provinces, and related measures and cross-border comparisons. The minister answered that severity claims cannot be confirmed, that research and a joint protocol are underway, that responsibility depends on location, and that Dutch infection levels are not clearly out of line with other countries.
I do not recognise this picture.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel 'Midden in de stikstofcrisis maakt het kabinet het in sommige gebieden juist makkelijker stikstof uit te stoten'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a newspaper report that the 25-kilometre maximum calculation distance for nitrogen deposition creates zones without permit requirements and may weaken scrutiny of large polluting projects. The minister answered that the release of the updated AERIUS Calculator is delayed to 13 January 2022, that the 25-km limit does not create permit-free zones, and that additional mitigation measures and individual permit conditions are being examined.
No, that is not correct. If there are no nitrogen aspects, a nature permit may still be required because of other aspects such as disturbance.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Als er geen stikstofaspecten zijn, kan een natuurvergunning alsnog aan de orde zijn vanwege andere aspecten zoals bijvoorbeeld verstoring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over duisternis en stilte

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked the government about protecting darkness and quiet (light and noise pollution), the number and loss of quiet areas, and hunting in them. The Minister answered that darkness and quiet are recognised as important, that protection relies on existing law and provincial competence, that about 14,000 hectares of land quiet area were lost net, and that no new national rules are planned.
The cabinet is currently not intending to draw up new, additional rules on this, partly because of its caretaker status.
Het kabinet is op dit moment, mede vanwege zijn demissionaire status, niet voornemens hierover nieuwe, aanvullende regels op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van der Lee over hoe Nederlandse vlees-, zuivel- en veevoerbedrijven ontbossing, landroof en corruptie stimuleren

MPs Teunissen and Van der Lee asked how Dutch meat, dairy and feed companies contribute to deforestation, land grabbing and corruption via soy supply chains, and whether soy traceability, certification and due diligence are adequate. The minister answers that OESO guidelines do not require full supply-chain transparency, that mixed trade models make soy origin hard to trace, that certification has been effective, and that mandatory IMVO legislation is planned but left to a new cabinet.
The cabinet therefore welcomes the European Commission's proposed law to keep products, including soy, linked to deforestation and forest degradation off the European market.

Het kabinet verwelkomt daarom dat er nu een voorstel van wet van de Europese Commissie voorligt om producten, waaronder soja, van de Europese markt te weren die gerelateerd zijn aan ontbossing en bosdegradatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over de gedragscode natuurbeheer

An MP asked the minister about the lapsing Gedragscode Natuurbeheer, its consequences for nature management, and interim measures to avoid extra burdens. The minister confirmed the code expires 19 December 2021, said the new code is under assessment with a six-week consultation required, and said talks with the provinces and LNV are ongoing on handling exemptions.
The VBNE is currently consulting with the IPO and LNV on how exemption granting can proceed quickly and adequately in the period until approval of the new code.
De VBNE voert op dit moment overleg met het IPO en LNV over de wijze waarop de ontheffingverlening in de periode tot goedkeuring van de nieuwe gedragscode snel en adequaat kan verlopen.
Antwoord op de vragen het lid Van der Plas over ontbossing in Brazilië en de link naar een Nederlands diervoeder

An MP asked the agriculture minister about a Zembla broadcast linking Brazilian deforestation to Dutch animal feed, and whether Dutch certified soy is truly exceptional and whether full segregation would harm the sector. The minister acknowledged the facts, declined to confirm that Dutch feed is uniquely fully certified, rejected full segregation as unworkable while noting its costs, and referred the EU deforestation policy question to a forthcoming BNC-fiche.
Whether the Netherlands is therefore the only country in the world where all soy used is certified sustainable, I cannot confirm.
Of Nederland daarmee het enige land ter wereld is waar alle gebruikte soja duurzaam gecertificeerd is, kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de uitbreiding van zeker 360 veehouderijen te midden van de natuurcrisis

An MP asks the minister whether at least 360 livestock farms have been allowed to expand since the 2019 PAS ruling via internal netting despite nature crisis, and whether unreliable technical measures and the 678 million euro reserve make this policy effective. The minister answers that no overview exists of farms actually expanded, that the effectiveness of low-emission stables is under study with results expected in 2022, and that the structural approach and any further policy choices are for the next cabinet.
There is no overview, either with me or with the provinces, of the number of businesses that have actually expanded.
Er is geen overzicht, bij mij en bij provincies, over het aantal bedrijven dat daadwerkelijk is uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel 'Vogelgriep bij pluimveebedrijf in Tzum, ruim 122.000 kuikens afgemaakt'

Parliamentary questions from MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of Agriculture about risk assessments, bird flu monitoring, costs, rules on hatching eggs, and delays in publishing the avian influenza protocol. The minister answered that no new risk assessment was made in September but one was requested in October, that the H5N1 strain is genetically new, that a review will occur only after the 2021-2022 season, that the protocol will be published in early 2022, and that compensation for lost free-range egg income is not given under current policy.
In September the expert group did not make an additional risk assessment for highly pathogenic avian influenza.
In september heeft de deskundigengroep geen (aanvullende) risicobeoordeling gemaakt voor hoogpathogene vogelgriep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over de beoordeling van de European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) van noodtoepassingen van neonicotinoïden op suikerbieten in 2020/2021

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the Netherlands did not grant emergency derogations for neonicotinoid pesticides on sugar beet in 2020 and 2021 when eleven other EU member states did, and whether this put Dutch farmers at a competitive disadvantage. The Minister replied that granting derogations is a member state competence, that the NVWA and Ctgb advised negatively on the applications, that alternative non-neonicotinoid derogations were granted instead, and that a sector research project seeking alternatives is under subsidy consideration.
I have therefore entered into consultation with the sector to look for solutions that fit within the principles of integrated crop protection and within my Future Vision Crop Protection 2030.
Ik ben daarom met de sector in overleg gegaan om te zoeken naar oplossingen die passen binnen de principes van geïntegreerde gewasbescherming en binnen mijn Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het plaatsen van honingbijkasten in de nabijheid van natuurgebieden

An MP from the Animal Party asked the minister whether beekeeping near nature areas and Natura 2000 sites, which may compete with wild pollinators, requires policy, permits, passing assessments, buffer zones or a registry. The minister acknowledged competition risks but declined new national policy for now, citing regional responsibility, lack of registration data, and planned research and a registry from 2023.
I am willing to enter into discussion with land-managing organisations and beekeepers' associations on this matter
Ik ben wel bereid om hierover het gesprek aan te gaan met terreinbeherende organisaties en bijenhoudersverenigingen
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over ‘Foute’ soja in duurzaam veevoer

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about RTRS soy credits used in Dutch livestock feed, deforestation risks, and EU consumer guarantees. The minister answered that RTRS is an effective instrument, that about 69% of soy used in feed is deforestation-free, and pointed to the EU deforestation regulation proposal and national sustainability efforts.
I cannot confirm the figures you have stated.
Ik kan de door u aangegeven cijfers niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Biodiversiteitstop worstelt met vage doelen en beloften'

MP Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the minister about a report that the biodiversity summit was struggling with vague goals, Nizza commitments, the Aichi targets being largely missed, and how Dutch positions and follow-up monitoring would ensure implementation. Minister Schouten answered that Dutch positions are set at EU level and reflect the High Ambition Coalition's 30% target, that stronger monitoring and reporting will be pushed in the new framework, and that implementation of CBD agreements will be assessed after COP-15's second part.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de sterfte en slacht van geitenlammetjes binnen een week na hun geboorte

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the reported slaughter of goat kids under one week old, the reliability of the I&R registration system, and whether the government will act on a parliamentary motion for a plan against kid mortality. The minister says the data cannot establish the scale or fraud with certainty, points to shared responsibility of slaughterhouses and goat keepers, and promises monitoring and an analysis of 2021 mortality figures by April 2022.
It is not known how many kids in the period mentioned in question 1 were transported for destruction.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel bokjes in de periode zoals genoemd in vraag 1 voor destructie zijn afgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de export van dolfijnen naar een pretpark in China

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the export of dolphins, walruses and sea lions from the Dolfinarium to a Chinese amusement park, covering permits, inspections, the scope of the animal-welfare check under Article 4.11, sales proceeds, resale risks and breeding. The Minister answers that the Dutch rules apply to the transfer, that the RVO assesses the information provided, that the Dolfinarium is not required to produce a separate report, that conditions in China fall outside Dutch jurisdiction, and that the Dolfinarium does not currently intend to breed.
I see no objection in advance to sharing the relevant documents with your House in due course.
Ik zie op voorhand geen bezwaar om de desbetreffende stukken te zijner tijd met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de Nederlandse bijdrage aan het plan van het World Economic Forum voor een wereldwijde voedseltransitie

An MP asked the government about the Netherlands' role in a World Economic Forum plan for a global food transition, including WEF partnerships, the Global Coordinating Secretariat in the Netherlands, and financial contributions. The minister answered that no such WEF plan is known to the cabinet, that WEF partnerships are legally binding agreements, and that many details (funding, staffing, accountability) were referred to attached documents rather than stated in the answer.
The cabinet is not aware of any WEF plan for a global food transition.
Er is bij het kabinet geen plan van het WEF voor een wereldwijde voedseltransitie bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de Zembla-aflevering waaruit blijkt dat de verkoop van orka Morgan gebaseerd was op leugens

MP Wassenberg asked the minister whether the export of orca Morgan to Loro Parque, based on alleged dishonesty by the Dolfinarium, breached export conditions and welfare rules, and what would be done about it and about the planned transfer of twelve animals to a Chinese park. Minister Schouten answered that the EU certificate was lawfully issued (confirmed by the Council of State), that Morgan's welfare is regrettable but the Netherlands no longer has jurisdiction, and that any complaint about Spanish use must go to Spanish authorities; she declined to suspend the Hainan transfer, citing separate procedures.
Unfortunately, after the transfer of the orca to Loro Parque, the Netherlands no longer has jurisdiction over the animal.
Helaas heeft Nederland na de overdracht van de orka aan Loro Parque geen rechtsmacht meer ten aanzien van het dier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over belemmeringen die spelen bij opkoopregelingen in het kader van de stikstofaanpak

An MP asked why the provincial buy-out scheme for farms near vulnerable nature in Zuid-Holland, with a 2 mol nitrogen threshold and a no-relocation condition, is leaving its national budget largely unspent, since farmers wishing to exit are elsewhere and farmers near nature are not interested. The minister acknowledged the scheme's conditions limit flexibility, said a second tranche is exploring relocation with substantial emission reduction, and committed to working with Zuid-Holland on a pilot area-based project.
The periodic progress reports and my conversations with the provinces show that some conditions of the scheme limit the room for manoeuvre in practice.
Uit de periodieke voortgangrapportages en uit mijn gesprekken met de provincies blijkt wel dat een aantal voorwaarden van de regeling de speelruimte in de praktijk beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Valstar over de berichten ‘Dode en gewonde schapen in Vlijmen, waarschijnlijk door wolf’ en ‘Duitsland pleit voor intensievere jacht op wolf’

Two VVD MPs asked the agriculture minister about reports of sheep killed by wolves in Vlijmen, calls for more farmer support, compensation levels, the 2023 end of the compensation scheme, and hunting wolves as in Germany. The minister replied that prevention is primary, the existing compensation procedure is adequate, attack figures rise with wolf numbers, the scheme is extended to 2022 pending a new wolf plan, and lethal culling has little proven effect.
The coming year will therefore focus on more information and communication about the wolf in the Netherlands and on prevention methods.
Het komende jaar zal daarom worden ingezet op meer voorlichting en communicatie over de wolf in Nederland en over preventiemethoden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de vernieuwde toelating van het hormoonverstorende landbouwgif cypermethrin die wordt besproken tijdens de vergadering van het SCoPAFF van 21 en 22 oktober

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why cypermethrin, a pesticide alleged to be hormone-disrupting, is being re-approved, citing independent studies and the stricter 2018 criteria. The Minister answers that current evidence shows no hormone-disrupting properties, that the producer must supply missing data within two years, and that the Ctgb and the Dutch delegation will not change their position.
The publications of Singh et al. (2020) and Wang et al. (2021) will be brought to the attention of the rapporteur Member State Belgium.
De publicaties van Singh et al. (2020) en Wang et al. (2021) zullen onder de aandacht worden gebracht van de rapporterende lidstaat België

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de Regeling ten behoeve van de gerichte opkoop van veehouderijen ter vermindering van de stikstofdepositie op overbelaste stikstofgevoelige Natura-2000 gebieden, zoals toe

MP Van der Plas asks whether the buy-out scheme for livestock farms near overburdened Natura 2000 areas has changed from nitrogen reduction to permanent farm closure, and why the ban on relocating farmers was retained despite earlier agreement to drop it. The minister answers that the goal remains structural nitrogen reduction, that permanent closure is a means to that end, and that a second tranche relaxing the relocation ban is still being explored.

Progress and effects of the source and nature-restoration measures of the Nitrogen Reduction and Nature Improvement Programme, including the buy-out schemes, will be reported every two years, first in 2023.

Over de voortgang en gevolgen van de bron- en natuurherstelmaatregelen van het Programma Stikstofreductie en Natuurverbetering, waaronder de opkoopregelingen, wordt iedere twee jaar gerapporteerd, voor het eerst in 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht 'Honderden veehouderijen bij natuurgebieden mogen toch uitbreiden'

An MP asked the Minister whether farms near nature areas have expanded and added nitrogen emissions, and whether low-emission stable measures are less effective than expected and legally sound. The minister answered that there is no overview of expansions because internal use of already-permitted emission space needs no new permit, that the legal certainty of existing permits is safeguarded, that a CBS/CDM study and provinces' appeal against court rulings are pending, and that she is willing to talk with provinces about fairness for farmers acting in good faith.
There is no overview, either with me or with the provinces, of the number of farms that have actually expanded.
Er is geen overzicht, bij mij en bij provincies, over het aantal bedrijven dat daadwerkelijk is uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over de brief van UNESCO inzake de voorgenomen gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

Three MPs asked whether UNESCO had sent a letter on protecting the Wadden Sea and possible gas extraction beneath it, and whether it could be shared with a cabinet appraisal. The State Secretary confirmed UNESCO letters of 7 May and 30 November 2021, said the Ternaard gas production is assessed under UNESCO principles with a decision expected in March 2022, and that the cabinet plans to reply to UNESCO in January 2022.
The cabinet intends to send a letter to UNESCO with a response in January 2022.
Het kabinet is voornemens om in januari 2022 een brief te sturen aan UNESCO met een reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over interne analyses en afwegingen aangaande de gaswinning Ternaard en de aanleg van een elektrische stroomkabel onder de Wadden

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked about internal legal assessments, public consultation, and the Ternaard gas extraction and Wadden cable routing. The minister answered that the internal legal review underlying the draft decisions was shared, that the Landsadvocaat was not consulted beforehand to avoid exposing litigation strategy, and that the cable landing decision is being pursued jointly with other projects.

The government, like any other litigating party, must be able to speak freely with the lawyer representing it in (future) court proceedings, without the risk that advice given in that context becomes public.

De overheid moet, net als elke andere procespartij, vrijelijk kunnen spreken met de advocaat die haar vertegenwoordigt in (toekomstige) rechterlijke procedures, zonder het risico dat adviezen die in dat verband worden gegeven openbaar worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over de productie en export van zeer schadelijke landbouwgiffen die in Nederland verboden zijn

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked whether pesticides banned in the EU but exported from the Netherlands, and residues of them on imported food, should be stopped and whether MRLs should be set at zero. The minister reported about 16,000 tonnes of chemicals exported outside the EU in 2018 and noted that other countries set their own rules, that the Commission plans green diplomacy and to reconsider import tolerances, and that MRLs cannot automatically be set to the detection limit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over zieke dieren die alsnog op transport gaan

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the NVWA allowing sick and injured pigs and cattle to be transported to foreign slaughterhouses, and about enforcement, reporting figures, the sector transport protocol, camera supervision and the intervention ladder. The minister answered that the NVWA registers all reports, that the sector bears primary responsibility, that reports have been counted, that a protocol was agreed and camera supervision and the intervention policy are being considered, but gave no concrete new enforcement measures beyond periodic updates.
I will inform your House about the state of compliance with the transport regulation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de stand van zaken van de naleving van de transportverordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Wassenberg over de subsidieaanvraag van de Koning voor het beheer van het Kroondomein

MPs Wassenberg and Sneller asked the minister about the King's subsidy application for managing the Het Loo crown estate, including whether it could circumvent the 358-day public opening requirement and which parcels and hectares were covered. The minister answered that the application is the King's responsibility, that the opening conditions apply to nature-subsidy areas with limited exceptions, and that the application has been published on the estate's website.
It is up to the King (the estate's steward) to complete the subsidy application.
Het is aan (de rentmeester van) de Koning om de subsidieaanvraag in te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over de jachtakte van prinses Amalia voor het beheer van het Kroondomein

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether Princess Amalia obtained a hunting certificate, whether an exception to the minimum age was made, and whether this relates to management of the Crown Estate and a subsidy request. The minister answered that she obtained a hunting diploma (not a hunting licence), that no exception was made, and that there is no link between the diploma, the subsidy request and management of the Crown Estate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Erkens over het bericht 'Gerberakweker Simon stopt acuut vanwege torenhoge gasprijs: ‘Het is niet meer te betalen’'

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a flower grower stopping production due to high gas prices and what support glasshouse growers could get. The minister said problems are limited to a small number of firms, prices are expected to fall, a tax cut for 2022 is proposed, and no additional compensation is planned for now.
Additional measures are not currently on the table, since high prices are not expected to persist for long.
Aanvullende maatregelen zijn op dit moment niet aan de orde, aangezien het niet de verwachting is dat de huidige hoge prijzen langdurig aanhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het gedogen van ernstig dierenleed door botbreuken, bloedingen en ontwrichtingen bij tientallen miljoenen kuikens per jaar

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the NVWA stopped enforcing against catching chickens by the legs despite a court ruling and EU transport rules, and about the resulting injuries to tens of millions of chickens. The minister replied that the NVWA is pausing further inspections on catching method pending EFSA advice, that the court ruling was followed, that the method is not animal-friendly, and that enforcement against injuries continues through post-slaughter inspections and dialogue with the sector.
The NVWA's management independently decides on inspections and enforcement.
De IG NVWA neemt eigenstandig besluiten over de inspecties en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de voordelen en de stimulering van voedselbossen

An MP asks the minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the environmental benefits of food forests, their eligibility for CAP subsidies, the Green Deal's outcomes and national ambitions for food forests. The minister answers that food forests can be supported via the GLB basic premium, the eco-scheme and investment subsidies are still being explored, and the Green Deal evaluation and a national network are underway.
I am further exploring how the transition to agroforestry can be facilitated, for example through support for establishment within the NSP.
Ik verken bovendien verder hoe de omschakeling naar agroforestry gefaciliteerd kan worden, bijvoorbeeld via een ondersteuning voor aanleg binnen het NSP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Nederlandse overheid moet doen wat ze belooft’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the Netherlands did not vote for an IUCN motion on Amazon deforestation and whether it supports 80% Amazon protection by 2025. The minister says the motion was not known in advance, that the Netherlands would have supported it had it been, and that it supports Indigenous peoples and the 2030 zero-deforestation goal.
This partly led to the Dutch delegation not voting for this motion.
Dit heeft er mede toe geleid dat de Nederlandse delegatie niet heeft gestemd voor deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over ‘het te laat delen van de SCoPAFF-agenda, waardoor de Kamer dit niet tijdig kan bespreken’

An MP asked why the minister sent her position on the SCoPAFF pesticide votes of 21-22 October 2021 only on the evening of 15 October, after the agenda had been public since 6 October, leaving parliament no time to debate it. The minister answered that the position is sent when the Ctgb advice and interdepartmental coordination are complete, that this was not possible earlier before the autumn recess, and that she will inform parliament before each meeting and aim to do so as early as possible.
I aim to inform your House as transparently and as timely as possible about the SCoPAFF agenda.
1 Antwoord 1 Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer zo transparant en tijdig mogelijk te informeren over de SCoPAFF agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over geconstateerde ernstige misstanden op de dierenbeurs in Houten

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about serious animal welfare and public health concerns at the Houten reptile fair, including cramped housing, stress, zoonosis risk and NVWA inspections. The minister acknowledged the welfare concerns, reported NVWA findings and inspection history, and said a broader exploration of animal fairs and legal analysis is underway, without committing to a ban.
I have started an exploration into animal fairs in the Netherlands.
Ik ben een verkenning gestart over beurzen met dieren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de stapeling van pesticiden tot gifcocktails in ons milieu

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the synergistic toxicity of pesticide mixtures on bees, the stacking of active substances, water contamination and whether bans or quantitative reduction targets will be pursued. The Minister answers that the Ctgb is reviewing the study, that stacking restrictions were introduced for four substances, and that the government will pursue EU-level safety factors and monitoring while promising to report on follow-up.
The Ctgb has submitted the scientific article to the European working group developing the new bee guidance.
Het Ctgb heeft het wetenschappelijke artikel ingebracht in de Europese werkgroep die het nieuwe bijenrichtsnoer ontwikkelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de het nagenoeg gelijkblijvende gebruik van landbouwgif, ondanks beloftes voor een drastische afname

The MP Vestering asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why pesticide sales in the Netherlands fell only 1% in 2019 and why the government has not set quantitative targets despite promising a drastic reduction. The minister responds that the Netherlands is not directly comparable to the EU figures, that the trend is downward over 2011-2019, and that quantitative sub-targets are not yet set but will be monitored, with first monitoring results expected in autumn 2022.
Statistics Netherlands conducts a survey every four years to map pesticide use in the agricultural sector. The most recent data are from 2016.
Het CBS voert elke vier jaar een enquête uit om het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in de agrarische sector in beeld te brengen. De meest recente gegevens zijn van het jaar 2016
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het misdrijf in Stroe waarbij een beschermde wolf is doodgeschoten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the shooting of a protected wolf near Stroe, the ammunition used, the criminal investigation, the penalty gap with Belgium, a reward for the perpetrators, and measures against illegal killing of wolves. The minister answered that the investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, pointed to existing penalties and Benelux cooperation, said no reward has yet been considered, and committed to better public information, but declined to add new legislation on firearms.
The type of ammunition and the conclusions drawn from it form part of the ongoing criminal investigation.
Het type munitie en de daaraan verbonden conclusies vormen onderdeel van het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het Wierdense Veld

An MP from JA21 asks the minister about reports that the Wierdense Veld nature targets cannot be met, the role of consultancy Tauw in both advice and research, and the mapping of the area as restoring bog in AERIUS. The minister answers that the province completed its exploration, approved a measures package, and that the mapping and historical interpretation are sound, while declining to verify an anonymous researcher's remark.
Because the researcher, according to the article, only wanted to make this statement anonymously, it is also not possible for me to verify what exactly took place.
Omdat de onderzoeker deze uitspraak – volgens het artikel – alleen anoniem wilde doen, is het voor mij ook niet mogelijk om na te gaan wat er precies heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het afschot van wilde zwijnen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about record wild boar culls on the Veluwe, including the lack of a national overview of cull figures, permits and population counts, and the government's oversight role. The minister replied that provinces are responsible for hunting oversight and population data, that the government's role is limited to system responsibility and frameworks, and that the matters are for provincial decision-making, though she committed to answering each question.
Oversight of cull figures is a decentralised responsibility of the provinces.
Toezicht op afschotcijfers is een gedecentraliseerde verantwoordelijkheid van provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht: ‘Klimaatimpact Nederlandse veestapel fors overschat’

Van der Plas (BBB) asked whether IPCC findings on methane accounting (GWP* versus GWP100) require re-assessing the climate target for dairy and cattle farming, and how the government will act on a climate agreement passage about new insights benefiting the dairy sector. Minister Schouten answered that GWP* does not show cow impact is three to four times lower, that GWP100 remains the international standard, that any change would only follow after the IPCC cycle in 2022 and that no change to Dutch policy is currently at issue.
That is not currently at issue.
Dat is vooralsnog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over 'de uitspraak van de rechtbank Midden-Nederland d.d. 22 september 2021 met betrekking tot 17 agrarische bedrijven en één slachterij’

MP Bromet asks the Minister of Agriculture about a court ruling that annulled nitrogen-related decisions on 17 farms and a slaughterhouse, including criticism of technical stable measures and of the lack of a structural solution. The Minister acknowledges the ruling, says a legalisation programme is being prepared and that appeal is pending, defends the Rav emission factors as the best available science with a study due in 2022, and points to the Wsn as the structural approach.
I can at least guarantee that work continues unabated on legalising the reporting farms
Ik kan in ieder geval garanderen dat onverminderd hard wordt gewerkt aan het legaliseren van de melders
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Erkens over het bericht: ‘Klimaatimpact Nederlandse veestapel fors overschat’

MPs Van Campen and Erkens asked the ministers about a report claiming the climate impact of the Dutch livestock herd was overestimated, including whether an IPCC method change reduces cow impact threefold and how methane should be treated versus CO2. The government answered that the IPCC report does not claim cows' impact is three to four times lower, that GWP* only expresses short-lived gases' warming differently over time while GWP100 remains the international standard, and promised to send a cabinet appreciation of the IPCC report, which it had already done.
The IPCC report 'assessment report 6' does not contain such a claim.
In het IPCC rapport «assessment report 6» is een dergelijke stelling niet opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over de klimaatimpact van door de veestapel uitgestoten methaan

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder asked the ministers whether IPCC AR6 findings mean the climate impact of livestock methane is overstated, and what this implies for Dutch climate policy, LULUCF, and methane priorities. The minister answered that the IPCC does not say GWP* is better than GWP100, that GWP100 remains the international standard, that the issue will be revisited after the AR6 cycle, and that the national methane reduction target for livestock stands.
The IPCC does not make a statement about which method would be better or which method should be used.
Het IPCC doet daarbij geen uitspraak over welke methode beter zou zijn of welke methode gebruikt zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de vondst van zeehonden met hoogpathogene vogelgriep in Duitsland

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked the ministers about avian flu (H5N8) found in seals in Germany, its spread to wild animals, monitoring, and protocols for dead wild birds. The minister answered all 14 questions, mostly on substance, noting monitoring and protocols are being developed while rejecting a hunting ban and some measures.
We do not share that view. We do not pursue a policy to combat the disease in wild birds.
Die mening delen wij niet. Wij voeren geen beleid om de ziekte bij wilde vogels te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Kops en Mulder over de rampzalige gevolgen van de EU-klimaatplannen voor de landbouw

PVV MPs Kops and Mulder asked whether EU climate plans (Fit-for-55, Farm to Fork) would cause large food price rises, deforestation and worsening nature, citing a German study. The minister responded that the study uses unrealistic hypothetical assumptions and covers only part of the strategy, that the government shares the goal of affordable food but supports the EU climate plans, and that these plans protect nature and cut emissions.
These assumptions are not realistic because they are not part of the climate plans of the European Commission.
Deze aannames zijn niet realistisch omdat ze geen onderdeel uitmaken van de klimaatplannen van de Europese Commissie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de wijze waarop de stikstofdepositie berekend wordt

MP Bisschop (SGP) asked the minister whether AERIUS overestimates nitrogen deposition on habitat edges between forest and heath, and whether it should correct for this and exclude such hexagons from monitoring of the nitrogen environmental standard. Minister Schouten rejected each premise, arguing that forest does not necessarily capture more nitrogen than low vegetation and that no correction or change is warranted.
There is no reason to do so, given the answer to the first question.
Daartoe is geen aanleiding, gezien het antwoord op de eerste vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de massale dolfijnslachting op de Faeröer eilanden

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked the government about the mass dolphin slaughter on the Faroe Islands, including whether Denmark and the Faroese government have been pressed and whether the topic will be raised in EU forums. The minister replied that the Netherlands opposes the hunt, that the ambassador has raised it with Faroese representatives, that the Faroe Islands are responsible for their own marine resources, and that the issue will be discussed in the EU Council working group on whaling.
As an autonomous part of the Kingdom of Denmark, the Faroe Islands are themselves responsible for managing their natural resources, including the hunting of cetaceans.
Als autonoom onderdeel van het Koninkrijk Denemarken zijn de Faeröer Eilanden zelf verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van hun natuurlijke hulpbronnen, met inbegrip van de jacht op walvisachtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het openbaar maken van gegevens op 16 juli 2021 in het kader van de WOB (Wet Openbaarheid van Bestuur) met als onderwerp Lelystad Airport

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, on behalf of the Infrastructure Minister, why the legalisation of the Lelystad Airport PAS nitrogen notification was pursued despite flawed calculations, whether it is fair given the state's shareholding, and how good faith and fairness are assured, following WOB disclosures. The minister answered that the process follows statutory procedures, that the state as shareholder leaves operations to the company, that the nitrogen space is not from the Warme Sanering Varkenshouderij, and that good faith is presumed for all notifications; the minister answered all eleven questions but late.
It is a political decision to open the airport.
Het is een politiek besluit om het vliegveld te openen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het vrijgeven van de juridische analyse van de natuurvergunning voor de gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

An MP asked the Minister whether the Wadden Sea gas extraction permit application by NAM could be refused under existing nature protection law, whether the legal analysis would be released before the objection deadline, and whether the rules should be revised if the permit must be granted. The Minister declined to pre-judge the final decision, pointed to the draft decision and public documents, and said the current law strongly protects Natura 2000 areas.
I will take this objection together with the other submitted objections into account when preparing the final decision on the application for a Wnb permit.
Ik zal deze zienswijze tezamen met de andere ingediende zienswijzen betrekken bij de voorbereiding van het finale besluit op de aanvraag om een Wnb-vergunning
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Dierenbescherming haalt verwaarloosde paarden uit vieze stallen in gemeente Venlo’

An MP asked ministers about a 2021 case in Venlo where neglected horses were removed from a keeper who had earlier had 33 horses seized on Texel, and whether a longer or lifetime animal-keeping ban should apply. The government answered that it cannot discuss individual cases, defended the 10-year maximum ban in the pending bill as proportionate, and said enforcement would follow any new violation.
The bill provides that the criminal judge may, upon conviction for a criminal offence, impose an independent animal-keeping ban for a maximum duration of ten years.
Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet in de mogelijkheid voor de strafrechter om in geval van veroordeling wegens een strafbaar feit een zelfstandig houdverbod voor de maximale duur van tien jaar op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het stikstofbeleid

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the uncertainty of the nitrogen deposition calculation at hexagon level, and whether deposition measurements were made after 2015 to validate the AERIUS model. The minister answered that the uncertainty at hexagon level is assumed equal to the one-square-kilometre grid pending further research, and that RIVM measures deposition and will report on model validation with deposition data in the coming year.
While validation of the model based on concentration measurements has been reported regularly, this has not yet been done for the deposition measurements.
Terwijl over de validatie van het model op basis van concentratiemetingen wel regelmatig gerapporteerd is, is dit voor de depositiemetingen tot op heden nog niet gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het meerekenen van intensieve landbouwgronden als Natura 2000-gebieden terwijl Nederland bijna wereldkampioen biodiversiteitsverlies is

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why intensively farmed land counts as Natura 2000 protected nature amid high biodiversity loss, and whether goose culling and pesticide use in these areas are consistent with conservation goals. The minister acknowledges the biodiversity problem, reports the area of farmland within Natura 2000 sites, says agricultural use is needed for certain protected species, defers on the pesticide court ruling pending the province's response, and declines to reclassify such land as unrealised nature ambition.
No, these arable fields and grasslands are designated because they have a function within the Natura 2000 area, for example as foraging area.
Nee, deze akkers en weilanden zijn aangewezen omdat ze een functie hebben binnen het Natura 2000-gebied, bijvoorbeeld als foerageergebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de wijze waarop de stikstofdepositie berekend wordt

An SGP MP asked whether land-use roughness and vegetation transitions cause overestimation of nitrogen deposition in AERIUS near forest edges, and whether corrections or exclusion of such hexagons are needed. The minister rejected the premises, arguing that neighbouring forest increases turbulence and that the calculation is representative, and declined to correct or exclude hexagons.
There is therefore no reason to correct or to leave out hexagons.
Er is dus geen reden om te corrigeren of hexagonen weg te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over niet rijpe mais en de uiterste datum voor inzaaien van vanggewas

MP Van der Plas asks the minister about unripe maize, the harvest-maturity research and the 1 October deadline for sowing cover crops after maize, and whether an exemption will be granted this year. The minister confirms the signals, grants postponement of the sowing deadline on sandy and loess soils, defends the 1 October date on nitrogen-leaching grounds, and says the CDM advice shows unripe maize can raise methane emissions but that feeding it is not unacceptable for animal welfare.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de toezending van gespreksverslagen van bijeenkomsten van de minister van Landbouw, of haar medewerkers, met de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the agriculture minister why she did not disclose that the European Commission had written a flash report on a 25 February 2021 meeting about the Wierdense Veld, and why minutes of Commission meetings are not sent to parliament promptly. The minister replied that no joint report of the meeting with the Commissioner existed, that she was unaware of an internal Commission email summary, and that minutes of official-level meetings fall outside the EU information agreements, though she pledged general information via letters and debates.
Conversation reports do not fall under those agreements, partly because the cabinet believes this does not benefit how the Netherlands deals with the Commission and other Member States
Gespreksverslagen vallen niet onder die afspraken, mede omdat dit naar de mening van het kabinet niet ten goede komt aan de omgang van Nederland met de Commissie en andere Lidstaten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Brussel maakte wél verslag van gesprek over Wierdense Veld’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why she earlier said no report existed of her meeting with the European Commissioner on the Wierdense Veld, when a flash report now surfaces, and questioned the Netherlands' interpretation of Habitats Directive Article 6 and the scientific uncertainty of the measures. The minister answered that she was unaware of the internal Commission report, that the Commission rejected the Dutch interpretation allowing a general-interest use to take priority, that the measures are judged adequate under current insights with monitoring planned, and that compensation is a last resort.

When on 6 September 2021 I answered 'No report was made of the conversation with the Eurocommissioner', I was not aware that an email with a short summary of the conversation had been sent within the services of the European Commission.

Toen ik op 6 september 2021 antwoordde «Er is geen verslag gemaakt van het gesprek met de Eurocommissaris», was ik niet op de hoogte van het feit dat er binnen de diensten van de Europese Commissie een e-mail was verzonden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de interpretatie van artikel 6 van de Habitatrichtlijn (92/43/EEG)

MP Tjeerd de Groot asked whether the current nitrogen approach meets the European Commission's interpretation of Article 6(2) of the Habitats Directive (non-deterioration), and asked for internal notes and Landsadvocaat advice on this. Minister Schouten answered that the structural approach is designed to prevent deterioration, that the government will adjust measures if needed, and that the nature-target analyses will follow mid-2022, but did not release the internal notes or advice.
Will you share with the House the internal notes between May 2019 and February 2021 that address the consequences of the non-deterioration obligation in Article 6(2)?
Wilt u de interne nota's tussen mei 2019 en februari 2021 waarin wordt ingegaan op (de consequenties) van het verslechteringsverbod uit artikel 6 lid 2 met de Kamer delen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over het vasthouden van water in natuurgebieden om overstromingen te helpen voorkomen

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked about retaining water in nature areas to help prevent floods, including the role of agriculture, river space, and responsibilities across government tiers. Minister Schouten answered substantively, describing existing policy, river-widening measures and groundwater frameworks, and committing to further letters on climate adaptation for nature later this autumn.
Action lines on climate adaptation for nature will be communicated to you later this autumn.
Actielijnen klimaatadaptatie natuur u later dit najaar wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Aanscherping leenregime banken zet boeren in de kou’

MPs Heinen and Van Campen asked whether the planned Basel IV bank capital rules would make financing agricultural investment harder, and what the government was doing about it. The Finance Minister answered that the impact depends on how the EU implements the rules and on banks' choices, that talks with banks and DNB have taken place, and that the Commission's proposal and impact analysis will be awaited before the government sets its position.
The cabinet acknowledges the importance of ensuring that agricultural sector financing remains guaranteed now and in the future.
Het kabinet erkent het belang dat de financierbaarheid van de agrarische sector nu en in de toekomst gewaarborgd blijft
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de EU Transportverordening (EG nr. 1/2005) met betrekking tot het vangen van kippen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about catching chickens by the legs under the EU transport regulation, including animal welfare, labour and the risk to supply if the practice stopped. The minister confirmed the practice is common in the EU, said she is pausing enforcement of the ban pending an EFSA opinion, and called the current method undesirable while committing to talks with the sector on gentler catching.
I would like to await this advice before deciding how to deal with the ban as it is currently worded in the transport regulation.
Ik wil dit advies graag afwachten voordat ik bepaal hoe om te gaan met het verbod zoals het nu in de transportverordening verwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de resten van landbouwgif in ons voedsel

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about pesticide residues found in food by EenVandaag, including whether there should be cumulative limits and stricter MRLs given supermarket standards. The minister answered that residues within legal MRLs pose no concern, that cumulative effects are being studied by RIVM and EFSA, and that the EU is considering a safety factor, but declined to lower MRLs structurally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het Westnijlvirus en de tijgermug

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about whether the NVWA's publication of tiger mosquito finds, including business names and neighbourhood-level locations, is consistent with a Council of State ruling on Wob requests. The Minister replies that the ruling concerned passive disclosure only, that the NVWA is reviewing more detailed active disclosure for 2022, and that the current approach aims to inform residents without conflicting with that ruling.
The NVWA is currently examining how information on mosquito finds can be made public at a more detailed level.
De NVWA onderzoekt op dit moment op welke wijze informatie over muggenvondsten op een meer gedetailleerd niveau openbaar gemaakt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het dodelijke landbouwgif Roundup

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about glyphosate-based Roundup herbicide, including reports it kills bumblebees, the role of co-formulants, France's withdrawal of 36 products, and Luxembourg's ban. The minister answered that the Ctgb judges the Roundup products safe for bees under use instructions, that co-formulant testing is done at national level, and that Dutch authorities cannot adopt Luxembourg's ban without scientific justification.
The Ctgb expects that the formulation studies with honeybees are representative of bumblebees with respect to the observed effects attributed to formulation adjuvants.
Het Ctgb verwacht dat de formuleringsstudies met honingbijen representatief zijn voor hommels ten aanzien van de geobserveerde effecten die aan formuleringshulpstoffen worden toegeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Vestering over hittestress bij dieren

MP Vestering asks the minister about heat stress in farm animals, including the failure of voluntary transport and sector protocols, lack of legal rules, slaughterhouse waiting times and mortality reporting. The minister says a plan of action on heat stress is being prepared, motions on 30-degree transport limits and a 15-minute waiting cap are being worked out, and no legal basis yet exists to structurally cut slaughter speed.
I am therefore having research done into how slaughter speed affects risk factors for animal welfare and food safety control and the ability to maintain effective supervision.
Ik laat dan ook onderzoeken hoe de invloed van slachtsnelheid op risicofactoren voor dierenwelzijn en controle op voedselveiligheid en het goed kunnen houden van toezicht, is.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over het ontbreken van wetgeving tegen hittestress bij diertransporten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why no legislation exists against heat stress during animal transport and how inspections can be strengthened. The minister answered that a plan of action on heat stress is being drafted, that existing rules and the national plan are enforced by the NVWA, that EU revision is expected, and that NVWA inspections and capacity are described.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Tjeerd de Groot over de campagne “Iedereen doet Wat”

MPs Boucke and De Groot ask why reducing meat consumption was dropped from the 'Iedereen doet wat' climate campaign despite internal documents treating it as low-threshold, and why flying less is omitted, and who is responsible among ministries. The state secretary answers by pointing to the campaign's positive-behaviour-change approach and the ministries' shared responsibility, without fully explaining the March 2019 decision or the ministry's arguments for dropping the measure.
Can you answer these questions separately?
Vraag 13 Kunt u deze vragen los beantwoorden?

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de aanpak van de stikstofproblematiek naar aanleiding van de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen van het lid Eppink naar aanleiding van de technische toelichting op 12 mei 20

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the nitrogen policy: whether AERIUS emission data could use 2019 or 2020 rather than 2018, how the foreign deposition reduction is secured, the measurement and model uncertainties, the legal basis under the Habitats Directive, and the sourcing of critical deposition values and pressure factors. The minister answers that 2019 data will be used in AERIUS Monitor 2021, that foreign reduction is assumed without binding targets, that model-based calculation is legally sound, and provides references, while committing to ongoing monitoring studies.
RIVM expects to publish AERIUS Monitor 2021 in December with deposition data based on 2019 emissions.
Het RIVM verwacht in december AERIUS Monitor 2021 te publiceren met depositiedata gebaseerd op de emissies uit 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over de wateroverlast

MPs Boswijk, Van Dijk and Amhaouch asked ministers about flood damage and whether the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen applies to farmers outside Limburg, and about sand bags, food safety, manure bookkeeping and working-time rules. Minister Schouten answered that the compensation law applies only to disasters meeting the Wet veiligheidsregio's definition, that uiterwaard damage is excluded and still under study, and that a ministerial regulation and RVO quick scan are being prepared.
Currently the desirability and possibilities of compensating damage in floodplains along the Maas are being explored, about which your House has been informed.
Momenteel wordt de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheden voor tegemoetkoming van schade in uiterwaarden langs de Maas verkend waarover uw Kamer is geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Hagen naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Stikstofdeal met zes boeren die stoppen, A15 kan volgens ministerie daardoor alsnog doorgaan’ in de Gelderlander

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Hagen (D66) asked whether deals with six livestock farmers allow the A15 extension to proceed despite the 25-km nitrogen limit, and why farms were bought out where external netting is not permitted. The minister confirmed agreements were signed (some before the 25-km rule was set), stated only businesses with a realised capacity were included, cited the Rijk's lifted netting limits and the province's permit withdrawal, and said no irreversible steps will be taken until the Raad van State rules.
Are you willing to take no irreversible steps on the A15 until this has been discussed in the House of Representatives during the MIRT committee consultation?
Bent u bereid geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten op de A15 tot hierover is gesproken in de Tweede Kamer tijdens het notaoverleg MIRT?

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het verloop rond het ontslag van oud-staatssecretaris Mona Keijzer en de afwezigheid van kabinetsleden bij de hoofdelijk stemming over de invoering van de QR-toegangspas

An MP asked several ministers how they were informed of and consented to the dismissal of State Secretary Mona Keijzer, whether the cabinet's rules of procedure were followed, and why a minister was absent from a vote on the QR access pass. The government answered that the dismissal was materially in line with cabinet procedure via consultation with the vice-prime ministers, and that the ministers' disagreements were part of normal cabinet deliberation.
This materially guarantees that the decision was taken in accordance with the sense of the Council of Ministers and does justice to its rules of procedure.
Hiermee is materieel gewaarborgd dat het besluit is genomen in overeenstemming met het gevoelen van de ministerraad en recht gedaan aan het reglement van orde van de ministerraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de uitblijvende maatregelen tegen stalbranden

An MP asked the agriculture minister why concrete measures against barn fires have not yet followed the Safety Board's March 2021 report, and whether the minister can use the MP's amendment to protect animals. The minister confirmed the MP's reading of the amendment and referred to a separate letter of 8 October on the announced measures rather than setting them out in the answer.
I refer you for the announced measures to the letter to the House 'Aanpak van stalbranden' of 8 October.
Ik verwijs u voor de aangekondigde maatregelen naar de Kamerbrief «Aanpak van stalbranden» van 8 oktober jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over het bericht 'Milieuorganisaties vrezen dat nieuwe gasboringen oesterbank bij ‘Schier’ vernielen'

MPs De Groot and Boucke asked whether planned gas drilling north of Schier could damage an oyster restoration project and how this fits the North Sea Agreement and Natura 2000 rules. The minister answers that extensive assessments found no significant harm, that permits contain safeguards, and that definitive decision-making follows after objections are processed.
The concerns of the environmental organisations were raised in consultation responses. The consultation responses and advice will be taken into account in the definitive decision-making.
De zorgen van de milieuorganisaties zijn naar voren gebracht in inspraakreacties. De inspraakreacties en adviezen worden meegenomen bij de definitieve besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over ‘het leed van geitenbokjes en de duizenden geitenlammetjes die illegaal binnen een week naar het slachthuis zijn afgevoerd’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that thousands of very young goat kids were slaughtered or transported illegally within a week of birth, and about registration gaps and mortality. The Minister disputes that the figures prove illegal transport, explains the rules and registration changes, says NVWA oversees compliance, and declines to commit to a new plan but promises a later update.
From 2016 to July 2021, 23 transports of goat kids were inspected. No violations were found during these inspections regarding fitness for transport and the I&R obligation.
Vanaf 2016 tot juli 2021 zijn 23 transporten met geitenlammeren gecontroleerd. Bij deze controles zijn geen overtredingen vastgesteld met betrekking tot de geschiktheid voor vervoer en de I&R-plicht.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het rapport ‘Naar een ontspannen Nederland’

Member Van der Plas asked whether the report 'Naar een ontspannen Nederland' was financed by the minister, what its purpose was, who commissioned it, and whether further nitrogen-reduction research is planned. The minister confirmed a subsidy was granted to the authors on their own initiative, said no commission was issued, and listed existing nitrogen-reduction studies and demonstration projects.
As indicated, this report was not drafted on commission from the Ministry of LNV.
Zoals aangeduid is dit rapport niet in opdracht van het Ministerie van LNV opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat twee wolven zijn ontsnapt in DierenPark Amersfoort

An MP asked the minister whether Amersfoort zoo is safe after two escapes in a short period, whether it should lose its licence, and whether zoos should be reconsidered. The minister replied that escapes are exceptional, that protocols were followed, that an independent investigation was completed and improvements implemented, and that zoos should not be abolished.
I do not have the investigation report in my possession.
Ik heb het onderzoeksrapport niet in mijn bezit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Boswijk over ‘de onwerkbare situatie voor zwerfdierstichtingen’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Boswijk (CDA) asked the minister about legal uncertainty and impracticable rules for dog-rescue foundations under EU animal health law, illegal dog trade and registration obligations. The minister acknowledged the signals, explained that the regime applies to commercial movements of dogs, promised communication efforts, a regulatory aid tool and talks with the foundations, while declining to confirm or deny claims about illegal trade and forged passports.
The suspicion is that these numbers are considerable, but because of their illegal nature, exact figures are unknown.
Het vermoeden is dat deze aantallen behoorlijk zijn maar vanwege de illegale aard ervan zijn exacte cijfers onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid lid Vestering over het bericht 'Gegoochel met stikstof waardoor de natuur achteruitboert’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether innovative stable techniques cut nitrogen less than promised, whether low-emission floors pose explosion risks, whether intra-sector offsetting avoids new permits, and how subsidies, PAS-melder legalisation and latent permit space will avoid nature deterioration. The Minister largely acknowledges weaker real-world performance of some techniques, cites ongoing research and existing measures, rejects some claims, and defends the legalisation of PAS-melders and the new Wsn as adequate safeguards.
The Aarhus Convention and Article 6(3) of the Habitats Directive require public participation regarding permits for plans and projects that require an appropriate assessment.

Het Verdrag van Aarhus en artikel 6, lid 3, van de Habitatrichtlijn verplichten tot inspraak ten aanzien van toestemming voor plannen en projecten waarvoor een passende beoordeling moet worden verricht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over mislukte veenvorming in het Wierdense Veld

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the Wierdense Veld peat restoration plans were unsupported, whether 'actief hoogveen' was absent and 'herstellend hoogveen' unrealistic, whether a 30-year peat-forming restoration study exists, whether the Netherlands applies a stricter definition than the EU, and whether the measures are wasteful. The minister rejected each premise, stating that consultant reports showed goals were achievable, that the 30-year criterion remains in the definition, and that the measures are justified.
Recently, the provincial executive of Overijssel decided to resume the area process.
Recent hebben gedeputeerde staten van Overijssel besloten het gebiedsproces te hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Bromet over de verlenging van het Europees Diploma voor de Oostvaardersplassen en Nationaal Park Weerribben-Wieden

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government welcomes the renewed Council of Europe Diploma for the Oostvaardersplassen and Weerribben-Wieden, and whether Lelystad Airport's development endangers these Natura 2000 areas. The minister answered that the diploma is welcome, that the airport's routes avoid the areas (with minimum flight heights of 3,000 and 6,000 feet), and that the government will not commit to further action beyond the existing legal duty to protect Natura 2000 areas.

It concludes that the temporary connecting routes take place at a height of 6,000 feet and above, and that the earlier 2014 MER conclusion that there will be no damage to the natural characteristics of the Natura 2000 areas therefore does not change.

Hierin wordt geconcludeerd dat de tijdelijke aansluitroutes plaatsvinden op een hoogte van 6.000 voet en hoger, en dat de conclusie (uit het eerdere MER 2014) dat er geen sprake zal zijn van de aantasting van de natuurlijke kenmerken van de Natura 2000-gebieden daarom niet verandert.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over het illegaal vangen van zwanen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about illegal capture of swans, including how many cases occur, how the ban on swan drives is enforced, and the number of reports received. The minister answered that the ministry lacks the data, that provinces and police are responsible for enforcement, and that reports to the NVWA and police are listed, while admitting a late reply on earlier questions.
