The Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (LNV) does not have this data.
Het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (LNV) beschikt niet over deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over nieuwe natuur

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the scale of the new-nature target under the Natuurnetwerk Nederland, how much stems from nitrogen problems, which actors are involved, how the type of nature is decided, and whether new nature should be less nitrogen-sensitive. The minister answered that roughly 38,530 ha of the 80,000 ha target remained as of 1 January 2020, that the Programme Nature funds provincial restoration programmes in nitrogen-sensitive Natura 2000 areas, that provinces decide the nature type regionally, and that nitrogen sensitivity plays no role in choosing nature types.
For answering the question of which nature should be realised, nitrogen sensitivity plays no role.
Voor het beantwoorden van de vraag welke natuur moet worden gerealiseerd, speelt de stikstofgevoeligheid geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het rapport van de Eerlijke Bankwijzer waaruit blijkt dat banken onvoldoende verantwoordelijkheid nemen in de eiwittransitie

An MP asked ministers whether banks are doing enough to finance the protein transition, citing an Eerlijke Bankwijzer report on barriers such as farmer access to capital and vested interests. The minister agrees banks can play a crucial role, points to existing and planned measures, acknowledges voluntary IMVO covenants are insufficient, and says the government will pursue due-diligence rules at EU level or national measures if needed, but declines to set measurable targets for banks yet.
Supplementing and tightening the IMVO measures is therefore necessary.
Aanvulling en aanscherping van de IMVO-maatregelen is daarom nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over vanggewassen in het kader van verplichting voor het ecologisch aandachtsgebied (EA) zoals geformuleerd in het Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid (GLB)

An MP asked the minister whether farmers can meet the GLB ecological focus area cover-crop rules (sowing deadline, establishment, eight weeks standing) in wet weather, and how enforcement handles this. The minister answered that the EU rules are binding with no room for deviation, that the 15 October sowing deadline is a national facilitation rule, that force majeure may apply, and that she is reluctant to add extra national rules on CO2 emissions.
I have no room to deviate from these EU requirements.
Ik heb geen ruimte om van deze EU-eisen af te wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over grote hobbypluimveehouderijen

An MP asked the minister whether hobby poultry keepers contribute to spreading bird flu, how many hobby keepers and screenings exist, and how awareness of registration duties can be raised. The minister answered that registration applies to flocks of 250 or more birds regardless of purpose, that hobby holdings are not separately identifiable, and that information outreach will be improved, without committing to new screening.
The number of hobby poultry farms is not known to RVO, because RVO only records locations with more than 250 birds.
Het aantal hobbypluimveehouderijen is bij RVO niet bekend, omdat bij RVO alleen locaties worden gemeld met meer dan 250 stuks pluimvee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Raan over de dood van een lammergier na botsing met een Nederlandse windmolen

MPs Vestering and Van Raan asked ministers about the death of a lammergier after a collision with a Dutch wind turbine, detection systems, protected-area permits, cumulative effects and subsidies for biodiversity. The ministers answered largely in general terms, saying permits are the responsibility of provinces, that a black-blade pilot is under way, and that a cumulative study and subsidy review are being considered.
Provinces are the competent authority for granting exemptions or waivers for species and permits for Natura 2000.
Provincies zijn bevoegd gezag voor het verlenen van ontheffingen of vrijstellingen voor soorten en vergunningen voor Natura 2000.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over stropers

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and of Justice and Security about a poaching network in Limburg, including the methods used, the seizures, detection rates and reports, and the number of animals killed. The minister condemned the practices but declined to share operational details, gave aggregated report and case figures, said animal totals cannot be reliably counted, and did not commit to a new national study.
I cannot share further information with your House, as I cannot go into individual cases or investigative information.
Meer informatie kan ik niet met uw Kamer delen aangezien ik niet in kan gaan op individuele gevallen of opsporingsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over 'De miljarden die de Rotterdamse haven misloopt door de stikstofcrisis'

An MP asked whether the nitrogen policy is sufficient to address the Rotterdam port's missed sustainable investments, how many investments were lost and how many permits granted, what nitrogen space exists, and whether Project Mainportontwikkeling Rotterdam compensation is complete. The minister acknowledged investment concerns, said the total lost investment cannot be stated because firms are reticent, pointed to a facet plan due end 2021 and to ongoing analysis of Voordelta compensation, and said permit data lies with the province.
I therefore cannot give a conclusive answer to the question of how many sustainable investments the Rotterdam port has missed due to the nitrogen problem.
Ik kan daarom geen sluitend antwoord geven op de vraag hoeveel duurzame investeringen de Rotterdamse Haven is misgelopen door de stikstofproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Dijk gaat schuiven, weilanden in Reeuwijk onder water’

MPs Valstar and Rudmer Heerema asked the government about a dike subsidence in Reeuwijk that farmers attribute to American crayfish burrowing, and about control of invasive crayfish. The minister answers that the cause is not yet established and that crayfish burrowing seems unlikely to be the main cause, that a national strategy process is underway, and that recreational or volunteer fishing for crayfish is not advisable.
According to the water manager, Hoogheemraadschap van Rijnland, it is currently unclear what caused this dike subsidence.
Het is volgens de waterbeheerder, het Hoogheemraadschap van Rijnland, op dit moment niet duidelijk wat de oorzaak is van deze dijkverzakking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de export van dolfijnen naar een pretpark in China

An MP asked the minister about the export of dolphins, walruses and sea lions from the Dolfinarium Harderwijk to a Chinese amusement park, including animal welfare, CITES permits, oversight of the receiving facility, and the zoo's conservation and educational value. The minister answered that transfer is allowed only if the receiving zoo meets Dutch welfare standards, that RVO will check this, that the Dolfinarium's commitments will be enforced through licence conditions, and that renovation deadlines run to 2024, 2026 and 2029.
If the Dolfinarium does not implement the changes or does not do so on time, I will take enforcement action.
Als het Dolfinarium de wijzigingen niet of niet tijdig doorvoert, zal ik handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Dierenwelzijnsorganisatie wil verkoop van acht dolfijnen aan China tegenhouden'

An MP asked the minister how animal welfare is guaranteed for dolphins sold to a Chinese park, whether checks are made on receiving facilities, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that welfare is paramount, that the zoo must show welfare is secured at the destination under the Besluit houders van dieren, and that talks with the Dolfinarium are ongoing; several answers referred to earlier answers.
I will ensure that the Dolfinarium complies with this.
Ik zal erop toezien dat het Dolfinarium zich hieraan houdt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de effecten op klimaat, milieu en inkomenspositie van boeren

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a WUR scenario study on the national CAP strategic plan, its public draft, the required environmental assessment and the researchers' call for a more ambitious plan. The minister answered that the report was sent to parliament on 15 September, that the public June draft was only a high-level version for national debate and must meet EU requirements by 31 December 2021, that the environmental assessment is not yet made and will be shared once done, and that no statements on ambition can be made yet.
Once the environmental assessment is ready, it will be shared with your House.
Zodra de m.e.r. gereed is, zal hij met uw Kamer gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘NVWA-baas wil keuringen in slachthuizen afstoten’

Boswijk (CDA) asked the minister about the outgoing NVWA inspector-general's call to stop slaughterhouses paying for meat inspections, arguing this creates a appearance of conflict of interest, and about whether NVWA oversight and inspection roles should be separated amid tensions with animal welfare. The minister defended cost pass-through, said EU rules prevent fully ending slaughterhouse funding but safeguards exist, and committed to a separate inspection organisation with a detailed proposal by Q2 2022.
It is important that the safeguards mentioned earlier are also retained or improved in the revision of the NVWA fee system, especially where the independence of supervision is concerned.

Het is belangrijk dat eerder genoemde waarborgen ook bij de herziening van het retributiestelsel NVWA behouden blijven of verbeterd worden, zeker waar het de onafhankelijkheid van het toezicht betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over het bericht 'Tweede Duitse coach weggestuurd uit Tokio na mishandeling paard'

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether a German coach's mistreatment of a horse at the Tokyo Olympics constitutes animal abuse, and about whipping, bit use, horse trade fraud, subsidies and a national horse welfare decree. The minister condemned the conduct, said whip use as punishment is not customary and that enforcement follows existing frameworks, but declined a dedicated horse welfare law and deferred answers on several points.
I am of the view that deploying specific, additional legislation on horse welfare does not contribute to better welfare for horses or to accelerating the process.
Ik ben van mening dat het inzetten van specifieke, aanvullende wetgeving voor paardenwelzijn niet bijdraagt aan beter welzijn voor paarden of versnelling van het proces.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de berichten ‘Te ruime regels voor stikstofhandel gevaar voor toch al overbelaste natuur’ en ‘Nieuwe vergunningsregels bieden ruimte voor meer stikstofuitstoot’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether extensive unused nitrogen permit space enables external netting that could increase nitrogen emissions and harm nature, and questions the Nieuwkoop pilot and the reinstated external netting rules. The minister answers that external netting only uses actually realised capacity with 30% deducted, that emissions generally fall, that data on latent space is lacking, and that she is exploring with the provinces how to prevent emission increases.
I have no insight into the extent of latent space in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de omvang van de latente ruimte in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over het bericht 'De bedreiging van de natuur door stikstofhandel’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that industry and farms hold unused nitrogen emission room that could be traded or used, potentially harming nature, and about the adequacy of the 30% deduction rate and the legal basis of the nitrogen policy. The minister answered that permitted emissions exceed actual emissions, that external netting only uses realised capacity with a 30% deduction, that the government is consulting provinces on preventing emission increases, and that the legal framework remains defensible.
I have no insight into the size of the latent space in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de omvang van de latente ruimte in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over turf-vrije potgrond

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked the government about peat extraction for potting soil, its CO2 and biodiversity impacts, import volumes, and bans in other countries. Minister Schouten answered that peat extraction harms peatlands, that RPP certification aims for 100% certified peat by 2025, that England alone plans a sales ban, and that the minister will work toward fully peat-free potting soil for private consumers and study phase-out in the professional sector, reporting before the budget debate.
Yes, I have been called upon by your House through a motion to work toward fully peat-free potting soil for private consumers
Ja, ik ben door uw Kamer per motie opgeroepen toe te werken naar volledig turfvrije potgrond voor particulieren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de aanleg van een wolvenhek in Friesland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether a wolf-proof fence in Friesland, covering the province's border, is compatible with the Habitats Directive, nature networks and the Nature Conservation Act, and whether it should be stopped. The minister answered that only a test fence on one farm exists, no permit or assessment was submitted or carried out, the fence would conflict with nature connectivity, and farmers are responsible for protecting livestock, while not committing to any new action.
No exemption or permit application has been submitted by the initiators to the province of Fryslân.
Er is geen ontheffings- of vergunningsaanvraag door de initiatiefnemers ingediend bij de provincie Fryslân.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over wilde zwijnen

MP Vestering (PvdD) asks the minister about wild boar culling on the Veluwe, including animal intrinsic value, population counts versus permits, and whether the nulstandsbeleid should be lifted. The minister repeatedly states that faunabeheer is decentralised to the provinces, that the ministry lacks the requested data, and that the data on counts and permits is publicly available.
It is not for me to intervene in the considerations and decisions the province makes in this regard.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afwegingen en besluiten die de provincie hierbij neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over uitspraken van de landsadvocaat

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about remarks by the state advocate (landsadvocaat) on nitrogen policy, including whether he should be struck from the bar roll and whether the government intends to harm the farming sector. The minister replies that the state advocate gives objective expert advice which the cabinet weighs, that the government balances measures for farmers who stop and those who continue, and that it aims to keep a sustainable agricultural sector.
It is the task of the state advocate to advise objectively, on the basis of his expertise, when advice is requested.
Het is de taak van de landsadvocaat om, als advies wordt gevraagd, op basis van zijn deskundigheid objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over probleem met de bij Brexit 'vergeten' scheepswerven in Stellendam nog steeds niet volledig opgelost

An MP asked why British fishing vessels heading for Stellendam shipyards must first call at a designated port for NVWA checks, and why NVWA is unavailable at weekends. The minister explains the checks serve EU anti-illegal-fishing obligations, that the shipyard ports lack inspection capacity, and that she will not change the arrangement but remains open to new evidence from the sector.
NVWA oversight is aimed at preventing illegal landings of fish.
Het toezicht van de NVWA is gericht op het voorkomen van illegale aanlandingen van vis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over de demonstratie van 50 Waddenzee-, Noordzee- en IJsselmeerkotters op 14 augustus op de Waddenzee

MP Ephraim asked the minister about fishers' shrinking fishing space from new nature areas and offshore wind farms, COVID support, and their future perspective. The minister answered that spatial changes are being managed through the North Sea Agreement, the Kottervisie and Garnalenvisie, support schemes, and case-by-case arrangements for fishing within protected areas and wind farms.
I am committed to achieving tailored solutions for fishing methods suited to the new situation, both in the nature areas and in the wind farms.
Ik zet mij in om zowel in de natuurgebieden als in de windparken maatwerk te realiseren voor vismethoden die passen in de nieuwe situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de uitspraak van de rechter in Overijssel over bemesten en beweiden op 29 juli 2021 (AwB19/1185 en AWB 20/186)

MP Boswijk asked the minister how a Overijssel court ruling on manuring and grazing under the nature protection act affects permit exemptions, whether it is coordinated with provinces and whether grazing will now need permits. The minister says Rijk and provinces coordinate monthly, that grazing and manuring are generally exempt when continuously farmed since the reference date, but that exceptions are being mapped and a generic substantiation is being sought.
The national government and the provinces are currently mapping these situations.
Het Rijk en de provincies zijn deze situaties op dit moment in kaart aan het brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht 'Rechter: Overijssel moet handhaven op vergunning beweiden en bemesten'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a court ruling requiring the province of Overijssel to enforce permit requirements for grazing and manure application, and about how clearly 'existing use' must be substantiated and how nitrogen targets can be made feasible. The minister replied that enforcement against grazing and manure application is disproportionate in most cases, that national guidelines on proving existing use will be developed, and that some answers were delayed.
With the provinces it has been agreed that no enforcement action is taken when grazing and manure application take place, because no permit under the Nature Conservation Act is required for them.
Met provincies is afgesproken dat er niet handhavend wordt opgetreden indien er wordt beweid en bemest, omdat daarvoor geen vergunning op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming is vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg ingezonden over de natuurbeheersubsidie van Kroondomein Het Loo

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked whether Kroondomein Het Loo may close during the period from 15 September 2021 despite the statutory opening requirements, whether the minister will implement the motion for year-round opening, whether the 2022 Gelderland plan excludes areas from the opening duty, whether objections can be lodged against the new subsidy application, whether the EUR 4.7 million subsidy should be reclaimed, and which hunting permits were granted. The minister answered that the temporary closure complies with current rules, that the new conditions only apply from 2022, and deferred answers to questions 2 to 6 for further consultation.
For questions 2 to 6 that is not possible, because more time is needed for consultation and investigation to answer them.
Voor de vragen 2 tot en met 6 is dat niet mogelijk, omdat voor het antwoord op die vragen meer tijd nodig is voor overleg en onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebruik van een verboden landbouwgif in viskwekerijen

MP Wassenberg asked the minister whether the banned pesticide imidacloprid could be used in fish farming and whether imported farmed fish with residues could reach Dutch shops, and asked about antibiotics, mortality, wastewater and inspections. The minister answered that imidacloprid is not authorised for fish in the EU, that an MRL exists for food safety while environmental risks are assessed separately, and described monitoring and the antibiotic rules, mostly without giving the specific figures requested.
No resistance data specific to national aquaculture production are known.
Er zijn geen resistentiegegevens specifiek van de nationale aquacultuurproductie bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht 'Weggemaaide zeldzame orchidee laat waterschap koud'

An MP asks the ministers how a water board could mow a protected orchid, whether enforcement of the Nature Protection Act in public space is adequate, and how ecological verge management can be encouraged and staff trained. The minister says the matter falls to the province of Zeeland as competent authority, sees no structural enforcement problem, declines to mandate Kleurkeur or the national flora database, and promises to discuss training and report yearly on verge management.
It is up to the province of Zeeland to hold the water board to account on this and enforce if necessary.
Het is aan de provincie Zeeland om het Waterschap hierop aan te spreken en te handhaven indien dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over het bericht ‘hartenkreet van boeren: ‘Alsjeblieft, pak het jacobskruiskruid aan!’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about farmers' complaints over the toxic ragwort (jacobskruiskruid), its spread, inconsistent local management and a possible eradication duty. The minister acknowledged the toxicity and said the number of affected animals is probably small and the species is native and valuable for biodiversity, so no national policy or eradication duty is planned, with management left to local managers.
I regret that, but this is no reason to draw up policy for it.
Dat betreur ik, maar dit vormt geen aanleiding om hier beleid voor op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de vervolgacties naar aanleiding van het eindrapport van het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof

An MP asked the minister whether the 25 km cut-off for nitrogen deposition calculations is justified given RIVM findings, whether emissions beyond that distance still harm nature, and whether it creates a threshold favouring large 'peak' emitters. The minister answered that no clear model break exists but 25 km is a defensible limit where deposition is reasonably attributable to a project, that surrounding nature is protected through the structural nitrogen approach and extra source measures, and that no drempelwaarde is introduced.
25 kilometres is the maximum distance up to which calculated deposition contributions are reasonably attributable to a project.
25 kilometer is de maximale afstand tot waar berekende depositiebijdragen redelijkerwijs toerekenbaar zijn aan een project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Thijssen over het webartikel 'Grenswaarden stikstof ter discussie'

MPs Bromet and Thijssen asked the minister about a web article claiming nitrogen critical-load ranges are unreliable and that habitat quality declines below the threshold, and why the official report reads differently. The minister answers that the article's conclusions are not in the report, that only the empirical part is reliable while the statistical part is only plausible, and that no policy change is needed now, while the results are being fed into a European review of critical loads.
The conclusions from the report do not for now give reason to tighten the emission reduction targets.
De conclusies uit het rapport geven vooralsnog geen aanleiding om de emissiereductiedoelstellingen aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over Nederland dat relatief meer bomen kapt dan Brazilië

MP Vestering (PvdD) asked the minister whether Dutch forest felling is relatively greater than Brazil's, whether 3,400 ha of compensation forest is truly 'extra', whether the replanting exemption for Natura 2000 felling should be removed, and how compensation, biodiversity and CO2 accounting are handled. Minister Schouten answered substantively on most points, committing to evaluate the forest chapter of the Wet natuurbescherming and to compensate past felling retroactively, while declining to say how much out-of-network felling was offset inside the Natuurnetwerk and stating the questions could not be answered within the deadline due to summer recess.
I intend to evaluate the chapter 'houtopstanden' in the Nature Conservation Act.
Ik ben voornemens het hoofdstuk «houtopstanden» in de Wet natuurbescherming te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het artikel 'Stikstofrapporten drama voor boer en natuur'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, through several questions, whether a nitrogen report would increase biodiversity, whether a claimed peatland area and its buyout costs exist, whether nature targets are feasible, and whether ammonia levels on the Veluwe are lower than elsewhere, and asked about funding and accountability for a report. The minister answered that the report is too high-level to quantify effects yet, that the peat area exists and was re-surveyed, that targets were assessed for feasibility, that ammonia figures are lower on the Veluwe, and that the funding conditions were met with no reason to reclaim money.
The report was prepared in a sound manner and deserves to be taken seriously in the further elaboration of nitrogen policy.
Het rapport is op een gedegen wijze tot stand gekomen en verdient het om serieus te worden genomen bij de nadere invulling van het stikstofbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het artikel ‘Gebiedsgerichte aanpak één grote leugen?’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about an article claiming nitrogen policy and area-based approach are a lie, covering ammonia deposition distance, buyouts of polluting farms, and measurement data. The minister responds that ammonia and nitrogen oxides deposit near the source, that buyout schemes address peak polluters, that monitoring data are publicly available, and that the policy is well founded.
The articles referred to in the questions give me no reason to doubt the justification of the nitrogen policy.
De artikelen waarin in de vragen wordt gerefereerd geven mij geen reden om te twijfelen aan de onderbouwing van het stikstofbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de wijze waarop de stikstofdepositie berekend wordt en de vergelijking met de kritische depositiewaarden

An MP (Bisschop, SGP) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether critical deposition values for active raised bogs, and the way nitrogen deposition is modelled per hexagon, overstate exceedance where trees and forest edges occur. The minister partly agrees, explains that the bog values are a midpoint expert judgment and that forest-edge effects are correctly modelled, rejects a correction, and commits to expanding dry-deposition monitoring and to considering tree belts in area-based measures.
There is no reason for such a correction.
Voor zo'n correctie bestaat geen aanleiding.

Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Vestering over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Noord-Nederland dat voor het gebruik van landbouwgif, ontwatering en beregening rond Natura 2000-gebieden een natuurvergunning nodig is

MP Vestering asked the minister whether a court ruling requires farms using pesticides, drainage or irrigation near Natura 2000 areas to obtain nature permits, and asked about enforcement and health risks. The minister answered that she awaits the province's appeal before interpreting the ruling, pointed to the Habitats Directive permit rule for significant effects, and referred to pesticide reduction programmes and a planned pilot on toxicity pressure.
It is appropriate for me to await the continuation of this concrete legal proceeding before I can arrive at an interpretation of this matter.
Het past mij om het vervolg van deze concrete rechtsgang af te wachten, voordat ik tot een interpretatie van deze kwestie kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht Exotische huisdieren blijken reservoir van zoönosen

An MP asked the minister about an AAP report finding zoonoses in exotic pets and the adequacy of EU animal health rules, and about a positive list for pets. The minister said the risk is not yet assessed, that EU rules focus on trade and disease listing with the Animal Health Regulation addressing zoonoses, and promised a review of a possible ban on trade in certain species and the advisory list for mammals this autumn.
I cannot currently form a judgement on the portion (one in ten) of non-domesticated species reported by Stichting AAP where zoonoses were found.
Ik kan op dit moment geen oordeel vormen over het door Stichting AAP genoemde gedeelte (één op de tien) van niet-gedomesticeerde diersoorten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de eerdere antwoorden op vragen over de brief ‘Hoe moet het verder met de ontwikkeling van het Wierdense Veld’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Wierdense Veld peat bog restoration, including validation of provincial ecological and hydrological studies, cost estimates, the Eurocommissioner meeting report, and nitrogen measures. The minister answered that validating studies falls outside her responsibility and refers to the province, that no report of the Eurocommissioner meeting was made, that costs cannot yet be estimated for the nitrogen-law measures, and that the minister will not anticipate the regional process; she did commit to pointing to available nitrogen-sensitivity maps.
Validating studies for the design and management of Natura 2000 areas does not fall under my responsibility.
Het valideren van onderzoeken voor de inrichting en het beheer van Natura 2000-gebieden behoort niet tot mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de afschuwelijke onverdoofde slacht van tienduizenden dieren tijdens het Offerfeest en het toezicht hierop

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about illegal unstunned slaughter of animals during the Feast of Sacrifice (Offerfeest), including enforcement measures, past cases, NVWA inspection capacity and the number of slaughterhouses involved. The minister answered that mobile NVWA teams monitor for illegal slaughter, described past prosecutions and penalties, stated that inspection capacity is deployed on a risk basis, and gave the 2021 inspector numbers and slaughterhouse participation.
Because the NVWA does not publicly name the slaughterhouses that slaughter for the Feast of Sacrifice, the requested figures have not been specified further.
Omdat de NVWA de slachthuizen die ten behoeve van het Offerfeest slachten niet met naam naar buiten brengt, zijn de gevraagde cijfers niet nader gespecificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Rooiseizoen voor biologische aardappeltelers in rook op door schimmelziekte’

An MP asked the minister about resistant organic potato varieties, why organic growers do not use them more, and whether new breeding techniques such as CRISPR-Cas could speed up Phytophthora resistance, given the EU organic target and the potato covenant. The minister answered that 23 resistant varieties exist and cover 80% of organic potatoes, that the sector drives breeding and the covenant targets are not yet met, that new techniques are excluded in organic farming, and that no significant food security effect is expected.
I am willing to contribute to this with additional research if desired.
Ik wil hier met aanvullend onderzoek aan bijdragen indien gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het met spoed opvangen van schapen die zijn aangetroffen bij illegale slachtplaats tijdens het Offerfeest

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asked the Minister of Agriculture about the NVWA's discovery of illegal unstunned slaughter of sheep at a Gelderland farm during the Feast of Sacrifice, and why 18 remaining sheep were not seized and moved to a shelter. The Minister answered that the animals were healthy, identified and registered, so there was no legal basis for seizure, that proceedings were drawn up against the farm owner and the buyer, and that the owner decides whether the animals are slaughtered.
There is no legal basis to seize these animals.
Er is geen wettelijke grond om deze dieren in beslag te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van den Berg over het artikel “Vissen in windpark nu al kansloos” dat onlangs verscheen in de Provinciale Zeeuwse Courant

Two CDA MPs asked the minister why staandwant and jigging were excluded from an experimental fishing project in the Borssele offshore wind farm, and whether this fits a project meant to generate knowledge. The minister answered that these gear types are excluded because safety and ecological suitability have not been shown, that knowledge can be gathered outside the wind farm, and that the government will develop a policy framework and remains open to supporting fishers.
It is only not permitted to experiment in wind energy areas with fishing gear for which it has not been shown that it can be operated safely and included in the BAS.
Het is alleen niet toegestaan in windenergiegebieden te experimenteren met vistuigen waarvan niet is aangetoond dat deze veilig uitgevoerd kunnen worden en hiermee in het BAS kunnen worden opgenomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de recente vacature voor een beleidsmedewerker op het ministerie

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of LNV, through 21 questions, about a ministry job advertisement that framed agriculture and nature as clashing, cited Commissioner Timmermans, and omitted agriculture and fisheries knowledge requirements. The minister answered every question, defending the advertisement's wording, stating that agriculture and fisheries remain important, and admitting the ministry does not record staff agricultural backgrounds.
It is not known how many employees have a demonstrable and practical background in agriculture and/or fisheries.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel medewerkers een aantoonbare en praktische achtergrond hebben in de landbouw en/of visserij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over de aanleg van een elektriciteitskabel door een kwetsbaar stuk van het Werelderfgoed Waddenzee

MPs Van Raan and Vestering (PvdD) asked the government about routing an offshore electricity cable through the vulnerable Wadden Sea World Heritage area, including Schiermonnikoog, and why the Eemshaven West route was chosen over Eemshaven East. The State Secretary answered that no route decision is final, that a second-phase environmental assessment and further studies will be completed before any irreversible steps, and that the government considers the wider energy transition and future connections in its choice.
In the meantime, I am not taking any irreversible steps.
In de tussentijd neem ik geen onomkeerbare stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Valstar over het ontwerp-weigeringsbesluit omtrent het aardwarmteproject Californië Lipzig Gielen Geothermie (hierna: CLG)

MPs Erkens and Valstar asked the government about the draft refusal decision on the CLG geothermal project, regional geothermal use and seismic risk, future capacity, licensing statistics, the Roer Valley rift, German comparisons and follow-up on SodM contacts. The State Secretary answered each question, explained that the refusal was based on safety uncertainties, and committed to a letter on geothermal risk policy within months.
The Climate Agreement, Built Environment section, sets an ambition of 40 PJ of sustainable heat.
Het Klimaatakkoord, onderdeel Gebouwde Omgeving, is een ambitie van 40 PJ duurzame warmte
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Rechtelijke uitspraak maakt van natuurvoorzorgsprincipe het verlammingsprincipe’

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the minister whether a court ruling on the Natura 2000 precautionary principle, which found the province of Drenthe had not sufficiently shown that drainage and pesticide use posed no significant risk, would make ordinary farm and household activities subject to permits and whether the precautionary principle should be amended. The minister answered that the case is ongoing on appeal, that the rule only applies to activities with significant harmful effects, and that the precautionary principle derives from the EU Habitats Directive and case law, so no amendment is planned.
It befits me to await the continuation of this concrete legal proceeding before I can arrive at an interpretation of this issue
Het past mij om het vervolg van deze concrete rechtsgang af te wachten, voordat ik tot een interpretatie van deze kwestie kan komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het ondeskundig doden en de daardoor veroorzaakte lijdensweg voor de grote grazers van Stichting Taurus

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the botched killing of large grazers at Stichting Taurus, the legal and inspection framework for such culls, dioxin levels in their meat, and related subsidy and oversight questions. The Minister acknowledged the video showed inadequate killing and said the NVWA is investigating, while stating that no additional structural measures are currently planned and promising a report in early 2022.
I disapprove of the way this cull was carried out, as seen in the footage.
Ik keur de wijze waarop dit afschot is uitgevoerd, zoals te zien op de beelden, af.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink naar aanleiding van de technische toelichting op 12 mei 2021 aan de vaste commissie voor Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de aanpak van de stikstofproblematiek

The MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the technical briefing on nitrogen policy, covering the share of foreign nitrogen deposition, sector breakdowns, measurement uncertainty, critical deposition values and drivers of biodiversity loss. Minister Schouten answered each of the 13 questions with data from RIVM and AERIUS, providing substantive figures and explanations while declining to produce some requested overviews by pointing to the absence of a databank or pending reports.
There is no databank showing in which nature areas (including Natura 2000 areas) soil studies have been carried out regularly over the past thirty years.
Er is geen databank waaruit blijkt in welke natuurgebieden (waaronder Natura 2000-gebieden) de afgelopen dertig jaar regelmatig bodemonderzoeken zijn gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over LTO Noord wil verlenging mest uitrijden vanwege hevige regenval

Questions from MP Boswijk (CDA) ask whether the minister knows that heavy rainfall has hampered manure spreading in the North of the Netherlands, whether this is acknowledged, what obligations apply, and whether the minister will grant LTO Noord's request to extend the manure-spreading period by two weeks. The item is marked as withdrawn (ingetrokken) on 1 September 2021, so no government answer is present in the text.
The written questions from MP Boswijk (CDA) on LTO Noord wants extension of manure spreading due to heavy rainfall were withdrawn on 1 September 2021.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Boswijk (CDA) over LTO Noord wil verlenging mest uitrijden vanwege hevige regenval zijn op 1 september 2021 ingetrokken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over uitrijtermijn voor vaste mest en drijfmest in respectievelijk Limburg en Friesland

An MP asked the minister about manure spreading deadlines in Limburg and Friesland after heavy rain, including extending the solid manure period on loess and making it match the slurry period. The minister confirmed awareness, requested Technical Soil Commission advice on a Limburg extension, deferred structural changes to the Nitrates Directive action programme, and granted a regional slurry exemption in ten Frisian municipalities until 15 September 2021.

Exemption or extension of the spreading period can under the Soil Protection Act only be granted insofar as the interest of soil protection does not oppose it and advice has been requested from the Technical Soil Commission (TCB).

Vrijstelling of het verruimen van de uitrijdperiode kan op basis van de Wet bodembescherming alleen worden verleend voor zover het belang van de bescherming van de bodem zich daartegen niet verzet en er advies gevraagd is bij de Technische Commissie Bodem (TCB).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Werner over het bericht ‘Schaapsherders in de knel: er zijn er nog maar een paar over en subsidie komt niet bij hen terecht’

MPs Boswijk and Werner asked whether only four independent shepherds remain, whether shepherding is on the national intangible heritage list, and how the government will secure their survival given that subsidies flow mainly to nature organisations and provinces. The minister answered that traditional flocks number about fifty, that shepherding is on the national inventory, that subsidies come mainly from provinces and the CAP grazing scheme, and that a national scheme for rare breeds is planned for 2023-2027, without guaranteeing survival of each flock.
The whole set of support for traditionally shepherded sheep flocks, as outlined in my letter of January 2019, contributes to the maintenance of shepherded sheep flocks in the Netherlands.
Het geheel aan ondersteuning van traditioneel gescheperde schaapskuddes, zoals geschetst in mijn brief van januari 2019, draagt bij aan de instandhouding van gescheperde schaapskuddes in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over ‘Uiterlijk 16 juli besluit over heropening Gosschalk’ en ‘Slachthuis Gosschalk blijkt onverbeterlijk’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the reopening of slaughterhouse Gosschalk after animal welfare abuses, including whether the plant could realistically fix problems in such a short time, staff training, slaughter speed, past enforcement failures, and whether it should be permanently closed. The Minister answered that the NVWA reopened the plant under intensified supervision after the fifth plan of action was found sufficient, and that the slaughter speed is being restricted in a phased way pending further research.
With my letter today I inform the House that the NVWA will lift the suspension of the slaughterhouse's approval with effect from 31 August.
Met mijn brief van heden informeer ik uw Kamer dat de NVWA met ingang van 31 augustus a.s. de schorsing van de erkenning als slachthuis opheft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over pulsvergunningen

An MP asked the minister how future incompatibilities between parliamentary wishes and EU rules on pulse fishing licences could be brought to parliament's attention, and what the effects were of extra licences on the level playing field and on relations with France. The minister acknowledged that warnings were ignored and that incompatibility with EU law should be flagged, but rejected a separate reporting paragraph, and argued that the pulse gear gave Dutch fishers an advantage without distorting competition.
Given the political and societal pressure, these signals were not acted upon at the time. That is not good and lessons must be learned from it.
Gezien de politieke en maatschappelijke druk zijn deze signalen destijds niet opgepakt. Dat is niet goed en daar moet van geleerd worden.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Vestering over het betrekken van ook dieren in de nood- en evacuatieplannen voor de overstroomde gebieden in Limburg

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how animals are included in emergency and evacuation plans for flooded areas of Limburg, what measures were taken to evacuate farm and wild animals, and where they were moved. The Minister answered that the Landelijk Crisisplan and a 2014 evacuation guideline assign animal keepers primary responsibility with government facilitation, outlined RVO and sector-organisation support and relaxed registration obligations, and described evacuation locations and rest measures for wild animals.
I am looking together with RVO and NVWA at how this will be implemented.
Ik kijk met RVO en NVWA samen naar de invulling hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het project ‘Wisselpolder Westhoek’ waarin vruchtbare [landbouwgrond] wordt ‘teruggegeven’ aan de Waddenzee

Parliamentary questions from MP Boswijk (CDA) asked whether the 'Wisselpolder Westhoek' project would convert fertile farmland into nature and Natura 2000 land, and how farming interests and earlier stakeholder involvement were being safeguarded. The minister answered that the idea is one of many under a still-open area process led by the province, with no decision taken, and that a broader impact analysis and agreements to return the land to farming would be considered.
Wetterskip Fryslân has collected nearly 200 ideas on and around the sea dike between Koehool and Lauwersmeer.
Het Wetterskip Fryslân heeft bijna 200 ideeën opgehaald op en rond de zeedijk tussen Koehool en Lauwersmeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, De Neef en Valstar over de mishandeling en het dumpen van huisdieren

MPs Ellian, De Neef and Valstar asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about rising animal abuse and dumping of pets during the coronavirus crisis and what the government would do. The minister answered that reports rose in 2020 but shelters saw no national increase in intake, outlined existing reporting and expertise arrangements, and said the animal-abuse ownership ban bill had been submitted to parliament.
The bill was submitted to your House on 15 July.
Het wetsvoorstel is op 15 juli jl. bij uw Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het onderzoek naar stikstofdepositie en kritische depositiewaarden

An MP from JA21 asked the minister whether soil-based nitrogen fixation, allegedly the largest nitrogen source, is excluded from nitrogen policy, and whether the government would commission further studies. The minister answered that the Antwerp study yields no new insights, that soil nitrogen flows are already accounted for in critical deposition values, and that no further study is needed.
No, the results have not yielded any new scientific insights.
Nee, de resultaten hebben geen nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de ophokplicht voor vrije-uitloopkippen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why a nationwide bird-flu housing order for free-range hens remained when neighbouring countries had lifted theirs, and posed questions on regional differentiation, compensation, vaccination and flock size. The minister explained that the order was lifted in regions and then nationwide on 6 July based on expert risk assessments, that compensation is not given for consequential damage, that vaccination is not yet opportune, and that the broader flock-reduction question is left to a new cabinet.
Based partly on the assessment of the expert group on animal diseases, I examined per region whether I could lift the housing order.
Ik heb, mede op basis van de beoordeling van de deskundigengroep dierziekten, per regio bekeken of ik de ophokplicht kon opheffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Wassenberg over een eventuele subsidieaanvraag voor Kroondomein Het Loo

MPs Sneller and Wassenberg asked whether a new subsidy application for maintenance of Kroondomein Het Loo had been received, and when it would be shared with parliament. The minister replied that no application has been received yet, that the Chamber will be sent the subsidy framework before any application, and that applications must be submitted by 31 December 2021 for subsidy from 1 January 2022.
I will give effect to the above commitment by sending you the framework with the subsidy conditions against which any application will be assessed, before any possible application.
Ik zal invulling aan bovenstaande toezegging geven door u voorafgaande aan een eventuele aanvraag het kader met de subsidievoorwaarden te sturen, waaraan de aanvraag getoetst zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel ‘Stikstofstrijder Johan Vollenbroek: provincie moet boeren zonder vergunning aanpakken’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a newspaper report urging provinces to act against farmers operating without permits, and about the legalisation of PAS-melders and interim-mers whose activities were allowed under previous rules. The minister replied that legalisation was not postponed indefinitely, that talks with provinces on interim-mers are underway, and that there will be no active enforcement by competent authorities while legalisation proceeds.
At the same time I have indicated that there will be no active enforcement by the competent authorities.
Tegelijkertijd heb ik aangegeven dat er geen actieve handhaving plaats zal vinden door de bevoegde gezagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bontenbal over koolstofvastlegging

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked the Minister of Agriculture about the potential of carbon sequestration in agriculture, how carbon farming can improve farmers' earnings, whether Commissioner Timmermans' view that the Netherlands is unsuitable for large-scale soil carbon storage is shared, what support is offered to farmers, and what a proposed AFOLU merger could mean for the agricultural sector. The minister answered each question in substance, giving sequestration estimates, outlining revenue options, describing support programmes and pilots, and stating that the AFOLU implications are still being assessed and will be reported to parliament via the BNC route.
Parliament will be further informed about this via the BNC route.
Uw Kamer zal via de BNC-route hier nader over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de aanpak van waterwaaier en ongelijkbladig vederkruid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister how invasive waterweed and Cabomba are managed, their ecological and recreational effects, and whether national rules, funding and provincial scaling-up are needed. The minister answered substantively on effects and EU rules, said a strategic approach and evaluation are underway, and gave no cost estimate or commitment to new national rules.
Therefore LNV is working with the relevant sub-national governments and other parties on a strategic approach, in which choices are made and priorities set.
Daarom werkt LNV samen met betrokken medeoverheden en andere partijen aan een strategische aanpak, waarbij keuzes worden gemaakt en prioriteiten worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het onderzoek naar stikstofdepositie en kritische depositiewaarden

The MP asks the minister whether soil nitrogen stored in nature areas, and nitrogen released by felling forest or converting nature, is being kept out of view in nitrogen policy, and questions the scientific basis of the nitrogen measures and their cost. The minister answers that only external deposition is relevant to the ecosystem balance, that soil-derived uptake is far smaller than claimed, and that the scientific basis is not doubted, so no further study is needed.
The release of nitrogen is in itself not a problem, as long as it remains part of the cycle.
Het beschikbaar komen van stikstof is op zich geen probleem, zolang het maar onderdeel is van de kringloop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Rechterlijke uitspraak maakt van natuurvoorzorgsprincipe het verlammingsprincipe’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the potential consequences of a Northern Netherlands court ruling requiring the province of Drenthe to show that drainage and pesticide use near a Natura 2000 area have no significant effects, and whether this would require permits for nearly all economic activity. The minister replied that the province, as competent authority, must still decide on next steps, that the ruling concerns a local case, that she is not aware of similar cases elsewhere, and that she will await the outcome before assessing the wider impact.
It is appropriate for me to await the next steps in this concrete legal proceeding before I can arrive at an interpretation of this matter and determine which steps are needed to map out the impact.

Het past mij om het vervolg van deze concrete rechtsgang af te wachten, voordat ik tot een interpretatie van deze kwestie kan komen en kan bepalen welke stappen nodig zijn om de impact in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht 'Stikstofdepositie geen bedreiging voor natuur in uiterwaarden'

Mulder (PVV) asks whether nitrogen deposition really poses no threat to nature in floodplains, whether critical deposition values there should be dropped, and whether the basis of nitrogen policy is too weak. The minister rejects the generalized conclusion, explains that critical deposition values for supplementary habitat types were set provisionally and are being corrected via mapping rounds, and says she does not share the view that the policy basis is seriously deficient.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht 'EU-commissie ergert food- en agribusiness'

An MP from the PVV asks the agriculture minister whether the European Commission's Farm to Fork strategy is being adopted without a proper impact assessment, and whether the Netherlands will withdraw support until one is published. The minister replies that a technical study is still ongoing, that each legislative element will get its own impact assessment and be submitted to parliament via the usual channel, and that the Dutch government will not withdraw its support since the strategy broadly aligns with cabinet policy.

Each legislative element of the Farm to Fork strategy will be accompanied by an impact assessment, and I will inform your House through the usual channel about the intended cabinet position on each element.

De uitwerking van elk wetgevingsonderdeel van de Van boer tot bord-strategie wordt voorzien van een effectbeoordeling en ik zal uw Kamer via de gebruikelijke weg over de voorgenomen kabinetspositie per onderdeel informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Column: Boeren krijgen sancties, natuurorganisaties een 'goed gesprek''

Rep. Boswijk (CDA) asked the minister why farmers in grassland bird-conservation schemes face repeated NVWA inspections and sanctions while nature organisations get only remedy periods and a certificate system; the minister answered that inspections follow the EU control rules and the subsidy system, that organisations are certified by Stichting Certificering SNL with remedy offered first, and that the NVWA's inspections and the GLB greening penalties follow set procedures with figures given. The answers are largely detailed and substantive but describe existing procedures rather than new commitments.
Regarding grassland bird management, the NVWA does not carry out inspections at nature organisations, because grassland bird management by nature organisations is fully nationally financed.
Met betrekking tot weidevogelbeheer voert de NVWA geen controles uit bij natuurorganisaties, omdat weidevogelbeheer door natuurorganisaties volledig nationaal wordt gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de berichten 'Weidevogels kunnen door roofdieren  fluiten naar nakomelingen' en 'Goed predatiebeheer behoudt grutto’s in Limburg'

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether predation of ground-nesting birds is a problem requiring national action, whether permit procedures for culling are too slow, and what national steps will be taken. The minister answered that predation is handled by the provinces through area-based management, that the provinces do not recognise the permit delay, and offered to consult the provinces on predation by predators and cats.
The competence to take measures to protect ground-nesting birds against predation lies with the provinces.
De bevoegdheid tot het nemen van maatregelen voor de bescherming van weidevogels tegen predatie ligt bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het verbod op pulsvisserij in de Europese Unie

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the Dutch pulse fishing ban should be reversed after the European Court upheld it, and what the government had done to protect Dutch pulse fishers, including whether further research and a regional approach could allow pulse trawling again. Minister Schouten answered that the Court's ruling stands, that the government had long opposed the ban and will keep raising the issue in the technical measures report, but that ICES has already assessed the science, a joint regional recommendation is unlikely, and reopening the debate or funding new research is not opportune.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de ophokplicht en de gevolgen daarvan voor Nederlandse pluimveehouders

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about the avian influenza housing order (ophokplicht) and its effect on free-range egg producers' status, plus related questions on the UWV disability reassessment affair. The answers, given by minister Koolmees for Social Affairs, mostly concern UWV's handling of reassessments, expressing regret for the impact on affected people and pointing to individual remedies, evaluations and planned reports rather than addressing the poultry sector questions.
There has been too little attention to the impact the decisions had on individual people's lives, such as the stress and uncertainty that resulted.
Er is te weinig oog geweest voor de impact die de beslissingen op de afzonderlijke levens van mensen hadden, zoals de stress en onzekerheid die er het gevolg van waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over het lage btw-tarief op sierteeltproducten

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked the government about the reduced 9% VAT rate on ornamental horticulture products, questioning its original justifications, its environmental impact, reliance on migrant labour, and whether it should continue. Minister Schouten answered that the reduced rate remains justified for affordability and sector support, that the sector's pesticide use per hectare has declined, and that a broad evaluation of the reduced rate will take place in 2022.
A broad evaluation of the reduced VAT rate, including ornamental horticulture, will take place in 2022.
Er zal in 2022 een brede evaluatie van het lage btw-tarief, inclusief sierteelt, plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de geitenhouderij en het leed van geitenbokjes

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about animal welfare in goat farming, including early slaughter of kid goats, short-term transport, colostrum provision, registration rules, housing and a subsidy for a new goat barn. The minister answers each question, acknowledging the registration tightening and a subsidy under review, but says data are not yet conclusive and no new legal obligations on housing or colostrum are planned.
At this moment, however, it is still too early to draw conclusions about the impact of the amended I&R obligation.
Op dit moment is het echter nog te vroeg om conclusies te trekken over de impact van de gewijzigde I&R-plicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Smeulders over de funderingsproblematiek in Friesland en over het artikel 'Provincie Fryslân gaat huiseigenaren betrekken bij oplossen funderingsschade'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about foundation damage in Friesland caused by lowered water tables in peat meadow areas, and about the responsibility, legal framework and lack of data on affected homes. The minister explained that water boards and municipalities bear care duties, that compensation depends on whether a water-level change is lawful and natural subsidence, that no research on the specific problem exists, and that the cabinet's response to the advisory report was sent to the House.
No research is currently being carried out to map this specific problem.
Er wordt op dit moment geen onderzoek uitgevoerd om deze specifieke problematiek in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over de aangenomen resoluties 74 en 76 bij stemmingen in het Europees Parlement over de EU Biodiversiteitstrategie

An MP asks the minister about European Parliament resolutions calling for limits on bottom trawling and super trawlers and what this means for the Dutch cutter fleet. The minister answers that the North Sea Accord governs, that the fleet must adapt and become more sustainable through the kottervisie, and that the EU fisheries policy is based on MSY rather than vessel size.
For me, the agreements in the North Sea Accord are leading.
Voor mij zijn de afspraken in het Noordzee Akkoord leidend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over nieuwe Europese wetgeving, die een bedreiging vormt voor Nederlandse garnalenvissers

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how she would respond to a European Parliament resolution that could ban bottom trawling and threaten Dutch shrimp fishers, and how to inform MEPs better. The minister answered that the resolution is a non-binding call, that the Noordzee Akkoord guides her position, and that a shrimp vision is being developed with the sector, but declined to influence the independent European Parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de toekomst van de Nederlandse kottervisserij

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the European Parliament's call to restrict bottom trawling in coastal areas and the threat to the Dutch coastal fleet. The Minister acknowledged the resolution, said stocks have improved but cod and sea bass remain concerning, and promised continued contact with the fishing sector without committing to a concrete new step.
There is intensive contact and consultation with the fisheries sector on the various European dossiers.
Er is over de verschillende Europese dossiers intensief contact en overleg met de visserijsector.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Kent over het bericht dat illegale schoonmaakmiddelen gebruikt worden in de luchtvaartindustrie

An SP MP asks why illegal, allegedly prohibited and hazardous cleaning agents are used to disinfect aircraft when approved alternatives exist, and whether the ministers agreed to the exemptions. The state secretary answers that no authorised biocide could be used on aircraft surfaces, so temporary exemptions were granted on Ctgb advice with conditions, that RIVM advises ordinary cleaning, and that the employer and Inspectie SZW are responsible for worker safety.
I am authorised to grant an exemption if a need for it is established.
Ik ben bevoegd een vrijstelling te verlenen indien hiervoor een noodzaak wordt vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het Kinderklimaatakkoord

An MP asked ministers about the Children's Climate Agreement, its proposals (dike and dune strengthening, eating less meat, replacing felled trees), rising meat consumption and forest loss, and what further measures will be taken. The state secretary answers that the government is willing to meet the children's delegation, points to existing climate and nature policy and youth consultation, and says further tree-planting ambitions are for a future cabinet to decide.
Are you willing to talk with the delegation coming to The Hague to present the Children's Climate Agreement to national politics?
Bent u bereid om in gesprek te gaan met de afvaardiging die naar Den Haag komt om het Kinderklimaatakkoord aan te bieden aan de landelijke politiek?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over laagvliegende vliegtuigen die vogels verstoren tijdens het broedseizoen

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked whether low-flying military transport aircraft disturb breeding birds and whether this complies with nature protection law, and why military exercises cannot be moved abroad during COVID measures. The State Secretary answers that a 2018 preliminary assessment found military flights above 3,000 ft not disturbing, that low-level flights are conditional on avoiding important breeding areas, and that permit applications for some areas are in preparation, while refusing to halt exercises during the breeding season.
For temporary restricted areas that are regularly used for an exercise, a permit application is being prepared.
Voor tijdelijke gebieden met beperkingen die met regelmaat in gebruik zijn voor een oefening is een vergunningaanvraag in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Hoe stikstofhandel de BV Brabant opnieuw in gevaar brengt: ‘Er is iets gruwelijk mis’’

An MP asked the Minister whether the province of Noord-Brabant is using bought-out farms' nitrogen rights for purposes other than nature restoration, including sales by auction, and whether the province can oversee the trade. The Minister said the province sold nitrogen space in one case by public sale, that proceeds flow to the nature budget, that she disapproves of provinces trading nitrogen space themselves, and that she cannot verify fraud claims or comment on individual cases.
However, I do not think it is right for provinces themselves to act as traders on such a platform, offering and purchasing nitrogen space.
Ik vind het echter niet goed als provincies zelf als handelaren op zo’n platform stikstofruimte gaan aanbieden en inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk en het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘LNV wijst oplossing Borkumse Stenen van de hand’

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder asked the minister whether a large closed fishing area north of Schiermonnikoog is set to take effect, why the Dutch fishers' federation's alternative plan for the Borkumse Stenen area was rejected, what alternative LNV proposed, and what the next steps are. The minister answered that the 558 km2 extension in the North Sea Agreement is targeted for 2022 but depends on EU procedures, that the fishers' alternative reduces area and ecological value, and that any boundary change needs consent of all North Sea Agreement partners.
The aim is to implement the measures as quickly as possible.
Inzet is om de maatregelen zo snel als mogelijk uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte’

Rep. Van der Plas (BBB) asked the ministers of Interior and Agriculture about the PBL report 'Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte', questioning its omissions on food production, its treatment of farmland, housing targets, solar and wind land claims, and datacenter space. The ministers answered that the PBL is independent, that the report takes existing policy as its baseline, and that the housing figure derives from the National Environmental Vision and Primos projections.
The PBL report 'Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte' focuses on the spatial choices the new cabinet must make.
Het PBL-rapport «Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte» richt zich op de ruimtelijke keuzes die het nieuwe kabinet moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de meest giftige pesticiden die nog op de Europese markt zijn toegelaten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about pesticides on the EU substitution list that are persistent, bioaccumulative or highly toxic, the use of comparative assessments, and whether the Ctgb considers non-chemical alternatives, including the case of difenoconazole. The Minister answered that 98 substances are currently on the list (26 no longer approved), that 33 comparative assessments have been started with 8 completed without withdrawing any product, that the Ctgb does not disclose ongoing applications, and that the Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030 aims to reduce pesticide use, with a pending EU proposal to simplify comparative assessment.
The Ctgb does not provide information on ongoing applications, because this concerns commercially confidential information.
Het Ctgb verstrekt geen informatie over lopende aanvragen, omdat dit bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Geurts over de mentale gezondheid van agrarische ondernemers

MPs Boswijk and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture about rising suicide rates among farmers and the gap between farmers and regular mental health care, and what more should be done. The Minister acknowledged the problem, described subsidised projects and sector initiatives to bridge the gap, said a structural follow-up approach and a central referral desk were being prepared, and promised to inform the House once the approach is set.
Once the structural follow-up approach is known and established, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra de structurele vervolgaanpak bekend is en vastgesteld, zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over jachtactiviteiten in gebieden waar wolven zijn gevestigd

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether boar hunting and population management in wolf habitat (Veluwe) comply with EU Habitats Directive protection duties, including disturbance of breeding wolves and damage to wolf dens. The Minister answers that hunting and population management are permitted under approved management plans, that experts see no negative effect on wolves, and that the province is the competent authority for permits and enforcement.
It is then up to the competent authority to enforce and supervise compliance with the conditions attached to the exemption granted under the Nature Conservation Act.

Het is vervolgens aan het bevoegd gezag om te handhaven en toe te zien op de naleving van de voorschriften die aan de ontheffing die op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming wordt verleend zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het verhoogde risico op Parkinson door het levenslange gebruik van melkproducten

An MP asked the minister whether lifelong dairy consumption raises Parkinson's risk, whether pesticide residues in feed could explain it, and whether MRLs, neurotoxicity testing and feed standards are adequate. The minister answered that the studies show an association rather than causation, that feed is covered by safety rules and pesticide approval assesses consumer exposure including neurotoxicity, and that the government has asked EFSA and RIVM to screen and improve testing, but did not commit to new MRLs for feed.
Earlier this year I asked the RIVM to carry out an exploration of options to improve the risk assessment for approving active substances in plant protection products with regard to neurotoxicity.

Ik heb begin dit jaar het RIVM gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de mogelijkheden om de risicobeoordeling bij de goedkeuring van werkzame stoffen in gewasbeschermingsmiddelen te verbeteren met betrekking tot neurotoxiciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het verdwijnen van een boom met een kolonie zeldzame vliegende herten op Kroondomein Het Loo

An MP asked the minister about the felling of an oak on Kroondomein Het Loo that hosted a colony of stag beetles, and whether protections were breached and the King should be held to account. The minister answered that the tree was dead, that RVO found no shortcomings, that no permit was needed, and that no compensation or action against the King was required, while noting planned improvements to written management records.
No errors came to light during the inspection.
Bij de inspectie zijn geen fouten aan het licht gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht `Steekproef- Veel vishandelaren maken er een potje van en informeren hun klanten slecht'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a Consumentenbond survey finding that most fishmongers fail to give required product information and rarely carry sustainability labels, including inspection frequency and enforcement plans. The minister answered that labelling duties are partly EU-mandated, that NVWA inspections focus on food safety every two to three years, that no enforcement action is warranted, and that the sector will be encouraged to improve information provision.
Violations of the statutory labelling obligations under the Common Market Organisation pose no risk to the safety or health of people, animals or the ecosystem.
Overtredingen op de wettelijke etiketteringsverplichtingen uit de Gemeenschappelijke Marktordening, leveren geen risico op voor veiligheid of gezondheid van mensen, dieren of het ecosysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Nederland raakt met landbouw-innovaties achter op China’

MPs Valstar and Van Campen asked whether Dutch agricultural biotechnology (CRISPR-Cas) is falling behind China and the US due to outdated EU rules, and what the government is doing to relax EU GMO regulation for plants. The ministers answered that CRISPR-Cas patent publications are lower in Europe, that the Commission study confirms current GMO rules need adapting, that the Netherlands is lobbying for a derogation, though the EU has not granted one.

The cabinet will continue to stress the urgency of this subject and continue to advocate for future-proof European regulation that leaves sufficient room for innovation while safeguarding human and environmental safety.

Het kabinet zal de urgentie van dit onderwerp blijven benadrukken en blijven pleiten voor toekomstbestendige Europese regelgeving die voldoende ruimte biedt voor innovatie en tegelijkertijd de veiligheid voor mens en milieu borgt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het voornemen tot overeenkomst voor stikstofsaldering ‘Valkenhorst’ waar het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf van plan is om de stalvergunning van drie agrarische bedrijven te gebruiken vo

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a plan by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf to use the permits of three farms as nitrogen offsetting for 800 homes and a health centre at Valkenhorst, and whether this drains rural land and hampers the shift to circular farming. The minister confirmed the tender, said the land sale is at market value rather than priced per farm or per kg nitrogen, and argued that this internal offsetting within the plan area is legally accepted and not a case of distant buying-out of farm nitrogen space.
Offsetting with space from existing permits is a legally accepted way of mitigating effects when allowing projects on the basis of an appropriate assessment.
Extern salderen met ruimte uit bestaande vergunningen is een juridisch geaccepteerde wijze van mitigatie van effecten bij het toestaan van projecten op basis van een passende beoordeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Why are peat-based composts banned?’

The MP asks whether peat-based potting soil is sold in the Netherlands, how much it is used, the effects of peat extraction on CO2 emissions and groundwater, and whether the Netherlands should follow the UK ban on peat compost for hobby gardeners. The minister confirms peat is the main ingredient, notes that certified responsibly produced peat is growing in market share, gives no CO2 figures yet, and says the UK approach is not needed given the small Dutch consumer market and the EU fertiliser regulation.
I do not currently have figures available that indicate the exact effect on CO2 emissions.
Ik heb op dit moment geen cijfers beschikbaar die het exacte effect op de CO 2 -uitstoot aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de brief ‘Hoe moet het verder met de ontwikkeling van het Wierdense Veld’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the costs, farmer impacts, drinking water supply and legal basis of restoring the Wierdense Veld bog, after the province of Overijssel asked for direction. The Minister answered that restoring the bog is necessary under the Habitats Directive, that the province leads the process, and that she sees no need for independent counter-expertise.
It is therefore not necessary for me to draft such a proposal, because the province of Overijssel will already take this up.
Het is daarom niet nodig dat ik zo’n voorstel uitwerk, omdat de provincie Overijssel dit al zal oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Overvallen door stikstofmalaise; Ministerie lijkt niet klaar te zijn geweest voor crisis'

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether the ministry was prepared for the 2019 Council of State ruling on the PAS nitrogen programme, and why it took so long to assess its consequences and develop a plan B. The minister answered that scenarios were prepared, that the consequences were clear within days, that new nitrogen policy was rolled out step by step and enshrined in law, and that she saw no reason for an internal evaluation.
I see no reason to launch an investigation into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hier een onderzoek naar in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bisschop over knelgevallen in kader van het fosfaatrechtenstelsel

MPs Boswijk and Bisschop asked whether dairy farms with irreversible investment commitments that could not use their phosphate rights were excluded from the hardship category, whether a count or damage estimate exists, whether a Meststoffenwet exemption is possible, and whether such farms can be exempted. Minister Schouten answered that this group could not be clearly defined and no solution existed without extra general cuts for others, declined to make an inventory as disproportionate, and refused to reopen the exploration given the projected nitrogen overshoot.
I do not consider it useful to make the requested inventory.
Ik acht het niet zinvol de gevraagde inventarisatie te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over de ontbossing van het Amazonegebied door soja-invoer van Nederland

MPs Thijssen and Gijs van Dijk asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Foreign Affairs whether Dutch soy imports drive deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon, including whether soy from post-2008 cleared land is imported and whether importers will be held to account. The ministers answered that about 5% of Brazil's soy exports go to the Netherlands, most Dutch-bound soy is covered by sustainability certificates, and the government will push for EU-level measures such as legislation, with a proposal expected in summer 2021.

The cabinet expects companies established in the Netherlands that operate internationally to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
