Het kabinet verwacht van in Nederland gevestigde bedrijven die internationaal opereren dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen en de UN Guiding Principle's on Business and Human Rights naleven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Veehouderij schrikt van vondst giftige schimmel in partij veevoer'

The MP asked the minister about aflatoxin found in animal feed, including why detection took a month, how contaminated feed and milk were handled, and how imported feed and certificates are controlled. The minister answered that a routine quarterly sector sampling found the contamination, that affected feed and milk were blocked and milk was excluded where limits were exceeded, and that NVWA and COKZ oversight applies.
Based on the dilutions in farm milk, the NVWA was able to estimate that the limits were not exceeded in the final consumption milk.
De NVWA heeft op basis van de verdunningen in boerderijmelk kunnen inschatten dat de limieten niet werden overschreden in de uiteindelijke consumptiemelk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat de boomkorvisserij significant bijdraagt aan CO2-uitstoot

Futselaar (SP) asked the minister whether a Nature study showing bottom trawling releases significant CO2 should prompt action on Dutch climate goals, including research into curbing trawling, use of pulse fishing, and expanded protected areas. The minister said the study does not show the Dutch trawl fleet's impact on climate, pointed to Noordzeeakkoord measures and planned innovation, and promised to inform parliament on fishing measures before summer.
The extent to which the Dutch beam trawl fleet affects limiting climate change does not clearly emerge from this research.
In welke mate de Nederlandse boomkorvloot invloed heeft op het beperken van klimaatverandering komt niet duidelijk naar voren uit dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Wassenberg over CO2-uitstoot van bodemberoerende visserij, die even hoog is als de luchtvaartindustrie

MPs Teunissen and Wassenberg asked whether CO2 released from bottom trawling is counted in national emissions, whether it can be quantified, and whether the government will protect 30% of Dutch seas. The minister replied that seabed disturbance emissions are not counted nationally because IPCC rules provide no method and the CO2 share is unknown, and that protection follows the Noordzeeakkoord targets (13.7% rising to 15% by 2030) rather than 30%.
I will explore, with the State Secretary of EZK and Dutch knowledge institutions, the options for characterising the nature and severity of seabed disturbance as a source of CO2 emissions.
Ik zal in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van EZK met Nederlandse kennisinstellingen de mogelijkheden verkennen om de aard en ernst van bodemberoering als bron van CO 2 -uitstoot te duiden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht dat veel minder varkensboeren gebruikmaken van de Subsidieregeling sanering varkenshouderijen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that far fewer pig farmers than expected are using the pig farm closure subsidy, attributing this to municipalities not cooperating on land repurposing and to slow procedures. The minister denied that municipalities are obstructing, said deadlines were extended up to 1 April 2021 so farmers had six to eight months, and promised a status letter in June with updated figures.
I cannot inform the House in May as previously promised, because the expected nitrogen effect is not yet known.
Ik kan uw Kamer niet in mei informeren, zoals eerder toegezegd, omdat het verwacht stikstofeffect nog niet bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het toevoegen van illegale middelen aan traditionele medicijnen

Two MPs asked the ministers about illegal painkillers (paracetamol, meloxicam) found in the herbal supplement Montalin sold in Dutch webshops, the trade in endangered species in traditional medicines, and the need for follow-up research into the goods flow. The minister confirmed that the NVWA inspected five webshops, which stopped selling Montalin, that samples are being tested, and that follow-up research into the goods flow is complex and is being handled through existing NVWA and customs efforts.
The NVWA immediately started an investigation into the sale of Montalin in the Netherlands.
De NVWA is direct een onderzoek gestart naar de verkoop van Montalin in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Geen Q-koortsvergoeding voor een op de vijf slachtoffers'

MPs De Groot and Diertens asked about roughly 600 rejected Q-fever compensation applications (about 20%) and whether applicants were wrongly excluded. The minister replied that rejected applicants did not meet the eligibility criteria, that the scheme was broadened after consultation with parliament, and that appeal procedures and an independent medical commission already reviewed the refusals.
For the rejected applications, objection and appeal procedures were available.
Voor de afgewezen aanvragen heeft er bezwaar en beroep opengestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over 575.000 kippen die in 2020 dood aan kwamen bij het slachthuis

Party MP Vestering asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the roughly 575,000 chickens that arrived dead at slaughterhouses in 2020, including the causes, the absence of an EU norm, and the NVWA's 1% intervention threshold and enforcement record. Minister Schouten answers that DOA figures are falling, that causes are hard to establish and not registered, that the NVWA actively addresses catching injuries and imposed 11 fines and 6 warnings in 2016–2020, and that the threshold has no legal or scientific basis.
In practice it is difficult to establish unambiguously what causes the increased DOA percentage, and who can be held responsible for it.
Het is in de praktijk lastig eenduidig vast te stellen wat de oorzaak van het verhoogde DOA-percentage is, en wie hiervoor verantwoordelijk gesteld kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Paternotte over de brandbrief van de Ondernemingsraad KDS en het FNV over het stijgend aantal besmettingen in slachthuizen en het niet naleven van de coronamaatregelen

MPs De Groot and Paternotte asked ministers about a works council letter reporting rising COVID-19 infections in slaughterhouses, non-compliance with measures, and weak NVWA oversight. The minister answered that the NVWA and inspectorates use an escalation ladder, including halting inspections, and that the Apeldoorn slaughterhouse was closed temporarily and restarted under conditions, while stating she finds the reported conduct undesirable and commits to continued close monitoring.
I do not recognise that these concerns are widely shared among employees in the food industry.
Ik herken niet dat die zorgen breed gedeeld worden bij medewerkers in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over het 'per ongeluk' kappen van een beschermd bos en het kappen van bomen in het broedseizoen

MPs Wassenberg and Vestering asked the minister about the accidental felling of a protected forest and tree-cutting during the breeding season, including killed squirrels, a badger disturbance permit, and the lack of central oversight of municipal and provincial tree-felling. The minister acknowledged the Nature Conservation Act was breached, referred enforcement to the RUD Utrecht, said central regulation is not the answer but will explore changes with provinces and VNG, and committed to raising the issues with an expert group.
The investigation by the RUD is still ongoing, so the province cannot comment on it in advance of that investigation.
Het onderzoek bij de RUD is nog lopende, waardoor de provincie vooruitlopend op dit onderzoek hier niet op in kan gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Bromet, Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland een grote aanjager is van wereldwijde ontbossing

MPs asked the ministers whether the Netherlands is a major driver of global deforestation per a WNF report, and about its links to nitrogen, climate, EU trade deals (Mercosur) and import tariffs. The ministers largely contest the report's attribution to the Netherlands, cite certification schemes and EU-level measures, and promise continued EU engagement on deforestation-free supply chains.
The Netherlands faces a major task in reducing nitrogen deposition.
Nederland heeft een stevige opgave om de neerslag van stikstof terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ernstig gewonde varkens bij een exportverzamelplaats

An MP asked the minister about severely injured sows at an export collection point in Gelderland, including whether NVWA checks were carried out, why the site's approval was not suspended, and why NVWA did not enforce on the footage. The minister answered that the animals could not be identified or linked to the site, so no enforcement was possible, while confirming a visible animal should not have been transported and reporting inspection and complaint figures for 2019.
It could not be established that these animals were delivered to the collection centre, and therefore also not whether these animals were presented and inspected for export.
Er kon niet vastgesteld worden dat deze dieren zijn aangevoerd op het verzamelcentrum en dus ook niet of deze dieren zijn aangeboden en gekeurd voor export.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het Uitvoeringsprogramma Waddengebied en de impactanalyse

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked the ministers about the Wadden Sea implementation programme, the impact analysis, and several related projects and stakeholder involvement. The minister answered that economic sectors are secured in the agenda, the impact analysis will be broader than socio-economic effects, and the programme and impact analysis will be discussed with Parliament before the summer and in the October debate.
On the outcome of that discussion I will inform your House by letter.
Over de uitkomst van de bespreking hiervan zal ik uw Kamer per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de noodzaak van een drastische vermindering van de stikstofuitstoot en de verwachting dat natuurherstelmaatregelen averechts werken

Parliamentarian Vestering (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why nitrogen emissions must fall drastically and whether nature restoration measures may be counterproductive, citing ecologists' warnings and accumulated nitrogen under the PAS. Minister Schouten answered that she sees no sufficient basis yet to tighten the nitrogen targets, that the PAS-related accumulation cannot be quantified because the effects of source measures were never systematically monitored, and that restoration measures are approved and assessed for effectiveness and no funds are reserved for harmful activities.
At the same time, there is currently insufficient basis to say with certainty already that the generic objectives included in the Wsn are insufficient.
Tegelijkertijd is er op dit moment onvoldoende basis om nu al met zekerheid te kunnen zeggen dat de in de Wsn opgenomen generieke doelstellingen onvoldoende zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Geurts over natuur die zich goed ontwikkelt ondanks stikstofdepositie en de definitie van het begrip project bij vergunningsverzoeken

Two CDA MPs asked whether hydrological restoration at Korenburgerveen means nitrogen effects are being offset, and how the legal concept of 'project' under nature permits should be defined and applied. The Minister acknowledged partial improvement from water-management measures but said nitrogen effects remain, that projects must be assessed on significant effects for Natura 2000 areas, and that permits must cover all inseparable parts of an activity.
No, the answer to question 6 shows that the delimitation depends on whether the activity in question may have significant effects on a Natura 2000 area.
Nee, uit het antwoord op vraag 6 blijkt dat de afbakening afhangt van de vraag of de betrokken activiteit significante gevolgen kan hebben voor een Natura 2000-gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het onderzoek naar stikstofdepositie en kritische depositiewaarden

MP Bisschop (SGP) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about experiments and uncertainties behind critical nitrogen deposition values, the Korenburgerveen and Binnenveld monitoring discrepancies, and whether water management should weigh more heavily. The minister answered that no local critical loads have been established from experiments, that the uncertainties raised are not 'enormous', that the KDW framework and AERIUS remain the basis, and that water management is a complementary but not substitute measure.
No, there is no question of 'enormous' scientific uncertainties.
Nee, van «enorme» wetenschappelijke onzekerheden is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht dat de natuur in het Korenburgerveen bij Winterswijk zich beter ontwikkelt dan voorspeld op basis van theoretische stikstofmodellen

An MP from the VVD asked the minister whether nature at the Korenburgerveen is developing better than nitrogen models predict, and whether water-management measures and area-specific approaches should be used more widely. The minister confirmed the research, said area-by-area inventories and hydrological measures are already part of policy, and partly endorsed the conclusions while cautioning that nitrogen effects remain visible.
That call fits seamlessly with the policy pursued by me and my predecessors.
Die oproep sluit naadloos aan bij het door mij en mijn voorgangers gevoerde beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht 'Minister Schouten komt met hilarisch antwoord op Kamervragen over kritische depositiewaarden'

An MP asks the minister to reconsider claims about critical nitrogen deposition values and the Korenburgerveen nature area, and to stop what he calls the harassment of farmers and waste of billions on a fabricated nitrogen problem. The minister maintains that the critical deposition values rest on studies predating the cited article, that the cited ecologist's note does not contain the quoted statements and itself reports species losses, and that the nitrogen problem is real and the spending necessary.
I have a warm regard for farmers; there was and is no question of belittling farmers.
Ik draag de boeren een warm hart toe; van het wegtreiteren van boeren was en is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over stikstofreductie en natuurherstel

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about nitrogen reduction and nature restoration, including whether groundwater levels rather than nitrogen deposition explain habitat losses, whether there is enough evidence to make critical deposition values a binding result obligation in law, whether a cost-benefit analysis was made, and how the policy relates to global land demand. The minister answered that groundwater is not the explaining factor at the Wageningen site, that an integrated approach is needed, that the critical deposition values rest on scientific and EU-law requirements without a cost-benefit analysis, and that the Dutch agricultural area is used efficiently.
That is why an integrated approach is very important, as has already taken place in the past and is being continued with the Nature Programme.
Daarom is een integrale aanpak heel belangrijk, zoals dat in het verleden al heeft plaatsgevonden en wordt voortgezet met het Programma Natuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het recent door ABDTOPConsult geschreven rapport ‘Stikstofruimte voor de toekomst’

MP Eppink asked the minister why the ABDTOPConsult report on nitrogen space did not directly cite the studies behind its 70% reduction claim, whether that figure stems from a WNF/Natuurmonumenten study, and whether such policy conclusions are often based on WNF studies. The minister answered that the conclusions rest on RIVM and other established sources, that WNF material was only partly known to the consultants and matched their findings, and that the report was independently produced with traceable references.
The report 'Stikstofruimte voor de toekomst' was carried out independently with traceable source references and conclusions.
Het rapport «Stikstofruimte voor de toekomst» is onafhankelijk uitgevoerd met navolgbare bronverwijzingen en conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het nieuws dat Duitse haantjes niet meer in de hakselaar hoeven

An SP MP asked the minister about news that German male chicks no longer need to be shredded, and about progress on alternatives to culling male chicks under the poultry sector agreement. The minister replied that in-ovo sexing and fattening of male chicks are the most promising options, that retail market demand and technical capacity remain obstacles, and that ministry will keep monitoring and talking with the sector.
My ministry will continue to follow developments in Germany and France and remain in discussion with the sector about developments in sales and techniques.
Mijn ministerie zal de ontwikkelingen in Duitsland en Frankrijk blijven volgen en in gesprek blijven met de sector over de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van afzet en technieken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het verbod op verrijkte kooien voor leghennen

MP Wassenberg asks the minister to confirm the ban on enriched cages for laying hens since 1 January 2021, the number of hens and farms still in such cages, and whether the NVWA or private body COKZ enforces the ban and whether all farms have been checked. The minister confirms the ban, corrects earlier figures, says 14 farms were registered in 2019, admits checks are not yet complete and grants one farm a temporary exemption, and defends COKZ inspections as efficient.
No, checks on this will be carried out by the COKZ as soon as possible.
Nee, controle hierop wordt zo spoedig mogelijk uitgevoerd door het COKZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht dat vleesrunderen op vergiftigde grond hebben gegraasd

The MP asked the ministers about reports that beef cattle grazed on contaminated floodplain land, whether a national overview of such areas exists, whether the meat reached consumers or foreign buyers, whether dioxin and other toxins are tested, whether grazing should be banned, and about granulite dumping and sanitation. The government answered that responsibility is shared across departments, that an NVWA investigation is ongoing with results expected in 2021, that affected meat was sold only to individual online consumers, and that granulite poses no proven harm and does not warrant sanitation.
Following this, NVWA-BuRO carried out a desk study, after which it was decided to start an investigation into dioxin and other contaminants.
Naar aanleiding hiervan heeft NVWA-BuRO een deskstudie uitgevoerd, waarna is besloten een onderzoek te starten naar dioxine en andere contaminanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de berichten over hoge waardes aan dioxines die zijn aangetroffen bij dieren in natuurgebieden

An SP MP asked the minister about reports of high dioxin levels in grazing animals in floodplains and the Oostvaardersplassen, and whether research, relocation, and health risks would be addressed. The minister confirmed the reports, announced a WFSR/NVWA study of meat from year-round grazing animals with the final report to be shared with parliament, said relocation is not yet under discussion, and attributed the contamination largely to past pollution, possibly via air deposition.
Yes, the final report will be shared with the House.
Ja, het definitieve rapport zal gedeeld worden met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Toezichthouder NVWA stond kwekers het gebruik van een verboden middel toe'

An MP asked the minister about press reports that the food safety inspectorate NVWA tolerated illegal use of the plant-protection agent V10 by tomato growers, and why nothing was done for years. The minister answered that inspectors and the predecessor plant health service repeatedly warned about restricted use, that enforcement was limited, and that an external expert will examine how the matter was handled.
I will ask the external expert to investigate how this was handled with regard to V10.
Ik zal de externe deskundige vragen te onderzoeken op welke wijze dit ten aanzien van V10 gebeurd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het gedoogbeleid van de NVWA bij wetsovertredingen

MP Vestering (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture about the NVWA tolerating use of the unauthorised tomato virus agent V10 by growers from 2006 to 2020 without enforcement, and whether this shows the NVWA is overburdened and should move to the Ministry of VWS. The Minister answered that she was not aware of the tolerance, will commission an external expert to investigate how it happened, and explained the history of exemptions and authorisation of V10 while defending the NVWA's independence.
I will ask an external expert to answer the questions of how this could have happened and what we can learn from it.
Ik zal een externe deskundige vragen antwoord te geven op de vragen hoe dit heeft kunnen gebeuren en wat we hiervan kunnen leren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het artikel 'Toezichthouder NVWA stond kwekers gebruik van een verboden middel toe'

MP Bromet asked the minister whether the NVWA had tolerated the illegal use of the agent V10 for about 14 years, why no investigation was launched, and how enforcement will be improved. The minister answered that the regulator's 2014 decision not to actively enforce the restricted use was a choice, that an external expert will examine the case as required by a motion, and that NVWA capacity constraints are being addressed.
I will ask an external expert to answer the questions of how this could have happened and what we can learn from it.
Ik zal een externe deskundige vragen antwoord te geven op de vragen hoe dit heeft kunnen gebeuren en wat we hiervan kunnen leren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de rechterlijke uitspraak over het verlenen van een Wnb vergunning ten behoeve van het wijzigen van een melkveehouderij

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a court ruling that found the emission factors in the Rav insufficiently substantiated for a Wnb permit to convert a dairy farm, and about the consequences for nitrogen calculations. The Minister answers that the ruling concerned the certainty required for Natura 2000 assessment rather than the Rav factors in general, that an appeal is being prepared, that no immediate changes to the nitrogen approach are foreseen, and that a CBS/CDM study on practical use of techniques will be available in late 2021.
I therefore do not recognise the claim that the emission factors in the Rav are insufficiently scientifically substantiated.
Ik herken mij derhalve niet in de stelling dat de emissiefactoren in de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij (Rav) niet voldoende wetenschappelijk onderbouwd zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de schijnoplossing van mestfabrieken voor het mestprobleem

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether manure processing plants are a stopgap for the manure surplus that lets livestock numbers stay unchanged, and whether they are needed at scale under the planned manure policy. The Minister answers that processing adds value to manure, that about 15 percent of phosphate production exceeds domestic capacity and is exported, that the policy contours are still being elaborated, and that a concrete reduction of animal numbers is not committed to.
Processing manure means bringing phosphate outside Dutch agriculture.
Het verwerken van mest, betekent het buiten de Nederlandse landbouw brengen van fosfaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de mogelijkheden tot vervroegde betaling GLB-inkomenssteun in 2021

MP Boswijk asked whether farmers' liquidity problems from COVID-19 have improved, the likely share of farmers in trouble if CAP income support is paid late, and whether national advance payments will be allowed again in 2021. Minister Schouten said there are no clear signs of serious liquidity problems, that about 30% of farmers used advance payments last year, and that the cabinet is still considering a repeat scheme of 80% advances under the de minimis rules.
At present I am considering the possibilities of offering advance payments again in response to the corona crisis.
Op dit moment bezie ik de mogelijkheden om naar aanleiding van de coronacrisis weer voorschotbetalingen aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over Lelystad Airport

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the ministers whether the government would honour the House's controversial declaration on Lelystad Airport and refrain from irreversible steps, including continuing the permit procedure, given the statutory decision deadline. Minister Schouten answered that the permit is a legally required individual procedure separate from political decision-making, that the deadline is an order term but binding and cannot be suspended, and that she will not pause the procedure.
A controversial declaration by the House of Representatives does not constitute grounds for me to invoke force majeure in the case of this permit application.
Een controversieel-verklaring door de Tweede Kamer vormt geen grond om mij te mogen beroepen op overmacht in het geval van deze vergunningaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het bericht 'Pulsvisserij blijft verboden, Europees Hof veegt Nederlandse bezwaren van tafel'

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether the EU Court ruling upholding the pulse fishing ban could be appealed, whether the July 2021 deadline could be extended, and whether compensation was possible. The minister answered that appeal is not possible, the transition deadline is fixed in law, and compensation from Europe is not considered realistic, while pointing to innovation support.
No, it is not possible to appeal against this ruling.
Nee, het is niet mogelijk tegen deze uitspraak in beroep te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van Helvert over de olifant Buba

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about the circus elephant Buba, arguing she should be allowed to stay with her circus family and that precedent should not block this. The minister replied that an exemption under conditions was granted on 25 March 2021 for an indefinite period, while noting that the keeper was responsible for her residence and that earlier relocation efforts had been supported.
At the request of Mr Freiwald, I granted an exemption on 25 March 2021.
Ik heb op verzoek van de heer Freiwald op 25 maart 2021 een ontheffing afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het onrechtmatig doden van konikpaarden en heckrunderen in de Oostvaardersplassen

An MP asked the minister whether the province of Flevoland unlawfully killed konik horses and Heck cattle in the Oostvaardersplassen, and whether oversight of provincial permits was adequate. The minister replied that the animals are not legally protected species so no permit was needed, that a handhavingsverzoek revealed only a missing authorisation for silenced rifles, and that this was regularised by an opdracht to Staatsbosbeheer, while the Rijk does not systematically check provincial decisions.
The national government does not have the role of systematically checking individual provincial decisions.
Het Rijk heeft niet de rol stelselmatig individuele provinciale besluiten te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de structurele mishandeling van honden in training bij leden van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Politiehonden Vereniging (KNPV)

An MP from PvdD asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about structural animal abuse in training of police dogs by KNPV members, including demands to suspend ties, halt exports, ban electric equipment, and review the dogs' use as force. The minister acknowledged the abuse reports, said a criminal investigation is ongoing, refused to suspend the relationship with the KNPV as a whole, and promised a law to ban electric training equipment.
A bill is being prepared to introduce such a ban.
Er wordt gewerkt aan een wetsvoorstel om een dergelijk verbod in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Weverling over het bericht 'Politiehonden in opleiding nog steeds mishandeld'

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Weverling asked about media reports of mistreatment of police dogs in training at a private KNPV club, including contracts, sanctions and reporting duties. The minister said police are examining whether criminal investigation is warranted, that the problem does not appear structural, and promised tighter contract penalties and no further purchases from trainers convicted of animal cruelty, but said a ban on keeping animals cannot apply to the KNPV as an umbrella body.
Based on this broadcast, the police, on the instruction of the Public Prosecution Service, are examining whether there are grounds for a criminal investigation.
Op grond van deze uitzending wordt door de politie, in opdracht van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM), onderzocht of er aanknopingspunten zijn voor een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het transport van duizenden Nederlandse koeien naar landen in het Midden-Oosten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture about thousands of Dutch cattle exported by sea to Middle Eastern countries despite the May 2020 suspension of exports requiring rest stops outside the EU, and about enforcement at non-EU ports and during sea transport. The minister confirmed the suspension applied only to exports needing EU-external rest stops, said the NVWA lacks powers and visibility outside the EU, and committed to pushing for an EU ban on long-distance live exports to non-EU countries.
It is not possible to impose EU legislation on non-EU countries and the NVWA has no powers in countries outside the EU.
Het is niet mogelijk om EU-wetgeving aan niet-EU landen op te leggen en de NVWA heeft geen bevoegdheden in landen buiten de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de 200.000 dieren die vast zaten aan boord van transportschepen door de blokkade van het Suezkanaal

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about roughly 200,000 animals stranded on livestock ships blocked in the Suez Canal, including feed, welfare, veterinary care and reporting of sea transport deaths. The minister answered that only partial information on Romanian and Spanish ships is available, that the Netherlands has no direct role since these shipments did not leave from the Netherlands, and that she advocates an EU-wide ban on long-distance live animal transport to non-EU countries and better reporting.
No information is shared with a shipping country, such as the Netherlands, when it is found that there is too little feed on board.
Er wordt geen informatie gedeeld met een verzendend land, zoals Nederland, als geconstateerd wordt dat er te weinig voer aan boord is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de schepen met vee die vast kwamen te zitten bij het Suezkanaal

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about livestock ships stuck at the Suez Canal, asking whether Dutch traders were involved, whether NVWA permits were issued, how the export ban on live animals applies to sea transport, and whether sea transports should be banned in the EU transport regulation. The Minister answered most questions substantively, stated that Dutch involvement is unknown, that a sea-transport ban on export is not possible under current rules, and that a Council discussion will follow.
It is possible that Dutch traders were involved, but I have no insight into this.
Het is mogelijk dat er Nederlandse handelaren betrokken waren maar daar heb ik geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Bromet over de schuldbekentenis van de Rabobank

GroenLinks MPs Snels and Bromet asked ministers how banks financing intensive agriculture share responsibility for unsustainable farming, for insufficient disclosure of transition risks, and for blocking farmers' green transition, following a Zembla broadcast. The ministers answered that all agricultural chain parties share responsibility, that banks must consider foreseeable risks, that they call on financiers to act, and that new public instruments such as an investment fund and working-capital scheme are being developed.
I call on Rabobank, and also on the other financial institutions active in the agri-sector, to explicitly take on their role in financing the transition to more sustainable agriculture.

Ik roep de Rabobank, en ook de andere financiële instellingen die actief zijn in de agrosector, op om hun rol in de financiering van de omschakeling naar een duurzamere landbouw nadrukkelijk op zich te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de Rabobank die erkent dat het landbouwsysteem failliet is, maar verandering tegenwerkt,

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the ministers about Rabobank acknowledging co-responsibility for agricultural problems while allegedly resisting change, and about financing barriers for farmers seeking sustainable transition and the use of subsidies that may flow to banks. The minister acknowledged shared responsibility of financiers, pointed to voluntary initiatives, the Omschakelprogramma and Investeringsfonds, the SER exploration, and declined to pursue additional legislation or new reporting, leaving banks' lending decisions to them.
I do not intend to work towards an additional reporting cycle at company level, but I consider it very important to have good insight into developments in this area.
Ik ben niet voornemens naar een additionele rapportagecyclus op bedrijfsniveau toe te werken, maar ik vind het wel heel belangrijk om goed inzicht te hebben in de ontwikkelingen op dit terrein.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Raan over de activiteiten van de KLM Flight Academy (KFA)

MP Van Raan asked about the rise in training flights at Groningen Airport Eelde in 2020 by the KLM Flight Academy, its turnover, NOW wage subsidy receipt of EUR 1.56 million, noise and environmental effects. The minister confirmed the 23% rise in movements, largely from training flights merged with Martinair, said turnover is booked per student progress and cannot be shown separately as it is confidential, and stated operations stay within noise limits and opening hours enforced by the ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het nieuws dat varkens overleden bij een val in een gierput

MP Futselaar (SP) asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Infrastructure whether the cause of a floor collapse causing pigs to fall into a slurry pit was investigated, how stable floors are inspected, and how safety and animal welfare are monitored. The Minister answered that the cause is unknown, that municipalities are responsible for enforcement under the Building Decree with policy discretion, that Inspectie SZW runs a sector campaign, and that welfare and fire safety will be considered as a condition in a subsidy scheme.
The municipality indicated that the cause of the floor collapse was not investigated and is therefore unknown.
Vanuit de gemeente is aangegeven dat de oorzaak van de vloerverzakking niet onderzocht is en daarom onbekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat het BPRC apen infecteert met het vogelgriepvirus

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about a BPRC study infecting monkeys with H5N1 avian flu, including animal suffering, the risk to the poultry sector, and whether the government will reduce animal testing and the primate breeding colony. The minister answers that the study was reviewed and permitted by the Central Committee on Animal Experiments, defers questions on zoonosis policy to a pending expert review, and states that the 40% reduction target for primate experiments by 2025 remains unchanged.

All animal experiments in the Netherlands are independently and carefully assessed by the Central Committee on Animal Experiments (CCD), which then determines whether the animal experiment may take place from a scientific and ethical standpoint.

Alle dierproeven Nederland worden onafhankelijk en zorgvuldig beoordeeld door de Centrale Commissie Dierproeven (CCD), die vervolgens bepaalt of de dierproef vanuit wetenschappelijk en ethisch oogpunt mag plaatsvinden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Von Martels, De Groot en Dik Faber over het signaal dat de NVWA niet overgaat tot het aanwijzen van verschillende havens als ‘dedicated landing port third countrie

MPs asked why the NVWA has not designated additional Dutch ports, such as Den Helder, as dedicated landing ports for third-country fishing vessels, which hurts shipyards once British vessels lose access after Brexit. The minister explains the EU IUU-regulation limits such designations, reports lost turnover and an intention to allow maintenance-only calls by UK vessels in specified ports, and declines to reconsider the broader landing-port designations.
I have received a confidential overview from the sector of the estimated turnover losses per shipyard.
Ik heb van de sector vertrouwelijk een overzicht gekregen van de geschatte omzetverliezen per werf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht 'Bospaden worden verhard met plastic bouwafval'

Green Left MPs Kröger and Bromet asked about reports that Staatsbosbeheer surfaces forest paths with plastic-contaminated construction waste, and whether the 1% contamination limit is respected and what harms result. The State Secretary answered that certified suppliers are used, that the limit applies by weight and volume, that the impact on nature is not yet fully known (RIVM research expected early 2022), and that the government will study tighter regulation of recycled granulate and engage stakeholders.
However, I will investigate whether there are possibilities to better regulate the use of recycled granulate.
Ik ga echter onderzoeken of er mogelijkheden zijn om de toepassing van recyclinggranulaat beter te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over het gebruik van bouwpuin vervuild met plastic voor wandelpaden

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether building rubble contaminated with plastic, used for forest and nature paths by State Forestry Service (Staatsbosbeheer), can be guaranteed free of harmful substances, and whether its use should be banned. The State Secretary answered that no national data exist on the quantities used, that the EU and Dutch standards cap plastic contamination at 1% but are not otherwise specific, and that the government will examine whether plastic contamination can be better regulated by year-end while supporting Staatsbosbeheer's initiative to explore alternatives.
At national level there is no insight into this. There is no reporting obligation for the application of recycled granulate as a building material.
Op landelijk niveau bestaat hierin geen inzicht. Op het toepassen van recyclinggranulaat als bouwstof rust geen meldingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de subsidie aan de Koning voor het beheer van het Kroondomein

An MP asked the government about a nature-management subsidy paid to the King for the Kroondomein, including legal basis, missing application, public access closures, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister answered that the subsidy was lawfully granted under the Kaderwet EZ-subsidies, that Parliament was informed via the budget, and that no reclaim is warranted, while declining to comment on royal security measures.
I do not comment on security measures taken to protect the King.
Over veiligheidsmaatregelen die getroffen worden ter bescherming van de Koning doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de bevindingen van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid met betrekking tot de aanpak van stalbranden

Rep. Futselaar (SP) asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Dutch Safety Board's finding that government and industry give too little priority to preventing barn fires, which kill large numbers of animals. The Minister acknowledges the current approach has not worked, admits a different approach with stronger government steering is needed, and promises a full response to the Safety Board's recommendations within six months, including a review of fire-safety rules with the Interior Ministry.
I endorse the conclusions and acknowledge that a different approach is needed, with greater government responsibility and more government steering.
Ik onderstreep de conclusies en erken dat een andere aanpak nodig is met een grotere verantwoordelijkheid en meer sturing van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over Kroondomein het Loo

Sneller (D66) asks whether Kroondomein het Loo is state-owned, whether the Kroondrager is usufructuary or economic owner, whether surpluses are paid out and how a subsidy was granted with an exception to public access (5,000 ha closed for three months, justified by privacy and security). The minister answers that the Kroondrager is usufructuary, that the subsidy followed the Kaderwet with a broader closure allowed for privacy, and that tax and private financial matters cannot be disclosed.
Financial transactions of natural persons count as conduct within the personal sphere of life.
Financiële transacties van natuurlijke personen gelden als gedragingen binnen de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'Rijksoverheid komt met stikstofvisie mede op basis niet beschikbare ecologische studies'

MP Madlener (PVV) asked whether the nitrogen policy vision rests on ecological studies that are not publicly available and whether conclusions drawn from them are proper. Minister Schouten answered that the consultancy used the latest research, that two cited studies were published or are forthcoming (one in May 2021), and that the report sets out options without prescribing policy choices.
The exploration contains references to both studies and indicates that publication is in preparation.
In de verkenning zijn verwijzingen naar beide studies opgenomen en is aangegeven dat de publicatie in voorbereiding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de Puppy Express

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the 'Puppy-Express.nl' campaign offering home delivery of puppies, its welfare risks, missing seller information, and the surge in impulse and illegal puppy purchases during the coronavirus crisis. The minister answered that the site was a House of Animals awareness campaign with no animals actually sold, that NVWA inspections and Marktplaats agreements exist, and that a mandatory cooling-off period for pet purchases is being studied.
I am also examining whether and how a mandatory cooling-off period for pet purchases could help reduce impulse purchases of animals.
Ik ben ook aan het onderzoeken of en hoe een verplichte bedenktijd voor de aanschaf van huisdieren bij kan dragen aan het terugdringen van het aantal impulsaankopen van dieren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het doodrijden van een wolvin door drukte in natuurgebieden

An MP asked whether recreational pressure, low-flying military helicopters and deer culling on the Veluwe disturb wolves, and whether speed limits or bans should be imposed to protect wolves and otters. The minister answered that disturbance only arises when visitors break conduct rules, that the Veluwe helicopter flights are judged not to disturb wolves, and that speed limits are a local road-manager matter, while promising no new protective measures for the wolf habitat.
Yes, I am aware of the report.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over puppy’s die als ‘click and collect’-handelswaar kunnen worden afgehaald bij een omstreden puppyhandelaar

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a controversial puppy dealer reopening under click-and-collect rules, alleged fraud and neglect since 2015, and the NVWA having paused breeder inspections during COVID-19. The Minister confirms click-and-collect applies to puppy sales, refuses to disclose individual inspection data, states that the NVWA resumed priority-based oversight with a protocol for home inspections, and promises a study on a mandatory cooling-off period and an I&R/DNA system, but rejects an import ban as unenforceable.
The NVWA does not share data on individual companies.
De NVWA deelt geen gegevens over individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de oproep van de NVWA om te stoppen met het kopen van puppy’s omdat het probleem van malafide hondenhandel te groot is

An MP asked the Minister about the NVWA inspector's call to stop buying puppies because illegal dog trade is too large to control, and about enforcement gaps including Hungarian documents and internet sales. The Minister replied that the call targeted buyers, that the NVWA runs risk-based supervision and awareness campaigns, that a ban on imports or online sales is not practicable, and that an identification and registration system and a DNA databank are being developed.
I do not have the possibility to regularly inspect breeders in other countries.
Ik beschik niet over de mogelijkheid om fokkers in andere landen regelmatig te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het besluit inzake het Wob-verzoek over melkquotum en fosfaatrechten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about irregular livestock registrations and leased German cows around 1-4 July 2015 that may have affected phosphate-rights allocation, and whether further investigation of IRS mutations was warranted. The Minister said irregular changes were checked against alternative data, that the total affected animals were not separately recorded, and that RVO re-examined registrations and found no deviation from other years, so no further investigation was deemed necessary.
I have asked RVO to carry out a further investigation into the mutations in the I&R system.
Ik heb RVO gevraagd om alsnog een nader onderzoek uit te voeren naar de mutaties in het I&R-systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Pluimveeslachterijen slachten vandaag niet: Geen NVWA-toezichthouders door code rood’

MP Lodders asked the Minister why the NVWA withdrew meat-inspection staff from poultry slaughterhouses during a KNMI code red weather warning, questioning the decision's timing, consistency, consultation with the sector and effects on animals and farmers. The Minister defended the NVWA's decision as protecting staff safety, said the sector was informed and consulted afterwards, rejected responsibility for farmers' costs and promised evaluation of the national plan on animal transport.
On Sunday evening 14 February at around 22.00 the NVWA decided, for the safety of its staff, not to start its services at the slaughterhouses on Monday morning until the KNMI code red was lifted.

De NVWA heeft op zondagavond 14 februari rond 22.00 uur het besluit genomen om in verband met de veiligheid van haar medewerkers de dienstverlening voor de slachthuizen op maandagochtend niet op te starten totdat code rood van het KNMI zou zijn opgeheven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het afzeggen van NVWA-controles door code rood

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the NVWA's decision to cancel slaughterhouse inspections during a KNMI code red weather warning, including whether the sector was consulted and whether animal welfare was harmed. The minister defended the NVWA's decision as a responsible protection of staff safety, said the sector was informed and consulted afterwards, and stated the policy is to suspend inspections during code red without a government-wide framework.
There is no government-wide framework for the deployment of government services during a KNMI code red.
Er is geen rijksbreed kader is voor de inzet van overheidsdiensten tijdens code rood van het KNMI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het moeten wijken van een dassenburcht voor een nieuwbouwwijk

An MP asked the minister about the province of Limburg granting a licence to capture and relocate badgers from a sett in Roermond to make way for new housing, and whether the species' duty of care was respected. The minister confirmed the licence, stated all badgers have been captured and moved, said the province is the competent authority, and noted that the duty of care has a mainly supportive role for nationally protected species.
My officials are in close contact with the province of Limburg and are also in contact about this case.
Mijn ambtenaren staan in goed contact met de provincie Limburg, en hebben ook contact over deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het niet verlagen van het afromingspercentage in het fosfaatrechtenstelsel

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture why the phosphate rights levy rate was kept at 20% rather than reduced to 10%, and about knelgevallen (hardship cases) and a planned bill on levy-free leasing. The minister refused to lower the rate for now, citing uncertainty about the phosphate production ceiling, said the phosphate bank is not a hardship instrument, and noted the leasing bill is being prepared pending EU state-aid consultation.
It is not possible to determine how much trade, and thus levy deduction, would have taken place at a sustained 10% rate.
Het is niet mogelijk te achterhalen hoeveel handel en daarmee afroming plaatsgevonden zou hebben bij een blijvend percentage op 10%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'Ook het KDW-model rammelt'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a claim that the critical deposition value (KDW) model rests on 19 measurements and 90 fictitious measurements, produces harmful nitrogen effects even at zero deposition, and wrongs farmers. The minister answered that the criticised 2014 Banin et al. study does not underlie the Dutch and European KDWs, which were published earlier, and that the answers to the factual questions are no.
However, the article by Banin et al. does not form the basis of the critical deposition values used in Europe and the Netherlands.
Het artikel van Banin e.a. ligt echter niet ten grondslag aan de in Europa en in Nederland gebruikte kritische depositiewaarden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de onwenselijke handel in natuurvergunningen door extern salderen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the trade in nature permits through external netting (extern salderen), including their supposed paper value, compensation in buyout schemes, and whether permits should lapse. The minister answered that permits confer no tradeable emission rights, that buyout schemes do not compensate for permit value, and that permits are adjusted or withdrawn, while giving partial figures and declining to estimate values or the number of farms affected.
Because no emission rights exist, it is not possible to estimate the value of nitrogen space in issued nature permits.
Omdat er geen emissierechten bestaan, is het niet mogelijk om een inschatting te maken van de waarde van stikstofruimte in afgegeven natuurvergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het hoge gebruik van landbouwgif door de sierteeltsector en de slechte naleving van de betreffende wet- en regelgeving

An MP asked the minister about high pesticide use in the ornamental horticulture sector, low compliance with pesticide rules, limited inspections, illegal pesticide trade, and whether COVID aid should have required pesticide reduction. The minister replied that use per hectare fell since 2012 for most crops, compliance was 67% in a 2019 inspection, the NVWA works risk-based, aid was not conditioned on sustainability, and a Drenthe lily pilot is starting.
Of course I find it unacceptable that laws and regulations are not complied with by everyone.
Ik vind het uiteraard onacceptabel dat wet- en regelgeving niet door iedereen wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Noord-Nederland dat technische lapmiddelen geen oplossing vormen voor de stikstofproblematiek

MP Wassenberg asked the minister about a court ruling that technical farm measures do not justify nitrogen permits, whether the ABDTopconsult studies show herd reduction is needed, and whether public money for technical measures is wasted. The minister disputed that the ruling undermines technical measures, said the package balances staying and exiting farmers, and stated the ruling has no current consequences for intern/extern salderen policy.
A substantive response to the independent explorations on the nitrogen problem is for the next cabinet, as are the choices made or not made on that basis.
Een inhoudelijke reactie op de onafhankelijke verkenningen met betrekking tot de stikstofproblematiek is aan het volgende kabinet, evenals de keuzes die al dan niet op basis daarvan worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het onderzoek naar stikstofdepositie en kritische depositiewaarden

An SGP MP asked the minister about nitrogen deposition research, critical deposition values, local habitat evidence, and the expansion of monitoring. The minister replied that the Wamelink report would follow in May, gave partial overviews, rejected the call for caution on local comparisons, and promised to expand ammonia measurement stations to ten, though she declined to add the MP's questions to the commissioned studies.
I cannot meet this request. The commission to WUR was not aimed at these questions and the report is substantively complete.
Ik kan niet aan dit verzoek voldoen. De opdracht aan WUR was niet op deze vragen gericht en het rapport is inhoudelijk afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het Westnijlvirus en de tijgermug

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the NVWA withholds business names and precise coordinates of exotic mosquito finds, why counts are published only annually, and why the website omits some species, despite a Council of State ruling on public access. The minister answered that the NVWA publishes finds at neighbourhood level under the ruling, that counts are given annually to avoid misleading alarm, and that the website covers all designated vector species, but did not supply the requested historical data beyond an annex and disputed the applicability of the ruling to enforcement requests.
The NVWA actively publishes information on mosquito finds at neighbourhood level.
De NVWA maakt actief informatie openbaar van de muggenvondsten op wijkniveau.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot en Diertens (beiden D66) over de berichten ‘Verzet tegen nieuwe vrachthaven Bonaire, aanleg zou ‘ecocide’ zijn’ en het bericht ‘conservebonaire.org opposes Hato port’

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that a proposed new cargo port on Bonaire would harm the coral reef, its financing, environmental impact assessment, and transparency. The minister answered that no decision to build a port has been taken, that feasibility studies and an MER are still pending and will be shared later, and that the island council (Bestuurscollege) is responsible for the decision.
For now, there is no decision to build a new cargo port (location).
Vooralsnog is er geen sprake van een besluit tot het bouwen van een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Banken draaien duimschroeven mkb’er strakker aan in tweede lockdown'

MPs Van der Linde, Lodders and Aukje de Vries (VVD) asked whether banks are becoming less willing to finance SMEs during the second lockdown, what this means for post-crisis credit, and what the government is doing to improve bank lending and use of guarantee schemes. The minister answered that banks report limited additional credit demand, that prudential rules are not seen as blocking lending, that ministries and banks meet regularly and agreed joint action, and that guarantee uptake lags initial forecasts for some schemes while the government promises further steps such as a fiscal review of equity versus debt financing.
No formally adopted minutes are drawn up of the administrative consultation with the banks, which is chaired by EZK.
Van het bestuurlijk overleg met de banken, dat wordt voorgezeten door EZK, worden geen formeel vastgestelde verslagen opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Noodkreet sectoren: zonder groene middelen, geen vergroening’

An MP asked the minister about long assessment waits at the Ctgb for low-risk and biological plant protection products, and whether the transition to such products is being delayed. The minister acknowledged limited EU assessment capacity, said the Ctgb has already accepted many new biological substance and product applications for coming years, and described ongoing efforts such as the Green Team and EU simplification advocacy.

The Ctgb has already accepted a considerable number of applications for new substances and new products as rapporteur member state for the coming years and included them in the planning, including many new biological substances and products.

Het Ctgb heeft voor de komende jaren al een behoorlijk aantal aanvragen voor nieuwe stoffen en nieuwe middelen als rapporterend lidstaat geaccepteerd en in de planning opgenomen, waaronder veel nieuwe biologische stoffen en middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht 'Brussel wil camera’s op schepen om vissers in de gaten te houden'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about an EU proposal to fit cameras on fishing vessels to monitor compliance with the discard ban, and whether this harms fishers' privacy and is feasible. The minister is not opposed to cameras in principle but wants pilot projects first to test effectiveness and privacy compatibility, and pursues a level playing field and alternative technologies.
I am therefore not opposed to cameras on board.
Ik ben dan ook niet tegen camera’s aan boord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het opkopen van zonneparken door buitenlandse investeerders

Two SGP MPs asked the ministers about foreign investors buying up large solar parks, the resulting outflow of subsidy money, and whether ownership and landscape-integration commitments could be enforced. The minister defended open resale and said there is no generic 50% local-ownership obligation, stating that participation remains voluntary and municipalities can only require good-faith efforts.
I therefore do not take a negative view of reselling solar parks to (foreign) investors.
Ik sta dan ook niet negatief tegenover het doorverkopen van zonneparken aan (buitenlandse) investeerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Nieuwkoopse stikstofboeren krijgen tonnen subsidie van minister Schouten voor project - 'Dit moeten we een kans geven''

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a pilot in which Nieuwkoopse dairy farmers receive subsidy for low-emission farming and may lease out nitrogen emission space to other businesses, questioning whether this undermines emission ceilings, the 70% rule, and the level playing field. The minister answered that the pilot is designed so 44% of the gains go permanently to nature, that subsidy targets knowledge rather than physical measures, and that the pilot will test whether leasing creates a viable model.
What is important here is that not all of the profit gained through innovation will be offset, but 56% of it.
Van belang daarbij is dat niet de volledige door innovatie verkregen winst zal worden gesaldeerd, maar 56% hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over financiële hulp voor wildopvangcentra en de kosten die dierenambulances en vogelopvangcentra maken als gevolg van vogelgriepuitbraken

Wassenberg (PvdD) asked whether the minister would provide structural financial support for wildlife rehabilitation centres and animal ambulances facing costs from avian influenza outbreaks, and what concrete results emerged from consultations with provinces and municipalities. The minister acknowledged the extra costs, said the ministry does not track which authorities pay, and announced a one-off subsidy covering 50% of avian-flu related costs, framed as an exceptional case.
Nevertheless, I intend to grant a one-off subsidy to cover part of the costs of caring for birds with avian flu.
Desondanks ben ik voornemens een eenmalige subsidie toe te kennen om een deel van de kosten voor de zorg voor vogels met vogelgriep te vergoeden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Lodders over het bericht 'Toevoegen leefgebieden Natura 2000 grote puinzooi'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about reports that tiny patches of nature (13 m2) were wrongly classed as nitrogen-sensitive in AERIUS, and about progress on the Geurts/Harbers motion to correct habitat mapping. The minister acknowledged technical errors, said most cases can be resolved in the next AERIUS version with a field check for the rest, and committed to asking provinces to take the new information into account in permit applications meanwhile.
Indeed, it was found last year that small pieces of nitrogen-sensitive nature had been included in AERIUS due to technical errors.
Inderdaad is afgelopen jaar geconstateerd dat er stukjes stikstofgevoelige natuur in AERIUS zijn opgenomen die zijn ontstaan als gevolg van technische fouten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over vangletsel bij kippen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the NVWA's enforcement on catching injuries to chickens is adequate, given that the catching method by the legs may breach EU transport rules and that enforcement uses a 2% intervention threshold. The minister said the transport rules are unclear on catching by the legs, that NVWA does not enforce during catching due to limited capacity, and that a 2% threshold is applied in line with realistic practice, while promising a public-private research project on catching injuries.
The NVWA is not present during the catching of chickens and carries out spot-check, risk-based inspections for catching injuries at the slaughterhouses.
De NVWA is niet aanwezig bij het vangen van kippen en voert in de slachthuizen steekproefsgewijs en risicogericht inspecties op vangletsel uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het Ierse plan om dit voorjaar tienduizenden kalfjes op het vliegtuig te zetten naar Nederland

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about an Irish plan to fly young calves to the Netherlands, and whether the minister would stop calf imports. The minister answered that the Irish plan raises welfare and climate concerns, that the concerns were passed to Irish authorities, and that calf imports over 8 hours will be phased out, with a possible EU-wide ban pursued.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de natuurvergunning van Groningen Airport Eelde

Two MPs (Van Raan and Wassenberg, PvdD) asked the minister whether the 2009 nature permit for Groningen Airport Eelde, its monitoring plans and reports, and possible additional conditions to protect nearby Natura 2000 areas were in order. The minister confirmed she is the competent authority, said monitoring was required, but explained that no further conditions were needed because flight movements fell after the permit, so the planned post-permit monitoring was never carried out.
The subsequent monitoring, which concerned the expansion, ultimately did not take place because the number of flight movements actually decreased after the permit was issued.
De opvolgende monitoring, die zag op de uitbreiding, heeft echter uiteindelijk niet plaatsgevonden omdat de hoeveelheid vliegbewegingen na afgifte van de vergunning juist is afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over het bericht 'Besluitvorming genetische gemodificeerde gewassen in impasse door gebrek aan politieke daadkracht'

VVD MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Infrastructure about a dissertation claiming EU GMO authorisation is deadlocked, and about import versus cultivation rules, CRISPR-Cas9, and their motion on biotechnology regulation. The ministers largely agreed EU procedures are slow and costly, said Dutch policy pushes for modernised rules, and pointed to an ongoing European Commission study due by 30 April 2021 without committing to a concrete new step.

The Netherlands is working to put the application and authorisation of new breeding techniques, such as CRISPR-Cas9, on the European agenda, provided species boundaries are not crossed and safety for humans, animals and the environment is guaranteed.

Nederland zet zich in op het Europees agenderen van de toepassing en toelating van nieuwe veredelingstechnieken, zoals CRISPR-Cas9, mits daarbij geen soortengrenzen worden overschreden en veiligheid voor mens, dier en milieu gewaarborgd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Wassenberg over de ontheffing van de avondklok voor de jacht op zwijnen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether hunting wild boar spreads African swine fever, citing EFSA research, hunting-hygiene risks, hunting tourism and an inconsistent dog rule. The Minister rejects that hunting spreads the disease, defends culling as risk-reducing, and says the dog rule will be clarified in the flyer.
The NVWA will adjust the text in the flyer.
De NVWA zal de tekst in de flyer aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Dik-Faber over de tegemoetkoming aan de leveranciers van schoolfruit

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture about compensation for school fruit suppliers who lost income during the first COVID-19 school closures, and about longer supplier recognition periods. The minister said only about 148,000 euro had been paid for documented costs against roughly 600,000 euro claimed, pointed to national support schemes, and said the recognition duration will be reconsidered when the scheme is revised, without committing to compensation.
I am awaiting the results of this study.
Ik wacht de resultaten van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht over de ‘coronaboete’ die leveranciers van de Albert Heijn boven het hoofd dreigt te hangen

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports that Albert Heijn threatens suppliers with penalties of up to 80% of order value when COVID prevents full delivery, and whether this falls under the unfair trading practices law. The minister said Albert Heijn reports imposing no such fines, called the practice morally unacceptable, and stated that the new law (planned in force 1 November 2021) will be enforced by the ACM with a dispute committee, while declining to judge the individual case.
As Minister, it is not for me to assess an individual case in light of the Unfair Trading Practices Act for the agricultural and food supply chain.
Het is als Minister niet aan mij om een individuele casus te beoordelen in het licht van de Wet oneerlijke handelspraktijken landbouw- en voedselvoorzieningsketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Wederom levensgevaarlijke stenenactie Greenpeace in VK-wateren' van de Nederlandse Vissersbond

MPs Von Martels and Agnes Mulder asked the minister whether she was aware of Greenpeace UK's rock-dumping action south of Brighton, which they said endangers fishers, and what she would do given her earlier stance on the North Sea agreement. The minister said she condemns the action, raised it in international fisheries consultations, and that UK authorities are investigating and the Dutch Public Prosecution Service found no grounds for criminal investigation of a similar earlier action.
This concerns an action by the British branch of Greenpeace in the English part of the North Sea.
Het betreft een actie van de Britse tak van Greenpeace in het Engelse deel van de Noordzee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht dat de minister een termijn heeft laten verstrijken in een rechtszaak over vergunningen van garnalenvissers

An MP asked the minister why the deadline in a court case over shrimp fishing permits lapsed, letting Natuurmonumenten's appeal succeed, and what will be done to resolve the uncertainty for fishers. The minister admits the ministry failed to request an extension in time, the Raad van State upheld the appeal on cumulative effects, and new objection decisions will be taken as soon as possible, which she regrets delays legal certainty.
By mistake, no timely request for an extension of the deadline was made.
Per abuis is niet tijdig om verlenging van de termijn verzocht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over lacunes in de beoordeling van Wageningen Environmental Research over het onderzoek naar landbouwgif in koeienmest bij veebedrijven in weidevogelgebieden in Gelderland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about gaps in Wageningen Environmental Research's assessment of pesticide residues in cattle manure and whether they harm soil life and dung beetles, and about the effectiveness of weidevogel programmes. The Minister largely defended the existing assessment and its methods, said WEnR was commissioned to reason about risks from manure chemicals, and said a scoping exercise on knowledge gaps would follow.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de brandbrief van Dier & Recht over ‘extreem gebruik van antibiotica door ongezonde kalversector’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a Dier & Recht letter claiming antibiotic use in the veal sector remains excessive and asked about ESBL bacteria, reduction options, and the sector's targets. The Minister answered that antibiotic use fell 51% since 2009, that ESBL prevalence is still high and further study is commissioned, and that the sector is implementing agreed reduction measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over steun aan buurt- en dorpshuizen voor het jaar 2021

MP Nijboer asked whether the government would extend compensation for neighbourhood and village houses for 2021 and whether municipal finance pressures threaten their closure. The minister said TVL support continues through Q2 2021 with higher minimum subsidies, that no additional support is planned for now, and that municipal finance questions are for a future cabinet.
The cabinet is currently not planning to take additional support measures beyond the existing TVL compensation and the extra TVL measures from April 2021.

het kabinet is vooralsnog niet voornemens om naast de compenserende maatregelen via de huidige TVL regeling en de extra compenserende maatregelen van de TVL regeling per april 2021, aanvullende ondersteuningsmaatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg over het sluiten van trimsalons voor dieren

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked why dog and cat grooming salons were closed during the lockdown, whether owners may bring animals in, why salons count as public places, and whether small salons can get state support. The minister answered that salons may fetch and return animals, that home-based groomers may take clients by appointment, and that existing support schemes are sufficient, so no further widening is planned.
At this moment I see no reason and no room to broaden this further.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding en geen ruimte om dit nog verder te verbreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Anker over het bericht 'Boeren ontevreden over maatregelen ganzen verjagen'

MP Van den Anker (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether wildlife damage to crops, mainly from geese, is rising, whether nature-restoration funds (EUR 3 billion) cover compensation for it, and how the damage will be compensated. The minister answered that damage payouts have been about EUR 24 million a year, that goose policy is a provincial responsibility, that no nature-budget money is reserved for wildlife damage, and that farmers should be compensated within the usual frameworks, though no concrete new step was committed.
Goose policy, like nature restoration and development policy, is a responsibility of the provinces.
Ganzenbeleid, evenals beleid voor natuurherstel en -ontwikkeling is een verantwoordelijkheid van provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de funderingsproblematiek

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about foundation damage in cities and rural areas, including costs to homeowners, the Fonds Duurzaam Funderingsherstel, the role of KCAF and RVO, and innovation for bacterial decay of wooden piles. The government answered that the problem is poorly quantified and complex, that the loan fund has issued only 34 loans, that KCAF declined cooperation, and that the Rijksprogramma Aanpak Funderingsproblematiek will be developed further in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht ‘Premie verzekering omhoog door drempeltjes’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture whether mandatory drempels (small dams) in ridge cultivation on clay soils will cause more water damage, raise weather insurance premiums, and whether the measure will be reconsidered. The Minister replies that the drempelplicht has not entered into force after a parliamentary majority asked for its removal, that extreme-weather exceptions were foreseen, and that she sees no basis for compensation but will not proceed with the measure.
On 3 February I informed your House that I am heeding the request of a majority of your House to scrap this measure, by not letting it enter into force.
Op 3 februari jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat ik gehoor geef aan het verzoek van een meerderheid van uw Kamer om deze maatregel te schrappen, door deze niet in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over plannen voor legalisering door provincies van twee illegale megastallen van varkensindustrieel Straathof

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about provinces legalising two unlicensed pig megastables run by Straathof, whether this conflicts with buy-out schemes, and whether the state should refuse legalisation and tighten oversight. The Minister answers that permits follow the legal framework and PAS-melder rules, that the owner's foreign ban and animal welfare record are not grounds to refuse a Wnb permit, that NVWA inspections occurred with sanctions, and that no action to block the legalisation is planned.

Nor can the alleged improper conduct of the entrepreneur towards animals be taken into account in assessing the Wnb permit application, as this aspect falls outside the assessment framework for these applications.

Evenmin kan het gestelde onbehoorlijke gedrag van de ondernemer jegens dieren in de beoordeling van de aanvraag van een Wnb-vergunning worden betrokken, aangezien dit aspect niet valt binnen het toetsingskader voor de beoordeling van deze aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘De strijd tegen mestfraude’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about manure fraud, including NVWA inspection findings, NVWA capacity, the delayed real-time manure transport registration, bank support for offending firms and the need to reduce manure production. The Minister confirms the figures with caveats, points to the enforcement strategy and sector plan, defers the rVDM decision to a successor and declines to commit to reducing livestock numbers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het mogelijk uitsterven van haaien en roggen

An MP asked the minister about the decline of sharks and rays from overfishing, bycatch and the shortfin mako shark at ICCAT, including whether the EU voted against a moratorium. The minister confirmed most facts, said the Netherlands backed scientific advice for a moratorium while other EU states opposed it, and committed to keep pushing for one.
I will continue to push firmly within ICCAT for consistently following scientific advice; in this case, therefore, for a moratorium.
Ik zal mij binnen ICCAT nadrukkelijk blijven inzetten voor het consequent volgen van het wetenschappelijk advies; in deze dus voor een moratorium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het rapport ‘de onzichtbare vervuilers van de vlees- en zuivelindustrie’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Agriculture about a Milieudefensie report on the global greenhouse gas emissions of Vion, FrieslandCampina and VanDrie Group, and whether the Climate Agreement should cover supply-chain and foreign emissions. The minister disputed the report's figures and comparisons, said the Climate Agreement correctly targets national emissions, and declined to adopt new supply-chain rules or independent monitoring, while noting the sectors' responsibilities.
Monitoring of greenhouse gas emissions is already carried out by independent and expert bodies such as PBL, CBS and RIVM.
Monitoring van broeikasgasemissies wordt nu al uitgevoerd door onafhankelijke en deskundige instanties zoals PBL, CBS en het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het openbaar maken van de locatiegegevens van PAS-melders

An MP asked the agriculture minister about the Council of State ruling on publishing location data of PAS notifiers, the next steps, privacy and safety protection, and whether only map views could be released. The minister answered that location data will be published in March with names and addresses withheld, and that a legalisation programme will follow if the nitrogen bill passes.
Based on the ruling, only the location data of the businesses will be made public. The personal data of the initiators will remain redacted.
Op grond van de uitspraak worden enkel de locatiegegevens van de bedrijven openbaar gemaakt. De persoonsgegevens van de initiatiefnemers blijven gelakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en De Groot over het bericht 'Vattenfall mag in de Maas doorgaan met massaal vermalen van vissen'

D66 MPs Schonis and De Groot asked about fish mortality at Vattenfall's Maas hydropower plants (Lith, Linne), eel survival, the legal footing of the 10% mortality norm after a Council of State ruling, and Rijkswaterstaat's remedies. The minister acknowledged substantial eel and smolt mortality, said the 10% norm can no longer be applied without legal anchoring after the Council of State ruling, and committed to restoring the permit framework and reporting to parliament by June 2021.
