Unlike before, however, the Council of State has in a recent ruling held that the 10% norm can no longer be applied without further legal anchoring.
Anders dan voorheen heeft de Raad van State in een recente uitspraak echter geoordeeld dat die 10%-norm niet meer zonder nadere juridische verankering gehanteerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het vermalen van vissen bij waterkrachtcentrales

An MP asks whether hydropower plants on the Rhine and Maas (Vattenfall at Alphen and Maurik, RWE at Linne) are exempt from the 10% fish-mortality norm, why fish mortality remains high, whether fish passes and warning systems are monitored, and whether operators will be pressed to take extra measures. The minister confirms temporary exemptions for testing new fish-protection techniques under strict monitoring, says the Council of State ruled the 10% norm cannot currently be applied, and promises to amend the legal basis and continue talks with operators.
The Council of State ruled in its judgment that the 10% norm cannot be applied under the current legal anchoring. I will therefore have the legal anchoring amended.
De Raad van State heeft in haar uitspraak geoordeeld dat de 10%-norm bij de huidige juridische verankering niet gehanteerd kan worden. Ik zal de juridische verankering daarom laten aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over vismonitoring in het Eems estuarium

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the government would expand fish monitoring frequency in the Ems estuary, following a Waddenvereniging pilot showing year-round sampling gives a fuller picture. The minister answered that monitoring is under evaluation by Rijkswaterstaat, with results expected end 2021, and that the current frequency meets KRW requirements.
Based on the outcomes, the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management will decide whether the monitoring programme needs to be adjusted.
Op basis van de uitkomsten besluit de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat of het monitoringsprogramma aangepast moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'STAF: Provincie creëert zelf piekbelasters in stikstof'

Madlener (PVV) asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why nitrogen-sensitive nature zones are drawn up to farm yards, whether buffer zones were removed, the status of search areas and habitat maps, the transparency of AERIUS calculations and the reliability of AERIUS at hexagon level. The Minister answers that the actual sensitivity determines mapping, that buffer zones never existed, that search areas are not in AERIUS, that the methodology is publicly explained and that the advice of the Adviescollege is taken seriously.
This is part of the implementation of the Geurts/Harbers motion (Parliamentary paper 35 600, no. 31).
Dit is onderdeel van de uitvoering van de motie-Geurts/Harbers (Kamerstuk 35 600, nr. 31 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'Zoekgebieden, phishing en AERIUS' van de heer Hanekamp

An MP asked the minister about a blog critiquing the AERIUS nitrogen calculator, search areas and the buyout calculator's 'maatgevende hexagonen', and the lack of cost-benefit analysis. The minister rejected the criticisms, explained that search areas and key hexagons are methodological tools, and pointed to ongoing research, transparency measures and planned work on reducing the calculation precision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'Vergunningverlening ligt opnieuw stil'

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a Council of State ruling that intern salderen (netting within a farm) requires no permit, and whether future AERIUS model updates could make currently permit-free farm developments subject to permits, creating uncertainty for farmers. The Minister acknowledges the uncertainty, explains that AERIUS updates change calculation results, says that permits can no longer be granted for intern salderen and that provinces are mapping consequences, and promises to inform parliament before summer.
I can imagine that the ruling leads to uncertainty. Together with the provinces, I am mapping the scope and consequences for nitrogen policy of the ruling.
Ik kan mij voorstellen dat de uitspraak tot onzekerheid leidt. Samen met provincies breng ik de scope en consequenties voor het stikstofbeleid van de uitspraak in kaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over satellietgegevens landbouwgrond

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture how farmers report parcels to RVO for subsidies, how satellite and aerial checks work, whether natural-inclusive farming and trees in pastures are correctly classified, and whether farmers can receive pre-filled satellite data. The minister explained the Gecombineerde Opgave process, controls and payment timelines, said natural-inclusive farming cannot be recognised by satellites, and committed to pursuing more national flexibility in the new CAP.
I agree with Mr De Groot that natural-inclusive farming can make an important contribution to multiple goals in the agricultural area.
Ik ben het met het lid de Groot eens dat natuurinclusieve landbouw een belangrijke bijdrage kan leveren aan meerdere doelen in het agrarisch gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de onduidelijke brief over de inzet voor het bijenrichtsnoer

MP Wassenberg asked the minister to clarify what 'most conservative protection level' for honeybees means, why the Ctgb uses 12.8% rather than 7% colony loss, and whether the minister will push for 7% at the EU meeting. The minister answered that the 2013 EFSA guidance set 7% as the maximum acceptable effect, that the Ctgb chose 12.8% as most conservative given natural colony variability, and that she will urge the Commission to propose protection levels and to act on the latest science.
At the 23 February meeting I will call on the Commission to come with a proposal as soon as possible.
Tijdens de bijeenkomst van 23 februari zal ik de EC oproepen om zo snel mogelijk met een voorstel te komen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Weverling over het bericht 'Beschermenswaardige partijen: bescherming van het daderdier'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about dangerous fighting dogs, including unrestricted ownership, medical and police costs, shelters rehoming such dogs, breeding restrictions and the Amsterdam appeal court ruling on liability. Minister Schouten answered that existing criminal and municipal powers are sufficient, that breeding restrictions and a risk test exist or are being developed, and that rehoming is possible depending on behavioural testing.
Criminal law provisions apply that impose restrictions on keepers of dangerous dogs.
Er gelden strafrechtelijke voorschriften die beperkingen opleggen aan houders van gevaarlijke honden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de berichten dat steeds minder boeren de overstap naar biologische landbouw maken

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports that fewer farmers are converting to organic farming, whether this is worrying, and how the government can support conversion (support via CAP, financing, market promotion, public procurement and land access). The minister acknowledges the decline, says causes are unclear, and points to existing and planned measures such as the conversion programme, a conversion credit guarantee, and a study on local land cooperatives, while leaving some decisions to a later cabinet.
It is true that fewer farmers are making the switch to organic farming.
Het klopt dat minder boeren de overstap maken naar biologische landbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het artikel 'Zonne-eilanden in IJsselmeer als mogelijke energiebron'

MPs Bromet and Van der Lee asked the ministers about a proposal for solar islands on the IJsselmeer, the route map for solar on water, the Agenda IJsselmeergebied 2050, and the Wieringerhoek MIRT project that excluded energy generation. The minister answered that a route map was sent to parliament, a pilot pre-study is ordered, the Wieringerhoek scope will be assessed at the planuitwerkingsfase, and more clarity is expected in 2021 and autumn 2021.
In addition, Rijkswaterstaat has been commissioned to carry out a pre-study for a pilot with floating solar panels on the IJsselmeer.
Daarnaast is opdracht gegeven aan Rijkswaterstaat tot een pre-verkenning voor een pilot met drijvende zonnepanelen op het IJsselmeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het melden van telen op zand en/of löss grond door boeren

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the requirement for farmers to report maize cultivation on sandy and loess soils by 15 February, including notification figures, prior maize acreage, administrative burden, flexibility, handhaving, and related questions. The Minister answers that 12,216 notifications covering 115,937 hectares had been received, provides acreage data and a burden estimate of about 249,000 euros, notes that notifications can be amended or withdrawn, and defends the measure as part of the Nitrates Directive action programme.
I am always willing to have the conversation with farmers about their experiences in practice.
Ik ben altijd bereid het gesprek te voeren met boeren over hun ervaringen in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het rapport ‘Basel III Reforms: Updated Impact Study’ van de Europese Bankenautoriteit

Three VVD MPs asked the Finance and Agriculture ministers about the EBA's Basel III updated impact study, including the claimed 21% capital increase for Dutch banks, the effect on agricultural and mortgage lending, and whether the impact is unfairly borne by farm credit. The minister answered that the impact depends on the EU implementation proposal expected in H1 2021, that interministerial talks with banks continue, and that a Commission impact analysis will follow.
Once the Commission presents a legislative proposal, the cabinet will inform the House of its position via the usual BNC fiche procedure.
Zodra de CIE met een wetgevend voorstel komt, zal het kabinet uw Kamer informeren over haar inzet volgens de gebruikelijke weg van een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de dreigende slacht van honderdduizenden haaien voor coronavaccins

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether squalene from shark livers used in some COVID-19 vaccines should be replaced by plant-based sources and whether the government would choose vaccines without protected animals. The minister confirmed shark-derived squalene is in the Sanofi/GSK vaccine, said plant-based alternatives are preferable where equivalent, and promised to ask contract partners in future agreements about protected animals in production.
I am, however, willing to ask the contracting party in the case of new agreements whether they use protected animals in the production process.
Ik ben wel bereid om in geval van nieuwe overeenkomsten aan de contractpartij te vragen of ze gebruik maken van beschermde dieren bij het productieproces
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het nieuws dat jagers worden uitgezonderd van de avondklok

An SP MP asked why hunters were exempted from the evening curfew, what the urgency of culling large game is, and whether this exemption should be scrapped. The minister replied that only wild boar management, to prevent African swine fever, is treated as a necessary activity, that hunters must still follow other COVID rules, and that she does not agree the exemption should be lifted.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de veiligheid van medewerkers bij de NVWA

An MP from D66 asked the agriculture minister about NVWA staff from animal welfare teams who feel misrepresented by an internal report, reports of intimidation for contacting politicians, and how confidential report passages became identifiable and public. The minister confirmed staff concerns, said contact with politicians is not forbidden but issues should first be raised internally, announced an external integrity commission with its own complaints point, and released the report for transparency despite identifiable passages.
In addition to these existing internal procedures, I am establishing an external integrity commission with its own reporting point.
Naast deze bestaande interne procedures stel ik een externe integriteitscommissie in met een eigen meldpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat een glastuinbouwbedrijf door de verhoogde Opslag Duurzame Energieheffing (ODE) overschakelt van elektriciteit naar gas

An MP asked the ministers whether the rise in the ODE energy levy, which pushes a greenhouse firm back from electricity to gas, undermines electrification and whether compensation will be paid. The government acknowledged the fiscal incentive problem, promised a compensation scheme and an evaluation in spring, but refused to revisit the levy rates in the short term.
I am not prepared to reconsider the rates in the short term.
Ik ben niet bereid om de tarieven op korte termijn te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het Natura 2000-beleid

MP Bisschop (SGP) asks the minister about the Natura 2000 policy, including nitrogen thresholds, the Standard Data Forms versus Article 17 reports, critical deposition values, ammonia-deposition correlation, and the Holohan judgment regarding which species and habitats must be protected. The minister answers that the approach is sound and defensible, that the Arcadis analysis gives no reason to change policy, and that the foreign comparison is not yet conclusive.
As appears from the answers to questions 8 and 9, there is no reason to change the policy following the Arcadis report.
Zoals uit het antwoord bij vraag 8 en 9 blijkt, is er geen aanleiding om naar aanleiding van het Arcadis-rapport het beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de ontheffing van de avondklok voor de jacht op zwijnen en vossen

An MP asked the government whether hunting wild boar and foxes at night is exempt from the curfew, why night hunting is allowed, and whether local permits were centrally requested. The minister replied that hunting is not a curfew exemption, only the necessary management of wild boar (to prevent African swine fever) and handling of road-killed wildlife is treated as essential work, agreed with the provinces.
In the third week of January, before the curfew was introduced, the ministry received requests from, among others, the KNJV about being able to carry out necessary wildlife management at night.

Het ministerie heeft in de derde week van januari, voorafgaand aan de invoering van de avondklok, verzoeken ontvangen van onder andere de KNJV over het in de nacht kunnen uitvoeren van noodzakelijk wildbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Vogelgriep bij pluimveebedrijf in Hekendorp'

MP De Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a bird flu outbreak at a poultry farm in Hekendorp, near housing, including the number of birds culled, neighbour nuisance, and schemes for sanitation or conversion to circular farming. The minister confirmed about 120,242 chickens were culled, said local authorities handle nuisance and siting, declined to comment on individual cases, and listed general subsidy schemes but no national scheme specifically for odour nuisance from poultry farms.
Local authorities are responsible for policy on the siting of poultry farms and housing and for taking measures in case of nuisance.
Lokale overheden zijn verantwoordelijk voor het beleid ten aanzien van de vestiging van pluimveebedrijven en woningen en voor het nemen van maatregelen bij eventuele hinder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het uitbreiden van een Natura 2000-gebied met een voormalig defensieterrein

Wassenberg (PvdD) asks whether the former Defence terrain near Meijendel Natura 2000 area, which The Hague council wants returned to nature, will be added to the protected area, and whether Zuid-Holland can help acquire it. The minister answers that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is examining with the municipality, province and stakeholders whether transfer is possible, aiming for clarity by September 2021, while the province plays a facilitating role.
The aim is to have clarity on this by September 2021.
Het streven is hier in september 2021 duidelijkheid over te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de koehandel met Nieuwkoopse 'stikstofruimte'

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about livestock farmers in Nieuwkoop trading nitrogen deposition rights, the Natura 2000 reduction needed, and whether this is legally permissible under the PAS ruling. The minister confirms the high deposition levels, says the farms are not the main cause, admits the PAS rulings limit using nitrogen gains for mitigation, but says external netting and leasing remain allowed under policy rules being reviewed with the provinces.
For now there is no reason to assume that private initiatives are, by their nature, measures within the meaning of Article 6(1) and (2) of the Habitats Directive that could only benefit nature.

Vooralsnog is er geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat particuliere initiatieven naar hun aard zijn aan te merken als maatregelen in de zin van artikel 6, lid 1 en 2 Hrl, die alleen ten goede zouden kunnen komen aan de natuur.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Bisschop, Madlener en Van Haga over het schrappen van artikel 8b uit het Besluit gebruik meststoffen ter uitvoering van het zesde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

MPs from VVD, CDA, SGP, PVV and FvD asked whether the minister would drop article 8b of the manure decree (requiring drempels between potato ridges on clay and loess soils), citing hindrance to integrated cultivation and conflicting research findings. The minister answered that the article cannot be amended after publication, so it will be excluded from entry into force by royal decree, while stating that nutrient runoff measures remain important for the seventh action programme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het besluit om drempels in de ruggenteelt op kleigronden verplicht te stellen

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the mandatory use of drainage-blocking ridges in potato cultivation on clay soils, questioning whether runoff effects were studied for flat fields and whether the net effect on surface water is limited. The Minister answers that preliminary research shows drams reduce runoff on flat fields too, that quantification is ongoing with publication in 2022, and that the regulation will not be reconsidered.
Preliminary results indicate that on flat fields as well, drams have a blocking effect on the leaching and runoff of nutrients.
Voorlopige resultaten wijzen er op dat ook op vlakke percelen drempels een blokkerend effect hebben op uit- en afspoeling van nutriënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asks the government about Maastricht Aachen Airport growth, noise in Limburg quiet areas, and conflicting studies on tourism impacts, and asks whether the growth doctrine influenced commissioned research. The minister answers that the province of Limburg is responsible for quiet areas and for MAA's future, that the independent advice is pending, and that he does not take positions on the Breda and Ecorys studies, while also replying on the air-freight levy report and rejecting a growth doctrine.

Since I am not the commissioning party for either study and there is no formal application for an airport decision yet that I must consider, I do not think it is appropriate to make statements about either study.

Aangezien ik geen opdrachtgever ben van beide onderzoeken en er nog geen formele aanvraag voor een luchthavenbesluit ligt waarover ik mij moet buigen acht ik het niet opportuun om uitspraken te doen over beide onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over de brief 'Agenda voor het Waddengebied 2050' d.d. 11 december 2020

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about the Waddenagenda 2050, including how the VVD/CDA motion on protecting economic sectors (agriculture, potato seed sector, fisheries, harbours, tourism) is reflected, the impact analysis, the signing of the declaration of agreement, consultation outcomes, and the balance between ecology and economy. The ministers answered that the impact analysis will run parallel to the implementation programme, sectors will be involved via the Omgevingsberaad, consultation led to a strengthened landbouw section, and a site visit is desired but not yet scheduled.

As indicated in the letter of 11 December 2020, in line with this motion, a broad impact analysis will be started in parallel with drafting the Implementation Programme so that effects on ecology and economy can be weighed in balance.

Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 11 december 2020 1 wordt, in lijn met deze motie 2 , parallel aan het opstellen van het Uitvoeringsprogramma Waddengebied 2021–2026 (Uitvoeringsprogramma) gestart met een brede impactanalyse om zo de effecten op ecologie en economie in balans met elkaar te kunnen afwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de NVWA al maandenlang weigert controles uit te voeren bij foute fokkers

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks why the NVWA has suspended enforcement of rules on breeding companion animals since March 2020, citing COVID-19, and whether it has developed protocols for home inspections. The minister confirms the suspension, says a protocol for inspections in domestic settings is being finalised, and commits to enforcement resuming once it can be done safely, with the decision on enforcement requests postponed until mid-2021.
A protocol has in the meantime been drawn up for inspections in domestic settings.
Er is overigens inmiddels een protocol opgesteld voor inspecties in huiselijke kring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Laçin, Van Raan en Stoffer over de stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport

MPs asked whether the 2014 nitrogen calculations for Lelystad Airport were wrong, why a high heat content was used, and whether the 2015 airport decision and 2019 PAS notification should be voided. The minister acknowledges calculation errors, says the PAS notification was made in good faith and will be legalised under a verification procedure, and promises to share the project-specific assessment later.
As reported in the letter to parliament of 3 December, I will share the project-specific assessment with the House once it is completed.
Antwoord 3 Zoals gemeld in de Kamerbrief van 3 december 5 zal ik de project specifieke beoordeling met de Kamer delen zodra deze is afgerond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, De Groot, Graus, Bromet, Futselaar en Moorlag over het opnemen van de haas en het konijn op de lijst bedreigde zoogdieren, terwijl beide nog steeds bejaagd worden

MPs from six parties asked the minister why the hare and rabbit, newly listed as threatened on the Red List of mammals, may still be hunted, and whether they will be removed from the huntable species list. The minister answered that both are listed as 'sensitive' rather than threatened, that the hunting season for hares has ended and for rabbits ends in January, and that research on population decline and hunting effects will be commissioned, with possible further protection measures to follow.
Next year I will have further research carried out into the decline of these species.
Het komende jaar zal ik verder onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de afname van deze soorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het artikel 'Konijn en haas op rode lijst met bedreigde zoogdieren, otter en zeehond eraf'

An MP asked the minister about the 2020 Red List of mammals (basisrapport), covering the choice of contractor, the advisory committee, the 1950 baseline, trend methods, use of hunting-district counts, and predator effects. The minister defended the methodology, said WBE data could be used once standardised and validated, and disputed that predation-by-cats was the only factor.
I will look into whether this is possible in the future.
Ik ga bekijken of dit in de toekomst mogelijk is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Vries, Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘Onrust bij pachters van buitendijks land achter Waddenzeedijk’ en ‘Rijkscommissie: Waddengebied moet Nationaal Landschapspark worden’

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about unrest among tenant farmers over the Wadden Sea dike plans and a national committee's proposal to make the Wadden region a National Landscape Park, including consultation with stakeholders and the absence of an impact analysis. The minister answered that dike reinforcement is being planned with stakeholders in phases, that the committee's advice is still being discussed with the parties concerned, and that a broad impact analysis will be started in parallel with the Wadden implementation programme.
In parallel with drafting the implementation programme, a broad impact analysis will be started, in line with the Dijkstra and Geurts motion, to weigh the effects on economy and ecology in balance.

Antwoord 14 Parallel aan het opstellen van het Uitvoeringsprogramma zal, in lijn met de motie Dijkstra en Geurts 8 , worden gestart met een brede impactanalyse om zo de effecten op economie en ecologie in balans met elkaar te kunnen afwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het geringe animo voor de subsidieregeling voor een wolfwerend raster

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the low uptake of the subsidy scheme for wolf-proof fencing, the number of sheep killed by people and dogs, the protection of wolves against disturbance, and whether hunting in wolf habitat is compatible with protection rules. The minister said the province of Gelderland monitors its own scheme, declined to launch a campaign or commission independent research, and argued that hunting and population management are not in conflict with protection rules.
Nationally it is not centrally recorded how many sheep are killed outside the slaughterhouse, so these numbers are not known to me.
Er wordt niet centraal geregistreerd hoeveel schapen buiten het slachthuis worden gedood. Deze aantallen zijn mij daarom niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de jacht op wilde zwijnen zonder deugdelijke schietvaardigheidstoets

An MP asks the minister why wild boar hunting proceeds without a proven shooting-skill test after the drive-hunt ban, and whether hunters can be assured animals will not suffer. The minister replies that shooting is only at standing animals from high seats, that legal duties and hunting codes apply, and that retesting is left to land managers rather than being legally required.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en De Groot over het bericht dat er wensballonnen in omloop zijn die niet voldoen aan de veiligheidseisen.

Two D66 MPs asked ministers whether sales of wish balloons that fail safety rules are rising during the fireworks ban, and what enforcement and public information exist. The government replied that it has no data on rising sales, that the NVWA enforces product safety rules and that municipalities may ban releases, while placing responsibility for safe use on consumers.
I am not aware whether sales of these products are increasing, because the NVWA has not carried out any research into this.
Het is mij niet bekend of er een toename is in de verkoop van deze producten omdat daar door de NVWA geen onderzoek naar gedaan is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het artikel 'Eerste besmetting met westnijlvirus in Nederland'

D66 MPs De Groot and Diertens asked the ministers about the first human West Nile virus infection in the Netherlands, expected case numbers, measures against mosquitoes, and a letter warning about the tiger mosquito. The minister said case forecasts are not possible, mosquito control for West Nile is still under study with a first advice expected in December, and the tiger mosquito is unrelated to West Nile transmission and is already being eradicated by the NVWA.
A first advice from the zoonoses response team is expected at the beginning of December.
Begin december wordt een eerste advies verwacht vanuit het responsteam zoönosen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over de relatie tussen besmetting met de parasiet Toxoplasma gondii en het risico op ongevallen en geestelijke aandoeningen

MPs Diertsen and De Groot asked whether Toxoplasma gondii infection is linked to traffic accidents and mental disorders, what is known about infection rates and prevention in the Netherlands, and whether prevention is proportionate. The minister answered that the associations are not causal, that the Dutch evidence finds no link to depression or anxiety, and that current prevention and consumer advice are the best feasible approach, with a committed cost-benefit review and a meat-safety project underway.
It therefore cannot be concluded that toxoplasmosis increases the chance of being involved in a traffic accident.
Er kan dus niet worden geconcludeerd dat toxoplasmose de kans vergroot om betrokken te raken bij een verkeersongeval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht 'Vergoeding lekke mestkelder ‘lachertje’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about reports that compensation for leaking manure cellars damaged by Groningen earthquakes would be based on economic rather than actual damage, and about timelines and the IMG's approach. The government answered that the IMG will publish its method for manure cellar damage in early 2021, that the expert panel advised repair costs unless they exceed 1.25 times capitalised business damage, and that the IMG's independence limits pre-empting its decision.
It is not appropriate for me to anticipate this, also given the independence of the IMG.
Het past mij niet, ook gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van IMG, hier nu al op vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de verkoop van illegaal geïmporteerd bushmeat

An SP MP asked the ministers about illegal bushmeat imports and sales in the Netherlands, customs and NVWA enforcement, sanctions, zoonotic risks and CBD voluntary guidance. The minister answered that customs and NVWA check risk-based, that bushmeat is not registered separately, that sanctions apply under food-safety and nature law, and that there is no insight into transit via Belgium.
This is not known. Veterinary legislation sets requirements for meat imports but does not distinguish so-called bushmeat from other meat.
Dit is niet bekend. De veterinaire wetgeving kent verplichtingen voor de invoer van vlees, maar maakt daarbij geen onderscheid tussen zogenaamd «bushmeat» en ander vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat ontsnapte chimpansees zijn doodgeschoten in Dierenpark Amersfoort

MP Wassenberg asked about the shooting of two escaped chimpanzees at Dierenpark Amersfoort caused by a human error, and whether this warrants reconsidering chimpanzee captivity, zoo safety rules and zoos' right to exist. The minister said the shooting was a necessary safety decision, that the park has started an independent investigation, and that no ban, new inquiry or reconsideration of zoos is planned.
Dierenpark Amersfoort takes its responsibility in this and has started an independent investigation.
Dierenpark Amersfoort neemt hierin haar verantwoordelijkheid en is een onafhankelijk onderzoek gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Lodders en Geurts over het deskundigenverslag deskundigengroep dierziekten HPAI evaluatie van 13 november 2020 ‘eendenbedrijf besmet’

MPs Lodders and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture about the expert report on avian influenza (HPAI) after a duck farm infection, covering spread, monitoring, ventilation routes, pest control, salmonella checks and export of meat from protection zones. The Minister answered most questions in substance, pointing to ongoing research and biosecurity measures, while declining to commit to raising meat export rules with the European Commission.
I therefore cannot now commit to putting this topic on the European agenda.
Ik kan daarom nu niet toezeggen dat ik dit onderwerp Europees zal agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de poging van Twente Airport om zonder vergunning zeer zware vliegtuigen te laten vertrekken

MP Van Raan asked the government about Twente Airport's attempt to operate very heavy aircraft without a permit, including whether the ILT granted an exemption under pressure and whether the airport repeatedly pushes regulatory limits. The minister answered that the ILT granted a one-off exemption for six Lufthansa aircraft under additional safety conditions, denied any influence from litigation threats or the airport's business plan, and said the ILT will tighten oversight of the airport.
The ILT is intensifying its attention on the airport because, based on the facts described, it has found that the airport repeatedly seeks the limits of the rules.

De ILT verscherpt haar aandacht voor de luchthaven, omdat zij op basis van de hiervoor beschreven feiten en omstandigheden heeft geconstateerd dat de luchthaven telkens de grenzen van de regels opzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Amhaouch en Postma over het bericht 'Onbegrip bij provincie over weigering Rijk om informatie voor stikstofaanpak te delen'

CDA MPs asked the agriculture minister why the national government refuses to share nitrogen-related farm data with provinces on privacy grounds, and whether this delays regional nitrogen plans, and asked about a study focusing on peak-polluting farms. The minister answered that privacy-sensitive data is not essential, that provinces already hold much of the information, that work on an alternative data-access solution is ongoing, and that the study reflects only one part of the broader approach.
I am working with RVO and BIJ12 (on behalf of the provinces) on an alternative solution to make the last part of the relevant information accessible to the provinces.
Ik werk samen met RVO en BIJ12 (namens de provincies) aan een alternatieve oplossing om het laatste deel van de relevante informatie toegankelijk te maken voor de provincies.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en De Groot over de artikelen ‘Waar kalkoenen klokken zwijgen de hijskranen’ en ‘Helaas het stikstofprobleem is niet opgelost met het uitkopen van 25 piekbelasters al helpt het wel’

MPs Bromet and De Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about nitrogen 'peak emitters' near Natura 2000 areas, the targeted buy-out scheme, a Gelderland study and provincial roles. The minister answered that provinces control targeting and timing, that the evaluation of the first tranche will guide future steps, and declined to give some data (such as the number of applicants) until spring 2021; she also failed to complete answers to questions 16 and 17 on time.
I am not aware whether these companies are aware of this.
Het is mij niet bekend of deze bedrijven hier van op de hoogte zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het artikel 'Overheid raadt kastomaat van eigen bodem af'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture whether it is correct that the government-funded Milieu Centraal advised consumers against winter tomatoes grown in Dutch soil, and whether this harms the reputation of Dutch horticulture. The Minister replied that it is not for government to dictate independent advice, noted the outdated calendar was taken offline, and said it is not possible to judge the environmental impact without current calculations.
It is not for the government to determine what advice independent organisations, such as Milieu Centraal, give.
Het is niet aan de overheid om te bepalen welk advies onafhankelijke organisaties, zoals Milieu Centraal, geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Overheid raadt kastomaat van eigen bodem af’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether a Milieu Centraal seasonal fruit and vegetable calendar, partly government-funded, wrongly rated Dutch winter tomatoes as less sustainable than Spanish or Moroccan ones, and how this fits the government's support for short supply chains. The minister confirmed the calendar was taken offline, said no LNV subsidy went to it, stated no current calculation allows a reliable country comparison, and declined to direct an independent organisation's advice.
At present no current calculation is available that would allow a careful statement on how the current production of Dutch tomatoes compares to tomato production in other countries.

Op dit moment is er geen actuele berekening beschikbaar waarmee een zorgvuldige uitspraak gedaan kan worden over hoe de huidige productie van Nederlandse tomaten zich tot de productie van tomaten in andere landen verhoudt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Deze supermarkten stunten nog steeds met varkenshaasjes’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that supermarkets still promote pork tenderloin without the Beter Leven quality mark, despite a voluntary agreement, and whether the Minister will hold them to account. The Minister answered that the agreement is between private chain parties, that she cannot verify the figures or whether the agreement is kept, and that she will discuss progress with supermarkets and report on a sustainability reporting standard before summer 2021.
This concerns an agreement that chain parties have made among themselves.
Dit gaat om een afspraak die ketenpartijen onderling met elkaar gemaakt hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de razendsnelle verspreiding van het vogelgriepvirus over Nederland

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the rapid spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza, the origin of such viruses in poultry farming, the culling of poultry by gassing, the lack of a nationwide hunting ban, and whether the government will reduce livestock numbers to limit zoonotic risk. The Minister answers most questions factually, defends the terminology and biosecurity measures, rejects a nationwide hunting ban as having limited effect, and says a broader expert group will examine zoonosis prevention.

The cabinet will, together with an expert group to be established, map out what is needed across public health, animal health and the environment to reduce as far as possible the risk of zoonoses arising.

Het kabinet zal daartoe samen met een expertgroep die ingesteld zal worden in beeld brengen wat nodig is in de breedte van volksgezondheid, diergezondheid en milieu om het risico op het ontstaan van zoönosen zoveel mogelijk te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over EKO1000-vallen voor ratten en muizen

An MP asked the minister whether EKO1000 rat and mouse traps cause unnecessary suffering, whether the sedative liquid was approved by the Ctgb, and whether the traps may still be sold and what enforcement the ILT has taken. The minister answered that no scientific evidence shows unnecessary suffering, that WUR research is commissioned with a report due Q4 2021, that the liquid lacks Ctgb approval and is not permitted, and that the importer has stopped sales while others still offer it online.

Enquiries with Wageningen University & Research (WUR) and the Pest Animal Knowledge and Advice Centre show that there is no scientific research data on the basis of which it can be concluded that the EKO1000 trap causes unnecessary suffering.

Navraag bij Wageningen University & Research (WUR) en het Kennis- en Adviescentrum Dierplagen leert dat er geen wetenschappelijke onderzoeksgegevens beschikbaar zijn op basis waarvan geconcludeerd kan worden dat de EKO1000-val leidt tot onnodig lijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het nieuws dat de controle op visvangst in de Nederlandse havens tekortschiet

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that fish catch controls in Dutch ports are deficient, and about the Deloitte finding that the NVWA lacks capacity for fisheries sustainability enforcement. The minister acknowledged the Commission's findings, promised a tighter sampling plan and more NVWA capacity, but refused to share the Commission's letter because the infringement procedure is confidential.
No, this concerns a legal procedure between the European Commission and the Dutch government.
Nee, het gaat hier om een juridische procedure tussen de Europese Commissie en de Nederlandse regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bijtekenen van tienduizenden hectares stikstof gevoelige natuur in rekenmodel Aerius

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the addition of tens of thousands of hectares of nitrogen-sensitive nature, including species habitats, to the AERIUS habitat map, and who is responsible for drawing these areas. The minister replied that the 2017 expansion to species habitats was transparently announced and applied to PAS analyses, that provinces and the competent authorities are responsible for the habitat maps, and that the legal protection of species habitats is equal to that of habitat types.
The inclusion of nitrogen-sensitive habitats is first ecologically tested and then implemented in AERIUS under the administrative responsibility of the central government and provinces.
Het opnemen van stikstofgevoelige leefgebieden wordt eerst ecologisch getoetst en vervolgens onder bestuurlijke verantwoordelijkheid van Rijk en provincies doorgevoerd in AERIUS.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het bericht 'Geniepig stikstofgevoelige natuur bijgeplust in Aerius' en het Stichting Agri Facts onderzoek 'Veel stikstofgevoelige natuur bijgetekend in rekenmodel Aerius (2017

An MP asks whether the AERIUS nitrogen model added about 80,000 hectares of nitrogen-sensitive nature without stakeholder visibility, and how habitat maps are updated and by whom. The minister says the increase stems from a transparent 2017 update adding species habitats, that only competent authorities (provinces, Rijkswaterstaat, Defence) update the maps via independent validation, and that the 2020 total of 173,878 ha was set within the designation decisions with no later additions by nature organisations.
This addition was made transparently, by posting on the AERIUS website on 1 September 2017, among other things, the following message.
Deze toevoeging is op transparante wijze gebeurd door op 1 september 2017 o.a. het volgende bericht te plaatsen op de AERIUS-website
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over de aanwijzing van natuurgebieden en het toevoegen van stikstofgevoelige habitats in het verleden

An MP asks the minister whether AERIUS was quietly expanded with more nitrogen-sensitive habitat, whether nature organisations shape the policy model, and whether farmers are right to feel targeted. The minister answers that the 2017 addition of sensitive habitat areas was transparently published, that habitat maps are made by competent authorities and independent experts rather than nature groups, and that the policy aims to enable development for farmers too.
This addition was made in a transparent manner by, among other things, posting the following message on the AERIUS website on 1 September 2017.
Deze toevoeging is op transparante wijze gebeurd door op 1 september 2017 o.a. het volgende bericht te plaatsen op de AERIUS-website
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht ‘Column: Democratische vraagtekens over bijplussen stikstofnatuur’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report claiming nitrogen-sensitive nature was mapped in AERIUS on privately owned land without a public administrative procedure, asking who decides these locations, whether landowners can object, and whether specific locations were changed. The Minister replied that the maps only reflect the factual presence of protected habitats based on objective data, that objection is possible via existing procedures, and that nature organisations cannot update the map themselves, while stating the mapping is not a legal designation and answering the location-specific questions only partly.
It is therefore not a legal or policy decision, but a representation of the factual situation.
Het is dus geen juridische of beleidsmatige beslissing, maar een weergave van de feitelijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over voedselverspilling

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Agriculture about food waste linked to cosmetic standards for fruit and vegetables, the status of a motion, EU-level action, and inclusion of class II produce in the school fruit scheme. The minister answered that retailers have committed to relaxing cosmetic demands, that the EU-level recommendation is pending in UNECE discussions, and that the school fruit scheme rules will be amended to allow class II produce by spring 2021.
Yes, at the upcoming revision of the School Fruit, Vegetables and Milk Scheme 2019 it will be amended so that class II products can also be supplied to schools.
Ja, bij de komende herziening van de Regeling schoolfruit,-groente en -melk 2019 zal deze zo worden aangepast dat ook klasse II producten geleverd kunnen worden aan scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de nog altijd voortdurende dreiging van het coronavirus in de vleesindustrie

MP Ouwehand asked the ministers whether they would prevent meat processor Vion from raising slaughter rates and why no intervention followed at Vion and Van Rooi Meat, and asked about coronavirus transmission via meat and the scope of slaughterhouse testing. The minister replied that slaughter hours were only temporarily reduced and are returning to normal, that the safety region judged the situations safe enough and acted case by case, and that testing is risk-based and scientific evidence shows food transmission is very unlikely.
It is up to the chair of the safety region, within infectious disease control, to take the most suitable control measures case by case.
Het is aan de voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio in het kader van infectieziektenbestrijding om per geval de meest geëigende (beheers)maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Graus over de tv-uitzending 'Kees van der Spek Oplichters Aangepakt’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about captive lion breeding and canned trophy hunting in South Africa, CITES quotas for captive-bred lion bone exports, controls, zoonotic health risks, a ban on trophy imports, and lion conservation. The minister answered that Dutch import permits for trophies of listed species have been refused since 2016, that Dutch and EU efforts to uplist the African lion to CITES Appendix I are ongoing with the next CoP planned for 2022, that no 2020 quota had been set by South Africa, and that she would consult other departments and WNF on public warnings.
I committed to your House to use all possibilities within the EU with a view to the next CITES Conference of the Parties (CoP).
Ik heb daarop uw Kamer toegezegd alle mogelijkheden in EU-verband te benutten met het oog op de volgende CITES Conference of the Parties (CoP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht “Wat overblijft van de I&R-affaire”

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about a report on the I&R cattle registration affair, including the 2018 blocking of thousands of dairy farms, the length of handling, financial damages and improvements to prevent recurrence. The minister acknowledges the Court's new interpretation implies the blockades should have been decided differently, reports about 130 damage claims with 30 settled, and promises to implement the ruling and apply lessons to future rules.
I must therefore acknowledge that, with the information available now, this situation should have been handled differently.
Ik moet dan ook erkennen dat er, met de informatie van nu, in deze situatie anders gehandeld had moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het slachten van paling

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about eel slaughtered without stunning, after NVWA inspections in 2019 found four of eleven farms in breach. The minister confirmed the violations, said the companies were warned and will be re-checked next year, and rejected continuous supervision as unnecessary.
The other companies have been ordered to urgently comply with the Regulation.
De andere bedrijven zijn gemaand om met spoed aan de Regeling gevolg te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over separatorvlees

Parliamentary questions from MP Futselaar (SP) asked about the volume, producers and buyers of mechanically separated meat (separatorvlees), its traceability rules, sanctions, NVWA enforcement capacity and labelling. The minister answered that no central registry of production volumes or buyers exists, that traceability follows EU rules and that the NVWA applies regular inspections and sanctions, but gave no figures for volumes or enforcement hours.
There is no overview of companies that process mechanically separated meat.
Er bestaat geen overzicht van bedrijven die separatorvlees verwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Extreem gevoelig; Corona besmettingen op nertsenfokkerijen’

The MP De Groot asked the Agriculture Minister about reports of COVID-19 infections on mink farms, including questions on hygiene protocols, screening timing, worker testing, escaped minks and possible intentional infection. The minister answered that the transmission route is unknown, that hygiene measures are adequately followed, that the NVWA-IOD found no evidence of intentional infection, and that the investigation was closed.
I can only repeat that the researchers of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine have not yet been able to determine how the virus spreads between mink farms.
Ik kan slechts herhalen dat de onderzoekers van de Faculteit Diergeneeskunde bij het onderzoek naar de insleeproutes nog niet hebben kunnen achterhalen hoe het virus spreidt tussen nertsenbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Dierenbeschermers willen verbod op reptielenbeurs in Houten: ‘Kan in coronatijd niet door de beugel’’

An MP asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Health about a reptile fair in Houten held during the coronavirus crisis, including exotic species, possible zoonotic risks, legality of origin and enforcement by the NVWA. The minister replied that neither the Besluit houders van dieren nor the Wet publieke gezondheid allows preventive bans on animal fairs, that inspections and enforcement are carried out, and declined to answer the questions again in the committee debate.
Neither the Besluit houders van dieren under the Wet Dieren nor the Wet publieke gezondheid grants powers to preventively prohibit animal fairs.
Noch het Besluit houders van dieren onder de Wet Dieren, noch de Wet publieke gezondheid geeft bevoegdheden om beurzen met dieren preventief te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het artikel 'Zwaar weer dreigt voor boeren bij Wierdense Veld'

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether the Wierdense Veld studies were independent, whether nitrogen targets are feasible given foreign deposition, and about the costs, certainty and proportionality of保 restoring the bog under Natura 2000. The minister defended the independence of the consultancies, acknowledged cost estimates of about 39.5 million euro, and said the government will discuss proportionality of Natura 2000 measures with the European Commission.
The cabinet therefore intends to enter into discussion with the European Commission about the proportionality of the measures to be taken under Natura 2000.
Het kabinet is daarom voornemens het gesprek met de Europese Commissie aan te gaan over de proportionaliteit van de te nemen maatregelen in het kader van Natura 2000.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'Minister Schouten blijft stikstofbeleid ophangen aan één rekenmodel'

An MP asked whether the minister had modelled the nitrogen policy measures with multiple models, including the European LOTOS-EUROS/EMEP model, and whether the results would be shared with parliament. The minister replied that OPS is used because it allows detailed local calculations needed for permit decisions, and that a Kennisprogramma Stikstof will examine ensemble modelling with several models.
For the calculation of the policy package in the bill on nitrogen reduction and nature improvement, the Operational Priority Substances model (OPS) is used.
Voor de doorrekening van het maatregelenpakket van het wetsvoorstel Stikstofreductie en natuurverbetering wordt gebruik gemaakt van het Operationele Prioritaire Stoffen model (OPS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het model waar het stikstofbeleid op gebaseerd is

An MP from FvD asked the minister why nitrogen policy relies solely on the AERIUS/OPS model rather than LOTOS-EUROS, and whether Germany uses LOTOS and the Hordijk committee's advice was followed. The minister answered that OPS is the only model giving the detailed one-hectare local deposition calculations needed for permits, that LOTOS-EUROS cannot do this, and that Germany uses LOTOS only for less detailed policy purposes, while declining to commit to running the policy with LOTOS.
This level of detail is needed to calculate nitrogen deposition for nature permit granting.
Dit detailniveau is nodig om ten behoeve van natuurvergunningverlening de depositie van stikstof te kunnen berekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht ‘misleidende kindermarketing door de vee-industrie’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government will act against pig-industry marketing aimed at children, including the 'The Pig Story' lesson pack and the Agractie 'Boer in de klas' programme that receives a start-up subsidy. Minister Schouten answers that schools freely choose their materials, the government does not vet or warn against them, no oversight tightening is planned, and the subsidy conditions are described.
Beyond that, I do not foresee any additional steps.
Verder voorzie ik geen extra stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘de dramatische achteruitgang van de biodiversiteit in Europa, die hoofdzakelijk veroorzaakt wordt door de industriële landbouw’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the decline of European biodiversity, the role of intensive farming, the Natura 2000 stikstof approach, pesticide-related bee mortality and the new CAP and derogation. The minister answers that EU targets were not met, defends the stikstof and CAP approach, says the bee risk-assessment is pending EFSA and rejects some demands for stricter measures.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen over de berichten ‘De Lugt: ‘Neonics-dossier bieten moet terug op tafel’ en ‘Ook Duitse bietentelers eisen derogatie neonics’ en over h

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about France's move to allow temporary derogations for neonicotinoid pesticides and the impact on Dutch sugar beet growers, questioning the level playing field and the lack of consultation with the sector. The minister answers that the French change is still pending in the Senate, that Dutch derogation requests are assessed on agricultural necessity and risks, and that she will consult the sector and pursue transition solutions.
I am of course willing to discuss the economic consequences and possible alternatives to neonicotinoid-containing products with the sector.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid om samen met de sector te spreken over de economische gevolgen en over de mogelijke alternatieven voor neonicotinoïne-houdende middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht "etiket dwarsboomt lage dosering gewasbeschermingsmiddelen"

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that labelling prevents low-dose application of crop protection products, and whether the authorisation body, the Ctgb, and the sector should facilitate low-dose systems and precision techniques. The minister answers that the Ctgb can only authorise what the holder submits, that the holder is responsible for label extensions, and points to the Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030 programme, with no concrete new commitments beyond reviewing options.
According to the Ctgb it is possible to apply a lower dose than the dose in the WG.
Het is volgens het Ctgb wel mogelijk om een lagere dosering toe te passen, dan de dosering in het WG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over Nederlandse schuld aan Europese automatische verlengingen van landbouwgif

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether the Netherlands bears responsibility for EU automatic extensions of pesticide approvals and for delays at the Dutch pesticide authority Ctgb, including whether the Ctgb is held to account and what action will be taken. The minister answers that extensions are a legally required temporary measure caused by shared delays across EU actors, that the Ctgb is autonomous but accountable to her as owner, and that she will keep pressing for improvements without announcing sanctions.
I have confidence in the Ctgb that in recent years it has already taken various measures and is making every effort to limit delays.
Ik heb vertrouwen in het Ctgb dat de laatste jaren al diverse maatregelen heeft genomen en zich tot het uiterste inspant om vertragingen te beperken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de artikelen 'Milieuwetten Brazilië versoepeld: bescherming kustbossen opgeheven» en «Import sojabonen uit Brazilië 40 procent hoger'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about Brazil loosening environmental laws, including protection of coastal forests, and about a 40 percent rise in Dutch soy imports from Brazil. The government acknowledged the reports, said Brazil's changes are being discussed through bilateral and EU dialogue, and argued the soy rise mainly serves other European markets while committing to EU-level deforestation-free import measures.

The Netherlands conducts, bilaterally and with European partners, an active dialogue with the Brazilian government on the importance of climate and environmental protection and combating deforestation.
Nederland voert, bilateraal en met Europese partners, een actieve dialoog met de Braziliaanse regering over het belang van klimaat- en milieubescherming en de bestrijding van ontbossing.
Antwoord op vragen vanhet lid Bromet over het artikel 'Ten koste van mens en milieu'

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister about a press article alleging that RIVM nitrogen models rest on limited measurements, that herd and manure-rights registers are not cross-checked, and that fraud is lucrative. The minister largely defends existing models and inspection arrangements, acknowledges uncertainties, and points to ongoing reviews and a planned sensor pilot without committing to a specific new check.
The Advisory Committee on Measuring and Calculating Nitrogen chaired by Mr Hordijk made recommendations in its final advice to reduce uncertainties.
Het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof onder voorzitterschap van de heer Hordijk heeft in hun eindadvies aanbevelingen gedaan om te komen tot een vermindering van de onzekerheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat de cijfers over de uitstoot van stikstof door de veestapel niet kloppen

An MP asked the minister whether reports that manure ammonia emissions from livestock barns are underestimated and that farmers may be cheating on animal numbers hold, and what would be done about possible fraud. The minister acknowledged the emission model underestimates some barn types, argued licensed capacity does not prove fraud, and pointed to risk-based enforcement and inter-agency data sharing as ongoing improvements, without committing to new concrete measures.
By increasing the chance of getting caught and confronting offenders with strict (financial) consequences, the incentive to commit fraud decreases.
Door de pakkans te vergroten en met stevige (financiële) consequenties te confronteren neemt de fraudeprikkel af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Onderzoek: Sjoemelende boeren. Ten koste van mens en milieu’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture about a newspaper report alleging that farmers cheat on animal and manure rights, and about discrepancies between RVO herd figures, permits and satellite-measured nitrogen deposition. The Minister answered that the CDM advice confirms low-emission stables do not always deliver expected reductions, that existing enforcement powers are adequate, that the rVDM monitoring system is being pursued, and that no additional action is needed on this specific report.
I see no reason to take additional action following this specific article.
Ik zie naar aanleiding van dit specifieke artikel geen reden om aanvullende actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de gevolgen van de hittegolf voor dieren in de veehouderij

MP Wassenberg asked the minister about heat stress in livestock during the 2020 heatwave, including the number of animals affected, NVWA inspection capacity, shade requirements, and enforcement. Minister Schouten answered that the 110 million figure is only an estimate of animals at risk, that existing rules cover heat stress without a fixed temperature threshold, that twelve written warnings were issued in 2020, and that no additional measures are planned.
I do not have data on this.
Hier heb ik geen gegevens over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de stikstofcrisis en het gebrekkig toezicht op en handhaving van dieraantallen en natuurvergunningen

Deputy MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the nitrogen crisis and weak supervision and enforcement of livestock numbers and nature permits, citing press investigations of farmers emitting more than permitted and fraud risks. Minister Schouten answers that the discrepancies can have many explanations, that the Netherlands' supervision is risk-based and provinces are primarily responsible for nature permits, and that no centralisation of permits or supervision is planned.
A centralised application procedure, central registration of nature permits and central supervision would add no value.
Een centrale aanvraagprocedure, centrale registratie van natuurvergunningen en centraal toezicht heeft geen toegevoegde waarde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en De Groot over het bericht dat een onomkeerbare ontwikkeling van regenwoud naar savanne dreigt voor de Amazone

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the government is aware of a study warning the Amazon is nearing a tipping point toward savannah, whether this warrants intensified forest protection, and what measures can keep deforestation-linked products out of the European market. The minister confirmed the study fits earlier warnings, said Dutch forest efforts were stepped up this year and will continue, pointed to EU-level legislative and non-legislative work on deforestation-free supply chains, and reported that Brazil has agreed to dialogue following the Amsterdam Declarations Partnership letter.

Within the European Union, legislative and non-legislative measures are being developed, partly under the Green Deal, to help reduce the ecological footprint of EU consumption and make supply chains deforestation-free.

Binnen de Europese Unie wordt, mede in het kader van de Green Deal, gewerkt aan wetgevende en niet-wetgevende maatregelen, die helpen bij het verkleinen van de ecologische voetafdruk van de EU-consumptie en het ontbossingsvrij maken van handelsketens.
Antwoord op vragen vande leden Smeulders en Bromet over het bericht ‘Coronaregels overtreden maar Van Rooi Meat krijgt geen straf: gemeenteraad wil opheldering’

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked why the safety region did not sanction Van Rooi Meat for exceeding COVID-19 staffing limits, whether the Labour Inspectorate was involved, and whether slaughterhouses are treated leniently. The minister answered that the company received a warning rather than a sanction because it had not reported the actual number of workers, that the Labour Inspectorate made an unannounced visit and found no irregularities in Helmond, and that a national cooperation platform was set up in September 2020.

The chair of the safety region weighed the matter and decided to give the company a warning and impose no sanction for failing to report in advance the actual number of persons present at the inspection.

De voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio heeft een afweging gemaakt en besloten het bedrijf een waarschuwing te geven en geen sanctie op te leggen voor het feit dat er vooraf geen melding is gemaakt van het daadwerkelijk bij de controle aanwezige aantal personen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Beukering-Huijbrechts over de berichten ‘Slachthuis mocht openblijven ondanks vele coronabesmettingen’ en ‘Dit is waarom slachthuis Vion open mocht blijven ondanks de vele

Two D66 MPs asked why slaughterhouses Vion and Rooi Meat were allowed to stay open despite many COVID-19 infections, including why the safety region did not intervene at Rooi Meat when staffing exceeded the agreed level and why the NVWA did not stop slaughter. The minister answered that the safety region weighed the case, issued a warning rather than a sanction, deemed the situation safe, and that NVWA had no reason to halt operations, while promising to inform parliament on sector talks and noting a new national coordination platform.
The chair of the safety region weighed the situation and decided to give the company a warning and impose no sanction.
De voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio heeft een afweging gemaakt en besloten het bedrijf een waarschuwing te geven en geen sanctie op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de toegezegde brief over stalbranden

Lodders (VVD) asks why no agreements on rodent control by farmers have been made, despite the coalition agreement and the fact that rodents may cause about 25% of barn fires, and asks for a letter before 1 April 2020. Minister Schouten answers that integrated pest management is the starting point, that certification and a farmer course for anticoagulant use will be tightened from 2023, that the government sees no direct proof rodents cause fires, and that a letter on barn fires will follow.
With the parliamentary letter on tackling barn fires, your House will be informed about additional measures to further limit the number of barn fires and animal casualties.
Met de Kamerbrief aanpak stalbranden wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over aanvullende maatregelen om het aantal stalbranden en dierlijke slachtoffers verder te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de aanhoudende schade van neonicotinoïden in het milieu en voor dieren

An MP asked the minister about persistent neonicotinoid contamination of surface water from greenhouses, the enforcement of greenhouse growers, and risks to birds and insects under EU approval procedures. The minister confirmed exceedances at 9 of 54 Delfland sites, described emission routes and enforcement measures, and noted that EU approvals for thiamethoxam and clothianidine have lapsed while imidacloprid's is expected to lapse.
There are various actions to prevent or limit as far as possible discharges of plant protection products into surface water.
Er zijn verschillende acties om de lozingen van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen naar het oppervlaktewater te voorkomen of zoveel mogelijk te beperken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht 'Flinke weerstand akkerbouw tegen Waddenagenda'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about farmers' and arable growers' opposition to the draft Wadden Agenda 2050, including their involvement, consequences for arable farming, and Natura 2000 links. The minister answers that LTO and nature groups were involved, that the agenda sets no land-use changes, and that talks with the agricultural sector and a Waddenbrief before the 5 November debate will follow.
The Ministries of IenW and LNV will enter into talks with the land and arable farming sector about the sector's position in the Agenda.
Het Ministerie van IenW en van LNV gaan in gesprek gaan met de land- en akkerbouwsector over de positie van de sector in de Agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Jaar van de Wilde eend, toch worden ze afgeschoten’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister why around 90,000 wild ducks are shot yearly despite the species declining about 30% since 1990, and whether hunting-list status and the wildlife list system are adequate. The minister answers that the culling is acceptable given reproduction, that Sovon finds no evidence hunting causes the decline, that the species' conservation status is not at stake, and that no revision of the wildlife list is planned.
There is no reason to revise the wildlife list now or to examine another system.
Er is geen aanleiding om de wildlijst nu te herzien of een andere systematiek te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht 'Greenpeace gooit opnieuw keien op zeebodem: 'Levensgevaarlijke actie''

PVV MPs asked whether Greenpeace dumping boulders on the North Sea bed endangers fishers, whether this should be prosecuted as attempted murder or manslaughter, why the Dutch flag can be kept, and whether Greenpeace can be banned. The Minister replied that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, which is examining the matter, that the flag cannot be withdrawn under Dutch law, and that only a court on Public Prosecution Service request can dissolve an organisation.
A judgement on the criminality of this conduct is for the Public Prosecution Service.
Een oordeel over de strafbaarheid van dit handelen is aan het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de  leden Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over berichten rond de actie van Greenpeace om de Doggersbank te beschermen door het storten van stenen

MPs Dijkstra and Weverling asked the ministers about Greenpeace dumping rocks on the Dogger Bank in the North Sea, its legal status, possible sanctions, and effects on fishers and the North Sea Agreement talks. The minister says the action is rejected, the stones were dumped in British waters so Dutch law does not apply, the Dutch prosecutor is considering an investigation, and Greenpeace has pledged to stay in the talks.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that it is considering whether there is reason to conduct a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft laten weten te bekijken of er aanleiding is om strafrechtelijk onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, Belhaj en De Groot over munitiedumps in de Deltawateren en Noordzeekust

Three D66 MPs asked the government about the munitions dump in the Oosterschelde and North Sea sites, including the risks, monitoring, clean-up or capping costs, and whether a dedicated management fund exists. The government answered that research results will be sent to parliament in 2021, that monitoring shows no danger, that no clean-up or capping is planned under current assessments, and that only existing monitoring budgets are available.
The results will then be submitted to your House in 2021.
De resultaten worden dan in 2021 aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het krantenartikel 'Boerenfonds kent een magere oogst; Steunpakket helpt slechts één boer’

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the very low uptake of the Jonge Boerenfonds (Young Farmers Fund), including the investment threshold, whether the fund's rules could be made more attractive, the unspent 11 million euro for training and coaching, and how to prevent budget remaining unused. The Minister answered that the rules contain no formal investment threshold, that uptake is expected to grow once farmers' uncertainty eases, that a training programme of 4 million euro is underway, and that it is too early to judge the scheme's effectiveness, while promising to monitor it and run a promotional campaign.
I therefore consider it a premature conclusion to already adjust the scheme based on its use in 2020.
Ik vind het daarom een voorbarige conclusie om op basis van het gebruik in 2020 al tot aanpassing van de regeling over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het bericht 'EU-hof zet streep door subsidie grondaankoop natuur'

MPs Von Martels and Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a CJEU ruling that ended state-aid subsidies for land purchases by nature organisations and whether the state faces interest claims. The minister answered that the ruling does not judge whether nature organisations may run economic activities, that the state still considers the subsidies compatible state aid, and that any interest claim depends on a new Commission decision.
The European Court's ruling contains no substantive judgment on whether nature organisations are permitted to carry out economic activities on land intended for nature management.
De uitspraak van het Europese Hof bevat geen inhoudelijk oordeel of het natuurorganisaties is toegestaan economische activiteiten te verrichten op gronden die zijn bestemd voor natuurbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Natuurorganisaties moeten mogelijk honderden miljoenen aan subsidie terugbetalen'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a European Court of Justice ruling that state aid to nature organisations (TBOs) for land purchases may have been wrongly approved, and about possible repayment obligations. The minister answered that the ruling does not judge the legality of past subsidies, that no formal Commission investigation has yet been opened, and that concrete consequences and amounts cannot yet be determined.
The judgment of the European Court does not constitute a substantive ruling on the legality of the subsidies granted to TBOs in the past.
Het arrest van het Europese Hof betreft geen materieel oordeel over de legaliteit van de in het verleden verleende subsidies aan TBO's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over loslopende nertsen en covid-19

An MP asked the minister whether loose mink in the Netherlands pose a public health risk and could infect mink farms. The minister answered that loose mink are not a meaningful health risk, that two loose mink tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 near culled farms, and that the role of loose mink is being examined in an ongoing tracing study.
In the tracing study that the research consortium is carrying out for us, all possible routes of infection are being examined.
In het traceringsonderzoek dat het onderzoeksconsortium voor ons uitvoert worden alle mogelijke besmettingsroutes onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over NEMA (National Emission Model for Agriculture) en AERIUS Calculator

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers how they will ease the ecology-economy tension in nitrogen policy, whether the AERIUS Calculator's methods (SRM-2 for roads with a 5 km cut-off versus OPS for other sources) are defensible, and about monitoring, permit numbers and building-phase exemptions. The minister replied that the calculator remains the best available tool, that the government is studying a scientifically based distance or deposition threshold with RIVM, that the meter network will be expanded, and that exact permit and housing figures are not centrally recorded or depend on future emissions.
I consider it important that competent authorities base their permit decisions on the best available method, and that is the AERIUS Calculator.
Ik vind het van belang dat bevoegde gezagen bij hun vergunningverlening uitgaan van de best beschikbare methode en dat is AERIUS Calculator.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht 'Sanering varkenshouderij levert veel minder stikstofwinst op dan gedacht, opnieuw tegenslag voor Minister'

Futselaar (SP) asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that the pig-farm buyout scheme (Srv) yields far less nitrogen reduction than estimated, why it targets odour rather than nitrogen and Natura 2000 areas, and whether Rabobank's financial interest in the scheme created a conflict of interest. Minister Schouten answers that the scheme aims at odour nuisance, that PBL used the scheme's assumptions, that a new calculation will follow once final participation is known, and that the Rabobank had no role in drafting the conditions.
I expect to have more certainty in the course of the fourth quarter of this year about which pig farmers will actually end their production.
Ik verwacht in de loop van het vierde kwartaal van dit jaar meer zekerheid te hebben over welke varkenshouders daadwerkelijk hun productie gaan beëindigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het nieuws dat loslopende nertsen zijn gesignaleerd

An SP MP asked the ministers about reports of escaped mink in Oldebroek and Best, their origin, NVWA enforcement, infection risk, causes of escapes and a study linking mink farms to human infections, and whether ending the mink sector only by March 2021 is responsible. The minister answered that the risk to residents is negligible, that escapes are handled by euthanasia and testing under a protocol without active searching, and that legislation to end the sector is being prepared urgently.
Further inventory of the locations where loose mink have been spotted is therefore not necessary and I will not do it.
Verdere inventarisatie van de locaties waar loslopende nertsen zijn gesignaleerd is daarmee niet nodig en zal ik dus niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het openzetten van extern salderen door verschillende provincies

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about differing provincial approaches to opening external netting of nitrogen rights, concerns about speculative buying-up of farms, the registration system, PAS-melders and a proposed nitrogen-leasing scheme. The minister acknowledged provincial differences, outlined monitoring, a one-year opening with evaluation and prior-notification duties, and said further measures would be considered in the bill or left to provincial policy rules.
If any undesirable effects occur, I will intervene together with the provinces.
Indien eventuele ongewenste effecten zich voordoen, zal ik samen met de provincies ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht ‘Provincie Noord-Brabant: wie een weg wil aanleggen, mag nu de stikstof van een boer kopen’
