Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about provinces allowing external netting of nitrogen rights from livestock farms, concerns about wealthy buyers, the 30% nature share, leasing of nitrogen space, and the SRM2 road-modelling method criticised by the Hordijk advisory committee. The minister answered that the provincial opening follows agreed policy, that monitoring and evaluation control the risks, that AERIUS remains the basis for permits, and that a reaction to the advisory committee is forthcoming.
The cabinet takes the advice of all advisory committees extremely seriously, and therefore also that of the Advisory Committee on Measuring and Calculating Nitrogen.
Het kabinet neemt de adviezen van alle Adviescolleges uiterst serieus, en dus ook die van het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat landbouwgif gevonden wordt in het hart van natuurgebieden

An MP asked the minister whether pesticide residues found deep inside Drenthe nature reserves show widespread drift, whether cumulative effects are assessed in authorisation, and what measures will reduce use. The minister confirms the findings, cites RIVM and Ctgb advice that current levels pose no unacceptable risk to non-target arthropods, acknowledges gaps in cumulative assessment, and commits to an exploration of area-based approaches and to asking the European Commission to address cumulative environmental effects.
I recognise the need to gain better insight into the burden on vulnerable areas from chemical substances in order to assess whether this leads to risks.
Ik onderken de behoefte om meer zicht te krijgen in de belasting van kwetsbare gebieden door chemische stoffen om te kunnen beoordelen of dat leidt tot risico's.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg , Futselaar, Bromet, De Groot, Moorlag en Graus over de onderbouwing voor de Nederlandse inzet voor de bescherming van honingbijen, hommels en wilde bijen in het bijenrichtsnoer

MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality for the scientific basis behind the Dutch position on protecting honeybees, bumblebees and wild bees in the EU bee guidance, including the BEEHAVE model, percentile choice, EFSA test runs and consultation of independent experts. The minister answered that the chosen option keeps colony size within natural variability, that the protection goal is still to be set, that a technical meeting is expected in late October, and that documents will be made public beforehand.
I will inform your House about this in advance of the meeting.
Ik zal uw Kamer voorafgaand aan deze bijeenkomst daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Sloten bij Reusel en Someren vervuild; inspectie bezoekt boeren'

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra asked why reports of suspected manure fraud in Brabant, including high nitrogen and phosphorus in ditches, were not taken seriously, how reports are registered and handled across agencies, and whether farmers should be asked to report anonymously. The minister defends the earlier position that soil samples are not conclusive evidence, describes the reporting channels, case volumes and handling times, and points to the area-based enforcement approach, without committing to an external review or a farmer reporting campaign.
I currently see no reason for an external investigation into how reports of fraud are recorded and processed.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding voor een extern onderzoek naar de wijze van opname en verwerking van signalen van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten: ‘De Lugt: ‘Neonics-dossier bieten moet terug op tafel’ en ‘Ook Duitse bietentelers eisen derogatie neonics’

An MP asks the Agriculture Minister whether the Netherlands should reconsider temporary derogations for neonicotinoid-coated sugar beet seed, citing France's and Germany's moves and level-playing-field concerns. The minister answers that a 2018 derogation request was rejected because safe use could not be shown, that alternative non-neonicotinoid products have been authorised temporarily, and that any new request would be assessed by NVWA and Ctgb.
If such a request were submitted again, I will again have myself advised by the NVWA and the Ctgb.
Wanneer een dergelijk verzoek opnieuw zou worden ingediend, zal ik mij wederom laten adviseren door de NVWA en het Ctgb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de oorzaken van droogte en de gevolgen voor natuur

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about drought causes, including drainage for agriculture, daytime irrigation, and effects on nature and Natura 2000 areas. The minister denied that drought is simply a policy failure, acknowledged agricultural drainage as one cause among several, and committed to an inventory of groundwater abstractions and area-based approaches.
The water boards and Rijkswaterstaat cannot state how many cubic metres that was in that period.
De waterschappen en Rijkswaterstaat kunnen niet aangeven hoeveel kubieke meter dat in die periode geweest is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het bericht 'LTO: inbreng sector niet meegenomen in afspoelingsmaatregelen'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the farm sector was excluded from designing measures to prevent runoff from arable fields, and why the measures are so detailed. The minister replied that LTO was consulted, that the draft decree was adjusted after consultation (including adding options and a 3-metre buffer zone), that the scientific reports will be shared, and that the regulatory burden is estimated at about €249,428.
The input from LTO and other organisations and individual farmers has led to adjustments in the draft decree.
De inbreng van LTO en van andere organisaties en individuele landbouwers, heeft geleid tot aanpassingen in het ontwerpbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur over illegale hondenhandel

An MP asked the minister, after a Nieuwsuur broadcast on illegal dog trade, how the earlier Weverling motion was implemented, the state of the identification and registration system, import numbers, NVWA reports and inspections, and capacity. The minister answered in detail: international cooperation and a dog chain analysis are underway, the improved I&R system is due mid-2021, NVWA handled 849 dog/cat reports in 2019 with 118 inspections, and some reports lacked leads to act on.
It is not possible to state how many dogs imported from abroad were placed in animal shelters.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel honden in dierenasiels geïmporteerd zijn vanuit het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Graus over de malafide puppyhandel vanuit Hongarije naar Nederland

MPs Wassenberg and Graus asked the minister about NVWA enforcement against illegal puppy trade from Hungary, including complaint handling, staffing, the identification and registration system, Hungarian oversight and a Belgian vet's role. The minister answered that enforcement is risk-based with limited staff, that the I&R system is being improved, that cross-border trust rules limit verification, and declined to share data on individual companies.
Data cannot be shared about individual companies.
Er kunnen geen gegevens worden gedeeld over individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de malafide puppyhandel vanuit Hongarije naar Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the ministers about illegal puppy trafficking from Hungary, including prosecution numbers, penalties, border controls, EU registration, and enforcement against criminal networks. The minister responds that enforcement is being strengthened through a task force and a pending houding-ban bill, while stating that penalties are adequate, border checks rely on mutual trust between member states, and the bill is delayed.
The OM's registration systems therefore cannot establish how many cases related to illegal dog trade were processed by the OM in recent years or whether they led to a conviction.

Uit de registratiesystemen van het OM kan derhalve niet achterhaald worden hoeveel zaken gerelateerd aan illegale hondenhandel de afgelopen jaren door het OM zijn verwerkt en of dit tot een veroordeling heeft geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders, Markuszower en Graus over heksenjacht door NVWA

MPs De Roon, Wilders, Markuszower and Graus asked whether the government instructed the NVWA to target the Israel Producten Centrum over labelling of wine from Judea and Samaria, and why Israel is treated differently from other countries. Minister Blok answered that the NVWA acts on complaints under EU origin-labelling rules applied equally to all countries, and that a binding CJEU ruling requires settlement-origin labelling.
No. Following a complaint received, the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) carried out an inspection in April 2019.
Nee. Naar aanleiding van een binnengekomen klacht heeft de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) in april 2019 een inspectie uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Geurts over het bericht 'Boeren weten raad met Stikstof'

MPs Harbers and Geurts asked the minister whether a farmer-led nitrogen plan that could cut ammonia emissions while freeing space for development is realistic, including financing innovation through leasing nitrogen space and integrating it into provincial policy. The minister responded positively, offering to help the initiators by calculating the measures, exploring legal safeguarding, and discussing a pilot with provinces, while noting that the plan still needs elaboration and that demand for leased space is uncertain.
I am willing to help the initiators, for example by having the proposed emission reduction measures calculated or by examining whether these measures can be legally secured.

Ik ben bereid om de initiatiefnemers daarbij te helpen, bijvoorbeeld door de voorgestelde emissiereductiemaatregelen door te laten rekenen of te onderzoeken of deze maatregelen juridisch geborgd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Futselaar over het krantenartikel ‘LTO wil af van onzinnige beregeningsverboden’ van 19 augustus vragen gesteld over de onderzoekersnotitie ‘Efficiëntie van beregening’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why a draft scientific study on irrigation efficiency was shared with the farm lobby group LTO Noord before publication, and whether this compromised scientific independence. The minister answered that the review was commissioned via a drought consultation, that sharing was only to test whether the knowledge was presented clearly, that the findings were not up for discussion, and that the final report is attached.
The findings themselves were not up for discussion during this meeting.
De bevindingen zelf stonden tijdens deze bijeenkomst niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over met corona besmette nertsen

An MP asked the ministers whether new Covid-19 infections at mink farms show that earlier measures failed, whether workers are tested, and whether all mink farms should be preventively culled before the autumn harvest. The minister answered that the risk is not minimised, announced intensified screening and enforcement, and argued preventive culling is not the most effective measure, instead planning an accelerated end to fur farming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over met corona besmette nertsen

An MP asked whether recent COVID-19 infections on mink farms show that measures have had little effect, why a new OMT-Z advice was needed before culling, whether economic interests are overriding public health as in the Q fever case, and why mink are not culled preventively. The minister answered that the measures were insufficient and were tightened, that the OMT-Z advised against preventive culling as the most effective route, and that the fur farming sector will be phased out faster.
For that reason, in my letter of 28 August 2020 I announced a tightening of the current measures and several additional measures.
Om die reden heb ik in mijn brief van 28 augustus 2020 een aanscherping van de huidige maatregelen en enkele aanvullende maatregelen afgekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de nieuwe coronabesmettingen bij twee nertsenfokkerijen

MP Ouwehand asked the ministers why new COVID-19 infections appeared at mink farms, how inspection and culling were conducted, and whether the culling method breached EU animal-killing rules. Minister Schouten answered that human transmission is most likely, described tightened measures and NVWA inspections, and rejected claims of illegality while promising to share the ongoing tracing research and the culling reports.
Once a definitive research report has been drawn up, we will share the results with your House.
Zodra er een definitief onderzoeksverslag is opgesteld, zullen we de resultaten met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de rituele slacht en het Offerfeest

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Agriculture whether NVWA rules made ritual slaughter during the Eid al-Adha (Offerfeest) practically impossible, whether many slaughterhouse applications were rejected, and whether the state would guarantee ritual slaughter could proceed. The minister denied that the rules changed, stated that 48 of 53 applicant slaughterhouses slaughtered during the festival after COVID plan adjustments, and said unstunned slaughter was able to take place within COVID guidelines without committing to new action.
The statutory rules for performing unstunned slaughter and supervising it have not changed compared with previous Offerfeesten.
De wettelijke voorschriften voor het uitvoeren van onbedwelmde slacht en het toezicht hierop zijn niet gewijzigd ten opzichte van vorige Offerfeesten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het artikel “Eindelijk succes voor Almelose luchtwasser van Jan Waayer”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a newspaper report on a biological air scrubber for pig stables that finally succeeded in obtaining RAV listing after years, and about the evaluation, timeline, pending applications and innovation procedures for such techniques. The state secretary answered that innovation is important, that the process took about 4.5 years and was lengthy for reasons withheld as competitive sensitive, that an acceleration taskforce will advise in autumn, and gave counts of pending applications and typical processing times.
Due to the applicant's competitive interests, these reasons cannot be discussed in substance.
Vanwege het concurrentiebelang van de aanvrager kan niet inhoudelijk op deze redenen worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over biomassa uit Estland

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals ask the ministers about clear-cutting and biodiversity loss in Estonian forests supplying wood pellets to Dutch subsidised biomass plants, including Natura 2000 logging, overexploitation, corruption risks and whether subsidies should stop. Minister Wiebes answers that Dutch sustainability criteria under the SDE+ scheme apply, that the government sees no reason for independent research, and that Estonian forest regulation is primarily Estonia's responsibility.
I am not aware of how much biomass is imported annually from Estonia.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel biomassa er jaarlijks geïmporteerd wordt uit Estland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat de NVWA nalatig is bij corona in slachthuizen

MP Moorlag asked the ministers about a report that the NVWA was negligent in responding to internal warnings about COVID-19 risks in slaughterhouses, including whether 1.5m distancing was enforceable, whether an external reporting point is needed for NVWA staff, and how health would be prioritised over economic interests. The minister responded that the NVWA took protective measures such as masks for vets from 11 May, that working conditions in slaughterhouses fall under the Inspectie SZW and the companies themselves, that an external reporting route via Inspectie SZW exists, and that public health was always leading in local decisions.
I do not recognise the picture that the NVWA acted indifferently or negligently.
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat de NVWA onverschillig of nalatig heeft geopereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over nalatigheid bij de NVWA bij het ingrijpen in slachthuizen waar onvoldoende maatregelen werden genomen tegen de verspreiding van het coronavirus

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the ministers why the NVWA failed to act against inadequate COVID-19 measures in slaughterhouses, despite staff warnings, and whether the government misinformed parliament. The minister rejects charges of NVWA or ministerial failure, says the NVWA did act (including suspending work at four slaughterhouses), and promises ongoing coordination and a September letter on the line-speed motion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘NVWA nalatig na signalen over slachthuizen als 'corona-hotspot’’

MP Lodders asked the minister about reports that the NVWA ignored warnings about meat plants as COVID-19 hotspots, including an internal survey showing vets often could not keep 1.5 metres and the use of interns. The minister confirmed signals and a 135-respondent internal survey, declined to share the survey as not opportune, said masks were provided and inspections followed, and rejected claims that NVWA ignored its own rules.
Given the purpose and nature of the internal survey, I do not consider it appropriate to send it to your House.
Gezien het doel en de aard van de interne enquête vind ik het niet opportuun deze aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Opnieuw betwiste ruiming kippen door salmonella'

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that vaccinated breeder chickens were culled early after a positive Salmonella routine test without re-sampling, questioning whether the procedure is sound given negative confirmatory tests. The minister replies that re-testing is now only allowed in exceptional cases of reasonable doubt under EU rules, that the Commission forced this change, and that the Netherlands will review the testing rules and an evaluation by WUR is underway.
Re-testing will now be omitted and will only be applied in exceptional cases where there is reasonable doubt about the correctness of the first test result.
De hertest blijft vanaf nu achterwege en zal nog slechts in uitzonderlijke gevallen worden toegepast wanneer er gerede twijfel is aan de juistheid van de eerste testuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het toezicht op het slachtproces ten tijde van COVID-19 en tijdens het Offerfeest

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about NVWA supervision of unstunned slaughter during the COVID-19 period and the Feast of Sacrifice, including low inspection staffing, illegal slaughter, and meat cooling rules. The Minister answered that supervision is unchanged and risk-based, that about 10% more animals were slaughtered, that the NVWA may grant a derogation allowing covered transport of carcasses, and that the convenant follow-up was delayed by the pandemic.
The criminal investigation is still ongoing. While this investigation is in progress, no statements can be made about it.
Het strafrechtelijke onderzoek is momenteel nog gaande. Lopende dit onderzoek kunnen hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het slachtproces ten tijde van COVID-19 en het Offerfeest

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether the NVWA (food safety and consumer authority) had reached a real agreement with two Harderwijk and Nijkerk slaughterhouses on stunning during the 2020 Eid festival, how inspection and sanctions would apply, and whether unstunned slaughter could respect RIVM distancing rules. The minister answered that after a court case the slaughterhouses submitted revised plans, that stunned slaughter was agreed, that vets would use masks where distancing was impossible, and that normal supervision and enforcement applied.
I have worked to send the answers to your House as quickly as possible.
Ik heb mij ingezet om de antwoorden zo snel mogelijk aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘NVWA nalatig na signalen over slachthuizen als 'corona-hotspot'’ en de uitzending ‘Nieuwsuur, seizoen 2020 Afl. 186

MP De Groot (D66) asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that the NVWA neglected warnings about unsafe conditions for workers in slaughterhouses during the coronavirus crisis, including vets feeling unheard, the adequacy of RIVM-guideline enforcement, management layers, and shift planning. The Minister rejects the characterisation of NVWA negligence, explains the internal survey, mask provision, letters to slaughterhouses and joint inspections with Inspectie SZW, and says an evaluation will come later without a set timeline.
I do not recognise the picture that the NVWA acted indifferently or negligently.
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat de NVWA onverschillig of nalatig heeft geopereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het advies van de Gezondheidsraad betreffende de gezondheidsrisico’s van landbouwgif en de kabinetsreactie hierop

An MP asks the government to confirm that the Health Council advises intensifying existing pesticide sustainability plans, to explain the gap with past targets, and to adopt stricter EU approval criteria and spray-free zones. The minister responds that the Toekomstvisie 2030 implementation programme will intensify efforts with annual monitoring, that targets from Gezonde Groei remain in force, and that spray-free zones lack the required scientific basis.
This is provided for in the implementation programme accompanying the Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030, which I will send to your House in September.
Hierin voorziet het uitvoeringsprogramma bij de «Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030», dat ik uw Kamer in september zal doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het rapport 'Nitrogen deposition and ammonia concentrations in the Dwingelderveld as affected by surrounding dairy farms'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a study claiming ammonia deposition near Dwingelderveld is overestimated by OPS model, and what consequences it has for policy. The minister disagreed that deposition ends at 400 metres, argued OPS is suitable locally and already includes a crop compensation point, and said the report gives no reason to revise the structural nitrogen approach.
The report by Mr Santing gives no reason to revise the policy on this.
Het rapport van dhr. Santing biedt geen aanleiding om het beleid hierop te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'Platteland als wisselgeld'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that Dutch per-hectare CAP payments would fall to fund convergence in other member states, and whether the government would stop external convergence and improve farm incomes. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposed further convergence, that the provisional EU deal halves the gap for low-payment states and is acceptable, and that a farm entrepreneurship agenda will follow.
Once the European Parliament approves the proposal put to it, the exact figures will become known.
Zodra het Europees parlement instemt met het aan hen voorgelegde voorstel, zullen de exacte cijfers bekend worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Weyenberg over het bericht 'Angstcultuur in vleessector: slachterijwerkers zwijgen opgelegd'

D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports of a fear culture in the meat sector, where migrant slaughterhouse workers feel threatened with dismissal if they report sick, and about hygiene, COVID-19 testing, and abusive temp agencies. The government acknowledges the dependency problem, points to existing inspection and reporting channels, and commits to advisory follow-up and a national cooperation platform, but gives mostly general answers and declines to reconsider the sampling-based testing approach.
The cooperation platform will be fully operational from 1 September.
Het samenwerkingsplatform is vanaf 1 september volledig operationeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Bromet en Ellemeet over G4 EA H1N1-virus en het bericht ‘RIVM houdt ontwikkeling van Chinees varkensvirus goed in de gaten’

MPs Klaver, Bromet and Ellemeet asked the ministers why RIVM is not preparing for the G4 EA H1N1 swine flu virus despite its pandemic potential, how vaccines could be produced, and what sources RIVM monitors. The ministers answered that human-to-human transmission has not been observed, vaccine production takes 4-6 months via WHO-coordinated surveillance, and that no link exists with African swine fever.
It is currently not known how Chinese employees and pig farmers were infected. That is a Chinese matter and we have no information about it.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend op welke manier Chinese medewerkers en varkensboeren zijn besmet. Dat is een Chinese aangelegenheid en we hebben daarover geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het verband tussen luchtvervuiling en het infectierisico van COVID-19

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether air pollution raises COVID-19 infection risk and what research and measures would follow, citing World Bank and Harvard studies. The state secretary answered that the studies are only ecological signals without proof of causation, that human-to-human transmission drives spread, and that research on air quality and COVID-19 is being scoped with RIVM before decisions are taken.
RIVM has been asked to carry out an exploration of research options on the relationship between air quality, livestock farming and COVID-19.
Het RIVM gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de onderzoeksmogelijkheden aangaande de relatie luchtkwaliteit, veehouderijen en COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de ziekte van Parkinson en het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen

An MP asks the government about a publication linking certain pesticides to Parkinson's disease, the adequacy of EU approval testing for neurotoxic effects, and monitoring of residues. The minister says the EU procedure will be tightened, commits to asking the Commission to revise data requirements, and points to ongoing Gezondheidsraad and monitoring work.
I have in the meantime asked the European Commission by letter to start a process to revise the data requirements on neurological disorders.
heb de Europese Commissie inmiddels per brief verzocht een traject te starten om de datavereisten op het gebied van neurologische aandoeningen te herzien
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Geurts over het bericht 'Agrifacts en Stikstofclaim blazen gesprek met LNV over voermaatregel af'

MPs Harbers and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the ministry set conditions on the communication after a planned technical briefing with the Agrifacts and Stikstofclaim foundations on feed-measure norms, and why the ministry set those conditions. The minister explained that the ministry proposed a joint-approved report as the only basis for external communication to avoid conflicting interpretations, that the foundations declined and cancelled the meeting, and that a supplementary note on the norms was sent to parliament.

The conversation is not intended to address the accuracy of the input data used from Statistics Netherlands (CBS) and Wageningen Economic Research (WEcR) and their calculations and calculation methods.

Het gesprek is niet bedoeld om de juistheid van de gebruikte invoergegevens van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) en Wageningen Economic Research (WEcR) en de berekeningen en rekenmethodiek daarvan aan de orde te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over de berichten: ‘Flu virus with 'pandemic potential' found in China’ en ‘Zorgen in China over nieuwe griep, die mogelijk kan uitgroeien tot pandemie’

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports of a swine-origin H1N1 influenza virus with pandemic potential found in China and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister answered that existing zoonosis structures and hygiene protocols are adequate, the virus shows no sustained human-to-human transmission so far, and current vaccines do not work well against it, while WHO will assess whether a new vaccine is needed.
I informed your House about the COVID-19 lessons learned process in my letter of 15 June 2020.
Ik heb uw Kamer over het proces t.a.v. COVID-19: «lessons learned» geïnformeerd in mijn brief van 15 juni 2020
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat een slachthuis medewerkers heeft aangezet tot het afleggen van valse gezondheidsverklaringen

An MP asked ministers about reports that a slaughterhouse pressured workers to fill in false health declarations, and whether the company withheld declarations from the GGD and why oversight was not tighter. The government said it had no signals of withholding, that the Inspectie SZW found no irregularities in one site, that additional oversight measures were taken, and that the NVWA could halt slaughter work if worker safety is not assured; criminal investigation is for the Openbaar Ministerie.
If the safety of NVWA and KDS staff is not assured, the NVWA will halt its work in slaughterhouses.
Als de veiligheid van NVWA en KDS medewerkers niet geborgd is, staakt de NVWA de werkzaamheden in slachterijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Hijink over het bericht dat bij een slachthuis in Helmond werknemers, al dan niet in opdracht van de werkgever, ziekteklachten verzwegen

MPs Futselaar and Hijink asked the government about reports that workers at a Helmond slaughterhouse concealed COVID-19 symptoms and falsified forms, and about enforcement, GGD inspections, NVWA oversight and sector culture. The ministers said such conduct is unacceptable, pointed to Inspectie SZW powers and planned extra enforcement powers, and described NVWA and GGD actions and a sector review.
I intend to give the Inspectorate SZW more legal powers to enforce effectively
Ik heb het voornemen om de Inspectie SZW meer wettelijke mogelijkheden te geven om effectief te kunnen handhaven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Harbers over het kort geding met betrekking tot onderbouwing ministeriële voernormen

MPs Geurts and Harbers asked the minister why the methodology behind the feed-norm measure for dairy farms could not be reconstructed in the summary proceedings, and whether the ministry's data and calculations were accessible. The minister replied that the underlying CBS data, a WEcR note and the CDM advice were all published, promised a meeting with the foundations on 12 August and a letter after the PBL assessment.
I intend to publish a report of the meeting on www.rijksoverheid.nl and am of course willing to inform the House of the outcomes.
Ik ben voornemens een verslag van het gesprek op www.rijksoverheid.nl te plaatsen en ben uiteraard bereid om uw Kamer te informeren over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht “LNV legt onderbouwing stikstofmaatregel niet vast”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the justification for a temporary nitrogen measure for dairy farms was allegedly not documented, and whether future policy would be transparent and open to outside scrutiny. The minister replied that the measure rests on CBS data and a Wageningen Economic Research note, that the supporting documents and CDM advice have been made public, and that a meeting with farmer groups was agreed.
By publishing all documents underlying the standards in the regulation, insofar as they were not already public, I provide full openness.
Door openbaarmaking van alle stukken die ten grondslag liggen aan de normen uit de regeling, voor zover die niet al openbaar waren, geef ik volledige openheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de rekenmethode achter de nieuwe eiwitmaatregel

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the calculation method behind the new feed protein limits for dairy cattle was documented and reproducible, and why the basis was not disclosed before a summary-proceedings case. The minister answered that all underlying documents were made public, the method rests on CBS data and a Wageningen notitie validated by the CDM, and that the team-based work does not depend on a single official.
That is why I have made all documents underlying the feed measure public, insofar as they were not already public.
Vandaar dat ik alle stukken die ten grondslag liggen aan de veevoermaatregel openbaar heb gemaakt, voor zover die niet al openbaar waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de rechterlijke uitspraak inzake de voorgenomen veevoermaatregel

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a summary-proceedings case on the feed measure for dairy cattle, which was withdrawn at hearing, and about data availability, verifiability and the KNMvD's veterinary concerns. The Minister answered that the underlying data are public, that a meeting with the foundations is planned to explain the calculations, and that the PBL analysis and KNMvD follow-up will be sent to parliament by month end.
I will inform your House further on this at the end of this month, together with the availability of the PBL calculation.
Ik zal uw Kamer hier eind deze maand nader over informeren gelijktijdig met het beschikbaar komen van de doorrekening van het PBL
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over waterplantenproblematiek op de Randmeren en Zuidelijk IJsselmeergebied

An MP asked the ministers whether Rijkswaterstaat bears responsibility, given past water management measures that promoted aquatic plant growth, for plant overgrowth obstructing recreational boating and swimming on the Randmeren and southern IJsselmeer beyond the fairway, and about the basis for the 10% mowing limit and the cooperation process. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is responsible only for the fairways of national waterways and designated recreational channels, that responsibility elsewhere lies with regional authorities and the recreation sector, and that a working group and pilots are being run.

On that basis, Rijkswaterstaat is responsible for reducing nuisance from aquatic plants only insofar as it concerns the fairway of the national waterways and certain fairways designated for recreational boating.

Op basis daarvan is Rijkswaterstaat verantwoordelijk voor het verminderen van overlast door waterplanten voor zover het de vaargeul van de rijksvaarwegen en bepaalde voor de recreatietoervaart aangewezen vaargeulen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over regelgeving en handhaving van garnalenvisserij in Natura 2000-gebieden

MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the minister how the fishing-hour limits for shrimp trawlers in Natura 2000 areas were set, why the permit figures differ from NVWA figures, and how monitoring and enforcement work. The minister explained that the permits were based on 2015 data, were partly corrected after objections, that WMR now monitors fishing hours while enforcement stays with the ministry, and that a new black-box monitoring system is being certified.
From the end of 2019 this monitoring was taken over by WMR.
Vanaf eind 2019 is deze monitoring overgenomen door WMR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat garnalenvissers veel meer mogen vissen in beschermde natuurgebieden

An MP asks the minister why shrimp fishing hours in Natura 2000 areas were increased without informing parliament, why earlier written questions went unanswered, and whether the VIBEG and VisWad convenants have been effective. The minister denies reducing enforcement, says the convenant evaluation is nearly finished and will be shared, and states that the current shrimp fishing is permissible under the Wet natuurbescherming.
Both decisions on objection can be found via the link provided.
De beide beslissingen op bezwaar zijn vindbaar via: https://puc.overheid.nl/natuurvergunningen/doc/PUC_308280_17/1/
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over regelgeving en handhaving van garnalenvisserij in Natura 2000-gebieden

An MP asked the minister whether shrimp fishers exceeded permitted fishing hours in Natura 2000 areas and why enforcement was lacking, including questions on NVWA staffing, the decision not to close areas, and release of reports. The minister admitted monitoring problems led to halted warnings, moved enforcement to Wageningen Marine Research with a margin, relied on a future black box system, and refused to close areas for lack of ecological necessity.
When the permitted number of fishing hours is exceeded, enforcement action is now taken, starting from 1 January 2020.
Bij een overschrijding van het aantal toegestane visuren wordt nu, dus ingaande vanaf 1 januari 2020, handhavend opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de verruimde vergunning voor garnalenvissers

MP De Groot (D66) asked whether shrimp fishing permits in Natura 2000 areas were expanded, how fishing speed and ecological impact were assessed, and whether a new appropriate assessment is needed. Minister Schouten answers that the permitted hours were recalculated and corrected via decisions on objection, that no new appropriate assessment is required, and that she sees no adverse ecological effects warranting intervention.
No, I refer to my answers to questions 5 and 6.
Nee, ik verwijs hiervoor naar mijn antwoorden op de vragen 5 en 6.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht dat garnalenvissers meer mogen vissen in Natura-2000-gebieden

MP Von Martels (CDA) asked the minister about a report that shrimp fishers could fish more in Natura 2000 areas, including how fishing hours in the permit were calculated, the software errors involved, and how individual fishers can comply with collectively granted hours. Minister Schouten answered that the hours capture the assessed fishing level rather than freezing it, that the errors (speed assumptions, a software bug, counting zero-knot sailing) were corrected in December 2018, and that enforcement would suspend permits for an area if hours are exceeded by 10%, leaving compliance largely to the fishers' representative organisations.
When setting the initial fishing hours for the reference year 2015, a fishing speed that was too low for the southern Natura 2000 areas was used.
Bij het vaststellen van de initiële visuren voor het ijkjaar 2015 is met een, voor de zuidelijke Natura 2000-gebieden, te lage vissnelheid gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de resultaten van het drijfmestonderzoek van Vanhoof en Nigten

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the findings of the Vanhoof and Nigten slurry study, including the role of feed quality, manure quality, soil biology, emission-poor floors, application techniques, and the mandatory row fertilisation from 2021. The minister acknowledged the study, said follow-up research depends on scientific peer review, noted the CDM advice and safety study on emission-poor floors, questioned the study's analysis, and decided to implement row fertilisation differently.
It would be valuable if the study were published in an international scientific journal, because such a publication requires scientific review.
Het zou waardevol zijn als het onderzoek in een internationaal wetenschappelijk tijdschrift wordt gepubliceerd omdat zo'n publicatie een wetenschappelijke review vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het afschieten van jonge zwijntjes

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether juvenile wild boar may be shot from 1 July, including nursing piglets, and why this is compatible with animal protection and the wildlife rescue efforts of a dierenambulance. The minister answers that shooting timing and methods are set in provincial exemptions based on approved management plans, that wild boar breed year-round so no closed season is realistic, and that provinces decide on management and rescue.
The date from which wild boar may be killed is stated in the exemptions issued by the provinces.
De datum vanaf wanneer wilde zwijnen gedood mogen worden, staat in de ontheffingen die door de provincies worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over het bericht 'Politieteam tasert en schopt hond in Duiven, rol agenten onderzocht'

MPs Helder and Graus asked the Justice Minister whether police use of a Taser and kicking against a dog in Duiven was reported, why a stun weapon was used on a tied-up dog, and whether the officers' conduct and the reported force had been reviewed. The minister confirmed a use-of-force report was filed, said an internal investigation was opened after the owner's letter, and declined to give details, forward case files to the lawyer, or state a timeline or suspension status while the investigation runs.
Because the investigation into the use of force is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about the nature of the use of force and the content of the use-of-force report.
Omdat het onderzoek naar de geweldsaanwending nog loopt kan ik geen verdere uitspraken doen over de aard van de geweldsaanwending en de inhoud van de geweldsmelding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het bericht dat het draagvlak voor het keurmerk 'On the way to PlanetProof' afbrokkelt

Two CDA MPs asked the agriculture minister about reports that farmers see little added value in the PlanetProof sustainability label and bear extra costs without a price premium. The minister acknowledged the criticism, gave illustrative cost figures, said a farm ownership agenda and ACM monitoring of prices are underway, but did not commit to new rules.
For that reason, and because of the importance I attach to it, I am working on drafting an agricultural entrepreneurship agenda.
Daarom, én vanwege het belang dat ik eraan hecht, ben ik bezig met het opstellen van een agrarische ondernemerschapsagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Zorgen om luchtvervuiling in Brabant en Limburg: 'Wat als er een tweede golf komt en het aantal doden hier weer hoger ligt?''

MPs Futselaar and Van Gerven asked the ministers whether residents of Brabant and Limburg have grounds for concern about COVID-19 resurgence linked to air pollution from livestock farming, and what steps will be taken on research and reducing pollution. The minister answered that RIVM is still scoping research on the air quality and COVID-19 link, that the Schone Lucht Akkoord and other measures address air pollution, and that mink farms with infections will be culled while a voluntary exit scheme is being considered.
Once these have been mapped out, my colleagues at I&W and VWS and I will decide whether and, if so, which studies we want to commission from RIVM.
Nadat deze in kaart zijn gebracht zullen mijn collega’s van I&W en VWS en ikzelf besluiten of en zo ja, welke onderzoeken we willen uitzetten bij het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de voortgang van diverse onderwerpen op het gebied van dierenwelzijn

The MP asks the minister about animal welfare matters: illegal foxes found at a mink farm, the status of the pet animal list (positive list) and its consultation timeline, the delayed animal abuse bill, and whether mink farms with COVID-19 infections should be closed early and inspected for welfare and fire safety. The minister answers that keeping foxes as pets is not prohibited, that the pet list is expected in summer 2021, that the bill is delayed to autumn, that a stopper scheme is under study with a decision in August, and that NVWA screening focuses on animal health while fire safety is a municipal matter.
The cabinet intends to take a decision on the stopper scheme in August and then inform the House about it.
Het kabinet is voornemens om in augustus aanstaande een besluit te nemen over de stoppersregeling en daarna uw Kamer daarover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat een nertsenfokker al jaren vossen in kleine, kale en smerige draadgazen kooien houdt

An MP asked the minister about reports that a mink farmer kept foxes in small, bare, dirty wire cages, questioning NVWA oversight and enforcement. The minister answered that fox-keeping as a hobby animal is not prohibited if breeding for fur has ceased, that the NVWA inspected the farm in 2017 and in May 2020 without grounds for enforcement, and that the owner handed the foxes to a zoo.
It is no longer possible to determine which companies kept foxes before the 2008 ban, so this question cannot be answered.
Het is niet meer te achterhalen welke bedrijven voor het verbod van 2008 vossen hebben gehouden, waardoor het niet mogelijk is om deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het lot van geitenbokjes

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the fate of around 100,000 goat kids born in dairy goat farming, the closure of bokkenmesterijen, herd growth despite a goat stop, and high kid mortality. The minister answers that licensing is a municipal competence, that provinces have taken precautionary measures, and that I&R registration will be tightened from December 2020 with a further letter on animal welfare promised before summer.
Licensing and the control thereof is a competence of municipalities.
Vergunningverlening en de controle daarop is een bevoegdheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en De Groot over stikstofuitstoot

D66 MPs asked why provinces permitted two power plants to switch to biomass with higher nitrogen emissions by using intern salderen on old permits, and whether this conflicts with the government's nitrogen reduction goals. Minister Schouten defends the permits as lawful and within existing rules, says the new permits set lower maximum emissions, and declines to reopen or tighten permits or launch wider investigations.
I see no possibility to apply stricter policy or to further restrict permits that have become final in law.
Bovendien zie ik geen mogelijkheid om een strenger beleid te hanteren of in rechte vaststaande vergunningen verder in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de toename van de stikstofuitstoot door de biomassacentrales in Diemen en Geertruidenberg

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether biomass plants in Diemen and Geertruidenberg, licensed on maximum historic emissions and without netting out unused headroom, would raise nitrogen emissions, and questioned the NOx standards. The minister answers that the provinces are competent authority, that permits were granted via internal netting within the rules, that actual emissions may rise under full operation, and that stricter emission standards are planned for 2022.
It should be noted first that the provinces are the competent authority for these permits. I therefore cannot intervene in their assessment of the permit.
Vooropgesteld moet worden dat de provincies bevoegd gezag zijn voor deze vergunningen. Ik kan dan ook niet treden in hun beoordeling van de vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over Het bericht ‘Experts: ‘Megaslachterij Vion zou gesloten moeten worden’

An MP asked the government why the Vion slaughterhouse in Boxtel stayed open despite high COVID-19 infection among workers, and about worker protection, testing and enforcement. The minister answered that closures are decided case by case by the safety region chair on GGD advice, that the causes of infection are not yet scientifically proven, and that enforcement and inspection measures are in place, without committing to closing slaughterhouses or a breeding ban.
It is up to the chair of the safety region, within infectious disease control, to take the most appropriate control measures case by case.
Het is aan de voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio in het kader van infectieziektenbestrijding om per geval de meest geëigende (beheers)maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Dierenasiels verzwijgen verleden van gevaarlijke vechthonden'

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether dog shelters conceal the past bite incidents of fighting dogs they rehome, how many such incidents occurred, and whether shelters should disclose a dog's history. The minister says rehoming of bite-history dogs via RVO is excluded, aggregate data is unavailable, shelters bear responsibility for disclosure, and a multidisciplinary study and a bill are pending.
It is not known how many dogs involved in a bite incident had previously been in an animal shelter.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel honden die betrokken zijn geweest bij een bijtincident daarvoor in een dierenasiel zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over vechthonden uit dierenasielen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether dangerous fighting and high-risk dogs are being rehomed from shelters, whether owners and new keepers are informed of bite history, and whether stricter breeding, trade and keeping rules are needed. The minister answered that dogs are not known to be trained fighters or high-risk on arrival, that bite history is usually unknown, and pointed to a welfare-based breeding rule, a risk-assessment test under development, and a planned standalone keeping ban.
I have no insight into how many dogs in a shelter have been assessed by an expert as posing a high risk of dangerous behaviour and serious injury.
Ik heb geen inzicht bij hoeveel honden in een asiel aan de hand van een deskundige beoordeling een hoog risico op gevaarlijk gedrag en ernstig letsel is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Bromet, Futselaar, Moorlag en Madlener over de Nederlandse inzet voor het bijenrichtsnoer

MPs asked the minister whether the Netherlands would back a proposed bee guidance option based on natural colony variability, which the Ctgb and minister favour over the 2013 fixed 7% mortality threshold, and asked for postponement of the July 2020 SCoPAFF discussion. The minister answered that the discussion is non-binding, that she follows the Ctgb advice on the scientific basis for protection goals, and that she has pushed for rapid implementation of the bee guidance while refusing to postpone the meeting.
I consider it important that the way in which the protection goal is set is scientifically justified.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de wijze waarop het beschermdoel wordt vastgesteld wetenschappelijk verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over de aangeboden petitie/brandbrief draf- en rensport

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked the ministers whether there is sound justification to keep banning trotting and racing selection trials, given a tested protocol, outdoor activities, no spectators and permission elsewhere in Europe, and whether the ban can be lifted soon. Minister Schouten answered that the planned easing of measures from 1 July removes any medical reasons to ban races, including selection trials, and that she sees no need for further action now.
With the announced easing of measures from 1 July, there are no longer any medical-substantive reasons to prohibit races.
Met de aangekondigde versoepeling van maatregelen per 1 juli zijn er geen medisch-inhoudelijke redenen meer om wedstrijden te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het verbeteren van de Nederlandse wolvenaanpak

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how the Dutch wolf policy can be improved, including timing of intervention, preventive culling, damage liability and whether the wolf presence threatens Natura 2000 targets. The Minister answers that provinces have set intervention criteria, that wolves are protected and that the government will keep working with provinces, but declines to commit to a new policy and says no action is needed now on several points.
The public support study confirmed that a majority of the Dutch agree with this.
Het draagvlakonderzoek heeft bevestigd dat een meerderheid van de Nederlanders het hier mee eens is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over agrobosbouw

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about agroforestry (agrobosbouw): its potential for climate, biodiversity and soil goals, support instruments, the Wet natuurbescherming, verdienmodellen, agricultural education and the 25,000 ha target in the Klimaatakkoord. The Minister answered that agroforestry is a promising form of farming still in its infancy, that advice is being studied, and that she will work on a subsidy scheme, GLB pilots and the Bossenstrategie, while many questions were answered only with planned analyses.
I am willing to discuss this with the provinces in the context of the forest strategy.
Ik ben bereid hier over in gesprek te gaan met provincies in het kader van de bossenstrategie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over corona onder het personeel van het vleesbedrijf Vion in Boxtel

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether measures at Vion's Boxtel meat plant are effective after new COVID-19 cases among staff, whether labour and food inspectorates oversee the plant and temporary agency workers, and why the plant stayed open when Vion's Apeldoorn site was closed. The government answered that the new cases were found at health checks at the gate, that the Inspectorate SZW enforces the Working Conditions Act and has started inspections of slaughterhouses, and that the NVWA and safety region monitor the measures, while noting the causes of infections are still under study.
The Inspectorate SZW will deploy additional inspections at slaughterhouses in the coming period.
De Inspectie SZW zal de komende tijd extra inzetten op inspecties bij slachthuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over de berichten 'Coronabesmettingen bij VION in Boxtel nog altijd aan de orde van de dag'

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked whether the ongoing COVID-19 infections at the Vion slaughterhouse in Boxtel, and the company's claim that its workplace is safe, warrant closure in light of a parliamentary motion. The Staatssecretaris replied that closure decisions lie with the regional safety board chair on GGD advice, that the plant resumed production on 2 June with extensive measures, and that a national coordination platform is being set up, while stating no signals currently show the measures are ineffective.
The chairs of the safety regions are, under the Public Health Act, the Safety Regions Act and emergency ordinances, the competent authority to take measures at regional level.

De voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio's zijn op basis van de Wet publieke gezondheid, de Wet op de Veiligheidsregio's en Noodverordeningen het bevoegd gezag in deze om op regionaal niveau maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over het bericht ‘Zes locaties in beeld voor stookfabriek in Vierpolders’

Two PVV MPs asked the government about a reported plan for a biomass wood-burning plant in Vierpolders, claiming biomass emits more CO2 than coal and gas, questioning whether it is sustainable, and asking whether subsidies will be stopped. The minister rejected the claims, said biomass is a necessary transition alternative, confirmed no new subsidy for solid wood-fired electricity and no subsidy for heat plants under 5 MWth in the autumn 2020 SDE++ round, and promised a sustainability framework and a phase-out strategy.
No new subsidy will be made available for the use of solid woody biomass for the production of electricity only.
Er wordt geen nieuwe subsidie beschikbaar gesteld voor het gebruik van vaste houtige biomassa voor de productie van uitsluitend elektriciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de Koning ten onrechte subsidie ontvangt voor Kroondomein het Loo

An MP asked whether the Crown estate Het Loo unlawfully received a subsidy, whether the 358-day public access rule and oversight by its Raad van Beheer are adequate, and for correspondence on the estate. The minister answered that the subsidy was granted under the Kaderwet EZ-subsidies with partial analogous application of the Gelderland regulation, that no exemption was granted, that the Crown's correspondence is withheld under constitutional privacy and Crown autonomy, and that the Raad van Beheer answers to the Crown.

Correspondence between the government and the Crown estate falls, under Article 41 of the Constitution, within the Crown's freedom to arrange its household and the protection of the King's private life.
Correspondentie tussen de regering en het Kroondomein valt, gelet op artikel 41 van de Grondwet, onder de inrichtingsvrijheid en bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de Koning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de bestrijding van de eikenprocessierups, waardoor ook andere insecten gedood worden

An MP asked the minister whether biological caterpillar control agents for the oak processionary moth also kill other caterpillars and harm protected species and biodiversity, and whether natural alternatives are being pursued. The minister confirmed that these agents also affect other soft-bodied insects, explained the enforcement division among NVWA, ILT and provinces, and said the ministry participates in the Kennisplatform Processierups while natural restoration takes years.
In doing so, other insects with a soft body, such as other caterpillars, can also be affected.
Hierbij kunnen ook andere insecten met een soft body , zoals andere rupsen, worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de Koning ten onrechte subsidie ontvangt voor Kroondomein het Loo

An MP asked whether the King wrongly receives subsidy for the Het Loo Kroondomein, including an exemption from public access of 7,200 hectares and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister answered that the subsidy was lawfully and carefully granted under nature-management rules, with partial closure allowed for privacy, and declined to reclaim it or change the arrangement.
Correspondence between members of the Royal House and ministers about the subsidy and opening of the Kroondomein is not known to me.
Correspondentie tussen leden van het Koninklijk Huis en ministers over de subsidie en openstelling van het Kroondomein is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Pimpelmezen gaan massaal dood, net nu ze ons van de jeukrups moeten verlossen'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports of mass deaths of great tits and blue tits linked to the spraying agent Xentari used against oak processionary caterpillars, and whether the government would investigate, halt use, or take steps on the bird deaths and a related bacterium. The minister answered that Xentari was approved as safe for birds, that the reported 33% mortality was not supported by data, that no mass mortality or link to pest control was found, and that no measures were needed.
For the time being there is no mass mortality of great tits and blue tits in the Netherlands.
Vooralsnog is er geen sprake van massale sterfte van kool- en pimpelmezen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over vleermuizen en vogels die slachtoffer worden van lijmbanden

An MP asks the minister about birds and bats being killed by glue traps used against the oak processionary caterpillar, and whether such use is lawful. The minister confirms glue traps are banned outside under the Nature Conservation Act without provincial exemption, that no exemptions have been granted, and that enforcement lies with provinces and environmental services, which act where needed.
Compliance with the ban on glue traps and similar outdoors is monitored by the provinces, and where necessary by the environmental services acting on their behalf.
Op het verbod tot gebruik van lijmbanden e.d. buitenhuis wordt toegezien door de provincies, en in voorkomende gevallen de Omgevingsdiensten voor hen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over maatregelen tegen de eikenprocessierups

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about preventive measures against the oak processionary caterpillar, the lessons from 2019 and whether a national prevention plan will be made with local governments. The minister answered that a Knowledge Platform was set up, the guideline and waste protocol were updated, and that a national prevention plan is not opportune because control is tailored locally by municipalities and land owners.
Preventive and control measures actually taken in the field fall under the responsibility of the relevant municipalities and land owners.
Preventie- en bestrijdingsmaatregelen die concreet in het veld worden getroffen vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van desbetreffende gemeenten en terreineigenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht 'Ctgb trekt proefontheffing Vertimec in'

An MP asked why the Ctgb withdrew a trial permit for Vertimec against oak processionary caterpillar after initially granting it, and whether environmental and ecosystem effects will be assessed more broadly in all pesticide authorisations. The minister explained the Ctgb applied a narrower test to trial permits, then widened its environmental assessment and found unacceptable risks to other insects and birds, and stated that environmental and health effects are already assessed broadly in every authorisation without committing to a new instruction.

After an internal evaluation, the Ctgb decided that for outdoor application of this agent in an oak tree, it would also weigh knowledge of the environmental aspects of Vertimec as a plant protection product.
Na een interne evaluatie heeft het Ctgb besloten voor het buiten toedienen van dit middel in een eik, ook de kennis van milieuaspecten van Vertimec als gewasbeschermingsmiddel mee te wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en de Groot over het bericht ‘Koning krijgt ten onrechte subsidie voor het Loo’

MPs Sneller and De Groot asked whether the Minister knew of reports that the King receives subsidy for Het Loo despite exemptions from subsidy conditions, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, and whether the subsidy decision would be shared and the legal procedure monitored. The Minister confirmed knowledge, said the Chamber had been informed through budget debates and a letter, shared the subsidy decision as an attachment, defended the subsidy as lawfully granted, and committed to report on the court outcome and to inform the Chamber before any new subsidy is granted.
Yes. I have included the subsidy decision as an annex to this letter.
Ja. Ik heb de subsidiebeschikking als bijlage bij deze brief opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over injecties met giftige bestrijdingsmiddelen in eikenbomen

An MP asked the minister about a trial injecting oak trees with the insecticide Vertimec to control the oak processionary caterpillar, which could harm bees, butterflies and other insects, and whether the trial was lawful. The minister replied that the Ctgb withdrew the trial exemption, judging risks to other insects and foraging birds too great, and that the trial had been notified under the regular biocide procedure without suspensive effect.
The Ctgb ruled that the risks of this trial for other insects and for foraging birds, for example, are too great.
Het Ctgb heeft geoordeeld dat de risico's van deze proef voor andere insecten en voor bijvoorbeeld foeragerende vogels te groot zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht 'Warme zomer op komst, met veel droogte'

The SP MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Agriculture about heat stress during livestock transport, the status of sector protocols, a ban on transport above 35 degrees, cooling and waiting times at slaughterhouses, and the effects of the corona crisis on NVWA inspections. The Minister answered that the national plan and sector protocols were updated and published on 17 June, that a transport ban above 35 degrees takes effect 2 July, and that the NVWA will refuse certification for long transports forecast to exceed 30 degrees, while several questions were answered only partially or deferred to later advice.
I do not have data on this.
Over deze gegevens heb ik geen beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over drugssmokkel op zee

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked the Justice, Agriculture and Transport ministers about drug smuggling by fishing vessels, including subsidies, detection odds, licence withdrawal and Bibob screening. The government acknowledged the financial pressure link, said subsidies should exclude convicted fishers while EU rules limit this, and promised investigations into licence withdrawal and Bibob use while noting limited data on detection.
The Minister of LNV will investigate what options exist to exclude fishers who have committed criminal offences from these funds.
De Minister van LNV zal onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om vissers die strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd uit te sluiten van deze middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het beschermen van dieren bij de verwachte hittegolven

Ouwehand (PvdD) asks why the government has not protected animals from heat stress and transport deaths in the expected heatwaves, and why promised evaluations, protocols, a transport ban bill and NVWA capacity have not been shown to Parliament. Minister Schouten answers that a 35-degree transport ban is set by policy rule effective 2 July, that sector protocols were updated, that NVWA capacity is limited and not fixed in advance, and that she cannot impose herd-size limits, and she sends a letter with details.
The ban is not established through a bill but through a policy rule.
Het verbod wordt niet via een wetsvoorstel vastgelegd maar door middel van een beleidsregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en De Groot over contaminanten in rode aal

MPs Futselaar and De Groot asked the minister about dioxin and PCB exceedances in eel from Dutch inland waters, including eel caught near Urk, and whether such eel should be kept off the market. The minister answered that monitoring follows a 2017 closure policy, that Urk exceeded one EU maximum limit and a policy limit, that the area will be closed if exceedances recur this year, and that a general ban on IJsselmeer eel is not yet warranted.
If the results at Urk again show an exceedance of one of the limits this year, that area will be closed.
Indien de resultaten bij Urk dit jaar opnieuw een overschrijding van één van de limieten laten zien dan zal dat gebied worden gesloten.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bromet over het rapport ‘Uitgesproken’

MP Bromet asked the ministers about the 'Uitgesproken' report on pesticide use near residents in Westerveld, including the lack of citizen participation in the local convenant, the planned LNV pilot and the timing of the Health Council advice. Minister Schouten answered that local parties should find their own balance, that the pilot is being prepared under provincial leadership, and that the Health Council advice was published on 29 June 2020 with a reply sent separately.
My preference is that residents and growers enter into dialogue with each other to reach satisfactory agreements at the local level.
Het heeft mijn voorkeur dat omwonenden en telers met elkaar in gesprek komen om op lokaal niveau bevredigende afspraken te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de voedselveiligheid in de palingketen

An MP asks the minister about dioxin and PCB exceedances in eels caught near Urk in the IJsselmeer, including whether the catch should be banned, whether affected eels can be traced, and whether the area will be resampled. The minister answers that the area will be closed to fishing if exceedances recur this year, that eel quality elsewhere in the IJsselmeer meets limits except the Ketelmeer zone already closed, and that monitoring results are published.
If the results at Urk again show an exceedance of one of the limits this year, that area will be closed.
Indien de resultaten bij Urk dit jaar opnieuw een overschrijding van één van de limieten laten zien dan zal dat gebied worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Pasgeboren kuikens niet meer vergast of in de shredder in Frankrijk’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about France's planned ban on killing newborn male chicks, the gender-screening-in-ovo project, the 40 million chicks killed yearly in the Netherlands, and whether the Netherlands should ban chick killing. The Minister welcomed the French-German initiative, described the sector's voluntary commitments and the in-ovo project, but said she is not currently planning a ban and will keep monitoring developments.
At the current state of affairs, I do not intend to introduce a ban on killing day-old male chicks.
Ik ben bij de huidige stand van zaken niet voornemens een verbod op het doden van eendagshaantjes in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Geurts, Baudet en Moorlag over de tariefverhogingen van Rendac

MPs Bisschop, Geurts, Baudet and Moorlag asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about Rendac's 2020 carcass-collection tariff increases, the lack of transparency in tariff calculations, and the status of the destruction-market review. The minister defended the tariffs as cost-based, said the ADR and the external auditor check compliance, and withheld Rendac's confidential figures from the Chamber while promising renegotiated agreements with Rendac.
The confidential business information obtained cannot be shared with third parties.
De verkregen bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik niet delen met derden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de toelating van het landbouwgif sulfoxaflor

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the authorisation of the insecticide sulfoxaflor, its similarity to neonicotinoids, its bee risks and the EFSA 2020 reassessment, and whether it should be banned from open crops immediately. The minister confirms current Dutch authorisations and EFSA's identified risks to bees and bumblebees, but states that the Ctgb-imposed mitigation measures cover these risks and that she awaits the European Commission's proposal before acting further.
I am awaiting the Commission's proposal and the Ctgb's advice on it.
Ik wacht het voorstel van de Commissie af en het advies daarop van het Ctgb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Özütok over het bericht van EenVandaag ‘Verbod streekmarkten drijft boeren tot wanhoop: Onbegrijpelijk, omdat weekmarkten wél open mogen'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why regional farmers' markets were banned under COVID-19 emergency rules while weekly markets stayed open, and whether municipalities could re-permit them. The minister explained that markets are excluded from the event ban only when they are ordinary markets, that whether a regional market counts as an event is decided case by case by the safety region chair, and that organising markets remains a municipal matter, while stating sympathy for short supply chains.
Whether a regional market falls within this definition depends on the concrete circumstances and organisation of that market and is for the chair of the safety region to assess.
Of een streekmarkt binnen deze definitie valt, zal afhankelijk zijn van de concrete omstandigheden en inrichting van die markt en is ter beoordeling van de voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'Internationale wetenschappers: pulsvisverbod onnodig'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether, given an ICES advice said to undermine the pulse-fishing ban, she would bring it to a halt and restore Dutch pulse-fishing permits, at least in the Dutch EEZ. The minister said the advice confirms pulse fishing is a sound alternative, will be raised in the EU Council and the pending court case, but that the ban is set in EU law and she cannot issue permits.
The ICES advice confirms that the pulse trawl is a responsible alternative to the traditional beam trawl and has less impact on ecology and the environment.
Het ICES-advies bevestigt dat de pulskor een verantwoord alternatief is voor de traditionele boomkor en daarbij minder impact heeft op de ecologie en het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de juridische mogelijkheden om besmette nertsenbedrijven te ruimen

Futselaar (SP) asked whether legal obstacles exist to culling mink farms with COVID-19 infections, which legal instruments apply, and whether the mink sector should contribute to the Animal Health Fund. Minister Schouten answered that the minister has culling powers under the Gwwd, SARS-CoV-2 was designated for mink, responsibilities are shared with VWS within the zoonosis structure, and the mink sector's contribution to the fund is being examined.
As already promised to your House, I am examining whether a contribution from the mink sector to the animal health fund is among the possibilities.
Zoals reeds toegezegd aan uw Kamer onderzoek ik of een bijdrage van de nertsensector aan het diergezondheidsfonds tot de mogelijkheden behoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Paternotte en Kröger over het rapport Evaluatie stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport (advies 3456) van de Commissie voor de m.e.r. d.d. 31 maart 2020

Three MPs asked the ministers whether AERIUS applies SRM2 to road traffic deposition and OPS to other sectors, and why SRM2 is cut off at 5 km, given the Commission's evaluation and TNO's 2015 audit. The minister confirmed the SRM2/OPS split and defended the 5 km cut-off as consistent with the NSL tool and past Raad van State acceptance, while promising a broader cabinet response after the summer.

The cabinet will come after the summer with a more extensive substantive cabinet response to both the final advice of the Nitrogen Problem Advisory Committee and the final report of the Nitrogen Measurement and Calculation Advisory Committee.

Het kabinet komt na de zomer met een uitgebreidere inhoudelijke kabinetsreactie op zowel het eindadvies van het Adviescollege Stikstofproblematiek als het eindrapport van het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de berichten 'Vleessector vindt kritiek op hygiëne in coronatijden niet terecht' en 'Schouder aan schouder aan de lopende band: slachterijen willen coronatests'

An MP from D66 asked ministers how food safety in meat processing is guaranteed during the coronavirus crisis, how infections among slaughterhouse workers are being prevented, and whether testing of workers should be done. The government answered that the NVWA keeps official meat inspection running as usual, that Inspectie SZW has issued guidance and accepts complaints, and that testing will be risk-based and phased in outbreak locations.
If the NVWA finds that slaughterhouses do not comply with all RIVM guidelines, no inspections take place.
Indien de NVWA constateert dat slachthuizen zich niet houden aan alle RIVM-richtlijnen vinden er geen keuringen plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het onderzoeksrapport van Investico over stalbranden

The MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about an Investico report on barn fires, their rising trend and animal deaths, and whether current fire-safety measures and larger barns are adequate. The Minister answers that the existing action plan is risk-based, notes a fall in fires and casualties since 2017, says no statistically significant link between barn size and fire risk has been found, and promises further measures in a forthcoming letter.

To further limit the number of barn fires and animal casualties, I have asked the partners of the Action Plan to examine which additional measures are possible and which existing measures can be accelerated.

Om het aantal stalbranden en dierlijke slachtoffers verder te beperken heb ik de partners van het Actieplan gevraagd om na te gaan welke aanvullende maatregelen mogelijk zijn en welke bestaande maatregelen versneld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Toename stalbranden: sinds 2012 één miljoen dieren in vlammen op, Megastallen verhogen brandrisico door soepele bouwregels‘

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that barn fires have killed about one million animals since 2012 and whether mega-stables raise fire risk under lenient building rules. The minister said a periodic electrical inspection regime and a 60-minute fire-resistant technical room requirement apply, that fire safety is legally required, and that larger compartments are allowed only with equivalent safety measures.
Soon I will send your House a letter with the additional measures in the approach to barn fires.
Binnenkort stuur ik uw Kamer een brief met de aanvullende maatregelen in de aanpak van stalbranden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zonnepanelen op water

MP Dik-Faber asks how many locations are considering floating solar on water, what is known about ecological effects, whether natural areas like the IJsselmeer should be considered, and how the solar ladder (preferring roofs and facades) applies. The minister says roughly a dozen floating projects have been permitted, ecological research is ongoing, natural areas are not excluded in principle, and the solar ladder will be monitored within the RES process.
The competent authority also takes the ecological impact into account in the permit assessment.
Het bevoegd gezag neemt bij de vergunningverlening ook de ecologische impact mee in de afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over rechterlijke uitspraken over de PAS

An MP asked the ministers about court rulings on the PAS nitrogen programme after 29 May 2019, including how many concern farm housing, grazing, manure and enforcement, and why some rulings were not published. The minister answered that the courts themselves decide on publication under the Rechtspraak criteria, that no integrated system counts PAS rulings, that the Council of State published all its PAS rulings, and that the Noord-Nederland court has now published some rulings after media attention.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de toezegging om het Natura 2000-gebied 'Broekvelden, Vettenbroek & Polder Stein' ook onder de Habitatrichtlijn te beschermen

An MP asked why the designation decision bringing the Broekvelden, Vettenbroek & Polder Stein Natura 2000 area under the Habitats Directive is taking so long, and how nitrogen-sensitive habitats there will be protected.
