The minister explains the designation is linked to a Commission infringement procedure that was suspended on Dutch assurances, that the process is being reviewed alongside wider studies on land Natura 2000 areas, and that no nitrogen measures change is needed because the area is not overloaded.
Designation as a Habitats Directive area will therefore be considered in light of the outcomes of the announced studies expected this summer.
Het aanwijzen als Habitatrichtlijngebied zal dus bezien worden in het licht van de deze zomer verwachte uitkomsten van de aangekondigde onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de steeds verdere achteruitgang van de grutto

An MP asks the agriculture minister about the continuing decline of the black-tailed godwit, whether current meadow-bird management works, and whether subsidies for agri-environment management are effective and enforceable. The minister acknowledges the decline and its complex causes, defends current measures and an ongoing WUR evaluation due end of year, and explains provincial responsibility and intervention options.
I expect to be able to send the outcomes of this evaluation to the House at the end of this year.
Ik verwacht de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie eind dit jaar aan de Kamer te kunnen toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht 'Het is onduidelijk en onzeker welke natuurgebieden baat hebben bij de stikstofaanpak'

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister why RIVM used average critical deposition values per 64-hectare hexagon, which may mask nitrogen-sensitive habitat types, and whether a habitat-type-based method and recalculation will be provided. The minister defends the averaged approach as a global overview, says precise habitat-level figures will follow with the measures, and promises answers before the next debate.
The number of hectares of nitrogen-sensitive nature that falls below the KDW can only be determined with more precision once the source measures are further elaborated and the effects occur.
Het aantal hectares met stikstofgevoelige natuur dat onder de KDW komt, kan pas met meer precisie vastgesteld worden wanneer de bronmaatregelen verder uitgewerkt zijn en de effecten optreden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Weyenberg over de berichten: 'Coronaslachters Groenlo mogelijk aan het werk in plaats van in quarantaine' en 'Varkensstallen dreigen vol te raken door sluiting slachthuizen

Two D66 MPs asked the government about reports of Groenlo slaughterhouse workers possibly working while in quarantine, overcrowded pig stables due to slaughterhouse closures, and related labour, enforcement and animal welfare concerns. The government answered that the regional safety authorities and the NVWA/Inspectie SZW are responsible for enforcement, that a breeding ban is disproportionate, that borders cannot be closed to EU live animals, and that sectors will develop short-term scenarios.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht “Wederom kleuren Nederlandse akkers oranje-geel door gebruik van het omstreden middel glyfosaat”

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a report on glyphosate use on Dutch fields, whether EU directives allow a ban on glyphosate outside integrated pest management, and why Luxembourg could ban it. The Minister replied that a ban is not justified on current scientific grounds and would conflict with EU approval rules, but that a 'no, unless' policy will apply to specific uses agreed with the sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de ondersteuning van mkb-bedrijven tijdens de Corona-crisis

Member Stoffer (SGP) asked the government about support for SMEs during the COVID-19 crisis, covering BMKB loan guarantees, TOGS and NOW subsidy eligibility, payment terms, and tax payment relief. The minister answered most questions with concrete measures such as lower BMKB provisions, extended loan terms, expanded TOGS sector lists, and an extension of the tax payment deferral to 1 October 2020, while declining to make blanket changes such as broad rate alignment or suspending labour law obligations.
The cabinet has decided to extend the term of the BMKB-C to 4 years.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om de looptijd van de BMKB-C te verlengen tot 4 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Futselaar over arbeidsmigranten in een vleesfabriek in Groenlo die moesten doorwerken ondanks een corona-uitbraak

MPs Van Dijk and Futselaar (SP) asked whether meat-plant workers, mostly migrant workers, were forced to keep working during a COVID-19 outbreak at Vion Groenlo and why the plant closed late. The minister answered that the plant closed after a GGD sample showed over 20% infection, that closures are the responsibility of safety-region chairs, and that the labour inspectorate is inspecting slaughterhouses and enforcing workplace safety duties.
The labour inspectorate started on 8 June 2020 a project on slaughterhouse inspections for corona and will inspect a number of preselected slaughterhouses in the coming weeks.
De Inspectie SZW is op 8 juni 2020 gestart met het project «inspecties slachterijen – corona« en zal de komende weken een aantal voorgeselecteerde slachthuizen inspecteren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het sluiten van landgoederen met een openstellingssubsidie

An MP asked the Minister whether the growing closure of estates with an opening subsidy to the public, citing corona, is being enforced, how often estates are checked, whether subsidies are clawed back, and whether a public register and complaint route exist. The Minister replied that no closures due to corona measures were reported, that the Tax Authority checks about 100 estates specifically on openness each year, that revocation of status is rare and not separately recorded, and that complaints go via RVO.nl, with a half-yearly public list of open estates.
No reports have been received by RvO.nl that estates have actually been closed due to corona measures.
Er zijn geen meldingen ontvangen bij RvO.nl dat er daadwerkelijk landgoederen zijn gesloten vanwege coronamaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een nieuw onderzoek naar de risico’s op botsingen met vogels als gevolg van de opening van Lelystad Airport

An MP asks the government whether a new bird-radar study showing higher-altitude and night-time bird movements undermines the bird-strike risk assessment in the updated environmental impact report for Lelystad Airport, and whether the report should be re-tested or redone. The minister answers that the new method does not change the conclusions, that the same radar data was used, that the risk assessment remains valid, and that no guarantee against bird strikes can be given, but declines to commit to a new or independent review.
No. The relevant scientific article by Kranstauber and others does not concern Lelystad Airport.
Nee. Het betreffende wetenschappelijke artikel van Kranstauber en anderen gaat niet over Lelystad Airport.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Schonis en De Groot over het bericht 'Vergeten diesels blijken ernstige vervuilers'

MPs Schonis and De Groot asked whether a news report that diesel machines on construction sites emit far more nitrogen oxides than assumed is correct, and whether models like AERIUS underestimate deposition. The government confirms measured emissions of four machine types exceeded type-approval norms by 25% to 350%, has raised the emission factor and promised further measurements, but says full model impacts are not yet known.
I find it undesirable that emissions from mobile machinery in practice are higher than the official norm.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat de emissies van mobiele werktuigen in de praktijk hoger zijn dan de officiële norm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over aanhoudende droogte en natuurbranden

An MP asked the ministers whether they know of reports on the drought and large forest fires in the Deurnese Peel, what additional measures are planned, how water boards and the monitoring of vulnerable nature areas have responded, and for a timeline of drought and fire-prevention actions. The minister answered substantively, pointing to existing drought recommendations, Deltaprogramma funding, priority water supply for category 1 nature areas, and the coordinating role of the regional and national bodies, while stating that fire ignition is hard to prevent.
The Netherlands is becoming more resilient to drought through implementation of the 46 recommendations of the Drought Policy Table.
Nederland wordt beter weerbaar tegen droogte met de realisatie van de 46 aanbevelingen van de Beleidstafel droogte
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over een werkbezoek aan het bedrijf HZPC in Joure en het artikel ‘HZPC verplaatst aardappelonderzoek naar Canada’

Two VVD MPs asked the agriculture minister about HZPC moving potato research to Canada and the strict GMO and crop protection rules that may drive such moves. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to an EU review of GMO rules due by April 2021, innovation programmes, and NVWA capacity, while answering most questions on substance.
As agreed in the coalition agreement, the cabinet is working to revise the European GMO regulation.
Zoals in het regeerakkoord is afgesproken, zet het kabinet zich in voor herziening van de Europese ggo-regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Sienot over de aanhoudende droogte, natuurbranden en het verband met het snel opwarmende klimaat

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about recurring drought, forest and nature fires in the Netherlands and Europe, their link to rapid warming, economic damage, prevention measures and whether the climate targets should be tightened. The minister answered that fire statistics only exist since 2017, that drought risk grows with warming, that prevention runs through regional fire-risk programmes and drought and adaptation policy, that the Copernicus report confirmed known trends without prompting a new European meeting, and that the Netherlands supports a higher EU 2030 target.
The Copernicus report has not given rise to organising a European meeting or to accelerating climate measures.
Het Copernicus-rapport is geen aanleiding geweest voor het organiseren van een Europees overleg of klimaatmaatregelen versneld kunnen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over verdroging in Nederland

An MP from D66 asks the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about drought and groundwater lowering (verdroging) in the Netherlands, including irrigation by farmers, the influence of agriculture on water governance, the composition of water board boards, and follow-up on Beleidstafel Droogte recommendations. The minister responds that drought measures are in place, structural programmes are under way, and several studies (flexibilising groundwater permits, drinking water restrictions) will report in 2021, while stating that the question of guaranteed agricultural seats is left to an advisory commission.
I will send this advice to your House once the commission has presented it to me.
Ik zal dit advies, zodra de commissie het aan mij heeft aangeboden, aan uw Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over nertsen met corona

An MP from the PvdA asked the ministers of Agriculture and of Health about mink farms with coronavirus, including whether all farms were checked, whether more research was underway, and how the virus could spread. The ministers answered that all mink farms are being screened by blood test, the virus has been found on nine sites, the affected sites will be culled under new policy, and further research and an OMT-Z advice are underway.
The number of infected mink per farm is not precisely known because a sample is taken to establish whether the infection is present or not.
Het aantal besmette nertsen per bedrijf is niet precies bekend omdat een steekproef wordt genomen om aan te tonen of de infectie aanwezig is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Bromet en Futselaar over de gevaren van de coronabesmettingen bij nertsenfokkerijen

Three MPs asked the ministers about COVID-19 infections at mink farms, including culling, protective equipment, enforcement of the reporting duty and inspections, and the future of mink farming. The ministers answered that infections were confirmed on nine locations at six farms, that culling was decided on 3 June with a possible voluntary exit scheme still under study, that the NVWA carried out no mink-farm inspections in 2020 so far, and that the questions were answered later than planned.
Not all animals are tested, so we cannot give the precise number of infected animals.
Niet alle dieren worden onderzocht en daarom kunnen wij het precieze aantal besmette dieren niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over coronabesmettingen bij medewerkers van slachthuizen en vleesverwerkingsbedrijven

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about COVID-19 infections among slaughterhouse workers, whether the RIVM guidelines could be followed, enforcement by the NVWA and KDS, and the risk to food safety and animal welfare. Minister Schouten answered that slaughterhouses bear primary responsibility, that the NVWA can suspend work where guidelines cannot be followed and did so at four plants, and that some questions (sick-leave data, number of stoppages, stocks of meat) were not available or answered only partially.
Where the NVWA finds that the RIVM guidelines cannot adequately be followed, the NVWA employee can immediately suspend the service.
Daar waar de NVWA constateert dat de richtlijnen van het RIVM niet adequaat kunnen worden opgevolgd, kan de NVWA-medewerker de dienstverlening per direct opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Wassenberg en Van Esch over een alomvattend aanvalsplan om het risico op toekomstige overspringende zoönotische infectieziekten drastisch te verkleinen

MPs Ouwehand, Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about zoonotic disease risks, intensive livestock farming, wildlife trade, deforestation and a comprehensive action plan to reduce spillover risk. The ministers answered that risks are recognised and managed through the Dutch zoonosis structure, but declined to commit to new bans, a dedicated action plan or additional wildlife-trade enforcement, saying existing measures are sufficient.
The cabinet will continue to work to keep the risks as small as possible or make them smaller.
Het kabinet zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten dat de risico's zo klein mogelijk zijn of kleiner worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Alkaya over de onderhandelingen over visserijsubsidies

Two MPs asked the government whether it would pause WTO fisheries subsidies negotiations after 150 NGOs requested a halt due to inclusiveness and transparency concerns during COVID-19. Minister Kaag answered that talks are stalled, the government does not consider the process non-transparent, supports resuming talks by end-2020, and does not back halting all trade and investment negotiations.
The cabinet does not agree with this claim.
Het kabinet is het niet eens met deze stelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de wildopvang, die dreigt te bezwijken door een tekort aan geld en een toename van het aantal op te vangen dieren als gevolg van de coronacrisis

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the risk that wildlife shelters collapse from a shortage of funds while animal intake rises during the coronavirus crisis, and whether talks on a uniform national compensation guideline have stalled. The minister agreed closure would be undesirable, said talks continue though slower, and promised an inventory of funding and recommendations by end of June.
I expect to be able to present recommendations to the House at the end of June.
Ik verwacht eind juni aanbevelingen aan de Kamer te kunnen aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de zeer korte termijn voor de internetconsultatie bij de Wet stikstofreductie en natuurverbetering

MP Bisschop (SGP) asked why the internet consultation on the Nitrogen Reduction and Nature Improvement Act closes on 3 June 2020, only a week after the draft was published, and whether the deadline could be extended. Minister Schouten answers that the cabinet's urgency to bring the law into force justifies the short period, that the deadline still allows adequate responses, and that an extension is not opportune.
I am aware that there is a short response period for stakeholders.
Ik ben ervan op de hoogte dat er een korte reactietermijn is voor de belanghebbenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de opvang van de Afrikaanse olifant uit circus Freiwald

An MP asked the minister about finding a suitable sanctuary in Europe for the elephant Buba from circus Freiwald before its temporary permit expires on 30 June, including commercial interests, expert involvement and periodic updates. The minister answered that welfare comes first, that three possible sanctuaries are being assessed with independent experts, and that the Chamber will be informed once a location is found, though a move before 30 June is unlikely.
I will inform the Chamber when a suitable sanctuary for the elephant has been found.
Ik informeer uw Kamer wanneer er een geschikte opvanglocatie voor de olifant gevonden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de kabinetsmaatregelen rondom stikstof

An MP from the SP asks the agriculture minister about nitrogen policy, including whether critical deposition values must be met everywhere in Natura 2000 areas, whether a 2030 target of 50% of nitrogen-sensitive area below critical values is legally binding, and whether ecological measures can replace deposition cuts. The minister answers that deposition reduction is needed and that the target is an effort obligation rather than a binding result, while committing to ongoing monitoring and further research.
The cabinet indeed aims to bring nitrogen deposition below the critical deposition values (KDW) on at least 50 percent of the hectares of nitrogen-sensitive nature in Natura 2000 areas by 2030.

Het kabinet streeft er inderdaad naar om in 2030 op ten minste 50 procent van de hectares met stikstofgevoelige natuur in Natura 2000-gebieden de stikstofdepositie onder de kritische depositiewaarden (KDW) te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Animal Rights toont beelden van dierenleed bij konijnenfokkers door heel Nederland’

An MP asked the minister how the government will respond to footage showing dead, sick and dying rabbits at breeding farms, and whether NVWA inspections and sanctions will be increased. The minister said the footage was assessed by the NVWA but cannot itself prove an offence, referred to earlier answers on inspections and sanctions, announced inspections planned for 2020, and said a concrete, measurable plan to improve welfare is being pursued with the sector.
Sick, injured or dead animals in a cage cannot be qualified as a violation on the basis of image material.
Zieke, gewonde of dode dieren in een hok zijn niet op basis van beeldmateriaal als overtreding te kwalificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, De Groot, Van Eijs, Paternotte en Schonis over het bericht ‘Dutch spell out green ideas for EU recovery fund’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture about a Dutch non-paper proposing a green EU recovery, including conditioning state aid on the national climate plan, early energy and circular investments, and an exclusion list for the Just Transition Fund. The government said the non-paper was an informal civil-servant document, declined to share such papers routinely, and gave largely non-committal answers, deferring concrete national plans until after the Commission's proposals and an August decision.
However, the cabinet considers sharing all such informal civil-servant lobbying documents at all times neither opportune nor desirable for effective Dutch advocacy in Brussels.
Echter, het kabinet acht het te allen tijde delen van al deze ambtelijke beïnvloedingsdocumenten niet opportuun noch wenselijk voor effectieve Nederlandse belangenbehartiging in Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de stikstofberekeningen inzake Lelystad Airport

Three MPs (Van Raan, Kröger, Laçin) asked 28 questions about stikstof (nitrogen) calculations for Lelystad Airport, including why new calculations were commissioned after the Council of State ruling against the PAS, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, and whether the MER 2018 was complete. The minister answered that the new work follows the PAS annulment, that the Chamber was informed in September 2019 and February 2020, that results are not yet final, and that the Commission for the MER and RIVM advice was obtained, while declining to share the commissioning assignments citing commercial confidentiality.
It is not customary to share commissioning assignments with the House of Representatives because of their commercially confidential nature.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om opdrachtverstrekkingen te delen met de Tweede Kamer vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijk karakter hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het uitsluiten van plantaardige zuivel van Europese landbouwsubsidies

An MP asks whether EU agricultural subsidies (CAP pillars 1 and 2) exclude plant-based dairy producers and whether this conflicts with government policy to shift toward a more plant-based society. The minister answers that the rules define dairy as animal-derived, that plant-based producers are not excluded from CAP support if they meet the scheme conditions, and that the government will promote plant-based alternatives in the new CAP and national strategic plan.
The starting point is that the supported actions contribute to achieving the stated objectives.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de ondersteunde acties bijdragen aan het behalen van de genoemde doelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de situatie van de vogelopvang in Naarden en de steun voor wildopvangcentra in Nederland

MP Wassenberg asked the minister whether the Naarden bird shelter still faces problems, what steps were taken after a debate commitment, and whether wildlife shelters can get workable rules and funding. Minister Schouten answered that NVWA intervened over unlicensed medicines, that talks with shelters and a plan to revise the quality rules are under way, and that she will inform parliament before summer.
The NVWA enforces in line with its intervention policy, which is public and can be found on the NVWA website.
De NVWA handhaaft conform haar interventiebeleid, dat openbaar is en terug te vinden is op de website van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de mishandeling van honden, in training bij leden van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Politiehonden Vereniging (KNPV)

An MP asked the ministers about abuse of dogs in training by members of the KNPV police dog association, shown on television, and whether trainers would be prosecuted, banned from keeping dogs, and whether training should be brought under government control. The ministers answered that an investigation is ongoing, a standalone dog-keeping ban bill is being prepared, police buys mostly from KNPV-affiliated private schools, and they declined to make training a regulated profession or bring it fully under government.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police have started a criminal investigation.
Het OM en de politie zijn een opsporingsonderzoek gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Graus over het programma Undercover in Nederland inzake de training van politiehonden

MPs Graus and Helder asked about an SBS6 Undercover broadcast showing alleged mistreatment of police dogs during training, and whether the KNPV and police should act. The Minister of Justice replied that animal abuse is a criminal offence, an investigation is ongoing so no details can be given, police will stop buying from abusive trainers, and stricter supervision and purchase contracts are being explored.
The public prosecution service and the police have started a criminal investigation, as with every report of animal abuse.
Het OM en de politie zijn een opsporingsonderzoek gestart, zoals bij iedere melding van dierenmishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over “manipulatie van Monsanto om de Europese toelating van glyfosaat te beïnvloeden”

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about alleged Monsanto manipulation of the EU glyphosate approval, including ghostwriting, a rewritten Kirkland study and the omitted TNO dermal absorption study. The minister answered that EFSA, ECHA and Ctgb found no reason to think industry influenced the assessment, that the TNO study was not in the dossier but newer studies were used, and that the approval process is open.
I have confidence that these studies were taken into account correctly in the latest European assessment procedure for the active substance glyphosate.
Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat deze studies op de juiste wijze zijn meegenomen in de laatste Europese beoordelingsprocedure van de werkzame stof glyfosaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over “niet vernieuwen van de toelating van het aan Parkinson-gerelateerde mancozeb"

An MP asked the Minister whether the EU would vote on not renewing approval of the fungicide mancozeb, its sales and health risks, and whether the Netherlands would support the Commission's proposal. The Minister answered that the proposal is on the May 2020 SCoPAFF agenda, that the Netherlands will support non-renewal if the final proposal matches the draft, and that it is pressing the Commission to conclude the decision quickly.
I find these worrying signals and that is why I am already urging the European Commission to conclude the decision-making quickly.
Ik vind dit verontrustende signalen en daarom dring ik er al bij de Europese Commissie op aan snel de besluitvorming af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over het bericht ‘Natuurmonumenten voert betaald parkeren in’

MPs Futselaar and Laçin asked ministers whether they would intervene in or discuss with Natuurmonumenten its plan to introduce paid parking at its nature reserves, and whether it would reduce access or cause spillover parking and affect its financial health. The minister replied that the government has no view on the parking charge, that Natuurmonumenten sets its own parking policy, that no contact or talks are planned, and declined to assess the organisation's finances.
It is not for the cabinet to pass judgement on the financial management of the Natuurmonumenten association.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel uit te spreken over de financiële huishouding van de vereniging Natuurmonumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over onderzoek met apen voor de ontwikkeling van een vaccin tegen COVID-19

An MP asks whether animal testing for COVID-19 vaccines is wasteful, whether non-animal methods should be prioritised and funded, and whether the reduction of primate use at BPRC is being undermined by Java monkey research. The minister says standards require animal tests, that alternatives are being funded through calls and programmes, and that the BPRC reduction stands, with an exception clause not needed so far.
The BPRC indicates that invoking this clause on the basis of the COVID-19 pandemic is not necessary for now.
Het BPRC geeft aan dat een beroep op deze clausule op basis van de COVID-19-pandemie vooralsnog niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Belangenverstrengeling zaait twijfels over giftig zaad’

MPs De Groot and Paternotte asked whether industry co-funding of research on bee decline, pesticide approval studies and Wageningen University & Research (WUR) funding compromise independence, and whether pesticide studies should be public. The minister answered that the 2011 bee study was fully publicly funded, that WUR's private co-funding is limited and governed by integrity rules, that pesticide approval relies on company-funded but quality-checked studies with some publication, and that open access is a policy goal.
Underlying studies can be made public on request, within the limits of European and national legislation.
Onderliggende studies kunnen op verzoek openbaar worden gemaakt, binnen de grenzen van Europese en nationale wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de berichten ‘Glyfosaatverbod in pachtcontract onwettelijk en ‘Brabant mag verbod glyfosaat eisen van pachters'

MP De Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture whether a glyphosate ban in tenancy contracts by Brabant province and Gilze en Rijen municipality is lawful, why bans are allowed for short leases, and why the motion on glyphosate outside integrated crop protection has not been implemented. The Minister answered that the Central Land Tribunal allowed the Brabant one-year ban, the municipality is appealing a ruling against its ban, and an IPM step-plan inventory of alternatives to glyphosate is underway as the motion's implementation.
I am awaiting the ruling of the Central Land Tribunal in this case.
Ik wacht de uitspraak van de Centrale Grondkamer in deze casus af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de berichten dat de meeste bedrijven in de vleessector de RIVM-richtlijnen niet naleven

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about union reports that most meat-sector firms do not follow RIVM corona guidelines yet slaughtering continues, and whether the minister misled parliament about it. The minister replies that slaughterhouses are responsible for compliance, that the NVWA has suspended inspections at some plants, that a worker-hygiene study is underway, and denies misinforming parliament or withholding information.
I do not recognise the picture that measures are not being complied with across the board.
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat over de hele linie maatregelen niet worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het Duitse laboratorium LPT (Laboratory of Pharmacology and Toxicology) dat jarenlang zou hebben gemarchandeerd met resultaten van proefdieronderzoek

MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that the German lab LPT may have manipulated animal-test results used in approving glyphosate, and whether approval should be suspended and EU scrutiny sought. The minister said German authorities are investigating, that the LPT studies do not change the glyphosate reassessment outcome, declined to request a European study or contact TNO and Monsanto about the 2002 study, and committed only to awaiting the German results and noting that findings will be shared with supervisory bodies.
An investigation into this alleged fraud by the German authorities is currently underway.
Er loopt inmiddels een onderzoek naar deze vermeende fraude door de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de berichtgeving dat de Europese toelating van glyfosaat gebaseerd is op vervalste gegevens uit het Duitse horrorlaboratorium LPT

MP Wassenberg asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that the EU approval of glyphosate rested on falsified studies from the German LPT laboratory, raising fraud, animal welfare, GLP certification and the choice of testing labs. The minister answered that the BfR and Ctgb see no reason to question the glyphosate reassessment based on the LPT studies, that the German fraud investigation must be awaited, and that GLP inspection and EU quality requirements are adequate.
The BfR currently sees no reason to question the outcome of the reassessment of the active substance on the basis of the LPT studies.
Het BfR ziet op dit moment geen aanleiding om op basis van de studies van LPT de uitkomst van de herbeoordeling van de werkzame stof ter discussie te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de schadelijke effecten van SHDI-pesticiden op planten, dieren en mensen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about evidence that SDHI pesticides harm soil organisms, bees and humans via mitochondrial effects, plus EU approval status, Dutch sales, toxicity and a scientists' call for a ban. The minister answered that the in vitro study cannot be directly translated to real exposure, that the Ctgb sees no reason to withdraw existing approvals and is awaiting further research.
The Ctgb, like the French authority Anses, sees no reason to intervene directly in existing authorisations and first awaits further research.
Het Ctgb ziet, net als de Franse toelatingsautoriteit Anses, geen aanleiding om direct in te grijpen op bestaande toelatingen en wacht eerst verder onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Trillende handen, dementie, depressie: landbouwgif is zo onschuldig niet'

MPs De Groot and Dik-Faber asked about reported links between pesticides and Parkinson's and other neurological conditions, the Gezondheidsraad advice, EU action on mancozeb, and timing of the advice. The minister said she takes the concerns seriously, asked the Gezondheidsraad to examine health risks, requested the European Commission to revise neurological data requirements, and pressed the Commission to finalise the mancozeb decision, with the Gezondheidsraad advice expected in summer.

I expect the Gezondheidsraad advice on the health risks of exposure to crop protection products in the summer and will share it with your House, together with the Minister for Medical Care and Sport and the Minister for Environment and Housing.

Ik verwacht het advies van de Gezondheidsraad over de gezondheidsrisico's van blootstelling aan gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in de zomer en zal dit, samen met de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport en de Minister voor Milieu en Wonen, met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht 'Miljoenen aan rechten weggegeven voor ‘illegale’ koeien: ‘Overheid levert een wanprestatie’'

MP Futselaar (SP) asked whether millions of phosphate rights were wrongly granted to cows kept without valid permits, and whether this threatens the phosphate ceiling, state aid rules and the need for recovery. The minister rejected the claim, stated that rights were granted per the Meststoffenwet, that permit checks are the task of provinces and municipalities, and gave no overview of affected farmers.
Checking compliance with the Nature Conservation Act and other environmental permits is a task of the provinces and municipalities.
De controle op de Natuurbeschermingswet- en andere milieuvergunningen is een taak van de provincies en gemeentes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘CBb ruimte voor positieve uitspraak knelgevallen klein’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that the CBb (College of Appeal for Business) rarely ruled in favour of dairy farmers claiming individual disproportionate burden under the phosphate rights system, and about whether organic and sustainable farmers are affected. The Minister answered that 7 of the 92 partly or fully upheld cases concerned individual disproportionate burden, that organic dairy farmers are not overrepresented among rejected cases, and that the law applies to all dairy farmers, so no exemption is planned.
Of the 283 cases the CBb found unfounded, 7 dairy farmers were SKAL-certified in the reference year 2015.
Van de 283 zaken die door het CBb ongegrond zijn bevonden, waren 7 veehouders in het peiljaar 2015 SKAL-gecertificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Aukje de Vries en Moorlag over het bericht over watercrassula op Terschelling en de bestrijding van invasieve exoten

MPs Weverling, Aukje de Vries and Moorlag asked the minister about the spread of water crassula on Terschelling, its financial and legal responsibilities, control methods, and coordination among authorities. The minister confirmed the threat to protected dune habitat, described provincial spending of about 4.3 million euros, noted the difficulty of control, and rejected a central knowledge platform while promising an evaluation and a meeting on this case.
For this specific problem I will organise a consultation.
Ik zal voor deze specifieke problematiek een overleg organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de maatregelen die beschikbaar zijn voor dierentuinen tijdens de coronacrisis

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about support measures for zoos during the coronavirus crisis, including small parks relying on volunteers that cannot use the NOW wage subsidy, and whether a dedicated scheme would be created. The minister listed the general schemes available (NOW, TOZO, guarantee schemes, tax deferral, TOGS), said she is in contact with zoos and has asked them for data on costs, and said that generic measures rather than a special scheme are being pursued.
Generic measures are being deployed to help the zoos.
Er wordt ingezet op generieke maatregelen om de dierentuinen te helpen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Geurts en Lodders over de voortzetting van de activiteiten van Stichting Veldleeuwerik

MPs Geurts and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the uncertain future of Stichting Veldleeuwerik's farmer study groups and how the sustainability practice network would be continued. The minister replied by referring to attached findings and a kwartiermaker appointment, pledging support for existing groups with BO Akkerbouw while the new practice network is set up.
I attach great importance to supporting the current entrepreneur groups of the former Veldleeuwerik network.
Ik hecht er groot belang aan om de huidige ondernemersgroepen van het voormalige Veldleeuwerik netwerk te steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de inzet van vangkooien door zwijnenjagers

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the use of cage traps by wild boar hunters, covering legality, animal welfare, by-catch, slaughter methods, video evidence, COVID-19 measures and illegal releases of wild boar. The minister answered that cage traps are permitted only under provincial exemptions for damage control and population management, that welfare requirements apply, and that she sees no unnecessary suffering, while declining to share correspondence with provinces since licensing is a provincial power.
Granting exemptions for the use of cage traps is a statutory competence of the provinces.
Het verlenen van ontheffingen voor de inzet van vangkooien is een wettelijke bevoegdheid van de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over berichten dat aangevoerde grond voor de aanleg van een aarden wal bij Emmen is besmet met de wratzieke

An MP asked the agriculture minister why contaminated soil brought in for an earthen dike near Emmen was only tested long after delivery, why no testing duty exists, and what compensation farmers receive. The minister answered that no phytosanitary basis for testing existed, that NVWA tested voluntarily and found contamination in 2 of 15 samples, that local measures suffice, and that farmers are not compensated by the state but may sue the supplier.
Based on the phytosanitary regulations for soil organisms, there was no reason for soil investigation.
Op basis van de fytosanitaire regelgeving voor bodemorganismen was er geen aanleiding voor grondonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat grote stukken strand door de storm Ciara zijn weggeslagen

An MP asked the ministers about storm Ciara washing away large parts of the Walcheren beach, sand nourishment delays caused by nitrogen rules, and whether Natura 2000 rules should be waived for urgent sand nourishment. The minister confirmed awareness, said an accelerated nourishment at Dishoek is planned before autumn 2020, and declined any exemption from Natura 2000 and ADC rules as unnecessary.
For the Dishoek location on Walcheren, an accelerated sand nourishment is currently being prepared for water safety reasons, planned to be completed before the start of the autumn 2020 storm season.

Op dit moment wordt voor de locatie Dishoek op Walcheren omwille van de waterveiligheid een versnelde zandsuppletie voorbereid, die gepland is om voor de aanvang van het stormseizoen najaar 2020 gereed te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over formule 1 wil coureurs door zeehondenreservaat laten pendelen

Two PvdA MPs asked whether F1 teams should be shuttled over the beach past a seal reserve, questioning the nature, safety and municipal regulation of the plan. The minister replied that the Grand Prix was postponed due to Covid-19 and the beach route dropped, so no negative effects are expected, and said the province is the competent authority for nature.
The organiser has also announced that the Formula 1 teams will not drive over the beach from Noordwijk to the circuit in Zandvoort during the Grand Prix.
Ook heeft de organisator bekendgemaakt dat de Formule 1-teams tijdens de Grand Prix niet over het strand van Noordwijk naar het circuit in Zandvoort gaan rijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat de provincie Drenthe toestemming heeft gegeven voor het afschieten van tientallen diersoorten op Groningen Airport Eelde

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about reports that the province of Drenthe permitted culling dozens of animal species at Groningen Airport Eelde, and whether the permit was justified, lawful, effective and transparent. The minister replied that the province is the competent authority under the Wet natuurbescherming, that the permit was granted for aviation safety, that the government cannot intervene in provincial decisions, and that the matter can be taken to court.
It is not for me to intervene in the considerations and decisions of the provinces, nor to intervene in the course of justice.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afwegingen en besluiten van de provincies, noch om te interveniëren in de rechtsgang.

Antwoord op vragen het lid Von Martels over het voorstel van de eigenaar van het bosreservaat 'Achter de Voort' (Staatsbosbeheer) om vanuit de aanwijzing als bosreservaat een aantal aanpassingen ten aanzien van de intern

An MP asked the minister about a proposal by Staatsbosbeheer to adjust internal management measures for Achter de Voort, which is both a forest reserve and a Natura 2000 site, and whether this conflicts with the forest reserve status. The minister replied that no real conflict exists, only the search zone for one measure changes, the reserve is excluded, and no EU discussion is needed.
The owner of the Achter de Voort forest reserve has assured me that there is no such conflict.
De eigenaar van het bosreservaat Achter de Voort heeft mij verzekerd dat er van het genoemde conflict geen sprake is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het vervroegde luchtvaartadvies van de commissie Remkes en de gebrekkige rapportage van stikstofuitstoot op grote hoogte

An MP asked the ministers about the early aviation advice of the Remkes committee and whether nitrogen emissions above 3,000 feet from aviation are fully reported, including whether they are placed under 'abroad'. The government answered that the Adviescollege recommends bringing emissions above 3,000 feet into view, that Dutch airport emissions above that height are not counted as 'abroad', and that reporting to the EU will be adjusted following the advice.
With the follow-up to the Remkes committee's advice, the reporting to the European Commission will be adjusted on this point.
Met de opvolging van het advies van de commissie Remkes zal op dit punt de rapportage naar de Europese Commissie worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het stilleggen van de eendenhouderij

MP Ouwehand (PvdD) asks the Minister of Agriculture about halting the duck farming sector during the coronavirus crisis, including animal welfare, bird flu risk, a missing nature permit for the only duck slaughterhouse, and compensation. The minister confirms the sector's temporary halt on new hatching and early slaughter, says a permit question falls to the province, acknowledges welfare concerns, and declines to make ending the sector a condition for aid.
The authority to assess whether this development requires a permit under the Nature Conservation Act lies with the province, in this case the province of Gelderland.
De bevoegdheid om te beoordelen of deze ontwikkeling vergunningplichtig is onder Wet natuurbescherming (Wnb) ligt bij de provincie, in dit geval provincie Gelderland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de situatie voor dieren in de veehouderij als gevolg van de coronacrisis

Party for the Animals MP Ouwehand asks the agriculture minister about animal welfare risks in livestock farming after COVID-19 cut demand from hospitality and export, causing overcrowded stalls, unsold meat and milk, and culling of day-old chicks. Minister Schouten replies that welfare remains monitored, that she lacks legal powers to impose mandatory production limits on a non-contagious-disease basis, and that sectors are pursuing voluntary measures.

In this situation I have no legal powers to impose mandatory production-limiting measures as a crisis measure under the Animal Health and Welfare Act and the Animals Act, because COVID-19 is not an infectious animal disease.

Ik heb echter in deze situatie geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om, als crisismaatregel, verplichte productiebeperkende maatregelen op te leggen op basis van de Gezondheids- en Welzijnswet voor dieren (GWWD) en de Wet dieren omdat COVID-19 geen besmettelijke dierziekte is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het lot van kalfjes uit de melkveehouderij als gevolg van de coronacrisis

The MP Ouwehand asks the Minister of Agriculture about the fate of dairy calves during the COVID-19 crisis, including the drop in veal demand, longer stays in stables, calf imports, transport welfare abuses seen in new footage, and farming restrictions. The Minister answers that sector-wide production limits cannot be imposed legally, that the NVWA has reduced inspections, and that research and talks with the sector are ongoing.
The NVWA does carry out inspections on reports that immediately require them, due to the seriousness of the violation and/or the possible consequences for animal welfare or animal health.
De NVWA voert wel inspecties uit bij meldingen die daar, vanwege de ernst van de overtreding en/of de mogelijke gevolgen voor het dierenwelzijn of diergezondheid, onmiddellijk om vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het delen van de aanpak van de stikstofcrisis met de Kamer

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether an agreement exists on the nitrogen crisis approach and whether she will send it to parliament. Minister Schouten replied that the cabinet decided that day on a structural approach, to be sent to parliament with the answers, and confirmed she will send it.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevolgen van de maatregelen tegen het coronavirus voor dieren in de veehouderij

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether, during the COVID-19 measures, reduced slaughter capacity, staff shortages and oversupply of pigs threaten animal welfare and food safety, and whether production restrictions and breeding limits should be imposed. The minister answered that no concessions are made on inspection levels, that sectors are preparing voluntary production-limiting measures, and that no binding legal basis exists for mandatory production restrictions since COVID-19 is not an animal disease.

However, in this situation I have no legal powers to impose mandatory production-limiting measures as a crisis measure under the Animal Health and Welfare Act (GWWD) and the Animals Act, because COVID-19 is not a contagious animal disease.

Ik heb echter in deze situatie geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om, als crisismaatregel, verplichte productiebeperkende maatregelen op te leggen op basis van de Gezondheids- en Welzijnswet voor dieren (GWWD) en de Wet dieren omdat COVID-19 geen besmettelijke dierziekte is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de voortgang van het stikstofbeleid

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the progress of nitrogen policy, including farmers' opposition, the feed measure, the effect of COVID-19 emission reductions, and the demonstration ban during the crisis. The minister answered that the government will present a structural nitrogen approach with measures to reduce emissions and restore nature, that the feed measure is necessary and will not be reconsidered, and that citizens can still express their views despite the gathering ban.
The Advisory Council on Nitrogen Issues will present its advice on the longer term before the summer.
Het Adviescollege Stikstofproblematiek zal voor de zomer haar advies over de langere termijn presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Bromet, Moorlag en Futselaar over het uitgelekte plan voor de aanpak van de stikstofproblematiek

MPs Ouwehand, Bromet, Moorlag and Futselaar asked the minister how leaks about the nitrogen plan reached the media before parliament was informed, and when parliament would receive the plan. The minister regrets the media coverage, says parliament will be informed once cabinet decides, and states the cabinet has now concluded its decision and sent the structural approach letter to parliament.
I attach importance to informing your House once the discussions with the parties involved have taken place and cabinet decision-making is complete.
Ik hecht eraan uw Kamer te informeren zodra de besprekingen met betrokken partijen hebben plaatsgevonden en de besluitvorming in het kabinet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het opkopen van stikstofrechten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether Noord-Brabant's purchase of farms to acquire nitrogen rights for an industrial project is lawful, and how it fits with the area-based nitrogen approach and national priority for housing. The minister answered that the provincial rules permit the purchase agreements as preparation, that interprovincial cooperation and transparency rules are being agreed, and that the provinces hold regional responsibility.
I intend to agree with the provinces that for external netting, an initiator (both public and private) notifies the province in advance of a planned purchase.
Ik ben voornemens om met de provincies af te spreken dat bij extern salderen een initiatiefnemer (zowel publiek als privaat) zich vooraf meldt bij de provincie over een voorgenomen aankoop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Dik-Faber over opkoop van diverse veehouderijen in andere provincies door de provincie Noord-Brabant

MPs Geurts and Dik-Faber asked the minister about Noord-Brabant buying out livestock farms in other provinces to use external nitrogen offsetting for Logistiek Park Moerdijk, and about scattered nitrogen effects from shipping and offsetting rules. The minister replied that the province acted within its policy rules but acknowledged poor coordination with other provinces, and promised agreements with provinces on notification, monitoring and management measures.
Given the limited coordination with other provinces over this buyout, this did not go well and caused much unrest, for which the province has offered apologies.
Gezien de beperkte afstemming met de andere provincies over deze opkoop, is dit hier niet goed verlopen en heeft dit veel onrust veroorzaakt waarvoor de provincie excuses heeft aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de stikstofaanpak

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the nitrogen approach, including external netting, speculative buyouts of farms, a nitrogen registration system, voer measures and corona-related emission reductions. The Minister says provinces will require prior notification of buyouts, external netting will open for one year with a half-year review, and she will examine several proposals while rejecting market-protecting registration.
I intend to agree with the provinces that when externally netting, an initiator (both public and private) notifies the province in advance of a planned purchase.
Ik ben voornemens om met de provincies af te spreken dat bij extern salderen een initiatiefnemer (zowel publiek als privaat) zich vooraf meldt bij de provincie over een voorgenomen aankoop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht ‘Boeren in Bladel krijgen massaal drugsbrieven: ‘Mijn cliënt zoekt ruimte voor hennepplanten”

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Lodders asked about fake drug-crime letters sent to farmers in Bladel and whether similar letters circulate elsewhere, and about reporting channels and vacant farm buildings. The minister says the letters were part of a municipal awareness campaign, that similar initiatives exist nationwide, and that reporting is possible via police and Meld Misdaad Anoniem, while promising to inform parliament on the broader offensive later.
A clear picture of the precise extent is lacking, but it can be assumed that such practices occur throughout the country.
Een duidelijk en helder beeld over de precieze omvang ontbreekt, maar aangenomen kan worden dat dit soort praktijken in het hele land voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Moorlag over stikstofemissie ten gevolge van houtstook

An MP (Moorlag, PvdA) asked the ministers whether Dutch emission limits for NOx and dust from biomass power plants in the Activiteitenbesluit comply with EU rules and whether they should be tightened, citing a Mobilisation for the Environment letter. The state secretary replied that the limits meet EU requirements, that TNO is studying tightening them under the Schone Lucht Akkoord, and that provinces and municipalities will apply Best Available Techniques in permitting.
In the context of the Clean Air Agreement I am having TNO research the possibilities for tightening these emission limit values
In het kader van het Schone Lucht Akkoord laat ik TNO onderzoek doen naar de mogelijkheden van aanscherping van deze emissiegrenswaarden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat het fokken van honden met extreem platte snuiten ondanks een verbod ongestraft doorgaat

Wassenberg (PvdD) asks why breeding of extremely short-snouted dogs continues despite a ban, how many breeders and inspections exist, and whether enforcement is adequate. The minister answers that enforcement by the NVWA has started with new criteria, nine controls were held in 2019, six written warnings issued, and capacity was increased for 2020 though not yet proven effective.
In 2020 more controls, based on selection and on reports, will be carried out on breeding dogs with extreme physical characteristics.
In 2020 zullen meer controles, op basis van selectie en op basis van meldingen, worden uitgevoerd op het fokken van honden met extreme uiterlijke kenmerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht “Nieuwe megastal Knorhof stap dichterbij”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a planned 26,000-pig stable by a farmer previously sanctioned for animal welfare and environmental violations in the Netherlands and Germany, and about a possible EU black list for banned livestock keepers. The minister answered that such violations alone cannot justify refusing an environmental permit, that the provincial authority decides on the permit, that a black list is not yet achievable at EU level, and that a bill on animal abuse is expected to go to the Council of State before summer 2020.
Failure to sufficiently comply with animal welfare and environmental rules, however, cannot in itself be grounds for refusing an environmental permit for the construction of a new stable.
Het niet of onvoldoende naleven van dierenwelzijns- en milieuregels kan echter op zichzelf geen grond zijn voor het weigeren van een omgevingsvergunning milieu voor de bouw van een nieuwe stal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over gevaarlijke honden

Two MPs asked whether a mayor can neutralise a dangerous dog and whether a mayor may have a biting dog euthanised, and whether a dog-keeping ban should be created for owners of repeatedly aggressive dogs. The government answers that mayors have existing powers under the Gemeentewet, local bylaws and bestuursdwang, that euthanasia is only possible in extreme cases after seizure, and that a standalone dog-keeping ban is being prepared with the Justice Minister.
In addition, a bill is being prepared with the Minister of Justice and Security to introduce a dog-keeping ban as a standalone measure.
In aanvulling hierop wordt in samenwerking met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid een wetsvoorstel voorbereid waarmee een houdverbod als zelfstandige maatregel wordt geïntroduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de Maximale Residu Limiet voor fluopicolide in blauwmaanzaad

An MP asked the Minister whether the very low EU residue limit of 0.01 mg/kg for fluopicolide in blue poppy seed harms Dutch growers, whether it is justified, whether imports face a different limit, and whether the government will push for a higher limit. The Minister answered that the default limit applies because no use was ever applied for, that the same limit applies to all poppy seed regardless of origin, and that the onus lies with companies to submit a request, which one has reportedly done at the Ctgb.
The reason the MRL of 0.01 mg/kg applies to blue poppy seed is that the use of fluopicolide on blue poppy seed and a higher MRL for this use were never requested and therefore never assessed.

De reden dat de MRL van 0,01 mg/kg voor blauwmaanzaad van toepassing is, is het feit dat de toepassing van fluopicolide op blauwmaanzaad en een hogere MRL voor deze toepassing niet zijn aangevraagd en dus niet zijn beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de noodzaak van het uitbreiden van de lijst met vitale beroepen met dierenartsen en dierverzorgers

MP Wassenberg asked whether veterinarians and animal carers should be added to the government's list of critical occupations during COVID-19, citing staff shortages at shelters and animal care organisations. Minister Schouten replied that the list is deliberately kept narrow to limit exceptions to measures, that veterinary work for the food chain is covered, that animal carers are not listed but local solutions should be sought, and that she is monitoring the situation in consultation with sector bodies.
The list of critical occupations and vital processes has been kept limited in order to restrict the spread of COVID-19 as much as possible.
De lijst met cruciale beroepen en vitale processen is beperkt gehouden om de verspreiding van COVID-19 zo veel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de ongewenste en ernstige gevolgen van de coronamaatregelen voor mensen en organisaties die kwetsbare, zieke en gewonde dieren opvangen

MP Wassenberg asked whether Covid-19 quarantine rules, which keep household members home, could leave animal shelters and carers short-staffed and endanger animal care. Minister Schouten acknowledged the risk, said the rules aim primarily at the epidemic, and pointed to local solutions and case-by-case exemptions for specialist carers rather than new general exemptions.
I am willing to monitor the situation and am already doing so.
Ik ben bereid om de situatie te monitoren en doe dit ook al.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de wenselijkheid van het toevoegen van diergeneeskundige,- en dierverzorgende beroepsgroepen aan de lijst van cruciale beroepen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether veterinary and animal care professions should be added to the list of critical occupations during COVID-19, and why they were excluded. The minister answered that the list is deliberately limited to keep exceptions few, that animal health must not be compromised but specialist care can often be arranged locally, and that case-by-case solutions are sought.
The request to add veterinary and animal care occupations to the list of critical occupations is known to me.
Het verzoek om diergeneeskundige en dierverzorgende beroepsgroepen aan de lijst van cruciale beroepen toe te voegen is mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Von Martels over schade aan mestkelders, ventilatiekanalen en funderingen veroorzaakt door mijnbouwactiviteiten in Groningen

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers whether agricultural damage to manure cellars, ventilation shafts and foundations from Groningen gas extraction had been wrongly excluded from reinforcement and damage handling by NAM, CVW and the TCMG, and how farmers are heard and supported. The government answered that the TCMG handles new damage claims, uses civil liability law with the statutory presumption of causation, is consulting an expert panel on manure cellar damage due around June 2020, and is working with the Province on a programmatic approach for farmers.
The panel's advice is expected to be ready around mid-June 2020.
Naar verwachting is het advies van het panel medio juni 2020 gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de bomenkap voor stadsverwarming in Purmerend

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether 16,000 trees were felled in the Schoorl dunes, whether the wood fed Purmerend's district heating, and whether a Staatsbosbeheer representative's roles (Enerco, Energiehout, former FSC board) amounted to conflict of interest. The minister answers that the felling was a 2018-2019 thinning, the wood went to the wood industry, and no conflict of interest exists given functional separation and that FSC does not certify.
In response to your questions I obtained information from Staatsbosbeheer.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van uw vragen informatie ingewonnen bij Staatsbosbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat Shell de Nationale Boomfeestdag van Staatsbosbeheer sponsort

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether Shell's sponsorship of the Nationale Boomfeestdag, its climate record, and related tree-planting and flight-compensation claims amount to greenwashing and misleading children's education material. The government confirmed the sponsorship, said climate responsibility lies with companies and the Klimaatakkoord, declined to assess school learning materials citing school autonomy, and promised a separate letter on the voluntary CO2 compensation market.
The cabinet regularly receives questions about the content of learning materials.
Met enige regelmaat krijgt het kabinet vragen over de inhoud van leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat lijmplankjes veel dierenleed veroorzaken

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about the animal suffering caused by glue traps and whether their sale and use should be banned. The minister replied that glue traps are prohibited without a provincial exemption, that they are sold legally, that a sales ban is not warranted, and that IPM prevention is the preferred approach.
As I explained in my answer to question three, the use of glue traps is prohibited, but provinces can deviate from this by granting exemptions.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag drie heb toegelicht, is het gebruik van lijmplankjes verboden, maar kunnen provincies kunnen hier van afwijken door ontheffingen te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de kapwerkzaamheden in Natura 2000-gebied de Schoorlse Duinen

An SP MP asked the minister about tree felling in the Natura 2000 area Schoorlse Duinen, its timeline, area affected, permits, and compliance with nature law and the forestry code. The minister answered that only about 10 hectares (Dr. Van Steijnbos) will be felled in the current plan period, the Baaknolbos will in principle be spared, and the felling is assessed as within legal exemptions, with the forestry code update still pending.
This management plan can be found via the following weblink.
Dit beheerplan is te vinden via de volgende weblink
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked about the poor condition of 164 state-owned farmsteads leased to tenant farmers, the timing of repairs, the Grondkamer rent-review process and a recent ruling, and the strategic status of the farms. The ministers answered that repairs will start once funds are freed in the spring budget process (estimated at about 24 million euro), that 153 farms are strategic, and that the rent norms remain adequate, while declining to draw conclusions for other tenants from the ruling.
Once the funds become available, further repair work will be started as quickly as possible.
Na het beschikbaar komen van de middelen wordt zo snel mogelijk gestart met de verdere herstelwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de berichten ‘Royal Floraholland: sierteeltsector ongekend hard geraakt’ en ‘Coronavirus treft vooral logistiek en sierteelt hard

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether she was aware of reports that the flower sector was hit hard by the coronavirus, what steps were being taken on trade impact, credit guarantees, support for affected firms, and sector-specific measures. The minister answered that ongoing contact with sector representatives continues, that expanded guarantee schemes and tax payment deferrals are available to all firms including flower growers, and that she will ask the European Commission for market-support measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevolgen van de maatregelen tegen het coronavirus voor dieren in de veehouderij

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about animal welfare risks in livestock during the coronavirus crisis, including transport delays, slaughterhouse staffing, NVWA and KDS inspector absences, and food safety. The Minister answers that welfare is weighed in crisis measures, EU transport rules still apply, she does not support a transport stop, NVWA has scaled back non-essential supervision while keeping slaughter inspections, and several answers are deferred to a later reply.
Where possible the questions have been answered. More time is needed for the questions not yet answered.
Daar waar mogelijk zijn de vragen beantwoord. Voor de niet-beantwoorde vragen is meer tijd nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het Vlaamse verbod op de jacht in het kader van de coronamaatregelen

An MP asked whether the Netherlands will, like Flanders, ban hunting and angling during the COVID-19 measures, since trips for these hobbies are no longer considered justified. The minister answered that no additional measures beyond the existing stay-at-home advice are needed, noting hunting is closed until August and population control may continue under strict RIVM rules.
There is no reason to take additional measures for hunting and angling beyond the measures the cabinet has already announced.
Er is geen aanleiding om voor het jagen en het beoefenen van de hengelsport aanvullende maatregelen te treffen, bovenop de maatregelen die het kabinet al heeft afgekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het WUR rapport ‘Cosmetische aspecten in specifieke handelsnormen voor groenten en fruit’

MP Dik-Faber asked the minister about a WUR report on cosmetic standards for fruit and vegetables, the lack of data on waste, consumer acceptance, and supermarket cosmetic requirements, and whether the minister would act on them. The minister answered that the report gives enough basis to raise EU trade standards, committed to further research via a waste working group, reported talks with supermarkets who agreed to relax requirements when needed, and said structural solutions would be explored with the working group.
I presented this recommendation in November 2019 to the UNECE working group on agricultural product standards.
Tevens heb ik deze aanbeveling in november 2019 voorgelegd aan de «UNECE-werkgroep standaarden agrarische producten».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitgifte van dode dieren vanuit vrachtwagens tijdens het Offerfeest

An MP asked the ministers whether the sale of slaughtered animal carcasses from trucks during the Eid al-Adha festival was legal, under what exemption, and how the NVWA supervises it. The government answered that a temporary, generic NVWA permission allowed transport of unchilled carcasses from approved slaughterhouses, with NVWA inspection of slaughter, and that the police tweet's wording was unfortunate.
On the basis of that authority, the NVWA granted a permanent generic permission for transport of not yet chilled carcasses during the Eid festival.
Op grond van die bevoegdheid heeft de NVWA een permanente generieke toestemming verleend voor vervoer van nog niet afgekoelde karkassen tijdens het offerfeest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Lodders over een bericht van het Operationeel Centrum van de politie-eenheid Den Haag

Two VVD MPs asked why the Den Haag police unit tweeted that selling meat from vans during the Offerfeest was legal, and questioned the NVWA oversight, food safety and equal treatment behind it. The minister explained that the NVWA had granted a permanent general permission for transporting uncooled carcasses, that the tweet was meant to inform the public, and that the controls were sample-based, without committing to any new action.
That regulation also allows the competent authority, in this case the NVWA, to grant permission for transporting meat and delivering it to citizens via (mini) vans.
Deze verordening maakt het ook mogelijk dat de bevoegde autoriteit, in dit geval de NVWA, toestemming verleent voor het vervoer van vlees en aflevering aan burgers via (mini)vrachtwagens.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Leijten en Futselaar over nieuwe berichten van belangenverstrengeling en corruptie in het falende Europese Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid (GLB)

MPs Leijten and Futselaar asked whether EU agricultural subsidies enabled fraud and oligarch enrichment, citing reports on Czech PM Babiš and Italian mafia fraud, and whether the CAP should be cut and capped. The minister called the allegations serious, said the Commission should investigate, declined to comment on individual cases, denied that CAP subsidies destroyed markets for small farmers, and said the Netherlands favours a smaller MFF and a cap on support per farm.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases under ongoing investigation.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen waarnaar onderzoek nog lopende is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht “‘Duidelijke toename’ van boeren die stap naar het buitenland overwegen”

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that farmers are increasingly considering emigration, including how many have left, why, and the consequences for rural areas and competitiveness. The minister answered that exact figures are scarce (about 100 farmers emigrated 2010–2015 and 5 in 2016), that the policy response focuses on farmers' income, generational succession and the rural programme, and that no concrete new action was promised.
There is little exact data on emigrating farmers (families), since this is not easy to establish.
Er zijn weinig exacte gegevens over emigrerende boeren(gezinnen) aangezien dit niet eenvoudig vast te stellen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het programma ‘Certificeren op afstand’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the 'certify remotely' programme for veterinary export certificates, including new deadlines, weekend export limits, frozen products, and the high fee compared with Germany. The minister answers that no new requirements were imposed, that the fee is set by ministerial regulation, and that remote and on-site certification will both be kept for now.
Certifying after the fact is not permitted by law.
Het achteraf certificeren is wettelijk niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Bouali over het bericht ‘Hoe aquaria wereldwijd het koraalrif bedreigen; Vissen op Nemo’s’

MPs De Groot and Bouali asked ministers about imports of tropical aquarium fish and coral through Schiphol, possible illegal wild capture, and EU enforcement under CITES. The minister answered with 2019 import figures for CITES-listed species, described CITES permit and customs controls, and said the EU and Switzerland and the US had proposed a CITES study of unprotected species trade.
For species not protected under CITES, no figures are available.
Voor de soorten die niet beschermd zijn onder CITES zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de geplande wildexcursies van Staatsbosbeheer op de Veluwe zoals op hun website vermeld

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister whether Staatsbosbeheer's guided wildlife excursions on the Veluwe, including night walks and Land Rover trips, disturb rest areas and biodiversity. The minister replied that excursions are guided, limited in frequency, and that Staatsbosbeheer will act if negative effects are observed, while Land Rovers are being phased out.
If Staatsbosbeheer observes negative consequences from this type of excursion, it will always take immediate action.
Wanneer Staatsbosbeheer negatieve gevolgen waarneemt van dit soort excursies, zal zij altijd direct actie ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en De Groot over rechtswetenschappelijke onderzoek naar de Habitatrichtlijn en Vogelrichtlijn

MPs Groothuizen and De Groot asked the ministers of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and of Justice and Security about a legal study on domestic cats and the EU Birds and Habitats Directives, including whether cat predation is a significant threat and how permits for trap-neuter-return programmes are handled. The minister answered that cat predation is not shown to significantly affect protected species, that provinces are responsible for permits and nature measures, and that no ban on letting cats roam is considered necessary.
It is not known how many animals are killed by cats in the Netherlands.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel dieren in Nederland door katten worden gedood.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het doorfokken van honden

An MP asked the minister about breeding practices for Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retrievers and Saint Bernards that spread hereditary epilepsy, and whether the Raad van Beheer, breed clubs and a shared database will be pushed to change. The minister acknowledged the problem, said the Raad van Beheer will present breeding policy later this year, that the NVWA enforces the breeding ban on known carriers via complaints, and that PETscan and the ECGG are being used to collect data.
It is important that the Raad now takes swift steps, and I expect concrete agreements to be made in the short term with breeders of Saint Bernards and Toller Retrievers.
Het is wel van belang dat de Raad nu snel stappen zet en ik verwacht dat op korte termijn concrete afspraken worden gemaakt met fokkers van sint-bernardhonden en toller retrievers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de wijziging van de salmonellabestrijding bij pluimvee

An MP from the CDA asked why Dutch poultry flocks are slaughtered early after a first positive salmonella test even when a second opinion finds no infection, and what the government is doing about EU rules. The minister agreed early slaughter is undesirable, explained that EU rules do not allow routine retesting, and said WUR research is underway to strengthen the case with the Commission.

At the end of 2019 the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality asked Wageningen University and Research (WUR) to compare the different control approaches and produce a scientifically grounded evaluation.

Het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit heeft eind 2019 aan Wageningen University and Research (WUR) gevraagd om de verschillende bestrijdingsaanpakken te vergelijken en een wetenschappelijk onderbouwde evaluatie te maken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht dat Britten de visrechten van Europese vissers af willen pakken

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that Britain wants to end the automatic fishing rights of European fishers in British waters, and whether Dutch fishers would need permits and how the Netherlands is preparing. The minister confirmed awareness, said the UK will set its own fishing rules after the transition period and a permit regime is likely, and described Dutch negotiating positions and the July 2020 target for a fisheries agreement.
It is therefore up to the UK to assess whether a permit must be granted in this zone for fishing by vessels not flying the UK flag.
Het is daarmee aan het VK om te beoordelen of in deze zone voor de visserij door vaartuigen die niet onder de vlag van het VK vissen een vergunning moet worden verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Nationale Week zonder Vlees

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture why the ministry dropped its 2019 promotion of the Week without Meat, whether it will promote reduced meat consumption as a nitrogen and climate measure, and what it is doing to shift to plant-based proteins. Minister Schouten answered that the Week is for the foundation to promote, that the government promotes a healthy and sustainable diet via the Schijf van Vijf, that the ministry's catering participates, and listed existing protein-transition research and programmes.
It is up to the Nationale Week zonder Vlees foundation to invite people to take part in the Nationale Week zonder Vlees.
Het is aan de stichting Nationale Week zonder Vlees om mensen uit te nodigen om mee te doen met de Nationale Week zonder Vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Provincie wil steenmarter breed bestrijden’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Fryslân pilot on controlling stone martens, which coincided with more hatched lapwing and black-tailed godwit chicks, is successful, and whether the province's request to list the stone marten on the national exemption list will be granted. The minister finds the pilot promising but insists the province already has sufficient powers, declines the national listing, promises a broader national study and a discussion with Fryslân, and says no national damage data exists.
Control of damage and nuisance caused by the stone marten is a competence of the provinces.
Bestrijding van schade en overlast van de steenmarter is een bevoegdheid van de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Van der Lee en Van Raan over de Gedragscode Zon op Land
