Five MPs from different parties asked ministers about the industry-drafted Gedragscode Zon op Land (code of conduct for ground-mounted solar), its alignment with the solar-ladder motions, protection of Natura 2000 and national park areas, guidance to local authorities and RES regions, use in rijksgronden tenders, and PBL's landscape report. The government welcomed the code as consistent with the voorkeursvolgorde zon, said it will be promoted via the Nationaal Programma RES and monitored, and deferred the landscape-policy questions to a forthcoming NOVI letter.
Through the National Programme RES we will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the RES regions.
Via het Nationaal Programma RES (NP RES) brengen we deze gedragscode onder de aandacht van de RES’en.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het stoppen met zoutwinning in de Waddenzee

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the advisory committee found the baseline measurements for salt mining in the Wadden Sea insufficient for monitoring, and whether all preparatory activities should stop given the World Heritage status. Minister Wiebes confirmed the committee's finding, rejected stopping preparatory work, and said the revised baseline would be submitted to the audit committee, with no mining allowed until monitoring is in order.
I currently see no reason for further measures.
Ik zie nu geen aanleiding voor verdere maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over ongunstige fiscale regels voor de landbouw

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked about unfavourable tax rules for farmers facing volatile incomes from drought and animal disease, comparisons with Belgium, France, Denmark and Ireland, and whether a tax-free climate reserve or wider use of the reinvestment reserve is possible. The state secretary pointed to income averaging, loss relief, the tax exemption for broad weather insurance, and a sector proposal on a climate reserve that is still being studied.
The proposal was sent by the sector representatives on 16 January 2020 and will be studied further.
Het voorstel is op 16 januari 2020 door de vertegenwoordigers van de sector toegezonden en zal nader worden bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Slacht dreigt voor Texelse Konikpaarden: "Het pakte niet uit zoals we hadden gehoopt"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that twenty Konik horses on Texel faced slaughter after failed relocation, and whether Staatsbosbeheer could rehome them elsewhere. The minister answered that the horses can stay on Texel because mitigating measures are being taken, that relocation to private keepers or other areas is undesirable or infeasible, and that Staatsbosbeheer should be trusted to weigh the decision carefully.
The current solution makes relocation unnecessary.
De huidige oplossing maakt herplaatsing overbodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over de vertraging van duurzame energieprojecten vanwege de stikstofproblematiek

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why sustainable energy projects, including hydrogen projects in Groningen, are delayed by the nitrogen problem, and what measures are being taken to complete them on time. The minister answered that stricter permitting after the PAS ruling delays some large energy projects, that no complete overview exists, and listed measures such as netting schemes, lease of nitrogen space, and a planned bundling programme, with a further letter promised in spring.

There is no complete overview of projects affected, because the competent authority lies with different governments (municipalities, provinces and central government) and initiators can be both public and private parties.

Er is geen compleet overzicht van projecten die hiermee te maken hebben, omdat het bevoegd gezag hiervoor bij verschillende overheden (gemeenten, provincies en Rijk) ligt en initiatiefnemers zowel overheden als private partijen kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het artikel ‘Ik heb rapporten herschreven. En daarna dwong je onderzoekers een handtekening eronder te zetten’

Bromet (GroenLinks) asks whether the agriculture ministry pressured ecologists to alter Natura 2000 recovery conclusions during the PAS, whether the PAS was legally doomed as a result, and how future reports and monitoring will be made trustworthy. Minister Schouten denies that any pressure was exerted, says the PAS process used a uniform, reviewed methodology, and promises to raise report reliability with the Rijksheren and strengthen monitoring.
As far as is now known, the ministry has not exerted any pressure to adjust research results.
Er is vanuit het ministerie voor zover nu bekend geen druk uitgeoefend om onderzoeksresultaten aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht “Het gaat niet goed met de natuur in Nederland. Als het zo doorgaat 'is het tegen de klippen op werken'" en natuurgebied ’t Twiske

An MP asked the minister about a newspaper report on poor nature conditions in the Netherlands and about growing commercial events, catering and overnight stays at the Natura 2000 area 't Twiske, asking how nature protection and nitrogen rules can be guaranteed. The minister answered that the Wet natuurbescherming applies, that the province of Noord-Holland is responsible for the management plan and permits, and that case-by-case assessment will determine whether large events or horeca are acceptable.
Permit granting for these kinds of activities is a responsibility of the province of Noord-Holland.
Vergunningverlening voor dit soort activiteiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de aanwijzing van natuurgebieden en het toevoegen van stikstofgevoelige habitats in het verleden

MP Von Martels (CDA) asked the minister about the designation of Natura 2000 areas, including claims that habitats were added or designated without being present and that conservation status is not improving. The minister rejected several claims, defended the designations as legally required, and gave limited answers on monitoring data, noting evaluations are still ongoing.
Afterwards, in a few cases a nitrogen-sensitive habitat was added where, according to the Council of State, this had wrongly not yet been done.
Nadien is in enkele gevallen een stikstofgevoelig habitat toegevoegd als dat volgens de Raad van State ten onrechte nog niet was gebeurd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Harbers over het artikel 'Politieke agenda zit oplossing stikstof dwars'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a press article claiming Natura 2000 areas were designated on improper grounds, with habitat types and species added or missing and the basis for designations questioned. The minister answered that designations follow objective criteria, that corrections were made for scientific errors, and that an investigation into the designation decisions is underway.
That is why research is being carried out into the content of the designation decisions, as announced in my letter of 13 November 2019.
Daarom vindt er onderzoek plaats naar de inhoud van de aanwijzingsbesluiten, zoals aangekondigd in mijn brief van 13 november 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Omdat duizenden bedrijven geen natuurvergunning hebben weten we niet hoeveel stikstof de industrie uitstoot’

An MP asked the ministers whether it is known how many companies lack a nature permit under the Nature Conservation Act, and why emissions reporting thresholds limit visibility of industrial nitrogen emissions. The government answered that the number of companies without permits is not known, that provinces are responsible for permitting and enforcement, and that industrial emissions are well covered by the Emissieregistratie, while declining to lower the reporting threshold.
It is not known how many companies wrongly lack a permit under the Nature Conservation Act.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel bedrijven er ten onrechte geen vergunning hebben in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over de berichten ‘Zelfs grote bedrijven hebben geen natuurvergunning, dus weten we niet hoeveel stikstof in de natuur terechtkomt’ en ‘Uitstoot van Gelderse bedrijven o

SP MPs Futselaar and Laçin asked about reports that thousands of businesses, including large ones, lack the nature permits required under the Wet natuurbescherming, so nitrogen emissions are unknown. The minister answered that many firms need no permit for nitrogen, that enforcement is largely a provincial responsibility with no statutory inspection deadlines, that no active enforcement occurs until a collective legalisation scheme exists, and that a decision on the Schiphol enforcement request is expected by 1 April 2020.
It is not known how many businesses wrongly lack a permit under the Wet natuurbescherming.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel bedrijven er ten onrechte geen vergunning hebben in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het bericht dat de overheid tuinders hielp om het ETS te ontwijken

MPs Bromet and Van der Lee asked whether the government helped greenhouse growers avoid the EU ETS by splitting companies and treating gas boilers as back-up, and why this was not debated with parliament. Minister Schouten answered that the affected firms left the ETS for legitimate reasons, that the NEa supervises to prevent misuse, that the rules were not put to parliament as they implement EU-based provisions, and that removing the back-up rule would be undesirable and contrary to EU law.
The NEa checks permit applications from companies that thereby cease to fall under the ETS against the legal framework so that the rules cannot be abused.
De NEa toetst de vergunningaanvragen van bedrijven waardoor ze niet langer onder ETS vallen aan het wettelijk kader zodat geen misbruik gemaakt kan worden van de regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de dierlijke oorsprong van het nieuwe coronavirus en de falende aanpak van de handel in bedreigde diersoorten

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether the new coronavirus originated from wildlife sold at a Wuhan market and whether the government will tighten import checks, ban trade in protected species and push China and the EU for stronger wildlife trade rules. The minister acknowledged possible wildlife reservoirs and the zoonotic risk but declined new import controls, a CITES evaluation, a total trade ban or a call to China, arguing there was no evidence the spread stems from animal trade.
There is no reason now to tighten supervision and enforcement of imports of animal products and animals from China.
Er is geen reden om nu tot een aanscherping van toezicht en handhaving op de import van dierlijke producten en dieren uit China over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de overheid de glastuinbouw heeft geholpen om het betalen van de CO2-prijs te ontwijken

An MP asked whether the government helped greenhouse horticulture firms escape the EU ETS carbon price, and whether this undermines climate goals and public trust. The ministers deny any improper help, say firms left the ETS for legitimate reasons under NEa supervision, and reject changing the arrangement or pursuing unpaid sums.
Given the NEa's supervision of the legal rules, I have confidence that possible misuse of the rules is very small.
Door het toezicht van de NEa op de wettelijke regels heb ik er vertrouwen in dat mogelijk misbruik van de regels erg klein is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van der Lee over het artikel 'Overheid hielp tuinders Europese CO2-prijs te ontwijken'

MPs Sienot and Van der Lee asked whether the government helped greenhouse growers escape the EU ETS carbon price by splitting firms and classifying gas boilers as backup, and whether this undermines climate targets. The minister denies any evasion: the firms left the ETS legitimately, the NEa supervises misuse, and the sector remains subject to the CO2 sector system with compensation for overshoot.

There are three reasons why companies no longer participate in the ETS: 1. companies reduced the capacity of their installations; 2. companies split up; 3. companies no longer meet the ETS criteria based on the 'back-up scheme'.

Er zijn drie redenen dat bedrijven niet meer deelnemen aan het ETS: 1. Bedrijven hebben het vermogen van hun installaties verminderd; 2. Bedrijven hebben zich opgesplitst; 3. Bedrijven voldoen op basis van de «back-up regeling» niet langer aan de ETS-criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de lagere dierenwelzijnsstandaarden in Canada, naar aanleiding van het rondetafelgesprek over het EU-Canada-vrijhandelsverdrag CETA van 6 november 2019

An MP asked the trade and agriculture ministers whether lower animal welfare standards in Canada (transport durations, sow housing, cattle branding) undermine a level playing field under CETA, and whether EU import requirements can enforce equivalence. The government answered that EU import rules cover only plant/animal health, food safety and labelling, that animal welfare import conditions are limited under WTO rules, and that the CETA Regulatory Cooperation Forum is discussing long-distance animal transport.
Through CETA it is possible to keep talking with Canada about animal welfare requirements.
Via CETA is het mogelijk om in gesprek te blijven met Canada over dierenwelzijnseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het Joint Management Committee on Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures in het CETA-verdrag

An MP asked the ministers about the CETA Joint Management Committee on SPS measures, including whether it can amend CETA without parliamentary control and how the EU position is set. The minister answered that amendments to annexes and protocols follow a simplified procedure, that the Council sets the EU position and Parliament is informed, and that Parliament must approve treaty amendments under article 91 of the Constitution, but many questions were answered only by reference to earlier answers or to the European Commission website.

Deviating from that, article 5.14(2)(d) of CETA and article 30.2(2) determine that the Joint Management Committee on SPS measures and the CETA Joint Committee respectively may decide to amend the protocols and certain annexes to the agreement.

In afwijking daarvan bepalen artikel 5.14, lid 2, onder d, van CETA en artikel 30.2, lid 2, dat het Gemengd Comité van beheer voor sanitaire en fytosanitaire maatregelen respectievelijk het CETA Gemengd Comité kunnen besluiten om de protocollen en een aantal bijlagen bij het akkoord te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat vogels kleiner worden door klimaatverandering

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the government about reports that birds are shrinking due to climate change, including the red knot study and its implications for biodiversity and the Wadden Sea. The minister acknowledges the research, says climate change is one cause of biodiversity loss, notes the Wadden Sea's importance for migratory birds, and points to existing climate and Wadden policy without committing to new action.
This is a scientific question that I cannot assess.
Dit is een wetenschappelijk vraagstuk dat ik niet kan beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de antwoorden op eerder gestelde vragen inzake de regeling Pelsdierhouderij slopen en ombouwen

MP Lodders asks why, more than six years after the fur farming ban took effect, the subsidy scheme for demolition and conversion of fur farms still does not work adequately, and what the minister will do for affected entrepreneurs. The minister replies that the scheme entered into force in February 2018, that changes will be submitted to parliament and the European Commission, with publication targeted for the second half of 2020, and that the full 36 million euro budget will be pursued without a firm guarantee of retroactive timing.
Assuming this procedure proceeds smoothly, I aim to publish and bring into force the amended decision in the second half of 2020.
Uitgaande van een voorspoedig verloop van deze procedure streef ik er naar het gewijzigde besluit in de tweede helft van 2020 te publiceren en in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over apen als proefdieren

An MP asked the minister about reports of a police raid on a Tilburg primate laboratory, the origin of monkeys imported from a German breeder suspected of animal abuse and fraud, and whether trade in wild-caught or poorly documented primates should be curbed. The minister replied that the NVWA checked documents and inspections found no irregularities, that the EU ban on wild-caught primates applies, and that she sees no need for a further ban though she welcomes the Dutch labs' commitment to domestic breeding.
Based on the protection of business and manufacturing data, I cannot provide the information on the number of monkeys.
Op grond van de bescherming van bedrijfs- en fabricagegegevens kan ik de informatie over het aantal apen niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over PFAS houdende grond afkomstig van de verwerking van aardappelen, suikerbieten en cichoreiwortels

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked the ministers about PFAS limits threatening processing of potatoes, sugar beet and chicory and the costs for the sector, and about use of manufacturer's declarations and the PFAS taskforce. The minister replied that a temporary national background value and clarified guidance now allow tarra soil to be reused again, that the sector is represented in the taskforce, and that area-specific policy could speed up soil quality maps.
On 1 December 2019 I amended the temporary PFAS policy framework, clarifying the use of tarra soil and setting a temporary national background value.
Op 1 december 2019 heb ik het tijdelijk handelingskader PFAS aangepast waarin het gebruik van tarragrond is verduidelijkt en is een tijdelijke landelijke achtergrondwaarde vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over bladblazerterreur

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers about the health, noise and environmental harm of leaf blowers and whether they should be banned or phased out. The minister answered that a categorical ban is not possible under EU rules, that municipalities should decide on use, and that the national government will not intervene but will raise the topic with the VNG.
I do not consider it the task of the national government to intervene here, but I do want to bring this topic to the attention of the municipalities via the VNG.
Ik vind het niet de taak van de nationale overheid om hier in te treden, maar ik wil wel dit onderwerp bij de gemeenten via de VNG onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Paternotte over de aflevering van Zondag met Lubach «de slacht & NVWA» van 24 november 2019

D66 MPs asked the ministers about shortages of veterinary staff at the NVWA, the training and selection of large-animal vets, and whether slaughter volumes endanger food safety, following a Zondag met Lubach episode. The minister answered that the shortage raises workload but does not directly affect inspections, outlined training figures and recruitment steps, and said capacity gaps do not automatically mean food-safety risk.
The mentioned shortage of veterinarians has no direct consequences for the execution of the inspections carried out on the slaughter process.
Het genoemde tekort aan dierenartsen heeft geen directe consequenties voor de uitvoering van de keuringen die worden uitgevoerd op het slachtproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Harbers over het OPS-model

MPs Lodders and Harbers asked the ministers whether the full source code, calculation rules and data of the OPS dispersion model had been made public, and why emission data requested after a September 2019 commitment had not been shared. The minister replied that the source code was published in early November 2019 with the model data in the OPS download, that emission data were partly withheld for business confidentiality and privacy reasons, and that the RIVM released aggregated data to the plaintiffs in a court case on 7 January 2020, with further publication of changes promised.
Not all emission data are publicly available on Emissieregistratie because they contain business-confidential and/or privacy-sensitive (GDPR) information.
Niet alle emissiedata zijn openbaar op Emissieregistratie te vinden aangezien deze bedrijfsvertrouwelijke en/of privacygevoelige (AVG) informatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het gedogen van overtredingen naar aanleiding van de PAS-uitspraak

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government's plan to legalise nitrogen-permit-exempt activities after the PAS ruling means existing Nature Conservation Act violations will be tolerated indefinitely, and how this fits enforcement policy and the duty to enforce. Minister Schouten answered that enforcement is paused pending legalisation through regional approaches and assessments, that this counts as a special circumstance with concrete prospect of legalisation, and that grazing and manuring are handled separately.
Until then, the national government and provinces, in their role as competent authority, will not actively enforce against these notifications.
Tot die tijd zullen Rijk en provincies in haar rol als bevoegd gezag niet actief handhaven op deze meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over de groene BOA’s

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Agriculture about the position of green enforcement officers (BOA's), including their numbers, violence against them, training, cooperation with police and radio equipment. The minister answered that numbers are not separately registered, violence is a matter for employers and is recorded irregularly, and that the government is working on a plan of action, with progress reports promised for early 2020.
There is no nationally uniform picture of the number of incidents involving green BOA's.
Er is geen landelijk uniform beeld van het aantal incidenten waar groene BOA's bij betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht in ‘Nieuwe Oogst’ dat leeftijd stal obstakel is in de regeling voor warme sanering

MP Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the five-year production requirement in the pig-farm sanitation subsidy applies to the age of the location or to individual buildings, and whether RVO's stricter reading was correct. The Minister answered that the requirement applies to the whole production capacity, that younger stables can count if continuously used for pigs, and that RVO has since adopted this more flexible reading, while demolition of the whole location remains required.
RVO.nl had indeed previously communicated the five-year requirement such that a stable younger than five years did not count in calculating the subsidy amount, in consultation with the department.

Eerder communiceerde RVO.nl inderdaad de vijf-jaar-eis zo dat een stal van jonger dan vijf jaar niet meetelde bij de berekening van de hoogte van het subsidiebedrag, dit in overleg met het departement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het kennelijk uitblijven van bestuurlijk overleg met de convenantpartners over het onverdoofd slachten

An MP asks why a promised consultation with convenant partners on unstunned ritual slaughter, announced in February 2018, had not taken place, and why the convenant's agreed limits on animal numbers and separate sales channels remain unimplemented. The minister says the consultation was held on 28 November 2019, that the partners will supply information in Q1 2020, and that no slaughterhouses have reduced supervision frequency.

With a view to elaborating the system referred to in article 3 of the addendum, the convenant partners will supply in the first quarter of 2020 the information needed to determine the actual demand of religious communities in the Netherlands for meat from unstunned ritually slaughtered animals.

Met het oog op de uitwerking van het stelsel, bedoeld in artikel 3 van het addendum, zullen de convenantpartners in het eerste kwartaal van 2020 de informatie aanleveren om te bepalen wat de daadwerkelijke behoefte van de in Nederland aanwezige religieuze gemeenschappen is aan vlees van onbedwelmd ritueel geslachte dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitrol van 5G

Van Raan (PvdD) asked the government about approval steps, rollout timelines, antenna numbers, tree removal, health and environmental research, cumulative exposure and EMF norms for 5G. The government answered that spectrum auctions run from 2020, that private operators decide rollout locations, that research has found no proven harm below exposure limits, and that Agentschap Telecom will monitor compliance.
The choices they make in this regard depend on business strategy, which is commercially confidential.
De keuzes die zij hierbij maken zijn afhankelijk van de bedrijfsstrategie, die bedrijfsvertrouwelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de kritiek van NGO’s op de concept-duurzaamheids-impactanalyse van het EU-Mercosur-verdrag en de status van het akkoord

An MP asked the government about NGO criticism of the draft sustainability impact assessment of the EU-Mercosur agreement, including its timing, data gaps on Brazilian deforestation and CO2, the mixed-competence status of the deal, and animal welfare conditions. The minister answered that the draft SIA is not final, the final version is expected mid-2020, a separate impact study on Dutch agriculture will be carried out, and the government will assess the deal before the Council decides.

The cabinet will, in accordance with the Voordewind et al. motion referring to the Koopmans/Snijder-Hazelhoff motion, commission a study into the impact of the EU-Mercosur Association Agreement on the Dutch economy, in particular Dutch agriculture and horticulture.

Het kabinet zal conform de motie Voordewind c.s. waarin verwezen wordt naar de motie Koopmans/Snijder-Hazelhoff een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de impact van het EU-Mercosur Associatieverdrag op de Nederlandse economie, in het bijzonder de Nederlandse land- en tuinbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Rijkswaterstaat en Gelderland botsen over bomenkap A28’

An SP MP asks the ministers about Rijkswaterstaat's plan to fell trees along the A28 on the Veluwe and whether municipalities and the province were surprised, with questions on the scale of felling, compensation, consultation and residents' input. The minister replies that the fire-corridor felling is postponed pending consultation with the municipalities, safety region and province, that only a limited set of trees is now being removed for traffic safety, that no direct consultation with residents took place as is usual for such maintenance projects, and that Parliament will be kept informed.
I will inform your House about the progress of the consultation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de voortgang van het overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over de kosten van de gevolgen van de stikstofuitspraak

MPs Futselaar and Beckerman asked where the 500 million euro nitrogen reserve comes from, whether it is sufficient, how the 1 billion euro housing boost is divided, and what the costs for municipalities and provinces will be. The minister answered that the reserve is funded from a 2019 budget underspend, that the amount's adequacy is still unknown, that the housing boost is separate and not earmarked, and that the financial impact on local governments is not yet known, with support helpdesks and a team being set up.
At this moment it is not yet clear what the exact financial consequences of the nitrogen ruling are for municipalities and provinces.
Op dit moment is nog niet inzichtelijk wat de exacte financiële gevolgen van de stikstofuitspraak voor gemeenten en provincies zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over natura 2000 en het toevoegen van habitats

MP Von Martels (CDA) asked the agriculture and nature minister about adding nitrogen-sensitive habitats to Natura 2000 sites, asking whether this is an EU obligation, its consequences and whether the plan will be suspended. The minister answered that adding the habitats is required under the Habitats Directive, that the amendment will be suspended and reconsidered, and that talks with the European Commission are ongoing.
Yes, I am willing to do so. The 'amendment on present values' decision will be suspended and reconsidered.
Ja, hiertoe ben ik bereid. Het «wijzigingsbesluit aanwezige waarden» wordt opgeschort en heroverwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over natuurbeheer en klimaatbeleid

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about dune restoration on Terschelling (removing helm grass so dunes drift again), whether it serves species like the natterjack and rabbits, how nature management aligns with climate policy and carbon storage, and the link to the biomass roadmap. The minister answers that the measures are part of a nitrogen-reduction package under the PAS, that they protect habitats and coastal climate adaptation, that no forest is removed, and that forest carbon storage is addressed in the forest strategy and the biomass roadmap is due in early 2020.
No forest is removed in the measures on Terschelling.
Bij de maatregelen op Terschelling wordt geen bos verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over compensatie voor de gaswinning in het Waddengebied

MPs Van der Lee and Bromet asked whether the 448 million euro investment agenda for compensating gas extraction under the Wadden Sea is justified, whether the Waddenfonds has been used for natural restoration, and whether it should be used for nature and farmers' transition. The minister answered that the proposed projects were narrowed to a 6 million euro per year contribution over ten years conditional on extraction, that the Waddenfonds has spent roughly 46% on ecology since 2012, and that the fund's allocation will reach a 50/50 split by 2026.
I do not intend to spend 448 million euros and will also not charge the taxpayer.
Ik ben niet van plan 448 miljoen euro uit te geven en zal ook geen rekening bij de belastingbetaler neerleggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het beperken van ammoniak in de veehouderij via technieken

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about subsidies for ammonia-reducing techniques in livestock farming, their effectiveness and cost-efficiency, and how further reduction affects climate, animal welfare, nature and small farmers. The Minister answered that spending data is incomplete, that emissions fell substantially, and that a source-oriented approach and financial support are planned, but gave no full evaluation of effectiveness or cost-efficiency.
The required information is not available. Not all schemes have (recently) been evaluated yet.
De benodigde informatie is niet voorhanden. Nog niet alle regelingen zijn (recent) geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een eerlijke prijs voor voedsel

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether consumers should pay a fairer, environmentally priced price for meat with proceeds used to compensate low incomes and farmers, and whether cheaper vegetables and fruit would follow. The minister answered that a True Cost Accounting programme will study which instruments work, that information and awareness are emphasised over price, and that other parties will be invited to join the programme.
This summer the multi-year True Cost Accounting in Agri&Food programme started.
Deze zomer is het Meerjarenprogramma True Cost Accounting in Agri&Food van start gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat 600 miljoen euro uit het Waddenfonds is uitgegeven zonder dat de natuur erop vooruit is gegaan

MP Wassenberg asked whether the Waddenfonds spent about 600 million euro on economic projects without measurable nature gains, and asked about monitoring, evaluation and reallocating remaining funds. The ministers answered that spending is balanced roughly 50/50 between nature and economy under the 2011 agreement, that nature indicators are still negative, and rejected a separate monitoring commission and new earmarking, while noting provinces may strengthen their oversight role.
Therefore there is no question of a payout of 600 million euros to economic projects.
Er is dus geen sprake van een uitkering van € 600 miljoen aan economische projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Het Waddenfonds als grabbelton’

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about press reports that the Waddenfonds lacks independent or central government oversight of subsidies and their results, and about possible conflicts of interest. The ministers answered that there is no direct central oversight because the fund is decentralised, that they stand by its policy, and that they will consider a specific grant mechanism via SiSa accountability to improve control.
Via SiSa (single information, single audit) the provinces would then account to me annually for the spending charged to the specific grant.
Via SiSa (single information, single audit) leggen de provincies dan jaarlijks aan mij verantwoording af van de bestedingen ten laste van de specifieke uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over handhaving van wet- en regelgeving, onder andere met betrekking tot kustvissers

MP Moorlag asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about enforcement of engine-power limits for coastal fishing vessels, following reports of tolerated overpowered engines and a 2019 EU study on electric-motor manipulation. Minister Schouten answered that inspections by NVWA, ILT and RVO take place year-round, that the government takes the EU study's signals seriously and will look at improving oversight, but withheld the internal protocols and signal details on control-technical grounds.
I take the signals identified in the report seriously, and based on the recommendations I will look at how oversight can also be improved for this type of engine.
De door het rapport geconstateerde signalen neem ik serieus, en op basis van de aanbevelingen ga ik kijken hoe toezicht ook voor dit type motoren kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over hondenhandel

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether imported dogs from Eastern EU states are sick, illegally vaccinated or sold under fraudulent health certificates, and whether NVWA enforcement is adequate. The minister denies evidence of systematic non-compliance, reports 89 checks in 2018 without shortcomings, and promises a dog identification and registration reform plus 3 extra enforcement FTE in 2020.
At the NVWA, supervision and enforcement of companion animal welfare will be intensified in 2020 with 3 FTE, part of which will be deployed on dog trade.
Bij de NVWA vindt voor toezicht en handhaving op welzijn van gezelschapsdieren in 2020 een intensivering plaats met 3 fte, waarvan een deel ingezet wordt op hondenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat vermeend schone stallen net zo vervuilend als traditionele stallen zouden zijn

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether CBS research showed that low-emission stables emit more ammonia than assumed, and what public subsidies went to such stables. The minister answered that low-emission floors for dairy cattle may not work well, that luchtwassers show no new indication of poor performance, that subsidies are withheld if techniques prove ineffective, and that the CDM advice and CBS report will be sent to parliament before year end.
I will share the CDM advice with your House before the end of the year.
Ik zal het CDM-advies voor het eind van het jaar met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Onafhankelijk kennisplatform invasieve exoten in de maak'

An MP asked the minister whether she supports a single independent knowledge platform on invasive alien species, given the many scattered studies and pilots. The minister agreed invasive species are undesirable and that initiatives are valuable, but argued one broad platform is not necessarily optimal and that she will assess support requests on merit.
I consider it important that, in consultation with the various organisations, it is examined whether and how that cooperation can be further improved.
Ik vind het van belang dat er in overleg met de verschillende organisaties gekeken wordt of en hoe die samenwerking verder verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘het bericht dat de rechter het besluit tot afschot van edelherten in de Oostvaardersplassen onrechtmatig heeft verklaard’

An MP asked whether the government would act after a court ruled that Flevoland's culling of deer in the Oostvaardersplassen was unlawful, and whether the province had neglected its duty and should be placed under supervision or forcibly replaced. The minister said the province is still considering the ruling, that it is for the province to decide next steps, that the province acted carefully, and that there is no reason for indeplaatsstelling or other intervention, while promising to examine merging or redrawing nature areas with provinces without naming specific areas.

If not, why not? Answer 4, 5 and 6: Responsibility for the welfare of the large grazers was transferred in 2016 by the then State Secretary of Economic Affairs to the Provincial Executive of Flevoland.

Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 4, 5 en 6 De verantwoordelijkheid voor het welzijn van de grote grazers is in 2016 door de toenmalige Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken overgedragen aan GS van de provincie Flevoland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het in gevaar brengen van de gezondheid van dier en mens voor een truc om stikstofruimte te verkrijgen

An MP asks the agriculture minister whether placing thousands of ducks in a vacant barn in an avian-influenza hotspot, to bank nitrogen room for a wind farm, endangers animal and human health and whether such schemes will be stopped. The minister says she knows the press reports, that the farmer used capacity within his permit, that the sector roadmap on avian influenza and possible location-based measures are underway, and refers to earlier answers on preventing such constructions.
In this case, the policy line was not deviated from.
In deze casus is niet afgeweken van deze beleidslijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked about the poor condition of state-owned farmhouses leased by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, complaint channels, rent setting, inspections, repair timelines and the policy against selling these farms. Minister Ollongren answered substantively, reporting complaint figures, inspection status, a budget increase and a plan to start interdepartmental talks, while confirming the ban on selling non-strategic farms to tenants only under conditions.
In the context of the spring memorandum 2020, I will start interdepartmental consultation to free up the funds needed to carry out the maintenance work.
Ik zal in het kader van de voorjaarsnota 2020 een interdepartementaal overleg starten om de middelen vrij te maken, die nodig zijn om de onderhoudswerkzaamheden uit te kunnen voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Medewerkers onbeschermd blootgesteld aan landbouwgif'

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked about a broadcast report showing farm workers exposed to pesticides without protection, including inspection and enforcement figures, health studies, and whether the Labour Inspectorate has acted. The minister answers that the situation is unacceptable, cites NVWA inspection data for 2018, notes the Labour Inspectorate cannot establish violations from footage alone, and promises a Health Council advice on residents' health risks expected in summer 2020.
I have no information on whether the health of the workers involved in this case has been examined.
Ik heb geen informatie over het feit of de gezondheid van betrokken medewerkers in dit geval is onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Laboratoriumtest: Mogelijk kankerverwekkende minerale olieresten in babymelk van Neolac, Hero Baby en Nutrilon’

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the ministers whether test results showing possibly carcinogenic mineral oil residues in baby formula from Neolac, Hero Baby and Nutrilon warranted recall, NVWA removal from shelves, company proof of safety and statutory maximum limits. Minister Bruins answered that the NVWA is investigating and companies must trace the contamination source, that EFSA cannot yet make a solid risk assessment, that recall and shelf removal are not warranted for now, and that Dutch efforts for EU maximum limits are ongoing.
In this case there are so many uncertainties about the reliability of the method and its conclusions that an order to recall products is not appropriate.
In dit geval zijn er zoveel onzekerheden over de betrouwbaarheid van de methode en de conclusies daaruit, dat een aanwijzing om producten terug te roepen niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over hondengevechten in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers why authorities acted only now against dogfight organisers, whether penalties are too low, and whether lifetime breeding and keeping bans should apply. The government replied that local authorities set priorities, that current maximum penalties match the seriousness of the offences and courts decide sentences, and that a bill allowing immediate enforcement of keeping bans is planned.
The bill is expected to be sent to the Council of State for advice in spring 2020.
Het wetsvoorstel wordt naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2020 ter advisering aan de Raad van State verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het «Special Report on the Ocean and Cryosphere in a Changing Climate  (SROCC)» van het IPCC

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers about the IPCC special report on oceans and the cryosphere, covering glacier loss, marine heatwaves, ocean acidification, marine protected areas and fisheries. The government answered at length, mostly restating the IPCC findings and pointing to the forthcoming cabinet appraisal and international negotiations, with few concrete commitments.
A comprehensive cabinet appraisal of the IPCC report on oceans and the cryosphere has been sent to the House.
Een uitgebreide kabinetsappreciatie van het IPCC-rapport over oceanen en de cryosfeer is aan de kamer toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat vogels doof en agressief worden van vliegvelden

An MP asked the ministers whether a study showing that aircraft noise may make wild birds near airports deaf and aggressive would be incorporated into noise limits, environmental impact assessments, Schiphol growth decisions and the decision to open Lelystad Airport, and whether a new assessment was needed. The minister replied that the study is limited and does not show large-scale harm, so its results will not be used in policy or environmental impact reports, and that the Lelystad Airport environmental assessment is sufficient and will not be redone.
As indicated in the answer to questions 4 to 7, this study gives no reason to include its results in new policy or in the environmental impact reports to be drawn up.
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op de vragen 4 t/m 7 geeft dit onderzoek geen aanleiding om resultaten te betrekken bij nieuw beleid of op te stellen milieueffectrapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat er pal naast het safaripark Beekse Bergen een outdoor hardcore festival is gehouden

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked whether loud hardcore festival noise near Safaripark Beekse Bergen harmed animals and whether the Animal Welfare Act or licensing rules were breached. Minister Schouten answered that noise was mostly within licence limits, the park reported no behavioural changes, the NVWA's latest inspection predated the festival, and that municipalities and provinces hold licensing responsibility while she would not intervene.
I assume that municipalities take their responsibility in granting and enforcing permits.
Ik ga ervan uit dat gemeenten hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen bij het verstrekken en handhaven van vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Von Martels, Lodders en Bisschop over het artikel 'Grote onvrede over aanpak pootgoedfraude'

MPs from CDA, VVD and SGP asked the minister about NVWA and NAK handling of seed potato fraud (valse NAK-labels), the enforcement tools of the plant inspection services, and cooperation between the agencies. The minister answered that the NVWA acted within its powers, that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that the inspection services' fines powers are limited under current law, and that an evaluation of enforcement instruments is planned by 2021.
I will evaluate the use of the enforcement instruments currently included in this legislation and will also involve the plant inspection services and the sector.
Ik zal de inzet van de nu in deze regelgeving opgenomen handhavingsinstrumenten evalueren en daarbij ook de plantaardige keuringsdiensten en de sector betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de beelden waaruit blijkt dat circus Freiwald zich opnieuw niet aan de wet houdt en een olifant daarvan de dupe is

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about footage of a circus elephant being touched by the public in breach of its exemption conditions, and about NVWA enforcement, inspection history and the basis for the temporary exemption. The minister confirms a breach, a written warning and an unannounced re-inspection, but withholds inspection reports for privacy and says a new search for an elephant shelter in Europe will be made before the exemption expires on 30 June 2020.
These reports are not actively made public. The reason is the importance of protecting the privacy of persons involved in the inspection.
Deze rapporten worden niet actief openbaar gemaakt. Reden daarvoor is het belang van het beschermen van de privacy van personen die betrokken zijn bij de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de situatie van vissers in Zeeland

An MP asked the minister about the situation of Zeeland fishers: delays in using an oyster-farming permit pending monitoring-plan approval, the eel fishing closure and its lack of compensation, oyster borer pests, and oxygen-depleted water in the Grevelingenmeer. The minister defended the permit timeline as constructive and expected approval in time for April 2020, rejected extending the permit or compensating lost months, outlined the oyster pest plan, the EU eel regulation rationale, and planned a sluice and dam measures to address stratification.
The consultation with the oyster sector on the monitoring plan is proceeding constructively.
Het overleg met de oestersector over het monitoringsplan verloopt constructief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over uitgedeelde boetes op grond van de Meststoffenwet

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture how many fines under the Manure Act were imposed in 2017 and 2018, their total value, breakdowns by violation type and amount, the effect of mitigation policy, the cause of the rising trend, and the status of a study on economic gains from fraud. The minister answered with detailed figures, explained the rise as due to more advanced data analysis and larger criminal investigations, and said mitigation is case-specific and not fully tracked.
How many cases of mitigation and which amounts are involved is not tracked by RVO.nl in its entirety.
Om hoeveel gevallen van matiging en om welke bedragen het gaat wordt door RVO.nl niet in haar totaliteit bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de bouwers van een windmolenpark de vergunning van voormalige eendenfokkerijen misbruiken om een windmolenpark te realiseren

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether a wind park permit in Flevoland, which relied on temporarily filling duck-farming stables to use nitrogen compensation room, is lawful and should be stopped, and whether latent permit space should be scrapped. The minister answered that the province checked the permit against the rules then in force, that the stables were filled within valid permits, that the two farms' permits will be withdrawn and their intensive livestock use permanently ended, and that the government will set uniform rules by 1 December 2019 while maintaining that latent permit space does not raise emissions.
In the letter to parliament of 1 November 2019 I informed you that the cabinet and the provinces will make uniform agreements on the policy rules by 1 December 2019 at the latest.
In de Kamerbrief van 1 november 2019 (Kamerstuk 32 670, nr. 193 ) heb ik u geïnformeerd dat het kabinet en de provincies uiterlijk 1 december 2019 eenduidige afspraken maken over de beleidsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de openbaarheid van de broncode van het rekenmodel OPS

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the source code of the OPS model underlying the AERIUS nitrogen calculator had been made public despite earlier transparency pledges, and asked for full release at short notice. The minister confirmed the code was made publicly available in the week of 4 November 2019, explaining the delay was caused by many questions put to RIVM, and pointed to the GitHub repository.
In the week of 4 November 2019, the source code of the OPS model was made publicly available.
In de week van 4 november 2019 is de broncode van het OPS-model openbaar beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over ontploffingsgevaar emissiearme stalvloeren en ruimte voor alternatieve systemen

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked about explosion risk from low-emission stable floors after the Markelo incident, the delayed release of the Omgevingsdienst Twente report, and barriers for innovative systems under the RAV protocol. The government admitted the report was promised but not sent, said a new study on floor safety will be commissioned, and outlined steps to speed up approval procedures.
That was not right, because that had been promised.
Dat was niet goed, want dat was wel beloofd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over emissiearme stalvloeren

Two VVD MPs asked whether emission-reducing stable floors have been adequately tested for safety after explosions on dairy farms in Lettele and Markelo, and why earlier warnings and the Technical Advisory Pool's role were not considered. The minister acknowledges the earlier answers should have weighed a 2016 fire-academy warning, and announces a joint study with the Minister for Environment and Housing on the safety of emission-reducing floors, with results to Parliament in early 2020.

Given the remaining questions about the safety of emission-reducing floors for livestock farmers and others involved, the Minister for Environment and Housing and I will commission a study into the safety of emission-reducing floors in practical use.

Gezien de vragen die resteren over de veiligheid van emissiearme vloeren bij veehouders en andere betrokkenen zullen de Minister voor Milieu en Wonen en ik een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de veiligheid van emissiearme vloeren bij het gebruik in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘NVWA en Marktplaats laten huisdierenleed links liggen’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture why banned pet advertisements (docked animals, animals too young to be separated from their mother) remain on Marktplaats, and what the NVWA and the platform are doing about it, including warnings, keyword filtering and fees. The minister answered that such ads are hard to verify from text and photos, that inspections and removals follow reports, that Marktplaats now requires more seller fields, refers buyers to LICG, and that paid listings for dogs and cats have roughly halved ads since August 2019.
Based on an advertisement text and photos, it generally cannot be established whether there is a violation of the relevant prohibitions or not.
Op basis van een advertentietekst en foto’s is in de regel niet vast te stellen of er sprake is van een overtreding van de betreffende verboden of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat straaljagers van Defensie zonder vergunning boven het Wad vliegen

MP Wassenberg asked whether Defence jets fly over the Wadden Sea without the required nature permit, why earlier promises were not met, and whether flights should be suspended. The government answered that permit applications for military flight activities are being prepared for submission in Q1 2020, that flights at standard altitudes need no further assessment, and that suspension is not necessary.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over oefenvluchten van Defensie boven het Waddengebied zonder hiervoor via een natuurvergunning afspraken te hebben gemaakt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why military training flights over the Wadden area increased sharply without a nature permit and whether the protection of the area would be secured. The minister answered that a permit exists for helicopter low-level flying, that regular flights above minimum altitude were assessed as not requiring a permit, and that a permit application for other military flights is in preparation for early 2020.
Regular military flying activities above the regular statutory minimum altitude have been assessed and found not to require a permit.
Gewone militaire vliegactiviteiten boven de reguliere wettelijke minimumhoogte zijn getoetst en niet vergunningplichtig gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Ziengs over het bericht 'Massale muizen- en rattenplaag op komst in Nederland'

MPs Weverling and Ziengs asked the ministers about reports of a looming mouse and rat plague, criticism from the KAD that government is complacent, the planned restriction of anticoagulant rodenticides from 2023, and whether adequate alternatives and ongoing research exist. The state secretary answers that integrated pest management and prevention are central, that a RIVM exploratory study is underway with its report expected end 2019, and that alternatives remain available, while the Ctgb is planning to limit anticoagulants to certified professionals.
The cabinet wants to reduce the number of barn fires in line with the reaction agreement.
Het kabinet wil conform het reageerakkoord het aantal stalbranden verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het verband tussen landbouwgif en de ziekte van Parkinson

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether pesticide risks for Parkinson's disease are adequately assessed, whether moratoria, reporting duties, inspection checks and occupational-disease recognition should apply. The minister answered that EU approval procedures already test neurotoxicity, that the EU will be asked to strengthen procedures for neurological effects, and that a moratorium or reporting duty is unnecessary, while the inspectorate monitors risk-based and Parkinson's is not a recognised occupational disease in the Netherlands.
I support this recommendation and will ask the European Commission to take this up promptly.
Ik ondersteun deze aanbeveling en zal de Europese Commissie vragen dit voortvarend op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de mobiele slachthuizen

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that NVWA staff see mobile slaughterhouses worsening animal suffering and withholding of veterinary care, and asked for an independent evaluation. The minister answered that the ongoing pilot evaluation covers these signals, that animal welfare must not be harmed, that the food safety inspection regime still applies, and that the evaluation will be finished soon and shared with parliament.
I have no information on how many NVWA employees share the concerns.
Ik heb geen informatie over hoeveel NVWA-medewerkers de zorgen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Medewerkers NVWA: mobiel slachthuis werkt dierenleed in de hand’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that NVWA inspectors and vets are concerned a mobile slaughter unit (MDU) pilot allows animal suffering and unfit animals into the food chain, asking for national investigation, a halt to the pilot and clarification of how animals were handled. The minister answered that ante- and post-mortem inspection prevents unfit meat entering the food chain, that the pilot is lawful, that no national investigation is warranted and that the pilot will not be stopped pending its evaluation.
There is no reason based on the MDU pilot to establish a national investigation.
Er is op grond van de pilot met de MDU geen aanleiding om een landelijk onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de regeling Pelsdierhouderij slopen en ombouwen

An MP asked the minister about the status of the fur farm demolition and conversion subsidy scheme, the one-year implementation deadline, and whether other required procedures are accounted for. The minister reported ten applications, said the one-year deadline cannot be extended because it is part of EU state aid approval, and announced a planned loosening of the deadline and permit requirements.
I intend to considerably extend the implementation period and ensure that fur farmers do not already need to hold all required permits when applying.
Ik ben voornemens de uitvoeringstermijn aanzienlijk te verruimen, en ervoor te zorgen dat pelsdierhouders niet reeds bij de aanvraag hoeven te beschikken over alle benodigde vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het advies van de commissie-Remkes over de stikstofkwestie

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the German and Belgian nitrogen approaches, the costs of keeping the Dutch norm, lowering the livestock herd, the reliability of the AERIUS model and lowering motorway speed limits are justified. The minister answered that Dutch nitrogen norms cannot follow the German approach because the Council of State ruled the PAS threshold legally untenable, that AERIUS is the best available model, and that speed-limit reductions will be studied regionally.
In view of the Council of State ruling, the Dutch nitrogen norms will not be adjusted to the German example.
Gelet op de uitspraak van de Raad van State worden de normen in Nederland voor het stikstofbeleid niet aangepast aan het Duitse voorbeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht 'Concrete aanpak stikstof kan maanden duren’

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked the government about a report that a concrete nitrogen (stikstof) plan could take months, and about speed limits, livestock farms near Natura 2000 areas, natural restoration measures, the AERIUS calculator and missing permits for airports. The ministers answered that a area-based approach and a threshold for small projects will be prepared, with a package by year-end, but gave few numbers and deferred several points (speed-limit effects, farm counts, airport permits, AERIUS scope) to later dates.
The cabinet will come by the end of the year with a worked-out package on the basis of which decision-making can take place at the start of the new year.
Het kabinet komt voor het einde van het jaar met een uitgewerkt pakket op basis waarvan in het begin van het nieuwe jaar besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over “de alternatieve luchtvaartnota van Natuur & Milieu, Greenpeace en Natuur en Milieufederatie Noord-Holland, waaruit blijkt dat krimp van de luchtvaart onvermijdelijk is.”

MP Van Raan asks the government whether it endorses the claims in an alternative aviation policy paper by environmental NGOs, including that aviation must shrink, that technical measures are insufficient, and that health and noise harms and nitrogen deposition require action. The minister answers that the government pursues a broad mix of climate instruments, will assess volumes via the PlanMER, does not endorse all claims (e.g., on economic importance), and will consider the paper's ideas in the forthcoming Luchtvaartnota without committing to a shrinkage scenario.
The government's approach is primarily aimed at achieving the necessary emission reductions through this route.
De inzet van het kabinet is er primair op gericht om via deze weg de benodigde emissiereducties te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Otterloo over de stikstofproblematiek

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a new barn permitted in Heusden after a farmer went bankrupt, how such ongoing permit procedures are handled after the Council of State's PAS ruling, and whether uniform criteria apply to halting permits. The minister answered that the nature permit was final before the PAS ruling, that the building permit procedure continues, and that voluntary closure is the starting point for farms wanting to stop.
The letter of 4 October (Kamerstuk 32 670, no. 167) set out how and under which conditions permission can again be granted after the Council of State ruling.
In de Kamerbrief van 4 oktober jl. (Kamerstuk 32 670, nr. 167 ) is aangegeven op welke wijze en onder welke voorwaarden na de uitspraak van de Raad van State weer toestemming kan worden verleend
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Honingcowboys bedreigen de wilde bij in de Biesbosch’

An MP asks the minister why hundreds of unregistered beehives stand just outside the Biesbosch, threatening wild bee species, and what the government will do about it. The minister replies that no registration duty exists, that regulation is a matter for provinces, municipalities and land managers, and that the government will alert those parties and rely on knowledge development and possible self-regulation rather than new national policy.
I see no reason to formulate new government policy.
Ik zie geen aanleiding tot het formuleren van nieuw overheidsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de verbetering van de spoorlijn naar Zandvoort

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the rail upgrade to Zandvoort would proceed without the Formula 1 race, how it fits with the Council of State's PAS nitrogen ruling, whether nitrogen can be offset or an ADC-test applied, and who pays for the upgrade and nearby residents' noise concerns. The Secretary of State answered that the upgrade responds to a motion and is partly co-financed by the Rijk, that nitrogen permitting will be assessed only once a request is filed, that noise stays within existing limits, and that the Grand Prix organiser pays only event-specific costs.
Nitrogen deposition on rail mainly occurs during the construction of a project, such as from incoming freight traffic.
Stikstofdepositie komt bij spoor vooral voor bij de aanleg van een project, zoals door aanvoerend vrachtverkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Futselaar over de verkoop en levering door webwinkels van in Nederland niet erkende gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en pesticiden aan particulieren

An SP MP asked the minister whether webshops such as Bol.com and Tuinadvies.nl may sell pesticides not authorised by the Ctgb to Dutch consumers, and what enforcement and health/environment assessment would follow. The state secretary answered that such sales are not permitted, enforcement focuses on prevention and communication, supervision will be intensified in 2020 with a report promised, and EU-level cooperation exists.
For that reason I have agreed with the NVWA that supervision and enforcement of sales will be intensified in 2020.
Om die reden heb ik met de NVWA afgesproken dat in 2020 toezicht en handhaving op de verkoop worden geïntensiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over Fosfaatrechten zelfzuivelaars

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about uncertainty for self-cheesemakers under phosphate rules, including registration numbers, re-decisions on phosphate rights and treatment of new entrants. The minister explains the existing self-cheesemaker scheme remains in force until a planned switch to actual milk production, that re-decisions have been issued, and that monitoring will be expanded in future data collection.
RVO.nl does not keep a register of self-cheesemakers. I therefore cannot provide you with a current overview of self-cheesemakers at this time.
RVO.nl houdt geen register bij van zelfzuivelaars. Ik kan u derhalve op dit moment geen actueel overzicht van zelfzuivelaars overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het bericht ‘Duizenden veehouders nog in ongewis over fosfaatrechten’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about thousands of livestock farmers still uncertain about phosphate rights, including delays in objection procedures, whether a re-assessment will pause pending objections, and the status of hardship-case applications. The Minister answered that objections are being handled as quickly as possible but carefully, that a re-assessment is expected by autumn 2019, that procedural agreements exist with some farmers, and that seven hardship cases still await data, while mostly referring back to earlier answers without firm dates.
The CBb issued rulings on 16 April 2019 and 25 June 2019 on the definition of dairy cattle in the Meststoffenwet.
Het CBb heeft op 16 april 2019 en 25 juni 2019 uitspraken gedaan over de definitie van melkvee in de Meststoffenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over dode dieren die gedumpt zijn in het buitengebied van Haaren

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked the ministers about dead hares and a wild boar dumped in the Haaren countryside, possible use as prey in illegal dog betting, and rising illegal activity and enforcement gaps in rural areas. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police received no report, no examination has taken place so cause of death is unknown, dog-prey betting is not legal, and the rural enforcement action plan is still being implemented with a progress report promised for early 2020.
I have promised the House to report on the progress of the elaboration of the action plan in early 2020.
Ik heb de Kamer toegezegd begin 2020 te rapporteren over de voortgang van de uitwerking van het plan van aanpak.
Antwoord op van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de geplande kap van gezonde bomen langs de A9

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked why thousands of healthy trees must be felled along the A9 for widening and a relocated fuel station, whether this fits climate and nitrogen rules, and about fuel station lease terms. The minister confirms awareness, explains the tree removal is tied to widening and the rest-stop relocation with one-for-one compensation planned, says the fuel station is a relocation not an addition, cites a 15-year lease, and states the nitrogen (PAS) rules do not apply because no Natura 2000 area lies along the route.
It has been demonstrated that widening the A9 has no effect on nitrogen deposition in Botshol.
Aangetoond is dat de verbreding van de A9 geen invloed heeft op de stikstofdepositie in Botshol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de handel in apen naar Europese proefdiercentra door een Nederlands bedrijf

An MP asked whether a Dutch company trading macaques to European animal testing labs, including a lab in Parma, was implicated in mistreatment shown in undercover footage, and asked for trade volumes, transport welfare and wild-catch safeguards. The minister said Italian authorities should act, that the company meets EU and Dutch rules enforced by the NVWA, and declined to disclose trade volumes and origins for commercial confidentiality reasons.

Although I consider it important to be as transparent as possible on animal testing, I cannot, in line with the earlier answer, provide this information because of the protection of business and manufacturing data.

Hoewel ik het belangrijk vindt om bij dierproeven zo transparant mogelijk te zijn kan ik, in lijn met de eerdere beantwoording, deze Informatie vanwege de bescherming van bedrijfs- en fabricagegegevens niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het gebruik van biostimulanten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the unregulated market for biostimulants, including labelling, toxicity of micro-organisms such as Bacillus and Aspergillus niger, and the lack of inspection. The minister answered that the market is not monitored, the EU fertiliser regulation will bring rules by 2022, most questions were answered in substance, and the NVWA enforces against products making crop-protection claims.
Supervision of what is understood as biostimulants is currently still limited.
Het toezicht op wat onder biostimulanten wordt begrepen is op dit moment nog beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Tonnen winst: saucijsjes en gehakt onterecht verkocht als biologisch’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report that a meat processor sold conventional sausages and mince as organic, and why its director was not prosecuted. The minister confirmed the practice is unacceptable, explained that criminal prosecution was not pursued due to limited NVWA investigative capacity and priorities, and said Skal withdrew the company's organic certificate in 2017.
In practice this means that the NVWA-IOD does not have sufficient capacity to criminally investigate all suspected fraud with organic food.
In de praktijk betekent dit dat de NVWA-IOD onvoldoende capaciteit heeft om alle vermoedelijke fraude met biologisch voedsel strafrechtelijk te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over aanrijdingen met wild

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about wildlife road collisions, including under-reporting, registration gaps across provinces, and whether provinces can improve reporting. The minister replied that estimates suggest about 10,000 collisions a year, that registration is fragmented and decentralised to provinces, and that she will consult provinces on improving reporting and include collisions in the wildlife management evaluation.
I will consult with the provinces to examine how reporting of wildlife collisions can be improved.
Ik zal mij met de provincies verstaan om te bezien hoe de aanmeldingen met aangereden wild kunnen worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Rijksvastgoedbedrijf biedt 825 hectare pachtgrond aan’

MP De Groot asked whether the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) offers 825 hectares of state farmland under liberalised lease, what conditions apply on soil quality, biodiversity and climate, how compliance is supervised, and how this fits the government's policy on circular agriculture. The state secretary confirmed 42 plots are offered by open tender under liberalised leases of two to six years, with contract conditions on soil analysis and land use, private-law enforcement, and an ongoing review of allocation criteria with no firm timetable for biodiversity monitoring data.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) currently offers, via a public tender, 42 plots with a total area of 825 hectares of land.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) biedt momenteel, via een openbare inschrijving, 42 kavels aan met een totale oppervlakte van 825 hectare grond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het "Special Report on Climate Change and Land" van het IPCC

An MP asks the government about the IPCC Special Report on Climate Change and Land, including the links to diet, livestock, forest and the Schijf van Vijf. The government answers that the report shows effective strategies exist, that a full appraisal will follow in November, and that it does not draw the conclusions the MP attributes to the IPCC.
A comprehensive appraisal of the IPCC report will be sent to you in November (together with that of the forthcoming special report on Oceans and Ice).
Een uitgebreide appreciatie van het IPCC-rapport ontvangt u in november (tezamen met die van het nog te verschijnen speciale rapport over Oceanen en IJs).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de tussenevaluatie van de nota Gezonde Groei, Duurzame Oogst

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality to respond to criticism from farm organisations and Agrifacts of the PBL interim evaluation of the Gezonde Groei, Duurzame Oogst policy note, on the measurement period, the biodiversity framing, sampling representativeness, assessment method, and the 50% reduction target. The Minister answered each point, defending the PBL methodology as consistent with the Water Framework Directive and stating that the 50% target for 2018 was not met.
Yes. The PBL has since published two responses to the criticism from the Agrifacts foundation on its website.
Ja. Het PBL heeft inmiddels twee reacties op de kritiek van stichting Agrifacts gepubliceerd op zijn website.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Stichting AAP vindt 53 exoten in Nederlandse huisdierenhandel’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report by Stichting AAP finding 53 exotic mammal species offered in the Dutch pet trade, including whether the government tracks offer trends, how it enforces online sales, and what it does against illegal import of protected species. The minister said no data on offer is collected, pointed to agreements with Bol.com and Marktplaats and risk-based NVWA enforcement, described CITES and EU enforcement cooperation, and promised a draft positive list for consultation by year end.
No information is collected on the supply of animals, so this information is not known.
Er wordt geen informatie verzameld over het aanbod van dieren, dus deze informatie is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat tientallen soorten exotische dieren, waaronder apen, gewoon te koop zijn via Marktplaats en Facebook

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why exotic animals, including protected monkeys and the invasive Indian mongoose, are openly advertised on Marktplaats and Facebook, and whether enforcement is adequate and legislation is planned. The minister answered that NVWA enforces risk-based, uses a protocol and keyword list with Marktplaats, has 23 inspector fte, sees no need for extra capacity or a dedicated internet ban, and is exploring similar agreements with other platforms.
I will explore the possibilities of making such agreements with other online providers as well.
Ik ga de mogelijkheden na om dergelijke afspraken ook met andere online-aanbieders te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de stalbrand in Niawier, waarbij 42.000 kippen zijn omgekomen

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the minister about a barn fire in Niawier that killed 42,000 chickens, including whether birds escaped, the farm's permit and capacity, fire prevention, and whether the government will act on barn fire prevention. The minister said no birds escaped, that permits are a municipal matter, and that a broader action plan with added measures is being discussed, but gave no concrete legislative commitment.
How many animals the farm was permitted for is not known to me. The issuing of environmental permits falls under the responsibility of the municipality concerned.
Voor hoeveel dieren het bedrijf een vergunning had, is mij niet bekend. De afgifte van omgevingsvergunningen valt onder de bevoegdheid van de desbetreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Bosman en van Gent over het bericht ‘Afschieten honderden damherten op Haringvreter had voorkomen kunnen worden’

MPs from the VVD asked the minister whether an overpopulation of fallow deer on the Haringvreter, which has reduced breeding birds and orchids, could have been prevented by earlier culling permits and why population recovery needs several winters. The minister confirmed the permit history and damage, said several winters of culling are needed, and committed to including such cases in the review of wildlife management.
Yes, it is my intention to include practical situations such as those on the Haringvreter in the evaluation of wildlife management, as requested in the Von Martels motion.
Antwoord 9 Ja, het is mijn voornemen bij de evaluatie van het faunabeheer, zoals gevraagd in de motie-Von Martels 2 , praktijksituaties als die op de Haringvreter, mede te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Ouwehand over het evenement 'Zwientie Tikken' waarbij varkens worden getreiterd ter vermaak van de mens

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the 'Zwientie Tikken' pig-chasing event at a Dutch festival was acceptable given animal welfare and disease rules, and what would be done. The minister said the organiser is responsible for compliance, the NVWA found three violations, two of which lead to written warnings and one to a report that may lead to a fine, and that pigs were sourced from a nearby farm with privacy reasons given for not disclosing details.
The NVWA found 3 violations here, two of which will be dealt with through a written warning.
De NVWA heeft hierbij 3 overtredingen vastgesteld, twee daarvan zullen met een schriftelijke waarschuwing afgedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht “Nieuwe inzichten in effect van neonicotinoïden op nuttige insecten”

MP Bromet asked the minister whether the WUR study on neonicotinoid exposure of beneficial insects via honeydew would affect Ctgb and EFSA risk assessments, and whether the Ctgb would reassess neonicotinoids. The minister answered that honeydew exposure is not yet included in current frameworks, that the Ctgb will urge EFSA to add this route, and that a reassessment is not needed given the 2018 restriction to greenhouse use.
The Ctgb has meanwhile committed to me that, based on this publication, it will urge EFSA to include the honeydew exposure route in both assessment frameworks.
Het Ctgb heeft mij inmiddels toegezegd om op basis van deze publicatie er bij EFSA op aan te dringen om de blootstellingsroute via honingdauw op te nemen in beide beoordelingskaders
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over de eerdere beantwoording over het zogeheten gelijkberechtigingsdossier
