MPs Von Martels and Geurts (CDA) asked the government to respond to the Vereniging Gelijkberechtiging Grondbezitters' claims about state aid to nature organisations (TBOs), including whether the General Court annulment, the interest claim under the CELF ruling, and settlement options were handled correctly. The state secretary defended the earlier position, said the state intervened in support of Natuurmonumenten, argued the Commission's approval may well be reconfirmed, and declined to pursue interest recovery or concrete settlement proposals pending the court procedures.
It is for the European Commission to take a new decision, should it decide to open the formal investigation procedure.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om een nieuw besluit te nemen, mocht zij besluiten tot het openen van de formele onderzoeksprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over mijnbouwactiviteiten in het waddengebied

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the government shares concerns about mining in the Wadden Sea World Heritage area, whether UNESCO's letter signals concern, and whether a moratorium on new mining is needed. Minister Wiebes replied that strict conditions, monitoring and an independent audit committee apply, that UNESCO's letter is a standard procedural request, and that no moratorium is considered necessary.
Nederland expects to send the reply letter to UNESCO in September 2019. The Minister of LNV will inform your House about this.
Naar verwachting zal Nederland de antwoordbrief aan UNESCO in september 2019 versturen. Uw Kamer zal hierover door de Minister van LNV worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de uitverkoop van natuurgebieden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about Staatsbosbeheer's plan to sell about 379 hectares of nature land, including 10.8 hectares inside Natura 2000 areas, to fund purchases elsewhere, and how nature protection is guaranteed. The minister answers that land-use obligations in zoning plans and provincial supervision protect the sold land, that sales create larger connected nature areas, and that no change to public ownership is needed.
Future owners commit, when purchasing nature plots, to realising or maintaining the nature.
Toekomstige eigenaren verplichten zich bij de aankoop van natuurpercelen tot realisatie dan wel behoud van de natuur.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over duizenden jonge varkens en kippen die in hun stal zijn gestorven door de hitte en de afhankelijkheid van de brandweer om oververhitting van stallen te voorkomen

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the ministers about thousands of pigs and chickens dying from heat in closed stalls after ventilation failures, and about reliance on the fire brigade to cool stalls. Minister Schouten answered that the NVWA handled incidents, that the veterinarian is responsible for emergency and alarm systems, and that many questions could not be answered because the specific farms were not identified; she said the regional safety body decides on fire brigade cooling and that incident reporting will be made mandatory.
I will arrange for such incidents to always be reported to the NVWA.
Ik ga regelen dat dergelijke incidenten altijd gemeld moeten worden bij de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over de ‘bewapening van boswachters’

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked why green BOA rangers at Recreatie Noord-Holland lost their baton and pepper spray, and whether the procedure is clear enough. Minister Grapperhaus explained that the extension was granted with handcuffs only after negative advice from police and prosecutors, that the weapons decision still needs careful review, and that the procedures are clear enough, with the issue to be raised with the BOA unions.
Because the procedure regarding a possible award of these weapons is still ongoing, I refrain from further explanation of this case.
Omdat de procedure ten aanzien van een eventuele toekenning van deze geweldsmiddelen nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van een nadere toelichting op deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Deel naar Spanje verhuisde konikpaarden is ziek’

MP Wassenberg asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that Konik horses moved from the Oostvaardersplassen to a Spanish reserve are sick and thin, and about Staatsbosbeheer's contract, selection criteria, welfare monitoring and oversight of the receiving foundation. The minister answered all 21 questions, acknowledging about 20 horses in poor condition but stating that Staatsbosbeheer no longer bears formal responsibility, that welfare monitoring and disease handling are now the foundation's responsibility under Spanish law, and that no formal aftercare or independent veterinary supervision was agreed.
Although Staatsbosbeheer formally no longer bears responsibility for the animals after the transfer in March 2019, Staatsbosbeheer of course wants the horses to have a good life in Spain.
Hoewel Staatsbosbeheer na de overdracht in maart 2019 formeel geen verantwoordelijkheid meer heeft voor de dieren, wil Staatsbosbeheer natuurlijk wel dat de paarden een goed leven hebben in Spanje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over stilleggen van diertransporten tijdens de hittegolf

MP Ouwehand asked why no transport stop for livestock was announced during the July 2019 heatwave, and whether the current plan allows animals to be transported below 35 degrees with risks. The minister replied that the 35-degree limit is a voluntary agreement that will be made legally binding, that NVWA inspections focus on animal welfare rather than temperature, and that inspection capacity was roughly doubled during hot days at the cost of other inspections.
Because in a number of cases the voluntary agreements unfortunately were not complied with, I will legally establish that transports at an outside temperature above 35 degrees are not permitted
Omdat in een aantal gevallen de vrijwillige afspraken helaas niet worden nageleefd, ga ik wettelijk vastleggen dat transporten bij een buitentemperatuur boven de 35 graden niet zijn toegestaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het niet naleven van het hitteprotocol voor dierentransporten door de veehouderij

An MP asked the Minister why pig and poultry farmers kept sending animals to slaughter above the 35°C limit in the heat protocol, and why the NVWA did not intervene at Vion Boxtel despite activist footage. The minister acknowledged the footage, said the NVWA found no violations on the morning in question, reported fines and sanctions issued in the July heat period, and announced the 35°C limit will be codified in law.
As you can read in my letter, I will now legally establish this 35-degree limit for transports taking place exclusively on Dutch territory.
Zoals u in mijn brief kunt lezen ga ik deze grens van 35 graden nu wettelijk vastleggen voor transporten die uitsluitend op Nederlands grondgebied plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het gebruik van een levende haan tijdens Kallemooi

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the use of a live rooster hung for three days at 18 metres during the Kallemooi festival on Schiermonnikoog, including whether enforcement agencies checked compliance with imposed welfare measures since 2016. The minister answered that no physical inspections occurred after 2015, that the court found no animal mistreatment, that enforcement requests were received in 2019 and under review, and that the tradition will not be banned while the law is respected.
In the following years no physical inspection was carried out by the LID.
In de daarop volgende jaren heeft geen fysieke controle plaatsgevonden door de LID.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Von Martels over het handelen van de NVWA met ondeugdelijk pootgoed en opvolging van meldingen door keuringsdiensten

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture how the NVWA handled fraudulent seed potatoes and follow-up on reports from inspection bodies, including cross-border aspects with Belgium. The minister answered that an NVWA investigation is ongoing, that fields were partly ordered destroyed-free but subject to phytosanitary inspection, and that existing enforcement powers are sufficient, while committing to talks with inspection services.

I cannot provide further information at this stage, except to note that both the Dutch General Inspection Service for seed and seed potatoes (NAK) and the Belgian Federal Agency for the Safety of the Food Chain (FAVV) are involved by the NVWA in this matter.

Ik kan hierover in dit stadium geen nadere informatie verstrekken, met uitzondering van de mededeling dat zowel de Nederlandse Algemene Keuringsdienst voor zaaizaad en pootgoed van landbouwgewassen (NAK) als het Belgische Federaal Agentschap voor de Veiligheid van de Voedselketen (FAVV) hierbij door de NVWA betrokken worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Graus over het bericht dat een zeer gevaarlijke reuzenteek aangetroffen is nabij Nederland

PVV MPs Agema and Graus asked the state secretary and ministers about reports of the dangerous Hyalomma tick near the Dutch border, its Crimean-Congo virus risk, public information, monitoring and vaccines. The minister answered at length that the risk to Nederland is currently very low, that monitoring and public information are being expanded, and that a separate tick hotline is of limited added value.
Because of the recent findings in Germany, the RIVM and the CMV will expand monitoring together with partners.
Vanwege de recente bevindingen in Duitsland gaan het RIVM en het CMV met partijen de monitoring uitbreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Eikenprocessierups: waar spot jij hem?'

An MP asks the minister about the large nuisance from oak processionary caterpillars, its health risks, control methods, and whether national coordination is needed. The minister explains the causes of the increase, lists health risks and control measures, places the duty to control on oak owners with municipalities' public health role, and reports on a new national knowledge platform and website.
I attach importance to adequate information being offered in one central place about the oak processionary caterpillar and its control.
Ik hecht er belang aan dat op één centrale plek adequate informatie wordt aangeboden over de eikenprocessierups en de bestrijding daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over de aanpak van de overlast door de eikenprocessierups

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers how the government will tackle the large-scale nuisance from the oak processionary caterpillar, including whether a national approach is needed. The minister acknowledges the increased nuisance, points to a new knowledge platform and RIVM/GGD information, and states that municipalities bear a duty of care, so the response is decentralised, with the ministry providing national coordination.

At national level I also take the lead, among other things through knowledge dissemination, research that is being set up and carried out, and sharing insights on controlling the oak processionary caterpillar.

Landelijk wordt ook regie genomen door mij, onder andere via kennisverspreiding, onderzoek dat wordt opgezet en uitgevoerd en het delen van inzichten ten aanzien van de bestrijding van de eikenprocessierups.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de gevolgen van de vernietiging van het Programma Aanpak Stikstof voor biomassacentrales

An MP from PvdD asked ministers whether the Council of State's annulment of the Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) affects pending permits for biomass plants, including Nuon's plant in Diemen, and whether new nitrogen assessments are needed. Minister Schouten answered that pending permits can no longer rely on the PAS and need an appropriate assessment, that the Diemen permit did not use the PAS, and that no new nitrogen study is required.
Pending permit applications can no longer be granted under the PAS.
Lopende vergunningaanvragen kunnen niet meer via het PAS worden vergund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten–Arissen over het afschot van wilde zwijnen in het leefgebied van de wolf

An MP asked the minister about wolf-territory culling of wild boar, night-vision and silencer use by hunters, and whether the wolf's presence requires a change in culling policy and a hunting ban during the wolf pup season. The minister answered that provinces set and supervise culling permits, that no conflict exists because wolf prey species are not hunted, and that no policy change is needed for now, while promising to monitor the wolf population.
The permits issued by the provinces prescribe how and in what manner the culling of wild boar may take place. The provinces also supervise compliance with the permits.
In de door de provincies afgegeven ontheffingen is voorgeschreven hoe en op welke wijze het afschot van wilde zwijnen mag plaatsvinden. De provincies zien ook toe op naleving van de ontheffingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Malmström – Finalizing Mercosur deal is ‘priority number one’

MPs Lodders and Van Haga asked about the state of the EU-Mercosur trade negotiations, the urgency of concluding them, whether farm and chemical standards would be weakened, and what concessions on agriculture were on the table. The ministers answered that a political agreement had been reached, that EU standards will not be lowered, that the cabinet will assess the balance once consolidated texts are available, and that they would not disclose other ministers' reactions.
Once the consolidated texts become available, the cabinet can assess the balance of the advantages and disadvantages of the trade agreement for the Netherlands.
Als de geconsolideerde teksten beschikbaar komen, kan het kabinet de balans op te maken van de voor- en nadelen van het handelsakkoord voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over de uitzending van Radar over drugsdumpingen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about drug waste dumpings on private land, including whether owners should be expected to take preventive measures, whether full compensation for clean-up costs is warranted, and whether convicted dumpers could fund a victims' fund. The government answered that owners need not take preventive measures, that full compensation for direct clean-up costs for private owners will be provided through provincial schemes and structural funding, and that a victims' fund and separate co-financing arrangements are still being explored by the intergovernmental working group.
In connection with drug dumpings, citizens who have committed no offence are not obliged to take measures to prevent the dumping of drug waste, nor to clean up dumped drug waste.

In samenhang met drugsdumpingen zijn burgers die geen overtreding hebben begaan, niet verplicht om maatregelen te nemen om dumping van drugsafval tegen te gaan en ook niet om gedumpt drugsafval op te ruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Nispen over illegale drugsdumpingen

Two SP MPs asked who is responsible for cleaning up illegal drug waste after the Raad van State ruled that landowners need not pay, and asked about the status of inter-governmental talks, funding, and urgency. The Minister answered that regional and local authorities bear responsibility, that the cabinet will provide EUR 1 million per year structurally for co-financing direct clean-up costs, and that proposals for a structural co-financing scheme will come before the summer recess.

The cabinet now makes available structurally EUR 1 million per year for the period 2019 through 2024 on the budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security to (co)finance the direct costs of clean-up of drug dumping.
Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 mln. per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over de aanpak van mestfraude

MPs Lodders and Laan-Geselschap asked about the government's approach to manure fraud, including reporting channels, how reports are registered and handled, and cross-border enforcement with Belgium. Minister Schouten answered that no single body collects all reports, that reports via official channels are registered, and that 63 processes-verbaal from 2017 led to mostly convictions and some transactions, while declining to give full regional report counts for the police.
There is no body that collects all reports, including those from all other bodies.
Er is geen instantie die alle meldingen, ook van alle andere instanties, verzamelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het artikel van De Volkskrant van 25 mei jl. onder de titel ‘een aan alle kanten stinkende affaire’

MP Wassenberg asked whether SDE+ subsidies for manure digesters are really for renewable energy or mainly serve to dispose of manure surplus and sustain intensive livestock farming, and whether the subsidy should end. The minister defended the digesters as cost-effective renewable energy producers, said existing subsidies will not be ended, and noted co-digestion is no longer a separate SDE+ category from 2019.
No, I will not end the subsidies on existing manure (co-)digesters.
Nee, de subsidies op bestaande mest(co)vergisters zal ik niet beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over de voorgenomen uitbreiding van een geitenhouderij in Hurwenen

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether the expansion of a goat farm in Hurwenen from 7,000 to over 13,000 goats was acceptable, given a RIVM link to pneumonia risk, and whether the minister would impose a national expansion ban or intervene in this case. The minister replied that land-use and environmental decisions rest with municipalities and provinces, that a flawed permit application led to the permit being granted by operation of law, that follow-up health research is expected in 2021, and that no national ban is being considered.
The municipality concerned acknowledged, according to the Zembla broadcast, that the permit application was not handled properly and that errors were made.
De betreffende gemeente heeft, blijkens de uitzending van het programma Zembla, erkend dat op de vergunningaanvraag niet goed is gereageerd en dat er fouten zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de halal slacht van eenden, duiven, konijnen en herten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the Vugts slaughterhouse in Steenbergen slaughters ducks, pigeons, rabbits and deer unstunned for halal, and why these species were not in the 2018 overview of unstunned slaughter. The minister answered that only sheep and lambs were slaughtered unstunned there, while all other animals were stunned first, so they were not listed.
From the data of the NVWA it appears that only sheep and lambs were slaughtered unstunned.
Uit de gegevens van de NVWA blijkt dat er uitsluitend schapen en lammeren onbedwelmd geslacht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het aantal gehouden varkens in Nederland over fraude met dierproductierechten van varkens

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that more pigs are kept in the Netherlands than permitted, a gap between Dutch and German export figures, and whether the animal production rights enforcement system works. The minister replied that no central pig registry exists and disputed the Varkens in Nood conclusions, attributed export discrepancies to data-source issues and TRACES/I&R mismatches, and maintained that the system functions well with criminal enforcement.
I am of the opinion that the system of animal production rights functions well.
Ik ben van oordeel dat het stelsel van dierproductierechten goed functioneert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat een varkenshouder met beroepsverbod in Duitsland zijn varkensstal in Nederland gewoon uit mag breiden

An MP asks the Ministers of Agriculture and Justice how a pig farmer banned from practising in Germany can still expand his Dutch stables, and whether current enforcement tools are sufficient. The minister replies that the German ban does not apply in the Netherlands, that NVWA has inspected the farm 22 times with interventions, and that a tightened enforcement bill is planned, while the EU blacklist exploration is still in progress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de massale kap van Nederlandse bossen

An MP from FvD asked the ministers about mass deforestation in the Netherlands, the amount of wood harvested, and the use of forest biomass for energy despite KNAW and RIVM warnings. The minister said there is no overall list of forests slated for felling, that provinces are inventorying conversions under Natura 2000 and PAS, and that biomass is considered sustainable under international criteria, while promising a forest strategy with the provinces and a review of ISDE and emission standards.
No, I do not have such an overview.
Nee, ik beschik niet over zo’n overzicht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Lodders en Rutte Arno over het bericht ‘Bijkleuren van tonijn brengt risico voor de volksgezondheid met zich mee’ en de uitzending van het televisieprogramma Kassa

Two VVD MPs asked whether coloring of yellowfin tuna is banned, how it can be detected, and whether histamine risks are being controlled. The Minister of Medical Care confirmed that tuna coloring is prohibited under EU additive and food safety law, described NVWA inspections and sampling plans, and reported low histamine incident numbers.
The NVWA carries out checks on compliance with additives legislation through inspections.
De NVWA voert controles uit op de naleving van de additievenwetgeving door middel van inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het houden van dolfijnen in gevangenschap

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether keeping dolphins in captivity, especially at the Dolfinarium in Harderwijk which left the zoo association, is still justified given scientific findings and Belgium's plans to ban it, and whether the zoo licence should be re-examined. The Minister said the licence is reviewed by an inspection committee on application, that the Dolfinarium will be asked to shift its show toward education, that the NVWA will inspect in Q4, but declined to propose a national ban.
I will make concrete agreements with the Dolfinarium on adapting the show.
Ik zal met het Dolfinarium concrete afspraken maken over het aanpassen van de show.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over intimidatie van toezichthouders door de vee- en vleessector

An MP asked the ministers about the assault on an NVWA veterinary inspector at an abattoir, the abattoir's prior violations, and the safety of inspectors working alone, including incident figures and transport and market controls. The minister condemned the violence, explained the suspension and its conditions (owner absent during inspections, two-person inspections at the company's cost), and answered many questions with incident data, while stating that many incident figures are not recorded.
Unfortunately, aggression and violence against NVWA inspectors do occur more often.
Het komt helaas vaker voor dat agressie en geweld tegen NVWA-inspecteurs wordt gebruikt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht waaruit blijkt dat Nederland de wettelijke verplichting om te stoppen met overbevissing uiterlijk in 2020 bij lange na niet gaat halen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that the Netherlands will not meet its legal obligation to end overfishing by 2020, including quota levels above scientific advice and enforcement of the landing obligation. The minister largely defended current policy, said MSY goals remain the basis of Dutch positions, and committed to informing parliament about mackerel and herring negotiations within three weeks.
I will inform you within three weeks about the advice for mackerel and Atlanto-Scandian herring.
Ik zal u binnen drie weken informeren over de adviezen van makreel en Atlanto Scando haring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over de vernietiging van Hollandse uien in Hongarije

MPs Amhaouch and Geurts asked the government about Hungarian authorities destroying a Dutch onion consignment that lacked origin labelling, and whether this was lawful and avoidable. The minister answered that the missing label breached rules, that the consignment was sent to biogas digestion after a spot check, that Hungarian law permits such measures, and that talks with Hungary will be held to prevent recurrence.
I will discuss with the relevant Hungarian authorities whether agreements are possible to prevent this in the future.
Ik zal met de betreffende Hongaarse autoriteiten bespreken of afspraken mogelijk zijn om dit in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht dat de Aziatische hoornaar plotseling overal in Nederland opduikt

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports of the Asian hornet appearing across the Netherlands, its dangers, sightings, nest eradication responsibilities, and planned action. The minister answered that the hornet poses little danger to humans but harms insect pollinators, that only one verified sighting occurred this year with many false reports of the European hornet, and that eradication is likely not feasible so provinces will decide on management measures in autumn.
I have asked the NVWA and the provinces to continue combating the Asian hornet this summer.
Ik heb de NVWA en provincies gevraagd deze zomer de bestrijding van de Aziatische hoornaar voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht 'Shell wil fundamenten olieplatforms in Noordzee na gebruik laten staan'

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about Shell's plan to leave the concrete base of decommissioned North Sea platforms in place, including OSPAR rules, German objections, and the 11,000 tonnes of contaminated material remaining. The minister answered that the Netherlands has not yet taken a position, is commissioning an independent review and will submit a draft position to parliament first, while acknowledging that contaminated material would slowly enter the environment in the very long term.
I will submit this draft position to your House before adopting the final position toward the UK.
Ik zal uw Kamer dit conceptstandpunt voorleggen alvorens het definitieve standpunt richting het VK in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over een Europees beroepsverbod

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked whether foreign occupational bans can be used in Bibob integrity screening, whether stakeholders can force a Bibob check and challenge refusals in court, and whether improper animal treatment can factor into environmental permit decisions. The minister answered that foreign criminal and administrative sanctions can be considered in Bibob screening, that initiating a Bibob check is discretionary and not appealable, and that animal welfare falls outside environmental protection but criminal animal offences can ground a permit refusal.
Whether or not to apply the Bibob Act is a discretionary power of the administrative body concerned.
Het al dan niet toepassen van de Wet Bibob is een discretionaire bevoegdheid van het betreffende bestuursorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht ‘Staatsbosbeheer wil duidelijker bosbeleid van minister’

MPs Thieme and Van Kooten-Arissen asked the minister about Staatsbosbeheer's timber harvesting, nesting-bird protection during felling, net CO2 effects of forest loss, biomass burning and EU carbon-neutral treatment. The minister answered that harvesting is limited to regular management and calamities, that surveys precede felling under the code of conduct, and that biomass is treated as carbon-neutral under international rules, with a forest strategy to follow.
However, the forest strategy I am developing together with the provinces will also address forest management and the questions that arise.
Wel zal bij het maken van de bossenstrategie, die ik samen met de provincies ga ontwikkelen, ook worden ingegaan op het beheer van bossen en de vragen die daarbij spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht ‘Bonaire overspoeld met Sargassum zeewier’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the recurring sargassum seaweed influx on Bonaire, its ecological and economic damage, causes, responsibilities, clean-up means, and circular use. The minister answered that the Openbaar Lichaam (island authority) is responsible for prevention and clean-up, that the Rijk has financially supported some equipment, and that it is willing to consult the island government and STINAPA and to address sargassum in the upcoming nature policy plan.
The actions taken to bring the problem under control fall under the responsibility of the Openbaar Lichaam.
De acties die ondernomen worden om de problematiek onder controle te krijgen vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Lichaam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Inval bij veevoederbedrijf, mogelijk afvalstoffen in het voer’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a police raid on a feed company suspected of mixing waste into animal feed, whether public health was at risk, and whether the company was already known to the food authority. The Minister confirmed the raid, said health and animal risks were assessed as low so far, that the activities were halted pending a criminal investigation, and that the food authority had found irregularities in 2016 that were resolved.
Since this is an ongoing criminal investigation, no further statements can be made.
Aangezien het een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek betreft, kunnen verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Steenmarters teisteren auto’s bij Tjongerschans’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about stone marten damage to cars and other harms, and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that no national damage data exist, that particulars are responsible for prevention, that provinces can act, and that the species will not be placed on the national hunting exemption list for now.
As a result, there is no national overview of the damage and nuisance caused by stone martens.
Daardoor is er geen landelijk overzicht van de schade en de overlast die steenmarters veroorzaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over de ontheffing voor het doodschieten van onder andere de das, eekhoorn, haas, konijn, ree, wild zwijn, steenmarter, vos en 22 vogelsoorten op het terrein

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about a provincial exemption allowing the killing of protected animals (badger, hare, deer, fox and 22 bird species) at Twente Airport, and questioned oversight, the procedure, and whether the exemption should be withdrawn. The minister answered all 17 questions, largely stating that the province is the competent authority and declining to intervene, while confirming the province will withdraw the exemption at the applicant's request.
It is not for me to intervene in the considerations the provinces make when taking those decisions.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afwegingen die de provincies bij het nemen van die beslissingen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bromet over het bericht “Zware kritiek van oud-directeur Staatsbosbeheer op houtkap”

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about clear-felling by Staatsbosbeheer, the Forest Stewardship Council criteria, and the lapsed forest management code under the Nature Conservation Act. Minister Schouten denies that clear-felling is standard practice, says felling is limited to small areas except in calamities, and announces a forest strategy to be sent to parliament by year end.
I aim to send it to your House before the end of the year.
Ik streef ernaar deze voor het einde van het jaar naar uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over starre mestprocedure die leidt tot extra kosten

An MP asks the minister about the rigid manure sampling procedure for solid manure, which the MP says imposes extra costs and delays on farmers, and questions whether the rules are simple and efficient. The minister replies that the February 2019 change relaxed the notification deadline from 13:00 to 15:00 and that the independent sampling rules are necessary to combat manure fraud, while refusing to shorten processing times at the cost of sampling quality.

In my considerations I also took into account that the independent sampling organisations must be able to carry out their work carefully and independently, and that the NVWA must be able to exercise adequate supervision.

Ik heb in mijn overwegingen ook meegenomen dat de onafhankelijke monsternemende organisaties hun werk zorgvuldig en op een onafhankelijke wijze moeten kunnen uitvoeren en dat de NVWA in staat moet zijn adequaat toezicht uit te kunnen oefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Er zit mogelijk veel meer ‘bijengif’ in de vrije natuur dan gedacht, maar die ontdekking komt te laat’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a study showing the pesticide thiacloprid is far more harmful to aquatic life in simulated field conditions than in lab tests, and why the regulator did not act sooner. The minister acknowledged the findings as worrying, said the regulator considered the study too late for the reassessment, and promised to push for swift EU decision-making and inform parliament before its position vote.
Safety for humans, animals and the environment is leading for me and I will push for swift decision-making.
Veiligheid voor mens, dier en milieu zijn voor mij leidend en ik zal aandringen op snelle besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht in de Telegraaf “kleine visser zit klem”

MPs asked the government about reports that small fishers are squeezed by offshore wind farms, including access rules, fines for approaching turbines, and the progress of a Noordzee future perspective. The minister answered that the ministries share responsibility, that no record was kept of a meeting with fishers, that wind farms were opened to vessels up to 24 metres from May 2018 under conditions, and that a Noordzee agreement process and a fishing-sector perspective are underway, with evaluation in 2020.
No report was made of the meeting referred to.
Van het gesprek waarnaar wordt verwezen is geen verslag gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'De EU heeft zijn criteria afgezwakt, en dus mag het meeste landbouwgif gewoon worden gebruikt'

MP De Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report that EU criteria for endocrine-disrupting pesticides were weakened, the Dutch position in 2009 and later, the health and biodiversity risks, and whether science guides pesticide decisions. The minister rejected the claim that the criteria were weakened, outlined the Dutch negotiating position, said authorised products contain no substances disruptive under the 2009 criteria, and affirmed reliance on EFSA, ECHA and Ctgb advice.
I consider it very important that decisions on the reassessment of these substances be taken as quickly as possible, so that they are assessed on the basis of the most recent scientific insights.

Ik vind het van groot belang dat er zo snel mogelijk besluiten worden genomen over de herbeoordeling van deze stoffen, zodat deze beoordeeld zijn op basis van de meest recente wetenschappelijke inzichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de rietteelt en rietsnijders in Nederland, in het bijzonder nationaal park de Weerribben-Wieden

An MP asked about unrest among reed cutters in the Weerribben-Wieden after SNL subsidy rates were lowered, the tenancy and import problems, and the sector's future. The minister acknowledged the concerns, explained that subsidy rates are set by an independent IPO commission, and said the province is reviewing effects and that she is willing to talk with the sector and IPO.
I am happy to be willing to enter into discussion with the IPO, the Province of Overijssel and the sector about reed cultivation in the Weerribben-Wieden.
Ik ben graag bereid om met het IPO, de Provincie Overijssel en de sector in gesprek te gaan over de rietteelt in de Weerribben-Wieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Hier heeft Bram geen toekomst’

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the rising number of Dutch farmers emigrating, the reasons behind it, and regulatory burden and cost pressures in farming. The minister replied that CBS figures show at least 100 farmers emigrated in 2010–2015 and 5 in 2016, that the true number is likely higher, and that she is working on farm finances, succession support and regulatory relief while noting that exact causes are hard to establish.
Exact and reliable data on emigrating farmers (families) are not easy to establish.
Exacte en betrouwbare gegevens over emigrerende boeren(gezinnen) zijn niet eenvoudig vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten ‘Honderden producten onterecht verkocht als biologisch’ en ‘5 vragen over fouten met biologische producten’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that organic products were wrongly sold as organic, questioning SKAL's proportionality stance on violations, consumer information, sanctions, SKAL's tariff increase, its evaluation, NVWA enforcement and retail responsibility. The minister answers that proportionality applies, that SKAL is tightening its sanctions and transparency, that the evaluation remains broadly positive, and that enforcement does not distinguish organic from conventional farming.
I have asked Skal to draw up an action plan for this and to inform me about it.
Ik heb Skal gevraagd hiertoe een plan van aanpak op te stellen en mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het rapport ‘ Epilepsie bij Sint Bernards‘

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report on epilepsy in St Bernards, including whether breeding practices and the Dutch St Bernard club's approval of carriers cause animal suffering and whether enforcement of breeding rules will be applied. The minister agreed breeding carries a considerable epilepsy risk, said breeders bear primary responsibility and that rearing clubs and the Raad van Beheer will adjust breeding policy, and said the NVWA sets enforcement priorities risk-based without committing to new oversight of St Bernard breeders.
I am of the view that a breeder must do everything to prevent hereditary defects from being passed on, and this is also laid down in regulations.
Ik ben van mening dat een fokker er alles aan moet doen om te voorkomen dat erfelijke gebreken worden overgedragen en dat is ook vastgelegd in regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over de gevolgen van Braziliaans landbouwbeleid voor Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the agriculture and trade ministers about the effects of Brazil's farm policy under Bolsonaro, including deforestation, approval of 120 chemicals banned in the EU, residue controls on Brazilian imports, and the Dutch sugar beet seed derogation. The minister acknowledged concerns, said the Netherlands is raising them with Brazil and at EU level, noted that residue monitoring shows no reason for extra controls, and defended the refusal of a neonicotinoid derogation while confirming a temporary alternative pesticide exemption.
The Netherlands is intensifying dialogue with the Brazilian government on agriculture and climate, to convey our concerns on the one hand
Nederland is de dialoog met de Braziliaanse overheid op het gebied van landbouw en klimaat aan het intensiveren, om aan de ene kant onze zorgen over te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de zeehondenjacht in Canada

An MP asked whether the minister knows Canada's commercial seal hunt starts today and whether the government will urge Canada to end it and lobby the Canadian ambassador and subsidies. The minister confirmed the hunt starts, said the Canadian government knows the Dutch position and that EU import of seal products has long been banned, saw no need to contact the ambassador, and stated the commercial hunt is not subsidised by Canada.
I see no need to personally inform the Canadian government or the Canadian ambassador of the Dutch position.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om de Canadese overheid of de Canadese ambassadeur van het Nederlandse standpunt persoonlijk op de hoogte te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Familie in rouw na drama in stal: dertien koeien komen om in eigen mest na explosie’

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked the minister about a barn explosion in Markelo that killed thirteen cows, whether investigations were ordered, and whether emission-free floors and new stall systems are assessed for safety. The minister answered that no direct ignition cause was found by the fire service and insurer, that an Omgevingsdienst Twente investigation is pending and will be shared, and that safety is part of stall assessment though no evidence shows emission-free floors are unsafe.
The investigation by the Omgevingsdienst Twente is expected to become publicly available. I will send this to you as soon as it is completed.
Het onderzoek van de Omgevingsdienst Twente zal naar verwachting openbaar beschikbaar komen. Dit zal ik u toezenden zodra dit gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de falende aanpak van hondengevechten

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers why dog fighting enforcement fails, citing a report on criminal networks and high-risk dog trade, and asked about prosecutions, sentences, cooperation between enforcement bodies and policy changes. The minister answered that an ongoing investigation prevents disclosure of details, that no data on earlier cases is available, outlined existing penalties and enforcement frameworks, and pointed to pending legislation and measures without committing to new policy changes.
Since this concerns an ongoing investigation, no further statements can be made.
Aangezien dit een lopend onderzoek betreft, kunnen er geen verdere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘windmolens medeoorzaak insectensterfte’

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that wind turbines contribute to insect deaths, citing a German DLR study, and asked about insect considerations in permitting and monitoring of renewable energy. The minister said the German estimate is small relative to total insect numbers according to Dutch experts, that insects are not considered in wind permitting under the Nature Conservation Act, and that the effects of solar parks and renewable energy on insects will be explored.
In permitting wind farms under the Nature Conservation Act, insects are not taken into account.
In de vergunningverlening voor windmolenparken op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming wordt geen rekening gehouden met insecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Brussel wil vegaschnitzel verbieden'

An MP from D66 asked the government whether EU proposals to restrict meat and dairy names for plant-based substitutes were justified, what the Dutch position is, and whether consumers are misled. The minister answered that the amendments are only committee proposals, that labelling must not mislead, that no Dutch research on consumer deception exists, and that a clarifying policy line will be published before summer 2019.
The line I intend to follow regarding the labelling of vegetarian products will be further clarified before summer 2019 and published on the NVWA website.
De lijn die ik ten aanzien van de etikettering van vegetarische producten wil volgen, zal vóór de zomer 2019 nader worden geduid en worden gepubliceerd op de website van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Olievlek drijft richting Waddeneilanden’

An MP asked ministers whether an oil slick drifting toward the Wadden islands, its cause, the response by authorities, and whether further protection of North Sea and Wadden nature was needed. The minister said the slick was not from offshore installations, described the Coast Guard and Rijkswaterstaat response, and pointed to existing directives and an upcoming North Sea agreement without committing to new measures.
The source of the oil pollution is so far not known.
De bron van de olieverontreiniging is vooralsnog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een nieuw onderzoek naar de impact van de ongekende veranderingen rond de Noordpool

MP Van Raan (PvdD) asked ministers about media reports on a new study of rapid Arctic change, including claims of a tipping point, sea-ice and ice-sheet loss, and whether Dutch climate policy has enough margin for setbacks toward the 1.5°C goal. The minister acknowledged the study's concerning picture and the need for ambitious climate policy, while stating the 49% 2030 target stands and that policy can be adjusted as new insights emerge.
Dutch climate policy aims for a 49% reduction in 2030 compared with 1990.
Het Nederlandse klimaatbeleid is gericht op een reductie van 49% in 2030 ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Koeien verdrinken onder emissieloze stalvloer’

Madlener (PVV) asked whether the minister knows of reports that cows drowned under an emission-free barn floor, whether a national inventory of such incidents will be done, and whether the inherent risks of this floor type are being studied. The minister confirms awareness, says an inventory is being carried out with the dairy sector after the Markelo incident, and states that fire brigade and insurer report no evidence that low-emission floors are more dangerous, so no further safety study is planned.
Following the incident in Markelo, I am carrying out an inventory together with the dairy sector.
Naar aanleiding van het incident in Markelo voer ik samen met de melkveesector een inventarisatie uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen en Wassenberg over bomenkap in Nederland

MPs Van Kooten-Arissen and Wassenberg asked the minister about large-scale tree felling in the Netherlands, its scale compared with Brazil, its biodiversity impact, and whether felled Natura 2000 trees must be replanted. The minister confirmed high felling rates, said biomass is mostly a by-product rather than a main driver, did not claim a general biodiversity conclusion, and promised a forest strategy and further investigation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht op AnimalsToday.nl over het voornemen van een dierenverhuurbedrijf om een dierentuin te beginnen

MP Futselaar asked the minister about an animal rental company with a poor record planning a zoo in Appeltern, and about licensing, enforcement, zoning and rules for animal hire. The minister replied that no application has been filed, that a poor record would be weighed in any licence assessment, that the NVWA inspects such firms, and that no further tightening of the rules is currently planned.
The NVWA does not separately record in its systems whether a case concerns an animal rental company.
De NVWA houdt in haar systemen niet apart bij of het gaat om een dierenverhuurbedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het voorlopig akkoord over de import van kippenvlees uit Oekraïne

MPs Stoffer and Bisschop asked whether the EU-Ukraine provisional deal raising the duty-free poultry quota from 20,000 to 70,000 tonnes would mean more Ukrainian chicken fillet on the EU market, and whether the government would push for tighter terms. The ministers answered that the Commission is still negotiating, that the government will assess the draft Council decision and the parliamentary motion before taking a final position, and that it has written to Commissioner Hogan raising concerns.
The cabinet will study the Commission's draft Council decision and on that basis take a definitive position.

Het kabinet zal het concept Raadsbesluit ten behoeve van goedkeuring met ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van de Europese Commissie bestuderen en op basis hiervan een definitief standpunt innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Europa pakt Oekraïense kippenvleesexport aan’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that the EU was tackling Ukrainian chicken meat exports, including how a quota increase from 20,000 to 70,000 tonnes fits with the removal of duties on chicken parts and whether a provisional application of the Association Agreement amendment should proceed before European Parliament consent. The minister explained that Ukrainian exporters exploited an unforeseen tariff loophole, that renegotiation is underway and requires Council and European Parliament approval, and that the government will assess the Commission's proposal and raise concerns about the quota and SPS/animal welfare implementation.
In anticipation, the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality sent a letter on 25 April 2019 to Commissioner Hogan expressing concerns about the provisional outcome of the negotiations.

Vooruitlopend hierop heeft de Minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit op 25 april 2019 een brief aan Commissaris Hogan gestuurd waarin zorgen worden geuit over de voorlopige uitkomst van de onderhandelingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de brief betreffende een algeheel verbod op het gebruik van de stroomhalsband

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the scientific basis for a total ban on electric shock collars for dogs, whether any use can be justified, and how the ban would be enforced. The minister cited recent scientific review evidence that shock collars are a serious, unavoidable welfare infringement without proven superior training results, declined to seek advice from the Animal Affairs Council, and said enforcement would fall to inspection bodies and the Public Prosecution Service.
No, I did not consider it necessary to request advice from the Animal Affairs Council, because the latest scientific insights on welfare harm from shock collars underpin my decision.

Nee, het vragen van een advies aan de Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden vond ik niet nodig omdat de laatste wetenschappelijke inzichten inzake de welzijnsaantasting van het toepassen van de stroomband mijn besluit onderbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de beelden van een paard met een brandend dekje in de Efteling

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a horse with a burning blanket galloping in an Efteling show, questioning its welfare and whether the park should be called to account. The minister said NVWA inspections found no breach of animal welfare rules, no burns or stress, and declined to actively challenge the park while continuing routine inspections.
There are many situations in which horses are used and where entertainment is involved.
Er bestaan veel situaties waarin paarden worden ingezet en waarbij sprake is van vermaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht ‘35 vissers willen lading MSC Zoe uit zee halen, maar ze mogen niet’

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked why fishing vessels were reportedly barred from helping recover containers lost from the MSC Zoe and how quickly the recovery of the remaining containers would proceed. The minister replied that fishers may assist under conditions set by the ILT for safety and that the shipping company MSC is legally responsible for recovery, with Rijkswaterstaat monitoring progress.
However, this may not be a reason for shipowner MSC to not take its own responsibilities but to shift them onto others.
Het mag echter geen reden zijn dat reder MSC haar eigen verantwoordelijkheden niet op zich neemt maar afwentelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht dat ‘de sterfte van kalfjes op 1200 boerderijen schrikbarend hoog is’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about RTL's report that calf mortality exceeds 20 percent on about 1,200 farms, whether an action plan is needed, and who supervises calf welfare. The minister confirmed the figures (1,265 farms), said enforcement lies with the NVWA, pointed to existing sector initiatives and promised further discussion with the sector and a letter in summer.
I am concerned about the figures and believe all calves deserve the best care.
Ik ben bezorgd over de cijfers en vind dat alle kalveren de beste zorg verdienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de hoge sterfte en mishandeling van kalfjes die geboren worden in de melkveehouderij

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture about high calf mortality and mistreatment in dairy farming, prompted by RTL reporting, including whether deaths are classified as stillbirths, whether calves are denied care for economic reasons, and what concrete targets exist. Minister Schouten acknowledges concern, explains monitoring and sector initiatives, disputes the 12.5% figure, and promises to set concrete targets with the sector this summer and report to parliament.
I want to give the sector room to continue the measures it has initiated.
Ik wil de sector de ruimte geven om de ingezette maatregelen verder door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over standpuntbepaling in het Europees Parlement over een hoger toegestaan restgehalte van neonicotinoïden

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the Commission's proposal to raise maximum residue limits for several pesticides, including clothianidin, and about Dutch support, the fate of Cruiser SB exemption, and residue controls. The minister answered that the Netherlands supported the proposal based on EFSA safety assessments, explained that bee protection drove the neonicotinoid restrictions, declined to give a country-specific view, and pointed to EFSA reports for residue control data.
I cannot make statements about the situations and considerations of non-EU countries.
Over de situaties en overwegingen van niet-EU landen kan ik geen uitspaken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en De Groot over kleine en middelgrote slachthuizen in Noord-Nederland

MPs Geurts (CDA) and De Groot (D66) asked the minister about small and medium slaughterhouses in the north of the Netherlands, including the handling of about 30,000 kg of condemned meat and an independent investigation into NVWA oversight. The minister answered that the 30,000 kg concerned 31 cattle in 2017, all of which were traced to Rendac for destruction, with only administrative irregularities found, and that an independent external inquiry and an internal audit of NVWA oversight are ongoing.
As I also indicated during the NVWA General Consultation of 23 April, the NVWA investigated the 30,000 kilograms.
Zoals ik ook tijdens het Algemeen Overleg NVWA van 23 april jl. heb aangegeven, heeft de NVWA onderzoek gedaan naar de 30.000 kilo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Boetes voor verstoren natuur op Waddenzee worden niet meer uitgedeeld'

MP De Groot asks whether fines for disturbing nature in the Wadden Sea have stopped, why, and whether monitoring of blackbox systems in shrimp fishing and speeding enforcement are adequate. The minister replies that enforcement continues through several bodies, that some blackbox systems still do not function properly and are being fixed, that enforcement capacity is considered sufficient, and that a Wadden Sea management authority decision and a review of disturbance enforcement will follow.
I am in consultation with the parties involved to arrive at an adequate solution.
Ik ben in overleg met de betrokken partijen om tot een adequate oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat Limburg heeft besloten wasberen te gaan schieten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about the Limburg province's plan to shoot raccoons, questioning its effectiveness, costs, population estimates and the minister's responsibility for EU invasive species policy. The minister answers that the province has chosen a two-track approach, that the minister supports removing the invasive species, and that the province makes its own choices under the decentralised nature policy, with the ministry in contact with the province.
The province of Limburg makes its own choices in how invasive alien species are combated.
De provincie Limburg maakt eigen keuzes in de wijze waarop invasieve uitheemse soorten worden bestreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht ‘Keurmerktrammelant’

An MP asked the ministers about the proliferation of food labels and certification marks in supermarkets, whether they are trustworthy, and whether government regulation or a single state-set health logo is needed. The government answered that existing rules suffice, pointed to a Milieu Centraal benchmark and campaign, and said a government-backed food-choice logo is planned by 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over een keurmerk voor voedsel

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether the government would adopt the Nutriscore food labelling system, citing a Consumentenbond survey of snacks. The Secretary of State said the government is still comparing European logos and running consumer research, will decide after summer and no later than end 2019, and gave no commitment to Nutriscore.
I expect to inform you after the summer, but no later than the end of 2019, about the outcomes of the studies and my decision on the new food choice logo.
Ik verwacht u na de zomer, maar uiterlijk eind 2019 te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken en mijn beslissing over het nieuwe voedselkeuzelogo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de tariefsverhoging van 35% door Skal Biocontrole

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about a 35% fee increase by the private inspection body Skal Biocontrole, its oversight, staffing and whether more certifiers should be accredited. The Minister confirms she approved the increase as necessary for growth in the sector, calls it likely one-off, says she is negotiating a moderate fee policy with Skal, and defends the current single-certifier system.
I did not, however, want to withhold my approval of the level of this part of the fees.
Ik heb mijn goedkeuring aan de hoogte van dit onderdeel van de tarieven echter niet willen onthouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over landbouwgif in Drenthe

Two MPs asked the ministers whether residents near lily cultivation in Drenthe should be concerned about 57 pesticides found in soil and vegetables, and whether the government would investigate health risks and cumulative effects. The minister acknowledged residents' concern, stated that all measured levels stayed below safe thresholds, and pointed to ongoing OBO exposure research and a Gezondheidsraad advisory request, without committing to new limits.
The cabinet will ask the Health Council to include this issue in its advice, as announced in the letter to the House of 10 April.
Het kabinet zal de Gezondheidsraad vragen om dit vraagstuk te betrekken in hun advies, zoals aangekondigd in de brief aan uw Kamer van 10 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een nieuw onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat het gebruik van landbouwgif kan leiden tot de ontwikkeling van ALS

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about a US study linking pesticide-related pollutants to faster ALS progression, and about the precautionary principle, the Gezondheidsraad advice, the RIVM exposure study and a promised meeting with a residents' group. The minister answers that the substances studied are EU-banned POPs, that the EU pesticide regulation allows intervention on new scientific insight, that monitoring found no exceeded limits, and that further research and meetings are planned.
Regulation (EC) 1107/2009 is based on the precautionary principle and provides the possibility to intervene where necessary on the basis of new scientific insights.
Verordening (EG) 1107/2009 gaat uit van het voorzorgsbeginsel en biedt de mogelijkheid om waar nodig in te grijpen op basis van nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Bromet over het bericht 'Mest barst van chemicaliën en dat is slecht nieuws voor de weidevogels'

MPs De Groot and Bromet asked the Minister of Agriculture about a report linking pesticide residues in manure to declining meadow bird populations, and about whether permitting rules and organic standards are strict enough. The minister confirmed the reported findings, said a causal link to meadow bird decline has not been shown, and pointed to pending EFSA-based permit reassessments and a forthcoming pesticide vision and implementation programme.
Once EFSA's risk assessment of cumulative exposure to substances via residues is ready, it will be implemented and applied by the Ctgb in the permitting policy for plant protection products.

Zodra de risicobeoordeling van EFSA van cumulatieve blootstelling van stoffen via residuen gereed is, zal deze worden geïmplementeerd en toegepast door het Ctgb in het toelatingsbeleid van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Ploumen en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Westerveld hoopt op snelle publicatie van RIVM rapport’

MPs Moorlag, Ploumen and Nijboer asked about a news report on Westerveld hoping for quick publication of a RIVM report on pesticide exposure, when it was completed, and what legal tools municipalities have to protect residents from pesticide exposure via zoning. The minister answered that the RIVM reports were sent to the House on 10 April, and that municipalities can use zoning plans and the precautionary principle to set buffer zones, with about 50 metres a commonly accepted rule of thumb, while the exposure study shows no unacceptable risk at that distance.
Yes, this is possible and is already happening.
Ja, dit kan en vindt ook al plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over de rapportage gezamenlijk meetnet gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in het gebied van het Waterschap Drents Overijsselse Delta

Two VVD MPs asked the government about pesticide exceedances at Waterschap Drents Overijsselse Delta, including permethrin and imidacloprid in consumer products, and about the overall pesticide policy approach. The minister answered that consumer use is hard to link directly to exceedances, that policy addresses both professional and non-professional use, and that the government will send further data such as the RIVM sales analysis before the summer recess.
Sales figures for biocide products for consumers are not available at the Ministry of IenW.
De verkoopcijfers van biocideproducten voor consumenten zijn niet voorhanden bij het Ministerie van IenW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het uitzetten van paling als symptoombestrijding

MP Van Kooten-Arissen asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about stocking eel as a symptom-fighting measure, including mortality, migration, funding and whether a year-round fishing ban should be imposed. The minister answered that stocking is part of the EU eel recovery plan, acknowledged uncertainty about its net effect and survival, and declined a year-round ban for now.
For a year-round fishing ban in the EU or in the Netherlands, I currently see no reason.
Voor een jaarrond vangstverbod in de EU of in Nederland zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de Daglichtkas

MPs Weverling and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked why the award-winning Daglichtkas solar-thermal greenhouse technology was excluded from SDE+ support, what consultation with the horticulture sector preceded this, and what the consequences are for innovation and the energy transition. The minister explains that the technology was removed from the solar-thermal category since 2018 because of overstimulation risk, that the sector was consulted on the definition, and that the effects are limited but he will consider it when designing SDE++ 2020.
In my preparations for designing SDE++ 2020, I will take the application of solar thermal in greenhouses as a specific point of attention.
In mijn voorbereidingen voor de vormgeving van de SDE++ 2020 zal ik de toepassing van zonthermie in kassen als specifiek aandachtspunt meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over de berichten ‘Microplastics bewust in diervoeding gestopt’ en ‘ECHA proposes to restrict intentionally added microplastics’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about reports on intentionally added microplastics in animal feed and an ECHA proposal to restrict them. The minister answered that microplastics are not used in animal feed, that effects on soil and water are possible, and that restriction proposals are underway at EU level with a process of about one year.
The Netherlands considers it important that a broad look is taken at how the spread of microplastics in the environment can be curbed.
Nederland vindt het belangrijk dat breed wordt gekeken hoe de verspreiding van microplastics in het milieu kan worden teruggedrongen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Planbureau rommelt’

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the PBL environmental agency's published claims about meat, climate and nitrogen emissions were accurate, and whether policy had been based on flawed PBL data. The government answered that PBL's independence and quality are safeguarded, that the 25-40% reduction concerns agriculture-related emissions only, and that it knows of no cases where policy was based on incorrect PBL data.
In my view, the above sufficiently safeguards independence and quality now and in the future.
Het bovenstaande waarborgt in mijn ogen nu en in de toekomst voldoende de onafhankelijkheid en kwaliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL) “rommelt met de cijfers en de impact van het eten van vlees op het klimaat overdrijft”

MPs Geurts and Agnes Mulder asked about reports that the PBL overstated the climate impact of meat eating, following objections from Stichting Agri Facts, and whether the Chambers were informed of shortcomings. The minister confirmed the PBL corrected a web publication wording, rejected the claim of shortcomings and said no changes to the Klimaatakkoord calculations are needed.
Based on the objections raised by Stichting Agri Facts and the PBL's response, I have not been able to identify any shortcomings and therefore do not endorse the Foundation's claim.

Op grond van de door de Stichting Agri Facts aangedragen bezwaren en de reactie van het PBL daarop heb ik geen tekortkomingen kunnen constateren en onderschrijf ik de stelling van de Stichting dus niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Biodiversiteit is groter dan gedacht’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a claim that biodiversity is greater than thought and about PBL's methods, including its use of 1700 as a baseline, its exclusion of wet nature, and its treatment of farmers' conservation efforts. The minister rejected several premises (PBL does not treat 1700 as a qualitative baseline) and referred to PBL's independence, while acknowledging some points and offering no concrete new action.

The substantive independence of the PBL is guaranteed in the Guidelines for the Planning Bureaus, which state that ministers must refrain from giving instructions on research methods and the content of the agency's reports.
De inhoudelijke onafhankelijkheid van het PBL is gewaarborgd in de Aanwijzingen voor de Planbureaus
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over Brexit, veterinaire keurpunten en levende dieren

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the government about Brexit no-deal preparedness, the lack of veterinary inspection posts on the north bank of the Nieuwe Waterweg, and the handling of live animals and products. Minister Schouten answered that NVWA preparations are on track but disruptions are not excluded, that inspection post applications are pending with the European Commission, and that temporary alternatives such as transport to southern inspection posts are being explored.
I am awaiting the definitive response of the European Commission.
Ik ben in afwachting van de definitieve reactie van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het loket agroloket@minez.nl

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture about the Agroloket, a channel for farmers and businesses to report unnecessary regulatory burdens, including its visibility, the handling of reports and the lack of overview of cases. The minister answered that the loket has received few reports, that case handling times vary, and that the website and reporting overview were changed, but did not provide a full overview of reports and their outcomes.
With the current set-up of this portal it is not possible to include an overview of the submissions.
Bij de huidige opzet van dit loket is het niet mogelijk om een overzicht van de inzendingen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand het niet naleven van de wettelijke bepaling om de Wet dieren te evalueren

An MP asked why the Wet dieren evaluation required within five years of its 2013 entry into force had not yet been carried out and whether the minister had breached the law. The minister acknowledged the duty, attributed the timing to the phased entry into force, said the evaluation has started with a research bureau to report by year-end, and committed to informing parliament, while excluding enforcement capacity from the evaluation.
The research bureau will deliver the evaluation report by the end of the year at the latest, after which I will inform your House early next year.
Het onderzoeksbureau zal het evaluatierapport uiterlijk eind van het jaar opleveren, waarna ik uw Kamer begin volgend jaar zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Het bos is vogelvrij’

An MP asked the minister whether forest plots are being clear-felled and replanted with full soil disturbance, whether the 2010 clear-felling code remains in use unrevised despite the new Nature Conservation Act, and how clear-felling and replanting will be assured to be forestry-sound and climate-compatible. The minister acknowledged that large-scale felling sporadically occurs but is not monitored nationally, said the 2010 code is a species-protection code being updated in consultation with the sector, and committed to agreement on the update this year and to climate tools.
I expect to reach agreement with the VBNE this year on updating the current code of conduct.
Ik verwacht dit jaar tot overeenstemming komen met de VBNE over de actualisatie van de huidige gedragscode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het bericht ‘Mestoverschot berekend met verouderde cijfers’

MPs Lodders and Geurts asked whether Dutch manure policy relies on outdated excretion standards that disadvantage dairy farmers, and why they have not been updated. The minister answered that the forfaits were deliberately not revised for now to avoid exceeding the sectoral phosphate and nitrogen ceilings, with a CDM advisory opinion awaited before a decision for 1 January 2020.
As also reported earlier in the General Consultation of 13 December, I have therefore chosen not to revise the forfaits for the time being.
Zoals ook eerder gemeld in het Algemeen Overleg van 13 december jl., heb ik er daarom voor gekozen de forfaits vooralsnog niet te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de afvoer van fosfor via melk

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether phosphate excretion from dairy cattle is overstated because milk phosphorus removal is underestimated and feed losses are counted, and why CBS only used the higher milk phosphorus value from 2017. The minister confirmed the points, explained that new milk phosphorus measurements were validated by WUR and will be considered in the forthcoming update of excretion norms, and said a decision will follow by summer 2019.
Based on this advice, I will make a decision before summer 2019 on any adjustment of the standard excretion norms.
Op basis van dit advies zal ik voor de zomer van 2019 een besluit nemen over eventuele aanpassing van forfaitaire excretienormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de vermeende overschrijding van het stikstofplafond

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about whether the agreed five-year averaging method (excluding the two most extreme values) should have been applied to the 2018 nitrogen excretion figures, which show a possible exceedance of the nitrogen ceiling. The minister confirmed the averaging will apply to the final 2018 figures due in summer, declined to pre-empt them, and said that the nitrogen production is near the ceiling so measures to reduce it remain important.
Ik kan hier dan ook niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over toezicht en handhaving binnen het domein dierenwelzijn van de NVWA

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality detailed questions about NVWA inspector numbers, veterinary training, inspection capacity and reporting of animal welfare violations, including whether inspection forms are filled in and whether budget cuts reduced inspection frequencies. The Minister answers that capacity is sufficient for the main risks, that some inspection frequencies were not in fact lowered, and provides inspection counts and figures on non-transportable animal arrivals at slaughterhouses.
However, I cannot rule out that the situation described in the question sometimes occurs in practice.
Ik kan echter niet uitsluiten dat de situatie die in de vraag geschetst wordt, zich soms in de praktijk voordoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over uitbreiding van het externe onderzoek naar de gang van zaken rond de noordelijke slachthuizen en het optreden door de NVWA

MP Ouwehand asked the Minister of Agriculture why the external investigation into northern slaughterhouses and the NVWA's response is limited, whether it should cover farm supervision, the Animal Rights footage and a specific Limburg pig farm, and asked for the research questions and an answer before the AO. The Minister answered that the investigation (by 2Solve) is limited to the middle-sized cattle slaughterhouses in the north for now, that the NVWA cannot enforce on footage alone, that the Limburg farm passed re-inspections, and that results will be sent before summer; the research questions are attached.
Because of persistent signals about the northern slaughterhouses, I have decided to commission further external research into them.
Vanwege aanhoudende signalen rondom de noordelijke slachthuizen heb ik besloten hier nader extern onderzoek naar in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Geen boetes voor verstoren natuur in de Waddenzee’

An MP asked whether fines for disturbing nature in the Wadden Sea have stopped, why enforcement is difficult under the Nature Conservation Act, and about capacity of the Wadden unit and closing areas to the public. The minister confirmed no disturbance fines were issued in the past year, described enforcement difficulties and ongoing consultation, and promised to inform parliament within half a year on outcomes and a decision on a Wadden management authority.
I expect to be able to inform your House within half a year about the outcomes of the consultation.
Naar verwachting zal ik uw Kamer binnen een half jaar kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van het overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het vervangen van asbestdaken voor zonnepanelen

PvdA MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether projects like Essent's 'Dakvrienden', where an energy company funds asbestos roof removal in exchange for solar panels, should be encouraged and extended to farms and private homeowners. Minister Wiebes replied that the government supports combining asbestos removal with sustainability, will examine whether support is needed, and that such private-homeowner models are for energy companies to consider, noting solar is not profitable on every roof.
Initiatives that combine the removal of asbestos roofs with sustainability are shared as good examples within the programmatic approach, and it is being examined whether support is needed.

Initiatieven die het saneren van asbestdaken combineren met verduurzaming worden in het kader van de programmatische aanpak gedeeld als goed voorbeeld en er wordt onderzocht of ondersteuning nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Koeiengriep vastgesteld in Duitse grensstreek'

MP Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture about a reported IBR (bovine herpes, 'cow flu') outbreak on three German farms near the Dutch border and whether Dutch farms, vets and municipalities were warned. The minister answered that Germany is officially IBR-free, the risk of spread is very small, IBR is not yet notifiable in the Netherlands so the government has no communication role, and an AMvB is being prepared.
There has therefore been no communication from the government about the IBR outbreaks in Germany.
Er is vanuit de overheid dan ook geen communicatie geweest over de IBR-uitbraken in Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het nu alweer niet nakomen van de afspraken om de sterfte van bokjes in de melkgeitenhouderij terug te dringen

MP Ouwehand (PvdD) asks the Minister of Agriculture why the sector's plan to reduce kid mortality in dairy goat farming has not been reported to parliament, and why mortality figures for 2016-2017 are high and unclear. The Minister answers that the first reporting on the plan follows in spring 2019, that mortality is monitored via I&R registration and inspections, and that the sector is expected to reduce mortality without binding individual targets.
As I promised in the plenary debate on animals in livestock farming of 24 January, I will send Parliament a state-of-affairs letter on animal welfare in spring 2019.
Zoals ik in het plenair debat over dieren in de veehouderij van 24 januari jongstleden heb toegezegd, stuur ik uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2019 een stand-van-zakenbrief dierenwelzijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de stikstofdepositie bij luchthaven Lelystad
