MPs Kröger and Bromet asked about nitrogen deposition from Lelystad Airport on Natura 2000 areas, why the AERIUS study was not published, whether construction and traffic emissions were included, and whether sufficient PAS deposition space is available. The ministers answered that the detailed calculations are available on request and a reader's guide was added, that construction and road traffic were assessed with negligible or no effect on sensitive areas, and that the project fits within reserved priority-project capacity via a notification.
This approach was chosen because the information is very extensive and technical in nature.
Er is gekozen voor deze werkwijze omdat de informatie zeer omvangrijk en technisch van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het nu alweer niet nakomen van de afspraken om de sterfte van bokjes in de melkgeitenhouderij terug te dringen

An MP asked the minister why answers on kid goat mortality in dairy goat farming were delayed beyond three weeks, whether 2018 mortality figures exist, and whether farms reported quarterly data to the government. The minister said the delay was needed to coordinate with NVWA and RVO.nl, that quarterly mortality data goes to the private body Qlip rather than the government, and that 2018 figures were derived from the I&R registration system.
The action plan therefore does not oblige entrepreneurs to give the government quarterly insight into the mortality rate among lambs born on their farm.
Het plan van aanpak verplicht ondernemers dus niet om per kwartaal aan de overheid inzicht te geven over het uitvalspercentage onder lammeren die op hun bedrijf zijn geboren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat Rotterdam The Hague Airport alle vogels op de luchthaven wil en mag doden

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the province's permit allowing Rotterdam The Hague Airport to kill all wild bird species, including eggs and nests, goes beyond what is necessary, conflicts with Natura 2000 objectives, and whether the government will press the province to withdraw it and inform travellers about bird deaths. The minister replied that the province is primarily responsible for such permits, that the permit is open to objection and appeal to the administrative court, that it is not appropriate for the cabinet to judge this case, and that bird-strike control is a continuous process where killing is used only when other measures fail.
Primary responsibility for granting exemptions under the Nature Conservation Act lies with the provinces.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor het verlenen van ontheffingen in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming is bij de provincies belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de gevolgen van Lelystad Airport voor vogels

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the government had adequately studied bird strike risks around Lelystad Airport and why environmental NGOs' concerns had not been addressed. The minister rejected the critique, stated the bird research was thorough, and offered a further meeting with Vogelbescherming Nederland.
The Lelystad project within my ministry is willing to receive Vogelbescherming for an additional meeting.
Het project Lelystad binnen mijn ministerie is bereid om de Vogelbescherming te ontvangen voor een aanvullend gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de gevolgen van Lelystad Airport voor vogels

Two PvdD MPs asked whether the bird-impact research for Lelystad Airport was adequate, whether bird-scaring or killing measures are acceptable, and whether the airport decision should be suspended. The minister replied that the research (including a 2017-2018 baseline survey) shows no need for extra bird-scaring beyond the faunabeheerplan, that killing birds is a last resort, and that no defects justify suspending the decision.
No, I do not share that view. The bird research provides sufficient justification for a positive decision
Nee, die mening deel ik niet. Het vogelonderzoek geeft voldoende onderbouwing voor een positief besluit
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de impact van de luchtvaartplannen van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat op het natuurbeleid

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the agriculture and nature minister whether the aviation expansion plans of the infrastructure minister, including Lelystad Airport, affect nature policy through nitrogen deposition and bird strikes, and whether the effects on Veluwe nature have been adequately studied. The minister replied that the impacts were assessed in the MER and follow-up studies, that flight routes avoid Natura 2000 areas, and that the infrastructure minister's aviation policy falls outside her remit, so she sees no reason for further consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de schokkende beelden van een hondenshow in Eindhoven

Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the ministers about videos showing men touching dogs' genitals at a Eindhoven dog show, asking whether this is criminal, whether organisers must report it, and whether dog shows inherently harm welfare and should be restricted. Minister Schouten condemns the conduct as very inappropriate, notes a report has been filed with prosecution left to the Openbaar Ministerie, rejects a ban on dog shows arguing welfare can be safeguarded by supervision, and refers to earlier letters for enforcement plans.
Prosecution falls to the Public Prosecution Service.
Over de strafvervolging gaat het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Zware kritiek van oud-directeur Staatsbosbeheer op houtkap’

An MP asked the minister about reports that logging by Staatsbosbeheer is increasing, how this fits its policy, the Nature Conservation Act, the Gedragscode bosbeheer and FSC standards, and the costs and revenues of its forest management. The minister denied a general increase in logging, stated Staatsbosbeheer remains bound by the Nature Conservation Act and FSC, and provided financial figures while affirming that logging must not harm biodiversity.
No, it is not correct across the board that logging is increasing in the forests of Staatsbosbeheer.
Nee, over de gehele linie klopt het niet dat er toenemend wordt gekapt in de bossen van Staatsbosbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de stalbrand in Biezenmortel waarbij zeker 2500 varkens zijn omgekomen en over het lot van de varkens die de brand in hun stal hebben overleefd

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about a barn fire in Biezenmortel that killed around 2,500 pigs, the adequacy of fire-safety rules for enclosed pig barns, the removal of luchtwassers from the fire-risk discussion, and the fate of surviving pigs. The minister answers that housing systems meet legal requirements, that a fire-safety action plan is in place, that surviving pigs were sent to slaughter, and that the ban on air scrubbers was rejected because of environmental goals, though the fire-spread risk will be included in the action plan.
The progress report on the Brandveilige veestallen action plan, due before the summer recess, will report on the implementation and results of the periodic electrical inspections.

In de voortgangsrapportage over het actieplan Brandveilige veestallen, welke voor het zomerreces zal verschijnen, zal worden gerapporteerd over de uitvoering en de resultaten van de periodieke elektrakeuring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en De Groot over het bericht ‘vier jaar geëist tegen vleesfraudeur Willy Selten’

MPs Geurts and De Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture about a prosecution request in a meat-fraud case, the status of Taskforce Voedselvertrouwen action plan items on meat chain quality systems, slaughter of cows, supervision of fattening farms and preventing non-slaughter-worthy cows entering consumption. The Minister answered most questions with reference to ongoing work, promised a further report before the summer recess, and stated that the NVWA checks risk-based but does not register fattening farms separately.
I will also include this topic in the independent external investigation about which I informed you in my letter on slaughterhouses in Northern Netherlands
Dit onderwerp zal ik ook betrekken bij het onafhankelijke externe onderzoek waarover ik u heb geïnformeerd in mijn brief over slachthuizen in Noord-Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Ook afname weidevogels op biologische boerenbedrijven mogelijk gevolg van aanwezige pesticiden'

De Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture whether pesticides in manure, their combined ecological effects, and their impact on meadow birds and insects are adequately regulated and studied. Minister Schouten replied that existing authorisation rules already cover residues in manure, that no evidence yet confirms ecologically relevant pesticide levels in manure, and that she shares concern about bird and insect decline and will address pesticide dependence in a forthcoming vision document.
I am concerned about the decline of meadow birds and insects.
Ik maak mij zorgen over de afname van weidevogels en insecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'EBRD overweegt opnieuw miljoenenlening MHP'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the EBRD's proposed EUR 100 million loan to Ukrainian poultry producer MHP for acquiring a Slovenian poultry integrator raises concerns about unfair competition, state aid and lower production standards, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that the loan is not state aid, that EBRD rules require additionality, that the Netherlands abstained and objected to earlier MHP loans on environmental and animal welfare grounds, and that the EU is seeking to curb duty-free poultry imports from Ukraine through the Association Agreement.
Because it concerns an acquisition, the EBRD is bound by rules on handling market-sensitive information.
Omdat het een overname betreft is de EBRD gebonden aan regels ten aanzien van de omgang met marktgevoelige informatie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over ziekmakende giftige dampen in varkensstallen en het aanhoudende gedogen daarvan

MP Ouwehand asks the Minister of Agriculture about harmful ammonia levels in pig barns, whether the animal welfare rules have been enforced, and why no binding ceiling exists despite expert recommendations of 20 ppm. Minister Schouten replies that enforcement took place before 2018, that signal indicators were developed by WUR, that no statutory ceiling is set, and that an evaluation of the Animal Welfare Act will follow.
I have no reason to doubt the findings of the Climate Platform.
Ik heb geen reden om aan de uitkomsten van de bevindingen van het Klimaatplatform te twijfelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de bekendheid van burgers met het dierenleed dat schuilgaat achter dons

MP Ouwehand (PvdD) asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how consumers can know about animal suffering behind down after a Kassa broadcast showing live-plucking of ducks and misleading RDS labelling. Minister Schouten answers that she cannot confirm the origin of sold down, notes that retail and the industry bear responsibility through the textile convenant and that consumers can inform themselves, without committing to new action.
It is up to the retailers to instruct staff about the products they sell.
Het is aan de retail om medewerkers te instrueren over de producten die zij verkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over de concrete aanpak van bedreigingen van boeren

MPs Buitenweg and Bromet asked the Justice, Interior and Agriculture ministers how threats against farmers by violent animal activists are being tackled, including the scale, reporting and prosecution figures and the AIVD's assessment. The minister condemned the intimidation, said such threats are not separately registered, stressed reporting and existing police and prosecution responses, and did not commit to new measures.
Threats against farmers or vandalism of barns motivated by animal activism are not as such registered by the Public Prosecution Service and the police.
Bedreiging van boeren of vernieling van stallen vanuit dieren-activistische motieven, wordt niet als zodanig door het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het proces rond de Bee Guidance

MP Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture why her earlier written answers on the EU Bee guidance document process were thin, and asked about the process history, the Dutch position, leaked drafts and whether chronic toxicity testing would be relaxed. Minister Schouten answered that the Commission now proposes phased implementation with an EFSA mandate to revise contested parts within two years, that the Netherlands supports harmonised guidance and has no formal position yet, and that the drafts are working documents she will not send, while promising to inform parliament once a concrete proposal exists.
These are working documents circulated within a technical discussion. When the Commission presents a concrete proposal to the member states, I will inform your House of it.
Dit betreft werkdocumenten die binnen een technische discussie worden verspreid. Wanneer de EC een concreet voorstel aan de lidstaten voorlegt, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de week zonder vlees

An MP (Ouwehand, PvdD) asked the government about its role in the Week zonder Vlees campaign, meat-free catering at ministries, and reducing animal protein consumption in policy. The government answered that the campaign is a private initiative, that it promotes healthy and sustainable diets without ruling out meat, and that it considers mandatory meat-free catering too intrusive on personal choice.
It is primarily up to the Nationale Week Zonder Vlees foundation itself to draw the public's attention to the Week zonder Vlees.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de stichting Nationale Week Zonder Vlees zelf om het publiek te wijzen op de Week zonder Vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de biggensterfte in Nederland is toegenomen in plaats van afgenomen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that piglet mortality in the Netherlands has risen despite sector agreements, and whether voluntary agreements have failed and binding measures are needed. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to a plan of action, a piglet-vitality checklist and a planned benchmark, and committed only to report on progress in spring, without announcing new binding measures.
I will inform you in spring, as promised in the debate on Animals in Livestock Farming of 24 January, about the progress of activities aimed at better care for young animals.

Ik zal u, conform mijn toezegging in het debat Dieren in de veehouderij van 24 januari jl., in het voorjaar informeren over de voortgang van de activiteiten gericht op betere zorg voor het jonge dier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over het bericht dat via CETA er gemanipuleerd voedsel de markt op komt

SP MPs Alkaya and Futselaar asked whether gene-edited (CRISPR-Cas) apples from outside the EU can enter the European market while EU farmers are supposedly barred from using the method, and whether CETA guarantees that EU food standards are respected. The minister answers that imports must meet EU GMO and food safety rules, that the CJEU ruling applies GMO rules to new breeding techniques, that CETA does not change EU standards, and that import controls may be adapted with EU-level discussions ongoing.
All exports from Canada to the EU must comply with EU standards, including EU rules on genetic modification and food safety.
Alle export van Canada naar de EU moet voldoen aan EU-standaarden, waaronder EU-regelgeving op het terrein van genetische modificatie en voedselveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de berichten ‘Bewegingsjacht om dierziekte te voorkomen ‘veel gedoe voor weinig opbrengst’’ en ‘Omstreden jacht met bijna 80 man levert op: één dood zwijn’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a large drive hunt of wild boar in Zuid-Oost Twente and a related drive hunt in Brabant, questioning whether they fit the limited drive-hunt definition and whether the rules are proportionate. The minister answered that the Twente hunt, a count combined with four kills, fell within the definition, that the ministerial regulation would be evaluated after two years, and that the Chamber would be informed of the hunts.
I intend to evaluate the Ministerial Regulation on preventive measures against African swine fever two years after entry into force for effectiveness and proportionality.
Ik ben voornemens de Regeling preventieve maatregelen Afrikaanse varkenspest twee jaar na inwerkingtreding te evalueren op effectiviteit en proportionaliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Omstreden jacht met bijna 80 man levert op: één dood zwijn’ en over het ‘Verslag bewegingsjacht 5 januari 2019 Wildbeheereenheid Zuid-Oost Twente’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a newspaper report on a drive hunt with nearly 80 hunters in Zuid-Oost Twente, questioning whether handling a possibly infected wild boar carcass, dogs, eating and drinking, and horn-blowing complied with African swine fever hygiene rules, and whether sanctions apply. The minister answered that no African swine fever was present, the dissection and leaving remains followed the protocol, the hunt was not aimed at infected animals, no violation of hygiene or legal rules occurred, and no measures were considered.
In the drive hunt on 5 January 2019 in Zuid-Oost Twente there was no violation of hygiene or legal rules, so no measures are being considered.
Bij de bewegingsjacht op 5 januari 2019 in Zuid-Oost Twente was geen sprake van schending van hygiënische of wettelijke voorschriften, zodat geen maatregelen worden overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Von Martels over de problematische situatie in de suikerbietenteelt na het wegvallen van het gebruik van neonicotinoïden

Two MPs asked the minister about the problems facing sugar beet cultivation after the EU restrictions on neonicotinoids, including delays in consultation, the handling of the Cruiser SB exemption request, and the environmental impact of alternatives. The minister answered that the restrictions were supported for bee risks, that a temporary exemption was judged unworkable and undesirable, and that long-term issues will be addressed in a crop protection vision.
I have informed your House as soon as possible about my decision.
Ik heb uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd over mijn beslissing.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Omtzigt, Lodders, Bisschop en Van Rooijen over een keurpunt voor levend vee voor de Brexit en de extra capaciteit bij de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

MPs asked whether the minister had led a public-private effort to set up live-animal inspection posts at Dutch seaports before a no-deal Brexit, and about NVWA staffing and preparedness. The minister replied that applications were sent to the European Commission before the 15 February deadline, that exact locations are confidential, that the NVWA has hired 100 of 143 needed staff, and that service levels may have to be adjusted for about a year.
I cannot go into the precise numbers and locations because of the confidentiality of this information.
Op de precieze aantallen en locaties kan ik niet in gaan in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het afwijzen van de stof pymetrozine door de Europese Commissie

An MP asks why the Netherlands supported the EU non-renewal of the pesticide pymetrozine, whether sector consultation took place, and how IPM systems and parliamentary information will be handled. The minister answers that the Netherlands backed the Commission proposal on the basis of risk assessment (groundwater metabolites, hormone-disrupting properties), that agricultural need is not a criterion, and that the Chamber will now be informed before each SCoPAFF meeting.

To avoid uncertainty about when the Chamber is or is not informed about substances, I have chosen to inform the Chamber before every SCoPAFF meeting about all intended Dutch positions on items where decisions will be taken.

Om onduidelijkheid te voorkomen over wanneer uw Kamer wel of niet over stoffen wordt geïnformeerd, heb ik ervoor gekozen om uw Kamer voorafgaand aan elke SCoPAFF-vergadering te informeren over alle voorgenomen Nederlandse standpunten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over het bericht dat alleen een radicaal ander dieet in 2050 alle monden kan voeden

D66 MPs asked whether the EAT-Lancet report on a radically different diet for 2050 warrants changes to health and food policy, how it compares with the Preventieakkoord and the Schijf van Vijf, and how it fits agriculture and climate goals. The government replies that the report supports current healthy-eating policy, that the Schijf van Vijf broadly matches EAT-Lancet, and that it will rely on existing climate and circular-agriculture plans without new binding measures.
No, this report supports the policy on healthy nutrition, and the impetus indicated together with the National Prevention Agreement.
Nee, dit rapport ondersteunt het beleid op het gebied van gezonde voeding, en de impuls die daar mede met het Nationaal Preventieakkoord aangegeven wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Pulsmissie van Veerman strandt in Frankrijk'

An MP asks the minister about the stalled mission of the special envoy for Dutch pulse fishers, who was unable to get France to appoint a counterpart, and what steps follow. The minister says the envoy tried to engage France without success, that the reasons are unknown, and refers to a separate letter for next steps and the trilogue outcome.
From the French side, despite repeated urging, no counterpart was ever appointed.
Vanuit Franse kant is ondanks herhaaldelijk aandringen nooit een counterpart aangewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht: “Konijnenfokkers bedreigd: Ik ben bang voor een kogel door mijn raam”

MPs Lodders and Laan-Geselschap asked about threats against rabbit farmers, inspection and offence figures, and police and government protection measures. The minister condemns all threats, reports that 15 of 45 inspections found violations (none classed as serious), and says the police do not register victims by occupation, so no figures on reports or convictions are available.
The police do not register victims by their profession and therefore have no figures available on this.
De politie registreert niet specifiek op het beroep van slachtoffers en heeft hierover dan ook geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de plannen voor grootschalige zandwinning in het IJsselmeer voor de kust van Friesland

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked the ministers about the large-scale sand extraction plans in the IJsselmeer off Friesland, covering alternative sites, drinking water effects, cumulative impacts on Natura 2000, the Habitats Directive ADC test, the Commission m.e.r. advice, and consistency with provincial plans. The minister answered that the chosen Gaasterland site was the most suitable after alternatives were considered, that drinking water effects are negligible, that no significant effects on Natura 2000 are expected so no ADC test is required, and that the municipality makes the final zoning decision.
This means that an important (final) assessment is left to the municipality De Fryske Marren.
Daarmee wordt een belangrijke (finale) afweging gelaten aan de gemeente De Fryske Marren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over beperking van de geitenhouderij

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether provinces restricting goat farming, which may push farms into other provinces, call for national policy such as a national settlement ban or herd cap, given the health risks. The minister answered that eight provinces have temporary bans on new or expanded stables under the precautionary principle, that municipalities and provinces may set their own conditions, and that no national ban or cap is being considered until the cause of the elevated pneumonia risk is found, with follow-up research due in 2020.
A national settlement ban or a national maximum on the number of goats is not being considered at this time for that reason.
Een nationaal vestigingsverbod of een nationaal maximum aan het aantal geiten wordt om die reden op dit moment niet overwogen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de berichten ‘Baas Hoge Veluwe wil wolven afschieten: 'Slechts ruimte voor handjevol'’ en ‘Directeur De Hoge Veluwe wil dat afschieten van wolf mogelijk wordt’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about news reports that the Hoge Veluwe director wants wolves shot, whether Dutch landowners lobby via the European Landowners Organisation to delist the wolf, whether released wolves are realistic, and how other European countries handle wolf expansion. The minister confirmed awareness, said Dutch landowners' lobbying was not known to her (the Dutch membership is run by the Federatie Particulier Grondbezit), found no evidence of released animals, and described varied national wolf plans and compensation schemes.
I am not aware that Dutch landowners are lobbying via the European Landowners Organisation (ELO) to remove the wolf from the list of protected species.
Het is mij niet bekend dat Nederlandse landeigenaren via de European Landowners Organisation (ELO) lobbyen om de wolf van de lijst van beschermde diersoorten af te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het zogeheten gelijkberechtigingsdossier

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the state aid case concerning nature organisations (TBOs) after the General Court found the Commission should have opened a formal investigation on a complaint by VGG. The minister answered that repayment is uncertain, explained the standstill and interest questions, and said she would consider engaging an independent facilitator for a settlement.
What amount of money this would involve is unknown.
Om welk geldbedrag het hier zou gaan is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Von Martels over de bestrijding van de Japanse duizendknoop

CDA MPs asked about the spread of Asian knotweed, its damage costs, EU and national listing as an invasive species, and support for a national protocol. The minister said damage costs are not tracked, control is difficult with no single effective method, she supports a protocol and will approach parties, but declined EU listing and national designation under article 3.19 of the Nature Conservation Act.
No data are kept by the managers on the damage caused by Asian knotweed and the associated costs for residents, businesses and governments.
Er worden door de beheerders geen gegevens bijgehouden over de schade door Aziatische duizendknopen en daarmee gepaard gaande kosten voor inwoners, bedrijven en overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de terugkeer van de wolf in Nederland

MP Wassenberg asks the minister whether the return of the wolf is positive, whether reopening wolf hunting would undo protection efforts, and about lobbying by a park director, the wolf's conservation status, wolf population estimates, and Germany's possible hunting. The minister answers that hunting wolves in the Netherlands is not allowed under EU law, the wolf's conservation status varies by country, and wolf population counts rely on genetic research.
Hunting wolves is not an issue in the Netherlands.
De jacht op de wolf is in Nederland niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Schonis, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat er 277 containers overboord zijn geslagen bij de Waddeneilanden, waarvan drie met benzoylperoxide

MPs asked how the government will protect nature and environment in the Wadden Sea after 277 containers, three holding benzoylperoxide, were lost overboard, and about responsibility, liability, tracing, monitoring, cleanup coordination and a future Wadden authority. The minister replied that retrieval is the priority, that Rijkswaterstaat and the Wadden Academy are studying the effects, that the shipping company is liable and has accepted cleanup costs, that the Veiligheidsregio Fryslân coordinates cleanup, and that the role of a future Wadden authority is still being decided.
The shipping company has been held directly liable on behalf of the State and obliged by Rijkswaterstaat to clean up under the Maritime Accidents Combating Act.
De reder is namens de Staat direct aansprakelijk gesteld en door Rijkswaterstaat tot opruiming verplicht op basis van de Wet bestrijding maritieme ongevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over een werkbezoek aan de vissers Lauwersoog d.d. 6 januari 2019 en diverse berichten in de media over de overboord geslagen zeecontainers van

MPs from the VVD asked about the MSC Zoe container loss off the Wadden islands, its risks for fisheries and shipping, liability, recovery timelines, and container securing rules. The minister answered that the shipowner is held liable and must recover containers within a two-month expected timeframe, that investigations by the OM and OvV are underway, and that securing rules were tightened in 2016, but gave no exact compliance percentage.
At present no exact percentage is known of ships where cargo has been properly secured.
Op dit moment is geen exact percentage bekend van schepen waar op de juiste wijze lading vastgezet is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de verkoop van doodgeschoten herten uit de Oostvaardersplassen

MP Wassenberg asked the minister about the sale of culled deer from the Oostvaardersplassen, the NVWA's individual inspection, the feasibility of oversight given NVWA capacity, and the skill of replacement rangers. The minister answered that each deer is inspected via an approved game-processing facility, that animal welfare during culling falls outside slaughter rules and is only spot-checked by the regional body, and that replacement staff are sufficiently experienced; no Koninklijk Jachtdepartement staff were involved.
In addition, small quantities of game for the local market may be offered directly by a qualified person to the poulterer and catering trade without involvement of a game-processing facility.
Daarnaast bestaat de mogelijkheid dat kleine hoeveelheden wild voor de lokale markt door een gekwalificeerd persoon direct worden aangeboden aan poelier en horeca zonder tussenkomst van een WBI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten ‘Paardenstallen getroffen door uitbraak zeer besmettelijk griepvirus influenza’ en ‘Openheid van zaken over influenza uitbraak in Limburg’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports of an influenza outbreak among horses in Limburg, including vaccination rates, communication and differences between Dutch and international vaccination schemes. The minister answered that influenza in horses is not notifiable, so no complete picture exists, that stakeholders communicate actively, and that vaccination remains voluntary except where sport or breeding organisations require it.
A very precise picture of the occurrence of influenza in horses does not exist, since it is not a notifiable disease and there is no monitoring programme.
Een heel nauwkeurig beeld over het voorkomen van influenza bij paarden is er niet aangezien het geen aangifteplichtige ziekte is en er geen monitoringsprogramma is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Futselaar over het bericht dat een Oekraïense kippenmiljardair het meest profiteert van het associatieverdrag met Oekraïne

Two SP MPs asked whether the EU-Ukraine association agreement lets Ukrainian poultry imports undercut Dutch producers through lower standards, state aid and EU loans to MHP, and whether the agreement should be evaluated. The ministers answered that imports must meet EU health and safety rules, that the Commission monitors implementation and is closing a tariff loophole, that the state aid cannot yet be judged compatible, and that the Netherlands opposed the EBRD loans.
Periodic evaluation of association agreements is therefore necessary to keep a finger on the pulse and to be able to intervene if needed.
Periodieke evaluatie van associatieakkoorden is daarom nodig om de vinger aan de pols te houden en in te kunnen grijpen als dit nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het afzwakken van de ambitie om in 2025 wereldleider proefdiervrije innovatie te zijn

An MP asked whether the minister weakened the national ambition to be a world leader in animal-free innovation by 2025, and why this was not reported, financed, monitored or backed by evaluations. The minister denied weakening the ambition, reformulated it as being a forerunner, gave an explanation, and outlined networks and monitoring without concrete new targets or extra funds.
I shared the current formulation of the ambition with you both in my letter of 1 June to the House and in the annex 'Philosophy and working method of the Animal-Free Innovation Transition'.
Ik heb zowel in mijn brief d.d. 1 juni jl. aan de Kamer als in de bijlage «Filosofie en werkwijze Transitie Proefdiervrije Innovatie» de huidige formulering van de ambitie met u gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Regels nekken mestexport per schip’

MP Madlener asks whether the minister is aware of reports that rules hamper manure export by ship and whether she will agree with the sector to avoid extra costs and delays. The minister confirms awareness, explains that independent sampling rules were relaxed after sector consultation (notification deadline moved to 15:00 the working day before, two-hour windows, extended windows for intermediaries), and sees no reason for further consultation.
There is a relaxation of the requirements. I see no reason to conduct new consultations with the sector on this.
Er is sprake van een versoepeling van de eisen. Ik zie geen aanleiding om hierover opnieuw overleg met de sector te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ernstige misstanden op paardenmarkt in Hedel

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about video-documented animal welfare abuses at the Hedel horse market, whether they violated the Animal Welfare Act, and why enforcement by the NVWA and the municipality failed over many years. The Minister replied that no violations were found by the NVWA, defended self-regulation and the existing guidelines, said the municipality's role is being clarified with the VNG, and pointed to inspection trends and a tightened welfare protocol.
No violations of Animal Welfare Act article 1.3 paragraph 3 were found by the NVWA during these checks.
Hierbij zijn geen overtredingen van Wet dieren artikel 1.3 lid 3 vastgesteld door de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de gruwelijke wereld achter de handel in cavia’s

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about serious animal welfare abuses in the guinea pig breeding and trade shown by Kassa, including sick animals being killed, sale of ill animals and misleading advice to buyers. The minister acknowledged the abuses but stated that conclusions cannot be drawn from one trader, pointed to existing enforcement by the LID and NVWA, and declined to introduce new bans or tighter rules, while noting that a review of the Animal Act will consider killing rules.
However, no conclusions can be drawn on the basis of images from one trader.
Op basis van beelden bij één handelaar zijn echter geen conclusies te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Weverling en Von Martels over het bericht dat patenten toch mogelijk zijn op veredelde groenten en planten

MPs De Groot, Weverling and Von Martels asked whether the European Patent Office appeals board allowing patents on natural plant traits and classically bred plants undermines Dutch law, and what the government will do. The minister says the written ruling is not yet available, that the government opposes such patents and will push for a lasting EU-level solution, but has not yet decided whether treaty amendment is the right route.
I am in favour of a swift and lasting solution to this matter.
Ik ben voor een snelle en duurzame oplossing van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat Japan zich terugtrekt uit de internationale walvisvaartcommissie

The MP Wassenberg asked the government whether it shares concern about Japan's withdrawal from the International Whaling Commission, what consequences it has for relations and the trade agreement's sustainability chapter, and whether the government will raise the matter with Japan, summon its ambassador, or seek EU pressure or sanctions. The government answered that it regrets the decision, raised it with Prime Minister Abe, notes the sustainability chapter allows annual dialogue, and sees no EU sanctions basis since Japan is acting within its rights.
Japan has also indicated it will only hunt in its own territorial sea and exclusive economic zone, whereby Japan does not violate international agreements.
Japan heeft tevens aangegeven enkel nog in hun eigen Territoriale Zee en Exclusieve Economische Zone te zullen jagen, waarmee Japan geen internationale afspraken schendt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de aanpassing van de Uitvoeringsregeling en het Uitvoeringsbesluit Meststoffenwet

An MP asked the minister about the January 2019 amendments to the fertiliser implementing regulations, their consistency with circular agriculture and CO2 goals, and the treatment of liquid plant-based digestate versus compost. The minister answered that the changes implement the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme, that compost must now be non-pumpable, and that plant-based digestate will be reviewed in the upcoming EU fertiliser regulation framework.
I want to examine whether the new framework of the EU Fertiliser Regulation also offers possibilities for the Fertiliser Act.
Ik wil bezien of het nieuwe kader van de Meststoffenverordening ook mogelijkheden biedt voor de Meststoffenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen over het bericht 'Vis kan eindelijk door Haringvlietdam, maar daarachter wachten netten en fuiken'

Member De Groot (D66) asked the ministers about the research on migratory fish near the Haringvliet sluices, the monitoring of bycatch, the failed voluntary fishing-restriction proposal and its financing, and the cost of the Kier decision. Minister Schouten answered that the study measures fishing impact on migratory species, that bycatch registration exists for relevant fisheries, that the current evidence shows limited impact so extra protection seems unnecessary pending results, and that the government did not take a passive role.
Individual catch records of fishers cannot be shared with third parties under the GDPR as business (economic) data.
Individuele vangstregistraties van vissers kunnen op grond van de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming (AVG) als bedrijfs-(economische) gegevens niet met derden worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Weverling over de voorbereiding op de brexit door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

MPs Lodders and Weverling asked the minister about the NVWA's Brexit preparations, including external reviews, inspection locations, staffing, IT readiness and coordination with other inspection bodies. The minister answered that preparations are on schedule, with a worst-case plan requiring 143 FTE, ongoing recruitment and training, and some locations and IT readiness still being addressed.
The NVWA saw no reason to commission such an external study.
De NVWA zag geen aanleiding om een dergelijk extern onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over problemen bij de aanmelding voor derogatie

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about technical problems with registering for the 2019 derogation, whether affected businesses could still register after 31 January, and why fees could not be paid by automatic direct debit. The minister said the software problems were resolved, that the deadline stays at 31 January except that late applicants who show they were blocked will still be processed, and that payment by iDEAL or invoice was chosen over direct debit for security reasons.
If an entrepreneur can nevertheless demonstrate that he could not gain access and was therefore not helped in time, RVO.nl will also process his notification after 31 January.
Mocht een ondernemer desondanks kunnen aantonen dat hij geen toegang kon krijgen waardoor hij niet tijdig is geholpen, zal RVO.nl zijn melding ook na 31 januari in behandeling nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Wassenberg over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

Two PvdD MPs asked 21 questions about Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether the government accepts shared responsibility for climate policy, whether it will tighten its own climate measures and move toward plant-based catering. The government answered on behalf of the full cabinet, but the answer text available here is only a reference to an Aanhangsel and gives no substantive response.
The written questions from MPs Ouwehand and Wassenberg (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24285, have been answered by means of Appendix to the Handelingen, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Wassenberg (beiden PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24285 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over het op tijd inrichten van een keurpunt voor levende dieren voor export naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk in verband met een eventuele harde Brexit

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked whether a border inspection post for live animals imported from the UK is needed in a no-deal Brexit, whether one will be ready by 29 March 2019, and whether the government will work with business to set one up. The minister answered that no approved sea-port inspection post exists in the Netherlands or along the West European coast, that business is responsible for building one and has not yet applied, and that the government will support a solution if business takes the lead.
I am willing to work with the NVWA to facilitate business in realising a solution, if business takes the initiative to do so.
Ik ben bereid om samen met de NVWA het bedrijfsleven te faciliteren bij het realiseren van een oplossing, als het bedrijfsleven daar het initiatief daarvoor neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de zienswijze 'Dierproeven ten behoeve van de Veehouderij' van de Raad voor Dieraangelegenheden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about the Animal Affairs Council's opinion on animal experiments for livestock farming, including rejection rates, severe suffering, whether such tests should be allowed, and a phase-out plan. The Minister answers that 144 livestock project applications were reviewed since 2015 with 5 rejected, that 17 projects with potentially severe suffering were approved, that the 'no, unless' principle applies, and that a phase-out will be pursued through the Transition to Animal-Free Innovation track rather than a concrete reduction plan.
The independent administrative body Central Committee on Animal Experiments (CCD) informed me that from 2015 through April 2018, 144 project applications for livestock farming were processed.

Het Zelfstandige Bestuursorgaan Centrale Commissie Dierproeven (CCD) heeft mij geïnformeerd dat er in de periode van 2015 t/m april 2018 144 projectaanvragen ten behoeve van de veehouderij zijn behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht dat Nederlandse supermarkten fors meer zijn gaan stunten met goedkoop kippen-, varkens-, en rundvlees

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that supermarkets are increasingly offering deep discounts on chicken, pork and beef, and how this fits with animal welfare and circular farming goals. The minister said the government does not track meat promotions, that supermarkets set their own pricing, and that talks with supermarkets on sustainability and animal welfare are ongoing, including an agro-nutrimonitor at the ACM.
Supermarkets themselves decide on their pricing policy.
Supermarkten gaan zelf over hun prijsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de plannen voor grootschalige zandwinning in het IJsselmeer voor de kust van Friesland

Two GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a large-scale sand extraction plan in the IJsselmeer off Friesland, its effects on Natura 2000 nature, landscape, drinking water, restoration and whether less harmful locations were considered. The government answered that responsibilities are spread across Rijk, province, municipality and water boards, that environmental and appropriate assessments were carried out, and that no further talks with the province are planned.
In my view a careful weighing has taken place.
Naar mijn mening heeft een zorgvuldige afweging plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de verplichte rijenbemesting vanaf 2021 en de aangepaste teeltmaatregelen voor 2019 die voortvloeien uit het zesde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

An MP asked the minister whether revised cultivation measures for maize on sandy and loess soils under the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme had been adequately communicated to farmers, given a survey where 40% of growers were unaware. The minister replied that communication runs via RVO.nl, sector consultation and internet consultation, that the list of catch and follow-on crops will be published before year-end, and that further communication will be intensified.
RVO.nl has received few questions about this.
RVO.nl heeft hierover weinig vragen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel ‘Bij sterft sneller door verdelger’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a study linking bee mortality to glyphosate, whether it warrants asking EFSA to review its glyphosate opinion, and the status of a motion to restrict glyphosate use. The minister answered that the Ctgb found both studies methodologically flawed and not reliable, so no EFSA referral or new national restrictions are warranted, and that a full Ctgb reassessment is due by end 2019 after which the Chamber will be informed.
I will inform the Chamber separately about the implementation of the De Groot motion once the results of the Ctgb reassessment are available.
Ik zal uw Kamer separaat informeren over de uitvoering van de motie De Groot als de resultaten van de herbeoordeling van het Ctgb beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de mishandeling bij de slacht van verzwakte, afgedankte melkkoeien

An MP asked the minister about cruel treatment of cows at a German slaughterhouse near the Dutch border, whether Dutch cows were slaughtered there, dairy yield and vaccination practices, and NVWA oversight and enforcement at the Dutch slaughterhouse. The minister condemned the treatment shown, gave production figures, reported enforcement actions against transporters and farmers, and defended the NVWA's supervision and its approach to intimidation of inspectors.
If an NVWA inspector finds such conduct, they will take enforcement action.
Indien een toezichthouder van de NVWA dergelijk gedrag aantreft zal deze handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg inzake het gevonden leeuwenwelpje in Tienhoven

An MP asked the ministers about a lion cub found in Tienhoven, the origin of the animal, the CITES protection of lions, the positive list for mammals kept as pets, and the WHO's inclusion of traditional Chinese medicine in the ICD. The minister declined to disclose origin details citing an ongoing criminal investigation, and otherwise gave largely policy-level answers, committing to consult on the positive list in 2019 and to support CITES disposal work.
This information is part of a criminal investigation.
Deze informatie is onderdeel van strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht dat zelfzuivelaars een forfaitaire melkproductie van 7.500 kilo per koe mogen hanteren

A D66 MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether self-dairy farmers may use a flat-rate milk yield of 7,500 kg per cow for phosphate calculation, and whether this creates unfair competition and circumvents phosphate-rights rules. The Minister confirmed the flat rate applies to a limited group of about 200 self-processing farms, said the rules apply equally to all, and will monitor phosphate production without committing to changes now.
I will keep a close eye on phosphate production by self-dairy farmers.
Ik zal de vinger aan de pols houden waar het gaat om de fosfaatproductie door zelfzuivelaars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked how innovators outside livestock farming can get new ammonia-reducing stall systems onto the Rav list, and about procedures, cooperation with other countries, TAP composition and the motion on testing barriers. The government explained quick scans, a maximum 20-week assessment, VERA cooperation, and that it is mapping barriers and will inform the Chamber early next year.
I will inform the Chamber early next year about the steps I will take to remove these barriers as much as possible.
Ik zal de Kamer begin volgend jaar informeren over de stappen die ik zal zetten om deze belemmeringen zo veel mogelijk weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat krabben en kreeften maandenlang lijden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that crabs and lobsters suffer for months during capture, transport and sale, including conditions of confinement, lack of food, quarantine and food safety. The minister answered that welfare of these animals is poorly understood, that existing rules such as article 2.1 of the Animal Welfare Act apply, that no specific transport rules exist for live lobsters, and that the government sees no need to change its approach, while committing only to a further focus on species of significant importance to the Netherlands.
It therefore cannot be said whether these animals have an emotional experience.
Het is daarom niet te zeggen of deze dieren een emotionele gewaarwording hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Weer ongeluk met gevaarlijk Multiplay-springkussen’

An MP from the VVD asks the Ministers of Medical Care and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a reported accident with a Multiplay bouncy castle and about NVWA oversight of suppliers, certification bodies (AKI) and sales information. The minister answers that the NVWA sent letters to suppliers, inspected and tested certificates, withdrew the Piraat model, reviewed AKI audits and is handling further incidents, while declining some data requests and saying no additional warning labels are needed.
I cannot provide your House with the data you requested.
De door u gevraagde gegevens kan ik uw Kamer niet leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar natuurinclusieve landbouw’

An MP asked the minister about a PBL survey on nature-inclusive farming, questioning whether restricting distribution to LTO members makes the sample unrepresentative and whether non-members will be approached. The minister confirmed the study, said the questionnaire was opened to all farmers via agricultural media, but deferred on representativeness to the professionalism of researchers and the steering group.
I trust in the professionalism of the researchers and the steering group that they have designed a sound research setup.
Ik vertrouw op de professionaliteit van de onderzoekers en de klankbordgroep dat zij een goede onderzoeksopzet hebben ontworpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Het rode gevaar komt uit het westen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the American crayfish harms Dutch waters, including its effects on biodiversity, extra dredging, EU water quality targets, and whether the Fisheries Act blocks effective control. The minister answered that species-specific risks are known, that fishing exemptions and water board contacts exist, that further research is with regional partners, and that recreational use of professional gear is not desirable.
It is up to the regional parties to determine whether further research is worthwhile.
Het is aan de regionale partijen om te bepalen of verder onderzoek zinvol is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het levend ontvinnen van een haai in Caribisch gebied

MP Wassenberg asked the minister about a video showing fishermen in Curaçao finning a live shark, whether the EU ban applies there, and what steps will be taken on the shark reserve, strategy and ICCAT. The minister answered that Curaçao is a national matter, the shark reserve and Curaçao's commitment are not yet implemented, and the national shark strategy will be sent to parliament in Q1 2019 with some commitments to pursue a global finning ban.
It is not for me to address the Curaçao government on this, as it is a matter for the country.
Het is niet aan mij om de Curaçaose regering hierop aan te spreken daar het een landsaangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Duitse vissers willen verbod beroepsvisserij'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether commercial fishing near the Haringvliet sluices is compatible with Natura 2000 goals, given changes from the Kier decision. The Minister says existing permits were assessed against Natura 2000 targets, that a study on migratory fish impacts is being updated and due in Q1 2019, and that future water projects should consider fisheries from the outset.
I will inform your House of the results at that time.
Over de uitkomsten hiervan zal ik uw Kamer op dat moment informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Vis kan eindelijk door Haringvlietdam, maar daarachter wachten netten en fuiken'

An MP asked whether fishing near the Haringvliet sluices threatens fish migration investments, including how much fishers earn, compensation, and whether fishing has increased. The minister answered that fishing has actually decreased near the sluices since 2011, that migratory species are largely not targeted, and that no large-scale problem requires additional restrictions.
The precise turnover of the various fishing activities taking place near the Haringvliet sluices is unknown.
De precieze omzet van de verschillende visserijvormen die in de omgeving van de Haringvlietsluizen plaatsvinden is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Amhaouch over toename import in de EU van legbatterijeieren

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers how much egg and egg-product imports into the EU have risen, whether imported eggs meet EU animal welfare standards, and what is being done about Ukraine's laying-hen housing and chicken fillet imports. The minister replied that imports must meet EU health and labelling rules but not EU production standards, that trade agreements contain limited welfare provisions, and that Ukraine has a phased implementation plan through 2021 which the Netherlands will keep pressing.
Products imported into the EU generally do not have to meet EU production requirements, such as housing systems and animal welfare standards, unless agreements have been made with third countries.

Door de EU geïmporteerde producten hoeven in het algemeen niet te voldoen aan productie-eisen van de EU, als houderijsystemen en dierenwelzijnsstandaarden, tenzij er met derde landen afspraken over zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over barrières voor Europese trekvissen

An MP asks the ministers about barriers to European migratory fish, the costs of fish passages, and whether fishing near migration hotspots such as Kornwerderzand, Den Oever and the Haringvliet should be banned. The minister answers that barriers are necessary for water safety, freshwater supply and shipping, that fishing impacts are limited, and refers to earlier answers on the fishing questions without a concrete new commitment.
All barriers are strictly necessary because of functions such as water safety, sufficient (fresh) water and shipping.
Alle barrières zijn strikt noodzakelijk vanwege functies als waterveiligheid, voldoende (zoet) water en scheepvaart.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de berichten 'De wolf: nuttig dier of overbodige killer?', 'En de grootste schapendoder is ... misschien wel uw eigen hond' en 'Schapenhouders willen dat wolf beschermde status

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about wolves migrating from Germany, their ecological role, and whether sheep farmers' calls to remove wolves' protected status should be heeded. The minister answered that wolves remain strictly protected, that derogations are possible under provincial policy, and that the Operational Wolf Plan phase 2 decision is still pending.
Since 2014 the wolf has been designated as a protected native species.
Sinds 2014 is de wolf aangewezen als beschermde inheemse diersoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over het bericht ‘Ecologen: zonneparken zijn funest voor de natuur’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether they share experts' concern that large solar parks harm nature and soil life, and about rooftop priority, land competition, the number of solar parks under construction, the government's role, and innovative placement such as noise barriers. The ministers answered that ecological effects depend on site and design, that spatial planning is primarily a responsibility of municipalities and provinces, that rooftops should be prioritised per the draft NOVI, and that they will inform parliament in early 2019 on a national assessment framework.
I will inform you early in 2019 about the implementation of this motion and also involve it in drafting the draft NOVI.
Ik zal u begin 2019 informeren over de uitvoering van deze motie en deze ook betrekken bij het opstellen van de ontwerpNOVI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht dat een hogere productie per koe goed voor economie, milieu en klimaat zou zijn

MP De Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture about a tweet by the chair of the Topsector Agri&Food praising higher milk output per cow as good for the economy and climate, and whether this conflicts with the minister's circular agriculture vision. The minister confirmed the tweet, said it does not give a full picture of the sector's broader agenda, and pointed to the Kennis- en Innovatieagenda and missions framework as consistent with the vision, without committing to new action.
These statements by Mr Dijkhuizen do not give a complete picture in light of the broader agenda of the Topsector Agri&Food.
Deze uitingen van de heer Dijkhuizen geven geen volledig beeld in het licht van de bredere agenda van de Topsector Agri&Food.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de misstanden op de World Dog Show 2018

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about welfare abuses and sick, deformed dogs winning prizes at the World Dog Show 2018, including the lack of independent vet checks, weak kennel-club welfare enforcement, and whether shows should be banned. The Minister acknowledged the problems, promised to press the kennel club (RvB) to introduce independent vet judging of breed winners and to strengthen enforcement, but declined to ban dog shows and said several matters are the private kennel club's responsibility.
I will therefore enter into discussion with the Raad van Beheer about the results of Fairfok and the further necessary steps to make breeding healthier in the coming years.
Ik ga daarom in gesprek met de Raad van Beheer over de resultaten van Fairfok en over de verdere noodzakelijke stappen om de fokkerij gezonder te maken in de komende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over zorgen uit het land over de subsidieregeling voor pelsdierhouderijen

An MP asks the minister about the status and design of the subsidy scheme for demolishing and converting fur farms, including the start date, budget use, transition period, locational limits and pension support. The minister answers that five applications have been filed, the scheme took effect on 28 February 2018 with tax provisions backdated for EU state-aid reasons, and that the budget of 36 million euro is fully available for the flanking policy, with further consultation with the sector promised for spring 2019.
I will inform your House in spring 2019 about these and other results of the consultation with the sector.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het voorjaar 2019 over deze en overige resultaten van het gevoerde overleg met de sector informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het besluit van Gedeputeerde Staten Flevoland om gezonde edelherten en pasgeboren jongen af te schieten en de uitplaatsing van konikpaarden naar andere gebieden

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Flevoland provincial executive's decision to cull healthy red deer and relocate konik horses, questioning its legality, the expert basis of the Van Geel commission, and the animal welfare implications. The minister replied that the decision rests on the Nature Conservation Act and is a matter for the courts, that the Van Geel report is treated as the independent review, and that the minister sees no grounds to terminate the agreement or intervene, though culling will not proceed before a court ruling on 19 November 2018.
Culling of red deer will not proceed until the interim relief court rules on 19 November 2018 on the Flevoland provincial decision.

Er zal niet tot afschot van edelherten worden overgegaan tot de uitspraak van de voorzieningenrechter op 19 november 2018 inzake de voorlopige voorziening tegen het besluit van de provincie Flevoland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over getroffen rozentelers door Ralstonia en crisisaanpak plantenziekten

Von Martels (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture about growers of cut roses hit by Ralstonia, asking whether state aid under EU rules is possible, whether a compensation scheme will be introduced, and about the risks of future outbreaks. The minister declined to individually assess growers' financial situation, refused a dedicated aid scheme while keeping the possibility of sector-financed risk coverage under study, and noted the reporting duty.
It does not befit me to go into individual situations.
Het past mij niet op individuele situaties in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over de groeiplannen van Eindhoven Airport en de gevolgen voor de natuur

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether Eindhoven Airport's growth scenarios would increase CO2, nitrogen and fine-particle emissions, conflict with Natura 2000 protection and the PAS, and whether a critical report was withheld. The government answered that the scenarios are analytical only, no decision has been taken, growth would be assessed as a priority project only later, and the report was not suppressed but published with a delay by the municipality.
The report concerned on nitrogen deposition was not withheld.
Het betreffende rapport over stikstofdepositie is niet achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over agressie tegen toezichthouders van Staatsbosbeheer

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about violence against Staatsbosbeheer supervisors by hunters, including tougher sentencing, the maximum penalty, a lifetime hunting ban and a Zuid-Holland training initiative for hunters. The ministers answered that aggravating factors and prosecution guidelines already apply, that training hunters in handling aggression is justified, and that current rules on hunting licence refusal after violent convictions are proportionate, so no tightening is planned.
I consider the current regulations proportionate and at this moment see no reason to tighten the regulations on this point.
Ik acht de huidige regelgeving proportioneel en zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de regelgeving op dit punt aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Kooten-Arissen over het testen van zenuwgassen op proefdieren door Defensie

MPs Wassenberg and Van Kooten-Arissen asked the Defence Minister about animal testing of nerve agents on guinea pigs and rats, including ethics, the origin of animals, the number of animals used, funding for alternatives and plans to end testing. The government answered that the tests are necessary for medical countermeasures under the Animal Experiments Act, that about 100 rodents a year are used, and that testing will stop only when non-animal methods suffice, which is not expected soon.
For sound and reliable research, due to the lack of sufficient alternatives, the use of laboratory animals is still necessary.
Voor goed en betrouwbaar onderzoek is, vanwege het ontbreken van voldoende alternatieven, het gebruik van proefdieren nog steeds noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de verstikkingsdood van varkens nadat de ventilatie in hun stal uitviel

MP Ouwehand asked the Minister of Agriculture about the suffocation of about 1,200 pigs after ventilation failed in a fully automated barn, including reporting duties, the role of the NVWA and municipal and regional inspection, and oversight of automated systems. The minister answered that the NVWA's investigation found the barn had an alarm and emergency ventilation, that farmers bear primary responsibility, and that reporting obligations and inspections were in place, while declining to answer several questions about municipal inspections and past cases.

I do not have information on whether the keeper evaded a reporting obligation to the municipality of Haaren, nor on the findings and quality of the inspections by the Brabant-Noord environmental service.

Ik beschik niet over informatie of de houder zich onttrokken heeft aan een meldingsplicht aan de gemeente Haaren en over de bevindingen en de kwaliteit van de controles van de omgevingsdienst Brabant-Noord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel ‘1700 illegale geiten ontdekt bij boer in Waalre’

An MP asks whether the national agencies RVO and NVWA, and municipalities, can ensure that animals are lawfully located, after 1,700 illegal goats were found at a farm in Waalre, and proposes information-sharing and a national audit. The minister answers that environmental permits are the responsibility of municipalities and provinces, that information sharing is not justified given privacy rules and efficiency, and that no national investigation will be launched.
I do not share that view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de geplande herbouw en uitbreiding van mega varkensstal De Knorhof

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the minister whether she would stop the rebuild and doubling of the De Knorhof mega pig farm after a fire, given the owner's animal welfare violations, prior bans and permit breaches, and asked about NVWA inspections, inspection reports and municipal litigation costs. The minister declined to judge or intervene, citing municipal and provincial competence, gave only partial inspection information (two welfare checks since July 2017), and refused to publish inspection reports or provide data on omgevingsdienst visits.

It is not for me to assess the plans, because for new construction, rebuilding and renovation of barns the applicable legal frameworks of spatial planning and environmental policy apply, for which the decentralised governments are the competent authority.

Het is niet aan mij om de plannen te beoordelen, want voor nieuwbouw, herbouw en renovatie van stallen zijn de vigerende wettelijke kaders van het ruimtelijk ordenings- en milieubeleid van toepassing, waarvoor de decentrale overheden het bevoegd gezag zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat een “omstreden teckelfokker naar Hongarije verkast”

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that a controversial dachshund breeder moved to Hungary with dogs despite an ongoing criminal investigation, repeated inspection failures, unregistered puppies and sales via online platforms, and asked why the breeder was not stopped and how enforcement could be improved. The Minister said enforcement is a matter for Hungarian authorities and the public prosecutor, that only the criminal court can impose a closure or ban for now (a proposed Animal Ownership Ban bill would add an administrative power), and that the existing instruments are sufficient while pointing to inspection capacity, registration rules and better buyer information.
At present only the criminal court decides whether a business is shut down or subjected to a ban on keeping animals.
Op dit moment bepaalt alleen de strafrechter of een bedrijf wordt stil gelegd of een houdverbod krijgt opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Von Martels en Moorlag over “designer dogs and cats”

MPs Weverling, Von Martels and Moorlag asked the minister about breeding of 'designer dogs and cats' with hereditary health problems, citing a petition, a European conference, and the adequacy of existing rules and enforcement. The minister agreed such breeding is unacceptable, pointed to Article 3.4 of the Besluit houders van dieren and ten NVWA inspections (four with enforcement), announced a review of enforcement due by year end, and said the issue is being raised in an EU subworking group.
I have commissioned research to make this more enforceable.
Ik heb onderzoek uitgezet om dit beter handhaafbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gevaren voor de volksgezondheid ten gevolge van niet tegen Q-koorts gevaccineerde geiten

An MP asked whether an exemption from the Q-fever goat vaccination obligation, granted on conscientious-objection grounds in 2011 by the NVWA under ministerial mandate, is lawful and safe for residents. The minister answered that the exemption carries strict additional conditions giving protection equivalent to vaccination, citing Article 107 Gwwd, and committed to a very restrictive exemption policy.
There is currently one company in the Netherlands that does not vaccinate against Q fever.
Er is momenteel één bedrijf in Nederland dat niet vaccineert tegen Q-koorts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over twee zwaargewonden kinderen na val onveilig speeltoestel

An MP asked the Ministers of Agriculture and of Medical Care about dangerous Multiplay bouncy castles after two children were seriously injured, including whether the NVWA should have acted sooner and why certificates were not checked. The minister acknowledged a non-valid certificate led to one model being taken out of use, stated the NVWA inspects only a small share of locations, and promised further steps on the procedure for placing bouncy castles on the market.
The NVWA has no information that shows whether the correct certificates and logbooks are present for all play equipment.
De NVWA heeft geen informatie waarbij inzichtelijk gemaakt kan worden of bij alle speeltoestellen de correcte certificaten en logboeken aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over gebrek aan handhaving door de NVWA

An SP MP asked ministers about lax NVWA enforcement against a dangerous product sold as medicine (MMS) and an unsafe inflatable play structure. The minister defended the NVWA's procedures, said enforcement against MMS is now being applied, and said the play structure was only partly unsafe and enforcement was adequate.
I see no reason to change the procedures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de procedures aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het onderzoek ‘Europe's renewable energy directive poised to harm global forests’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about a Princeton study warning that the revised EU renewable energy directive could harm global forests by counting wood as a low-carbon renewable fuel. The minister rejected the claims of mass deforestation and rising emissions, citing sustainability criteria and stricter Dutch rules, and promised to send a reaction before the European Parliament vote.
Your House will receive my reaction before the final vote on the revision of the renewable energy directive by the European Parliament.
Uw Kamer ontvangt mijn reactie voordat er definitief gestemd wordt over de herziening van de richtlijn hernieuwbare energie door het Europees Parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de grote vertraging bij de herbeoordeling van bestrijdingsmiddelen

An MP asked the ministers why pesticide active substances with possible harmful properties have had their EU approvals extended without full reassessment, and why Dutch authorisations remain in place. The minister replied that delays are due to procedural and capacity reasons, that extensions are temporary pending full review, that the Ctgb is the competent authority and acts when new scientific information warrants it, and that it is not for the minister to instruct the Ctgb.
The Ctgb is the competent authority in the Netherlands for decisions on whether to authorise plant protection products.
Het Ctgb is in Nederland de bevoegde autoriteit voor besluiten over het al dan niet toelaten van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat Japan de commerciële walvisjacht weer wil invoeren

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked ministers about Japan's bid to lift the ban on commercial whaling at the IWC, the government's position and efforts against it, and whether the EU-Japan trade agreement contains binding whaling and dolphin-hunting commitments. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposed Japan's proposal and actively lobbied against it, described its wider conservation efforts, and said the trade deal only allows partners to raise compliance with environmental agreements, with no specific whaling conditions beyond that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het voorstel van de Europese Commissie om de uitbreiding van de vissersvloten in overzeese territoria te subsidiëren

An MP from PvdD asked the minister whether she supports a European Commission proposal to subsidise fleet expansion in overseas territories, and how this fits with overfishing and SDG 14. The minister answered that the Commission only consulted on amending state aid guidelines, that modernisation without capacity increase could be acceptable, that she opposes increasing capacity, and that she raised critical questions in the state aid advisory committee.
I do not consider that desirable.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Weverling over de uitzending ‘De bijenredders’

MPs Lodders and Weverling asked the minister about a Brandpunt+ broadcast on varroa mite control and a project to introduce varroa-resistant bees, and whether the National Bee Strategy and Bee Health Action Programme address it. The minister answered that the varroa mite is an important cause of winter bee mortality, welcomed the Arista Bee Research initiative, said it has joined the National Bee Strategy, and described existing knowledge-development and monitoring measures.
I will continue the policy aimed at reducing bee mortality among honeybees, developing more resilient (varroa-resistant) honeybees and optimising beekeeping practice.

Ik zal het beleid gericht op het verminderen van bijensterfte onder honingbijen, het ontwikkelen van meer weerbare (varroa-resistente) honingbijen en het optimaliseren van de imkerpraktijk voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over undercoverbeelden over apenexperimenten in het BPRC

An MP asked the government about undercover footage showing sedated monkeys at the BPRC primate research centre, including animals left unattended and handlers joking near suffering animals, and whether subsidy should stop. The minister answered that the NVWA inspected, found the sedation adequate and no violations, and committed to a plan from the BPRC by 1 January 2019 to reduce primate experiments by 40 percent, with a letter to parliament in Q1 2019.
Following the undercover footage, the NVWA carried out an extra inspection at the BPRC on 10 September.
Naar aanleiding van de undercoverbeelden heeft de NVWA op 10 september jl. een extra inspectie bij het BPRC uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Zorgen bij Brabantse varkensboeren over uitbraak Afrikaanse varkenspest in België’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the risk of African swine fever spreading from Belgium to the Netherlands, including the measures taken, whether hunting of wild boar should be opened or halted, and whether human activity in hunting and farming spreads the virus. The Minister answers that the introduction risk is small to medium, that a Plan van Aanpak and buffer-zone population reduction are planned, and that she does not support a general hunting ban, which she considers not in line with expert advice.
I am already in consultation with the provinces about this.
Ik ben hierover reeds in overleg met de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over een algemeen jachtverbod op wilde zwijnen om het risico op verspreiding van de Afrikaanse varkenspest tegen te gaan

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether a general hunting ban on wild boar should be introduced to prevent African swine fever, and raised questions on hunting by foreign and Dutch hunters, the importation of wild boar from Belgium, provincial prevention budgets and the scientific basis of policy. The minister replied that a general hunting ban is not in line with expert advice, that population reduction is recommended in buffer zones, and that the province of Limburg's request for a driven-hunt method is under consideration.
I have no signals that this is still the case.
Ik heb geen signalen dat dit nu nog het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat vissers 'kapot gemaakt worden' door verdere beperking van de visvangst op het IJsselmeer

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether fishers on the IJsselmeer are being ruined by further catch restrictions, and whether the decline is not caused by fishing alone given reduced capacity.
