The minister acknowledged the reports, cited expert analysis that fishing pressure must be brought into balance with the water system's reduced carrying capacity, and said fishers will be involved in measures to cut catches of bream and roach by 36%.
I will keep you informed about the outcomes and decision-making.
Over de uitkomsten en besluitvorming houd ik u op de hoogte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts en Slootweg over de voorbereiding van Nederland op een keiharde Brexit

MPs Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts and Slootweg asked the government how prepared the Netherlands is for a no-deal Brexit, including whether the added customs, NVWA and justice capacity will be operational by 29 March 2019 and what risks remain. The government answered that NVWA and customs will only partly be staffed by that date, with temporary service reductions expected, and that departments are taking mitigating measures with the Foreign Affairs minister coordinating.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Vis kan eindelijk door Haringvlietdam, maar daarachter wachten netten en fuiken’

MPs Weverling and Remco Dijkstra asked about the opening of the Haringvliet dam sluices (Kierbesluit), concerns over saltwater intrusion into freshwater supplies during drought, monitoring, and evaluation. The ministers answered that freshwater intakes were relocated, saltwater intrusion is avoided in low-Rhine-flow periods, monitoring and telemetry will follow the effects, and no evaluation conclusions can yet be drawn.
Work is done on a risk-controlled basis, starting with smaller openings and situations with relatively high Rhine discharge.
Er wordt risico-gestuurd gewerkt, waarbij gestart wordt met kleinere openingen en situaties met relatief veel Rijnafvoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht 'Schildklierhormoon in diervoeding'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a Radar broadcast reporting high thyroid hormone levels in some raw meat pet food, whether the NVWA had investigated this, and what measures would remove the hormone from pet food. The minister said the broadcast alone does not support conclusions, the NVWA had not investigated previously, the producer is responsible for product safety, and the sector is developing a hygiene code that the NVWA will oversee.
The NVWA will ensure that attention is paid to thyroid tissue within the hygiene code.
De NVWA zal er op toezien dat er binnen de hygiënecode aandacht wordt besteed aan schildklierweefsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat jagers in de afgelopen 3,5 jaar zeker 1000 verwilderde katten doodschoten

Van Kooten-Arissen (PvdD) asked the minister about reports that hunters shot about 1000 feral cats in 3.5 years, asking whether the 2013 Thieme motion against cat shooting is being honoured, how hunters can distinguish feral from pet cats, and whether a national ban and TNR and chipping rules should be introduced. Minister Schouten replied that cat management is a provincial responsibility, that she will not introduce a national shooting ban, and that she will study municipal chipping obstacles and promote information via LICG.
As set out in my answers to questions 2 and 4, responsibility for managing stray cats lies with the provinces, and I will not introduce a national ban on shooting cats.
Zoals in mijn antwoorden op vragen 2 en 4 verwoord ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor het beheer van zwerfkatten bij de provincies, en zal ik geen landelijk afschotverbod op katten invoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het afschieten van verwilderde katten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about shooting feral cats, the scale of the cat population and predation, the TNR method, sterilisation obligations and cat registration. The minister answered that feral cats cause health and nature problems, that TNR is not an alternative to shooting for protecting birds, that sterilisation obligations are hard to enforce so none will be introduced, and that municipalities are responsible for registration, which is being discussed with them.
The number of stray cats outside shelters is estimated in that handbook at between 135,000 and 1.2 million.
Het aantal zwerfkatten buiten opvangcentra wordt in genoemd Handboek geschat tussen de 135.000 en 1,2 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het verbod op het gebruik van de sleepvoet

MPs Lodders and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture why the planned ban on slurry-shoe (sleepvoet) manure application on grassland on clay and peat soils was not reconsidered, and about alternatives, their effects, verification and responsibility. The Minister maintained the ban from 1 January 2019 as agreed under the PAS nitrogen programme, described approved alternatives, and set out the verification and responsibility arrangements.
For these alternatives, my ministry is now working on elaborating the regulations so that they can be applied in 2019.
Voor deze alternatieven werkt mijn ministerie nu aan de uitwerking van de regelgeving zodat deze kunnen worden toegepast in 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Wassenberg en Ouwehand over de jaarlijkse milieuschade van ruim 37 miljard euro

MPs Van Raan, Wassenberg and Ouwehand asked the government about the roughly 37 billion euro annual environmental damage from Dutch firms and consumers, the CO2 minimum price, aviation emissions, livestock and imported environmental costs, and whether environmental costs are included in fiscal and policy calculations. The Minister mostly defended existing policy, said the PBL figures are uncertain and not fully comparable, pointed to planned True Pricing work and aviation measures, and declined to give some requested estimates.
The multi-year programme I have in mind should provide more insight into the cost-shifting mechanisms.
Het meerjarenprogramma dat mij voor ogen staat moet meer inzicht in de afwentelingsmechanismen opleveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de berichten dat dieraantallen in de veehouderijsector veelvuldig worden overschreden

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that livestock numbers are often exceeded in intensive farming, about ammonia emission estimates, enforcement capacity, and inconsistent farm counts. The minister answered that NVWA inspections found overshoots on 68 farms in 2017 with 51 reports, that inspections are risk-based and not extrapolable, and that RIVM will correct its register and clarify the ammonia trend later.
These figures cannot be extrapolated, because there is already a risk-based selection of companies to be inspected.
Deze cijfers kunnen niet worden geëxtrapoleerd, want er vindt al een risicogerichte keuze plaats voor het controleren van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Lodders over het bericht ‘Boeren vrezen wilde zwijnen na besmetting’

MPs Geurts and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about African swine fever risks from wild boar, including whether the national government should take over management from the provinces, testing of hunted wild boar, transport and waste controls, and vaccines. The minister answered that consultation with provinces and stakeholders is ongoing, that provinces remain legally responsible for wild boar population management, that the national government can only intervene through substitution in case of neglect, and that existing monitoring and biosecurity measures are considered sufficient for now.
Given this decentralisation of powers, the national government can only intervene in case of neglect of duty by a provincial administration through substitution.
Het Rijk kan, gegeven deze decentralisatie van bevoegdheden, alleen ingrijpen als sprake is van taakverwaarlozing door het bestuur van een provincie door middel van in de plaatstreding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de daling van het aantal weidevogels

An MP asked the minister whether the agri-environment scheme and the Natuurwet adequately protect meadow birds such as the black-tailed godwit, and whether the government will revise rules, enforcement and provincial cooperation. The minister said it is too early to judge the new collective scheme, pointed to ongoing learning and optimisation plans with the provinces, said the Wet natuurbescherming offers good protection, and promised to inform parliament this autumn and to meet the researcher.

At the committee meeting on nature of 8 March 2018, I committed to inform your House this autumn about the elaboration of the plans of provinces and the national government to improve the meadow bird population.

Tijdens het AO Natuur van 8 maart 2018, heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd dat ik u dit najaar zal informeren over de uitwerking van de plannen van provincies en Rijk voor het verbeteren van de weidevogelstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aantallen dieren die onbedwelmd worden geslacht

An MP asked the minister for numbers and breakdowns on animals slaughtered without stunning in kosher and halal slaughter, including whether non-kosher meat is sold on as halal and whether the NVWA supervises these flows. The minister mostly declined detailed breakdowns (NVWA keeps no such records), said the NVWA only supervises the slaughter itself and not sales channels or labelling, and reported 80 violations in Q1 2018 with corrective measures and a noted improvement in Q2.
No, I cannot make this further breakdown. The NVWA does not keep records of this.
Nee, ik kan deze nadere uitsplitsing niet maken. De NVWA houdt hier geen registratie van bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de bescherming van dieren tegen de hitte

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about protecting livestock from heat stress, including inspection powers, shelter in pastures, stable ventilation, and slaughter transport. The minister answered that holders must protect animals, that the NVWA has enforcement powers and has issued limited sanctions, and that existing sector protocols suffice without new restrictions.
No data are available on the number of inspections over the past 5 years under extreme warm weather conditions.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal controles in de afgelopen 5 jaar bij extreme warme weersomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘EU blijft streng op nieuwe veredelingstechnieken’ en ‘Europees Hof remt kwekers vanwege genetische modificatie’

MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the minister how the EU Court ruling on new plant breeding techniques such as CRISPR-Cas9 (subject to GMO rules) affects policy, import controls, and the coalition goal of promoting these techniques in Europe. The minister answered that the ruling keeps such products under GMO authorisation, that detection is difficult, and that the government will address the policy consequences in a separate letter to parliament.
We will shortly inform the House by letter about the Dutch position on applying new plant breeding techniques and the policy consequences of the European Court of Justice ruling.

Wij zullen uw Kamer spoedig per brief informeren over de Nederlandse inzet voor de toepassing van nieuwe plantenveredelingstechnieken en de beleidsconsequenties van de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Het is een puinhoop bij RVO.nl’

An MP asked the minister about reported delays and errors in the transfer of phosphate rights at RVO.nl, including processing times, complaints and objections. The minister answered that processing times now fall within the 8-week legal limit from March onward, that transfers of cattle farmers' rights are held pending reassessment of their decisions, and gave complaint and objection figures.
That is why I have decided to suspend the registration of notifications from cattle farmers.
Daarom heb ik besloten de registratie van kennisgevingen van vleesveehouders aan te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat bestrijdingsmiddelen die mogelijk een gevaar vormen voor mens en milieu veel te lang blijven toegestaan

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether pesticides with serious risks are automatically re-approved after their review deadline and what will be done about it. The minister rejected the claim of automatic renewal, explained the EU review system and reasons for delays, and pointed to an ongoing EU REFIT evaluation with proposals expected in 2019.
No, I cannot agree with that.
Nee, daar kan ik mij niet in vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat Fransen nieuwe jacht op de grutto niet uitsluiten

MPs Van Kooten-Arissen and Van Raan asked whether France's hunting of protected migratory birds such as the curlew and black-tailed godwit harms Dutch populations and whether the Dutch government will protest or block imports. The minister said France has extended a hunting ban on the godwit and curlew (except coastal curlew hunting) until July 2019, will monitor the situation, and will support proposals at the AEWA meeting in December 2018.
The Netherlands is closely monitoring developments in France and the population status of the black-tailed godwit and curlew, as the Netherlands invests heavily in conserving these species.
Nederland volgt de ontwikkelingen in Frankrijk en de stand van de populaties van de grutto en de wulp nauwgezet, aangezien Nederland veel inspanningen doet om deze soorten te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Futselaar over de bijdrage van 8 miljoen euro aan de nertsenhouderij

MPs Ouwehand and Futselaar asked the minister about reallocating 8 million euro from pig-sector funds to fur farm transition measures, the maximum compensation per location, fraud risks, shortening the transition period, NVWA enforcement and animal testing for vaccines. The minister confirmed the 8 million reservation and the compensation caps, said the extra amount is still being explored under state aid rules, refused to shorten the transition period or introduce declining compensation, and described enforcement capacity and the animal testing permit with limited detail.
However, no intellectual property rights may be infringed nor confidential information disclosed.
Er mag echter geen intellectuele eigendomsrecht worden geschonden noch vertrouwelijke informatie worden prijsgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten - Arissen over het bericht dat Brabant wil experimenteren met drukjacht op zwijnen

MP Van Kooten-Arissen asks the minister whether the proposed 'drukjacht' (one-on-one movement hunt) for wild boar in Brabant differs from the banned drijfjacht, whether it is ineffective, and how the ban can be kept in force. The minister answers that drukjacht is a limited, selective form permitted only as 1-op-1 hunting under provincial regulation, that other movement hunts remain banned, and that enforcement is the responsibility of competent authorities.
Compliance with that latter ban is monitored by the authorities competent to do so.
Op de handhaving van dat laatste verbod wordt toegezien door de daartoe bevoegde instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Futselaar over de bijdrage van 8 miljoen euro aan de nertsenhouderij

MPs Ouwehand and Futselaar asked the minister why EUR 8 million was reallocated from pig-sector transition funds to fur-farm compensation, the cap on demolition costs, possible fraud by illegal expansions, shortening the transition period, enforcement capacity and late NVWA decisions, and animal testing for vaccines. The minister answered that the EUR 8 million is a separate reservation whose use is still being studied under state-aid rules, that the cap is EUR 95,000 (EUR 120,000 with asbestos), that fraudulent applicants can be refused, that shortening the period cannot be costed and a declining subsidy is undesirable, and that enforcement and testing decisions rest on risk-based and legal grounds.
If this leads to an amendment of the Decree on subsidies for demolition and conversion costs of fur farms, I will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Als dit leidt tot een wijziging van het Besluit subsidiëring sloop- en ombouwkosten pelsdierhouderij, zal ik uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat een gevaarlijk product nog steeds op de markt verkrijgbaar is als medicijn

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a dangerous chlorine-based product (MMS) still sold as a medicine is acceptable, why NVWA enforcement came late despite a 2017 RIVM report, and what legislation governs it. The minister acknowledged the concern, explained the NVWA's warnings since 2010, the risk assessment process and the applicable food and medicines law, and said the existing information on warnings was sufficient.
As early as 2010 the NVWA warned consumers about MMS products because the safety of these products could not be guaranteed.
Al in 2010 heeft de NVWA consumenten gewaarschuwd voor MMS-producten omdat de veiligheid van deze producten niet kon worden gegarandeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Levensgevaarlijk chloormiddel nog steeds te koop als ‘medicijn’’

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked why the NVWA took years to act against Miracle Mineral Solution, a chlorine-based product sold as a medicine, despite early warnings and health reports. The minister explained the NVWA needed an independent risk assessment, enforcement began in 2018 after the March report, and it had issued warnings and fines in earlier years.
The bureau can ask the Front Office Food and Product Safety of the RIVM and RIKILT to carry out a risk assessment.
Bureau kan het Front Office Voedsel- en Productveiligheid van het RIVM en het RIKILT vragen een risicobeoordeling uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het afkeuren van gezonde groente en fruit door supermarkten

Party MP Ouwehand asks the minister whether supermarket cosmetic standards that led to 60,000 kilos of plums being rejected, and EU trade norms, should be relaxed so edible produce can be sold, and whether a non-enforcement policy should be adopted. The minister calls the waste regrettable, says she will talk with supermarket executives, but rejects a non-enforcement policy, saying the inspectorates only check EU norms and she will examine cosmetic requirements in EU norms.
Setting up a non-enforcement policy is therefore not necessary.
Het instellen van een gedoogbeleid is dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat nog maar 10 tot 15% van de consumentenprijs bij de aardappelproducent terechtkomt

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether she was aware of reports that only 10 to 15% of the consumer price of potatoes reaches the grower, and what she would do so that Dutch food producers earn a reasonable income. The minister acknowledged the 2014 Wageningen margin study, said the weak position of primary producers is worrying, and pointed to announced measures against unfair trade practices, cooperation support and a market monitor at the competition authority ACM.
The cabinet is aware that the position of the farmer in the chain is under pressure.
Het kabinet is zich ervan bewust dat de positie van de boer in de keten onder druk staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over de berichten dat de Nederlandse natuur verschrompelt en een noodplan nodig is

MPs Van Kooten-Arissen and Van Raan asked whether the government shares concerns that prolonged drought is withering Dutch nature and threatening species, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the concerns, describes crisis coordination, water allocation rules, the Deltaplan Zoetwater and planned nature-network and climate-stress-test steps, but gives no new binding commitments beyond existing programmes.
I too am concerned about the consequences for nature of the ongoing drought.
Ik maak mij ook zorgen over de gevolgen voor de natuur van de aanhoudende droogte.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘Twaalf schapen afgeslacht in Overijssels weiland: was het een wolf?’, ‘Dit wil je niet nog een keer meemaken’ en ‘Wolf maakt mogelijk slachtoffers b

VVD MPs asked the minister about wolf attacks on sheep, whether farmers can be better protected, compensation and whether lethal control should be possible. The minister answered that wolves are a protected species, that livestock protection is the owners' responsibility, that provinces handle damage compensation and that the operational wolf plan is being revised, with a commitment to consult stakeholders.
It seems desirable to me that foreign examples, such as those in Germany, are taken into account in this revision.
Het lijkt mij wenselijk dat buitenlandse voorbeelden, zoals die in Duitsland, bij deze aanpassing worden meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de afzet van 1 miljoen kuub mest op het spel staat door een niet-geaccrediteerde analysemethode

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that Eurofins Agro uses a non-accredited NIRS method for soil analyses, potentially invalidating manure disposal space for about 1 million cubic metres. The minister said Eurofins uses an allowed alternative method if equivalent reliability is shown, that the Commission of Experts is assessing this and a reply is expected in September, and that no other government controls exist beyond accreditation, though modernisation of the rules may be considered.
However, I have asked the Commission of Experts on the Fertilisers Act (CDM) whether Eurofins has sufficiently demonstrated the equivalence of the method it uses.
Wel heb ik de Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet (CDM) gevraagd of de gelijkwaardigheid van de door Eurofins gebruikte methode voldoende door Eurofins is aangetoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders inzake overlijden na fatale val van speeltoestel

An MP asked the minister about the death of a child after a fatal fall from an indoor play device, the NVWA's failed inspections of the play hall since 2013, and its enforcement and follow-up. The minister acknowledged that the NVWA did not act adequately after the 2013 inspection, that its enforcement tools were not used timely, and described tightened intervention policy and monitoring measures.
The NVWA should have found during its 2013 inspection that there was an unsafe situation.
De NVWA had tijdens haar inspectie in 2013 behoren te constateren dat er sprake was van een onveilige situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Kooten–Arissen over de verwaarlozing van honden op een teckelfokkerij in Woerden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the neglect of dogs at a Woerden breeding kennel still in operation, covering inspections, seizures, enforcement capacity, and breeder oversight. The minister answered in detail, citing an ongoing criminal investigation, the NVWA's risk-based enforcement, and the courts' role in deciding seizures and bans, while declining to give some information and committing to a policy letter on dog welfare.
Within the framework of the still ongoing criminal investigation, these questions cannot be addressed in further detail.
In het kader van het nog lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan op deze vragen niet nader worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Nederland medeschuldig aan olifantenslachting'

De Groot (D66) asks whether existing EU rules on pre-1947 ivory trade are effective given reports that legal trade feeds illegal poaching, whether the Netherlands supports closing the EU ivory market, and whether the minister will act. Minister Schouten says current rules already restrict trade, the EU study on domestic ivory markets is due for discussion in September, the Netherlands supports EU-level measures, and she is prepared to ban ivory trade nationally if EU action fails.
If this does not produce results or takes too long, I am willing to take stricter national measures myself to ban the trade in ivory in the Netherlands.
Als dit echter geen resultaten oplevert of te lang op zich laat wachten, ben ik bereid zelf stengere nationale maatregelen te nemen om de handel van ivoor in Nederland te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat wild op de Veluwe lijdt onder extreme droogte

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether shooting wild boar piglets on the Veluwe during extreme drought is ethically acceptable and whether a general hunting ban should be imposed. The minister refused a general hunting ban, pointing to provincial authority to close hunting in exceptional weather, said adult sows and newborn piglets are generally not shot, and reported extra drinking points created for wild animals.
I cannot proceed to introduce a general hunting ban.
Ik kan niet overgaan tot het instellen van een algemeen jachtverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitzonderlijke droogte en de gevolgen voor de landbouw

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the exceptional drought justifies relaxing rules on manure spreading, grassland ploughing, greening measures and fallow grazing, and requests quicker decisions. The Minister confirms the situation is exceptional, says requests will be considered welcomingly and with priority, commits to advice from the CDM and a request to the European Commission on greening exemptions, and says decisions will be communicated as soon as possible.
I am committed to providing entrepreneurs with clarity as quickly as possible on decisions that are sufficiently substantiated.
Ik zet mij ervoor in om zo snel mogelijk duidelijkheid te geven aan ondernemers met besluiten die voldoende onderbouwd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de aanhoudende droogte in Nederland

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about farmers being obliged to sow cover crops during the drought, whether this is fair given the costs and failing crops, and whether a derogation will be granted quickly. The minister answers that a formal derogation request has been submitted to the European Commission, that a decision cannot come before Commission approval, and that she will push for speed while supplying the information requested.
I have consulted with the European Commission on this and submitted a formal derogation request aimed at easing the greening conditions for sowing catch crops.
Ik heb daarover overlegd met de Europese Commissie en een formeel derogatieverzoek ingediend met het oog op een versoepeling van de vergroeningsvoorwaarden voor het inzaaien van vanggewassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'Hogan belooft versoepeling EU-regels wegens droogte'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture about the Commissioner Hogan report on relaxing EU rules because of the drought, and about what the government would do for farmers. The Minister answered that the government has requested a derogation on catch-crop rules, is pursuing a bank guarantee route via RVO.nl, and points to the broad weather insurance, but declines to commit to new structural drought measures beyond existing instruments.
The Netherlands immediately afterwards submitted a derogation request regarding the greening requirements for catch crops, in line with the sector's (LTO's) request.
Nederland heeft direct daarna een derogatieverzoek ingediend ten aanzien van de vergroeningseisen met betrekking tot vanggewassen, conform het verzoek van de sector (LTO).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'West-Brabantse aardbeientelers luiden noodklok over 'oneerlijke' Belgische concurrentie'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about claims by Dutch strawberry growers that Belgian competitors receive more EU subsidies, and whether the Dutch government had engaged with them. The Minister denied that Belgian growers simply get more subsidy, explained that national strategies differ by member state, said the Dutch focus shifted away from operating-cost subsidies, and pledged to keep working for a level playing field.
No. Under the European regulation, each member state must adopt a national strategy for sustainable operational programmes in the fruit and vegetable sector.
Nee. Op grond van de Europese verordening dient elke lidstaat een nationale strategie voor duurzame operationele programma's in de sector groenten en fruit vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over de netto opbrengst van pachtgronden

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance how lease returns on farmland compare with the box 3 wealth tax assumed yield of 5.39%, whether the regulated rent norms can leave net lease income below the tax, and whether the government will change the box 3 system. The government answered that regulated lease prices cap only direct rental income, that box 3 is a forfaitary system averaging returns across wealth levels, that some individual landlords may face a higher tax burden than their lease income, and that a letter on actual-return box 3 is in preparation, while declining to give a regional breakdown of average net returns and of lease-type-specific yields.

Because the returns on savings and investments are adjusted annually on the basis of the most recent available data, the wealth yield tax system from 2017 onward better matches the average actual return.

Doordat de rendementen op spaargeld en beleggingen jaarlijks worden aangepast aan de hand van de meest actueel beschikbare gegevens sluit het stelsel van de vermogensrendementsheffing vanaf 2017 beter aan bij het gemiddelde werkelijke rendement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

Two VVD MPs asked why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (Dutch state property agency) let maintenance of its leased farm buildings lapse, why it does not sell them, and which conditions apply. The State Secretary answered that the agency manages 164 farms, has an inspection and maintenance plan for 2018 after a 2017 letter to tenants, and maintains a policy of not selling farm buildings, while knowing of no operational hindrance from the maintenance backlog.

Because there is a backlog in maintenance of agricultural buildings, the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf notified all tenants of agricultural buildings by letter on 14 September 2017 that they could report faults and problems to a national fault line.

Omdat er een achterstand is in het onderhoud van agrarische gebouwen heeft het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf op 14 september 2017 alle pachters van agrarische gebouwen per brief gemeld dat zij melding kunnen maken van storingen en problemen op een landelijk storingsnummer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de internetconsultatie Regeling tot wijziging van de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij (Rav) en de Regeling geurhinder en veehouderij (Rgv)

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and minister about the internet consultation on amending the ammonia and odour regulations for livestock farming, questioning the WUR study underlying the change, its financial effects, and whether consultation should have waited for pending questions and parliamentary debate. The government answered that combi-scrubbers perform worse than assumed, that the study is statistically robust, that expansion possibilities will be restricted for affected farms, and that no cost-benefit analysis is available; it deferred some questions to a separate reply.
A cost-benefit analysis is not available.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de Evaluatie geurverwijdering door luchtwassystemen bij stallen

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked about differences in air-scrubber performance and standards between the Netherlands and Germany, and about the planned adjustment of odour-reduction percentages for combi-scrubbers following a WUR evaluation. The government answered that no EU or Dutch standards exist for scrubbers, that Dutch and German lab measurements differ due to methodology, that combi-scrubbers underperform relative to permit assumptions, and that it will adjust emission factors, while noting the impact on farmers is limited for existing farms.
The study shows that combi-scrubber systems in practice do not deliver the emission reduction assumed in permits.
Het onderzoek toont aan dat de combi-luchtwassystemen in de praktijk niet de emissiereductie geven waar in vergunningen mee wordt gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bericht ‘Ernstig dierenleed vastgelegd bij nertsentransport vanuit Nederland’

An MP asked the minister about footage of severe animal suffering during mink transport from the Netherlands, including possible violations of EU transport rules, enforcement, controls, export ban and pre-departure checks. The minister said the NVWA is investigating via a complaint, enforcement lies with Polish authorities, mink transports were not controlled in five years for lack of risk indications, and declined to ban mink exports or require pre-departure checks, promising to raise the signal with the sector.
The NVWA contacted this competent authority to obtain more information about the situation found.
De NVWA heeft contact gezocht met deze bevoegde autoriteit om meer informatie te krijgen over de aangetroffen situatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, De Groot en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Dit keer dumpen de boswachters zelf afval, als statement’

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security, Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and Infrastructure and Water Management about fly-tipping in rural areas after rangers dumped waste as a protest. The minister acknowledged the problem, said a joint plan of action on supervision and enforcement in rural areas would be sent to parliament before the budget debates, and noted that cleanup costs and enforcement capacity are burdens but gave no national data on causes or environmental damage.
As promised in the Nature committee debate of 8 March 2018, I am working with the Minister of LNV on an action plan to improve supervision and enforcement in rural areas.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO Natuur van 8 maart 2018 werk ik samen met de Minister van LNV aan een plan van aanpak om het toezicht en de handhaving in het buitengebied te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'LNV overrompelt schapenboeren: zeedijk telt maar half voor Mestwet'

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about reports that a manure-policy change caught sheep farmers off guard, whether enforcement and reporting of manure fraud work properly, and how many fraud reports came in. The minister denied any tightening of the manure law, explained the court rulings on sea dikes and a suspended policy rule, and reported about 30 suspected manure-fraud signals in the past 12 months.
Following these rulings, after consultation with LTO, Wetterskip Fryslân and the Union of Water Boards, a policy rule was drawn up.
Naar aanleiding van deze uitspraken is, na overleg met LTO, Wetterskip Fryslân en Unie van Waterschappen, een beleidsregel opgesteld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over het bericht ‘RVB wil dat onjuiste pachtnota's betaald worden’

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf sent tenants invoices and reminders for April 2018 based on outdated rent percentages, and what would be done about payment pressure and liquidity risk. The Staatssecretaris admitted a process step was wrongly skipped, apologised, committed to no automatic follow-up calls and to stopping collection with interest refunds.

When sending the invoices for rent for the period 1 October 2017 to 30 April 2018, it was not possible to implement in time in the administrative systems the rent price adjustments applying from 1 July 2017.

Bij het verzenden van de facturen voor de pacht over de periode 1 oktober 2017 t/m 30 april 2018 is het niet gelukt om de aanpassingen van de pachtprijzen die gelden vanaf 1 juli 2017 tijdig in de administratieve systemen door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Zorgen Staatsbosbeheer om veiligheid boswachters’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about reported safety concerns for forest rangers (boswachters) and green enforcement officers, including incident numbers, whether rangers should receive handcuffs, batons and pepper spray, C2000 radio access, and a joint action plan with the police. The minister answered that no total incident figures exist because of a changed registration system, reported about 70 incidents at Staatsbosbeheer in 2017, said the equipment request is under advisory review, and promised an action plan to be shared around the budget debate.
No figures are available on the total number of incidents involving forest rangers and enforcement officers.
Over het totaal aantal incidenten van boswachters en boa’s zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Kooten- Arissen over “de verkoop van een giftige aanslagreiniger, gevaarlijk voor mens, dier en milieu”

MPs Wassenberg and Arissen asked whether a green-mould cleaner sold by Action, containing the toxic substance DDAC, is safe and whether it should be recalled or banned for consumers. The state secretary answered that the product is authorised by the Ctgb and meets legal requirements, but a warning label on pets will be added, and no recall or sales ban is planned.
A warning sentence on the label is a proportionate measure for this problem.
Een waarschuwingszin op het etiket is voor dit probleem een proportionele maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over het bericht “Bayer zette wetenschap jarenlang op dwaalspoor”

An MP asked whether the Dutch pesticide approval system is independent enough and whether it should discount industry-favoring Good Laboratory Practice standards, and whether it should push for EU reform and independent academic input. The Minister rejected the analysis, said the dossier requirements and EFSA/member-state review are adequate, and declined to pursue national or EU changes, pointing to an existing EU proposal on EFSA risk assessment.
No, I do not share these analyses.
Nee, ik deel deze analyses niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over late betalingen door en marktmacht van Nederlandse supermarkten

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked the government about late payments by Dutch supermarkets to suppliers, bank-financed payment schemes, and whether rising market power and concentration threaten competition. The State Secretary answered that existing payment-term rules apply to supermarkets, a Commission proposal on unfair trading practices is being assessed, a ban on assignment clauses is planned, and that the ACM already polices abuse of dominance case by case, while declining to speculate on causes or commission a broad market-power study.
It is not for me to speculate on the underlying reason for supermarkets' conduct.
Het is niet aan mij om te speculeren over wat de achterliggende reden van het handelen van supermarkten is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Dierenarts waarschuwt: dodelijke hondenziekte bij Duitse grens geconstateerd’

An MP asked the minister about reports of canine distemper near the German border, its prevalence, vaccination rates, fake vaccination passports on imported dogs, and fox transmission. The minister answered that there is no notification duty or registration system, that vaccination protects well, and that EU discussions on animal transport continue, without committing to new measures.
For canine distemper, also called Carré's disease, there is no notification obligation.
Voor hondenziekte, ook wel ziekte van Carré genoemd, is geen meldplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel ‘Kweekvlees is er! Maar we mogen het niet proeven’

An MP asks the ministers of Agriculture and Medical Care about the status of approval of cultured meat under EU novel food rules, EU efforts to speed approval, remaining legal barriers, and the NVWA's sealing of cultured meat packages. The government replies that cultured meat is not yet approved or in the EU list, no application has been filed, speeding up is very limited, no other legal barrier exists, and it supports the NVWA's enforcement action.
I support the NVWA's actions in this matter.
Ik ondersteun het optreden van de NVWA in deze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over het bericht ‘NVWA bevestigt besmetting bruinrot in snijroos’

VVD MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture about Ralstonia (brown rot) infections in cut roses, compensation for affected growers, a 2018 College van Beroep ruling denying compensation under the Plantenziektenwet, use of EU regulation 702/2014, and the unknown source of the outbreak. The minister said no compensation negotiations have taken place, the Netherlands chose not to pay compensation under EU rules judging the losses a normal business risk, and the source remains unidentified despite NVWA investigation.

I want to support the sector by jointly examining, together with the sector, what room exists within cabinet policy and European and national laws and regulations to achieve risk coverage by the sector itself.

Ik wil de sector ondersteunen door samen met de sector te onderzoeken welke ruimte er binnen het kabinetsbeleid en Europese en nationale wet- en regelgeving gevonden kan worden om tot realisatie van een risicoafdekking door de sector zelf te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over door bruinrot getroffen rozentelers

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about rose growers hit repeatedly by Ralstonia (brown rot), including whether compensation should be given for losses from rightful containment measures and how the sector's plant health covenant and the source of infection will be handled. The Minister answered that such losses are normal business risk, that the Netherlands has chosen not to compensate under EU rules, and that talks with the sector on risk coverage and source tracing are ongoing.
The Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and several sector organisations in the plant sector are in consultation to reach agreements to limit phytosanitary risks in general.

Het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en enkele sectororganisaties in de plantaardige sector zijn in overleg om te komen tot afspraken om fytosanitaire risico's in het algemeen te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over het bericht 'Gegevens huisdieren en hun baasjes op straat'

MPs Koopmans and Weverling asked whether pet owners' data from pet chip databases was exposed online, whether breaches were reported to the Data Protection Authority, and how the ministry prepared affiliated bodies for GDPR. The minister replied that no sensitive data reportedly leaked, databases blocked bulk queries, one database filed a breach report, and a DPIA and processing agreements were in place.
Following the NOS finding, the databases took measures so that querying multiple chip numbers from a single IP address is now impossible.
Naar aanleiding van de constatering door de Nederlandse Omroep Stichting (NOS) hebben databanken maatregelen genomen, waardoor opvraag van meerdere chipnummers vanaf één IP adres nu onmogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het kantelen van een vrachtwagen met 300 jonge kalfjes aan boord

An MP asked the agriculture minister about a truck carrying about 300 young calves that overturned on the A16, the calves' ages, transport duration and rest stops, drinking systems, and monitoring of calf mortality and disease during transport. The minister answered most questions on substance, explained the rest-stop rules and NVWA checks, but declined to register transport deaths or illness, saying it is not a statutory task, and committed to no new action beyond referring the Irish stop violation to Irish authorities.
It is not a statutory task of the NVWA to register road accidents involving animals and report on them.
Het is geen wettelijke taak van de NVWA om wegongevallen met dieren te registreren en daarover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ongezonde voedingsproducten

MP Moorlag asked the State Secretary whether it is harmful that less than a third of large food companies' products are healthy by the Access to Nutrition Index standards, and whether the government will push companies to speed up healthier product ranges. The State Secretary agreed the situation is regrettable, said companies share responsibility, and promised more attention to better food supply in the upcoming prevention accord, with further information in autumn.
Yes, see answer to question 3. All parties, including the food industry, will have to put their shoulders to the wheel to improve the food supply.
Ja, zie antwoord op vraag 3. Alle partijen, ook de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, zullen er de schouders onder moeten zetten om het voedingsaanbod te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Von Martels en Van der Molen over oesterbanken voor de haven van Terschelling

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers about Japanese oyster banks affecting currents and access to the Terschelling harbour, dredging and ferry berths, a possible sailing ban near seal sandbanks, and the addition of the grey seal to Wadden dune habitat designations. The minister confirmed monitoring of the oyster banks with results expected end of the year, said the banks lie outside the ferry channel and do not affect access, confirmed planned maintenance of ferry infrastructure from 2019, and explained the limited scope of the grey seal designation.
These oyster banks are scheduled to be re-measured by Wageningen Marine Research this spring.
Deze oesterbanken worden volgens de planning dit voorjaar opnieuw ingemeten door Wageningen Marine Research.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Natuurclubs willen af van landbouwgif dat akkers oranje kleurt'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, after a newspaper report that nature groups want to stop glyphosate use, whether using glyphosate to reset grassland fits integrated pest management and whether its use should be restricted on land owned by nature organisations or government. The minister replied that the Ctgb is re-assessing all glyphosate uses, that she is in talks with LTO on reducing glyphosate use including grassland renewal, and that nature organisations can already set conditions in agreements with farmers.
I am now in talks with LTO Nederland about reducing the use of weedkillers and crop protection products based on the active substance glyphosate.
Ik ben inmiddels in gesprek met LTO Nederland over het terugdringen van het gebruik onkruidbestrijdingsmiddelen en gewasbeschermingsmiddelen op basis van de werkzame stof glyfosaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het ILVO-onderzoek naar de effecten van de pulsvisserij

The MP asks the minister about the ILVO study on side effects of electric pulse beam trawling for shrimp, its implications for EU negotiations on the Technical Measures Regulation, and whether other member states are shifting position. The minister answers that the study is positive for pulse fishing, that it will be raised in international dialogue meetings, that the trilogue timeline is unclear, and that only France has explicitly sided with Parliament's proposed ban.
The cited study contributes to clarifying the side effects of pulses in the shrimp fishery.
Het genoemde onderzoek draagt bij aan het inzichtelijk maken van de neveneffecten van de pulsen in de garnalenvisserij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Weedkiller products more toxic than their active ingredient, tests show'

A D66 MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report that glyphosate-based weedkiller products are more toxic than their active ingredient, and whether it should prompt reconsideration of the EU glyphosate approval. The minister said the study does not disclose product composition, so it cannot be assessed, and that the Ctgb is reassessing all glyphosate products including co-formulants, while the EU decision concerned only the active substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel 'Veluwse kwarteleitjes van Jumbo kwamen van Franse legbatterij'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the sale of quail eggs from caged French hens labelled as free-range is consistent with EU rules, and whether the EU should ban caged quail egg production and require origin codes. The minister agreed quail should have further EU restrictions and origin coding, said she would push for this in Brussels without Dutch leadership, and considered current sanctions sufficient.
When this comes up in Brussels, I am certainly willing to campaign hard for it.
Wanneer dit in Brussel ter sprake komt, ben ik zeker bereid mij daar hard voor te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat scharrelkwarteleieren afkomstig zijn van een Franse legbatterij

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether scharrel quail eggs sold by Jumbo actually came from a French battery farm, about their origin, whether French welfare standards match Dutch ones, and whether egg codes should be mandatory for quail eggs. The minister confirmed the eggs came from a French supplier, explained that EU rules for quail welfare differ and that egg coding is a matter for Brussels, and said she has no data on whether farms mislabel products after setbacks.
When this comes up in Brussels, I am willing to push hard for it.
Wanneer dit in Brussel ter sprake komt, ben ik bereid mij daar hard voor te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over fraude met kwarteleieren

An MP asked the minister of Agriculture about fraud with quail eggs sold as free-range, including whether quail farming for production is banned, which permits existed, and how inspections were carried out. The minister answered that no permits were ever granted, inspections found no quail, the NVWA and NCAE are investigating, and the minister will press for EU-level restrictions on quail egg laying cages.
I do not have information on this at my disposal.
Ik heb hierover geen informatie tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over kuikenbroedmachines als lespakket voor scholen en ter vermaak van particulieren

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about school chick-hatching kits, Easter chick sales and social media promotion, and whether the government would act against impulse purchases and home slaughter. The minister said welfare responsibility lies mainly with keepers and sellers, that enforcement tools exist for excess, and declined to ban such initiatives or commit to new action.
I am not in favour of banning such initiatives.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van om dergelijke initiatieven te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het rapport van de Externe begeleidingscommissie beheer Oostvaardersplassen

An SP MP asked the minister whether she knows the Van Geel commission report on managing the Oostvaardersplassen, whether she will respond to its advice, what role the national government sees in supporting the province, and whether she will seek alternative habitats for the grazers in the Netherlands or abroad. The minister confirmed knowledge of the report, declined to comment on it ahead of provincial decision-making, and said she will engage with the province on any implementation requiring her cooperation within the existing Rijk-provincie division of responsibilities, referring questions 4-6 to that answer.
Decision-making by the provincial states on the advice is expected in July 2018, and I do not think it is for me to respond to the report now.
Besluitvorming door provinciale staten over het advies wordt in juli 2018 verwacht en ik vind het niet aan mij om nu op het rapport te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de berichten ‘Situatie buitendijkse haven is onvoorstelbaar’ en ‘Komst buitendijkse haven nog niet zeker’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the Maritime Service Harbour in Northern Flevoland is stalled because the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the province cannot agree on erfpacht terms, leaving banks unwilling to finance entrepreneurs. The Minister acknowledges the disagreement, says the Rijk is willing to talk further with the province, and suggests granting rights directly to entrepreneurs as a possible fix.
On the Rijk's side we are happy to enter further consultation with the province to achieve swift realisation of the Maritime Service Harbour.
Van Rijkszijde treden wij graag verder in overleg met de provincie om tot een snelle realisatie van de Maritieme Servicehaven te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Arissen over de gevoeligheid van de eendenhouderij voor vogelpest

MPs Ouwehand and Arissen asked the government about the susceptibility of duck farming to avian influenza, outbreak frequency, hygiene, welfare links and whether duck farming should be closed. Minister Schouten answered that ducks are more easily infected, that housing and biosecurity measures reduce but cannot eliminate risk, and that she does not intend to ban duck farming, instead pursuing a future-vision trajectory with the sector and animal welfare groups.
I do not intend to ban duck farming in the Netherlands.
Ik ben niet van plan de eendenhouderij te verbieden in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over het stranden van levende, grote walvisachtigen en de nieuwe leidraad waarmee gestrande, grote walvissen mogelijk in gevangenschap terechtkomen ten behoeve van onderzoek en educ

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about causes of whale strandings, research underway, whether large whales may be kept in captivity under the new stranding guideline, and about responsibilities and legal status of that guideline. The minister said large baleen whales and toothed whales over 5 metres cannot be kept in captivity, that the guideline was improved with a permanent stranding coordinator, and that no legal binding is planned.
I therefore see no need to make the guideline further legally binding.
Ik zie daarmee geen noodzaak om de leidraad verder juridisch bindend te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over het bericht 'Heibel om afschieten honden op Bonaire'

MPs Helder and Graus asked whether the chief prosecutor on Bonaire acted unlawfully by telling police that loose dogs could be shot, and why Caribbean Netherlands lacks the animal welfare rules of Europe Netherlands. The Minister replied that the e-mail was a clumsy internal instruction about reporting, not an order to lie, and that European and Dutch animal welfare rules do not apply in Caribbean Netherlands, which relies on local regulation and the Penal Code BES.
The chief prosecutor in that e-mail certainly did not intend to create the suggestion that reporting should be done contrary to the truth.
De hoofdofficier heeft in het betreffende e-mailbericht dan ook geenszins de intentie gehad de suggestie te wekken dat er in strijd met de waarheid geverbaliseerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over fosfaatrechten

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether phosphate rights, traded since before their 2018 introduction, create an unregulated market open to fraud, speculation and price manipulation, and asks for transparency and monitoring. The Minister replies that the trade is private-law, restricted to farming enterprises and registered with RVO.nl, that no market regulation is planned for now, and that the market will be monitored with annual reports to parliament.
I will report to your House on this annually.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover jaarlijks rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de reactie op de steunmaatregelen aan pluimveehouders in België naar aanleiding van de fipronilcrisis

An MP asked the minister whether Dega-16, a product used in Belgium during the fipronil crisis, was unauthorised as a biocide in both countries and whether this justified state aid to affected poultry farms. The minister answered that Dega-16 was unauthorised in both countries, that its label claim makes it a biocide requiring authorisation regardless of natural origin, and that the government sees no basis for compensation since producers are primarily responsible for food safety.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over een stalbrand in Woudenberg

Futselaar (SP) asked the minister about a second barn fire at a Woudenberg poultry farm, questioning how the farm could keep operating after the first fatal fire and asking about the status of the action plan on barn fires. The minister confirmed the 30,000 chickens died, said the first fire was at a different barn, attributed licensing to municipalities, and pointed to a new action plan and a Building Decree exploration due in 2018.
The municipalities are responsible for issuing these permits.
De gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de afgifte van deze vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bericht dat er weer 30.000 kippen zijn gestorven bij een stalbrand op een bedrijf waar eerder al 80.000 kippen omkwamen door brand

MP Ouwehand asked the minister about a second barn fire at the same farm (30,000 chickens dead after 80,000 earlier), whether the stable met fire-safety rules, and whether existing stables should face stricter Building Code requirements. The minister confirmed the fire, said the stable was licensed in 2009 without a scrubber, admitted some data were unavailable, and said a review of Building Code rules for existing stables would report in the second half of 2018.
As indicated in the letter to parliament of 30 August 2017, I have started an exploration into adapting the Building Code for existing stables.
Ik heb, zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 30 augustus 2017, een verkenning gestart naar de aanpassing van het Bouwbesluit voor bestaande stallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over oogstramingen CBS

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked why provisional onion and potato harvest estimates by CBS were sometimes revised down, whether provisional figures distort prices, and whether publication could be limited to final figures. The minister disputed the premise that revisions were mainly downward, said CBS publication is a legal duty and serves transparency, and noted there is no EU obligation to publish provisional estimates.
The claim that final estimates generally came out lower in the period 2010–2017 is therefore not correct.
Het gestelde dat de definitieve ramingen over het algemeen lager uitvielen in de periode 2010 – 2017 is dus niet juist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Supermarkten zetten telers onder druk met nieuw keurmerk groente en fruit'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about supermarkets' new produce quality mark that does not oblige retailers to pay growers extra, and how this fits the coalition agreement's commitment that the ACM will ensure growers receive higher prices for above-legal standards. The minister said the ACM currently lacks powers over producer-buyer contracts, that options to reward growers are being mapped, and that she will report before summer and talk with retailers.
On the detailed implementation of this, I will inform you together with the State Secretary of EZK before the summer, and will also include the quality marks.
Over de nadere invulling daarvan zal ik u samen met de Staatssecretaris van EZK voor de zomer informeren en zal daarbij ook de keurmerken meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat er veel meer afval in de Stille Oceaan ronddrijft dan werd aangenomen en dat bijna de helft van deze vervuiling bestaat uit visnetten

An MP asked the government about a Nature study showing far more ocean plastic in the Pacific than assumed, with fishing nets making up nearly half, and whether this implies similar underestimates in the North Sea, what fishing-gear waste is found on Dutch beaches, whether the Green Deal on clean fishing is working, and what further measures are planned. The minister answered that North Sea findings cannot be translated directly, that net and rope waste is the largest category on Dutch beaches, that the Green Deal shows progress, and that new EU port reception rules and international initiatives are planned, but gave no new binding measures.
I acknowledge the need for a vigorous approach to reducing plastic litter in the marine environment.
Ik onderken de noodzaak van een voortvarende aanpak om plastic zwerfvuil in het mariene milieu terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sienot en De Groot over het bericht 'Onderzoekers: plasticsoep in Stille Oceaan komt vooral van visserij en scheepvaart'

D66 MPs asked whether the government shares researchers' view that cleaning up the Pacific plastic soup is futile and that production should be tackled, and what Dutch fishing and shipping sectors contribute and what agreements exist nationally, in the EU and globally. The minister answered that prevention via a circular economy is the primary policy, cites national green deals with the fishing and shipping sectors, EU port reception facility revision, and international initiatives, while noting the Pacific findings cannot be directly transferred to the North Sea.
Results of beach litter surveys on North Sea beaches in OSPAR's 2017 Intermediate Assessment show that in the southern North Sea in 2014/2015 packaging material had the largest share of items found.

Uit de resultaten van zwerfvuilmetingen op Noordzeestranden in het Intermediate Assessment 2017 van OSPAR blijkt dat in de zuidelijke Noordzee in 2014/2015 de categorie verpakkingsmateriaal het grootste aandeel heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de stormloop op grond voor zonneparken

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Agriculture about a rush of investors onto farmland for solar parks, its effects on land prices, young farmers, biodiversity, and whether rooftops and other land should be prioritised. The minister answered that municipalities and provinces are primarily responsible, that the government will consider rooftops and its own property, will include the issue in the Climate Agreement, and will inform parliament before summer 2018, but gave no binding national restriction.
The responsibility for this lies primarily with municipalities and provinces.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt primair bij gemeenten en provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel ‘Experts luiden de noodklok over falende aanpak tijgermug’

An MP asks the health minister whether invasive mosquito species should be prevented entirely, whether imports of used tyres and Lucky bamboo should be banned, and who is liable for a local epidemic. The minister answers that complete prevention cannot be promised, that NVWA will impose technical-hygienic rules on tyre importers but will not publish company names, and that liability cannot be determined in advance.
The names of the companies where exotic mosquitoes are found, I will not make public.
De namen van de bedrijven waar exotische muggen gevonden worden, zal ik niet bekend maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Luchtwassers werken veel slechter dan gedacht'

Two PvdA MPs asked the government whether odour and air scrubbers perform worse than assumed, why the research report had not been published, and whether it would be released immediately. The government confirmed the study was finished, said single scrubbers met regulatory values while combination scrubbers performed considerably lower, and stated the report and a policy response had been sent to parliament on 3 April 2018.
The performance of the single-stage air scrubbers was in line with the values set out in the regulations.
De prestaties van de enkelvoudige luchtwassers kwamen overeen met de in de regelgeving opgenomen waarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over misstanden in Nederlandse varkensstallen

The SP MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Agriculture about undercover footage and a Varkens in Nood report showing sick and dying pigs, and about NVWA inspections and fines. The Minister said she was shocked, pointed to sector responsibility and NVWA inspections, reported 350 welfare inspections in 2017 with a maximum fine of 4,500 euro, and promised a welfare note and a further letter on a 'warm' sanitation of the pig sector.
The NVWA regularly carries out inspections of pig farmers on animal welfare.
De NVWA voert met regelmaat controles uit bij varkenshouders op dierenwelzijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over het bericht ‘350 hectare grond opgeheven overheidsdienst in de verkoop’

MP Arissen asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that 350 hectares of land held by the BBL agency were being sold, including the leasing of hunting rights at about 2.50 euro per hectare, a possible option granted to a wildlife management unit, and whether hunting rights should go to the highest bidder and privatisation of nature should be curbed. The minister answered that the prices are market-conform, that BBL does not grant new hunting leases, that no change to the leasing system is planned, and that existing legal safeguards suffice against privatisation risks.
I see no reason to change the practice as applied by BBL.
Ik zie geen aanleiding in de praktijk zoals die wordt gehanteerd door BBL verandering aan te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Futselaar over het bericht dat Brussel een kenniscentrum opricht voor bestrijding van voedselfraude en het bevorderen van voedselkwaliteit

MPs De Groot and Futselaar asked about the European Commission's planned knowledge centre on food fraud and food quality, including its tasks, staffing, budget, effect on national food authorities such as the NVWA, and legal basis. The minister answered that the centre supports the EU Food Fraud Network without changing national enforcement roles, that FTE and budget are unknown, and that the Commission alone decided on it without Dutch involvement.
I do not know how many FTE will be deployed for the knowledge centre and how many of these will be found within the existing staff of the Joint Research Centre of the European Commission.
Het is mij onbekend hoeveel fte zullen worden ingezet voor het kenniscentrum en hoeveel daarvan binnen de bestaande formatie van het Joint Research Centre van de Europese Commissie worden gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de uitbreiding van de lijst met ecologische aandachtsgebieden

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about adding Miscanthus, Silphium perfoliatum and flower-rich fallow land to the list of ecological focus areas and about the timing given the EU omnibus regulation. The minister answered that the Wageningen research advice rates Silphium and flower-rich fallow well but Miscanthus poorly, and that the new options will open only for application year 2019 because the delegated regulation is delayed.
I intend to follow the advice of the WR.
Ik ben voornemens het advies van de WR te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht dat Nederland het verbod op pulsvissen over zich heeft afgeroepen

Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the minister whether the Netherlands delayed research into pulse fishing for years, whether the Commission was consulted, and why 84 vessels were licensed for the research. The minister denied any delay, listed Commission contacts and vessel licence timing, and defended the scale of the research programme.
No. Research has been carried out from the very beginning of issuing permits.
Nee. Er is vanaf het begin van de afgifte van toestemmingen onderzoek uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het voortzetten van het succesvolle teeltproject zonder mest Planty Organic

MP Ouwehand asked the minister whether the Planty Organic mineral-self-sufficiency farming project, which received funding from 2013 to 2015 and now lacks money, should be continued and funded. The minister said project funding is always time-limited and renewal is not automatic, noted the project's promising results, and pointed the researchers to the Topsector Agro & Food call for new proposals rather than committing new funding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over de aanvraag voor de status van referentielaboratorium voor Nederlandse instellingen

MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Netherlands applying to host an EU reference laboratory for plant pest and disease identification, and what would happen if no Dutch institution were designated. The minister replied that the NVWA's NRC-fytosanitair is suitable, that hosting a reference laboratory would strengthen Dutch influence, that funding options are being examined, and that she intends to build support at EU level.
At present I am examining, in good faith, the possibilities for responding to this.
Op dit moment onderzoek ik welwillend de mogelijkheden om hierop te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over dieren die verdrinken in hun eigen mest

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about 22 pigs that fell through slatted floors into a slurry pit in Wilp and drowned, and about how inspections of barn floors, animal numbers and welfare rules are enforced. The minister confirms the incident and the cruelty, refuses to disclose the farm's animal numbers citing privacy, explains NVWA's limited inspection role and that no prosecution will follow, and says the matter will be raised with the sector without committing to a specific new measure.
In the context of privacy, I do not consider it appropriate and correct to make the company data public in this individual case.
In het kader van privacy acht ik het niet gepast en correct om de bedrijfsgegevens in dit individuele geval openbaar te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Producten van nieuwe genetische modificatietechnieken moeten strikt als GGO gereguleerd worden’ van het European Network of Scientists for Social and Environmenta

An MP asked the government to comment on an ENSSER article calling for strict GMO regulation of new genetic modification techniques, including off-target effects, biohacking, miniaturisation and bioterrorism risks. The government welcomed the scientific debate, said existing licensing and risk assessment cover these risks, and announced a separate letter on modernising biotechnology regulation.
Your House will shortly be informed in a separate letter about the progress of the modernisation process.
Uw Kamer wordt binnenkort in een separate brief geïnformeerd over de voortgang van het moderniseringstraject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het onderzoek van de commissie-Sorgdrager naar het fipronilschandaal

An MP asked whether the Sorgdrager commission's investigation into the fipronil egg scandal covers all actors in the egg chain, why private-sector representatives sit on its advisory group, and whether civil society groups such as foodwatch are heard. The ministers answer that the commission is independent and broad in scope, that no representatives of investigated organisations sit on the advisory group, and that the government will not steer the commission's findings.
No representatives of organisations that are the subject of the investigation take part in the expert advisory group.
In de klankbordgroep van deskundigen nemen geen vertegenwoordigers deel van organisaties die onderwerp van onderzoek zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Ouwehand over het transport –met dodelijke afloop- van 20.800 kalkoenkuikentjes per vliegtuig van Canada naar Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether the transport by air from Canada to the Netherlands of 20,800 turkey chicks, about 90% of which died, was justified given animal welfare and climate impacts, and asked about inspection, enforcement and sanctions. The minister answered that air transport is allowed under IATA rules if followed, that the cause of death appears to be hypothermia, that the NVWA opened a criminal investigation and drew up a report, and that the case is ongoing so no further statements can be made.
In this specific case the matter is still ongoing and no further statements can be made.
In dit specifieke geval loopt de zaak nog en kunnen geen verdere uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Verbod op spieringvisserij in IJsselmeer’

MP Weverling asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why fishers have been barred from catching smelt in the IJsselmeer, on what legal basis, whether a 2013 report was acted upon, and about stock levels, affected fishers, buy-out compensation and timing of alternatives. The minister answers that the ban dates from 2009, cites the legal grounds, confirms the 2013 advice was shared with fishers, reports declining smelt stocks and Natura 2000 targets not being met, and says a new assessment framework will follow this year.
Furthermore, WMR advises, from the precautionary principle, not to permit fishing on spawning smelt any longer.
Daarnaast adviseert WMR om vanuit het «voorzorgsbeginsel» de visserij op de paaiende spiering niet meer toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht dat agrarische adviseurs de noodklok luiden over aanpassingen van het stikstofrekenmodel AERIUS

Member Bisschop (SGP) asked the minister about reports that changes to the AERIUS nitrogen calculation model cause unexpected rejections of permit applications where ammonia emissions stay the same or fall. The minister acknowledges that small relocations of emission points can cause unexpected deposition results, says only a few permit applications are affected, and promises to keep refining the model in the continuous development of the PAS, without committing to a formal evaluation with stakeholders.
The occurrence of this kind of unexpected calculation result is known.
Het voorkomen van dit soort onverwachte rekenresultaten is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over het bericht dat cijfers CBS ervoor zorgen dat de prijs van uien laag blijft

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked whether CBS onion harvest estimates, repeatedly revised, depress onion prices and whether mandatory CBS survey participation is enforced with fines. The minister answered that CBS figures inform market prices without determining them, provided five years of revision data, and that no fines apply for 2016 and 2017 under a letter of intent.
The CBS does not have data on the onion prices that growers receive.
Het CBS beschikt niet over uienprijzen die de telers ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over artikel 14 van de Meststoffenwet

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the accuracy of sampling manure phosphate content, the court's suspension of fine cases, and how article 14 of the Meststoffenwet is enforced. The Minister defended the sampling accuracy, said both phosphate and nitrogen must be accounted for, and declined to break down fines by sector or give fine collection figures, citing lack of capacity.
The type of company is not separately registered for entrepreneurs who receive a fine, so I cannot answer this question.
Van de ondernemers die een boete krijgen wordt het type bedrijf niet apart geregistreerd. Ik kan deze vraag daarom niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het advies 'Nieuwe landbouwhuisdieren' van de Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture about the Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet advice on new farm animals such as insects and worms, including whether they contribute to the manure problem and whether a separate manure category should be created. The Minister acknowledges the advice, says insects and worms do excrete manure and contribute to the problem, and promises a decision on possible changes to the regulation before summer 2018.
I will make a choice before the summer of 2018.
Ik zal voor de zomer 2018 een keuze maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Lodders over de Colombiaanse antidumpingprocedure tegen de Nederlandse aardappelsector

Two MPs asked whether Colombia's anti-dumping investigation into frozen potato products from Dutch, German and Belgian producers was procedurally and substantively sound, and whether the Netherlands would push the European Commission to take it to the WTO. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares concerns about the procedure and has lobbied Colombia and the Commission, but that a WTO case can only be brought by the Commission once definitive measures exist, with a decision expected in March 2018.
On the basis of the facts now available, the Netherlands already urged the European Commission at the trade policy committee of 16 February 2018 to seriously consider this step.
Nederland heeft er op basis van de nu voorliggende feiten in het handelspolitiek comité van 16 februari 2018 reeds bij de Europese Commissie op aangedrongen deze stap serieus te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over diverse berichten over dierenleed in de Oostvaardersplassen

An MP asked the minister about reports of animal suffering in the Oostvaardersplassen and whether the 2016 agreement with Flevoland adequately implements a parliamentary motion. The minister declined to judge the reports, said Flevoland's provincial executive is responsible for animal welfare policy, rejected an evaluation or new agreement for now, and pointed to an independent review by the Commissie-Van Geel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Willekeur bij publicatie voedselveiligheidswaarschuwingen”

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers why food safety warnings were published late or not at all by the NVWA, and how consumers could find them in one place. The minister replied that companies must issue public warnings themselves, that the NVWA can only require companies to publish, not to report to it, and that the NVWA will tighten its internal procedures and urge companies to notify faster.
In the TV broadcast the NVWA promised it would tighten its internal procedures so that public warnings are published faster.
In de Tv-uitzending heeft de NVWA toegezegd dat ze haar interne werkwijze gaat aanscherpen zodat publiekswaarschuwingen sneller worden gepubliceerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over de uitzending van Rambam, waaruit blijkt dat trainers (politie)honden ernstig mishandelen
