An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a broadcast showing abuse of police dogs during training with electronic collars, slip chains and prong collars, and asked why the amending decree banning such tools has not yet entered into force. The minister called the footage shocking, said the amendment is aimed for 1 July 2018 with the electric collar rules delayed, and largely declined to ban sale or use of these tools, pointing to the sector's responsibility and risk-based enforcement.
The aim is for the amending decree to enter into force on 1 July 2018.
Het streven is om het wijzigingsbesluit per 1-7-2018 in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over NL Jaagt aflevering 20 waarin les wordt gegeven in illegale dodingsmethoden

An MP asked the minister whether a hunting training video (NL Jaagt episode 20) teaching neck-breaking (cervical dislocation) of wounded geese was illegal, and whether the firm Duke Faunabeheer should still receive permits and public contracts. The minister confirmed the method is not allowed for geese, said provinces decide on permits, declined to provide data on payments and animals killed, and said she intends to address the presenters on the video's content while considering enforcement adequate.
I do not have information on whom the provinces grant exemptions and assignments to, or what costs are involved.
Ik beschik niet over informatie aan wie provincies ontheffingen en opdrachten verlenen en welke kosten daarmee zijn gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Slootweg over het bericht 'Boer kan fipronil-mest niet kwijt'

MPs Geurts and Slootweg asked why farmers forced to burn fipronil-contaminated manure at an incineration plant must pay waste tax while the Moerdijk plant is exempt, and whether the levy should be waived. The minister confirmed the tax applies by law, rejected a temporary exemption given greening policy in the coalition agreement, and pointed to a protocol and other processing options.
Amending the Wbm to include an exemption or zero rate in the waste tax for incidental cases is not appropriate.
Een aanpassing van de Wbm om in de ASB voor incidentele gevallen een vrijstelling of nihiltarief op te nemen ligt niet in de rede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Nederlands echec rond pulsvisserij is eigen schuld'

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether the European Commission ever formally approved the large Dutch expansion of pulse fishing permits, whether other member states were consulted, and what was done about EU complaints. The minister replies that the permits rest on three categories of approval (regular rules, a bilateral research agreement, and facilitation of the landing obligation), that the Commission confirmed them, and that other member states were only informed at official level.
From the above it appears that the European Commission cooperated in the expansion of experimental pulse fishing.
Uit bovenstaande blijkt dat de Europese Commissie medewerking heeft gegeven aan de uitbreiding van de experimentele pulsvisserij
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of Brexit for the Netherlands, focusing on a customs impact memo, customs staffing needs (500-800 extra staff), IT readiness and the timing of recruitment. The government answered that the Douane and NVWA are recruiting within existing frameworks, that analyses for internal deliberation will not be shared, and that preparations continue ahead of March 2019.
The analyses requested by your House were, however, prepared for internal deliberation and it is undesirable that they become the subject of political debate.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde analyses zijn echter opgesteld voor intern beraad en het is onwenselijk dat zij onderwerp zijn van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht «Hap, slik en weg is het insectenbedrijf»

De Groot (D66) asked the minister whether insects are nutritious and environmentally better than meat, why the NVWA was slow issuing an export certificate, whether EU rules on insect feed and food are unclear, and whether government will help insect firms with legal problems. Minister Schouten answered that insects are nutritious and have lower planetary impact, that the NVWA needed more time due to initial uncertainty and Swiss extra conditions, that EU rules are being clarified step by step, and that a Green Deal and talks with the sector are underway.
My ministry will also soon enter into talks with Venik about the information needed to obtain export certificates.
Tevens gaat mijn ministerie op korte termijn in gesprek met de Venik over de benodigde informatie voor het verkrijgen van exportcertificaten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat België haar pluimveehouders, die getroffen zijn door de fipronilcrisis, mag compenseren

An MP asked whether the minister knows that Belgium may compensate poultry farmers hit by the fipronil crisis and whether the Netherlands will do the same for farmers not at fault. The minister confirmed awareness but declined to compensate, arguing the fipronil-free product was not permitted in the Netherlands, damage by private parties is primarily the businesses' responsibility, and restraint is warranted given ongoing legal proceedings.
Government compensation is not at issue if damage was caused by the actions of private parties.
Compensatie door de overheid is niet aan de orde als schade is veroorzaakt door het handelen van private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Dik-Faber over de fipronilschade van pluimveehouders

MPs Geurts and Dik-Faber asked the minister about the European Commission's approval of Belgian compensation for fipronil-contaminated poultry farmers, whether this creates an unequal playing field, and what support is available. The minister answered that the Commission deems the crisis to fall under compensable exceptional events for Belgium only, that compensation is not due for damage caused by private parties and that the Dutch position is unchanged, while listing Dutch support measures and noting the Commission found no distortion of competition.
Government compensation is not at issue if damage was caused by the actions of private parties.
Compensatie door de overheid is niet aan de orde als schade is veroorzaakt door het handelen van private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of a hard Brexit for the Netherlands, including the KPMG report on non-tariff trade barriers, planned actions, customs and inspection capacity, and information provision to businesses. The government answered that it is intensifying business information, hiring extra customs and NVWA staff, and that the cost of a hard Brexit is estimated at about 1.2% of GDP, while stressing that the EU-UK arrangements are still under negotiation.
The precise effect on employment is difficult to estimate, because trade can also shift to other countries and new jobs can therefore also arise.
Het precieze effect op de werkgelegenheid is moeilijk in te schatten, omdat handel zich ook kan verplaatsten naar andere landen en er dus ook weer nieuwe banen kunnen ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over gezelschapsdieren met erfelijke gezondheidsproblemen

An MP asks the minister about breeding of companion animals with hereditary health problems, including enforcement of article 3.4 of the animal keepers decree, the lack of concrete criteria, the weak criminal follow-up after warnings, and a proposal to reverse the burden of proof. The minister answers that enforcement is hard because the norm is open, that criteria are being developed with NVWA, LID and NGOs with results expected mid-2018, that warnings have been issued and prosecution is possible, and that the reversed burden of proof is not pursued but a clearer guideline is needed.
I am investigating, in consultation with the NVWA, LID and several NGOs, how to make the ban on harmful breeding of animals more enforceable.
Ik onderzoek in samenspraak met de NVWA, LID en enkele ngo's hoe het verbod van het op een schadelijke manier fokken van dieren beter handhaafbaar te maken is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de hoge aantallen dode, gewonde en kreupele kippen in eierboerderijen, ook die met een Beter Leven-keurmerk

An MP asks the minister about high mortality and injury among laying hens in all housing systems, including Beter Leven-certified farms, and about the animal welfare duty, the snavelkap ban, stocking density and subsidies for the egg sector. The minister acknowledges the footage is concerning and that mortality is around 8%, says no stricter stocking rules will be imposed beyond EU law, and says the beak-trimming evaluation will be discussed with the steering group before informing parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het nieuws dat dode en kreupele kippen zijn aangetroffen in een eierboerderij

SP MP Futselaar asked the minister about undercover footage showing dead and lame hens on egg farms, including organic, Beter Leven and Rondeel farms, and whether these farms were recently inspected. The minister confirmed the footage is known but could not confirm the locations, said NVWA checks found no violations, outlined applicable welfare rules, admitted mortality data are limited, and offered to discuss proposals with the sector and animal welfare groups.
I cannot confirm whether the footage was indeed recorded at the listed addresses.
Ik kan niet bevestigen of de beelden inderdaad opgenomen zijn op de vermelde adressen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over het bericht dat jagers in 2018 wasberen mogen afschieten

An MP asked the minister why raccoons were classed as unwanted, the basis for culling in Gelderland, and whether the province would be consulted. The minister replied that the EU lists the raccoon as invasive, that member states must act against established populations, and that the province and a wildlife management unit are drafting a plan, with provinces to be made responsible through a regulation change.

A change to the Nature Conservation Regulation is currently being prepared, under which, with the consent of the provincial executives, the provinces will be charged with carrying out eradication, management and restoration measures for invasive alien species on their provincial territory.

Thans is een wijziging van de Regeling natuurbescherming in voorbereiding waarmee, met instemming van gedeputeerde staten van de provincies, de provincies worden belast met de uitvoering van uitroeiings-, beheers- en herstelmaatregelen ten aanzien van invasieve uitheemse soorten op hun provinciale grondgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebruik van uit het wild gevangen beschermde dieren in een dierexperiment

An MP asked the minister about trapping wild protected starlings and jackdaws for animal experiments at the University of Groningen and whether the ethics review was public. The minister answered that the animals are protected but the Central Committee on Animal Experiments approved the project under a 2015 exemption, that ethics advice and non-technical summaries are published, and that she sees no reason to halt the project.
Transparency about animal experiments is my first priority.
Transparantie over dierproeven staat bij mij voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over illegale verkoop van glyfosaat via Marktplaats

An SP MP asked the minister whether illegal online sales of glyphosate on Marktplaats were acceptable, what action would be taken against sellers, and whether a private-market ban should be pursued. The minister called the findings worrying, promised talks with Marktplaats and outlined NVWA enforcement, but rejected a private-market ban as unnecessary given existing legal powers.
I will consult with Marktplaats to make agreements ensuring that only authorised products with proper information are offered.
Ik zal met Marktplaats in overleg treden om afspraken te maken zodat kan worden geborgd dat alleen toegelaten middelen met de juiste voorlichting worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht “Experts luiden noodklok over falende aanpak tijgermug”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Health and Agriculture about expert warnings that the approach to the tiger mosquito is failing, and whether the NVWA can monitor and control invasive exotic mosquitoes and their introduction via products such as used tyres and Lucky Bamboo. The minister says the NVWA monitors risk locations and businesses with traps, that the ministries fund monitoring and control, and that existing preventive measures are sufficient, while acknowledging that the imported products cannot be checked directly at borders given free movement in the EU.
I consider the monitoring of and supervision over businesses and the monitoring at risk locations (see also the answer to question 2) sufficient.
Ik acht de monitoring van en het toezicht op bedrijven en de monitoring op de risicolocaties (zie ook het antwoord op vraag 2) voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de Fosfaatwet de doodsteek voor levend erfgoed wordt

An MP asked whether the Phosphate Act would lead to the extinction of old Dutch cattle breeds and what the government would do to prevent it. The minister confirmed awareness, explained that the Fertilisers Act offers no exemption for rare-breed cattle while the 2017 phosphate reduction regulation under the Agriculture Act did, and said alternative support for these breeds is being examined.

I am currently examining, in addition to my general commitment to preserving genetic resources and the additional subsidy for the Stichting Zeldzame Huisdierrassen under motion 34 775 XIII, no. 40, which suitable options exist to further support the preservation of old Dutch cattle breeds.

Ik bekijk momenteel, in aanvulling op mijn algemene inzet op het behoud van genetische bronnen en de aanvullende subsidie voor de Stichting Zeldzame Huisdierrassen op basis van motie 34 775 XIII, nr. 40 van Dik-Faber/De Groot, welke passende mogelijkheden er zijn om het behoud van oud-Hollandse rundveerassen verder te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het rapport The Hidden Cost of UK Food

MP De Groot asked whether the government would commission a Dutch equivalent of the UK 'Hidden Cost of Food' report, with attention to underpayment of farmers, and how it views initiatives to make external costs transparent. Minister Schouten answered that the government will explore with stakeholders and research institutes how to test practical approaches to external costs, without committing to a new report on farmer underpayment.

I intend, as a follow-up to the study by Wageningen Economic Research and True Price and other relevant studies, as well as the results of 10 October, to explore in discussion with societal parties and knowledge institutions the desirability and possibilities.

Ik heb het voornemen om als vervolg op de studie van Wageningen Economic Research en True Price en andere relevante studies, alsook de resultaten van 10 oktober in gesprek met maatschappelijke partijen en kennisinstellingen de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheden te verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Duitsland vreest oprukkende zwijnenpest'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about spread of African swine fever toward Germany and the Netherlands, including hygiene measures, controls and wild boar risk. The minister answered that spread is mainly linked to human activity, that EU and national measures (transport rules, disinfection, hunter and sector communication, monitoring) are in place, and that no change of strategy is needed for now.
I support the European Commission's initiatives for the approach, but I also acknowledge the problems with combating it in wild boar.
Ik steun de initiatieven van de Europese Commissie voor de aanpak, maar ik onderken ook de problemen met de bestrijding ervan in de wilde zwijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het lucratief bemesten van andermans grond

MP Moorlag asked the Minister of Agriculture about farmers unlawfully injecting manure into third-party or municipal land, whether this goes unpunished, and how it will be tackled. The minister said the case appears more nuanced than reported, pointed to RVO.nl checks and the procedure for reporting unlawfully claimed land, and promised a joint analysis with the municipality of Berkelland to be reported to parliament.
It has been agreed with the mayor of Berkelland, Mr Van Oostrum, that a joint analysis will be carried out shortly of what is happening and of everyone's responsibilities.
Met de burgemeester van Berkelland, de heer Van Oostrum, is afgesproken dat op korte termijn gezamenlijk geanalyseerd zal worden wat er speelt en wat daarbij ieders verantwoordelijkheden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'De overheid is de regie kwijt in het bestrijden van overlast van ratten'

An MP from the CDA asked ministers about reports that government has lost control of rat control, including the health risks, the RIVM rat monitoring, WHO advice, the status of an initiative group, the effectiveness of integrated pest management and public information for households. The ministers answered that three ministries share responsibility, that no national plague or clear rise in rat-related disease is visible, that existing legal frameworks cover prevention, and that monitoring, a planned effectiveness study and consumer information are under way.
Three ministries jointly lead the control of rat nuisance.
Er zijn drie ministeries die gezamenlijk regie voeren op het bestrijden van overlast van ratten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over de berichten over grootschalige mestfraude

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture why a 2015 NVWA compliance report on manure intermediaries was not sent to parliament, why it was not mentioned at a June 2017 round table, why a planned compliance measurement for livestock was not completed, and about fines, enforcement capacity and the cabinet response to a PBL evaluation estimating 30-40% of manure is traded illegally. The minister answered that the NVWA stopped compliance measurements due to animal welfare workload and derogation-related reprioritisation, reported fine levels and criminal sanctions, pointed to ongoing enforcement measures, and promised the cabinet response to the PBL report before year-end.
Since 2014 your House has been informed with some regularity about the approach to manure fraud.
Sinds 2014 is uw Kamer met enige regelmaat geïnformeerd over de aanpak van fraude met mest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het nieuws dat ieder jaar dertig miljoen dieren in de Nederlandse veehouderij te vroeg sterven

Member Futselaar (SP) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how she responds to reports that some 30 million animals die prematurely each year in Dutch livestock farming, and whether the sector's mortality figures are accurate, along with questions on whether 550 million animals per year is acceptable and whether low profit margins cause animal suffering. The Minister answered that high mortality is a concern, that sectors are working on plans to reduce it, that the primary responsibility lies with keepers under the Animal Welfare Act, that no national legal norm is planned, and that she will discuss livestock volume and environmental issues with industry and provinces.
I do not consider lowering the mortality rates to be an issue that can be regulated with a national legal norm.
Het verlagen van de sterftecijfers vind ik niet een vraagstuk dat geregeld kan worden met een nationale wettelijke norm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Greenpeace beschuldigt Nederlandse bedrijven van handel in 'bloedhout''

MP De Groot (D66) asked the ministers whether Brazilian timber from Para, Mato Grosso and Rondonia should be treated as high risk, whether NVWA enforcement will be strengthened, and how illegal timber can be kept off the Dutch market after Greenpeace accused Dutch firms of trading illegally logged hardwood. Minister Schouten answered that illegality is widespread in Brazilian forestry, that the NVWA is sharpening its intervention policy from early 2018, that enforcement capacity will be reviewed without firm commitment, and that the primary responsibility lies with importers, so illegal timber cannot be fully excluded.
Instead of always warning first, the NVWA will directly impose an order subject to a penalty for certain serious violations.
In plaats van altijd eerst waarschuwen zal de NVWA bij bepaalde, zware overtredingen direct een last onder dwangsom opleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat banken brandonveilige stallen financieren

An SP MP asked the Agriculture and Finance ministers whether banks financing livestock barns should check fire safety, and whether the state should press state-owned banks on animal welfare and fire prevention. Minister Schouten replied that fire safety rules fall on municipalities and regional environmental services, banks have no formal role but are welcome to add fire-prevention conditions, state-owned banks are bound only by normal law, and she is willing to talk with the Dutch Banking Association.
Banks have no formal responsibility in this context.
Banken hebben geen formele verantwoordelijkheid in dit kader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Van den Hul over de mogelijke Amerikaanse import van jachttrofeeën uit Afrika

Two Dutch PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they knew of reports that the US planned to lift its ban on elephant trophy imports from Zimbabwe and Zambia, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister confirmed awareness, noted Trump had reportedly suspended the plan, and said the Netherlands keeps its own import ban and will raise illegal wildlife trade at EU and CITES level, without committing to specific country-level action.
In European and global CITES settings, the Netherlands will continue to call for adequate measures to combat illegal trade in wildlife products.
In Europees en mondiaal CITES-verband zal Nederland aandacht blijven vragen voor adequate maatregelen om illegale handel in wildlife producten tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over oprukkende varkenspest in Polen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that African swine fever is spreading westward in Poland, including the risk to the Netherlands, NVWA preparedness, and extra border hygiene checks. The minister answered that the risk is taken seriously, that the NVWA is prepared through exercises and standby contracts, and that existing EU and national transport and disinfection rules apply, with the sector reminded of its responsibilities.
Yes. The NVWA has experience in combating contagious animal diseases.
Ja. De NVWA heeft ervaring met het bestrijden van besmettelijke dierziekten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over de arrestatie in een zaak van illegale hondenhandel

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers why the police and regulators did not stop a dog trader sooner despite earlier findings of misconduct and zoning violations, and how many dogs were affected. The minister declined to discuss the ongoing criminal investigation, pointed to NVWA's primary responsibility and to planned measures against illegal dog trade.
As for the rest, I cannot make further statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Voor wat betreft het overige kan ik geen nadere mededelingen doen over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Groot over het bericht 'Volkerak weer deels opengesteld'

A D66 MP asked the ministers whether opening part of the Volkerak to eel and mitten crab fishing is justified given dioxin and PCB contamination, ICES advice against eel fishing, and proposed EU zero catch limits. The minister answered that the opening followed the policy rule applied to measured eel contamination, that two extra areas were closed, that a national autumn fishing ban exists, and that the EU measures and 2018 reporting will be monitored.
I consider this decision to be correct, because the policy rule has been applied.
Ik beoordeel dit besluit als juist, omdat de beleidsregel is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “Stoot Nederlandse melkkoe meeste of minste methaan uit binnen Europa”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether differing EU member-state methods for estimating dairy cow methane emissions create an uneven playing field and whether Dutch methods should be harmonised. The minister answered that the IPCC-based, differentiated methods are mandatory and effective, that the earlier high figures were outdated and recalculated, and that no further harmonisation steps are needed.
I do not consider additional steps necessary, because the differences in calculation method are in line with international agreements and depend on the size of the source.
Ik acht aanvullende stappen niet nodig, want de verschillen in berekeningsmethode zijn overeenkomstig internationale afspraken en afhankelijk van de omvang van de bron.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over gezondheidsrisico’s van geitenhouderijen voor omwonenden

An MP from the Labour party asked the minister about health risks of goat farms for nearby residents, the province of Overijssel refusing research and restrictions that other provinces had, and whether national standards and national research should follow. The minister answered that the RIVM study found higher pneumonia risk near goat farms, that the cause is unknown, that follow-up research will run until about 2020, and that more insight is needed before risk-reducing measures can be set.
I share the need to gain insight into the causes of increased disease burden around goat farms, because this is a worrying signal.
Ik deel de noodzaak om inzicht te krijgen in de oorzaken van verhoogde ziektedruk rond geitenhouderijen, want dit is een zorgelijk signaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Friesland een belangrijk illegaal jachtveld voor roofvogels is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that Friesland is a major illegal hunting area for birds of prey, including whether enforcement capacity is sufficient. The minister called the figures worrying, said no sources confirm Vogelbescherming's suspicions of poisoning to remove competitors, pointed to green enforcement officers and ongoing agreements, and sent population data for raptors up to 2016.
I am not aware of any sources that confirm Vogelbescherming's suspicions on this point.
Mij zijn geen bronnen bekend die de vermoedens van Vogelbescherming op dit punt bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de berichten dat er dertig procent minder leven is in de Noordzee door sleepnetten

An SP MP asked the minister about reports of a 30% decline in North Sea life linked to beam trawling, and whether trawling should be curbed or banned. The minister acknowledges trawling harms some benthic species but says multiple causes are involved, notes reduced trawling intensity and new gear, and offers to discuss the research with parliament.
I am of course willing to discuss this research with your House.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid om dit onderzoek met uw Kamer te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Aanzienlijk minder dieren in Noordzee'

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether she knew of reports of a sharp decline in North Sea animal life, whether the reported 30% average decline could be confirmed, and what the causes were and how the decline would be halted. The minister confirmed awareness and said a single average figure cannot be drawn from the CBS data across 140 species, and referred to an earlier answer for causes and measures.
I refer you for this to the answer to question 4 from Member Futselaar (SP)
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar het antwoord op vraag 4 van het lid Futselaar (SP)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Geurts en Dijkgraaf over het bericht van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek over het Living Planet Report

MPs Bruins, Geurts and Dijkgraaf asked about a CBS Living Planet Report claim that bottom trawling is a major cause of decline in North Sea benthic fauna, which Wageningen Marine Research said could not be concluded from its data, and about CBS's paid work for interest groups. The minister confirms the data sources, says CBS corrected the claim to attribute the finding to Wageningen research, and states that CBS's paid-work terms preserve its independence, while declining to go further on rectification or apology.
CBS concluded that its original report of 30 October required adjustments on some points and published a revised version on 3 November.
Het CBS is tot de conclusie gekomen dat het oorspronkelijke bericht van 30 oktober jl. op enkele punten aanpassing behoefde en heeft op 3 november jl. een aangepaste versie gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de dramatische effecten van sleepnetten op de Noordzee

The MP Wassenberg asked whether the minister knows of research showing a 30% decline in seabed fauna in the North Sea, largely due to beam trawling, and whether beam trawling and pulse fishing should be phased out and seabed life protected with ambitious recovery goals. The minister confirmed the 30% finding, referred to earlier answers for the trawling questions, described pulse fishing as a promising less damaging alternative with ongoing long-term research, and referred again to earlier answers on protection.
The pulse gear is lighter than the traditional beam trawl, so the gear penetrates the seabed less deeply.
Het pulstuig is lichter dan de traditionele boomkor, waardoor het tuig de zeebodem minder diep penetreert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Q-koorts is geconstateerd in de gemeente Bodegraven-Reeuwijk

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Q-fever infection cluster of three people in Bodegraven-Reeuwijk, including the source investigation, nearby livestock vaccination, public information and the advice to residents. The minister answered that GGD and NVWA are jointly investigating the source, that a nearby farm lacking vaccination was ordered to vaccinate, and that the GGD informed GPs and the municipality, while the source remains unknown.
The GGD and the NVWA are jointly conducting research to find the source of this infection.
De GGD en de NVWA voeren gezamenlijk onderzoek uit om de bron van deze besmetting te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het plan van 100.000 hectare nieuw bos

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the status of a sector proposal to create 100,000 hectares of new forest, which is part of an Action Plan Forest & Timber with an estimated extra CO2 storage of 4.2 Mton per year by 2050. The minister answered that a draft programme plan was presented, that the parties want to discuss implementation with the national government, and that she is willing to explore with the sector how forests can contribute to the climate ambitions.
I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Becker over het bericht ‘Oekraïne wil tafeleieren naar Europa brengen’

MPs Lodders and Becker asked whether Ukrainian table eggs will soon be exported to the EU and whether they meet EU animal welfare and food safety standards. The minister answered that an EU-approved exporter exists, that Ukraine is phasing in EU standards by 2021 under the association agreement, and that EU egg import quotas leave the Dutch and EU producers largely unaffected.
The cabinet will continue to keep itself informed of progress.
Het kabinet zal zich blijvend op de hoogte laten stellen van de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over Roundup

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about glyphosate (Roundup): its effects on soil life, use in grassland reset and pre-planting weed control, and discrepancies between sales figures from Nefyto and CBS usage statistics. The Minister said current soil norms are not exceeded so further research is not needed, promised an inventory of glyphosate use and talks with the sector, and said she would discuss better measurement of use with CBS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het nalaten te handhaven op illegale jachthutten door de Omgevingsdiensten

An MP asked the minister why illegal hunting huts in the Biesbosch were not removed after a February 2017 enforcement request, including questions on handling by the Omgevingsdiensten and whether animals were illegally killed. The minister replied that the Omgevingsdiensten act under provincial responsibility, so she would not comment on their conduct, that huts are not an offence under the Wet natuurbescherming per se, and that the province has no evidence of illegal killings.
The Omgevingsdiensten work on behalf of and under the responsibility of the provinces. It is therefore not for me to respond to the working methods of these services.
De Omgevingsdiensten werken in opdracht van en onder verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies. Het is derhalve niet aan mij om een reactie te geven omtrent de werk- en handelwijze van de deze diensten.

requests the government to make a decision as soon as possible with the region on tackling the problems on the N35

requests the Minister to discuss with the province of Overijssel, based on a traffic study, whether transfer of the N35 is possible

Motie van de het lid Remco Dijkstra over het afwegen van nut en noodzaak van het project Zuidasdok
Asks the Minister to weigh the need for and necessity of the Zuidasdok project, examine whether it solves the public transport and congestion problems, and propose scaling it down.
requests the Minister to weigh the usefulness and necessity of the Zuidasdok project

Motie van het lid De Pater-Postma c.s. over de verdere MIRT-planning van de N35

With this amendment an amount is reserved in article 22 External safety and risks for co-financing cleanup of drug dumping
Met dit amendement wordt in artikel 22 Externe veiligheid en risico’s een bedrag gereserveerd voor «cofinanciering opruiming drugsdumpingen»
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Çegerek en Remco Dijkstra ter vervanging van nr. 17 waarmee een bedrag wordt gereserveerd voor de cofinanciering van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen
Amendment moving a sum within the budget from external safety to sustainability to co-finance clean-up of drug waste dumping by municipalities.
With this amendment an amount is reserved under article 21 Sustainability for co-financing the clean-up of drug dumpings.
Met dit amendement wordt in artikel 21 Duurzaamheid een bedrag gereserveerd voor «cofinanciering opruiming drugsdumpingen».
Motie van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Jan Vos over de bijmengverplichting voor biobrandstoffen
Asks the government to set the biofuel blending obligation through 2020 with a 10% end target.
requests the government to set the biofuel blending obligation for the years through 2020
verzoekt de regering om, de bijmengverplichting voor biobrandstoffen voor de jaren tot en met 2020 vast te stellen
Motie van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de makelaarsfunctie bij het verkrijgen van grondstoffen
Asks the government to act on a broker (makelaar) role helping businesses, especially SMEs, obtain and reuse scarce raw materials, and to inform the House on implementation.
Amendement van de leden Çegerek en Remco Dijkstra waarmee 1 miljoen euro wordt vrijgemaakt voor het opruimen van dumpingen van drugsafval
Adds 1 million euro in the budget for co-financing municipal clean-up of illegal drug-waste dumping, with forensic investigation of polluters.
with which dumping of drug waste can be cleaned up
waarmee dumpingen van drugsafval kunnen worden opgeruimd

Amendement van het lid Remco Dijkstra waarin € 100 (x € 1 000) wordt vrijgemaakt voor Climate Dialogue, om zo op een goede, neutrale wijze een discussie over klimaatverandering en –beleid tussen versc
Moves 100 thousand euro within the climate budget to fund Climate Dialogue, a discussion forum between scientist groups.
This amendment frees up 100 thousand euro for Climate Dialogue
Dit amendement maakt € 100 (x € 1.000) vrij voor Climate Dialogue
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de berichten '5G knokt om bandbreedte met levensreddend satellietstation voor schepen' en 'Reders bezorgd over ontmantelen Burum'

MPs Weverling, Remco Dijkstra and Aukje de Vries asked about reports on 5G interference with Inmarsat's Burum satellite station used for maritime emergency communications and on the station's possible dismantling, asking about consultations, alternatives, and timelines. The minister answered that an October 2023 agreement with Inmarsat to migrate emergency-traffic services to Greece secures maritime safety, while noting delays in answering and that no consultation with the province or municipality occurred.

Due to the agreement with Inmarsat, emergency, urgency and safety traffic is secured and there are no longer doubts about whether the Netherlands can sufficiently fulfil its obligations for maritime safety under international treaties.

Door de overeenstemming met Inmarsat is het nood-, spoed- en veiligheidsverkeer geborgd en zijn er geen twijfels meer over de vraag of Nederland de verplichtingen voor de veiligheid op zee onder de internationale verdragen voldoende kan uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Remco Dijkstra en Wiersma over het bericht dat het metropakket MRA een serieuze optie is voor financiering uit Nationaal Groeifonds

VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the Amsterdam metropolitan package (extending the North/South line and closing the ring line) was a serious option for Nationaal Groeifonds funding, including housing numbers, port land use, social housing shares and land revenues. The government answered in detail on the proposal, its costs, housing figures and port policy, reserving 1.5 billion euros for the North/South line extension but declining to calculate some counterfactuals and leaving the exact land-revenue effects undetermined.
For the reason given above, this calculation cannot be made.
Om de reden die hiervoor werd gegeven is deze berekening niet te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Subsidieregeling Elektrische Personenauto’s Particulieren’

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked about the oversubscribed 2021 EV subsidy for private buyers, budget allocation, lottery use, and whether the subsidy should be cut to stimulate more purchases. The state secretary answered that the 2021 budget was EUR 14.4 million, that the rules were changed in 2020 to stop carrying over applications, and that she sees no reason to lower the per-car subsidy before an interim evaluation.
I will inform your House about the results of the planned interim evaluation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de geplande tussentijdse evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel 'Nederland tegen Brussel: schiet op met ban op verbrandingsmotor'

MP Remco Dijkstra asked the state secretary whether a Volkskrant article about a Dutch call for a ban on new combustion-engine car sales from 2030 matches the non-paper, whether a national sales ban is intended, and whether the market should be left to act. The state secretary answered that the government wants 100% zero-emission new sales by 2030, prefers tightening EU CO2 standards over a national ban, supports supplementary national incentives, and disagrees that the market alone should be left to deliver.
The cabinet aims for 100% zero-emission new sales in 2030. It prefers to achieve this through EU legislation.
Het kabinet streeft naar 100% zero-emissie nieuwverkoop in 2030. Het heeft de voorkeur om dit via EU-wetgeving te bereiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Waterbedrijven willen tarieven kunnen verhogen’

Dutch MP Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about drinking water companies wanting to raise tariffs and seeing the WACC profit cap as an obstacle to investment. The minister said tariffs must be cost-covering, that the ILT is researching the companies' financial situation and planned investments, and that a WACC extension power has been added to the Drinkwaterwet as a short-term safeguard, with longer-term solutions to be developed with the sector.
Once this investigation is completed, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de funderingsproblematiek

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about foundation damage in cities and rural areas, including costs to homeowners, the Fonds Duurzaam Funderingsherstel, the role of KCAF and RVO, and innovation for bacterial decay of wooden piles. The government answered that the problem is poorly quantified and complex, that the loan fund has issued only 34 loans, that KCAF declined cooperation, and that the Rijksprogramma Aanpak Funderingsproblematiek will be developed further in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel 'Het zoet en zuur van 'verkenner' Van Geel bij Maastricht Airport'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a newspaper article on the advice of an independent explorer for Maastricht Airport, covering cargo versus passenger flights, runway length, cargo volume forecasts, night closure, and the airport's viability. The minister answered that the province of Limburg, as owner, will decide the airport's future and any new licence application, that the ministry will not comment prematurely, and that night closure will remain for noise reasons.

Your House was previously informed about the reason for not continuing the procedure of the Maastricht Airport Decision, which would have allowed use of the full available runway length of 2,750 metres.

Uw Kamer is eerder geïnformeerd over de aanleiding om de procedure van het Luchthavenbesluit Maastricht, waarmee het gebruik van de volledige beschikbare baanlengte van 2.750 meter mogelijk werd gemaakt, niet voort te zetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Aukje de Vries en Veldman over de problematiek rondom bemanningswisselingen en vaccinatie van zeevarenden

MPs from the VVD asked about crew changes and vaccination of seafarers, including test requirements at foreign airports, the feasibility of arrival testing, vaccine rollout delays such as in the Philippines, and private vaccination options. The minister acknowledged the difficulties, extended the antigen test validity to 24 hours, and said the RIVM is examining how seafarers can access existing vaccination routes, without committing to new parliamentary reporting.
I will inform your House when there are new developments regarding the points above.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren op het moment dat er met betrekking tot bovenstaande punten nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel uit Nieuwsblad Transport d.d. 14 januari 2021 “Helpende hand voor rood-wit-blauw”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat about declining Dutch flag popularity, fleet growth and decline, Maersk reflagging to Liberia, and plans for a maritime authority. The minister answered that the flag is a quality flag, that a fiscal evaluation is underway, that a transition toward a maritime authority will be decided after summer 2021, and that the answers are given in full, but without concrete new commitments beyond those plans.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de artikelen 'CBR neemt weer motorexamens af' en 'CBR moet 600.000 examens inhalen'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that the CBR driving test agency must catch up on about 610,000 exams after COVID lockdowns, and about the implications for motorcycle exams and waiting times. The minister confirmed the backlog, said motorcycle practical exams can resume safely outdoors, and said concrete measures will be sent to parliament once agreed with the CBR.
As I wrote in my letter to the House of Representatives of 16 February, I am currently consulting with the CBR about their proposals.
Zoals ik in mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 16 februari heb geschreven, ben ik op dit moment in overleg met het CBR over hun voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Elektrische auto duurder in onderhoud dan brandstofauto's'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that electric cars cost more to maintain than combustion cars, tyre-wear particulate emissions, and cybersecurity of charging infrastructure. The government disputed the maintenance claim, cited research that EVs emit less fine particulate overall, and said cybersecurity rules for charging points are being developed, with a 2021 advisory report expected.
WESP B.V. is a private limited company and has not given us insight into this data.
2 is een Besloten Vennootschap (B.V.) en heeft ons geen inzicht gegeven in deze data.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht in Nieuwsblad Transport over Mautclaim

MP Remco Dijkstra asked the minister whether the government supports about 600 Dutch firms reclaiming excess German truck toll for 2017, whether Dutch exposure to similar CJEU-linked claims exists, and how TLN's no-cure-no-pay claims arrangement is viewed. The minister answered that the claims are a matter between firms and the German state, that the German court must still rule, that no consequences for the Netherlands are expected because enforcement costs were excluded from the tariff calculation, and that the arrangement is for individual firms to use.
I cannot interfere in any possible legal proceedings.
Ik kan me niet mengen in eventuele gerechtelijke procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de thuiswerken en wegverkeer

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why road traffic remained heavy despite the call to work from home, and how working-from-home and flexible work by employers were progressing. The minister answered that traffic had partly recovered to 70-80% of pre-crisis levels, that home working is a major factor but not for all workers, and that a regional employer approach with provinces, municipalities and business groups is underway, while declining to answer the last question in time for the MIRT committee meeting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Snelle douane helpt luchtvaart uit Corona’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Infrastructure about press reports on US preclearance at Schiphol, including the timeline of talks, economic benefits, and the process to implement it. The government replied that negotiations continue with Dutch sovereignty conditions maintained, the bilateral treaty must be concluded and then submitted to parliament, and the timing depends on negotiations and parliamentary process.
Only after the bilateral treaty negotiations are fully concluded can the treaty be signed. Afterwards the treaty will be submitted to parliament for approval.
Pas nadat de bilaterale verdragsonderhandelingen volledig zijn afgerond, kan het verdrag ondertekend worden. Daarna zal het verdrag ter goedkeuring aan het parlement worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Aartsen over 'Spanje wil tweede instorting toerisme voorkomen'

MPs Dijkstra, Koopmans and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether safe travel corridors and rapid testing could revive tourism, following reports on Spain's Semana Santa operation, and how the EU and other parties could set criteria. The minister said the current COVID situation rules out reopening tourism now, promised to make necessary travel safer via negative test certificates and a possible shorter quarantine, and said a possible Schiphol–Atlanta corridor is being explored.
Therefore, at this moment there is no question of restarting tourism.
Daarom is op dit moment geen sprake van het weer op gang helpen van toerisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'ASV: Kade Kanaleneiland Utrecht geteisterd door inbrekers'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about repeated break-ins at the Kanaleneiland quay in Utrecht, the number of incidents, prevention measures and whether Rijkswaterstaat owns the quay. The minister answered that police and municipality hold primary responsibility, that Rijkswaterstaat owns only the sheet-pile structure and anchors, and offered to help find solutions without committing to a concrete new step.
Rijkswaterstaat itself has no data on the number of break-ins and has requested the data from the municipality.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft zelf geen gegevens over het aantal inbraken en heeft de gegevens opgevraagd bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Twente Airport sluit akkoord met Inspectie over vertrek 747’s: zo min mogelijk brandstof aan boord’

An MP asked the minister about the Inspectorate's (ILT) dispute with Twente Airport over permitting departures of six Lufthansa widebody aircraft, and the roles, safety rules and resolution involved. The minister answered that ILT could not approve permanent certificate changes because the airport lacked required infrastructure, that the issue was resolved with a one-off package of safety requirements, and that no court intervention was needed.
The ILT, the licensing authority, cannot agree to this because Twente Airport does not meet international laws and regulations on several points.
De ILT, vergunningverlener, kan hier niet mee instemmen, omdat Twente Airport op enkele onderdelen niet voldoet aan internationale wet- en regelgeving
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Renovatie Afsluitdijk duurt door fout zeker 3 jaar langer, valt duurder uit'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked about a reported error in the Afsluitdijk renovation that delays the project by about three years and raises its cost, including the cause, traffic impacts, mitigation and extra funding. The minister explained that a combination of low water levels with high waves was omitted from the design inputs, said traffic and cycling disruption will last longer, and said the extra budget is still under negotiation with the contractor, with details expected in spring.
I expect to be able to give you more clarity on this next spring.
Naar verwachting kan ik u hierover komend voorjaar meer duidelijkheid geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Zonder schoolreisjes en evenementen gaan de touringcarbedrijven ten onder'

An MP asked the minister about reports that touring coach companies face collapse without school trips and events, asking about sector size, government contact, survival measures and fallback use of coaches. The government confirmed the sector's size and revenue, described intensified contact during the pandemic, pointed to generic support schemes and said sector-specific aid is a cabinet-wide trade-off, while the market governs the sector.
Questions from individual touring coach entrepreneurs were also answered by email or letter, and on 17 June the State Secretary of EZK personally received a petition from the touring coach sector.

Ook zijn vragen van individuele touringcarondernemers beantwoord via e-mail of per brief en heeft de Staatssecretaris van EZK op 17 juni persoonlijk een petitie in ontvangst genomen van de touringcarbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Uitbaggeren van het Westgat is weer nodig’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Westgat channel near Lauwersoog needs dredging, whether it was last dredged in 2018, how maintenance is planned, and whether the Wadden accessibility motion requires action. The minister answers that the 2018 dredging was a one-off pilot paid for by regional parties rather than Rijkswaterstaat, that there is no regular dredging, that sand from the Westgat cannot serve coastal nourishment, and that the economic effects will be assessed in a final evaluation in 2021.
There is no question of regular dredging of the Westgat.
Er is geen sprake van regulier baggeren van het Westgat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra  en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Subsidiepot stroomauto’s nu al op’

MPs Lodders, Remco Dijkstra and Omtzigt asked whether the EV subsidy budget running out within eight days, the cost per avoided tonne of CO2, the limited climate gain and the Court of Audit's criticism of car taxes justify the scheme. The state secretary answered that the costs per avoided tonne fall to about 450 euro by 2025, that the scheme stays within budget and the Klimaatakkoord commitments, and that the carry-over rule for unused budget will be stopped, but gave no definitive per-tonne benchmark.
All calculations that have been carried out have already been sent to you on 3 July 2019.
Alle berekeningen die zijn uitgevoerd, heeft u reeds ontvangen op 3 juli 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de  leden Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over berichten rond de actie van Greenpeace om de Doggersbank te beschermen door het storten van stenen

MPs Dijkstra and Weverling asked the ministers about Greenpeace dumping rocks on the Dogger Bank in the North Sea, its legal status, possible sanctions, and effects on fishers and the North Sea Agreement talks. The minister says the action is rejected, the stones were dumped in British waters so Dutch law does not apply, the Dutch prosecutor is considering an investigation, and Greenpeace has pledged to stay in the talks.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that it is considering whether there is reason to conduct a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft laten weten te bekijken of er aanleiding is om strafrechtelijk onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Kwart van alle auto-ongelukken  gebeurt tijdens de eerste drie minuten'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about research showing many car accidents occur in the first minutes of a trip, and about insurer data, telematics-based premiums, data sharing and phone distraction measures. The minister answered that the MONO campaign and the Strategic Road Safety Plan address distraction, and that insurer data initiatives such as a Road Safety Data Taskforce are being explored, without committing to new binding measures.
That is why I, as mentioned in answer 2, am focusing on the MONO campaign, whose essence is that a driver is Undisturbed On the Road.
Daarom zet ik – zoals vermeld in antwoord 2 – in op de MONO-campagne waarbij de essentie is dat een bestuurder Ongestoord Onderweg is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Problemen met afsluitingen door vrachtwagens nog steeds niet op orde: tunnels elf keer per dag dicht'

An MP asked the minister about recurring closures of Noord-Holland tunnels (Velsertunnel, Coentunnel) caused by overheight trucks, including causes, costs, fines, delays and remedies. The minister explained that height detection is set above the legal 4-metre limit, reported closure durations, said Rijkswaterstaat checks and fines some trucks but police issue most fines and no cost data exist, and described signage and photo boards as measures.
Rijkswaterstaat does not have the current data of the police.
Rijkswaterstaat beschikt niet over de actuele gegevens van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Forse daling Nederlandse autoverkopen houdt aan' en recente cijfers van de ACEA van 22 september jl.

An MP asked the state secretary about the sharp fall in Dutch new car registrations, the ageing of the car fleet, the outlook for diesel cars and the role of fiscal and emissions policy. The state secretary answered every question on substance, noting the fleet is ageing, that diesel's share is falling, and that the government aims for 100% zero-emission new car sales by 2030, without any commitment to new oversight or structural changes.
Yes. These figures indicate that the August 2020 decline compared with August 2019 in Dutch new passenger car registrations is slightly stronger than the stated European average.
Ja. Deze cijfers geven aan dat de daling van augustus 2020 ten opzichte van augustus 2019 in Nederland van registraties van nieuwe personenauto's iets sterker is dan het genoemde Europese gemiddelde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Postma en Stoffer over het bericht 'Zonder meer asfalt staan we straks stil'

MPs Dijkstra, Postma and Stoffer asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a press report warning that road investment is needed, covering population growth, traffic trends since COVID-19, cost-benefit figures, MIRT budget allocation, freight corridors and the National Growth Fund. The Minister answered substantively on most points, stressing that all modes are needed, that the road budget to 2030 is largely committed, and that new road projects would need extra funding; the Minister did not recognise the cost-benefit figures cited in the article.
Investment decisions are taken together with the region via the Bestuurlijke Overleggen MIRT. Your House is involved in this through the Algemene Overleggen MIRT and Nota Overleggen MIRT.
Investeringsbeslissingen worden samen met de regio genomen via de Bestuurlijke Overleggen MIRT. Uw Kamer wordt hierbij betrokken in de Algemene Overleggen MIRT en Nota Overleggen MIRT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de APK-vrijstelling voor voertuigen van 50 jaar of ouder

The MP asked when the MOT (APK) exemption for vehicles aged 50 or older takes effect, how many vehicles it covers, and whether the RDW is ready to implement it. The minister answered that the exemption is set to take effect on 1 January 2021 through an amended Besluit voertuigen, that about 68,000 vehicles will be exempt, and that the RDW has the implementation under way.
Publication of the decree is planned for the end of October, with the intended date of entry into force being 1 January 2021.
De publicatie van het besluit is voorzien voor eind oktober, met als beoogde inwerkingtredingsdatum 1 januari 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Sloten bij Reusel en Someren vervuild; inspectie bezoekt boeren'

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra asked why reports of suspected manure fraud in Brabant, including high nitrogen and phosphorus in ditches, were not taken seriously, how reports are registered and handled across agencies, and whether farmers should be asked to report anonymously. The minister defends the earlier position that soil samples are not conclusive evidence, describes the reporting channels, case volumes and handling times, and points to the area-based enforcement approach, without committing to an external review or a farmer reporting campaign.
I currently see no reason for an external investigation into how reports of fraud are recorded and processed.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding voor een extern onderzoek naar de wijze van opname en verwerking van signalen van fraude.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Nijkerken-de Haan en Ziengs over het bericht dat het rijbewijs van een gehandicapte chauffeur is ingenomen

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the CBR refused to renew the driving licence of a disabled professional driver who had held one for 31 years, and whether a coulance scheme should exist for such cases. The minister acknowledged the impact, cited the expert assessment and a 2003 CBR policy note requiring two-handed control, rejected a general coulance scheme on road-safety grounds, and said the case was with the CBR without committing to contact it.
A general coulance scheme based on positive past indications is not justified from a road-safety perspective, because past indications do not necessarily say anything about future fitness to drive.

Een algemene coulanceregeling op basis van positieve indicaties uit het verleden is vanuit het oogpunt van de verkeersveiligheid niet verantwoord omdat indicaties uit het verleden niet noodzakelijk iets zeggen over de rijgeschiktheid in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Omtzigt over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer ‘Autobelastingen als instrument’

MPs Lodders, Remco Dijkstra and Omtzigt asked the state secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure about the Court of Audit report on car taxes, questioning the cost per avoided tonne of CO2, the climate gain, the clarity of policy goals and whether the 'hand aan de kraan' monitoring system prevents overstimulation. The government rejected the report's conclusions, arguing the costs are overstated, promising to send the first hand-aan-de-kraan analysis results to Parliament shortly.
The cabinet will send the outcomes to your House in the short term.
Het kabinet zal de uitkomsten op korte termijn uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkstra over het bericht: ‘EV’s zorgen in 2030 voor 1.400 extra zwaargewonden’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press claims that EVs will cause 1,400 extra seriously injured road victims by 2030, and whether registration and road safety policy account for this. The minister says the underlying report was not made available, that current crash data cannot support firm conclusions about EVs, that EVs are as safe as combustion cars and that no extra measures in the Road Safety Plan are needed.
The underlying report was requested but not made available by the researchers.
Het achterliggende rapport is opgevraagd, maar niet beschikbaar gesteld door de onderzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over een verschillend btw-tarief op verschillende vormen van educatie

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked why VAT rates differ across forms of education (music, sport, driving lessons) and how other EU states treat them. The Secretary of State explained that VAT rules follow EU directive obligations and CJEU case law, with discretion only over reduced rates, and that driving lessons fall under the standard 21% rate.
The Netherlands has no policy room to unilaterally deviate from applicable European rules as far as mandatory exemptions are concerned.
Nederland heeft geen beleidsruimte eenzijdig van die geldende Europese regelgeving af te wijken voor zover het gaat om verplichte vrijstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het soms weigeren van het dragen van mondkapjes door passagiers van vliegtuigen en vooral de gevolgen daarvan

An MP asked the minister about passengers refusing to wear face masks on flights, the consequences for delays, fines, and the possibility of a blacklist for disruptive passengers. The minister confirmed refusal can be grounds for denial of boarding or removal, that prosecution with a typical 300 euro settlement applies, and that sharing blacklists between airlines is being pursued step by step subject to privacy approval.
Inquiries with the airlines show that this situation occurs sporadically.
Navraag bij de luchtvaartmaatschappijen leert dat deze situatie sporadisch voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Remco Dijksta over het bericht dat mensensmokkel via visserij een ‘blinde vlek’

MPs Becker and Dijkstra asked the government about an Inspectorate report finding that maritime smuggling via fishing and leisure boats is a blind spot, including gaps in risk information, staffing, systems and cooperation. The State Secretary answered that current risk assessments show limited risks, that controls continue, and that improvements such as joint risk analyses, system modernisation and training are being explored or pursued.
Following the findings of the inspection report, the KMar and ZHP are currently exploring options to strengthen their intensive cooperation.
Naar aanleiding van de bevindingen van het inspectierapport verkennen de KMar en ZHP momenteel de mogelijkheden om de intensieve samenwerking te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Brug bij Grave dicht voor tientonners door roest op klinknagels’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the closure of the Thompson bridge at Grave to heavy vehicles due to rust, including repair timing, costs, diversion impacts, communication with stakeholders, other bridges at risk, and financial shortfalls. The minister answered that repairs will take 6 to 9 months, costs are not yet known, a major renovation or replacement is planned around 2028, and an indicative maintenance shortfall of 1 to 1.4 billion euro per year will be clarified at the end of 2020.
The exact costs cannot yet be stated at this time.
De exacte kosten zijn op dit moment nog niet aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over 'Bocht in geul naar Ameland blijft om natuur'

Three VVD MPs asked why the Reegeul-Oost bend cut to shorten the Ameland ferry route was abandoned, what alternatives were weighed, and what is being done to reduce ferry delays. The minister answers that a Nature Conservation Act permit cannot be granted because the works would permanently damage the priority habitat 'permanently submerged sandbanks', that the Vloedgeul cut was lawful because it followed a natural channel course, and that other Open Plan Process measures are implemented and monitored, with a longer-term study starting this autumn.

This means that realising the Reegeul-Oost bend cut is not feasible under nature legislation, because the conservation status of this habitat type is at stake and a permit under the Nature Conservation Act therefore cannot be issued.

Dit betekent dat de realisatie van de bochtafsnijding Reegeul-Oost vanuit natuurwetgeving niet haalbaar is omdat de staat van instandhouding van dit habitattype in het geding komt en een vergunning in het kader van de Wet Natuurbescherming daarom niet kan worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Miljoenentekort voor geplaagde Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht'

A VVD MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a reported EUR 92 million shortfall on the Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht, whether the national government would contribute more, and whether it should condition funding on road speed and tunnel variants. The minister replied that the project is a municipal responsibility under a 2010 fixed national contribution, that no further national funding is planned for the extra local integration measures, and that the choice of solution rests with Utrecht.
The financial justification of the different variants and the current shortfalls on the measures fall under the responsibility of the municipality.
De financiële onderbouwing van de verschillende varianten en de huidige tekorten op de maatregelen vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Remco Dijkstra over de berichten ‘Duizenden Nederlandse zeelieden nog langer vast op zee door visa-chaos’ en ‘Gestrande zeelieden vormen een dreiging voor de wereldeconomie’

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Affairs and Infrastructure ministers about reports that thousands of Dutch seafarers were stranded at sea because of visa problems, including the visa policy, EU coordination, visa on arrival at Schiphol, and why non-Dutch-flagged ships are excluded. The government acknowledged the welfare problem, described capacity increases at consulates in Manila, Moscow and Jakarta and the priority given to Dutch-flagged ships, and said it would keep monitoring and raise the issue at IMO, ILO and EU level.
This subject therefore has the full attention of the cabinet and has also been raised by the Netherlands with the IMO, ILO and the EU.
Dit onderwerp heeft dan ook de volle aandacht van het kabinet en is tevens door Nederland geadresseerd bij IMO, ILO en de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Stoffer en Postma over het bericht 'Onzekere toekomst voor gebruik oldtimer openbare weg'

MPs Dijkstra, Stoffer and Postma asked the ministers about the future of historic vehicles (oldtimers) on public roads, including a national register of mobile heritage, definitions, innovative fuels and export of cultural goods. The government says it supports a sector-led register with Mondriaan Fund funding, that heritage is defined under the Heritage Act, and that it will engage on fuels and export protection through a planned commission.
I have asked the RCE to continue supporting this process with knowledge and advice.
Ik heb de RCE gevraagd om blijvend dit proces te ondersteunen met kennis en advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Gent over het bericht dat grote stukken strand op Walcheren zijn weggeslagen door storm Ciara

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported beach erosion on Walcheren after storm Ciara, the damage assessment, and why sand nourishment at Dishoek was delayed, including whether the nitrogen (PAS) ruling affected it. The minister answered that only a small stretch needed urgent action, that an accelerated sand nourishment at Dishoek is being prepared for completion before autumn 2020, that talks with the province and municipalities are ongoing, and that the PAS ruling delayed the nourishment programme.

At present an accelerated sand nourishment is being prepared for the Dishoek location on Walcheren for reasons of water safety, planned to be completed before the start of the autumn 2020 storm season.

Op dit moment wordt voor de locatie Dishoek op Walcheren omwille van de waterveiligheid een versnelde zandsuppletie voorbereid, die gepland is om voor de aanvang van het stormseizoen najaar 2020 gereed te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘In levensgevaar door ladinggas’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a reported fosfine poisoning incident on a Dutch inland vessel and related questions on detection, the number of affected people, inspection roles and redress. The minister answered largely by referring to other answers and an investigation report, providing general information on inspection responsibilities, shipment numbers and a planned harmonisation effort with port masters.
My Ministry will provide expertise in cooperation with SZW.
Mijn Ministerie zal in samenwerking met SZW expertise verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Vanaf 1 januari 2020 alleen euro 6 vrachtauto’s welkom op de Maasvlakte'

An MP asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about the Maasvlakte Euro VI-only zone for trucks, whether it falls under the harmonised national environmental zone rules, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that the zone results from a 2012 package agreed with Rijk, Rotterdam and the port authority, is an exception that is not changed by the 2020 harmonisation, and that it will end on 1 January 2022 when city zones are tightened to Euro VI.
The special and deviating situation of the Euro VI zone on the Maasvlakte, which is incidentally well known to the transport and shipping business, will therefore definitively end on 1 January 2022.

Aan de bijzondere en afwijkende situatie van de Euro VI zone op de Maasvlakte, die overigens goed bekend is bij het vervoerend en verladend bedrijfsleven, zal dus per 1 januari 2022 een definitief einde komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de Wantijbrug en de Botlekbrug

An MP from the VVD asked the minister why Rijkswaterstaat renovated the Wantijbrug and Botlekbrug simultaneously, why transport firms were not consulted beforehand, whether an engineering firm was at fault, and whether affected businesses can claim compensation. The minister acknowledged the overlap was unintended and caused extra detours, promised more frequent contact with TLN, and pointed affected firms to the compensation scheme, though it expects no qualifying turnover loss.
Rijkswaterstaat will therefore maintain more frequent contact at administrative level and will soon discuss with TLN how information provision in such situations can be improved in both directions.
Rijkswaterstaat zal daarom frequenter contact onderhouden op bestuurlijk niveau en binnenkort met TLN bespreken, hoe de informatievoorziening in dit soort situaties over en weer verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Logistieke sector krijgt steeds meer last van coronavirus’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that COVID-19 is hitting the logistics sector, including container volumes from Asia, Rotterdam port impacts, and risks for small transport firms and foreign drivers. The minister answered with figures from the Port of Rotterdam and the sector, stated that exact capacity numbers are not available for commercial confidentiality reasons, and outlined existing measures and possible contingency steps.
Exact figures cannot yet be given. This concerns commercially sensitive information.
Exacte cijfers zijn (nog) niet te geven. Het gaat hier om bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘KLM weigerde Lili en Howick te vervoeren‘

MPs Becker and Remco Dijkstra asked whether KLM, partly state-owned, cancelled the flight of two deported children (Lili and Howick) at the last moment, what agreements exist with KLM on removals, whether airlines can be sanctioned for frustrating deportation policy, and whether the state should talk to KLM. The State Secretary confirmed KLM's decision, said the captain bears final responsibility for safe flight operation, declined to examine KLM's risk assessment, and stated that no sanctions exist and that KLM's independent decision is separate from the government's decision on the children.

I respect the decision KLM made to not transport these passengers on grounds of safe flight operation, and given KLM's professionalism and long-standing good cooperation, I see no reason to inquire into the risk assessment in this specific case.

Ik respecteer de beslissing die de KLM heeft genomen om uit hoofde van een veilige vluchtuitvoering deze passagiers niet te vervoeren en gelet op de professionaliteit van de KLM en de jarenlange goede samenwerking, zie ik geen aanleiding om navraag te doen naar de risico inschatting in deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht ‘Ladingen afgekeurd wegens inklimmers‘

MPs Dijkstra and Becker asked the ministers about reports that cargo was rejected because stowaways were found, including the size of the damage, the numbers and nationalities of stowaways and what happens to them, and what measures are taken against smuggling networks. The government answered that it has no overview of the damage or of rejected cargo, outlined expulsion and prosecution practice, listed border measures and cooperation with the UK and Belgium, and said smuggling is investigated where signals exist.
The government has no insight into the extent of the damage suffered in the transport sector from rejected cargo due to stowaways.
De overheid heeft geen inzicht in de omvang van de schade die wordt geleden in de transportsector door het afkeuren van ladingen vanwege inklimmers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Steeds vaker file voor Leidsche Rijntunnel'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising traffic jams at the Leidsche Rijn tunnel, tunnel metering, incidents, lane markings and sprinkler systems. The minister answered that metering moves queues out of the tunnel for safety, that tunnel metering frequency has fallen since 2015, that no significant rise in incidents exists, and that a water mist system is not cost-effective.
The effects will be examined again this spring.
De effecten worden dit voorjaar weer onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Veldman over het bericht 'Maximumsnelheid ook voor hulpdiensten omlaag: ‘Dit kan mensenlevens kosten’'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the lower daytime speed limit on motorways (100 km/h) would also apply to emergency services and, if so, how this affects response times and the OGS 2009 rules. The minister replied that emergency vehicles may still exceed the limit by up to 40 km/h, that effects on response times are expected to be negligible, that no amendment is planned, and that the effects will be monitored with the ambulance sector and the knowledge centre, with a promise to inform parliament if problems arise.
The exact effects of the speed reduction between 06:00 and 19:00 on the response times of emergency services are currently not known.
De exacte effecten van de snelheidsverlaging tussen 06.00 en 19.00 uur op de aanrijtijden van de hulpdiensten zijn op dit moment niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Nijkerken-de Haan en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Limburg vreest verlies duizenden banen door luchtvrachttaks'

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the national aviation tax would cost jobs and traffic at Maastricht Aachen Airport and whether further research and consultation with Limburg had taken place. The government answered that no airport-specific analysis was made, that national effects show a small emissions decline and limited job effects, and that the EU-level alternative remains uncertain.
No specific research was conducted into the position of Maastricht Aachen Airport.
Er is geen specifiek onderzoek gedaan naar de positie van Maastricht Aachen Airport.
