Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Aalst over de berichten ‘Helmplicht voor snorfietser wordt geleidelijk ingevoerd’ en ‘Ook de snorfietser moet eraan geloven: een niet-coole helm op’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports on a gradual helmet obligation for moped (snorfiets) riders, asking about safer alternatives, comparative risks, economic effects, relocation to the road, and how owners will be informed and can object. The Minister answered all ten questions on substance, explaining the planned helmet rule, the Arcadis study, the ongoing internet consultation, and that a communication campaign will follow if the rule is adopted.
The aim of this measure is to reduce the number of road deaths and injuries among moped riders, not to push the snorfiets off the streets.
Het doel van deze maatregel is om het aantal verkeersdoden en -gewonden onder snorfietsers te verminderen, niet om de snorfiets uit het straatbeeld te verdringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel 'Haast geboden voor filetopper, A4 Den Haag-Burgerveen'

Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the A4 Den Haag–Burgerveen congestion project cannot start sooner, whether budget can be shifted, and what can be done to ease the losses to transport firms. The minister answered that construction can only start in 2026 because of statutory procedures and planning, not budget, and that she will explore ways to start preparations earlier and work with the transport sector on mobility measures.
This means that at present construction cannot start before 2026.
Dit maakt dat op dit moment niet eerder dan in 2026 gestart kan worden met de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de eerste cijfers met betrekking tot snorfietsen op de rijbaan in Amsterdam

An MP asked the minister about Amsterdam's moped-to-road measure, including falling registrations, shifts to cars, persistent non-compliance, the cost of 6 million euro and the lack of a full evaluation. The minister answered each question, defended the measure, and committed to a broad evaluation once several road authorities have implemented it.
I myself will carry out a broad evaluation, based on the evaluations carried out by municipalities, of the effects on traffic flow and road safety of allowing mopeds on the carriageway.
Zelf voer ik een brede evaluatie uit, op basis van de door gemeenten uitgevoerde evaluaties, naar de effecten op de doorstroming en verkeersveiligheid door het toestaan van snorfietsen op de rijbaan

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch en Bruins over ongewenste effecten van de werking van historische rechten op slots in relatie tot de disruptie veroorzaakt door het coronavirus (IATA r

MPs asked whether the minister would press the European Commission to suspend slot 'use-it-or-lose-it' rules for 2020 at the request of IATA, given coronavirus disruption to air travel and the risk of empty flights. The minister agreed in principle, said the Commission would be asked to extend the existing waiver for the summer season and widen it to all severely affected countries, but declined to provide load-factor data citing commercial confidentiality.

I have asked the European Commission to extend its current waiver of the slot rules for preserving historic rights for the IATA winter season 2019/2020 in connection with the coronavirus into the upcoming IATA summer season

Ik heb de Europese Commissie verzocht om haar huidige ontheffing van de slotregels ten behoeve van het behoud van historische rechten voor het IATA winterseizoen 2019/2020 in verband met het coronavirus te verlengen voor het aankomend IATA zomerseizoen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over trajectcontroles op de A2

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why answers to earlier written questions on A2 speed trajectory controls took so long, whether analysis supported extending the controls, and whether extension should be suspended until parliament approves. The minister replied that coordination with the prosecution service, police and the infrastructure ministry took time, that pre-extension speed measurements justify the extra sections, and that the power to set control locations lies with the OM, police and Rijkswaterstaat, not parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Dit zijn de gevaarlijkste (snelweg)kilometers op de Nederlandse wegen'

MPs Postma and Remco Dijkstra asked the minister about a Telegraaf report ranking the most dangerous motorway stretches, led by the A10 at the Coentunnel, and about follow-up on earlier recommendations, speed, and safety measures. The minister says the ranking uses different crash data than Rijkswaterstaat's BRON, so conclusions cannot yet be confirmed, and lists measures taken and planned for the A10, A8, A12, A1 and A16 locations.
At this moment I cannot yet say whether the conclusions are correct.
Op dit moment kan ik nog niet zeggen of de conclusies kloppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht over de slechte staat van bruggen op de A44

An MP asked the minister about weight and width restrictions imposed on heavy and bus traffic on four structures on the A44 due to deteriorated bridges. The minister confirmed the restrictions, said they extend the structures' lifespan, and gave a planned replacement or renovation around 2025.
Until replacement or renovation, the width restriction and the weight restriction remain in force.
Tot aan vervanging of renovatie blijven de breedtebeperking en de gewichtsbeperking van kracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht over geannuleerde vluchten op Eindhoven Airport wegens mist

An MP asked the government about flight cancellations and delays at Eindhoven Airport caused by fog, including who bears the damage, whether the fog counts as force majeure, and why no higher-category ILS landing system was installed. The state secretary answered that 156 civil flights were affected in 2019, that damage is for airlines and the airport, that fog is force majeure, and that Defence is responsible for the ILS, with any upgrade initiative lying with the airport and possibly timed for the 2024/2025 runway works.
Eindhoven Airport states that it currently does not have this data available.
Eindhoven Airport laat weten momenteel niet over deze gegevens te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Renovatie IJsselbruggen hard nodig, voorlopig tijdelijke maatregelen’

An MP asked the minister about the urgent renovation of the A12 IJssel bridges, traffic delays, permits, communication with transport firms, the A15 extension and nitrogen issues. The minister answered that the bridges can be renovated, one bridge stays closed at a time, delays are limited, and no nitrogen problems are expected.
This research, completed at the end of 2019, shows that the two steel bridges can be renovated.
Uit dit eind 2019 afgeronde onderzoek blijkt dat de twee stalen bruggen gerenoveerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over meer trajectcontroles

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether extending a trajectory speed control on the A2 between Utrecht and Amsterdam, to cover the gaps between existing sections, is justified by accident numbers, and whether it is really about revenue rather than road safety. The Minister answered that the extension targets speed limit violations on the uncontrolled sections that raise safety risks, that the revenue goes to the state budget, and that no new motorway trajectory controls are currently planned.
The definitive accident figures for the year 2019 will become available at the end of 2020.
De definitieve ongevallencijfers over het jaar 2019 komen eind 2020 beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Vanaf vandaag twee extra trajectcontroles op de A2 omdat automobilisten de regels aan hun laars lappen’

MP Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Justice and Security to send the study underlying the expansion of speed trajectory controls on the A2 to parliament before the 18 December debate. The minister explains that the two new sections were previously unenforced for technical reasons, cites speed measurements showing about three times more violations there, but the answer does not provide the study itself.
Before the intermediate sections of the trajectory control system went into enforcement, speed measurements were carried out.
Voordat de tussenliggende secties van het trajectcontrolesysteem in handhaving zijn gegaan, zijn er snelheidsmetingen verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Fire at Norway Airport destroys hunderds of cars grounds planes’

The MP asks whether a major fire in a Norwegian airport car park could happen in the Netherlands, what fire safety rules apply to car parks, and how electric vehicle battery fires and rescue operations are handled. The minister answers that the Norwegian investigation is still pending, that a new NEN standard on car park fire safety is being prepared including alternative-fuel vehicles, that no central incident records exist, and that fire services are developing guidance.
I do not have information on individual incidents involving electric cars that proved flammable.
Ik beschik niet over informatie van individuele incidenten met elektrische auto's die ontvlambaar bleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Bosman over het bericht ‘Koraal Curaçao vernield door olieplatform’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether they knew of reports that an oil platform damaged coral reef off Curaçao, and about the extent of damage, responsibility, recovery and prevention. The government acknowledged the irreversible damage, said Curaçao's ministry is investigating the cause, noted coral planting is possible but limited, and stated Curaçao itself is responsible for shipping safety rules.
Curaçao is itself responsible for making and enforcing regulations on shipping safety to prevent such incidents.
Curaçao is zelf verantwoordelijk voor het maken en handhaven van voorschriften met betrekking tot de scheepvaartveiligheid om dergelijke incidenten te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Nieuwe test voor uitstoot diesels’

MPs Dijkstra and Ziengs asked the minister about a planned particle-count test in the APK for diesel cars with roetfilters, its timing, costs, affected vehicle numbers, compensation and consultation. The minister answered that the test is aimed for 2021, estimated 100,000 to 125,000 vehicles may fail, and rejected compensation for owners, while committing to an impact study and advice from the ATR and consultation.
To make the particle counter test mandatory for the APK, a further amendment of the Regeling voertuigen is needed.
Om de deeltjestellertest verplicht te stellen voor de APK is een volgende wijziging van de Regeling voertuigen nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Meer dan honderdduizend verkeersboetes onterecht: ‘Bezwaar maken loont’’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that over 100,000 traffic fines were wrongly issued and whether objecting is futile, with questions on the share of objections, barriers to appeal and standard letters. The minister denied a discouragement policy, explained that many successful appeals come from leasing companies, and stated that all appeals receive substantive review.
If an appeal is lodged, a substantive assessment always takes place by the OM or the district judge, and not only at the Court of Appeal Arnhem-Leeuwarden.
Indien er in beroep wordt gegaan vindt er altijd een inhoudelijke beoordeling door het OM of de kantonrechter plaats en niet pas bij het Gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over luchtvracht en de afgifte van luchtvaartrechten

An MP asked the minister about Kenyan flower imports routed via Saudi Arabia because the bilateral air agreement lacks fifth-freedom rights, and whether this makes Dutch flower logistics vulnerable. The minister confirmed the routing, explained the treaty limits (only third and fourth freedoms), said KLM Cargo competes actively, and said no other EU state appears set to rival the Dutch auction, while giving no figures on turnover or jobs.
I do not have specific data available on the turnover, employees and volumes related to the import of flowers from Kenya.
Ik heb geen specifieke gegevens tot mijn beschikking over de omzet, medewerkers en aantallen gerelateerd aan de import van bloemen uit Kenia.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘IATA, slot op Schiphol kost Nederland banen’

MP Remco Dijkstra asked the minister about an IATA report claiming Schiphol's slot limit will cost Dutch jobs, and whether the findings and KLM's concerns are accurate. The minister said the IATA report was published without ministry involvement, pointed to forthcoming ministry-commissioned studies on Schiphol's economic importance, and promised to inform parliament later on the medium-term Schiphol decision.
These studies will be presented to the House shortly.
Deze studies worden binnenkort aan de Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Automaatcode vervalt in Duitsland’

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch automatic-transmission driving licence codes would be affected by a German plan, whether similar changes were discussed in the Netherlands, and about exam volumes and CBR implementation capacity. The minister said the German plan does not remove the automatic code for automatic exams, that the EU directive does not allow deviation, and committed to raising the EU topic at the March committee and holding a consultation with the driving school sector.
I have therefore asked the European Commission to discuss this topic at the upcoming driving licence committee in March in Brussels.
Ik heb de Europese Commissie dan ook gevraagd om dit onderwerp op het eerstkomende rijbewijscomité in maart in Brussel te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de Giessenbrug

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Giessenbrug bridge, which has not been opened for tall ships since 2017 and may remain unusable until a 2026 renovation, harming a nearby shipyard. The Minister confirmed Rijkswaterstaat decided to stop operating the bridge, that the waterway is effectively downgraded to 5.40 m clearance, and that no acceleration of the renovation is currently possible, though the government remains in talks with stakeholders.
At this moment I see no possibilities for accelerating the renovation of the bridge.
Op dit moment zie ik geen mogelijkheden tot versnelling van de renovatie van de brug.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smals en Remco Dijkstra over het artikel "KLM onderzoekt blootstelling aan chroom-6"

MPs Smals and Dijkstra asked about KLM's investigation into past chromium-6 exposure of workers and the Inspectorate's role, inspections and sector risks. The state secretary answered that the employer bears responsibility, the Inspectorate has inspected KLM and checks chromium-6 risks, and the advisory commission's report on occupational disease compensation is now expected by 1 April 2020.
The Inspectorate SZW oversees compliance with the Working Conditions legislation and, in that role, has no involvement in KLM group's investigation.
De Inspectie SZW ziet toe op de naleving van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwetgeving en heeft vanuit die rol geen betrokkenheid in het onderzoek van de KLM-groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over Het bericht ‘Vrachtwagenheffing op N264 blijft mogelijk als sluipverkeer toeneemt’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about residents' fears of more truck traffic on the N264 if a truck levy is introduced, and about the criteria, coordination and speed of adding roads to the levy network. The minister answers that no substantial diversion is expected on the N264, that roads are added based on model studies and regional consultation, that urgent additions can be made within days, and that consultation responses will be reported in mid-2020.
The truck levy bill is currently still in preparation.
Het wetsvoorstel vrachtwagenheffing is op dit moment nog in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over general aviation vanaf Lelystad Airport

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the early opening of Lelystad Airport remains the government's aim, how users are kept informed, and about the status of a provincially led working track on relocating general aviation. The minister confirmed the opening plan, described monthly user consultations, and said the relocation question will be decided only after further capacity research, with the national government also having a role.
Only when these outcomes are available can it be determined whether, and if so which, agreements with general aviation are needed.
Pas wanneer deze uitkomsten beschikbaar zijn, kan worden bepaald of, en zo ja welke, afspraken met de GA nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van den Bosch over het bericht 'Boeren moeten het ontgelden, waterschapsbelasting omhoog'

MPs Dijkstra and Van den Bosch asked the ministers about a reported rise in water board taxes for farmers after a Supreme Court ruling on unpaved verges. The minister says water boards set their own rates democratically, that the ruling only redistributes costs within the unbuilt-property category, and that the ministers will inform parliament after the Unie van Waterschappen decides on further review.
The water boards will inform me about their decision-making.
De waterschappen zullen mij over hun besluitvorming informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘MSC Zoe: nog 2 containers en een regeling te gaan’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the shipping company MSC has paid only part of the cleanup and damage costs from the MSC Zoe container loss, nearly eleven months later, and when legal instruments would be used. The minister answered that roughly 2.86 million euros in claims has been filed, about 0.93 million has been paid, negotiations continue, no end date is committed to, and legal action is not yet warranted.
I think some time is still needed for this and I do not want to commit to an end date.
Ik denk dat hier nog enige tijd voor nodig is en wil mij niet vastleggen op een einddatum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht: ‘Ontgassen moet snel kunnen’

An MP asked the minister about the shortage of gas-venting installations for vessels, the ban on venting on the water in densely populated areas under the ADN, and how to enforce it and define the status of cargo vapours. The minister said a nationwide ban is desired via the CDNI amendment, enforcement applies in clearly densely populated areas, and a pragmatic treatment of vapours as residual products is being pursued pending a task force.
I share your view that a ban on venting should apply throughout the Netherlands.
Ik deel uw mening dat er in heel Nederland een verbod op ontgassen moet komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Sluis in Lith dicht door achterstallig onderhoud zeggen schippers die nu moeten omvaren’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the closure of a lock at Lith due to deferred maintenance, the detours for shipping, and the shortage of mooring places nationwide. The minister answered that an emergency repair is underway with completion planned for 29 January 2020, that mooring capacity is addressed via the MIRT and the NMCA, and that port quality is the responsibility of port managers, usually municipalities.
An emergency repair is currently being carried out on one of the two lock chambers of Lith lock.
Er wordt op dit moment een spoedreparatie uitgevoerd aan één van de twee sluiskolken van sluis Lith.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Giessenbrug 10 jaar dicht: schippers eisen reparatie’

An MP asked the minister why the Giessenbrug, closed to river traffic over 5.40 m since 2017, will not be renovated until 2026 and whether this can be accelerated, and what the economic and transport consequences are. The minister replied that the bridge cannot safely be operated, that renovation is programmed for 2026 with no acceleration possible for now, that economic effects are not precisely known, and that the government stays alert to accelerating the project.
Nevertheless, I remain alert to opportunities to accelerate implementation, should these present themselves.
Toch blijf ik alert op mogelijkheden om de uitvoering te versnellen, mochten deze zich aandienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Supersnelle politie-Audi’s staan stil’

MPs Dijkstra and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether police Audis bought to pursue criminals are largely idle for months due to a training backlog of 200 officers, and whether the minister was informed. Minister Grapperhaus denied the idle-fleet claim, said all vehicles are in regular use, that no 200-officer waiting list exists, and that the korpschef is responsible for operations.
The quality of business operations is the primary responsibility of the chief of police. That is why I was not informed about this subject.
De kwaliteit van de bedrijfsvoering is een eerste verantwoordelijkheid van de korpschef. Daarom ben ik over dit onderwerp niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over veranderingen voor het huidige vliegverkeer vanaf Lelystad Airport

An MP asked how general aviation users at Lelystad Airport would be affected by the arrival of holiday charter flights, including compensation, the new control zone rules from 7 November, flight plan requirements and consultation. The minister said forced relocation and compensation are not needed for now, that the airspace changes follow ICAO timelines, that control charges are deferred, and that the aviation sector was consulted and will be kept informed.
Regarding the increase in charges, I have decided for the time being not to levy a charge for tower services on users of Lelystad Airport.
Voor wat betreft de lastenverhoging heb ik besloten om vooralsnog géén heffing voor de (toren)dienstverlening in rekening te brengen bij de gebruikers van luchthaven Lelystad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht 'Seawatch3 alweer bijna bij Libië'

Two VVD MPs asked why the Sea-Watch 3 sailed again despite safety rules not being met, whether it could be blocked, and whether migrants would be accepted. The minister replied that the ship must meet the rules before rescuing, Sea-Watch is responsible for incidents, the ship was not informed in advance, Tunisia was the nearest safe port, and the Netherlands no longer takes over migrants from such ships.
I made a moral appeal to Sea-Watch to only sail again once the ship and crew meet the safety and crew requirements set out in the regulation.
Ik heb een moreel beroep gedaan op Sea-Watch om pas weer uit te varen als het schip en de bemanning voldoen aan de veiligheids- en bemanningseisen die zijn gesteld in de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Paternotte, Amhaouch en Remco Dijkstra over het gestaakte overleg tussen het ministerie en Noord-Veluwse gemeenten over vliegroutevarianten

MPs asked why the Noord-Veluwe municipalities stopped consultation on Lelystad Airport flight-route variants, and whether any variant avoids overflying the largest towns. The minister rejects the claim of a stopped consultation, says the variants do reduce overflown residents, and states a preference for route variant N for runway 23, though the document is cut off before its final answers are complete.
There is therefore no question of a halt to the consultation.
Van het staken van overleg is dan ook geen sprake.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra inzake het nieuwsbericht ‘Drones van klimaatactivisten weigeren op te stijgen bij Heathrow’

An MP asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Justice about reports that climate-activist drones disrupted flights at Heathrow, and whether similar action could occur in the Netherlands and how it would be prevented and sanctioned. The minister answered that such actions cannot be ruled out, pointed to upcoming EU drone rules, registration and identification requirements, a counter-drone knowledge programme, existing fines up to 7,800 euro, and a commitment to keep the policy under review.
It cannot be ruled out that actions by climate activists with drones at and around airports could also take place in the Netherlands.
Het valt niet uit te sluiten dat er ook in Nederland acties van klimaatactivisten met drones op en rondom luchthavens kunnen plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken–de Haan over het bericht 'Maximumsnelheid op de A79 bij Meerssen naar 90 km/u.'

MPs Dijkstra and Nijkerken-de Haan asked why the speed limit on the A79 near Meerssen was reportedly lowered to 90 km/h, whether this reflected poor road maintenance, and how long it would last. The minister answered that no lasting speed reduction applies; a temporary 90 km/h decision was wrongly taken and will be withdrawn, a slippery-road sign was placed instead, and maintenance is scheduled for a specific night subject to weather.
This decision turns out to be incorrect and will be withdrawn.
Dit besluit blijkt onjuist en zal worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Slecht wegdek: A77 van Rijkevoort richting Duitsland tot dinsdagochtend afgesloten, ook daarna hinder'

An MP asked the minister about the closure of the A77 towards Germany near Rijkevoort due to a defective expansion joint, its cause, repair timeline, and effects on residents, logistics and emergency services. The minister answered that the closure and detours were explained, the Gennep exit reopened on 23 September, and repairs are planned until around February 2020.
In the period until the end of November, the carriageway towards Germany will be repaired.
In de periode tot eind november zal de rijrichting richting Duitsland worden hersteld.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco  Dijkstra over het bericht 'Natuurorganisaties willen weten: waar blijft de schadevergoeding voor de aangespoelde containers?’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why shipping company MSC has been slow to pay damages for the containers lost from the MSC Zoe and the cleanup costs, nine months after the loss. The minister answers that MSC must fully compensate the damage, that about 1.93 million euro in claims remain open, that negotiations are ongoing toward a settlement, and that legal instruments are the fallback if talks fail.
My preference still is to reach an amicable agreement with MSC.
Mijn voorkeur gaat nog steeds uit om er langs minnelijke weg met MSC uit te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over aanrijdingen met wild

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about wildlife road collisions, including under-reporting, registration gaps across provinces, and whether provinces can improve reporting. The minister replied that estimates suggest about 10,000 collisions a year, that registration is fragmented and decentralised to provinces, and that she will consult provinces on improving reporting and include collisions in the wildlife management evaluation.
I will consult with the provinces to examine how reporting of wildlife collisions can be improved.
Ik zal mij met de provincies verstaan om te bezien hoe de aanmeldingen met aangereden wild kunnen worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de zandoverlast op de Markerwaarddijk

VVD MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about repeated closures of the Markerwaarddijk due to sand drifting, the choice to use sand in the dike reinforcement despite the known risk, alternatives considered, economic impact, and how closures will be prevented. The Minister acknowledged the problem, explained the cost, ecological and sustainability reasons for the mixed sand-stone design and the alternatives assessed in the environmental impact report, and said an extra layer of soil is being applied with completion expected in October.
The economic consequences of the road closure for the region are not known to me.
De economische gevolgen van de wegafsluiting voor de regio zijn mij niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “onverwoestbaar stofje gaat bouwprojecten lamleggen” en over de gevolgen van de industriële stof PFOS voor de bouwwereld

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary whether new PFAS rules for soil and dredged material would further delay road and housing projects, and how the government would address the concerns of municipalities and industry. The state secretary replied that the temporary framework adds clarity rather than new obligations, that the duty of care applies where PFAS is found, that she is consulting with regional authorities and will inform the House in early 2020.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra en Koerhuis over de berichten ‘Havengebied dreigt een warzone te worden’, ‘Wordt ruimte straks de grote uitdaging voor Amsterdam?’ en ‘Kock wil verzelfstandiging havenbedrijf

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports on tensions between the Amsterdam port and housing plans, and about the municipality's 100% ownership of the port company. The minister answered that the port is of national importance, that the municipality as sole shareholder is responsible for its ownership, and that Rijk and region coordinate on infrastructure and housing without committing to a concrete new step.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam, as 100% shareholder, to give proper form to its ownership of Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam als 100% aandeelhouder om op een goede manier invulling te geven aan haar eigenaarschap van het Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht in het Noord-Hollands Dagblad op 9 juli 2019  ‘Vernieuwing Leeghwaterbrug opnieuw maanden vertraagd’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported months of delay in replacing the Leeghwater bridge in Alkmaar, covering the cause, safety, damages to businesses and when the bridge will be finished. The minister said the province of Noord-Holland is responsible and the municipality is permit-giver and supervisor, that a province letter will largely answer the questions, and that the ministry will be kept informed.
This bridge and the works on this bridge fall under the responsibility of the province of Noord-Holland.
Deze brug en de werkzaamheden aan deze brug vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Noord Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Schonis en Remco Dijkstra over de grote problemen bij het CBR

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about data leaks at the CBR, where medical documents of one client were viewable in another's file, including how many cases there were, when they were reported, and whether affected people were informed. The minister reported 71 cases in January to June 2019 and 5 in 2018, said procedures and GDPR obligations were followed, and agreed to share monthly progress reports with the Chamber.
Yes, I am willing to share with the Chamber the monthly report that the CBR sends me within the framework of enhanced oversight.
Ja, ik ben bereid om de rapportage die het CBR maandelijks aan mij doet toekomen in het kader van het aangescherpt toezicht te delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries hebben vragen gesteld over het bericht “Oefenen voor een no deal Brexit”

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked about a report on no-deal Brexit preparations, the lack of a Border Inspection Point on the north bank of the Nieuwe Waterweg in Rotterdam, its consequences, responsibility, financing and EU approval. The minister answered by referring to earlier letters and briefings, said talks on an inspection post for live animals are ongoing, and mentioned a possible subsidy and guarantee under strict state aid conditions.
For a detailed explanation and answer to your questions, I refer you to several relevant letters.
Voor een uitgebreide toelichting en antwoord op uw vragen verwijs ik u naar enkele relevante brieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over bpm-fraude bij parallelimport

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked the State Secretary of Finance about BPM fraud in imported used cars, including timing of announced measures, import and inspection figures, post-assessments, objections and no-cure-no-pay practices. The government answered that solutions are being worked out with a letter this autumn, gave import volumes, said inspections stayed flat at about 1,000 per half year, and declined to quantify penalties and some objection data for lack of registration or management information.
This autumn, your House will be further informed about this.
Dit najaar wordt uw Kamer hierover verder geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Verkoop personenauto’s zakt flink in eerste halfjaar 2019’

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked about a reported 10% drop in new passenger car sales in the first half of 2019, the rise in BPM revenue despite fewer sales, and whether the BPM tables will be adjusted for the WLTP test procedure. State Secretary Snel answers that sales fluctuations are normal, that BPM revenue rose because cars became heavier and more CO2-intensive, and that the BPM will switch to WLTP-based tables from 1 July 2020 with compensating adjustments.
As described in the answer to question 3, such fluctuations in the number of new car sales are not unusual.
Zoals beschreven in het antwoord op vraag 3 zijn dergelijke fluctuaties in het aantal nieuwverkochte auto's niet ongebruikelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over slimme oplossingen voor het tekort aan parkeerplaatsen

An MP asked the minister about a German technology that increases truck parking capacity, and about the shortfall of secure truck parking along Dutch freight corridors. The minister reports a forecast shortfall of 2,400 spaces, about 800 planned spaces for 2020-2022, a full overview expected mid-2020, and a visit to Germany to explore the technology.
A complete overview can be expected to be provided around mid-2020.
Een totaaloverzicht kan naar verwachting medio 2020 worden geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Actieve handel in privégegevens uit kentekenregister: ‘Schokkend en gevaarlijk’’

An MP asked the ministers about an RTL Nieuws report that vehicle register data including names and home addresses was being sold online, and how the leak occurred, who can access the data, and what is being done. The minister answered that the RDW had no prior knowledge of misuse, a police investigation and an external review of extra safeguards are underway, and the RDW logs access and audits its security annually.
Until the outcomes of that investigation are known, I cannot make any statements about it.
Totdat de uitkomsten daarvan bekend zijn, kan ik hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het  bericht ‘De Ketelbrug stond vast, moet  oplossing voor komen’

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked about a July 2019 breakdown of the Ketelbrug bridge, its maintenance history, emergency access, and whether shipping would stay blocked. The minister explained the fault was a frequency controller, listed 16 shipping and 7 road disruptions since the 2013 renovation, said emergency services are alerted via the joint control room, and stated the bridge was back on regular operation from 1 August with no backlog maintenance.
From 1 August the bridge is operated again according to the regular operating regime.
Vanaf 1 augustus wordt de brug weer bediend conform regulier bedieningsregime.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over antwoorden van de Europese Commissie op het bericht ‘Tegengaan bureaucratie exceptioneel transport’

An MP asked the minister about EU-level differences and increasing refusals of permits for exceptional transport in countries such as France and Italy, and whether the issue could be raised in EU harmonisation of the weights and dimensions directive. The minister answered that national rules legitimately differ due to infrastructure, that exceptional vehicles fall outside the directive, and that she will explore finding allies in Europe for harmonisation.
I am willing to explore whether I can find allies in Europe to advocate for harmonisation.
Ik ben bereid om te verkennen of ik in Europa medestanders kan vinden om voor harmonisatie te pleiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de artikelen ‘Failliete rijschoolhouder blijkt spoorloos’, ‘Rijschoolhouder Ferry A. failliet’ en ‘Verdwenen rijschoolhouder neemt onbetaald personeel verschrikkelijk in

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about news reports of a bankrupt driving school owner who disappeared, including whether he can be extradited, how driving schools can be barred, whether the CBR and Tax Office supervise them, and how victims can claim damages. The minister declined to comment on the individual criminal case, pointed to a revocation procedure under the WRM, said the CBR does not supervise driving schools and the Tax Office only checks them incidentally, and said talks with the sector on quality improvement are ongoing.
I will not go into individual persons and criminal matters.
Ik ga niet in op individuele personen en strafrechtelijke zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Remco Dijkstra en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Transporteurs boos over dure Nederlandse tachokaart: ‘In buitenland veel goedkoper’

MPs asked why Dutch hauliers pay substantially higher prices for tachograph cards than in neighbouring countries and whether this disadvantages Dutch SMEs. The minister acknowledged price differences, said a benchmark study will be sent to parliament after the summer, and promised a revised, more transparent tariff scheme that may lower prices.
This study will be sent to your House after the summer.
Dit onderzoek zal na de zomer naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Gent over de berichten ‘De schrikbarende stijging die niemand kan verklaren’ en ‘Verkeersanalyse provincie nutteloos door Privacywet’

MPs Dijkstra and Van Gent asked whether the GDPR (AVG) prevents provinces from analysing traffic accidents, after reports that the increase in road deaths in Brabant could not be explained. The minister acknowledged that special personal data cannot currently be supplied due to a missing legal basis, that a bill is expected early next year, and pointed to aggregated data, in-depth studies and data sharing as alternatives.
However, special personal data cannot currently be supplied.
Bijzondere persoonsgegevens kunnen op dit moment echter niet worden geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Buitenlanders ontlopen parkeerboete, landen willen adressen niet geven’

Two VVD MPs asked why foreign drivers escape parking fines because some countries, notably Germany, no longer provide registered-keeper addresses, and what can be done. The minister acknowledged the problem (roughly tens of thousands of unpaid fines, at least EUR 1 million a year), explained that EU cross-border rules cover only traffic offences not parking, and committed to exploring bilateral data exchange, starting with Germany.

Together with my colleagues at the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, I will examine what options exist for reaching a similar exchange with other countries.

Ik zal, samen met mijn collega´s van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om met andere landen tot een soortgelijke uitwisseling te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Algemene voorwaarden en verzekering rijscholen niet altijd op orde”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about driving schools whose terms and insurance are not always in order, leaving pupils liable for fines or damage. The minister said no uninsured driving-school cars are known, that branch organisations check members yearly and expel non-compliant ones, and that no legal means exist to sanction individual schools, while a review with the sector is ongoing.
However, I am examining other options with the sector to organise this better.
Wel onderzoek ik in overleg met de branche andere mogelijkheden om dit beter te organiseren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap, Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Venlo hotspot voor snelwegcrimineel’

MPs asked about rising cargo theft and mobile banditry targeting truck drivers near Venlo, including secure parking, EU action and prosecution of foreign suspects. The minister answered that incidents are falling, cited secure truck parking projects, joint task forces and prosecution measures, and committed to continued talks with the transport sector.
Compared with other European countries, the number of registered reports of transport crime in the Netherlands is relatively higher.
Vergeleken met andere Europese landen is het aantal geregistreerde meldingen van transportcriminaliteit in Nederland relatief hoger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Lege tank niet beboet’

Deputy Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked whether drivers who run out of fuel and stop on motorway hard shoulders should be fined, given that such stops are avoidable and the Leeuwarden court treated fuel shortage as an emergency. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no data on such stops or related accidents are registered, that running out of fuel is in principle avoidable but hard to prove negligence on, and that a fine reintroduction is not preferred, with Article 5 of the Road Traffic Act available for genuinely dangerous conduct.
No, that data is not known.
Nee, die gegevens zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Schiphol speelt tweede viool vrachtnet AF – KLM’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the decline of air cargo volume at Schiphol, slot scarcity, sector employment, the cargo-specific slot allocation, the aviation tax and US and Russian slot disputes. The minister answered in detail, citing data, committing to further studies on employment and the aviation tax, and noting the government's facilitating role.

That is why I am investigating with Schiphol, the slot coordinator ACNL and the sector all options to determine and allocate Schiphol's available capacity as optimally as possible within the EU slot regulation, including for cargo carriers.

Daarom onderzoek ik met Schiphol, de slotcoördinator ACNL, en de sector alle mogelijkheden om binnen de kaders van de EU slotverordening de beschikbare capaciteit van Schiphol zo optimaal mogelijk te laten vaststellen en te verdelen over alle gebruikers, waaronder de vrachtmaatschappijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Situatie zeehaventerminals fnuikend voor binnenvaart’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported congestion at Rotterdam container terminals harming inland shipping, the rail share of freight, and how inland shipping interests are weighed against sea shipping. The minister acknowledged the congestion problem, described bundling and digital/infrastructure measures already underway, denied that 20% of cargo could easily shift to rail, and said an overflow hub and further studies would follow, with more detail in the upcoming port memorandum.
I therefore expect that the share of rail transport in the Port of Rotterdam will increase.
Ik verwacht daarmee dat het aandeel van spoorvervoer in de Rotterdamse haven zal toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de berichten 'Spijkenisserbrug weer open na storing' en 'Problemen met Spijkenisserbrug en Haringvlietbrug voorbij'

An MP asks the minister about repeated failures of the Spijkenisser bridge, the timing and feasibility of accelerating its renovation, extra capacity, and bridge opening times. The minister reports stoppage statistics, states the renovation cannot be accelerated because of the technical survey, describes flanking measures under study, and declines fixed opening hours to protect shipping priority.
The investigation into acceleration options has recently been completed.
Het onderzoek naar de versnellingsmogelijkheden is recent afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Automobilisten hebben lak aan rode kruizen A16’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Remco Dijkstra asked about drivers ignoring red crosses on the A16, the legal basis for penalising them, and whether pilots and camera enforcement by road inspectors could be accelerated. The minister replied that ignoring red crosses is now criminal, that a bill would raise penalties, that enforcement staff and pilots are being expanded, and that camera enforcement on inspectors' vehicles was not pursued because of safety and role concerns.
Ignoring a red cross was transferred a few years ago from the administrative enforcement act for traffic rules to criminal law.
Het negeren van een rood kruis is een paar jaar geleden overgebracht van de Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften naar het strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat Defensie zich nog geen raad weet met steeds kleinere drones

VVD MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs, among others, about the difficulty of countering increasingly small drones, expert recommendations, inter-ministerial coordination, and Defence's counter-drone research and industry cooperation. The ministers replied that research is ongoing with international partners, coordination with the police and Justice and Veiligheid exists, and Nederland is pursuing counter-drone categories in EDIDP, without committing to new checks on the executive.
The cabinet will return on this matter shortly in a letter that will be sent to the House soon.
Het kabinet komt op korte termijn ter zake in een brief die uw kamer spoedig zal toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht in de Telegraaf “kleine visser zit klem”

MPs asked the government about reports that small fishers are squeezed by offshore wind farms, including access rules, fines for approaching turbines, and the progress of a Noordzee future perspective. The minister answered that the ministries share responsibility, that no record was kept of a meeting with fishers, that wind farms were opened to vessels up to 24 metres from May 2018 under conditions, and that a Noordzee agreement process and a fishing-sector perspective are underway, with evaluation in 2020.
No report was made of the meeting referred to.
Van het gesprek waarnaar wordt verwezen is geen verslag gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Laan-Geselschap over inzake het bericht ‘Belgische politie gaat bolides van roekeloze autopatsers direct in beslag nemen’

MPs Dijkstra and Laan-Geselschap asked whether Dutch law can seize cars from reckless drivers as Belgian police do, and how reckless driving is currently tackled. The minister replied that existing criminal and administrative powers already allow strong action, that car seizure is limited to specific grounds with prosecutor consultation and court review, and that no administrative seizure system like Belgium's is planned, pointing instead to two pending bills.
I therefore see no reason to introduce a seizure system such as the one described in the article.
Ik zie daarom geen redenen om een systeem van inbeslagname zoals in het bewuste artikel wordt beschreven te invoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Nieuwe’ geul klaar maar werkt nog niet’

MPs asked about the newly dredged Vloedgeul channel on the Holwerd-Ameland ferry route, which was finished but still showed delays, asking about expected travel-time gains, monitoring, further measures and a second cut-off. The minister answered that the expected saving is 4 to 6 minutes but cannot yet be verified, that weekly soundings and a planned measurement campaign will monitor the channel, that quarterly punctuality data will be provided and reviewed in the 2020 transport plan, and that a second bend cut-off and a long-term vision are in preparation.
The information requested by your House is not available in time for the General Consultation on the Wadden of 26 June 2019.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde informatie is niet tijdig beschikbaar voor het Algemeen Overleg Wadden van 26 juni 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Kwart miljoen boetes voor 1 km/u te hard: 'Dit riekt naar spekken staatskas'

VVD MPs asked the government whether fining drivers for speeding just 1 km/h over is justified, given that administration costs (9 euro) nearly equal the fine, and raised questions about the 130 km/h lower tolerance, foreign offenders and camera-based enforcement. The Justice Minister defended enforcement of small speeding offences for road safety, explained the cost breakdown and the abolition of the lower tolerance on 130 km/h roads, and reported on cross-border enforcement and the start of camera use by the tax authority.
Traffic enforcement exists to promote compliance with traffic rules and thereby safeguard road safety.
Verkeershandhaving is er om de naleving van de verkeersregels te bevorderen en daarmee de verkeersveiligheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht ‘Koppositie Schiphol als poort naar VS onder druk’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that US pressure threatens Schiphol's position and about the state of the pre-clearance negotiations, including costs, benefits and the government's role. The minister replied that there is no pressure, that the negotiations are ongoing, that any treaty must comply with Dutch, EU and international law and that parliament will approve the treaty after negotiations conclude.
Afterwards the treaty will be submitted to parliament for approval.
Daarna zal het verdrag ter goedkeuring aan het parlement worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Koerhuis over het bericht dat Amstelveen vasthoudt aan 2500 nieuwe studentenwoningen

MPs Dijkstra and Koerhuis asked whether Amstelveen's plan for 2,500 student dwellings under Schiphol flight paths risks residents' safety and health and circumvents Schiphol airspace rules. The minister answered that the plan is only a non-binding area vision, that the LIB rules restrict housing near flight paths and that consultation with the province and ministries will follow, but declined to judge the plan before a binding zoning plan exists.

In the short term, consultation will take place between representatives of the municipality, the province of Noord-Holland and the ministries of BZK and IenW to discuss how the area vision and the zoning plan still to be drawn up relate to the LIB rules.

Op korte termijn vindt nader overleg plaats tussen vertegenwoordigers van de gemeente, de provincie Noord-Holland en de ministeries van BZK en IenW om te bespreken hoe de Gebiedsvisie en het nog op te stellen bestemmingsplan zich verhouden tot de regels van het LIB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het Amsterdamse parkeervergunningenbeleid

VVD MPs Dijkstra and Ziengs asked why Amsterdam's parking permit policy excludes older vehicles such as classic cars, whether an emissions-class (RDW) system would be fairer, whether municipalities may regulate this, which Amsterdam streets still exceed the air quality norm, and what legal change would be needed. The State Secretary answered that municipalities set parking policy within the Gemeentewet, that Amsterdam chose registration-date cut-offs pending RDW emissions-class registration, that municipal autonomy permits such rules, that NO2 exceedances remained on several named streets in 2017, and that changing the Wegenverkeerswet was not appropriate.
Municipalities determine their parking permit policy within the framework of the Municipalities Act.
Gemeenten bepalen binnen de kaders van de Gemeentewet hun beleid ten aanzien van parkeervergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de informele Transportraad van 26-27 maart 2019

MPs Dijkstra and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the EU heavy-duty and car CO2 standards adopted at the March 2019 informal Transport Council count toward the 7.3 Mton mobility target, and why NEV 2017 already assumed some of these standards. The Staatssecretaris answered that the heavy-vehicle standards contribute 0.9-1.4 Mton, explained the NEV 2017 assumptions, and said the new standards will be included in the KEV 2019.
The tightened CO2 standards for passenger, light commercial and heavy vehicles will also be included in the Climate and Energy Outlook (KEV) of 2019.
De aangescherpte CO 2 -normen voor personen-, bestel- en vrachtauto's zullen ook in de Klimaat- en Energieverkenning (KEV) van 2019 worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Bosman over het bericht 'Vlaketunnel uren dicht door storing: lange files'

MPs Dijkstra and Bosman asked the minister about a failure that closed the Vlaketunnel for hours, causing long traffic jams, and whether Zeeland's access and tunnel closures could be avoided. The minister explained the SCADA power-supply fault during maintenance, outlined detour routes and planned replacement of the control system, and said a change to the Tunnelwet is not needed.
Currently various actions are being taken. Among other things, replacement of the SCADA system is being prepared.
Momenteel worden er verschillende acties ondernomen. Onder andere wordt vervanging van het SCADA systeem voorbereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over foute verkeersboetes op de A29

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about erroneous speed fines on the A29, including whether the government will refund around 18,000 fines after a court ruling. The Minister answers that the ruling does not require refunds, that a NMi study found the speed measurements reliable, and that collection of the fines will resume.
After investigation it has indeed emerged that the speed measurements were reliable and therefore there is no need to doubt the basis of the fines.
Na onderzoek is immers gebleken dat de snelheidsmetingen betrouwbaar waren en derhalve niet aan de grondslag van de boetes hoeft te worden getwijfeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Remco Dijkstra over de A16 Rotterdam

Rep. Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that the minister would consider 80 km/h on the A16 Rotterdam, and about design speed, environmental margins, opening date and mitigation for residents. The minister answered that the road is designed for 120 km/h but will have a 100 km/h limit for uniform traffic flow and junction reasons, that air quality and noise stay within limits, that opening is planned for 2024, and that construction-phase nuisance is mitigated.
The maximum speed will however be 100 km/h, as also described in the Tracébesluit.
De maximumsnelheid zal echter 100 kilometer per uur zijn, zoals ook is beschreven in het Tracébesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Meer geld naar veilige weg'

An MP asked the minister about a report calling for more road-safety investment, whether provinces and municipalities could be pushed to spend more on road infrastructure, and how much provinces spend on roads. The minister agreed investment in safety is needed, pointed to the Strategic Plan for Road Safety 2030 and a planned autumn consultation with IPO, VNG and transport regions, and gave provincial spending figures while noting motor-vehicle-tax revenues are general funds.
In the autumn I will discuss progress on implementing the SPV with IPO, VNG and the transport regions during an administrative consultation.
In het najaar spreek ik tijdens een bestuurlijk overleg met IPO, VNG en de vervoersregio's over de voortgang van de uitvoering van het SPV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘VVD wil lozen van giftige resten in de Rotterdamse haven aanpakken.’

An MP from the VVD asked the minister whether a pilot area and a national ban on discharging toxic residues (vapour degassing) from ships in the Rotterdam port should be supported, and what restrictions exist. The minister supports the idea of gaining experience with degassing installations, refers the matter to the existing Taskforce and high-level group, and says a ban must come as soon as possible without fragmenting rules.
Of course, the emission of toxic vapour substances must be eliminated as quickly as possible, provided it is reasonably feasible to comply with the ban.
Natuurlijk moet zo snel mogelijk het uitstoten van dampvormige giftige stoffen uitbannen worden, onder voorwaarde dat het redelijkerwijs mogelijk is om aan het verbod te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Betsjinning brêgen en sluzen Ofslútdyk ûnbetrouber'

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked why defects in the Afsluitdijk bridge and lock control systems were only investigated in 2018, what safety risks arose, and whether the cost and liability for the faulty installation would be pursued against the contractor. The minister answered that 15 related incidents occurred without accidents, extra staff and cameras were deployed, costs are about EUR 0.5 million, and Rijkswaterstaat will report on liability before summer.
Rijkswaterstaat will prepare a factual account before summer to determine the degree of liability and take a position on it.
Rijkswaterstaat maakt voor de zomer een feitenrelaas om de mate van aansprakelijkheid te bepalen en daar een positie over in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Kiwa Register start ‘veel te laat’ met uitgifte nieuwe tachokaarten’

MPs Dijkstra (VVD) and Stoffer (SGP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about delays in issuing smart tachograph cards, which may leave lorries unable to operate after 15 June 2019. The minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to capacity shortages at card producer Idemia, said the ILT assesses overmacht case by case rather than suspending fines, and stated that further solutions depend on talks with other member states and the European Commission.
The delay is caused by a shortage of capacity at card producer Idemia.
De vertraging wordt veroorzaakt door tekort aan capaciteit bij kaartproducent Idemia.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Laan-Geselschap en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Tienduizenden boetes trajectcontrole A2-tunnel bij Maastricht zijn onterecht'

MPs asked whether unclear signage at the A2 tunnel near Maastricht made tens of thousands of average-speed fines invalid after a court ruling, and how affected drivers would be compensated. The minister replied that the signage met the rules, was clarified in late 2017, that the court only set one fine to zero on its facts, and that no collective correction is planned.
Rijkswaterstaat has indicated that the signage on the A2 meets the requirements for traffic signs. There is therefore no question of wrongly imposed fines.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft aangegeven dat de bebording op de A2 voldoet aan de eisen inzake verkeerstekens. Er is dan ook geen sprake van onterecht opgelegde boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de twee vliegtuigongelukken met de Boeing 737 MAX

An MP asked the minister why the Dutch airspace was closed immediately after the Boeing 737 MAX groundings without accommodating planes already en route, why no notification reached TUI earlier, whether the flights faced imminent danger, whether TUI's force majeure claim holds, and how quickly the ILT communicates. The minister answered that the closure was a precautionary national decision, that TUI was kept informed via a NOTAM and direct contact, that the diversions were TUI's own choice, that the situation may qualify as extraordinary circumstances for compensation to be decided by the court, and that the ILT stayed in close contact with EASA and TUI.
The decision to close the Dutch airspace as a precaution was taken by the Netherlands, not by EASA.
Het besluit om het Nederlandse luchtruim uit voorzorg te sluiten is niet door EASA maar door Nederland genomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Dik-Faber en Remco Dijkstra over de doorlooptijden bij het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

MPs asked why driving licence renewals at the CBR take so long, leaving people without valid licences and at risk of losing their jobs, and about poor communication and the four-week response standard. The minister acknowledged the delays, described CBR capacity expansion, priority handling for expiring licences and professional drivers, and extra information measures, but did not discuss specific cases.
The CBR must provide clarity on the renewal of the driving licence within four months. Unfortunately, this is currently not achieved in all cases by the CBR.
Het CBR dient binnen vier maanden duidelijkheid te geven over de vernieuwing van het rijbewijs. Dit wordt op dit moment helaas niet in alle gevallen gehaald door het CBR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Politie zoekt getuigen van levensgevaarlijke rit over wielerparcours’

MPs Dijkstra and Heerema asked about police escort of cycling races, the legality of volunteer 'motards' directing traffic, and whether organisers should fund police presence. The minister answered that motards may not direct traffic while riding, that the police role is supervisory, and that the government will consult the KNWU and other parties on possible problems if police involvement is reduced.
Yes. I consider it important to get the possible problems clearly in view and to jointly explore possible solutions, including regarding the deployment of motards.
Ja. Ik vind het belangrijk om de mogelijke problemen goed in beeld te krijgen en gezamenlijk mogelijke oplossingen te verkennen, ook waar het gaat om de inzet van motards.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Van den Bosch en Lodders over het bericht 'Bestuurslid luidt noodklok: 'Waterschap Rivierenland heeft straks een half miljard schuld'

MPs of the VVD asked the government about a report that water board Rivierenland faces a debt of half a billion euros, asking how financial positions of water boards are monitored, whether rising dike-reinforcement costs and interest rates threaten investment plans, and whether water boards keep to their core tasks. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answered that each water board is responsible for its own finances under oversight by its general board and the provinces (including the Wet FIDO interest-risk norm), that the cost trends are not yet a established trend and are being monitored, that dike safety planning is not in jeopardy, and that water boards' core tasks are legally limited with provinces supervising them.
Each water board is itself responsible for its own financial position.
Ieder waterschap is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de eigen financiële positie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘De oplossing: én-en!’

An MP asked the state secretary why introducing E10 petrol in the Netherlands is taking so long, its CO2 benefits, prices, foreign experience, and which cars can use it. The state secretary said introduction is planned for 1 October 2019 pending procedural steps, that E10 is about 2 cents cheaper, and that about 1 million older cars are unsuitable.
I want the introduction of E10 to take place as quickly as possible and for motorists to be properly informed.
Ik wil dat de introductie van E10 nu zo snel mogelijk plaatsvindt en dat de automobilist op de juiste manier wordt geïnformeerd

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over een werkbezoek aan de vissers Lauwersoog d.d. 6 januari 2019 en diverse berichten in de media over de overboord geslagen zeecontainers van

MPs from the VVD asked about the MSC Zoe container loss off the Wadden islands, its risks for fisheries and shipping, liability, recovery timelines, and container securing rules. The minister answered that the shipowner is held liable and must recover containers within a two-month expected timeframe, that investigations by the OM and OvV are underway, and that securing rules were tightened in 2016, but gave no exact compliance percentage.
At present no exact percentage is known of ships where cargo has been properly secured.
Op dit moment is geen exact percentage bekend van schepen waar op de juiste wijze lading vastgezet is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht in De Limburger ‘Fileleed A2 Weert-Eindhoven: snelle maatregelen laten op zich wachten’

MPs Remco Dijkstra and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why quick measures on the congested A2 Weert–Eindhoven route were delayed, including whether the 2017 traffic analysis still holds, what happened to a motion on innovative measures, and why road widening was not pursued. The minister replied that the 2017 picture remains current, listed the measures taken (a travel assistant, filesignalering, a lighting study) and the planned research, and explained that other regional bottlenecks were prioritised over widening, with a no-regret package being implemented.
The SmartwayZ.NL Programme Council has commissioned a feasibility study of additional measures from the 2017 MIRT research, excluding widening.
De Programmaraad SmartwayZ.NL heeft opdracht gegeven de haalbaarheid te onderzoeken van aanvullende maatregelen uit het MIRT onderzoek uit 2017, niet zijnde verbreding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Remco Dijkstra, Van der Graaf, Von Martels, Gijs van Dijk, Van Aalst, Schonis en Laçin over de nieuwe prijsverhoging voor tachograafkaarten

MPs asked whether the government would accept a proposed 5% price rise for tachograph cards by Kiwa, how the Dutch price compares with neighbouring countries, and why the new fee system has not yet taken effect. The minister said the current card price stays at 95 euro while a new generation card is priced at 100 euro due to new EU requirements, promised a benchmark study and a letter later in the year, and refused to suspend the price increase despite a motion.
No, the tariffs for tachograph cards remain at the established price.
Nee, de tarieven voor de tachograafkaarten blijven op de vastgestelde prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Beroepschauffeurs werkloos door chaos bij CBR'

MP Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that professional drivers were left without work because of delays in medical assessments at the CBR, asking whether warnings existed, whether the backlog would be cleared, and how to prevent recurrence. The minister acknowledged the delays persist beyond expectations, said the CBR is helping affected drivers and that digitalisation should prevent future problems, and pointed to expedited procedures.
Last November I informed you that the processing times for medical assessments are still too long.
Afgelopen november heb ik u gemeld dat de doorlooptijden van medische beoordelingen nog steeds te lang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Die helm komt er, overal’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Amsterdam's plan to move mopeds to the road and require helmets on busy bike paths, questioning its justification, evaluation timing, consistency across cities and enforcement. The minister answers that road managers must justify their traffic decisions, that the national government will monitor road safety effects and reconsider if negative side effects appear, and that the decision is decentralised within national frameworks.
If that monitoring shows that undesirable side effects on road safety occur, that is an important reason for me to reconsider my decision-making.
Als uit die monitoring blijkt dat ongewenste neveneffecten op de verkeersveiligheid optreden, dan is dat voor mij een belangrijke reden om mijn besluitvorming te heroverwegen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Vliegveld Londen-Gatwick gesaboteerd met drones’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the drone disruption at London Gatwick airport and whether a similar situation could occur in the Netherlands, and what measures would be taken. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to existing drone bans and police enforcement, upcoming EU registration and identification rules expected in June 2019, and said consultation with other ministries and airports would follow on possible additional measures.
In the short term I will consult with the Ministry of Justice and Security and the various airports to see whether additional measures need to be taken.
Ik ga op korte termijn in overleg met het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de verschillende luchthavens om te bezien of er nog aanvullende maatregelen genomen moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Veerstoep bij pontje moet beter beveiligd'

An MP asks the minister about reports that ferry landings (veerstoepen) are unsafe, with several deaths, and whether level crossing safety studies could include them. The minister says the local road manager and ferry owner are responsible, risk analyses will be done under the road safety plan, and the Chamber will be informed by year end.
Responsibility for the infrastructure lies with the municipality or the province, depending on where the ferry landing is located.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de infrastructuur ligt bij de gemeente, dan wel de provincie, afhankelijk van waar de veerstoep zich bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Rode Kruis: “Stop met filmen, ga liever helpen”’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister whether bystanders filming accident victims and obstructing rescuers, including 25 fines issued on the A58 for phone use while driving, are adequately addressed and whether privacy is harmed. The minister said filming in public is generally lawful but morally wrong when victims are filmed, that phone use while driving is punishable, and that the government will propose a separate offence for obstructing rescuers and rely on existing portrait-right protections.
Therefore the cabinet proposes to make obstructing rescue workers a standalone criminal offence in the Criminal Code, regardless of where it takes place.
Daarom stelt het kabinet voor om het hinderen van hulpverleners als zelfstandig delict strafbaar te stellen in het Wetboek van Strafrecht, ongeacht waar dit plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Overlast door bruiloftsstoet: de feiten’

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Dijkstra (VVD) asked whether wedding convoys disrupting traffic with antisocial manoeuvres, including a Rotterdam convoy throwing fireworks, are being tackled, how many such incidents occurred, and whether rental-car operators could be blacklisted. The minister replied that police act on reports and issue fines, that no separate registration exists, that investigation of the Rotterdam incidents is ongoing, and that no blacklist is considered necessary.
The police have informed me that no separate registration of these is kept.
De politie heeft mij laten weten dat hiervan geen aparte registratie wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Spoor in plaats van vliegen kansloze missie’

An MP asked the Infrastructure Minister and State Secretary about cost comparisons between rail, road and aviation infrastructure, government spending and revenues by mode, and whether all costs should be weighed in modal choices. The government answered that it funds infrastructure mainly via the Infrastructure Fund, that full per-kilometre cost comparisons are complex, commissioned KiM research, and committed to outputs for the Mobility Fund in early 2019.
We will also use the outcomes of these studies when developing the Mobility Fund.
We zullen de uitkomsten van deze studies ook benutten bij de uitwerking van het Mobiliteitsfonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Remco Dijkstra over het artikel 'Lightyear in Helmond wil lage bijtelling zonne-auto’s'

MPs Sienot and Remco Dijkstra asked whether the government supports solar-powered cars such as Lightyear's, whether a workable legal definition is possible, and whether the zero-emission company-car tax exemption for hydrogen cars could be extended to them. The state secretary answered that the government supports the innovation through several channels, that a definition is feasible but needs further study, and that the tax treatment will be reviewed and reported to parliament by mid-2019.
It is too early to attach concrete criteria to this yet.
Het is te vroeg om hier nu al concrete criteria aan te hangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Ruim duizend automobilisten onder invloed van drugs’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the backlog of over a thousand drug-driving cases, sentencing levels, drug-test practice and enforcement capacity. The Minister said cases are being scheduled in stages, sentences follow the prosecutors' guideline with a higher penalty proposed in a pending bill, and the police are reviewing how they register test results.
I intend to speak with the police about options for more separate registration, and this point will also be addressed.
Ik ben voornemens met de politie te spreken over mogelijkheden voor meer afzonderlijke registratie, waarbij ook dit punt aan de orde zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Het rode gevaar komt uit het westen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the American crayfish harms Dutch waters, including its effects on biodiversity, extra dredging, EU water quality targets, and whether the Fisheries Act blocks effective control. The minister answered that species-specific risks are known, that fishing exemptions and water board contacts exist, that further research is with regional partners, and that recreational use of professional gear is not desirable.
It is up to the regional parties to determine whether further research is worthwhile.
Het is aan de regionale partijen om te bepalen of verder onderzoek zinvol is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Oproep na vliegtuigincident: wissel zwarte lijsten uit’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about unruly airline passengers, the damage they cause, and why shared blacklists of banned passengers have not yet been implemented. The minister answered that incidents are reported to the ABL, that Dutch airlines are examining sharing blacklists with the Dutch data protection authority, and that international action will follow once national clarity exists.
At national and international level I am taking action so that airlines can share blacklists in order to exclude disruptive passengers.
Op nationaal en internationaal niveau onderneem ik actie zodat luchtvaartmaatschappijen zwarte lijsten kunnen uitwisselen om zo ordeverstorende passagiers te kunnen weren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Langer 100 km/u op A32 bij Heerenveen’

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked whether a Heerenveen newspaper report about keeping 100 km/h on the A32 implied noise-norm breaches, and whether speed limits should be lowered without noise, environmental or safety grounds. The minister replied that no noise norms are exceeded on the stretch, that the municipality may fund extra noise measures but has not announced any, and that speed limits will be reviewed periodically and published in a draft traffic decree.
The 2016 noise production ceiling compliance report shows that on this road section there is no exceedance or imminent exceedance of the established noise production ceilings.
Uit het nalevingsverslag Geluidproductieplafonds 2016 blijkt dat er op dit wegvak geen overschrijding of dreigende overschrijding plaatsvindt van de vastgestelde geluidproductieplafonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht 'Trekkerrijbewijs zorgt voor uitsluiten buitenlandse stagiaires'

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the T-licence rule that reportedly excludes foreign interns from driving agricultural tractors on public roads. The minister confirmed the rule, explained the grandfathering for licences issued before 1 July 2015, and said interns can still operate tractors on private land and the rule is non-discriminatory and justified by road safety.
The requirement is non-discriminatory and applies to everyone, regardless of nationality.
De eis is non-discriminatoir en geldt voor iedereen, ongeacht nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Spanish cities grapple with invasion of electric scooters’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Spanish cities struggling with electric scooters and whether similar initiatives, safety rules and experimentation room exist in the Netherlands. The minister replied that electric steps are currently classed as special mopeds with rules being reviewed by SWOV, RDW and the Safety Board, that municipalities cannot themselves admit vehicles to public roads, and that the Strategic Road Safety Plan will take these developments into account.
Municipalities cannot independently decide to admit vehicles to the public road.
