Gemeenten kunnen niet zelfstandig besluiten om voertuigen toe te laten tot de openbare weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Files en ongelukken op A50: 'Het is hard nodig dat stuk tussen Oss en Nijmegen wordt aangepakt'’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about traffic jams and accidents on the A50 between Oss and Nijmegen, including its place in national capacity analyses, freight and cost figures, and whether funding and regional cooperation could fix it. The minister answered that the A50 is not in the coalition agreement or the NMCA top 10 so it is not a current investment priority, but agreed to a joint regional study of causes and solutions to be discussed at the MIRT meeting of 21 November 2018.
Nevertheless, I am willing to work with the region to look at the causes and possible solutions for traffic obstruction on the A50.
Desondanks ben ik wel bereid om samen met de regio te kijken naar de oorzaken en mogelijke oplossingen voor verkeershinder op de A50.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de berichten “Frankrijk wil tolvignet voor vrachtwagens” en “Franse minister wil tolvignet voor buitenlandse vrachtwagens”

An MP asked the Infrastructure minister how France's proposed toll sticker for trucks, aimed at foreign lorries, fits EU policy, what it means for Dutch hauliers, and whether it can be discussed with France. The minister replied that such vignettes exist in several member states, that a national-only vignette for foreign vehicles would be discriminatory under EU law, that she will watch closely that Dutch transporters are not discriminated against, and that since France has no concrete plan yet, any discussion would most likely be bilateral.
If a French vignette is introduced, I will closely monitor that our Dutch transporters are not discriminated against.
Als een Frans vignet zal worden ingevoerd, zal ik er scherp op toezien dat onze Nederlandse transporteurs niet gediscrimineerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘ministerie dendert door met vliegtaks’

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers why the ministry is pushing ahead with an aviation tax, how it fits the three-track policy, and how the EU, sector and other countries are involved. The government answers that it is pursuing all three tracks in parallel, that a national aviation tax may be introduced from 2021 if the European and emissions/noise routes yield too little, and that consultation, bilateral contacts and a Brussels coordination effort are underway.
The cabinet will make a choice this autumn on which variant can be worked out in national legislation
Het kabinet maakt dit najaar een keuze welke variant in nationale wetgeving kan worden uitgewerkt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Vis kan eindelijk door Haringvlietdam, maar daarachter wachten netten en fuiken’

MPs Weverling and Remco Dijkstra asked about the opening of the Haringvliet dam sluices (Kierbesluit), concerns over saltwater intrusion into freshwater supplies during drought, monitoring, and evaluation. The ministers answered that freshwater intakes were relocated, saltwater intrusion is avoided in low-Rhine-flow periods, monitoring and telemetry will follow the effects, and no evaluation conclusions can yet be drawn.
Work is done on a risk-controlled basis, starting with smaller openings and situations with relatively high Rhine discharge.
Er wordt risico-gestuurd gewerkt, waarbij gestart wordt met kleinere openingen en situaties met relatief veel Rijnafvoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Remco Dijkstra over het in Nederland houden van het vliegend erfgoed De Catalina

MPs Aartsen and Dijkstra asked whether the government would act to keep the historic Catalina aircraft in the Netherlands before its sale to a US buyer. The minister answered that the aircraft has no protected status, that no other party has yet offered to fund the purchase, and that a request must come from a heritage institution to the Mondriaan Fonds before a decision can be made.
I am willing to take action, but I depend on the willingness of the parties involved to come up with a good proposal and submit it to the Mondriaan Fund.
Ik ben bereid om actie te ondernemen, maar ben daarbij afhankelijk van de bereidheid van de betrokken partijen om met een goed voorstel te komen en dit in te dienen bij het Mondriaan Fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘AirBridgeCargo verkiest Luik boven Schiphol als Europese hub’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about AirBridgeCargo shifting part of its European hub operations to Liège, cargo slot scarcity at Schiphol, job risks, and alternatives such as Maastricht Aachen Airport. The minister said AirBridgeCargo will keep operating via Schiphol, acknowledged that some cargo carriers moved operations due to slot shortages, announced further research and a possible revision of the local slot rule, but could not quantify job losses.
It is currently not possible to reliably quantify the potential damage.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk om de potentiële schade op betrouwbare wijze te becijferen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘OM moet tienduizenden flitsboetes A29 terugbetalen’

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that the OM must refund tens of thousands of speeding fines on the A29 at Heinenoord, and when the OM knew of the doubts, whether the fines will be refunded and when, whether other locations are affected, and whether small-speed fine margins should change. The minister answered that the measurements were considered reliable until a court ruling of 16 July 2018, that the OM has appealed and is awaiting the outcome, that refunds will follow only if the appeal court finds the measurement unreliable, and that the fines policy will be addressed to parliament in autumn.
The OM has lodged an appeal. The outcome of this will first have to be awaited.
Het OM heeft hoger beroep ingesteld. De uitkomst hiervan zal eerst moeten worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de berichten 'Vliegboot Catalina uit de lucht door geldgebrek' en 'Catalina voortijdig aan de grond door motorpech'

An MP asked the minister about reports that the historic Catalina flying boat was grounded due to lack of funds and engine failure, and whether strict aviation rules and ILT certification delays are to blame. The minister said the Raad van State ruling restricting paid flights would be lifted by a new EU basic regulation, that the ILT issued the airworthiness certificate within the legal deadline, and that the culture ministry is open to support but only if other parties will operate the aircraft.
The ILT handles applications within the statutory deadlines and as quickly as possible.
De ILT behandelt de aanvragen binnen de wettelijke termijnen en zo snel als mogelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht: "Bergers: 'Verloren tijd bij aanpak fileleed'" en het interview met de voorzitter van de Vereniging van Bergings- en Mobiliteitsspecialisten (VBM) in de Nat

An MP asked the minister about delays in positioning tow trucks at strategic locations, claimed time savings, the scope for expansion beyond 20 locations, heavy-goods corridors, and blue flashing lights for tow trucks. The minister answered that the contracts start 1 April 2019 with no delay, that trials showed about 5 minutes faster arrival, and that benefits fall with more locations, while the second traffic package will be presented later this year.
The definitive award of all districts follows on 1 October 2018.
De definitieve gunning van alle rayons volgt per 1 oktober 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten, Remco Dijkstra, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht 'Nederlands rijbewijs online te koop via Poolse website'

MPs from VVD and SP asked whether fake Dutch driving licences sold via a Polish website endanger road safety, how often forgeries are found and prosecuted, what is being done to take the site down, and whether employers check licences. The minister answered that forgeries are rare and prosecuted under existing law, that Poland lacks a legal basis to act against the site until a pending bill takes effect, and that the site's removal depends on Polish authorities.
The Polish Ministry said the relevant Polish authorities are aware of the site's activities, but without a legal expansion there is no basis to act against these practices.

Het Poolse Ministerie liet weten dat de relevante Poolse autoriteiten aandacht hebben voor de activiteiten van de bewuste site, maar dat zonder wettelijke verruiming er geen grond is voor optreden tegen deze praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Gemeenten zijn irritant zoemende drones zat’

RemcoDijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a news report on municipalities being fed up with drone noise, and whether a sector code of conduct is desirable. The minister supports a voluntary code as self-regulation alongside existing rules, notes KNVvL and a Flevoland environmental service are drafting one for drone flights over nature areas, and says rollout is for the sector and provinces, with the code to be raised with the IPO.
I will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the Interprovincial Consultation (IPO).
Ik zal deze gedragscode onder de aandacht brengen van het Interprovinciaal Overleg (IPO).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Remco Dijkstra over harmonisatie van milieuzones

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the growing patchwork of municipal low-emission zones and the need for uniform national rules before 2020, including questions on communication, proportionality and judicial review. The State Secretary agreed harmonisation is desirable, outlined the planned Euro-class system for 2020 and said municipal zones and their traffic decisions remain open to appeal.
The traffic decision underlying the environmental zone is open to objection and appeal.
Het verkeersbesluit dat ten grondslag ligt aan de milieuzone staat immers open voor bezwaar en beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Bijna 3000 waarschuwingen voor scooters in milieuzone’

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about warnings issued to scooter riders entering Amsterdam's environmental zone, including enforcement methods, the age-based cut-off, and where fines go. The state secretary answered that municipalities set zone rules, enforcement uses ANPR cameras and officers, fines go to the CJIB, and no change to Amsterdam's zone for mopeds is planned.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam to determine which rules apply to entering the environmental zone.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam om te bepalen welke regels er gelden voor het betreden van de milieuzone.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Risico op instorten bij zeker honderd bruggen en viaducten door achterstallig onderhoud’

An MP asked the minister whether reports of collapse risk for hundreds of bridges and viaducts due to deferred maintenance are accurate, and what is being done. The minister answered that there is no collapse danger, that the 14 flagged objects had their risks addressed by measures already taken, and pointed to the investment programme and budget documents.
There is no danger of collapse for bridges and viaducts.
Er is geen sprake van instortingsgevaar bij bruggen en viaducten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht: 'Honderden appende vrachtwagenchauffeurs betrapt vanuit touringcar'

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about reports that 440 drivers, many of them professional truck drivers, were fined for phone use while driving, and about campaigns, enforcement and sentencing. The minister acknowledged the figures as worrying, described an upcoming public campaign and a voluntary convenant with industry, noted rising handheld-phone violations, and said a sentencing bill on dangerous phone use would go to the Council of State and then parliament.
I expect to be able to send the bill to your House after the summer.
Ik verwacht het wetsvoorstel vervolgens na de zomer aan uw Kamer te kunnen sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Remco Dijkstra over het stroomnetwerk rond Haarlemmermeer

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about electricity capacity shortages around Haarlemmermeer and the 29 April 2018 power outage at Schiphol. Minister Wiebes answered that grid expansion is underway, referred to earlier answers on several questions, said the Schiphol outage report is pending, and denied a causal link between capacity shortages and the Amsterdam outages.
I will not go into causes and consequences ahead of the final outcomes of this investigation.
Ik ga niet in op oorzaken en gevolgen vooruitlopend op de definitieve uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yesilgöz-Zegerius inzake het bericht 'Haven wil CO2 duurder maken'

MPs Dijkstra and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether a Northwest-European minimum CO2 price proposed by the Port of Rotterdam is realistic, how to avoid a Dutch go-it-alone, what investments a €50-70 price would bring, and how to keep chemical industry and the port competitive in the energy transition. The minister answered that the government seeks Northwest-European cooperation and flanking policy, is still studying a minimum CO2 price within the national Klimaatakkoord process, and has sector tables examining industrial investment projects.
The cabinet explicitly seeks cooperation with like-minded Northwest European countries.
Het kabinet zoekt nadrukkelijk samenwerking met gelijkgezinde Noordwest-Europese landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Ook bij storm moet KLM passagiers compenseren

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a court ruling requiring KLM to compensate passengers for cancellations during a storm and whether EU passenger rights rules have gone too far. The minister referred to the court ruling, explained that a general air traffic capacity reduction is not an extraordinary circumstance excusing compensation, and said the EU passenger rights regulation should be revised, though no solution to the Gibraltar dispute is yet in sight.
That is why I consider a revision of the passenger rights regulation desirable and necessary.
Daarom vind ik een herziening van de passagiersrechtenverordening wenselijk en noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Jouw medicijnen worden straks misschien wel door een drone gebracht’

MPs Koopmans and Remco Dijkstra asked the ministers about news that drones may deliver medicines, and about drone innovation, timing of an integrated vision, privacy and airspace safety, miniaturised or camouflaged drones and drone swarms in private hands. The government answered that it keeps its drone policy course, that general privacy rules and EU safety regulation apply, that small camouflaged drones filming covertly may be criminal, and that swarm flights will need to meet safety requirements under forthcoming EU rules.
This cabinet maintains the course set earlier, as stated in the most recent progress letter on drone policy of 28 May 2018.
Dit kabinet houdt vast aan de eerder ingezette koers zoals verwoord in de meest recente voortgangsbrief dronebeleid van 28 mei 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Maasvlakte: buitenlanders vrijuit op milieuzone’

An MP asks whether foreign trucks entering the Maasvlakte environmental zone face unequal treatment because their Euro emission class cannot be checked from the licence plate, and whether enforcement and fine collection abroad are assured. The government admits foreign vehicles can only be checked by roadside inspection, says it is exploring cross-border data exchange with the EU and other states, and promises to pursue a structural solution.
I would like to arrange the international exchange of vehicle data and keeper data.
Ik wil de internationale uitwisseling van voertuiggegevens en de gegevens van de kentekenhouder graag regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Omtzigt, Remco Dijkstra en Van der Graaf over de verkeersveiligheid op de N36

MPs from CDA, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the minister why the N36 would not be widened along two sections during this year's maintenance, despite a motion adopted by parliament, and whether the government would guarantee full widening. The minister confirmed awareness of the motion and the coalition agreement, outlined interim safety measures, and said the remaining sections are being studied with results due in the second half of 2018, but gave no guarantee of full widening.
Following the adopted motion, I am examining the added value of widening on the sections where major maintenance is not currently taking place.
Naar aanleiding van de aangenomen motie onderzoek ik wat de meerwaarde is van verbreding op de delen waar groot onderhoud nu niet plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Remco Dijkstra over een werkbezoek aan Schouwen-Duiveland

MPs Bosman and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about tractor restrictions on the N59 on Schouwen-Duiveland, including why only part of the road is closed and whether the safety risks of alternative routes will be independently investigated. The Minister confirmed awareness of the municipality's concerns, explained the criteria in the Zeeland agricultural traffic network, and said she is willing to support a new, additional independent study if needed.
If necessary, I am willing to cooperate in a new and additional independent study.
Indien het nodig is ben ik bereid om mee te werken aan een nieuw en aanvullend onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de berichten ‘Situatie buitendijkse haven is onvoorstelbaar’ en ‘Komst buitendijkse haven nog niet zeker’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the Maritime Service Harbour in Northern Flevoland is stalled because the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the province cannot agree on erfpacht terms, leaving banks unwilling to finance entrepreneurs. The Minister acknowledges the disagreement, says the Rijk is willing to talk further with the province, and suggests granting rights directly to entrepreneurs as a possible fix.
On the Rijk's side we are happy to enter further consultation with the province to achieve swift realisation of the Maritime Service Harbour.
Van Rijkszijde treden wij graag verder in overleg met de provincie om tot een snelle realisatie van de Maritieme Servicehaven te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Eindhoven wil eigen vliegtaks invoeren’

MPs of the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Eindhoven's motion to introduce a local aviation tax, including its legality, effects on competitiveness and whether other municipalities might follow. The Minister of the Interior answered that the decision rests with the municipal council, that such a tax would be tested by courts if challenged, and that the government prefers a national or European aviation levy instead.
It is up to the democratically elected representative body of the municipality, the municipal council, to decide on the introduction and levying of a tax.
Het is aan het democratisch vertegenwoordigende orgaan van de gemeente, de gemeenteraad, om de beslissing te nemen over de invoering en heffing van een belasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Wiersma over het bericht “Rotterdamse droogdok is al drie jaar besmet”

MPs Dijkstra and Wiersma asked about reports that Rotterdam dry-dock work on cruise ships has dropped since a 2014 Inspectie SZW fine, raising level-playing-field concerns. The minister acknowledged the uncertainty, promised an inventory of rules and enforcement in neighbouring countries before summer, and declined to disclose details of the ongoing court case.
There is currently a court case ongoing and during that period I cannot make statements.
Er loopt op dit moment een rechtszaak en gedurende die periode kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Alarm om haast vliegtaks'

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked why the ministry is already preparing an aviation tax, given the coalition agreement's European-route-first approach, and questioned its timing, effects and lessons from the 2008 tax. The State Secretary replied that parallel work on three tracks (European, emissions/noise levy, per-ticket charge) is needed to meet the 2021 budget target, with a letter to parliament before summer and an internet consultation, while answering most sub-questions on process and effects in general terms.
In my fiscal policy agenda I announced that I would send parliament a letter on the three tracks under investigation before summer.
In mijn fiscale beleidsagenda heb ik aangekondigd nog voor de zomer een brief over de drie te onderzoeken sporen naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Na ongelukken onnodig lang in de file door procedures’

An MP asked the minister whether breakdown and accident procedures on Dutch motorways unnecessarily prolong traffic jams, and what would be done to change them. The minister denied that procedures cause unnecessary delay, said safety comes first, and pointed to planned measures such as blue lights for weginspecteurs and a review of two-recovery-vehicle working arrangements.
I will, as said earlier, equip all road inspectors with blue lights so that they can reach incidents more quickly.
Wel zal ik, zoals eerder gezegd, alle weginspecteurs met blauw licht uitrusten zodat ze sneller bij incidenten aanwezig kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de werkwijze van het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheid

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why processing of health declarations for license renewal by people aged 75+ at the CBR takes so long, and whether it will be shortened. The minister explains that medical or driving tests can extend processing beyond four weeks, notes that people are advised to apply early, and states that performance agreements and investments in capacity and systems are expected to help.
I have made performance agreements with the CBR.
Ik heb met het CBR prestatieafspraken gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Schiphol laat capaciteit bewust onbenut'

An MP asked the minister why Schiphol decided not to transfer about 2,000 unused daytime winter slots to the busier summer season, and whether Schiphol had the legal power to decide this without consultation, given summer congestion. The minister replied that Schiphol, after failing to agree a capacity declaration with other parties, set it itself and will transfer about 835 night slots but not the daytime slots, citing expected peak congestion, and announced an amendment to the slot allocation decree.
To put an end to this unclear situation around the adoption of the capacity declaration, I am working on an amendment to the Slot Allocation Decree.
Om aan deze onduidelijke situatie rond de vaststelling van de capaciteitsdeclaratie een eind te maken, werk ik aan een aanpassing van het Besluit slotallocatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Campina en Unilever willen bereikbaar zijn in Wageningen’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about business access to Wageningen after a newspaper report, questioning whether car access to the town is under pressure and whether firms like Campina, TNO and Unilever suffer. The minister answered that the national motorways around Wageningen function adequately, and that responsibility for the local road network lies with the municipality and province.
Responsibility for that – insofar as it concerns the local road network – lies with the municipality and the province.
De verantwoordelijkheid daarvoor – voor zover het gaat om het onderliggend wegennet – ligt bij de gemeente en de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Lange ochtendfile op A9 vanwege gesloten spitsstrook en ongeval’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister why A9 peak-hour lanes stayed closed during a morning jam, whether they can be upgraded to regular lanes, and when Parliament will be informed. The minister attributed the closure to display faults, said a broader study on opening peak lanes will be sent around summer, and stated the Heiloo junction does not affect speed limits or lane upgrades.
Around the summer, your House will be informed about this.
Rond de zomer wordt uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Nederland is niet up-to-date’

MPs Dijkstra and Rutte asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch critical infrastructure is adequately protected against cyberattacks, whether attacks are increasing, and how the government keeps pace and funds cybersecurity. Minister Grapperhaus answered that he does not recognise the claim that critical infrastructure is inadequately protected, pointed to the Cybersecurity Act, the NCSC's role and EUR 95 million in structural funding, and promised the national Cybersecurity Agenda by end of April.
At the end of April this year, the Dutch Cybersecurity Agenda (NCSA) will be presented to your House.
Eind april van dit jaar zal de Nederlandse Cybersecurityagenda (NCSA) aan uw Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Lange files Rotterdam door storing Spijkenisserbrug'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about frequent failures of the Spijkenisser and Botlek bridges causing traffic jams around Rotterdam, their causes, accelerating the Spijkenisser bridge renovation, and contact with the Nissewaard municipality. The minister answered that failures were counted and remedial measures taken, that renovation is planned for 2021-2022 with acceleration being examined but limited, and that cooperation with the municipality is being intensified.
Rijkswaterstaat does not record data on economic damage.
Rijkswaterstaat registreert geen gegevens over economische schade.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht dat de Belasting van Personenauto's en Motorrijwielen (BPM)-opbrengst fors hoger is

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked whether the 27.4% rise in BPM car tax revenue for 2017 is real, what causes it, when the tariffs will be switched to WLTP-based tables, and how to prevent or compensate overpayment. The Secretary of State says final 2017 figures come in May 2018, attributes the rise mainly to economic growth and consumer preferences for larger cars rather than WLTP (only 128 WLTP cars sold), commits to a budget-neutral switch as soon as possible but not before analysis after summer 2018, and declines to investigate individual overpayment.
I am working to ensure that the BPM revenue (at macro level) does not rise as a result of the WLTP.
Ik zet mij in om de BPM-opbrengst (op macroniveau) niet te laten stijgen als gevolg van de WLTP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Drankrijders gaan na cursus net zo vaak weer de fout in’

Parliamentary questions from MP Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked about a report showing that drink-driving education courses (LEMA, EMG, ASP) may not reduce reoffending, and whether sanctions and communication between CBR and the Public Prosecution Service should be improved. The minister replied that a WODC study found a falling reoffending trend but inconclusive effectiveness evidence, that additional research is being considered, that overlapping administrative and criminal measures can reduce effectiveness, and that a letter on improvements will follow.
I am still considering whether it is possible to carry out additional research into the LEMA.
Ik bezie nog of het mogelijk is aanvullend onderzoek naar de LEMA te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Heerenveen wil stil asfalt op snelweg A32'

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked about residents' noise complaints near the A32 motorway at Heerenveen and whether noise ceilings were being respected. The minister answered that noise levels remain below the applicable production ceilings, outlined planned works and mitigation measures, and said she is already consulting the municipality.
Based on the most recent compliance report on noise production ceilings for 2016, the noise level along the A32 at Heerenveen is below the applicable noise production ceilings.
Op basis van het meest recente nalevingsverslag Geluidproductieplafonds 2016, ligt het geluidsniveau langs de A32 ter hoogte van Heerenveen onder de geldende geluidproductieplafonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Doorgetrokken streep helpt tegen ongelukken’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a continuous lane marking at the Feijenoord slip road of the Van Brienenoord bridge could reduce accidents, and what measures could improve safety on the A1 near Barneveld. The minister answered that a blokkenlijn was added in 2017, that its effects will be evaluated around summer 2018, and that a MIRT study on the A1/A30 Barneveld stretch will be completed in June 2018.
Around the summer I want to evaluate the measure and determine whether additional measures are necessary.
Rond de zomer wil ik de maatregel evalueren en bepalen of er aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Nieuwe auto’s duizenden euro’s duurder’

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the switch to WLTP testing will raise car registration tax (BPM) and prices, and about greener fleet policy. The State Secretary answered that CO2mpas recalculates WLTP emissions to NEDC values to keep current tables, that the impact cannot yet be judged, and that monitoring with RDW, TNO and industry will be extended, promising to keep the House informed; on fleet renewal the government relies on tax incentives for zero-emission cars rather than targeted fleet renewal.
I hereby undertake to keep your House informed of progress in this complex process.
Ik zeg bij deze toe uw Kamer op de hoogte te houden over de voortgang in dit complexe proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Minieme pakkans drugsrijder’

MPs Rutte and Dijkstra asked why drug-impaired drivers can go unpunished because the NFI lacks capacity to analyse blood samples, and what will be done about the backlog. The minister acknowledges the capacity shortfall, says analysis capacity will be expanded at short notice, that the most serious cases are prioritised, and that further information will follow in a letter at the end of January.
The analysis capacity will be substantially expanded in the short term.
De analysecapaciteit zal op korte termijn fors worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Stormachtig begin’

MPs Heerema and Dijkstra asked the minister whether the storm damage to the beach near Camperduin, where a beach pavilion closed, shows a risk to coastal safety, and whether Rijkswaterstaat should intervene against contractor Boskalis. The minister answered that sand loss is part of the dynamic coast, coastal safety is not endangered, Rijkswaterstaat monitors the coast annually, and sand nourishment will occur in spring 2018, so no intervention is needed now.
For this reason, the contractor will nourish sand in spring 2018 to maintain the coastline at Camperduin for the coming years as well.
Om deze reden zal de aannemer in het voorjaar van 2018 wel zand suppleren om de kustlijn ter hoogte van Camperduin ook voor de komende jaren te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Remco Dijkstra over uitstel verruiming Twentekanalen

MPs Ten Broeke and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a regional call to speed up the Twentekanalen widening, why the tender was withdrawn, and how to avoid the 18-month delay. The minister confirmed regular consultation with the region, explained the tender was withdrawn due to groundwater risks, and said the delay cannot be avoided, though some measures such as traffic restrictions and acceleration options are being explored.
Following this, the tender has been withdrawn in its current form.
Hierop is de aanbesteding in de huidige vorm ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over reorganisatie en bezuinigingen bij DowDuPont

MPs Dijkstra and Weverling asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the reported 500 job cuts at DuPont, the Dutch employment and investment picture of DowDuPont, and how to keep the Netherlands attractive for such firms. The minister confirmed the 500 figure applies only to DuPont, gave location-by-location employment and investment figures, and framed the chemical sector's role in decarbonisation.
Possible investments or divestments in the Netherlands resulting from these plans are not yet known.
Mogelijke investeringen of desinvesteringen in Nederland als gevolg van deze plannen zijn nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Maastricht Aachen Airport's inability to fully use its runway for loaded cargo flights, the risk of cargo airlines diverting to other airports, and the division of responsibilities. The minister answered that a decision allowing full runway length for departing cargo is taken in the short term, referred to a letter sent the same day, and set out the roles of the Rijk, the province, the ILT and the concessionaire.

This has led, among other things, to the agreement that the airport, together with the air cargo sector, will explore to what extent it can offer a solution to preserve and where possible strengthen the Dutch cargo market.

Dat heeft onder andere tot de afspraak geleid dat de luchthaven te samen met de luchtvrachtsector verkent in hoeverre zij een oplossing biedt om de vrachtmarkt voor Nederland te behouden en waar mogelijk te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “Stoot Nederlandse melkkoe meeste of minste methaan uit binnen Europa”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether differing EU member-state methods for estimating dairy cow methane emissions create an uneven playing field and whether Dutch methods should be harmonised. The minister answered that the IPCC-based, differentiated methods are mandatory and effective, that the earlier high figures were outdated and recalculated, and that no further harmonisation steps are needed.
I do not consider additional steps necessary, because the differences in calculation method are in line with international agreements and depend on the size of the source.
Ik acht aanvullende stappen niet nodig, want de verschillen in berekeningsmethode zijn overeenkomstig internationale afspraken en afhankelijk van de omvang van de bron.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Oude dieselauto’s niet meer welkom in Arnhemse binnenstad’

An MP asked the state secretary about Arnhem's plan to exclude older diesel cars from the city centre, questioning the measurement basis, the lack of uniform low-emission zone signage, and the proportionality of local measures. The state secretary replied that the Arnhem council has asked for further study of the measure's effectiveness, that a uniform national zone system will be decided before summer 2018, and that a bottleneck analysis of NO2 sources is underway.
It is my express aim to give clarity as soon as possible (before summer 2018) on how I intend to give substance to this, so that municipalities can take it into account.
Het is mijn nadrukkelijk streven zo snel mogelijk (voor de zomer van 2018) uitsluitsel te geven op welke wijze ik hier invulling aan wil geven, zodat gemeenten hier rekening mee kunnen houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het bericht 'Nieuw peilbesluit IJsselmeer negatief voor watersport'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a reported negative impact of the new IJsselmeer water-level decision on watersports, including whether the 10 cm lowering is needed for nature or climate goals, the basis for the reported economic losses, compensation, and whether the minister will talk with the sector. The minister answered that the lowering serves water storage and Natura 2000 goals, that the MER found no significant effects requiring compensation, that the economic estimates come from the sector and cannot be verified, and that talks with municipalities and the sector are ongoing with the decision expected around summer 2018.
The cost estimate for possible adverse economic effects on the watersports sector comes from the sector itself and cannot be verified by the ministry.
De kostenraming over mogelijke nadelige economische effecten voor de watersportsector is afkomstig van de sector zelf en is door het ministerie niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Bruins en Kröger over Lelystad

Five MPs asked the minister about press reports that former state secretary Dijksma criticised the ministry's capacity to handle the complex Lelystad Airport dossier, including the environmental impact assessment (MER). The minister acknowledged the reports, said the ministry has capable staff but needs extra expertise, and said the remarks do not affect the planned new MER assessment.
The ministry has competent and committed staff.
Het ministerie beschikt over kundige en betrokken medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de luchtkwaliteit en onderzoekscijfers voor emissies van TNO

MP Remco Dijkstra asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about a study finding LPG performs better than petrol and diesel on ground-level ozone, and whether TNO's outdated emission data for fuel factsheets should be updated with newer tests. The State Secretary answered that the factsheets will be updated before summer 2018, that TNO may use all available sources including the German study, and that electric driving is cleaner by definition while the fuel-technology picture is largely a matter of exhaust technology and fuel origin.
The plan is that the new update of the fuel factsheets will be available before summer 2018.
De planning is dat de nieuwe update van de factsheets brandstoffen vóór de zomer van 2018 beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de waterstofbussen in Arnhem

An MP asked the state secretary whether the hydrogen bus rollout in Arnhem is stagnating, whether more public money and risk-taking is needed, and what the national plan for hydrogen refuelling infrastructure is. The state secretary answered that hydrogen buses are still in an early innovation phase, that the ministry is subsidising a pilot and discussing a special-purpose vehicle to cover risks, and that the government facilitates through studies, subsidies and regional support.
The ministry has been in discussion with the region about this for some time.
Het ministerie is hierover al geruime tijd met de regio in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over mogelijke blootstelling van werknemers aan asbest

An MP asked the government about possible asbestos exposure of workers and residents after asbestos-contaminated blasting grit supplied by Eurogrit to about 140 buyers, and about preventive measures. The minister answered that the ILT and Inspectie SZW investigations are ongoing, that employers are responsible for safe removal, and that a TNO study and a letter to parliament will follow by end of October.
As soon as the results of the first part of the TNO investigation are known, your House will be informed about this by letter.
Zodra de resultaten van het eerste gedeelte van het TNO onderzoek bekend zijn, wordt uw Kamer hierover middels brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Remco Dijkstra over de aanpassing van de dienstregeling van het treinverkeer in het Rivierengebied

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about the 2018 timetable changes for rail in the Rivierengebied, including longer transfer times at Tiel and Geldermalsen, and how affected residents were weighed and consulted. The State Secretary confirmed the impacts, explained that the frequency upgrade on the Amsterdam–Eindhoven corridor required them, reported consultations via ROCOV, and said NS had only made a small improvement at Geldermalsen while finding no better option for Tiel.
NS is responsible for the timetable and regularly informs me as concession grantor about developments in the timetable.
NS is verantwoordelijk voor de dienstregeling en informeert mij als concessieverlener regelmatig over de ontwikkelingen in de dienstregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over het bericht ‘Tuinbouw in de knel door raffinaderijbrand Pernis’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the greenhouse sector's CO2 supply disruption after the Pernis refinery fire needs an emergency fix and talks with industry to prevent recurrence. The minister replied that CO2 supply is a private arrangement with no government role, but that EZ is exploring additional CO2 sources and buffering within existing green deal and smart grid frameworks, with timing unpredictable and supply restored from 21 August.
This is a collaboration between private parties, in which the government plays no role.
Dit is een samenwerking tussen private partijen, waarbij de overheid geen rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Oostenrijk hekelt Nederlandse aanpak drugsproducenten'

MPs Van Oosten and Dijkstra asked whether Austria's criticism that the Netherlands does too little against underground drug labs is justified, and about clean-up costs, cofinancing of drug-waste dumping and post-related drug trafficking. The minister rejected the claim of Dutch laxity, said the cooperation with Austria functions well, described the dismantling and cost-recovery arrangements, and reported underspending and an ongoing evaluation of the cofinancing scheme.
It has not become clear to the Dutch authorities which requests Austria is referring to in the reporting.
Het is de Nederlandse autoriteiten niet duidelijk geworden op welke verzoeken Oostenrijk in de berichtgeving duidt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en De Boer over een gesprek met stakeholders uit de spoorsector d.d. 13 maart 2017

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about a stakeholder meeting on rail, the new method for ProRail's user charge (VMT and a planned levy), its effect on freight competitiveness versus Germany, and the costs of rail safety systems. The State Secretary answered at length, explaining the new methodology, the planned multi-year levy differentiated by market segment, efficiency steering of ProRail, and that a diesel tax is not planned, while deferring some figures to later publications.
With this I aim for transparency and stability of the tariffs.
Ik beoog hiermee transparantie en stabiliteit van de tarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Zuid-Holland wil lozingen Chemours in Merwede verminderen'

An MP asked the State Secretary about provincial plans to reduce Chemours' GenX discharges into the Merwede, the risks to drinking water and the RIVM assessment. The government answered that it supports the provincial reduction, that the permit includes research obligations, and that Rijkswaterstaat and the RIVM continue to advise on the risks.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Visser over het bericht ‘Meer fijnstof achter het fornuis dan langs de snelweg’

MPs Dijkstra and Visser asked the State Secretary about a TNO study showing indoor fine-particle peaks from cooking that exceed outdoor levels, and about its representativeness, health implications, follow-up research and fit with the national air quality programme. The government answered that the study covers only nine homes, that indoor peaks are not covered by outdoor norms, that TNO and TKI Urban Energy research is underway, and that indoor ventilation rules in the Bouwbesluit apply.
TNO has indicated that an exploratory study will be carried out next year to determine emission factors for cooking meals.
TNO heeft laten weten dat er komend jaar een verkennende studie wordt gedaan naar bepaling van emissiefactoren van het koken van maaltijden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan de vereniging RONA in Overijssel en Gelderland op 20 februari jongstleden

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about freight train rerouting over Oost-Nederland lines, transparency on hazardous goods, calamity responsibilities, noise measures and quieter rolling stock. The State Secretary answered that rerouting raises freight trains from about 23 to 32 per day, that hazardous goods data is available to emergency services, that noise dampers and wagon bonuses are in place or planned, and that no extra funding is needed.
I endorse the importance of transparent information provision.
Ik onderschrijf het belang van transparante informatievoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Remco Dijkstra, Ouwehand, Cegerek, Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Geurts over het bericht dat chemiebedrijven de veiligheidsregels schenden

MPs asked the state secretary how to respond to reports that more than half of Dutch major-risk chemical firms repeatedly violated safety rules, including risks to workers and residents in Zaltbommel and how inspections and enforcement work. The state secretary replied that violations fell from 850 to 615 in 2015, that most are light offences, that inspectors act immediately on serious ones, that Zaltbommel is being handled through a planning and permit process, and that repeat offenders face escalated sanctions.
As previously promised, I will send the State of Safety of Major Risk Companies report for 2016 to your House before the summer, including an analysis of regional differences in compliance rates.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik de Staat van de Veiligheid Majeure Risicobedrijven over 2016 voor de zomer naar uw Kamer sturen inclusief een analyse van regionale verschillen in naleefpercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over de berichten 'Scenario kernramp grote onzin' en 'Vals rampscenario Tihange'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about press reports calling a Vienna IRS study of a nuclear disaster at Tihange 2 nonsense and exaggerated. The minister answered that the national nuclear regulator ANVS found the study unrealistic and of no added value for preparedness, that the German government also questioned it, and that transparent information sharing with the Limburg region is being pursued.
It is good that a public debate is held on a subject as important as nuclear safety.
Het is goed dat over een zo belangrijk onderwerp als nucleaire veiligheid een maatschappelijk debat wordt gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Afnemer wil rechtszekerheid’

Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the State Secretary about criticism that businesses lack legal certainty on whether residual streams are waste, and about the Helpdesk Afvalbeheer and possible reversal of the burden of proof. The State Secretary answered that interpretation differences exist, pointed to ministerial rules, legal opinions and LAP3 as clarification tools, denied the helpdesk problems, and said the burden of proof rests partly on companies.
I am continuously working on improving quality at the helpdesk, among other things through customer satisfaction surveys.
Ik werk doorlopend aan kwaliteitsverbetering bij de helpdesk, ondermeer met behulp van klanttevredenheidsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Duitse doelstelling broeikasgassen omlaag na protest industrie’

An MP asks the state secretary whether Germany has lowered its CO2 targets after industry protest, what this means for EU climate goals, and whether other countries will follow. The state secretary replies that Germany's 2050 plan targets a 55% cut by 2030 (higher than the EU's 40%), that global climate action requires all countries to contribute, and that the Netherlands remains committed to the Paris Agreement while awaiting US policy.
The central goal of the plan is a reduction of greenhouse gas emissions of 80–95% by 2050, with an interim target of at least 55% by 2030 (compared to 1990).
Het centrale doel van het plan is een reductie van de broeikasgasuitstoot van 80–95% in 2050, met een tussendoel van ten minste 55% in 2030 (ten opzichte van 1990).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Griekenland krijgt 1,75 miljard euro uit EU-klimaatplan om twee nieuwe kolencentrales te bouwen’

An MP asks why Greece may use EU emissions-trading free allowances to fund two new coal plants, and whether this fits EU climate leadership and Dutch coal phase-out. The State Secretary answers that Greece does not meet the eligibility threshold, that only low-CO2 investments should qualify, and that the Netherlands will inform parliament on its coal phase-out later this year.
I am committed to ensuring that only investments in low-CO2 technologies are eligible for funding under this ETS exception.
Ik zet me ervoor in dat alleen investeringen in CO 2 -arme technologieën in aanmerking komen voor financiering uit deze uitzonderingsbepaling in het ETS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Aantal dumpingen drugsafval afgelopen jaren gestegen’

MPs Dijkstra and Van Oosten asked the Minister of Justice and Security about rising drug-waste dumping and whether many incidents go unreported and unpunished. The Minister acknowledges unreported cases, points to integrated regional approaches and the LFO specialist unit, and says cost recovery from offenders cannot be fully reported from existing systems.
No complete overview of cases in which suspects were convicted for dumping drug waste, and of the costs recovered from them, can be generated from the registration systems of the OM and the police.

Uit de registratiesystemen van het OM en de politie is geen volledig overzicht te genereren van zaken waarin verdachten zijn veroordeeld voor het dumpen van drugsafval en de eventueel op hen verhaalde kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over onderzoek naar de gezondheidsrisico’s van kunstgrasvelden

MPs Dijkstra and Heerema asked the government about health risks of rubber granulate on artificial turf, including carcinogenic substances, the Hendrik-Ido-Ambacht case, and the representativeness of a 2006 RIVM-linked study, and whether a new study including children is needed. The minister answered that RIVM sees no public health risk from current evidence, that no specific government guidelines exist beyond REACH oversight by the NVWA, and that it is too early to decide on a new study pending literature review and measurements.
It is still too early to determine whether a new study is useful.
Het is nog te vroeg om te bepalen of een nieuw onderzoek zinvol is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over “Afval van zolder kan mee in de kolencentrale”

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that waste-derived fuel pellets (Subcoal) can be co-fired in coal plants, whether the waste status can be ended, and how to make recycled products easier to reuse. The secretary explains that a legal opinion on end-of-waste status is pending, that a coal plant has co-fired Subcoal under an environmental permit, and that by-product and end-of-waste criteria will be clarified in the upcoming national waste plan.

This legal opinion has an informative character and can as such be submitted by the company in assessments and decisions by the administrative body that is the competent authority for the company's activities.

Dit rechtsoordeel heeft een informatief karakter en kan als zodanig door het bedrijf worden ingebracht bij beoordelingen en beschikkingen door het bestuursorgaan dat bevoegd gezag is ten aanzien van de activiteiten van het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Moors over het bericht ‘Schotschrift tegen asbesthysterie’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a critical pamphlet claiming asbestos policy is overly alarmist and that the asbestos roof ban is poor value for money. The State Secretary rejected the alarmism claim, defended the cost-benefit analysis and the 2024 roof-removal deadline, and outlined subsidies, a programme office and enforcement measures while declining to quantify victim numbers precisely.
No, I do not endorse that conclusion. The central government takes a sober and pragmatic approach to asbestos in the residential, working and living environment.
Nee, die conclusie onderschrijf ik niet. De rijksoverheid staat voor een nuchtere en pragmatische benadering van asbest in de woon-, werk- en leefomgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Nationale prijsbodem CO2 bij EU ETS is geen oplossing’

An MP asked the state secretary about an article arguing a national CO2 price floor under the EU ETS is no solution, and about France's planned price floor and possible state aid to EDF. The state secretary said a national floor would not cut EU-wide emissions due to the waterbed effect, preferred EU-level action to reduce the surplus of allowances, and left the state aid question to the Commission.
It is for the Commission to determine whether there is unlawful state aid here.
Het is aan de Commissie om te bepalen of hier sprake is van ongeoorloofde staatssteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Remco Dijkstra over de berichtgeving en klachten met betrekking tot de opslag van radioactief afval bij NRG in Petten

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about press reports that radioactive waste stored at NRG in Petten is unsafe, and about a complaint filed with the Autoriteit Nucleaire Veiligheid en Stralingsbescherming. The minister says there is no direct danger, that waste is safely stored, and answers the complaint's four points, acknowledging past incomplete waste records and past safety-culture problems that have since improved.
In the past the administration of radioactive waste was incomplete, so the figures used varied over the years.
In het verleden was de administratie van het radioactief afval onvolledig, waardoor de gehanteerde getallen in de loop van de jaren hebben gevarieerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over de bestuursrechtelijke uitspraak inzake de Utrechtse milieuzone

MPs Visser and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the government to respond to a court ruling that found the Utrecht environmental zone decision insufficiently reasoned, questioning the proportionality of environmental zones for passenger cars and the evidence on their air-quality effects. The State Secretary answered that the municipality is responsible for such zones, that the ruling leaves the zone in force, that the proposed extension to passenger cars would be dropped in line with a motion, and that effects and alternatives are for the municipality to assess, with an evaluation expected.
To implement the Visser motion, the proposal to extend the environmental zone sign to passenger cars will be removed from this planned amendment.
Om uitvoering te geven aan de motie Visser zal uit deze voorgenomen wijziging het voorstel tot uitbreiding van het milieuzonebord naar personenauto's worden geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan de Waalhaven in Rotterdam op 25 april 2016

The MPs De Boer and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the state secretary about freight rail compensation for the German Betuweroute works, hazardous-goods transit under the Basisnet, rail capacity, usage charges, permits and information sharing. The state secretary answered in detail, noting State aid approval for compensation, that Basisnet exceedances are being investigated, and that she will inform parliament soon, but declined to commit to a usage-charge evaluation before summer.
I am consulting the sector to map as quickly as possible the causes of these exceedances and which measures can be taken.
Ik ben in overleg met de sector om zo snel mogelijk in kaart te brengen wat de oorzaken zijn van deze overschrijdingen en welke maatregelen genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over subsidiegelden

An MP asks how much the central government paid in 2014, 2015 and 2016 to environmental and nature organisations (Greenpeace, Milieudefensie, Natuur en Milieu, Urgenda, Sea Shepherd, IUCN, Wakker Dier), what they do with it, whether they also receive Postcode Loterij funds, and whether government funding of groups that protest against the government is appropriate. The government answers with detailed subsidy tables per organisation and project, notes that Postcode Loterij grants are not accounted to the state, and states that protest against government conduct is possible within the uniform subsidy framework.
Government subsidy payments are published as open data via Rijksbegroting.nl.
De subsidiebetalingen van de rijksoverheid worden gepubliceerd als open data via Rijksbegroting.nl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “National Parliaments should approve Paris Climate Agreement before it is a done deal”

MP Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the Paris Climate Agreement: EU signature and ratification, whether the agreement is legally binding, the costs and uncertainties of implementation, and the Commission's statements on policy flexibility. The State Secretary answered that the EU and member states will sign separately, ratify together after national procedures, that only the agreement's procedural obligations are binding (NDCs are not), and that the government will inform parliament on costs during ratification.
During the ratification procedure, your House will be further informed about these consequences.
Tijdens de ratificatieprocedure wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over deze consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Luchtkwaliteit in gevaar door 130 kilometer per uur’

Two MPs asked the minister whether raising motorway speed limits to 130 km/h complies with environmental and safety norms, and questioned RIVM and TNO statements on air quality. The minister answered that the speed increases were tested against safety and environmental conditions, that monitoring shows no norm exceedances after the increase, and that the RIVM and TNO statements do not contradict the NSL 2015 report.
The speed increases of 5 February were – as with previous speed increases – tested against safety and environmental preconditions.
De snelheidsverhogingen van 5 februari zijn – evenals voorgaande snelheidsverhogingen – getoetst aan randvoorwaarden van veiligheid en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkstra over het artikel ' Wagenings onderzoek statiegeld onzorgvuldig'

An MP asked the state secretary about a Trouw article alleging that a Wageningen research report on deposit schemes (statiegeld) was influenced by the ministry and that complaints were filed against it, and about NGO influence on postponing abolition of the deposit. The secretary said the ministry was not the commissioning party, acknowledged contact with the researchers to broaden the cost analysis and speed up the report, and said the 2015 decision not to release the deposit stands and will be assessed in the 2017 evaluation.
For further information I refer you to the WUR.
Voor nadere informatie verwijs ik u naar de WUR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de Ontwerp Regeling beheer verpakkingen

An MP asks how the planned ban on free plastic bags would be enforced by the ILT, how shops and consumers would be checked and informed, and whether the rule should be tested by the Council of State and delayed. The Secretary of State answers that enforcement starts cautiously via the ILT intervention ladder and targets shops, that a Council of State review is unnecessary because the underlying decree was already advised on, and that the 1 January 2016 start date stays.
Moreover, the Packaging Management Decree 2014, on which the basis of this regulation rests, was already submitted to the Council of State for advice in 2014.
Bovendien is het Besluit beheer verpakkingen 2014 waar de grondslag van deze regeling opgenomen is, in 2014 aan de Raad van State voor advies voorgelegd geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Remco Dijkstra over de milieuvervuiling van bandengruis

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about tyre-wear particles (bandengruis) and microplastic pollution, including the reliability of a 1,000-tonne estimate, other brake and road wear, follow-up research, remedies, and foreign measures. The State Secretary answered that the data are uncertain, gave emission estimates for brake and road wear, and said a RIVM study on microplastic sources was due in February 2016.
It is important, given the uncertainties in the data, that emissions from tyre wear and other road-vehicle wear (and road surface wear) are better mapped, including the share of microplastics.

Het is van belang – gezien de onzekerheden in de data – dat de emissies van bandenslijtage en andere slijtstof van wegvoertuigen (en van het wegdek) beter in beeld worden gebracht, inclusief het aandeel van microplastics hierin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Visser over “de manipulatie van modellen aangaande luchtkwaliteit”

VVD MPs Dijkstra and Visser asked the State Secretary whether Utrecht officials manipulating local air-quality traffic data, and the lack of local discretion over national models, undermine NSL air-quality reporting and measures such as milieuzones. The State Secretary answered that statutory models are fixed by the Regeling beoordeling luchtkwaliteit 2007 and managed by RIVM, that municipalities only supply traffic inputs which RIVM audits annually by sampling, and that no concerns about Utrecht's data were found.
To ensure the quality of the inputs, RIVM, on behalf of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment, annually checks the quality of the input data used in NSL monitoring on a sample basis.

Om de kwaliteit van de invoer te borgen controleert het RIVM, in opdracht van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu, jaarlijks steekproefsgewijs de kwaliteit van de invoergegevens die gebruikt worden in de NSL-monitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de Quick Scan van het PBL en ECN

An MP asked the state secretary about a PBL/ECN quick scan of additional emission-reduction measures for the Urgenda climate case, including who commissioned it, whether indirect social costs were omitted, and what the government will do with it. The state secretary replied that PBL chose to publish the scan itself, that it gives no basis for conclusions on additional measures because it ignores public support and legal feasibility and gives only rough cost estimates, and that the government will await the IBO study and cite its cost methodology.
The cabinet will however take this PBL and ECN report into account in the ongoing studies.
Het kabinet zal dit rapport van het PBL en ECN wel betrekken bij de lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over borden ter verduidelijking van de milieuzone

MPs Visser and Dijkstra asked whether Rijkswaterstaat would display milieuzone information on motorway matrix signs and who should bear the cost of signage for local low-emission zones. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat has no such plans, that informing drivers about local zones is a municipal task, and that the existing legal framework does not allow permanent signs on motorways, pointing instead to personalised navigation information.
Rijkswaterstaat will therefore inform the municipality of Utrecht that no fixed signs with milieuzone information may be placed along the motorways.
Rijkswaterstaat zal de gemeente Utrecht dan ook melden dat er geen vaste borden, met informatie over de milieuzone, langs de snelwegen geplaatst mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het nieuwsblad van de Metaal Recycling Federatie (MRF)

An MP asks the state secretary whether the WEEELABEX certification requirements for e-waste treatment, including a 5,000 kg batch test, are proportionate, whether certified recyclers may supervise uncertified partners, and whether enforcement can be postponed. The state secretary confirms the batch test is generally reasonable, rejects supervised subcontracting by uncertified firms, and says enforcement stays under the ILT's independent intervention framework without committing to a postponement.
No, processing or treating WEEE by a company not certified under WEEELABEX is not permitted.
Nee, het be- en verwerken van WEEE door een niet-WEEELABEX gecertificeerde onderneming is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Tellegen en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “Verkeershufters worden minder vaak gepakt”

Three VVD MPs asked whether speed trajectory controls are justified for environmental goals (CO2, fine dust, noise) and how their boetes and effects are documented, given reports that traffic offenders are caught less often. The minister answered that the purpose of trajectory controls is compliance with the posted speed limit, that environmental and safety considerations shape the limits themselves, and gave a fine table for 2010–2014 and noise-cost figures.
The purpose of trajectory controls is compliance with the applicable speed limit.
Het doel van trajectcontroles is naleving van de geldende snelheidslimiet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Visser en De Boer over het bericht «Ruim miljoen voor schone bussen»

Three VVD MPs asked why the hydrogen bus pilot in Amsterdam would not be repeated, what it contributed, how zero-emission buses fit climate policy, whether returning the buses after three years was a sound use of public money, and whether the project goals were SMART. The Secretary of State answered that the pilot served as an alpha test that led a bus manufacturer to invest in hydrogen buses, that the new subsidy projects continue in five regions, and that selection criteria and reporting obligations apply.
Na afloop wordt de regeling geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het voorgenomen verbod op gratis plastic tassen

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about the planned ban on free plastic carrier bags, questioning whether it goes beyond EU rules, its effectiveness, enforcement, and effects on consumers and the environment. The state secretary answered that the EU directive allows measures for all bags regardless of thickness, that enforcement will be checked by the ILT, and that a legal ban is needed for a level playing field, while many questions on effects and figures were answered only with estimates or deferred.
The ban that takes effect in the Netherlands on 1 January 2016 will cover all types of plastic carrier bags, regardless of wall thickness.
Het verbod dat per 1 januari 2016 in Nederland in werking treedt, zal alle soorten plastic draagtassen betreffen, ongeacht de wanddikte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over uitbreiding gemeentelijke milieuzones waaronder Amsterdam, Utrecht en Rotterdam en over het bericht dat Utrechtse lucht beter is

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary whether expanding municipal environmental zones (Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam) is justified given Utrecht's improved air quality, cost-effectiveness, and the Rijk's role in subsidies and a vehicle replacement scheme. The State Secretary answered that municipalities decide on and must demonstrate the cost-effectiveness of zones, the Rijk funds a subsidy scheme for van replacement in neighbouring municipalities, and an action plan is pending.
It is up to the municipalities to assess and demonstrate whether introducing an environmental zone for certain vehicle categories is a (cost-)effective measure.
Het is aan de gemeenten om in te schatten en aan te tonen of het invoeren van een milieuzone voor bepaalde categorieën voertuigen een (kosten)effectieve maatregel is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over de berichten ‘Met twintig camera's loeren op vieze auto's’, ‘Al bijna tweeduizend vieze auto's verwerkt tot schroot’ en ‘Cameratoezicht voor milieuzone Arnhem

MPs Visser and Dijkstra asked about camera enforcement of low-emission zones in Arnhem and Utrecht, the cost of cameras, privacy of plate data, and the higher fine. The state secretary answered that the zones and their justification are municipal responsibilities, that the fine follows standard Public Prosecution tariffs with a heavier sanction for the zone, and that a Utrecht NO2 exceedance is expected to be resolved by new calculations.
It is up to the municipalities to assess and demonstrate whether introducing an environmental zone is a (cost-)effective measure.
Het is aan de gemeenten om in te schatten en aan te tonen of het invoeren van een milieuzone een (kosten)effectieve maatregel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht dat de kwaliteit van het Olympisch water een schande is voor Brazilië

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about reports that the water quality in Rio's Olympic waters is a disgrace, and how Dutch expertise and companies could help clean it up. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described a Dutch fact-finding mission and a joint approach with other ministries, and said the Brazilian government ultimately decides on investments and partnerships.

I am of course willing, together with Minister Schultz van Haegen and my colleagues from EZ, BZ and BHOS, to work with Dutch companies and Dutch-developed sustainable innovations to make a successful contribution to reducing pollution of Guanabara Bay and building a circular economy in Rio de Janeiro.

Ik ben uiteraard bereid om samen met Minister Schultz van Haegen en mijn collega’s van EZ, BZ en BHOS mij in te zetten om met Nederlandse bedrijven en met inzet van in Nederland ontwikkelde duurzame innovaties een succesvolle bijdrage te leveren aan de terugdringing van vervuiling van de Guanabara Bay en de opbouw van een circulaire economie in Rio de Janeiro.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Visser over het bericht “Ruim miljoen voor schone bussen”

MPs Dijkstra and Visser (VVD) asked the State Secretary about subsidies of 4.25 million euro for hydrogen and hybrid buses, including a 1.3 million euro top-up for Rotterdam, and whether the subsidies are effective and technology-neutral. The government answered that the grants aim to gain practical experience with zero-emission buses for future procurement rather than to solve air quality problems directly, that the GVB pilot's buses have been returned, and that it has no plans to repeat the scheme while maintaining the zero-emission technology direction.

The aim of the contributions is to support decentralised governments responsible for public bus transport that are considering becoming launch customers for hydrogen buses in gaining practical experience in the short term.

Het doel van de bijdragen is om decentrale overheden die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het openbaar busvervoer en die overwegen launching customer te worden van waterstofbussen te ondersteunen bij het op korte termijn opdoen van praktijkervaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Illegale autosloop blijkt onstuitbaar'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report that illegal car dismantling is hard to stop, including 'fake export' cases, and about enforcement and environmental harm. The State Secretary answered that no quantitative data exist, enforcement lies with regional environmental services, and the RDW is working with the industry on solutions.
The RDW has no quantitative data on the number of cars that may be illegally dismantled.
De RDW heeft geen kwantitatieve gegevens over de hoeveelheid auto’s die mogelijk illegaal worden gesloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman, Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over de beoordeling van luchtkwaliteit bij plattelandswoningen

MPs Veldman, Lodders and Dijkstra asked the minister why air quality (fine dust) must be assessed for former farm dwellings occupied by third parties, unlike active farm housing, and whether exemptions or flexibility are possible. The minister explains that EU air quality rules apply except at workplaces, that the Council of State ruling requires assessment for former farm homes, and promises to explore flexibility, including a provision in the future Environment Quality Decree under the Omgevingswet.
However, I will examine whether there are other possibilities to achieve nuance and flexibility.
Wel zal ik nagaan of er anderszins mogelijkheden zijn om te komen tot nuancering en flexibilisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het uitbannen van plastic tassen, naar aanleiding van de brief die zij heeft toegezegd tijdens het AO Grondstoffen en afval op 16 oktober jl.

An MP asks the State Secretary about the EU agreement on plastic bags, whether a ban is proportionate, the environmental impact, enforcement and the failed Green Deal. The State Secretary answers that a ban on free thin plastic bags at checkouts from 2016 is planned as part of a broader approach, with enforcement by the ILT and a promised letter to parliament.

There will be no ban on plastic bags. As part of the broad policy aimed at reducing the number of carrier bags, and in implementation of the forthcoming amendment of the packaging directive, a ban on free plastic bags will come.

Er komt geen verbod op plastic tasjes. Als onderdeel van het brede beleid gericht op het terugdringen van het aantal draagtassen en ter uitvoering van de op handen zijnde aanpassing van verpakkingsrichtlijn komt er een verbod op gratis plastic tassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over de uitbreiding gemeentelijke milieuzones waaronder Amsterdam, Utrecht en Rotterdam

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about expanding municipal environmental zones (milieuzones) in Amsterdam, Utrecht and Rotterdam, questioning their proportionality, costs, cost-effectiveness analyses and the lack of a uniform access regime. The secretary answered that local municipalities decide on zones, a subsidy scheme for van replacement in border municipalities was set up with 4 million euro of NSL funds, no cost-benefit analysis of green deals is possible, and that a joint exploration with the G4 cities is underway.
The cost-effectiveness of the environmental zone is weighed in local decision-making on any expansion of the zone.
De kosteneffectiviteit van de milieuzone wordt bij de lokale besluitvorming over eventuele uitbreiding van de milieuzone meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de berichten ‘Oproep tot transparantie in ontwikkeling criteria voor biomassa’ en ‘Groen paspoort van FSC verlopen’

An MP asks whether FSC timber certification has fallen short of Dutch sustainable procurement criteria since 2012, why PEFC and MTCS are excluded, and whether TPAC's independence and added value are sound, given reported conflicts of interest in developing biomass criteria. The Secretary of State answers that TPAC re-assessment of FSC is still ongoing, that PEFC was approved in 2010, that the biomass criteria process is transparent, and that TPAC's funding and future depend on EU coordination which will be reported to parliament later.
After completion of the assessment, TPAC will publish the assessment results.
Na afronding van de beoordeling maakt TPAC de toetsingsresultaten bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over uitbreiding gemeentelijke milieuzones waaronder Amsterdam, Utrecht en Rotterdam

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about the proposed expansion of municipal environmental zones (milieuzones) in Amsterdam, Utrecht and Rotterdam, arguing for uniform national rules, the burden on businesses, and the effectiveness versus source-based policy. The State Secretary answered that municipalities decide on zones within a national framework, that zones remain needed for air quality hotspots, and that the national government supports source-based measures, innovation and uniform access regimes.
There is no overview available of all itemised expenditure related to specific measures in the NSL by national government, provinces and municipalities.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van alle uitgesplitste uitgaven in relatie tot specifieke maatregelen in het NSL door rijk, provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht dat de automobilist de klos is in de Randstad

MPs Visser and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the State Secretary whether the G4 cities' proposed air-quality measures, such as more lane-section controls, are symbolic, ineffective and costly for motorists. The State Secretary answered that the G4 letter will be discussed on 29 January, that the NSL approach has worked and was extended, that source policy is most effective, and that lane controls add little to urban air quality; costs were referred to the answer on question 2.
What the additional approach will look like I cannot say at this point.
Hoe de aanvullende aanpak er uit zal zien kan ik nu nog niet zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de extra kosten door ammoniakbeleid

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the state secretary about the extra costs of proposed ammonia rules for livestock farms, the effect on consumer prices, the sector's ability to bear the burden, and the comparison with EU Member States under the NEC directive. The state secretary answered that per-farm costs are hard to average since rules apply only to new or substantially expanded barns (at most 3% annual extra cost), cannot estimate consumer price effects, notes Dutch reduction targets are lower than the EU average, and says the position on the Commission proposal will follow later this year.
