No, I cannot indicate how much more consumers will on average pay and to what extent comparable extra costs were passed on to consumers in the past.
Nee, ik kan niet aangeven hoeveel meer geld de consument gemiddeld gaat betalen en in hoeverre vergelijkbare extra kosten in het verleden zijn doorberekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over de relatie tussen ammoniakuitstoot en emissiearme bemesting

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked whether measurement data cast doubt on the link between low-emission manure application and ammonia emissions, and whether the NEMA emission model was sound. The State Secretary answered that the scientific basis of ammonia policy was reviewed internationally without doubts, that the CDM was asked for a quick scan of the significant trend difference, and that Dutch ammonia measures are a national choice within EU ceilings.
Thereupon I asked the Expert Committee on the Fertilisers Act (CDM) to prepare a quick scan to explain the difference between the trends.
Daarop heb ik de Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet (CDM) gevraagd een quick scan op te stellen om het verschil tussen de trends te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra over Spoorhinder in Den Bosch en Rosmalen

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about rail noise and vibration complaints from residents in Den Bosch and Rosmalen, and about agreements made with them and possible speed limits for freight trains. The state secretary said the two cases differ, that noise and safety rules are met, that vibration is being studied and talks are ongoing, and that a speed-limit pilot in Rosmalen and an investigation for Den Bosch will be carried out.
Together with residents, the municipality and ProRail, my ministry will look into setting up a pilot.
Samen met omwonenden, de gemeente en ProRail zal mijn ministerie kijken naar de inrichting van een proef.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Cegerek over de afvalstoffenbelasting

MPs Dijkstra and Cegerek asked about the waste tax taking effect in 2015, including export leakage, the effect on storage tonnages, the competitive position of the sector, and whether other EU countries have comparable export levies. The state secretary answered that export effects are expected to be limited but will be monitored, that the level playing field in the EU is not currently ensured, and that measures will be considered if leakage appears.
Should this monitoring show that undesirable leakage abroad does occur, it will be considered which measures are appropriate.
Mocht uit deze monitoring blijken dat er toch sprake is van een ongewenste ontwikkeling met weglek naar het buitenland dan zal worden bezien welke maatregelen passend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Ziengs en Van Veen over het artikel 'Miljoenenstrop door stoffen'

MPs Dijkstra, Ziengs and Van Veen asked about the European Commission's plan to add five substances to the RoHS II restriction list, whether the process followed REACH procedures, and what the costs and benefits would be. The Secretary of State answered that the Commission acted within the RoHS framework after consulting member states and stakeholders, that the costs are real but the benefits of phasing out hazardous substances justify them, and that the government sees no reason to intervene, while it will monitor exemption applications.
I therefore see no reason to hold the Commission to account on this.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding de Commissie hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Litjens over de toepassing van het Besluit algemene regels ruimtelijke ordening (Barro) in Druten

MPs Dijkstra and Litjens asked the minister whether the Barro rules, which the Raad van State found a zoning plan in Druten to breach, were not blocking a business's storage on high ground and water transport, and whether an exemption could be granted. The minister defended the Barro flood-safety rules, rejected amending them, and said a municipal exemption request received on 10 June would be assessed carefully.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Leegte over de brandstoffenmix

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about double-counting of CO2 emissions in well-to-wheel calculations of fuel mixes, and whether a future vision process could be independently reviewed. The state secretary answered that electricity generation and refining are equivalent in double-counting terms, gave a table comparing electric and combustion vehicles, and said the vision process is open to stakeholders, reviewed, and will become a recurring three-yearly exercise under new EU rules.
There is no fundamental difference between electricity generation and refining when it comes to double counting in the well-to-wheel emissions calculation.
Er is geen principieel verschil tussen elektriciteitsopwekking en raffinage als het gaat om dubbeltelling in de berekening van well-to-wheel emissies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Leegte over het visietraject duurzame brandstoffenmix

MPs Dijkstra and Leegte asked about a working group on a sustainable fuel mix, the tank-to-wheel versus well-to-wheel CO2 accounting, consumer choice, environmental effects of batteries, and whether the chair of the gas-vehicle table, linked to a company with gas interests, could guarantee an objective outcome. The government answered that the process is broad and multi-stakeholder, that the vision and an action plan with cost-benefit analysis will follow, and that stakeholder diversity ensures objectivity.
I will send the vision to your House after the summer.
Ik zal de visie na de zomer aan uw Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders, Visser en De Liefde over het einde aan de betutteling van het milieubeleid

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government's Duurzaam Doen website and planned environmental measures amount to an end to paternalism in environmental policy, and about its cost, related initiatives, and the basis for recommending meat reduction. The minister answered that the site offers practical guidance rather than mandates, cost about 49,909 euros, that similar initiatives exist, and that reducing meat consumption benefits health and sustainability per official reports.
The cabinet wants to make use of the energy and ambitions that many parties and residents in our country have in the area of environment and sustainability.
Het kabinet wil gebruik maken van de energie en ambities die veel partijen en bewoners in ons land hebben op het gebied van milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het afschaffen van statiegeld

Rep. Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment whether abolishing deposit fees on large PET bottles would prevent bottle-to-bottle recycling and whether the Plastic Heroes collection system is mature. The State Secretary answered that bottle-to-bottle recycling is feasible without deposit, cited progress figures for the Plastic Heroes system, and said separate collection of bottles would likely encourage separation of other plastic packaging, while leaving the efficiency of the system to packaging industry.
There therefore does not appear to be any reason to assume that large PET bottles collected with the Dutch Plastic Heroes system cannot be used for bottle-to-bottle recycling.
Er lijkt dus geen reden te zijn om aan te nemen dat grote PET-flessen die ingezameld worden met het Nederlandse Plastic Heroes systeem niet ingezet kunnen worden voor bottle to bottle recycling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra over de veiligheidssituatie op rangeerterrein Kijfhoek

MPs De Boer and Dijkstra asked about the safety situation at the Kijfhoek rail yard after the Council of State annulled added safety conditions in its environmental permit, and about the risks for nearby municipalities. The Secretary of State answered that the site meets all legal requirements, that the Council of State ruling limits local rules, that a working framework with stakeholders is planned by end April 2014, and that additional measures for the Betuweroute will be sent to parliament after the summer.
Consultations have meanwhile taken place between the municipality of Zwijndrecht and the ministry, in consultation with the parties involved, about the ruling.
Over de uitspraak is inmiddels ook overleg gevoerd tussen de gemeente Zwijndrecht en het ministerie, in samenspraak met betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Bisschop en Geurts over het bericht van een werkbezoek aan de gemeente Barneveld op 16 januari 2014

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether a rail terminal in Barneveld would reduce road freight and whether the ministry would help assess its feasibility, and about multimodal terminals generally. The state secretary answered that such initiatives are primarily a market responsibility, that ProRail will review any concrete proposal against existing policy, and that the national terminal network is considered sufficient until 2020, with selective strengthening on key corridors also under study.
For new market initiatives for rail terminals, ProRail will examine whether such projects meet the policy starting points set out in the policy framework.
Bij nieuwe marktinitiatieven voor railterminals zal ProRail bekijken of dergelijke projecten voldoen aan de beleidsuitgangspunten, zoals die verwoord staan in het beleidskader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘extra ammoniakeisen dreigen vanuit Brussel’

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked about reports that the European Commission would propose tighter ammonia and fine-particle emission ceilings, and what this means for intensive livestock farming in the Netherlands. The Secretary of State answered that the proposed ceilings can likely be met under existing policy, that no direct effect on intensive livestock farming is expected, and that further Dutch stable and manure rules are being prepared but will not be suspended.
I do not want to suspend these measures because that would cause problems with implementing the PAS and with meeting the agreements already made under the European air quality directive.

Ik wil deze maatregelen niet opschorten omdat er dan problemen ontstaan met de implementatie van de PAS en ten aanzien van het voldoen aan de reeds gemaakt afspraken in het kader van de Europese luchtkwaliteitsrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Litjens over het feit dat een megabiovergister in Foxhol niet doorgaat

MPs Dijkstra and Litjens asked whether a mega biogas plant in Foxhol is blocked by an unintended side effect of legislation, how the government assesses this and whether it will act. The state secretary replied that responsibility for permits under noise, spatial planning and environmental law lies with the province of Groningen, which has proposed refusing the permit, so the central government has no formal role and the courts would decide any dispute.
It is not possible for me to take a formal role and responsibility in this case. That lies solely with the province of Groningen.
Het is mij niet mogelijk in deze casus een formele rol en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Die ligt enkel en alleen bij de provincie Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de mogelijkheid om hagelkanonnen in te zetten om de oogst te beschermen

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked whether anti-hail cannons may be used by fruit growers and whether municipalities should decide, and how enforcement by fines should be handled. The state secretary said the balancing of crop protection against noise nuisance is a local decision for municipalities, that no national rule or exception is appropriate, and that enforcement is up to the municipality.
The balancing of interests for the use of the anti-hail cannon must take place at the local level.
De belangenafweging voor het gebruik van het antihagelkanon dient op lokaal niveau plaats te vinden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over grondwaterzuiveringsinstallaties bij boeren

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked whether strict Activiteitenbesluit rules and rare discharge exemptions leave farmers with groundwater treatment installations no option but costly chemical waste disposal of brine, and whether the rules should be loosened. The state secretary replied that the rules are not stricter than the former Lozingenbesluit, that transitional rules and case-by-case maatwerkvoorschriften offer flexibility, and that no amendment is needed.
The decree gives the competent authority ample opportunities, within the appropriate frameworks, to broaden discharge possibilities case by case through a maatwerkvoorschrift.
Het besluit biedt het bevoegd gezag ruime mogelijkheden om binnen de geëigende kaders bij maatwerkvoorschrift de lozingsmogelijkheden per individueel geval te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Houwers, Bosman, Litjens, De Boer, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over ruimtelijke ordening op zee

VVD MPs asked the government for an overview of all plans, visions and directives touching on spatial planning at sea, their relationships, their national or EU origin, and the timing of answers before a committee debate. The minister answered that the National Water Plan and the North Sea policy note with the Integraal Beheerplan Noordzee form the integrated framework, described how EU directives are implemented nationally, and provided a schematic overview and a commitment to update the spatial framework in 2015.
The cabinet intends to adopt spatial protection measures for the seabed of the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden, to be reflected in the National Water Plan in 2015.
Het kabinet heeft het voornemen om ruimtelijke beschermingsmaatregelen te nemen voor de bodem van het Friese Front en Centrale Oestergronden, die neerslaan in het Nationaal Waterplan in 2015.
Antwoord vragen Remco Dijkstra over schaarse grondstoffen

Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked whether the Dutch government has sufficient insight into which scarce raw materials are critical to the economy, what the plan to secure essential materials entails, and the state of cooperation with business and bilateral agreements with source countries. The government answered all three questions by referring to a forthcoming letter on raw materials, without giving substance in this reply.
I refer you to the cabinet's state-of-affairs letter on raw materials, which the cabinet will send to you in April.
Graag verwijs ik u naar de stand van zakenbrief van het kabinet over grondstoffen welke het kabinet in april aan u zal sturen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het KNMI

An MP asked the state secretary whether the KNMI performs tasks beyond its statutory mandate, how such tasks are monitored, the status of a promised note on the KNMI Act amendment, and when the KNMI Act will be evaluated. The state secretary answered all five questions together by referring to a separate letter on the repositioning of the KNMI, without addressing them on substance.
For the points raised in the questions, I would like to refer you to that letter.
Voor de punten die in de vragen aan de orde worden gesteld, verwijs ik graag naar deze brief.

m: Amendement van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het verkorten van de termijn voor stabiel hoofdverblijf tot ten minste vijf jaar
Amendment shortens the required uninterrupted stable residence for the nationality option for stateless minors from ten to at least five years.
has had stable main residence for an uninterrupted period of at least five years immediately before the declaration
gedurende een onafgebroken periode van ten minste vijf jaren onmiddellijk voorafgaand aan de verklaring stabiel hoofdverblijf heeft
Amendement van de leden Van Dam  en Groothuizen over een maximale duur van 3 weken
Adds that any ministerial regulation imposing the curfew under the Public Health Act expires three weeks after entry into force, so a new curfew needs fresh action.
A ministerial regulation adopted under article 58j, first paragraph, under f, lapses at the latest three weeks after its entry into force.
Een krachtens artikel 58j, eerste lid, onderdeel f, vastgestelde ministeriële regeling vervalt uiterlijk drie weken na de inwerkingtreding ervan.
Motie van het lid Groothuizen c.s. over de werking van artikel 8, eerste en derde lid, van de Wbbbg beëindigen na inwerkingtreding van de Tijdelijke wet
Motion asking the government to end the use of article 8(1) and (3) of the Wbbbg for the evening curfew once the Temporary Act is in force, relying instead on the Public Health Act.
requests the government, after the Temporary Act restricting outdoor presence for covid-19 enters into force, to end the operation of article 8(1) and (3) of the Wbbbg
verzoekt de regering, om, na inwerkingtreding van de Tijdelijke wet beperking vertoeven in de openlucht covid-19, de werking van artikel 8, eerste en derde lid, van de Wbbbg te beëindigen
Amendement van de leden Groothuizen en van Dam over een definiëring van openlucht
Amendment excludes open-air areas belonging to a home, vessel or vehicle from the statutory definition of openlucht, to be set in formal law rather than ministerial regulation.
Therefore the definition of the term open air must take place in a formal law rather than in lower legislation.
Daarom moet de duiding van het begrip «openlucht» plaatsvinden in een formele wet in plaats van in lagere wetgeving.
Amendement van het lid Groothuizen over de bevoegdheden naar de IRK
Transfers powers from the investigating judge to the court (Internationale Rechtshulpkamer) for certain criminal-procedure authorisations in international legal assistance.
that the powers do not pass to the investigating judge as the bill intends, but to the International Legal Assistance Chamber
dat de bevoegdheden niet overgaan naar de rechter-commissaris, zoals het wetsvoorstel beoogt, maar naar de Internationale Rechtshulpkamer
Amendement van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over naast een taakstraf ook een voorwaardelijke straf kunnen opleggen
Amendment removes the word 'onvoorwaardelijke' so judges may combine a community sentence with a conditional prison sentence with behavioural conditions for assaults on public officials.
In the third paragraph the word 'unconditional' is deleted.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Wijngaarden c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over verzwaarde parlementaire controle
Adds a four-week waiting period before a ministerial regulation listing professions excluded by police data can be adopted, so that both chambers can review the draft.
A ministerial regulation as referred to in the first paragraph is not adopted earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.
Een ministeriële regeling als bedoeld in het eerste lid wordt niet eerder vastgesteld dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het aanwenden van vrijgekomen middelen voor een gedeeltelijke verlaging van griffierechttarieven onder de kantonrechtersgrens
Reverses the proposed court fee increase for civil claims between 5,000 and 12,500 euros, lowering the fees to 499 and 236 euros, to protect access to courts for small businesses and individuals.
Therefore this amendment reverses the increases in the fees in the category of claims of more than 5,000 euros and not more than 12,500 euros.
Daarom draait dit amendement de verhogingen van de tarieven in de categorie vorderingen van meer dan € 5.000 en niet meer dan € 12.500 terug.
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over een inspanning van de regering om twee keer 50 vluchtelingen uit Griekenland op te nemen
Asks the government to make every effort to take in 50 unaccompanied minors and 50 vulnerable family members from Greece before Christmas.
to make every effort to realise this
zich tot het uiterste in te spannen om dit te realiseren
Motie van het lid Groothuizen c.s. over onderzoek om Polen voor het Europese Hof van Justitie te dagen

Asks the government to investigate and prepare infringement proceedings against Poland before the EU Court of Justice over non-compliance with judicial independence rulings, and to inform the House by 1 February 2021.
requests the government to investigate and make the necessary preparations to sue Poland before the EU Court of Justice, preferably with like-minded member states
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken en de nodige voorbereidingen te treffen om, bij voorkeur in samenwerking met gelijkgezinde lidstaten, Polen voor het Hof van Justitie van de EU te dagen
Motie van het lid Groothuizen c.s. over een veiliger leefomgeving voor lhbti-asielzoekers en bekeerlingen in azc's
Asks the government to draw up within two months an action plan for a safer living environment for LGBTI asylum seekers and converts in asylum centres, including registering incidents.
requests the government, within two months, in consultation with relevant organisations, to draw up an action plan
verzoekt de regering, binnen twee maanden, in overleg met betrokken organisaties, een plan van aanpak op te stellen
Motie van het lid Groothuizen c.s. over ondersteunen van de sociaal advocatuur werkzaam in het personen- en familierecht
Asks the government to propose using unspent legal aid budget to support social lawyers in family and personal law.
requests the government to come with a proposal in the next supplementary or spring memorandum to use part of the remaining budget to support social lawyers
verzoekt de regering, bij de eerstvolgende na- of voorjaarsnota met een voorstel te komen om (een deel van) het overgebleven budget in te zetten voor het ondersteunen van de sociaal advocatuur
Motie van de leden Groothuizen en Van Toorenburg over de capaciteit voor de aanpak van cybercrime bij het OM
Asks the government to fund knock-on costs of police cybercrime investment so that prosecution capacity does not lag behind, and to inform the Chamber in spring.
requests the government, when investing in police capacity and expertise for tackling cybercrime, to simultaneously fund the knock-on effects so that prosecution capacity does not lag behind
verzoekt de regering, bij investeringen in capaciteit en/of expertise bij de politie voor de aanpak van cybercrime gelijktijdig te zorgen voor het financieren van de keteneffecten daarvan
Motie van het lid Van Toorenburg c.s. over meer recht doen aan het principe dat preventie geld oplevert in plaats van geld kost
Asks the government to investigate how the Justice and Security budget financing could better reflect that prevention saves money over the long term.
requests the government to investigate whether and how the financing system of Justice and Security can better reflect the principle that prevention yields money rather than costs money

verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken of en, zo ja, op welke wijze in de financieringssystematiek van Justitie en Veiligheid meer recht kan worden gedaan aan het principe dat preventie geld oplevert in plaats van geld kost
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over onderzoek naar de veiligheidsanalyse en beveiliging rond recente strafprocessen
Asks that the independent commission reviewing the security system also examine threat analysis and protection around recent criminal trials and the division of tasks among services.
research into the security analysis and protection around recent criminal trials, including Marengo

No court rulings have been made regarding Croatia that would mean the principle of mutual trust can no longer be assumed.
Over Kroatië zijn in dezen geen rechterlijke uitspraken gedaan die tot gevolg hebben dat niet langer kan worden uitgegaan van het interstatelijk vertrouwensbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de brief van werkgroep kind in AZC 'Impact corona op kinderen in AZC’s'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a working group letter reporting that children in asylum centres face poor internet, too few laptops and tablets, and reduced mental health and care support during COVID-19 school closures, and whether children can return to school. The government acknowledged the problems, described COA wifi upgrades, device funding of EUR 24 million via SIVON, maintained care consultations in adapted form, and noted that schools reopened from February and March 2021, with asylum-centre pupils prioritised.

As I shared with the House in my June 2020 letter, the COA, although providing good wifi to residents is not a standard service, decided during the first lockdown to invest in expanding bandwidth and wifi capacity, mainly for home schooling.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van juni 2020 met uw Kamer heb gedeeld heeft het COA, ondanks dat het aanbieden van goede wifi voor bewoners geen standaarddienst is, tijdens de eerste lockdown besloten om, met name ten behoeve van het thuisonderwijs, te investeren in uitbreiding van de bandbreedte en de wifi-capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Lange rijen bij registratie in Ter Apel'

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about long queues and night-time conditions for asylum seekers at the registration point in Ter Apel, including opening hours of AVIM, the planned chain coordinator, and preparation for instroom peaks. The State Secretary answered that after-hours arrivals wait in heated pavilions, that AVIM capacity is sufficient on average, that a chain coordinator started on 1 November 2020, and that the Flexibilisering Asielketen programme has been handed over to partner organisations.

To completely prevent asylum seekers having to spend a night in a pavilion, the registration process would need to run 24 hours a day, seven days a week, since asylum seekers arrive day and night in Ter Apel.

Om helemaal te voorkomen dat asielzoekers een nacht in een paviljoen moeten doorbrengen, zou het aanmeldproces 24 uur per dag zeven dagen per week moeten draaien, aangezien asielzoekers dag en nacht aankomen in Ter Apel.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof 'Alvorens een terugkeerbesluit uit te vaardigen tegen een niet-begeleide minderjarige, moet een lidstaat nagaan of er voor de minderjarige

MP Groothuizen asked whether Dutch policy complies with the European Court ruling that a member state must first check whether adequate reception exists before issuing a return decision for unaccompanied minors, and why the state did not check for minors over 15. The State Secretary acknowledged the ruling, said the DT&V previously checked adequacy only after the return decision, and that return decisions for unaccompanied minors are being withdrawn and no new ones issued pending a policy decision.

Under the previously applicable practice, the Dutch Return and Departure Service (DT&V) only examined after issuing a return decision whether adequate reception existed to enable return, with the return suspended.

In de voorheen geldende uitvoeringspraktijk onderzocht de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek (DT&V) eerst ná het nemen van een terugkeerbesluit of er adequate opvang was om terugkeer te realiseren, onder opschorting van de terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van de leden Groothuizen, Van Dam en Buitenweg over de rechtsstaat in Polen en de gevolgen voor Nederland

MPs Groothuizen, Van Dam and Buitenweg asked the government about media pluralism and press freedom in Poland, press lawsuits, EU tools, Polish asylum claims under the Aznar protocol, free movement, and detained Polish suspects after extradition suspensions. The government answered at length, largely describing EU monitoring frameworks, noting the limits of EU instruments, declining to provide asylum-motive statistics, and reporting that no one is held in Dutch detention solely due to the suspension.
The cabinet is not aware that Polish citizens are currently experiencing problems exercising their right to free movement in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet is er niet mee bekend dat Poolse burgers momenteel problemen ondervinden bij het uitoefenen van hun recht op vrij verkeer in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Ojik over zorg en begeleiding voor ex-AMV'ers vanaf 18 jaar

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about extended care and support for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers (AMV'ers) after they turn 18, including whether a uniform scheme and extra funding should be found. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for adult status holders, that Nidos extension is already possible at municipal cost, and that no structural or incidental funds are available in 2021, while promising ambtelijk contact but no timeline.
Should a new cabinet wish to regulate the support of the group you mean structurally and nationally, a civil-servant proposal will be requested for that purpose.
Mocht een nieuw kabinet de begeleiding van de door u bedoelde groep structureel en landelijk willen regelen, dan zal gevraagd worden om een ambtelijk voorstel daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de Kamerbrieven 'Voortgang afdoen vertraagde zaken IND' 'Gevolgen van de COVID-19-pandemie voor het migratiebeleid'

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the backlog of asylum cases at the IND, the stock of open cases at the end of 2020, the monthly reduction of the backlog, expected inflows and follow-up family reunification, and the new IND financing model. The State Secretary answered with figures on the open caseload, a forecast for July 2021, a commitment to monthly publication of backlog figures, and an assessment that the financing model cannot yet be evaluated.

The IND will publish these figures monthly around the 10th of the month for the time being, until the Taskforce has finished clearing the backlog of first asylum applications from before 1 April 2020.

De IND zal de komende tijd deze cijfers maandelijks rond de 10 de van de maand publiceren, tot het moment dat de Taskforce klaar is met het wegwerken van de achterstand op eerste asielaanvragen van voor 1 april 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de dwangsom van de ACM aan commerciële bemiddelingswebsites

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the minister why the government did not act earlier against commercial websites charging extra for VOG certificates, and whether rules should be tightened or other ministries asked to act. The minister answered that Justis and the ACM have taken action, that intermediaries cannot be obliged to inform consumers of the free route, and that the ACM enforces unfair trading practices.
I will continue to follow developments surrounding the intermediary websites for VOG applications.
Ik blijf de ontwikkelingen rondom de bemiddelingswebsites voor VOG aanvragen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het kerkbezoek van de minister van Defensie

An MP asked whether the Minister of Defence's attendance at an in-person church service, and the Justice Minister's earlier call to stay home over Christmas, were consistent with government policy and the example expected of cabinet members. The government answered that the church visit was a personal choice, that Covid rules cannot ban collective worship under the constitutional freedom of religion, and that a minister's individual faith is a personal matter.
Visiting a physical church service by the Minister of Defence was a personal choice.
Het bezoeken van een fysieke kerkdienst door de Minister van Defensie was een persoonlijke keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Meerdere OMT-leden bedreigd en thuis opgezocht'

MPs Groothuizen and Van Toorenburg asked the government about reports that several OMT members were threatened and visited at home, and about protection, public address data and doxing. Minister Grapperhaus said threats are unacceptable, police are investigating, protective measures are available where needed, and the address-shielding and doxing policy work is ongoing.
As your House knows, I cannot go into further detail on ongoing matters.
Zoals uw Kamer weet kan ik over lopende zaken niet verder in detail treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Van Toorenburg en Voordewind over het beëindigen van de coulance-regeling

MPs Groothuizen, Van Toorenburg and Voordewind asked why the COA coulance (grace) regime for rejected asylum seekers, used in the first lockdown, was not reintroduced, and whether people are being put onto the street during the current lockdown. The State Secretary replied that asylum processes are classed as vital, that accommodation options (vbl, family locations) remain available, that the coulance is not reinstated, and that departures are realistic.
Since there are shelter facilities for rejected asylum seekers and the asylum chain processes remain operational, I have decided not to reintroduce the coulance regime.
Aangezien er onderdakvoorzieningen zijn voor afgewezen asielzoekers en de processen in de asielketen operationeel blijven, heb ik besloten de coulanceregeling niet opnieuw in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over de inzet van diensthonden

MPs Groothuizen and Van Beukering-Huijbregts (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police dog deployment, prompted by a Zembla broadcast on dog bites, covering the rules, codification, registration, unit differences, certifications, complaints and evaluation of incidents. Minister Grapperhaus answered that dog use is governed by the force instruction and proportionality rules, that a draft amendment to the Ambtsinstructie tightens criteria, and that registration and evaluation procedures exist and were tightened.
It is not possible to break this down further, because other data on the deployment of the dog (including following commands or the number of bites) are not registered.
Het is niet mogelijk hier een verdere uitsplitsing in te maken, omdat andere gegevens over de inzet van de hond (waaronder het opvolgen van commando's of het aantal beten) niet worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Pedojagers slaan weer toe: hoofd tegen de stoeprand'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of vigilante 'pedo-hunters' (pedojagers) who lure and confront suspected offenders, and about whether such incidents are registered, whether citizen participation should play a role, and whether capacity at the prosecution service is adequate. The minister answered that these incidents are not separately registered, rejected vigilantism while leaving room for citizen assistance within the law, said the police lure-teen power will be kept and talks will follow, and declined to detail online communities for operational reasons.
I reject, as should be clear, any form of taking the law into one's own hands.
Ik wijs, dat moge duidelijk zijn, iedere vorm van eigenrichting af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘UNHCR urges investigation following deadly incident at Libya disembarkation point’

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a deadly incident at a Libyan disembarkation point and calls by UNHCR and IOM for an independent investigation, including the EU's support to the Libyan coast guard and the role of Operation Irini. The government supports an independent investigation, says the EU's training of the Libyan coast guard is not direct financial aid, and states it is not taking part in Irini's disembarkation mechanism and is still considering a future contribution.
The Netherlands supports the call by IOM and UNHCR for an independent investigation to establish the precise circumstances of the incident.
Nederland steunt de oproep van IOM en UNHCR tot het doen van onafhankelijk onderzoek om de precieze toedracht van het incident boven tafel te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de inwerkingtreding van de Wet straffen en beschermen en de uitvoering van de Wet USB

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the planned 1 May 2021 start of the Wet straffen en beschermen, the preparations and a Gateway review, and the division of execution tasks between the OM and AICE under the Wet USB, including local supervision of conditional sentences. The minister answered that the start date is still targeted, that a review found steps still needed, that the OM retains several execution tasks with a transfer planned later, and that local contacts are adequately secured.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Ophef over lokale quota voor huisvesting arbeidsmigranten”

Two MPs asked the Social Affairs minister whether municipal quotas limiting housing for migrant workers conflict with EU free-movement law and what the government will do. The minister agreed such quotas conflict with EU law, said the ministries will contact the VNG, and pointed to regional housing agreements and funding instead.
Limiting the housing of migrant workers through quotas specifically aimed at this group is at odds with the free movement of Union citizens, which permits no distinction by nationality.

De huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten beperken door middel van het instellen van quota die specifiek op deze groep gericht zijn, staat op gespannen voet met het vrij verkeer van Unieburgers dat geen onderscheid naar nationaliteit toestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de betrokkenheid van Frontex bij pushbacks

An MP asked the State Secretary about reported Frontex involvement in illegal pushbacks of migrants and whether an independent investigation is needed. The government says the incidents must be investigated under existing Frontex procedures, that no Dutch staff were involved, and that an independent inquiry is not needed for now while awaiting the internal investigation.
On the basis of the foregoing, the cabinet does not consider a separate, independent investigation necessary at this time.
Op basis van het voorgaande acht het kabinet een apart, onafhankelijk onderzoek op dit moment niet nodig.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over een onderzoek van de Raad voor de rechtshandhaving naar de bejegening van in bewaring gestelde vreemdelingen in Curaçao en het AIV-rapport ‘Veiligheid en recht

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about a Raad voor de rechtshandhaving inspection of detention conditions for migrants in Curaçao, the AIV advisory report on Caribbean security, the ombudsman's complaint that his recommendations are ignored, lack of legal aid and NGO access for Venezuelans, two minors reportedly detained, a Human Rights Institute recommendation, and a recent fire at the SDKK facility. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao decides whether to adopt inspection recommendations, though the Netherlands keeps pressing for improvements and Curaçao's project plan includes recommended measures, declined to intervene in the ombudsman matter, said legal aid is Curaçao's responsibility, denied that minors are currently held, and deferred the AIV-related questions to a later government response.
Under the Kingdom Act on the Council for Law Enforcement, it is up to the authorities of Curaçao to decide whether the recommendations in the inspection report are adopted.
Op basis van de Rijkswet Raad voor de Rechtshandhaving is het aan de autoriteiten van Curaçao om te bepalen of de aanbevelingen uit het betreffende inspectierapport worden overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Tovenaars met rommel’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about reports that failed waste-processing firms caused large public costs and that criminals operate in the sector. The government confirmed cost estimates in general terms, declined to give criminal records of owners, and announced a planned Omgevingsbesluit change allowing authorities to require financial security before granting permits.

This question cannot be answered. The criminal records of the natural persons referred to in the question who are in any way linked to companies prosecuted for environmental offences cannot be retrieved with an automated search.

Deze vraag kan niet worden beantwoord. De antecedenten van de in de vraag bedoelde natuurlijke personen die op enigerlei wijze zijn gelieerd aan bedrijven die strafrechtelijk zijn vervolgd voor milieudelicten, zijn niet met een geautomatiseerde zoekslag op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen inzake het bericht 'Advocaten slijpen messen na de bruiloftsfoto's en Grapperhaus verweer'

An MP asked the Justice Minister how intent figures in enforcing the 1.5-metre rule, whether the OM's internal 'three-step' enforcement framework is binding, and asked for statistics on fines, objections and payments. The minister answered that the framework is internal, non-binding and gives no rights to citizens, and supplied figures on fines, objections and collections, while noting the fine was lowered to 95 euro and that such fines were removed from criminal records.
No, the policy framework, unlike OM directives and prosecution guidelines, has no third-party effect; citizens cannot derive any rights from it.
Nee, het beleidskader heeft, anders dan OM-Aanwijzingen en strafvorderingsrichtlijnen, geen derdenwerking; burgers kunnen er geen rechten aan ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over verzetzaken tegen coronaboetes en de drieslag voor boa’s

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the government's claim of a three-step enforcement approach (warn, then fine) for corona fines holds, given that the Public Prosecution Service found no such mandatory sequence in its policy and a court ruled intent plays no role. The minister answered that the OM's enforcement framework leaves officers discretion, is not binding, grants no rights to citizens, and that enforcement will be intensified.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Lange rijen bij registratie in Ter Apel'

MPs Groothuizen and Van Toorenburg asked why asylum seekers arriving in Ter Apel still lacked beds despite new pavilions and rising inflow, and what measures will prevent this. The State Secretary explained the new registration process, the four heated pavilions and a waiting room for after-hours arrivals, and said a chain coordinator was appointed to optimise capacity, though there is no firm guarantee of a bed every night.

It is expressly not intended that asylum seekers spend two nights in the waiting room, but in the event of an unexpected peak in registrations, where vulnerable asylum seekers get priority, this cannot always be prevented.

Het is uitdrukkelijk niet de bedoeling dat asielzoekers twee nachten doorbrengen in de «wachtkamer», maar bij een onverwachte piek in het aantal aanmeldingen waarbij kwetsbare asielzoekers voorrang krijgen, is het niet altijd te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over rechtsbijstand aan verdachten bij strafbeschikkingen door het OM tijdens de coronapandemie

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether no agreement was reached on legal aid for suspects receiving OM penal orders during the pandemic, and why suspects summoned but not detained lack assistance. The minister replied that talks with the NOvA and chain partners are ongoing, that summoned suspects are informed of their right to subsidised legal aid, and that the quality of OM penal orders has improved according to oversight reports.

I am currently in talks with the legal profession and the relevant chain partners to provide some form of legal assistance in cases that were not submitted to the police judge during the coronavirus crisis but are settled by the OM with a penal order.

Ik ben momenteel in gesprek met de advocatuur en de betrokken ketenpartners om in de zaken die door de coronacrisis niet aan de politierechter zijn voorgelegd, maar door het OM met een OM-strafbeschikking worden afgedaan, in een vorm van rechtsbijstand te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over vervalsingen en het aanvraagproces van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG)

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked about forged Verklaringen Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) and commercial websites charging extra for VOG applications. The minister answered that forgeries are fraud, that Justis reports them, that employers must check authenticity, and that unauthorised use of government logos has been stopped with further steps under study.
Justis has informed municipalities of the existence of commercial parties.
Justis heeft gemeenten op de hoogte gesteld van het bestaan van commerciële partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Exclusive: Cyprus sold passports to criminals and fugitives’

MP Groothuizen asked the government about reports that Cyprus and Malta sold golden passports to criminals and fugitives, and whether the Dutch scheme should be abolished, whether EU action or an infringement procedure is possible, and whether due diligence could be transferred to Europol. The State Secretary answered that such schemes can facilitate crime, that Cyprus is abolishing its scheme, Malta has tightened its checks, the Dutch scheme will be reviewed after a year, and that the Commission is primarily responsible for any infringement procedure.
If after one year it appears that the scheme does not have this potential, it will be abolished.
Mocht na één jaar blijken dat de regeling deze potentie niet heeft, dan wordt zij afgeschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen vast in oorlogsgebied door sluiting ambassades’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Groothuizen asked whether ambassador closures due to COVID-19 leave about 1,500 refugee family members stranded in war zones and what the government will do. The minister answered that no exact figures exist, that about 90% of relevant posts have resumed visa services, that the government has eased rules and reissue arrangements, but that it cannot control the safety of people in conflict areas and cannot say when the remaining closed posts will reopen.

There is no insight into the exact number of refugee families (family reunification followers) who cannot come to the Netherlands for family reunification due to restricted consular services of an embassy or consulate-general.

Er is geen inzicht in het exacte aantal vluchtelingengezinnen (nareizigers) dat niet naar Nederland kan komen voor gezinshereniging door beperktere consulaire dienstverlening van een ambassade of consulaat-generaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over effectief toezicht op opsporing

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about judicial and internal oversight of police and prosecution investigations, including the shadowing of lawyers in the Ridouan T. case and the weak application of Article 359a Sv. The minister answered that courts retain review of investigative powers, that the Procureur-generaal's expanded oversight is being set up with extra capacity from autumn 2020, and that the new Wetboek van Strafvordering will revise procedural sanctions and be sent to Parliament after the new cabinet takes office.

By letter of 29 June, I informed the House of the state of affairs regarding the expansion of the Procureur-generaal bij de Hoge Raad's oversight of incidents in which the prosecution service played a role.
Bij brief van 29 juni jongstleden informeerde ik uw Kamer over de stand van zaken ten aanzien van de verruiming van het toezicht door de Procureur-generaal bij de Hoge Raad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Eerste coronabesmetting vastgesteld in Grieks vluchtelingenkamp Moria’

The MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Health about the first COVID-19 infection found in the Moria refugee camp on Lesbos, including contact with Greek counterparts, medical needs, testing, evacuations and EU funding. The government answered that it has regular contact with Greece, that camp residents are now tested, that Netherlands contributed a hospitainer and EUR 1 million to UNICEF, and that the number of migrants on the Greek islands fell from about 42,000 to 26,000.
The cabinet has informed the House on several occasions about the circumstances and the measures taken by the Greek government to prevent an outbreak of COVID-19 among migrants on the islands.

Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer op verschillende momenten geïnformeerd over de omstandigheden en de maatregelen die door de Griekse overheid zijn getroffen om de uitbraak van COVID-19 onder de migranten op de eilanden te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vagen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Groothuizen over het bericht 'Lange rijen bij registratie in Ter Apel'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Groothuizen asked why asylum registration at Ter Apel stalled, with long queues and people sleeping on chairs or the floor, and why no bed was provided. The Secretary of State attributed the delays to a higher-than-expected August intake combined with COVID-19 procedures, said a temporary pavilion with beds was not yet ready, and promised flexible capacity planning and a 24-hour registration target.
Unfortunately this facility was not yet ready when the intake in early August was higher than expected for several days.
Helaas was deze inrichting nog niet gereed toen de instroom begin augustus een aantal dagen hoger was dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Antihomogeweld in AZC: Vrouw overgoten met kokend water'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report that a Nigerian asylum seeker was scalded with boiling water in a reception centre, including questions on denied medical care, the perpetrator's continued residence, and protection of LGBTI residents against anti-gay violence. The State Secretary said the police are investigating, that care was given, that suspects were moved and interviewed, and that existing COA measures are adequate, without committing to new measures.
However, I cannot go into detail about the specific circumstances of the individual case.
Ik kan echter niet gedetailleerd ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Chaos bij taskforce asielaanvragen’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of chaos at the asylum taskforce, staffing levels, communication problems, cases pushed into the extended asylum procedure, and dossier quality. The State Secretary answered that staffing is growing via IND and external hires, communication was improved, capacity-driven transfers occur but the taskforce aims to clear them quickly, and quality safeguards apply, without committing to new structural changes.
As I indicated in my letter to the House of 7 September, new measures may deviate from the current way of working, so tension may arise with quality requirements and service delivery.

Zoals ik in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 7 september jl. heb aangegeven, kunnen nieuwe maatregelen afwijken van de huidige werkwijze waardoor spanning kan ontstaan met de kwaliteitsvereisten en de dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Groothuizen over het bericht 'Achterstand bij de IND wegwerken was het idee; het werd netflixen'

MPs Van Toorenburg (CDA) and Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that new IND decision-makers were advised to watch Netflix documentaries on asylum seekers' countries of origin, and about chaos, quality, and prioritisation problems in the IND backlog taskforce. The State Secretary answered that training uses optional viewing tips alongside written material, that start-up problems were organisational and are being addressed, that quality is safeguarded, and that about 4,000 cases were closed by 1 September with roughly 11,000 remaining.
These programmes are offered optionally outside the mandatory regular training component; staff can therefore choose to watch them when their workload allows.

Deze programma's worden facultatief aangeboden buiten het verplichte reguliere opleidingsdeel; men kan er dus voor kiezen de programma's te bekijken op het moment dat de werkomvang daar ruimte toe biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Chaos bij taskforce asielaanvragen’

An MP asks whether asylum lawyers are excluded from scheduling their clients' hearings, whether this undermines free choice of counsel, and whether a proposed two-week scheduling procedure should be adopted. The State Secretary says cooperation with the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand and COA is in place, lawyers can arrange substitutes, and regular consultation with the bar continues, but the proposed scheduling procedure cannot be adopted given the Taskforce's tight planning.
In principle this is not desirable, since the right to free choice of lawyer is a great good.
In beginsel is dit niet wenselijk, het recht op vrije advocaatkeuze is immers een groot goed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht over levenslanggestraften

An MP from D66 asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a court ruling ordering a decision on a life-sentence pardon request, the Hague Court of Appeal's view that the detention may be inhumane, the reasonableness of pardon deadlines, costs of litigation, and whether judges rather than politicians should decide. The Minister confirms the decision was issued on time, defends discretionary pardon power and refuses a statutory deadline or a bill transferring the decision to courts.
That means the judicial advice in a pardon procedure is not comparable to a judge's ruling imposing a sentence.
Dat maakt dat het advies van de rechter in een gratieprocedure niet vergelijkbaar is met de uitspraak van een rechter waarin een straf wordt opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'De aanpak van milieucriminaliteit dreigt vast te lopen'

An MP from D66 asked the Justice and Security and Infrastructure ministers how environmental crime enforcement can be given more urgency, whether it is falling into the margins of criminal law, how sanctions relate to subsidies, and when an action plan will be sent. The government agrees more urgency is needed, promises a full action plan by year-end and further information later, but gives no firm numbers on case durations or subsidy recipients and says it does not record that data.
The full action plan on environmental crime will be sent to your House before the end of this year.
Het volledige actieplan Milieucriminaliteit zal voor het einde van dit jaar aan uw Kamer worden verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over het bericht ‘Mondkapjesplicht in grote steden

Three D66 MPs asked whether local mask-wearing requirements in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, imposed via emergency ordinances, are compatible with Article 10 of the Constitution, their enforceability and sanctions, and why voluntary wearing was not chosen. The ministers answered that the experiments are a temporary, proportionate, locally motivated response to non-compliance with the 1.5-metre rule, that violations are punishable with a 95-euro fine, and that courts remain available for objections, while acknowledging the legal uncertainty and offering a temporary bill to shorten the emergency situation.
It is not for the government to intervene in any assessment of the sanction by the court.
Het is niet aan de regering om te treden in de eventuele beoordeling van de sanctie door de rechter.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over de Grieks-Nederlandse samenwerking ter verbetering van de situatie van alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers in Griekenland

MPs Groothuizen, Voordewind and Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary for progress on the Greek-Dutch initiative to set up reception places and a guardianship system for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in Greece, including timelines, partners, funding, obstacles and the role of NIDOS. The State Secretary answered that a MoU was signed on 18 June, a steering group met on 14 July, 48 reception places are being prepared with no fixed timetable, no funding has yet been transferred, and Greek authorities remain responsible.
On further progress I will continue to inform your House on a periodic basis.
Over de verdere voortgang zal ik uw Kamer op periodieke basis blijven informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Willekeur van coronaregels ondermijnt het vertrouwen’ en ‘Advocaten roepen mensen op: kom in verzet tegen coronaboete’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether corona fines can be challenged in court, given that kanton court hearings are largely suspended until 1 September 2020. The minister replied that objections (verzet) are possible and reviewed by the kantonrechter, but such cases were not yet heard, and the OM and Rechtspraak will bring a representative selection of objection cases to court before 1 September.
In principle this does not yet apply to criminal law kanton hearings (until 1 September 2020), which also include objection cases.
In beginsel geldt dit nog niet voor strafrecht kantonzittingen (tot 1 september 2020), waar ook de verzetszaken onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Geef kennismigranten en internationaal talent meer zekerheid tijdens de coronacrisis’

Three D66 MPs asked whether knowledge migrants and international students in the Netherlands should get more legal certainty during the COVID-19 crisis, including relaxed study-progress rules, extended job-search periods, and deadlines. The government answered that it will not impose consequences on temporary salary-criterion breaches under the Wtv scheme, offers flexibility on study progress and language tests, and is only exploring a broader interpretation of job-search rules, with no firm extension of the search period.

When insufficient study progress is caused by the coronavirus crisis, institutions can treat this as an excusable reason for the study delay, and this has no consequences for the student's residence permit.

Wanneer onvoldoende studievoortgang is veroorzaakt door de coronacrisis, kunnen instellingen dit aanmerken als een verschoonbare reden voor de studievertraging en heeft dit geen gevolgen voor de verblijfsvergunning van de student.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Stroom bootmigranten uit Libië zwelt weer aan’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports of a renewed rise in boat migrants from Libya, including conditions in Libyan detention centres during the COVID-19 crisis, whether rescued migrants are being returned to Libya, and EU coordination on disembarkation. The government answered that it monitors the situation, that the Libyan coast guard has intercepted about 4,400 people this year and about 2,000 are in official detention centres, that it has no indication of more returns to Libya, and that no specific EU consultation on disembarkation took place, while stating it will not participate in the voluntary redistribution mechanism of Operation Irini.
The Netherlands has not shown willingness to take part in the redistribution mechanism because the mechanism deviates from the cabinet's position on this theme.
Nederland heeft zich niet bereid getoond om deel te nemen aan het herverdelingsmechanisme aangezien het mechanisme afwijkt van het kabinetsstandpunt op dit thema.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'IOM deplores killing 30 trafficked migrants Libya'

An MP from D66 asked the ministers about the killing of 30 trafficked migrants in Libya, whether the incident would be investigated, and how Dutch policy addresses conditions for residents and migrants in Libya. The government condemned the incident, called on Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation in the Human Rights Council, and listed humanitarian funding and efforts to close detention centres.

In addition, the Netherlands expressed horror at the incident in a national statement to the Human Rights Council on 18 June and called on the Libyan authorities to conduct a thorough investigation with the aim of holding the perpetrators accountable.

Daarnaast heeft Nederland in een nationale verklaring in de Mensenrechtenraad op 18 juni jl. afschuw uitgesproken over het incident en de Libische autoriteiten opgeroepen tot een grondig onderzoek met als doel de daders ter verantwoording te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘IND wees ultiem verzoek asielzoeker Bahrein af'

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked how the IND handled new evidence and documents from a Bahraini asylum seeker facing risks on return, and why the Inspectorate report on the case was kept confidential. The State Secretary largely declined to discuss the individual case, explained general asylum assessment and document-handling procedures, and said publication of the report was withheld to protect the person's privacy and interests.
The government has, especially in individual cases in the field of immigration law, a duty to ensure that a person's interests and privacy are not violated.
De overheid heeft, zeker in individuele zaken op het terrein van vreemdelingenrecht, een plicht om er zorg voor te dragen dat de belangen en de privacy van een persoon niet worden geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen over het bericht dat de compliance bij ABN AMRO gedurende lange tijd tekortschoot

MPs Sneller and Groothuizen asked the Finance Minister whether ABN AMRO's compliance failures in 2015–2017 were known to the board of commissioners, to NLFI and to the ministry, and what the state did about it. The minister answered that compliance is the responsibility of the management and supervisory boards, that he cannot comment on the ongoing Public Prosecution Service investigation, and that NLFI and the ministry had regular contacts with the bank without compliance necessarily being on the agenda.
I therefore cannot go into the circumstances from the bank's past described in the article.
Ik kan daarom niet ingaan op de geschetste omstandigheden uit het verleden van de bank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer ‘Asiel, herplaatsing en terugkeer van migranten’

Two Dutch MPs (Voordewind and Groothuizen) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the European Court of Auditors report on asylum, relocation and return of migrants in Greece and Italy, including use of EU funds, relocation shortfalls, return rates, backlogs and conditions for unaccompanied minors. The State Secretary answered at length, largely agreeing with the report's findings and recommendations, explaining relocation and funding figures, and pointing primarily to Greek and Italian authorities for implementation while promising continued support and some concrete steps.
The cabinet therefore takes due note of the relevant analyses in the report and in principle agrees with the recommendations.
Het kabinet neemt dan ook goede nota van de betreffende analyses in het rapport, en sluit zich in beginsel aan bij de aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Voordewind, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Ojik over het bericht dat Griekenland asielzoekers stiekem terugstuurt naar Turkije

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Netherlands views reports that Greece secretly returns asylum seekers to Turkey, whether this breaches the ECHR, and whether the government will press for independent investigation in EU and Council of Europe settings. The government says it has no independent information to confirm or refute the reports, that Greece denies them and temporarily suspended asylum applications from March to April 2020, and that it expects Greece and the EU to comply with the ECHR, leaving investigation to the Commission and to complaints by those affected.
The Netherlands does not have independent information to confirm or refute the precise circumstances of the findings described in the article.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de precieze toedracht van de in het artikel geschetste bevindingen te bevestigen of te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de wenselijkheid van zelfonderzoek in fraudezaken

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked whether the professional rules for lawyers guarantee objectivity when they conduct self-investigations in fraud cases, including the risk of perverse financial incentives and the lack of licensing. Minister Grapperhaus answered that lawyers remain bound by professional conduct rules and disciplinary law, that the OM and FIOD verify such self-investigations, and that no specific new rules are needed.
The OM has indicated it is open in future to self-investigation by professionals, including lawyers or (forensic) accountants, hired by suspect companies themselves.
Het OM heeft te kennen gegeven in de toekomst open te staan voor zelfonderzoek door professionals, waaronder advocaten of (forensisch) accountants
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Ojik, Groothuizen en Van Meenen over onderwijs in asielzoekerscentra

Six MPs asked about schooling in asylum reception centres (azc's) during COVID-19, including poor wifi and lack of laptops for online lessons. The State Secretary answered that wifi capacity was expanded at all COA locations, EUR 6.3 million was allocated for devices, and schools must offer distance learning.
It is undesirable that online education is not possible due to limitations in network connections or the availability of tablets, laptops or computers.
Het is onwenselijk dat online onderwijs niet mogelijk is door beperkingen in netwerkverbindingen of de beschikbaarheid van tablets, laptops of computers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over versoepeling van Corona-maatregelen in gevangenissen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why Corona measures in prisons had not been eased like elsewhere, leaving visits and movement suspended since mid-March and detention phasing stalled. The minister replied that visits and leave were expanded from 2 June following RIVM guidelines, that suspension of detention for a small group of end-of-sentence prisoners continues for safety reasons, and that he will inform parliament shortly on resuming placement in restricted facilities.
I am considering when it is responsible to make placement in a ZBBI part of detention phasing again.
Ik bezie op welk moment het verantwoord is om de plaatsing in een ZBBI weer onderdeel te maken van de detentiefasering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de politieke verantwoordelijkheid in gevoelige zaken en de lopende strafzaak tegen Shell

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister how sensitive criminal cases are flagged to the minister, how the high-transaction procedure works, and what contact the ministry had with Shell over the Nigeria prosecution and a possible settlement. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the prosecution service informs him under the statutory duty of Article 129 RO, that he refrains from substantive comment on ongoing cases out of respect for prosecutorial independence and separation of powers, and that there was no ministry contact with Shell beyond seeking its view under the Wob request.
Part of this restraint is that I do not make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal case.
Onderdeel van de terughoudendheid is dat ik over een lopende strafzaak geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over aanbestedingen van tolk- en vertaaldiensten

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the Minister of Justice whether preparatory steps for the interpreter and translation procurement programme (Tolken in de Toekomst), such as early registration and online tender notices, were irreversible given his earlier commitment. The Minister answered that these steps are not irreversible, that tendering is required by law, and that he would reply to the parliamentary advocate's advice by letter, which was already sent on 20 May 2020.
Yes, pending the advice of the parliamentary advocate, I have not taken any irreversible steps.
Ja, ik heb in afwachting van het advies van de parlementair advocaat geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Asielzoekers zitten vast op een militaire kazerne, advocaten mogen er niet bij’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether asylum lawyers and Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland lacked access to the emergency reception at the Zoutkamp military barracks, and why asylum applications could not be lodged there. The State Secretary acknowledged that access was very limited during the emergency period, justified this as a proportionate Covid-19 measure, noted the site has since closed, and said applications are now processed again at COA locations.
During the period asylum seekers stayed at the emergency site, legal aid providers had very limited access to the emergency accommodation.
In de periode dat asielzoekers verbleven in de noodonderdaklocatie rechtsbijstandverleners zeer beperkt toegang hadden tot de noodonderdaklocatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Groothuizen, Voordewind en Van Toorenburg over het voorstel om migranten op de Griekse eilanden vanwege corona over te brengen naar stilliggende cruisesc

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Netherlands would press the EU to evacuate migrants from overcrowded Greek island camps, such as Moria, to idle cruise ships to prevent a COVID-19 outbreak, and why Dutch relocation promises were not being kept. The government answered that the Greek authorities are primarily responsible, that transfers to the mainland are already ongoing, that the Netherlands is backing a Greek-Dutch programme for unaccompanied minors, and that cruise-ship accommodation was judged unnecessary and costly by Greece.
In principle it is for the Greek authorities to take adequate measures to address the COVID-19 situation.
Het is in beginsel aan de Griekse autoriteiten om adequate maatregelen te treffen om de COVID-19 situatie het hoofd te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over wrakingscijfers

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the 2019 figures on recusal (wraking) requests in criminal cases, including whether withdrawn requests were counted and whether the figures justify the planned fast-track rules. The Minister confirmed the 692 requests with 17 upheld (later corrected to 4), explained 14 withdrawn requests, and said the planned legislation is motivated by procedural flexibility and the small share of granted requests.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Groothuizen over rechtspraak in tijden van coronacrisis

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked how the judiciary during the COVID-19 crisis can resume physical hearings, reduce case backlogs, adjust financing and protect indebted citizens. The ministers answer that hearings resume from 11 May with priority for criminal, youth and family law, that backlogs will be addressed without yet presenting a plan, and that they will examine the proposed changes to police-judge powers and evaluate emergency measures later.
In our letter of 23 April we indicated that courthouses can also be opened outside office hours and hold hearings.
In onze brief van 23 april jl. hebben we aangegeven dat er de mogelijkheid is om gerechtsgebouwen ook buiten kantoortijden te openen en zittingen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen inzake fundamentele rechten in het strafrecht

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Legal Protection about fundamental procedural rights in criminal law during COVID-19 measures, including phone-only lawyer consultation, video hearings, detainee access to hearings, public access to trials, and cell placement. The ministers largely answered that rights are safeguarded, that measures are proportionate and temporary, and that they are monitoring and adjusting practice, while committing to some reviews and expansions.
In taking all measures, the principles of the rule of law, democracy and fundamental rights are safeguarded, subject to the restrictions arising from the necessary public health measures.

Bij het treffen van alle maatregelen worden de beginselen van rechtsstaat, democratie en grondrechten geborgd met in achtneming van de beperkingen die voortvloeien uit de noodzakelijke maatregelen ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over het verbieden van samenkomsten buiten de publieke ruimte

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a ban on gatherings outside public space, under COVID-19 emergency ordinances, unduly intrudes on private life and the home, and how it fits Articles 10 and 12 of the Constitution and Article 8 ECHR. The minister answered that the ban rests on public health law, that proportionality and judicial review by courts apply case by case, and that temporary formal legislation with safeguards is planned.
Ultimately it is up to the criminal or administrative court to judge the ban and whether enforcement in a concrete situation affects the private sphere.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de strafrechter of de bestuursrechter om te oordelen over het verbod en of het optreden in een concrete situatie de persoonlijke levenssfeer raakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen overde gevolgen van de Luanda Leaks voor Nederlandse bedrijven en beleid

MPs Sneller and Groothuizen asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the consequences of the Luanda Leaks for Dutch firms and policy, including trust offices, Dutch shell companies, consultancy due diligence and anti-corruption enforcement. The minister answered most questions substantively but declined to say whether investigations are ongoing, citing the prosecution service and FIOD procedures, and promised to study trust-sector evasion and the government procurement leverage.
I cannot go into questions concerning what the Public Prosecution Service, the FIOD and supervisors are doing in terms of (whether or not) ongoing investigations.
Ik kan niet ingaan op vragen die zien op hetgeen door het OM, de FIOD en toezichthouders wordt gedaan in de zin van (al dan niet) lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma  over de aangenomen noodwet van de Hongaarse president Orbán

Two D66 MPs asked the Dutch ministers about Hungary's emergency law allowing rule by decree without time limit and criminal penalties for disinformation, and what the Netherlands would do regarding rule of law. The government called the Hungarian law worrying, said it raised rule-of-law concerns, and described raising it with Hungary, in the Foreign Affairs Council, through the Article 7 procedure, conditionality in the EU budget and the annual rule-of-law review.
The cabinet finds the steps taken by the Hungarian government and parliament worrying.
Het kabinet vindt de door de Hongaarse regering en parlement gezette stappen verontrustend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de gevolgen van het Corona-virus voor de (sociale) advocatuur

An MP asks the Justice ministers how the Covid-19 crisis affects the legal aid sector, including advance payment schemes, arrests and piket calls, lawyers' income, and whether court scheduling takes lawyers' agendas into account. The minister answers that an extra advance payment scheme and related measures are in place, that the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand monitors case numbers per field, and that further targeted measures may follow.
Your House will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Uw Kamer zal hierover zo spoedig mogelijk nader worden geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Buitenweg, Van Dam en Groothuizen over de brief van the European Network of Councils for the Judiciary (ENCJ) aan de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie over recente anti-Europese wetgeving

MPs from CDA, GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about the ENCJ letter on Polish rule-of-law reforms, the Polish 'muzzle law' and the Commission's infringement actions, and whether the Netherlands should start an Article 259 TFEU procedure against Poland. The ministers expressed serious concern, noted the Court of Justice's rulings and the Commission's role, supported rule-of-law conditionality in the EU budget, but argued that a Member State-initiated Article 259 procedure is not the appropriate instrument.
The separation of powers and the independence of the judiciary are essential principles of the democratic rule of law and form the core values of the European Union.
De scheiding der machten en onafhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht zijn essentiële beginselen van de democratische rechtsstaat en vormen de kernwaarden van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Groothuizen over de positie van arbeidsmigranten tijdens de coronacrisis

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the position of migrant workers during the COVID-19 crisis, covering worker testing, complaint routes, dismissals, housing, travel and harvest labour shortages. The minister answered substantively on most points, stating that employers must follow RIVM rules and that complaints can go to the Inspectie SZW, while stating that no unified figures exist on evicted or travelling migrant workers.

Although these developments have our continuous attention, there are currently no unambiguous figures on the number of migrant workers who have travelled home or lost their housing as a result of the corona crisis.

Hoewel deze ontwikkelingen onze continue aandacht hebben, zijn er op dit moment geen eenduidige cijfers over het aantal arbeidsmigranten die naar huis zijn gereisd of die als gevolg van de coronacrisis hun huisvesting kwijt zijn geraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het afschermen van de gegevens van advocaten in het kadaster

An MP asked whether lawyers' addresses in the land registry (Kadaster) can be shielded for safety, and whether this should be made easier. The minister answered that shielding is possible under article 37a of the Kadasterbesluit only for persons in the protection system, that the current openness will remain, and that no simplification is planned.
No, I do not share this view. The current practice of openness of cadastral information provided by the Kadaster will remain as it is.
Nee deze mening deel ik niet. De huidige praktijk van openbaarheid van kadasterinformatie (informatieverstrekking) van het Kadaster zal zo blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Justitie laat het bedrijfsleven lelijk in de steek bij corruptiezaken'
