MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice Minister about reports that Dutch prosecutors leave companies exposed in corruption cases, including how many firms were prosecuted or settled, whether Dutch anti-corruption law is fragmented or outdated, and how it compares with UK and French law. Minister Grapperhaus answered that exact counts are unavailable, about five firms settled in five years, Dutch law is adequate and needs no modernisation now, though a judicial review of high transactions is being introduced.
An exact figure for the number of criminal cases in which prosecution was instituted cannot be given.
Een exact cijfer van het aantal strafzaken waarin vervolging is ingesteld niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Nederland op slot voor vluchteling per vliegtuig’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report that asylum seekers can practically no longer reach the EU by plane, and about how airlines refuse passengers and cooperate in removals. The State Secretary rejected any obligation to facilitate onward migration, said airlines are bound by carrier sanctions, admitted that refusals are not systematically registered, and promised a policy response only after the advisory commission's reports are complete.
A policy response will be given after all sub-reports of the ACVZ have been completed.
Een beleidsreactie zal worden gegeven nadat alle deelrapporten van de ACVZ zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Sneller en Groothuizen over de implementatie van noodverordeningen ten behoeve van de ‘intelligente lockdown’

MPs Den Boer, Sneller and Groothuizen asked why the legal basis for new COVID-19 'intelligent lockdown' measures was not communicated, why emergency ordinances took days to draft, whether enforcement before legal force was lawful, and when the ordinances will be withdrawn. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the legal bases were in the Minister of Health's directive to safety regions, acknowledged the omission for future letters, defended announcing measures before the ordinances existed, explained the drafting complexity, and said the measures stay in force until the health minister's directive is withdrawn, with review before 28 April.
In future, care will be taken that these legal bases are also stated when informing the House.
In het vervolg zal erop worden gelet dat deze grondslagen ook worden vermeld bij het informeren van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de betrouwbaarheid en volledigheid van zelfonderzoek door eigen advocaten van bedrijven

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether company self-investigations by their own lawyers in criminal fraud cases are reliable, whether the OM keeps track of them, and whether this risks truth-finding. The Minister answered that the OM sets no specific framework, that the FIOD checks and the OM verifies such investigations, that the OM plans to use them more often, and that the risks are adequately mitigated.
The number of criminal investigations in which self-investigations were submitted, and in how many cases this led to sentence reduction, is not registered as such by the OM.

Het aantal strafrechtelijke onderzoekszaken waarbij zelfstandige onderzoeken zijn aangedragen en in hoeveel gevallen dit heeft geleid tot strafvermindering, worden niet als zodanig geregistreerd bij het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Stampvol vluchtelingenkamp Lesbos kansloos bij besmetting coronavirus’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Foreign Minister about COVID-19 risks in Greek migrant camps such as Moria, including protection measures, evacuation, and use of EU funds. The government answered that no migrants in Moria had tested positive yet, described Greek and EU containment measures and financial support, and said evacuation is in principle Greece's responsibility, with EU emergency mechanisms available if requested.
Responsibility for the decision on evacuating migrants from the Greek islands lies in principle with Greece.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de beslissing over een evacuatie van migranten op de Griekse eilanden ligt in beginsel bij Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Belhaj en Groothuizen over een Nederlandse bijdrage aan een gereactiveerde ‘Sophia-missie’

MPs Sjoerdsma, Belhaj and Groothuizen asked the ministers about the Berlin Libya conference, the EU arms embargo monitoring role, reactivating the Sophia mission, humanitarian and migration effects, and a Dutch contribution. The government welcomed the Berlin outcomes, said EUNAVFOR MED Irini (succeeding Sophia) will implement the UN arms embargo, and said a Dutch contribution of staff officers in Rome is likely while further capacity decisions await military advice.
The cabinet is still considering a possible contribution with other capabilities.
Het kabinet beraadt zich nog op een eventuele bijdrage met andere capaciteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de situatie in Kameroen

An MP asked the government about the humanitarian, security and political situation in Cameroon, including refugee flows, human rights, the February 2020 elections, education, and Dutch and EU support. The ministers answered in detail on the crises, Dutch aid of 2 million euros, EU pressure for dialogue, and Cameroon-related asylum figures.
The Netherlands contributed 2 million euros to the emergency aid programme of the Dutch Relief Alliance in Cameroon.
Nederland heeft 2 miljoen euro bijgedragen aan het noodhulpprogramma van de Dutch Relief Alliance in Kameroen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Slachtoffers misdrijven willen meer privacy, angst voor wraak daders’

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that crime victims lack privacy protection and fear reprisals, including why victims are not always told about postal-address or anonymous-filing options. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained the limits of anonymous filing, said a generic anonymisation measure and process fixes are under review, and promised a progress letter in spring 2020.
I committed in that letter to inform the House in spring 2020 about the state of affairs of these actions.
Ik heb in deze brief toegezegd uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2020 te informeren over de stand van zaken van deze acties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over algoritmische analyse van vonnissen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about algorithmic profiling of judges and the publication of court rulings, including France's ban on analysing judges' identities. The Minister said the analysis of judgments is longstanding but that technology allows it at larger scale, that only 2-3% of Dutch rulings are published online (rising to 5% under the agreement), and that a review of how large-scale analysis could be allowed is worth considering.
In addition, the potential negative consequences of publishing all rulings must be examined.
Daarnaast dienen potentiële negatieve consequenties van het publiceren van alle uitspraken te worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over de gevolgen van het Corona-virus voor de rechtspleging en de rechtsbescherming

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked how the Corona crisis affects criminal justice and legal protection, including the Public Prosecution Service's restricted approach, the Emergency Justice Act (Noodwet rechtspleging) and suspended community service sentences. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police, prosecutors, probation and courts have scaled back work to priority tasks, that remote legal aid is being organised and extra fees given, that the emergency act is not yet needed but would be decided via the Ministerial Crisis Committee, and that community service terms cannot currently be extended by law.
Applying the Emergency Justice Act is, given the exceptional measures it provides, not an instrument to be used lightly.
Het toepassen van de Noodwet rechtspleging is, mede gelet op de bijzondere voorzieningen die deze wet biedt, geen lichtzinnig in te zetten instrument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over de kabinetsbrief Vervolgmaatregelen aanpak coronavirus

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether suspending new asylum applications until 6 April removes access to reception and where arrivals will stay, plus questions on the IND, deportation talks, and COVID measures in asylum centres. The State Secretary confirmed new asylum procedures are suspended with only essential registration, that emergency shelter is being arranged, and that centre protocols and GGD cooperation are in place, though much remains uncertain.
The decision taken is that for asylum seekers who newly register, the asylum procedure is suspended.
Het besluit dat is genomen is dat voor asielzoekers die zich nieuw aanmelden de asielprocedure wordt opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en De Groot over rechtswetenschappelijke onderzoek naar de Habitatrichtlijn en Vogelrichtlijn

MPs Groothuizen and De Groot asked the ministers of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and of Justice and Security about a legal study on domestic cats and the EU Birds and Habitats Directives, including whether cat predation is a significant threat and how permits for trap-neuter-return programmes are handled. The minister answered that cat predation is not shown to significantly affect protected species, that provinces are responsible for permits and nature measures, and that no ban on letting cats roam is considered necessary.
It is not known how many animals are killed by cats in the Netherlands.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel dieren in Nederland door katten worden gedood.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het bericht ‘Vreemdelingenadvocaten: ‘Curaçao zet Venezolanen collectief uit’

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about reports that Curaçao collectively expelled Venezuelans and about detention conditions in the immigration barracks on Curaçao, including whether the Kingdom should intervene. The government answered that Curaçao is responsible for detention conditions, that Netherlands supports improvements, and that Kingdom intervention is a last resort, while promising continued monitoring and not committing to an independent visit.
Intervention by the Kingdom under the Charter is a last resort.
Ingrijpen door het Koninkrijk op grond van het Statuut is een laatste redmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Groothuizen over hoe Nederlandse bedrijven een mogelijk zeer schadelijke rol spelen bij uitbuiten van Angola

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers how Dutch companies and shell companies may have helped drain Angolan state funds, and what tools exist to tackle foreign bribery, consultancy oversight, and corporate liability. The government answered that existing criminal law is adequate, that investigations are ongoing and cannot be discussed, that trust-office rules and consultancy regulation are under review, and that it will study a remediation programme for companies.
I cannot make statements about any ongoing investigations.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over eventuele lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van der Graaf over levenslanggestraften

MPs Groothuizen and Van der Graaf asked about the National Ombudsman's findings on the prosecution service's advice in a 2017 life-sentence pardon request, the duration of the procedure, the review framework for life sentences and the government's response to NGO submissions to the Council of Europe. The minister maintains the advice was sufficiently substantiated, the review framework complies with the ECHR, no statutory deadlines are needed, and the pardon decision remains a discretionary balancing by the Crown.
I therefore see no need to take measures on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak om op dit punt maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over de mogelijke schikking met Shell

MPs Groothuizen and Sneller asked whether the Justice Minister discussed a possible settlement with Shell over the Etosha bribery investigation in Nigeria with prosecutors, whether ministry officials pushed for a settlement, why the Royal Household inquired about the case in 2016, and how the Prime Minister assesses Shell's conduct. The Minister answered that he was only informed of the investigation's status, denied requesting or pushing for a settlement, said the 2016 inquiry concerned a planned royal visit and media attention, and declined to comment on an ongoing criminal case.
Has the Minister asked the Public Prosecution Service to reach a settlement with Shell? If so, why did you do that and when did you do it?
Heeft de Minister het OM gevraagd een schikking te treffen met Shell? Zo ja, waarom heeft u dat gedaan en wanneer heeft u dat gedaan?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Tolken en vertalers staken ‘totdat de minister met ons in gesprek gaat’’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about interpreters' strike and proposals to open the interpreter register to B2-level interpreters, citing scarcity and quality concerns. The minister answered that the renewed register aims to gain oversight of quality and integrity of all interpreters used by central government, keeps C1 as the norm for mandatory-use organisations, and that he met the action group.
To gain grip on the quality and integrity of all interpreters providing services to central government, a renewed Rbtv will be introduced in which all these interpreters must be registered.
Om grip te krijgen op de kwaliteit en integriteit van alle tolken die diensten verrichten voor de rijksoverheid, komt er een vernieuwd Rbtv, waarin al deze tolken ingeschreven moeten staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Afwijzing vordering TUL in 2 strafzaken’

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Gelderland court ruling that refused to enforce suspended sentences despite convicting the defendants of new offences, because under the new Wet USB no appeal lies against such enforcement decisions. The minister agreed that enforcing a suspended sentence before the new conviction is final would conflict with the presumption of innocence, said CJIB measures now prevent such enforcement, and committed to amending the law soon.
I will bring this legislative amendment into procedure at very short notice.
Ik zal deze wetswijziging op zeer korte termijn in procedure brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘2500 jonge alleenstaande asielzoekers verdwenen’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that about 2,500 unaccompanied minor asylum seekers disappeared from reception centres, why some centres see many disappearances, why the Amber Alert system is not used for them, and what has been done since a July 2019 debate and a revised protocol. The State Secretary confirms roughly 2,570 such disappearances over 2010-2019, states that open (not closed) reception means minors may leave, explains the Ter Apel and Oisterwijk pattern, rejects the premise that Amber Alert is excluded, and promises analysis results and a reply within four weeks.
Within four weeks your House will receive the research results and my response to them by letter.
Uw Kamer ontvangt binnen vier weken per brief de onderzoeksresultaten en mijn reactie daarop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Je kunt niet tien keer met hetzelfde komen’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security to explain her remark that the asylum system should be based more on rules than on rights, and how that fits with the Van Zwol report on repeat asylum applications. The State Secretary answered that rights and rules are out of balance given misuse of the procedure, that she seeks new rules and EU-level tools while keeping the right to asylum, and described IND measures against hopeless repeat applications with average processing times of about 150 days.
To be able to counter misuse of the asylum system and the associated facilities, I want the European rights-based system to be supplemented with a well-functioning, rules-based system.

Om misbruik van het asielsysteem en de bijbehorende voorzieningen tegen te kunnen gaan, wil ik dat het Europese op rechten gebaseerde systeem wordt aangevuld met een goed functionerend, op regels gebaseerd systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Oxfam: nieuwe wet verslechtert situatie asielzoekers Griekse eilanden’

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether asylum seekers in Greece lack access to a fair asylum procedure and legal aid, whether the European Commission will supervise access to lawyers in closed centres, and how much EU money supports legal aid. The State Secretary acknowledges remaining bottlenecks including limited legal aid, says the government presses Greece for improvements, notes the Commission's oversight role and EUR 322,000 in EU legal-aid funding, but lacks exact figures and deems Commission involvement in closed centres premature.
The cabinet does not have the exact figures for the number of asylum seekers currently having access to legal aid.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de exacte cijfers van het aantal asielzoekers dat momenteel toegang heeft tot juridische bijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over gebrek aan zittingscapaciteit bij extra beveiligde rechtbanken

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the shortage of hearing capacity in the existing extra-secure courtrooms (the Bunker in Amsterdam and Justitieel Complex Schiphol), which are almost fully booked for 2020 largely due to the MH17 trial, and about the consequences and planned measures. The minister confirmed the capacity problem, said delays are likely, and said talks with the Council for the Judiciary are ongoing without committing to specific measures or costs yet.
I am holding talks with the Council about the expected need for additional courtrooms and the possibilities for extra capacity on this point.
Ik voer gesprekken met de Raad over de verwachte behoefte aan extra zittingszalen en de mogelijkheden voor eventuele extra capaciteit op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Groothuizen en Van den Berge over de werkwijze van de meervoudige kamers van de Hoge Raad

MPs Van Nispen, Groothuizen and Van den Berge asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the Supreme Court's practice of 'reservists' taking part in deliberations conflicts with articles 75 and 5 of the Wet RO. The Minister answered that reservists only give legal input in deliberations, do not decide cases or join the final vote, so no conflict with the law arises and no amendment is needed.
In my view there is therefore no reason to amend the law.
Mijns inziens bestaat er dan ook geen aanleiding om de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Politie arresteert klokkenluider die klaagde over machtsmisbruik’

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the arrest of two police officers suspected of leaking confidential police data, and whether this deters internal whistleblowing within the Dutch National Police. Minister Grapperhaus declined to comment on the individual criminal investigation, stated that whistleblowers following the prescribed internal procedure deserve protection while leaking confidential information is not whistleblowing, and pointed to internal procedures, an internal ombudsman and an ongoing evaluation.
As Minister of Justice and Security, it is not appropriate for me to comment on an individual criminal investigation.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid past het mij niet me uit te laten over een individueel strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Dam, Groothuizen, Helder, Kuiken, Van Wijngaarden en Van den Berge over het boek ‘Moordsporen, op zoek naar de waarheid achter cold cases’

MPs from several parties asked the Justice Minister about the book 'Moordsporen' on unresolved cold cases, including the Larissa Dumont case, and whether an independent second-opinion facility should be set up. The minister acknowledged the importance of resolving doubts for relatives, pointed to police learning and ombudsman initiatives, defended the prosecutor's earlier conclusions, and described an ongoing second-opinion pilot and existing complaint routes.
If relatives have doubts about the conclusions of the death investigation after it has concluded, they can raise them with the public prosecutor.
Indien nabestaanden na het overlijdensonderzoek twijfels hebben over de conclusies daarvan, kunnen zij deze kenbaar maken aan de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het bericht ‘Vreemdelingenadvocaten: 'Curaçao zet Venezolanen collectief uit’

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about reports that Curaçao collectively expels Venezuelan migrants without individual assessment, detention conditions, minors, oversight by the Kingdom, and Dutch military assistance. The minister answers that individual screening is procedurally required, that Curaçao's judiciary must review compliance, that 95 of 97 intercepted persons were returned after individual assessment, and that Dutch military support was provided under Curaçao's authority with some improvements to detention facilities pending.
It is not for the Dutch government but for the judiciary of Curaçao to assess, where relevant cases arise, to what extent irregularities occur in an expulsion.

Het is niet aan de regering van Nederland, maar aan de rechterlijke macht in Curaçao om in eventueel voorkomende gevallen te beoordelen in hoeverre er zich onregelmatigheden voordoen bij een uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Dam over Officieren van Justitie die in de fout zijn gegaan

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice about prosecutors (OM) who made errors, the adequacy of judicial review under article 359a Sv, disciplinary oversight and the Ombudsman complaint figures. The Minister replied that article 359a has a limited purpose, that a reflection chamber on OM quality was set up, that a letter on OM oversight and the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure will follow.
The article therefore has a limited purpose and does not aim to regulate comprehensive supervision of the OM.
Het artikel heeft derhalve een beperkt doel en beoogt geen alomvattend toezicht op het OM te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Groothuizen, Van den Berge en Özütok over geweld tegen de actiegroep Kick Out Zwarte Piet

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister and the Justice and Interior ministers how violence against the Kick Out Zwarte Piet congress was allowed, whether local authorities knew in advance, and how demonstrations and the Sinterklaas processions will be protected. The ministers condemned intimidation and violence, said police and prosecutors are investigating, and said local authorities (mayor, police, prosecutor) decide within legal limits, with a handreiking offered to municipalities; several answers were evasive about advance knowledge.
In our constitutional state it is unacceptable that (groups of) individual citizens disrupt a gathering of other citizens with violence and intimidation.
Het is in onze rechtsstaat ontoelaatbaar dat (groepen van) individuele burgers een bijeenkomst van andere burgers verstoren met geweld en intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht 'Vluchtelingenwerk bezorgd om uitzetting Afghaanse tolk'

MPs Belhaj, Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether an Afghan former interpreter for the US army, refused asylum and facing deportation, is consistent with government statements on risk groups for interpreters in Afghanistan, and how such cases are weighed. The government declined to discuss individual cases, explained that interpreters who worked for international missions are now treated as a systematically persecuted group following a motion, and estimated about ten former local staff granted asylum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over corrupte douaniers

MP Groothuizen asked the Justice and Finance ministers about corruption among customs officers in Rotterdam and why a research report on it was not published, including whether the customs service obstructed the study. The ministers answered that the research was independent, referred to a separate letter on the customs service's cooperation, and said screening of customs staff will be strengthened, with a first assessment expected in 2020.
The Police Education Council is an independent advisory body of the Ministry of Justice and Security whose position and tasks are regulated by law.
De Politieonderwijsraad is een onafhankelijk adviesorgaan van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid waarvan positie en taken bij wet zijn geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Het kamp op Lesbos was nooit zó vol’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that the Lesbos camps are overcrowded, the departure of camp directors, the worsening conditions on Greek islands, EU funding use, and the Greek proposal to designate Turkey as a safe country. The State Secretary answered that conditions have deteriorated, that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns with Greek authorities, that asylum procedure reform is the responsibility of the Greek government, and that the Chamber will be informed of significant changes.
If new agreements are made at European level on the Netherlands' involvement regarding the situation in the Greek refugee camps, your House will of course be informed.
Mochten er nieuwe afspraken worden gemaakt in Europees verband over de inzet omtrent de situatie in de Griekse vluchtelingenkampen, dan zal uw Kamer uiteraard geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over milieucriminaliteit

Two D66 MPs asked ministers about environmental crime, covering police expertise, illegal bird trapping and eel poaching, illegal waste transport, subsidy and manure fraud, and air-gun regulation. The government answered that police capacity is adequate, that some enforcement data are not registered or fall under provincial responsibility, and that a bill requiring permits for high-power air guns is nearly ready.
Control over bird trapping has been the responsibility of the provinces since 2017, so I will not give a picture or figures on this.
De controle op het vangen van vogels ligt sinds 2017 bij de provincies, daarom zal ik hier geen beeld of cijfers voor gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘COA lijkt te stoppen met consequente beschermde opvang LHBTQ-asielzoekers’

MPs Bergkamp and Groothuizen asked whether the COA closed the dedicated LHBTQ unit in Ter Apel, how this squares with a 2016 motion, and whether separate shelter is still needed. The State Secretary answered that the COA does not run dedicated LHBTQ shelter, prefers not to group specific groups, but tries to place residents with similar backgrounds within a location and can transfer people when unsafe; the answers to most questions refer back to answer 2.
The COA does not have protected shelter for LHBTQ residents.
Het COA beschikt niet over beschermde opvang voor LHBTQ bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Verhoeven over paspoorthandel op Malta

Three D66 MPs asked the government about passport sales in Malta, including whether they enable crime, the role of the Maltese state, AIVD warnings, and Dutch positions in the EU. The government answered that Malta conducts due diligence but this is no guarantee, that it sees such sales as undesirable but that citizenship remains national competence, that it will await an EU Commission process before dialogue, and that the Dutch investor residence scheme will be reviewed for added value.
As indicated in the answer to question 6, it is wise to await the outcome of these Commission initiatives and then engage in dialogue, preferably at EU level, on these schemes.

Zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 6 is aangegeven, is het verstandig om de uitkomst van deze initiatieven van de Commissie af te wachten en op basis daarvan de dialoog – bij voorkeur op EU-niveau – over genoemde regelingen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het fenomeen ‘voorgenomen beslissing’

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about the 'voorgenomen beslissing' practice and whether suspects are generally given a chance to present their view before a summons is issued. The minister answered that a suspect is usually heard (verhoor) before summons across nearly all criminal investigations, with exceptions such as an unfindable suspect, and clarified that 'zienswijze' refers to a response to the facts underlying the suspicion.
Following these questions, the OM has again informed me that it is customary that, in (nearly) all criminal investigations, the suspect is heard before the summons is issued.

Naar aanleiding van onderhavige vragen heeft het OM mij nogmaals laten weten dat het gebruikelijk is dat ten aanzien van (vrijwel) alle strafrechtelijke onderzoeken voorafgaand aan het uitbrengen van de dagvaarding de verdachte wordt verhoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over de Kerncijfers asiel en migratie, juni 2019

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about language provision for asylum seekers from several countries (Yemen, Syria, Eritrea, Turkey, Iran, Iraq), the link to long IND waiting times, and whether same-day language lessons are possible as the coalition agreement promises. The State Secretary answered that Syrians, Eritreans and stateless people already receive NT2 lessons at procedure centres, that the eligible group will be widened by 1 January 2020 based on recognition rates and numbers, and that the Flexibilisering Asielketen programme is developing a framework to prioritise likely-admissible claims.
As soon as possible for implementation, and at the latest by 1 January 2020, the group of asylum seekers who receive an offer will be updated.
Zo snel als mogelijk voor de uitvoering, uiterlijk per 1 januari 2020 wordt de doelgroep van asielzoekers die een aanbod krijgen, geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Staatloze asielzoeker hoopt op uitweg uit niemandsland’

A D66 MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a Council of State ruling that a residence permit under the outside-fault policy (buitenschuldbeleid) cannot be refused merely because the DT&V issued no positive advisory opinion, and how requirements for stateless applicants are clarified. The State Secretary accepted the ruling, announced a change to the Vreemdelingencirculaire allowing the DT&V to issue a reasoned advisory report, and gave statistics on stateless applicants while declining to discuss individual cases.
The decision must state reasons for the extent to which the foreign national meets the conditions for granting a residence permit under the outside-fault policy.
In de beschikking dient te worden gemotiveerd in hoeverre de vreemdeling aan de voorwaarden voor verlening van een verblijfsvergunning op grond van het buitenschuldbeleid voldoet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Jasper van Dijk, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Bisschop over het bericht dat een medewerker bij de IND door zijn leidinggevende onder druk werd gezet om zijn eigen dossi

MPs asked whether internal IND emails showing a supervisor discussing 'constructions' around asylum decisions contradict the De Leeuw commission's finding of no directed instructions to break rules, and whether further investigation, contact with ministry officials, and a meeting with the whistleblower are warranted. The State Secretary replied that the emails were included in the commission's research, found no reason for further investigation or doubt about the report's reliability or independence, declined to discuss individual personnel matters citing privacy, and saw no reason to meet the whistleblower.
I therefore see no reason for additional investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor een aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over de moord op de Maltese journaliste Daphne Caruana Galizia

MPs Verhoeven and Groothuizen asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about the independence of the Maltese public inquiry into journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia's murder, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and pending libel suits against her. Minister Blok answered that the inquiry is for Malta to organise independently, the Netherlands raises concerns bilaterally, Malta is following the Venice Commission recommendations, and the libel cases are for the Maltese courts to decide.
It is for the inquiry commission to shape the investigation in an independent manner.
Het is aan de onderzoekscommissie om het onderzoek op onafhankelijke wijze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het artikel "De uit zee opgepikte migranten moeten wel ergens van boord kunnen, waarschuwen Nederlandse reders"

MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked about reports that rescued migrants struggle to disembark, a hijacked merchant ship, and EU Operation Sophia, and asked for measures on safe ports and safety. The government answered that it has no such figures, supports calls for safe ports and a structural EU disembarkation solution, and noted that Sophia's mandate targets smuggling rather than rescue and was extended unchanged for six months.
The cabinet does not have such figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over dergelijke cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de situatie op en rond de Middellandse Zee

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about migrants rescued at sea being sent to a bombed Libyan detention centre, Italy's law fining rescuers, and the EU Sophia mission and Macron's migration mechanism. The government confirmed the Tajoura transfers, said it urged Libya to stop taking rescued people there and to open safer centres, noted the EU extended Sophia's mandate, said it was too early to assess the Italian law, and reported no tangible progress on a temporary relocation mechanism.
The Ministry of Internal Affairs of the UN-backed Government of National Accord decided on 1 August to close three detention centres, including the Tajoura centre.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse zaken van de door de VN gesteunde regering van het Nationale Akkoord (GNA), heeft op 1 augustus jl. besloten drie detentiecentra te sluiten, waaronder het centrum in Tajoura.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het tappen van de klokkenluider in de WODC-affaire

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the wiretapping of whistleblower Van Ooyen in the WODC affair, whether he knew of it, and why he filed a criminal complaint in a case that could implicate her. The minister answered that the investigation is for the Public Prosecution Service and the Rijksrecherche, that he filed the complaint on the prosecutor's advice, expressly stated the leak was not against her, and that talks on compensation are ongoing.
I cannot go into the details of an individual criminal investigation.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de details van een individueel strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Schonis en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Italy holds Netherlands, EU ‘responsible’ for migrant boat’

MPs asked the government about Italy holding the Netherlands and the EU responsible for migrants aboard the Sea-Watch 3, about Dutch obligations under the SAR convention, and about progress on a structural EU solution for disembarkation. The minister answered that Netherlands requested a port and asked the Commission to coordinate, that primary SAR responsibility lies with the state of the rescue zone, that no structural solution has yet been found, and that the government keeps pressing for one.
The cabinet will continue to press for a mechanism in which as large a group as possible, if not all member states, takes its responsibility.
Het kabinet zal blijven aandringen op een mechanisme waarin een zo groot mogelijke groep, zo niet alle lidstaten, haar verantwoordelijkheid neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma en Diertens over de situatie op Curaçao

MPs Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma and Diertens asked about the situation on Curaçao, including the Article 3 ECHR protection procedure, detention conditions for Venezuelan migrants, border and drug and arms smuggling controls, and funding. The government answered that the procedure was revised and adopted, that detention upgrades are being funded, and that border controls and support measures are being strengthened, while stressing that law enforcement is Curaçao's autonomous responsibility.
It is primarily up to the country of Curaçao to ensure that the procedure is properly implemented and to ensure that effective legal remedies and the necessary capacity exist.

Het is primair aan het land Curaçao om erop toe te zien dat op goede wijze invulling wordt gegeven aan de procedure en zorg te dragen voor het bestaan van effectieve rechtsmiddelen en de daarbij benodigde capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de "bemoeienis van het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid met het proces Wilders"

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked on what legal basis the Ministry of Justice and Security gave the prosecution points on possible defence arguments in the Wilders case, and why officials analysed the prosecution's report. Minister Grapperhaus answered that he cannot go into the content of the documents because they are now part of the court file, and promised a full account to parliament once the case is no longer before the court.
This means that as Minister of Justice and Security I must be extremely restrained and at this stage I cannot go into the substance of the documents.
Dit maakt dat ik mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid uiterst terughoudend dien op te stellen en ik in dit stadium niet inhoudelijk op de (inhoud van de) documenten kan ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het bericht  ‘Topambtenaren eisten harde aanpak in proces tegen 'kwaadaardige' Wilders’

MPs Kuiken, Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked whether ministry officials improperly advised the public prosecution service (OM) on prosecuting Wilders, citing reports that officials urged a tough approach and wanted to read the requisitoir in advance. Minister Grapperhaus largely refers to earlier answers and a letter sending documents to the Chamber, while stating the College of procurators-general must provide information the minister needs.
I refer you to my answer to questions 1 through 6 today on the questions from members Groothuizen and Van Nispen about the involvement of the Ministry of Justice and Security in the Wilders case.

Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 1 tot en met 6 van heden op de vragen van de leden Groothuizen (D66) en Van Nispen (SP) over bemoeienis van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid met het proces Wilders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Polen sleept kritische juristen voor de rechter’

MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the government recognises that Polish prosecutions of critical academics, including professor Wojciech Sadurski, continue despite an earlier answer that a prosecution was withdrawn. The government replied that the earlier answer concerned threatened prosecutions against jurists, that the Sadurski case concerns private and party complaints over a tweet and remains with the Polish courts, and that it will monitor the case and raise rule-of-law concerns in EU and bilateral channels.
It does not befit the Netherlands to actively interfere in cases that are still before the courts and/or to make statements about them.
Het past Nederland niet om zich actief te mengen in zaken die nog onder de rechter zijn en/of daarover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over procedeergedrag van de Rijksoverheid

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about rising spending on the state's external lawyer (landsadvocaat) and government procedural behaviour, and whether the government will reduce it. The minister answered with a multi-year table of spending by ministry, attributed the rise to complex and incident-driven cases, explained that the state uses external lawyers mainly in mandatory civil proceedings, and said the government will curb unnecessary litigation without committing to specific new steps.
It is difficult to say why the costs of hiring the state's lawyer were higher in 2018 than in previous years.
Het is moeilijk aan te geven waarom de kosten van inhuur van de landsadvocaat in 2018 hoger zijn uitgevallen dan in voorgaande jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mediterranean will be 'sea of blood' without rescue boats, UN warns’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about a UN warning that the Mediterranean would become a 'sea of blood' without rescue boats, and about related asylum trends and deaths at sea. The government answered that causal links between NGO rescue ships and drowning are hard to show, that the EU is discussing disembarkation and longer-term measures, and that Operation Sophia's mandate does not include rescue.
Such causal links are difficult to demonstrate.
Dergelijke oorzakelijke verbanden zijn lastig aan te tonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Opvangkampen op Samos een hel: dit niet eerder gezien’

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked the state secretary about reports of overcrowded and inhumane camps on Samos, including lack of electricity, water and toilets, long asylum waiting times, and EU funding and NGO support. The government acknowledged the problems, said Greece bears primary responsibility, and pointed to Dutch expert support and the new Greek government's priorities without committing to new funding.
Progress on this support will be reported to your House separately.
Over de voortgang van deze steun wordt uw Kamer separaat geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Dam over advocaten die stoppen met rechtsbijstand

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Minister for Legal Protection about lawyers quitting legal aid, especially youth criminal duty (piket) work, due to low fees and the new juvenile suspect rules. The Minister acknowledged the signals, reported declining registered lawyers and piket participation, and pointed to a fee measure, a €10 million innovation fund and the ongoing system reform as responses.
As Minister for Legal Protection I bear responsibility for a sufficient supply of lawyers, including by providing reasonable remuneration for the work to be performed.

Als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming draag ik een verantwoordelijkheid voor een voldoende aanbod van advocaten, onder meer door het bieden van een redelijke vergoeding voor te verrichten werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Oeigoeren in Europese landen worden onder druk gezet door de Chinese overheid’

Two D66 MPs asked the government whether reports that Uyghurs in Europe, including the Netherlands, are pressured and intimidated by Chinese authorities are true, and what protection, asylum figures, extradition practice and diplomatic action exist. The government confirms that such pressure is reported and calls unwanted foreign interference unacceptable, lists available protective tools and recent diplomatic efforts, but gives no statistics on Uyghur asylum applications (sensitive data) and no concrete new action.
Therefore this data is not registered in a way that makes it possible to generate an answer to this question from the automated information systems of the migration chain.
Daarom worden deze gegevens niet geregistreerd op een manier die het mogelijk maakt om een antwoord op deze vraag te genereren vanuit de geautomatiseerde informatiesystemen van de migratieketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het bericht dat Justitie de integriteitsproblemen te lijf gaat met een tarotlezeres

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice about a press report that the ministry used a tarot reader in a 'Week of Unblemished Conduct' integrity programme, and whether such activities were justified. The minister defended the week as a way to make integrity discussable, gave its costs and themes, said such sessions will recur, and rejected the complaints by anonymous officials while acknowledging the top must set the example.
Next year there will again be a Week of Unblemished Conduct organised.
Volgend jaar zal er weer een Week van het Onbesproken Gedrag georganiseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over onevenredige consequenties van het strafblad

An MP asked the Justice Minister about disproportionate consequences of criminal records, including a case where a settlement for a sexual offence stayed on a doctor's record and questions on police interrogation pressure, OM transaction offers and VOG implications. The Minister explained the objection procedure under the WJsg (art. 26) decided by Justid with appeal possible, said OM cannot amend records, and declined to comment on individual cases.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over het bericht dat bedrijven feitenonderzoek kunnen doen naar fraude en corruptie

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether companies investigating their own fraud and corruption, with lawyers they hire, is acceptable and how it is controlled, including sentence reductions, transparency and the lawyers' privilege. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the OM and FIOD check such investigations for depth, completeness and accuracy, that the OM does not register the number of cases involving company-led investigations, and that transactions are published with a press release and fact summary.
The number of cases in which company-led fact-finding into fraud and/or corruption played any role is not registered as such by the OM.
Het aantal zaken waarin het feitenonderzoek naar fraude en/of corruptie door bedrijven op enigerlei wijze een rol heeft gespeeld, wordt niet als zodanig geregistreerd bij het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over de toepassing van de nieuwe werkinstructie voor de beoordeling van lhbti’s en bekeerlingen

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked the State Secretary about criticism from COC and Stichting Gave of the IND's new guidelines for assessing LGBTI and convert asylum claims, including use of 'self-acceptance' criteria, stereotyping, third-party statements, passive conversion and expectations about religious study. The State Secretary largely rejected the criticism, stating the guidelines are applied correctly, that the concepts were dropped but may still arise, and that existing cases need not be reassessed except via new facts or the motion-based repeat-application route.
However, I do not rule out that errors are occasionally made.
Ik sluit echter niet uit dat er af en toe fouten worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over proces- en vonnisafspraken

The MP asks whether the Public Prosecution Service deliberately experimented with procedural agreements in a criminal case, how the handover failure was handled, and whether a legal basis and a more active policy approach are needed. The Minister says the agreements were not meant as an experiment, transparency was maintained, and a broader inventory and discussion with stakeholders is underway without committing to specific legislation.
The Public Prosecution Service has been transparent about the procedural agreements made with the defence.
Het OM is transparant geweest over de gemaakte procesafspraken met de verdediging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het  bericht “Deportaties in Turkije: ‘Ze hebben hem  naar Syrië gestuurd’”

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the government about reports that Turkey deported Syrian refugees to Syria, a country not considered safe, and about the implications for the EU-Turkey agreement and for Greek arrivals. The State Secretary answered that Turkey claims returns are voluntary, that about 340,000 Syrians have returned, that international partners could not confirm structural forced returns though a few individual cases suggest involuntary returns, and that no direct link to Greek arrivals can be concluded.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the developments.
Nederland blijft de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de onrust op het ministerie naar aanleiding van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in de WODC-affaire

Opposition MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked Justice Minister Grapperhaus about the works council's criticism of the ministry's criminal complaint over a leak in the WODC affair, and about interviews of staff by the deputy Secretary-General looking for leakers. The minister defended the complaint as not contrary to the whistleblower scheme, admitted the interviews should not have covered the subject under criminal investigation and that the deputy SG resigned, but gave no records and did not rule out other leak inquiries.
Those conversations therefore should not have been held on that subject.
Deze gesprekken hadden daarom over dat onderwerp niet moeten worden gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over ‘Amper beleid bij forse groei buurtpreventie door burgers'

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the rapid growth of neighbourhood watch apps and patrol teams and the lack of national rules or oversight of them. The minister answered that municipalities handle this locally, that citizens may act within legal limits, that no incident or crime-reduction overview exists, and that the issues (including ethnic profiling and vigilantism) will be raised with the VNG and Interior Ministry.
Vigilantism by citizens cannot be tolerated.
Eigenrichting door burgers kan niet worden getolereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de uitzetting van de heer Isbatov

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the deportation of an asylum seeker to Azerbaijan who was reportedly arrested there, including whether his arrest related to political activities and whether the IND's political-asylum assessments are adequate. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, said the Dutch asylum procedure is careful, saw no need for concrete improvements, and noted that no statistics on political asylum motives are registered.
As your House is aware, I cannot make statements about individual cases in connection with the privacy of the person concerned.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend, kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over hoe de sterke zekerheidsrechtelijke positie van banken alternatieve financiers belemmert

MPs Sneller, Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked whether banks' strong security positions in bankruptcy and the ban on pledging assets hinder alternative lenders, and whether the government will investigate, legislate or address this in the bankruptcy law revision. The minister answered that a study of Dutch financing practice will be commissioned, that the bankruptcy law revision is examining secured creditors' position, and that the bill to lift pledging bans will go to the Council of State shortly after the summer recess.
We are willing to commission a study into this, which will also address collateral provision in SME financing, in view of the motion adopted by your House on 18 June.

Wij zijn bereid om een opdracht tot een onderzoek daarnaar te geven, waarbij tevens, mede gelet op de op 18 juni door Uw Kamer aangenomen motie, 2 de zekerheidsstelling bij MKB-financiering aan de orde zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Polen sleept kritische juristen voor de rechter’

MPs Verhoeven and Groothuizen asked the ministers about reports that Poland was prosecuting critical academics, the rule-of-law procedure against Poland, and the Commission's rule-of-law communication. The government answered that the threatened prosecution was dropped, that it will voice concern about Poland's rule of law at EU level, and that it will study the Commission's proposals before reporting further.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Honderd Cubanen lopen illegale mars voor homorechten: 'Historisch moment'’

MPs Groothuizen and Bergkamp asked about reports that Cuban police arrested demonstrators at an unauthorised LGBTI rights march, and whether this changes the Dutch policy that LGBTI Cubans can generally return safely, including questions on monitoring, Cuban returnees, asylum statistics and a new country report. The government regrets the arrests and violence, says there is no reason to change policy since discrimination is not systematic enough to amount to persecution, will raise the issue with Cuban authorities, and holds that sufficient reliable information exists so no new thematic country report is needed.
I therefore cannot confirm these reports.
Ik kan berichtgeving hierover dan ook niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de uitvoering van de gewijzigde motie over een jaarlijkse rapportage over migratie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether she recalled promising an annual report on progress under the cabinet's migration agenda, and when the report would arrive, including whether it could be sent a month before the budget debate. The State Secretary confirmed the promise, agreed that sending it a month before the budget debate is valuable, and said the report will be sent as soon as possible after the summer recess.
Your House will receive the annual report as soon as possible after the summer recess.
Uw Kamer ontvangt de jaarlijkse rapportage zo snel mogelijk na het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Nederland stuurt Yezidi’s terug naar de tentenkampen en dat is tegen de eigen regels zeggen advocaten’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the IND returns Yezidi asylum seekers to Iraqi Kurdistan camps that the UNHCR considers unsafe, and how it assesses conditions there. The State Secretary answered that cases are assessed individually, that Yezidis displaced from other parts of Iraq are now treated as coming from Central Iraq under the vulnerable minorities policy, and that the ministry will review the position in the next country report.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to pay extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi's
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de VOG als verdienmodel

Groothuizen (D66) asked whether private firms charging more than the official VOG fee, and the fact that only applicants can request a VOG, should prompt tighter rules. The minister said the services are acceptable, that direct digital application is cheaper, and that Justis is studying ways to reduce administrative burden, without announcing new rules.
I will examine whether the communication on this is sufficiently clear.
Ik zal bekijken of de communicatie hieromtrent voldoende duidelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over het bericht dat repressie niet meer voldoende is in drugsaanpak

MPs Bergkamp and Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice and Health ministers how they view claims that repression alone is insufficient for drug policy, including criminal recruitment into the drug market, the normalisation of drug use, and calls for evaluation or an expert commission. Minister Grapperhaus answered that Dutch policy balances health and justice, points to prevention measures, the ondermijning funding and a closed cannabis chain experiment, and declined to set up a commission.
Setting up a committee is therefore not, in my view, opportune.
Het in het leven roepen van een commissie acht ik dan ook niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de rapportage vreemdelingenketen 2018

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice Minister about the 2018 asylum chain report, including why serious crimes were filed under 'other' and why police and prosecution were gagged. The state secretary largely deferred to a pending evaluation, agreed that the nuance between suspect registration and conviction matters, and pointed to ongoing ministry change programmes.

As I indicated in my letter to the House of 1 July 2019, an evaluation of the preparation and decision-making process that led to the incident overview in the 2018 Asylum Chain Report is currently underway.

Zoals ik heb aangegeven in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 1 juli 2019 vindt op dit moment een evaluatie plaats van het proces van voorbereiding en besluitvorming dat heeft geleid tot incidentenoverzicht in de Rapportage Vreemdelingenketen 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de aanbesteding van het CJIB

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked about the CJIB tendering of debt collection to bailiffs, including who takes over existing debts, costs for debtors, the abandoned postcode-based allocation model, protection of debtors' interests and the link with the Rijksincassovisie. The minister answered that the minimum subsistence amount is reset after 12 months, bailiff tariffs are statutory and unchanged, the old arrondissement-based model was dropped in 2001 to promote competition, and tendering allows bundling of one debtor's claims and selection of bailiffs aligned with the Rijksincassovisie.
The CJIB is committed to socially responsible collection and enforcement in line with cabinet policy.
Het CJIB zet zich in voor het sociaal-maatschappelijk verantwoord innen en incasseren conform het kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over preventieve handhaving in het bestuursrecht

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the relationship between preventive enforcement tools under the General Administrative Law Act, including the herstelsanctie to prevent repetition and the preventive herstelsanctie, and their legal basis. The minister answered that both are distinct competences recognised in case law, explained the criteria for repetition and the one-year lifting request, and stated that the reparatory sanctions are not punitive for Article 6 ECHR purposes.
According to case law, these are two coexisting competences.
Blijkens de jurisprudentie betreft het twee naast elkaar bestaande bevoegdheden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Kuiken, Krol, Buitenweg en Van Nispen over de mogelijke betrokkenheid van de Minister in de strafzaak tegen het lid Wilders

MPs from D66, SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and 50PLUS asked the Minister of Justice about possible contacts between his predecessor Opstelten or ministry staff and the Public Prosecution Service over the case against MP Wilders, including a timeline of contacts and why ambtsberichten are kept confidential. The Minister says he cannot vouch for all contacts, will not comment on individual prosecutions, and provides a partial timeline with confidentiality grounds for withholding the advisory reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het bericht dat er nu toch een strafrechtelijk onderzoek loopt naar de klokkenluiders van de WODC-affaire

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen ask why a criminal investigation now targets the sources of journalists in the WODC affair, after the minister earlier praised the whistleblower and why the ministry filed a complaint only in this case. The minister answers that the public prosecutor found grounds for investigation, that the ministry was obliged to file the complaint under the official secrecy provisions, and that the whistleblower deserves protection while leaking of confidential information is unacceptable.
As Minister of Justice and Security I have no involvement in individual criminal cases.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid heb ik geen bemoeienis met individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VN: 1.500 migranten in levensgevaar in Libië’

Four MPs asked the government about reports that about 1,500 migrants held in detention centres south of Tripoli were in danger from fighting, and about the evacuation of detainees, reports of forced participation in the conflict, and possible Dutch action. The ministers answered that the Netherlands is following the situation closely, supports UNHCR and IOM evacuations and resettlement via the Emergency Transit Mechanism, is considering additional funding, and says forced use of civilians in fighting would violate international humanitarian law, while the forced-participation reports were not confirmed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de benoeming van een bestuurder bij FPA Roosenburg

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why he was not actively informed about the appointment of a former prison care director as board member of a forensic care provider, how this fits with the needed culture change in forensic care, and what influence he has over such appointments. The minister answered that the board appointment was public after the provider announced it, that he steers private providers on quality and performance rather than personnel policy, and that a multi-year culture-change programme is being pursued with the sector.
Your House is generally not actively informed about appointments of board members at forensic institutions.
Uw Kamer wordt in zijn algemeenheid niet actief geïnformeerd over benoemingen van bestuurders bij forensische instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Buitenweg, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht Boek over politieonderzoek Nicole van den Hurk moet worden aangepast

MPs asked about a court ruling that a book on the police investigation into Nicole van den Hurk must be amended to protect relatives' privacy, and about how the police and prosecution service handle media contracts and embedded journalists. The minister admits errors were made, says the relatives were informed late, outlines a revised media guideline and standard contract, and says a Slachtofferhulp study will report by end 2019.
Errors were made. In weighing the public interest in openness against the protection of the relatives' privacy, insufficient attention was paid to the latter.

Er zijn fouten gemaakt. Bij de afweging tussen het maatschappelijk belang van openheid aan de ene kant en de bescherming van de privacy van de nabestaanden aan de andere kant is onvoldoende oog geweest voor het laatste.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het artikel ‘Nieuwe procedure voor benoemingen topstructuur OM’

MPs Van Dam and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about a new OM procedure for appointing top prosecution posts, including whether it opens recruitment from outside and promotes diversity and rotation. The minister answered that the procedure was agreed with the central works council, that vacancies are opened more widely with external advisory committees, and that the Fokkens report was sent to parliament on 25 April.
A new element is that the committees are supported by an external process facilitator.
Een nieuw element is dat de commissies worden begeleid door een externe procesbegeleider.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Reddingsschip Sea-Watch mag voorlopig weer uitvaren na winst rechtszaak’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government will handle the Sea-Watch 3 rescue ship dispute after a court ruling, and whether it will negotiate a transition period and clarify the requirements. The minister answered that the court upheld the regulation, set a suspension until 15 August 2019 for this vessel, and that talks on clarifying the requirements are ongoing, with the government committing to provide clarity itself if talks fail.
The court ruled that the regulation for vessels that systematically take drowning people on board is lawful and remains in force.
De rechter heeft geoordeeld dat de regeling voor schepen die stelselmatig drenkelingen aan boord nemen rechtmatig is en in stand blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Laan-Geselschap, Groothuizen en Van Dam over de procedure en de capaciteit bij het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

MPs asked about budget problems at the Council of Europe and the European Court of Human Rights, the reopening of Dutch criminal cases after a unilateral state acknowledgement of a Convention breach, and extra staff for Dutch cases at the Court. The minister said the Netherlands must meet its payment obligations and wants the Court spared from cuts, that the government will examine whether the reopening rules need amending, and that talks are underway on extra support for the Court's registry.

In view of this, I will examine whether amending the statutory provisions is necessary and desirable to ensure that revision is possible on the basis of a decision by the ECtHR following a unilateral government declaration that the Convention has been breached.

Gelet hierop zal ik bezien of aanpassing van de wettelijke regeling nodig en gewenst is om te verzekeren dat herziening mogelijk is op grond van de beslissing door het EHRM na een eenzijdige verklaring van de regering dat het verdrag is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Groothuizen over het artikel ‘Tweede ondernemer zwicht na dreigbrief van windmolenactivisten: 'U krijgt 48 uur'’

MPs Sienot and Groothuizen asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about a newspaper report of a second entrepreneur giving in to threats from wind-turbine activists, and what the government does against intimidation and to protect businesses. Minister Grapperhaus answered that intimidation is unacceptable, that police do not record wind-related offences separately, that local protest is largely lawful, and that businesses are primarily responsible for their own security with local authorities adding measures when risk warrants, while pointing to regional energy strategies and co-ownership to build support.
As previously indicated in answers to parliamentary questions, offences committed in relation to wind turbines are not registered by the police under a separate code.
Antwoord 3 Zoals eerder aangegeven in de beantwoording van Kamervragen 2 , worden delicten die worden gepleegd in relatie tot windmolens door de politie niet geregistreerd onder een aparte code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de aanbesteding van het CJIB

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked whether a new CJIB tender for bailiff debt collection contradicts the Rijksincassovisie, why it was started, and whether debtors bear extra costs when a new bailiff must re-establish the debt. The minister denied any conflict with the policy vision, explained the tender is needed because current two-year contracts are ending, and said ongoing files stay with the original bailiff.
No, the tender round does not conflict with the Rijksincassovisie.
Nee, de aanbestedingsronde is niet in strijd met de Rijksincassovisie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over reclassering voor veroordeelde bedrijven

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice Minister about a probation-style improvement programme for convicted companies, drawing on US and UK monitor arrangements, and whether companies that self-report could get lower fines. The minister was positive in principle, said the current Dutch transaction rules do not allow compliance conditions, and promised to explore an explicit high-transaction regulation including compliance and judicial involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het bericht 'Het nieuwe bekostigingssysteem van het Openbaar Ministerie'

MPs Van Dam and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the new funding system for the Public Prosecution Service, covering how TGO teams are financed, whether a time-recording study is planned, how surplus or shortfall in output is handled, open-ended budgets and innovation costs. The minister answered in detail, explaining the lump-sum versus product funding split, that a time-recording study may be considered, the reserve mechanism, and that special budgets are monitored closely.

For that reason, the OM and I will certainly consider whether a time-recording study – weighing the necessary costs and time burden for those involved – has sufficient added value for the price negotiations.

Om die reden zullen het OM en ik zeker bezien of een tijdschrijfonderzoek – daarbij meewegend de noodzakelijke kosten en tijdbeslag van betrokkenen – voldoende toegevoegde waarde heeft voor de prijsonderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het opleggen van strafbeschikkingen

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security, in 12 questions, about whether staff at the central OM processing centre (CVOM) had lacked legal competence to issue criminal penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen) before a 2017 statutory amendment. The minister answered that a formal defect in delegation existed before the amendment, that the orders were in substance issued by qualified prosecutors and staff, and that the defect was remedied by the 2017 law effective 1 January 2019.

Regarding the passage in section 4.6, stating that no indications were found of decisions taken without authority, the report considers that there is little reason to assume that in those cases OM criminal penalty orders were issued by persons who were not public prosecutors, prosecution secretaries or AJM staff.

Met betrekking tot de passage in paragraaf 4.6, waarin wordt gesteld dat geen aanwijzingen zijn gevonden voor onbevoegd genomen beslissingen, wordt in het rapport overwogen dat er weinig reden is te veronderstellen dat in die gevallen OM-strafbeschikkingen door personen zijn uitgevaardigd die geen officier van justitie, parketsecretaris of AJM’er waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Sjoerdsma over een oppositieleider die vastzit in een Tadzjiekse gevangenis

MPs from D66 asked the government about opposition leader Gadojev, detained in Tajikistan after apparently being arrested in Russia, and whether Interpol listings are being misused against political critics. The government replied that Gadojev returned to the Netherlands with consular help via the German embassy, that Interpol's rules forbid political interventions but full guarantees cannot be given, and that human rights are raised regularly in bilateral and multilateral settings.
However, I cannot speculate on the circumstances in individual cases listed on the Interpol list.
Ik kan echter niet speculeren over de toedracht in individuele casussen die op de Interpol-lijst staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘IND voorkomt principiële uitspraak over staatlozen in Nederland’

An MP from D66 asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the IND and DT&V revised a statelessness case late, how responsibility is divided between them, how the burden of proof for statelessness registration works, and how other EU countries handle residence for stateless people. The State Secretary answers that the DT&V assesses individual circumstances under the buitenschuld policy, that stateless persons are not automatically entitled to a residence permit, that municipalities are cautious in registering statelessness in the BRP, and that practice varies across the EU, referring to attached reports.
There is no referral to the buitenschuld procedure.
Er is geen sprake van een doorverwijzing naar de buitenschuldprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over het bericht dat Friese gezinnen op straat zijn gezet om een wietplantje

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior whether families evicted over a single cannabis plant in Friesland were disproportionately treated and whether a zero-tolerance policy could exempt small home growers. The minister said proportionality is for the courts (kantonrechter) to judge in individual cases and that local housing corporations and municipalities decide on zero-tolerance policies, so no new national change was committed.
Prior to any eviction from a home, it is always up to the sub-district court judge to assess whether a landlord may proceed.
Het is voorafgaand aan een woningontruiming altijd aan de kantonrechter om te beoordelen of een verhuurder hiertoe kan overgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Pon-affaire op herhaling’

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked about reports of a new complaint over a tender by the national police, and about the capacity, workload and prioritisation of the Rijksrecherche. Minister Grapperhaus answered that a new complaint was taken up in September 2018 and handed to the Rijksrecherche in December 2018, that capacity has been a long-standing constraint, and that integrity policy is being strengthened.

After a thorough analysis of the new complaint and review of the extensive documents later submitted, the Public Prosecution Service, in consultation with the Rijksrecherche, decided in September 2018 to take up the complaint.

Na een uitvoerige analyse van de nieuwe aangifte en na bestudering van de naderhand toegezonden omvangrijke stukken, heeft het Openbaar Ministerie in afstemming met de Rijksrecherche in september 2018 besloten de aangifte op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Europa stopt met oppikken van vluchtelingen op Middellandse Zee’

An MP asked whether EU operation Sophia in the Mediterranean was being halted, who would take over its work, how monitoring of the Libyan coast guard and rights compliance is ensured, and what the consequences of stopping it would be for migrant rescue and smuggling. The minister answered that Sophia is not stopped but its mandate was extended unchanged for six months, with the two ships recalled to port and surveillance and Libyan coast guard support strengthened, and that the government will keep monitoring the Libyan coast guard critically.
Operation Sophia has not been halted.
De operatie Sophia is niet stilgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Uitgezette Bahreini zonder eerlijk proces veroordeeld tot levenslang’

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked the State Secretary about reports that a deported Bahraini asylum seeker was sentenced to life imprisonment after an unfair trial, including questions on torture reports, monitoring, Sudan deportations and independent investigation. The government answered that it monitors the case via the Kuwait embassy, cannot confirm torture reports, declines an independent inquiry and deportation suspension, and says it will request an updated Sudan country report.
Out of respect for private life, I am not free to make individual facts and circumstances from an asylum file public.
Met het oog op de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, ben ik niet vrij individuele feiten en omstandigheden uit een asieldossier in de openbaarheid te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over levenslang gestraften

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a court order to submit a pardon request of a life-sentenced prisoner to the Crown, delays in pardon procedures, information gathering, victim involvement and the minister's remarks on life sentences. The minister answered that pardon procedures have no fixed deadlines, that information is adequately secured, and that the policy on life sentences complies with European human rights case law.
In the context of protecting the privacy of those involved, I can only inform the House that I take the handling of every pardon request, including the one concerned, seriously
In het kader van de bescherming van de privacy van betrokkenen, kan ik uw Kamer slechts melden dat ik de behandeling van elk gratieverzoek, zo ook het betreffende gratieverzoek, serieus neem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de praktijk van het opleggen van een strafbeschikking door het OM

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister of Justice how the public prosecution service (OM) delegates to staff the power to impose penal orders (strafbeschikking), how supervision by prosecutors works, and how often delegation was wrongly granted. Minister Grapperhaus answered that delegation follows legal rules and differs by function group and case type, that supervision is general in nature with case-specific pre-consultation, and that no cases of wrongful delegation are known in the past three years.
In the past three years, no cases are known in which delegation to OM staff was wrongly granted.
In de afgelopen drie jaar zijn geen gevallen bekend waarin ten onrechte aan medewerkers van het OM is gemandateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over de Rapportage Vreemdelingenketen januari-juni 2018

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked about the 2018 resettlement quota, missions, Turkey-related resettlement and selection withdrawals. The State Secretary reported about 610 selections and 530 arrivals under the national quota, cut the 2019 quota to 500, and admitted earlier Turkey figures in the Rapportage were wrong.
The national quota you ask about is part of the multi-year resettlement policy framework 2016–2019.
Het nationale quotum waarnaar wordt gevraagd maakt deel uit van het meerjarig beleidskader hervestiging 2016–2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Deze gastarbeiders zijn oud in een land dat een tussenstop had moeten zijn’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about reports that older guest workers face poorer health, reduced AOW pensions, and low remigration uptake, and what support or follow-up is planned. The government answered that it cannot precisely estimate pension counts, that AOW reductions average about 32.5% falling to 27.8%, that care is meant to be person-centred with programmes like Langer Thuis and Een tegen Eenzaamheid, and that remigration uptake may be affected by pension levels, family ties and health care in the origin country.
