I have instructed that the knowledge gained about what works and what does not be bundled.
Ik heb opdracht gegeven om de geleerde kennis over wat werkt en wat niet te bundelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en lid Groothuizen over ‘het nieuwe bekostigingssysteem van het Openbaar Ministerie’

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about the new funding system for the Public Prosecution Service (OM), including the output/lump-sum split, treatment of innovation and overtime costs, whether a time-recording study was done, and evaluation plans. The minister answered that about 43% of the OM budget is output-funded, that no time-recording study underpinned the system, and that a periodic evaluation including staff input will be carried out.
The system provides for periodic evaluation. This will be taken up jointly by the OM and the department.
Het systeem voorziet in een periodieke evaluatie. Dit zal door het OM en het departement gezamenlijk worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het rapport ‘Vulnerable and abandoned’ van Oxfam Novib

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked the government about the Oxfam Novib report on vulnerable refugees on the Greek islands, covering medical care, vulnerability screening, EU expert deployment, detention conditions, safety of women and children, and EU funding. The State Secretary acknowledges shortcomings in medical staffing and reception, outlines the vulnerability procedures and expert numbers, and says the government will keep raising the issue with Greece and the Commission, without disclosing the content of diplomatic talks.
Given the confidentiality of diplomatic communications, I cannot go into the remarks of my Greek colleague.
In het kader van de vertrouwelijkheid van het diplomatieke verkeer, kan ik niet ingaan op de uitlatingen van mijn Griekse collega.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Diertens en Bouali over het bericht 'Caribische eilanden kunnen grotere toestroom Venezolanen verwachten'

MPs Groothuizen, Diertens and Bouali asked whether UNHCR projections of a rising Venezuelan refugee flow to the Caribbean reflect a real threat, and about funding, detention, asylum procedures and rights on Aruba and Curaçao. The government answered that the UNHCR figures cover the wider Caribbean, that interceptions fell in 2018, that Curaçao has requested assistance on detention and the asylum procedure, and that asylum applications are assessed individually.

The Ministry of Justice and Security asks the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a country report when a high number of asylum applications from nationals of a given country is lodged in the Netherlands.

Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid vraagt het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken om een ambtsbericht als er in Nederland een hoog aantal asielaanvragen wordt ingediend van personen uit een bepaald land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over incassobonussen van deurwaarders voor grote klanten

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about bonus arrangements between bailiffs and large creditors such as insurers and energy companies, and whether these threaten bailiff independence. The minister acknowledges the risk, notes the financial supervisor BFT is investigating, points to a forthcoming KBvG regulation limiting tariff models and the Oskam committee report, and describes the CJIB's upcoming tender and the Rijksincassovisie.
This earnings model may pose a risk to the independence of the bailiff.
Dit verdienmodel is mogelijk een risico voor de onafhankelijkheid van de gerechtsdeurwaarder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht 'Huizen zijn er wel, statushouders niet'

MPs Groothuizen and Paternotte asked the State Secretary why about 3,000 refugee status holders were housed less than the 22,000 target in 2018, why Den Bosch received fewer matches than its target, and whether municipalities are blamed for shortfalls caused by COA allocation. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortfall of 2,934, attributed it mainly to the housing market, COA matching criteria and family reunification, and said municipalities are not penalised for unmet targets that carry over to the next period.

I rely on effective enforcement by the supervisory body toward the municipalities concerned and on COA deploying smart allocation of the available permit holders to those municipalities that received too few matches in 2018.

Ik reken daarbij op effectieve handhaving door de toezichthouder ten aanzien van bedoelde gemeenten en de inzet van het COA bij het slim verdelen van de beschikbare vergunninghouders over die gemeenten die in 2018 te weinig koppelingen hebben gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht dat het kinderspel is om bedrijven lam te leggen met beslag

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that conservatory seizures can cripple businesses, requesting case figures, the balance of burdens between creditor and debtor, and whether debtors should be heard earlier. The minister gave court statistics, explained the existing safeguards (judge's assessment, opposition procedure, damages), said the courts do not keep the requested data, and said a bill to bar seizure as a mere pressure tool is pending before the Council of State.
There are no figures known on the number of cases in which the seizure was lifted in summary proceedings.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het aantal gevallen waarin het beslag is opgeheven in kortgeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de praktijk van het opleggen van een strafbeschikking door het OM

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister of Justice about OM penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen): backlogs causing non-admissibility claims, funding, quality problems, criminal records without proper guilt establishment, statistics on objections, staff levels and clarity of CJIB letters. Minister Grapperhaus answered substantively on most points, acknowledging implementation problems, providing figures and committing to revise CJIB letters with the OM in early 2019.
It is important that the OM continues to prioritise improving quality and, through measurements and audits, measures the effect of the measures taken.
Het is van belang dat het OM blijvend prioriteit geeft aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit en door middel van metingen en audits het effect meet van de genomen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over gouden paspoorten en visa

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked whether golden passports and golden visas, which let wealthy investors obtain EU residence or citizenship, pose crime and terrorism risks and whether the Netherlands should abolish its investor residence permit. The government acknowledged the risk if screening is inadequate, said Dutch investor permits are strictly checked, and promised an evaluation of the Modern Migration Policy Act in Q2 2019 and participation in EU-level discussion.
Based on this evaluation, it can in due course be assessed whether it is desirable to adjust admission schemes.
Op basis van deze evaluatie kan te zijner tijd worden beoordeeld of het wenselijk is dat toelatingsregelingen worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de gevolgen van recente ontwikkelingen in de verhouding tussen Nederland en Iran voor het Nederlandse asielbeleid ten aanzien van Iran

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how recent tensions with Iran, including reported Iranian involvement in killings in the Netherlands, affect Dutch asylum policy on Iran, including asylum numbers, risk groups and the Ahwazi. The State Secretary answered with asylum statistics, said the policy rests on the 2017 general country report and the individual assessment, and saw no reason to change the Iran country policy now.
I expect that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will publish the new general country report on Iran in the spring.
Ik verwacht dat het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in het voorjaar het nieuwe algemeen ambtsbericht over Iran publiceert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'IND ontbreekt vaak in de rechtszaal bij zaken afgewezen asielzoekers'

An MP asked the State Secretary why the IND (immigration service) is absent from roughly 75% of asylum hearings and how this relates to its waiting-time problems and staffing. The State Secretary answered that the IND attends hearings in most cases but sends written positions in about 20% of cases, that absence does not automatically delay cases, and outlined recruitment and personnel planning measures.
In these cases a judgment was made not to attend the hearing and a written position was submitted.
In deze gevallen is een afweging gemaakt om niet ter zitting aanwezig te zijn en is een schriftelijk standpunt ingestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht 'Asielzoeker uit Bahrein na gedwongen vertrek uit Nederland meteen gearresteerd'

Two MPs asked whether the Netherlands deported a Bahraini asylum seeker who was arrested on arrival, and about his legal status, access to counsel, risk groups and whether deportations to Bahrain should be suspended. The Secretary of State declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy, held that the general asylum framework and sources suffice, saw no reason for a moratorium or an Inspectorate investigation, and promised only to monitor developments.
As your House is aware, for privacy reasons relating to the person concerned I cannot comment on individual cases and possible deportations.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken en eventuele uitzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de staat van het notariaat

A D66 MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about disciplinary sanctions against notaries, including the publication of reprimands and warnings, a decline in trust since 2005, rising severity of sanctions, accessibility and fees, and quality under market liberalisation. The minister answered that the legal system for publishing disciplinary rulings is adequate, that no clear trend in disciplinary cases or sanction severity exists, that trust has not measurably declined, and that the BFT supervision evaluation was largely positive.
Yes, I believe the legal system is adequate.
Ja, ik meen dat het wettelijk systeem toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Van Ojik over het rapport ‘Extra beschermd of extra beschadigd?’

MPs asked the State Secretary about a report finding that disabled and seriously ill children in asylum procedures and reception centres are not protected under UN child and disability treaties, and how the IND's medical assessments differ from treating doctors' views. The State Secretary responded that COA adapts housing and care case by case, that medical permits follow a separate IND/BMA assessment with discretionary power, and that individual cases are not addressed.
From that standpoint I cannot answer your question.
Ik kan uw vraag vanuit dat oogpunt dus niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over overlast en geweld door bepaalde groepen asielzoekers in asielzoekerscentra

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked the State Secretary about reports that a group of young men from Morocco and Algeria placed in the Beverwaard asylum centre caused rising nuisance and violence, including whether COA staff avoid intervening, how placement in the special supervision location works, and why return of safe-country asylum seekers is problematic. The State Secretary confirmed the placement and rising police involvement, said COA and partners share information and apply tailored measures, and pointed to existing return cooperation efforts and capacity of 100 places, largely without new commitments.
When placing people, COA applies the principle of spreading groups and, together with partners, works to adequately deploy available measures to ensure manageability and safety at locations.

Het COA hanteert bij plaatsing het uitgangspunt van spreiding van groepen en zet daarnaast, samen met betrokken partijen, in op adequate inzet van beschikbare maatregelen om de beheersbaarheid en veiligheid op locaties te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Groothuizen over het verdwijnen van Vietnamese minderjarigen uit opvanglocaties

MPs Bouali and Groothuizen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the disappearance of Vietnamese unaccompanied minors from reception locations, including whether the protocol will be revised and whether prosecutors will start a people-smuggling investigation. The State Secretary gave yearly figures (7 to 31 per year, 13 in 2018), said the protocol is being updated, and stated that no criminal facts have been established and the Public Prosecution Service assesses signals case by case without commenting on ongoing investigations.
The protocol no longer matches current work processes and is therefore being updated at this time.
Het protocol komt niet meer overeen met de huidige werkprocessen en wordt daarom op dit moment geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht  van Vluchtelingenwerk dat asielcentra vol zitten door het personeelstekort bij de IND

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that asylum centres are full due to IND staff shortages, long waiting times (especially in the extended asylum procedure), redeployment of IND staff, and whether flexible asylum system work has enough priority. The State Secretary answered that about 200 extra FTE are being recruited, that longer processing times in the extended procedure are expected to persist into 2019, and that the IND needs flexibility and better long-term staff planning.
Recently it was decided to open about 80 additional vacancies at the IND for processing asylum applications.
Onlangs is besloten om circa 80 vacatures extra bij de IND open te stellen voor het behandelen van asielaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘drugsdumpingen in Zuid-Nederland’

An MP from D66 asked the Ministers of Justice and Security and of Legal Protection about the rise in drug waste dumpings and synthetic drug labs in the south of the Netherlands, including police data, investigative capacity, legal instruments and the ondermijningskamer. The Minister answered with regional counts, explained limits in ERISSP registration and LFO capacity, and said existing laws are adequate and that a strategic advisory report is expected by year end.
I cannot go into this specific incident, because it forms part of operational information.
Ik kan niet ingaan op dit specifieke incident, omdat dit onderdeel is van operationele informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het rapport 'Opgesloten en uitgezet' van Amnesty International

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked the State Secretaries about the Amnesty report on detention and expulsion of Venezuelans in the Caribbean Kingdom islands, covering numbers, UNHCR registration, asylum procedures, detention conditions, and independent investigation. The government answered that Curaçao is responsible for its own asylum and detention matters, confirmed it will not commission independent investigations there, and offered only support for optimising Curaçao's Article 3 ECHR procedure.
The constitutional relations within the Kingdom do not allow me to unilaterally commission research into matters that concern an autonomous responsibility of the country of Curaçao.

De staatkundige verhoudingen binnen het Koninkrijk staan mij niet toe om eenzijdig onderzoek te laten verrichten naar zaken die betrekking hebben op een autonome verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Bouali over het bericht ‘Zorgen om verdwijnen van minderjarige asielzoekers’

MPs Groothuizen and Bouali asked about reports that unaccompanied minor asylum seekers are disappearing and falling victim to trafficking and sexual violence, and what measures prevent this. The State Secretary replied that protective reception measures, risk analyses and police notification have been strengthened and that the reception model is under evaluation, awaiting its outcome before further steps.
The asylum minors reception model is currently being evaluated. I look forward to the outcome of this study.
Op dit moment wordt het amv-opvangmodel geëvalueerd. Ik wacht graag de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Groothuizen over het artikel dat zestig moordzaken zouden zijn besmet door NFI-ruzie

MPs Van Oosten and Groothuizen asked whether about sixty murder cases were tainted by irregularities and internal conflict at the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI). The Minister replied that the figure was not confirmed, that an independent commission found six reports not or partly reviewed with no consequences for cases, and that corrective measures and a culture-change programme were underway.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Buitenweg en Groothuizen inzake het bericht ‘Het sluiten van woningen op grond van de Wet Damocles’

MPs Van Nispen, Buitenweg and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about closures of homes under article 13b of the Opium Act after a case where a tenant was evicted for 14 grams of cannabis. The minister said closure data are not centrally held, cited a study finding courts upheld appeals in 30% of published cases, noted a monitoring motion, and stated that closure is a measure to end violations rather than a punishment.
It is for the court to assess whether the mayor could reasonably use his closure power and, if so, whether the way the power was applied is proportionate.

Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de burgemeester in redelijkheid van zijn sluitingsbevoegdheid gebruik heeft kunnen maken en, zo ja, of de wijze waarop de bevoegdheid is toegepast evenredig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de beperkte openbaarheid van het Centraal Archief Bijzondere Rechtspleging

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Central Archive for Special Criminal Justice (CABR) is restricted from public access until 2025, how the advice of the Chief State Archivist shaped those restrictions, and whether copying and anonymising records could be eased. The Minister answered that restrictions protect personal privacy under data protection rules, that copies are generally not provided following a 2012 court ruling, and that the archive's document-based system does not allow anonymising records before viewing.
When the CABR was transferred in 2000, it was determined that, to protect the privacy of living persons, the archival records, inventory and access tools were not to be public before 1 January 2025.

Bij de overbrenging van het CABR is in 2000 bepaald dat, met het oog op de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van nog levende personen, de archiefbescheiden, alsmede de inventaris en de nadere toegangen (database en kaartsystemen) op dit archief niet openbaar zijn vóór 1 januari 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het onderzoek van de commissie Fokkens naar mogelijke integriteitsschendingen binnen de top van het openbaar ministerie

MPs Van Dam and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the delayed completion of the independent Fokkens inquiry into alleged integrity violations at the top of the Public Prosecution Service, and whether new facts or a wider circle of subjects explained the delay. The minister confirmed the delay is due to new documents and new reports prompting more interviews, but said the inquiry is independent and he will relay the parliament's wish for completion by year-end to the College of Procurators-General.
I will relay the wish of your House to the College.
Ik zal de wens van uw Kamer doorgeleiden naar het College.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over omkoping door Nederlandse bedrijven in het buitenland

An MP asked the government about bribery by Dutch companies abroad, the weak enforcement criticized by Transparency International, and the lack of independent judicial review and transparency of OM settlements (transacties). The Minister says enforcement has increased with new FIOD and OM capacity, and that the high-transaction practice and Aanwijzing will be reviewed and made more transparent within the Wet OM-afdoening evaluation.
At present the current practice is being reviewed.
Op dit moment wordt de huidige praktijk tegen het licht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht dat het COA te kampen heeft met overcapaciteit aan AZC's in Nederland

MPs Groothuizen and Paternotte asked about reports of overcapacity at COA reception centres and the criteria for closing them, including integration and municipal consultation. The State Secretary listed eleven affected locations, described COA's closure criteria and consultation with municipalities, and said a review of integration aspects is underway, though without committing to a specific new step.
To align reception capacity with the forecasts at the time, COA decided on 29 March 2018 to reduce reception capacity to 27,000 places.
Om de opvangcapaciteit in lijn te brengen met de toenmalige prognoses heeft het COA op 29 maart 2018 het besluit genomen de opvangcapaciteit terug te brengen tot 27.000 plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Libya keeps coast guards rejected by the EU'

MP Groothuizen asked whether Libyan coast guard personnel rejected by EU training screening remain employed, what the government will do to prevent smugglers joining, and how EU monitoring of the coast guard is being strengthened. The government replied that Libyan authorities are responsible for recruitment and vetting, that EU screening of trainees continues and monitoring has been added to the Sophia mandate, but that incidents cannot be excluded and monitoring is difficult.
Therefore, as the article also states, it is primarily up to the Libyans to vet their own people.
Daarmee is het, zoals ook in het artikel wordt gesteld, primair aan de Libiërs om hun eigen mensen te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het gebruik van handgranaten door criminelen als dreigmiddel

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security how often hand grenades were found at or exploded in business premises, whether mayors close premises after such finds, and whether criminals might use grenades to pressure entrepreneurs into closure. The minister reported 16 incidents with 9 explosions between 2017 and September 2018, said closure data is not registered, and stated that mayors decide case by case while local authorities set investigative priorities.
Can you indicate how often a mayor in the past two years has closed a business premises due to a hand grenade finding?
Vraag 2 Kunt u aangeven hoe vaak een burgemeester in de afgelopen twee jaren een pand van een onderneming heeft gesloten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht dat eenvijfde van de Syriërs wordt afgewezen vanwege extremistische of conservatieve denkbeelden

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether one-fifth of Syrian refugees nominated by UNHCR for resettlement from Turkey are rejected for extremist or conservative views, how the integration screening works, and about conditions in Greek camps. The State Secretary says the one-fifth figure conflates all rejection grounds, that conservative views alone are not a ground for refusal, and that integration screening does not reduce the national resettlement quota; the Greek camp questions were referred to earlier answers.
Holding conservative views is in itself not a ground for refusal.
Het hebben van conservatieve denkbeelden is op zichzelf geen grond voor weigering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over de bronbescherming van journalisten

MPs Groothuizen and Sneller asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service has adequately safeguarded internal procedures protecting journalists' source protection after recent cases where a journalist's call was wiretapped. The Minister answered that the directive is being updated to match the new source protection law, training will be expanded, and no extra measures are currently considered necessary.
The new directive will be widely communicated within the OM, and the OM's training courses will devote even more attention to this subject.
De nieuwe aanwijzing zal binnen het OM breed worden uitgedragen en in de leergangen van het OM zal nog meer aandacht worden besteed aan dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de regulering van rechtsbijstandverzekeringen

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the quality of legal aid provided by insurers' in-house jurists, self-regulation via the Verbond van Verzekeraars, the status of a motion on supervision of procedural legal advisers, and the free choice of lawyer after the Massar/DAS ruling. The minister answered that insurer quality is judged by the same civil standard as for lawyers, that a WODC evaluation found insurer-provided help rated best, that a study on supervision is being followed up, and that cost caps on external lawyers are for courts to assess.
Incidentally, the Verbond van Verzekeraars has no known signals that the stated cost maximum would be insufficient.
Bij het Verbond van Verzekeraars zijn overigens geen signalen bekend dat het gestelde kostenmaximum onvoldoende zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de inning van auteursrechten door collectieve beheersorganisaties

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about rising fees collected by collective rights organisations from small businesses for copyright use, the lack of clear justification, limited information for entrepreneurs, and whether oversight should be tightened. The minister acknowledged a single joint invoice has not yet been agreed, called on the organisations to act quickly, pointed to existing information channels, and said a bill strengthening the oversight body's powers is being prepared for submission in early 2019.
The cabinet aims for effective and efficient supervision of collective rights organisations.
Het kabinet streeft naar slagvaardig en doelmatig toezicht op cbo's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over de uitvoering van het Besluit zorgvuldig onderzoek verweesde werken

Two MPs from D66 asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security how Dutch archives may reproduce and publish copyrighted works, including online, and how the orphan works decree applies, in response to reports of municipal archives taking photos offline after a court ruling. The minister answers by setting out the copyright exceptions for archives and the orphan works diligence procedure, notes that no estimate exists for Dutch archives, and points to the EU EnDOW project and a pending EU proposal for extended collective licences as ways to reduce the administrative burden.
For the online publication of copyrighted standalone photographs, archives must in principle obtain permission from the relevant rightsholders.
Voor de online beschikbaarstelling van auteursrechtelijk beschermde losse foto's dienen archieven dus in beginsel toestemming van de desbetreffende rechthebbenden te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over het bericht 'Noodkreet Vluchtelingenwerk over retourtickets migranten'

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked about reports that the Netherlands is resuming Dublin transfers of asylum seekers to Greece and whether tickets were issued, and about reception conditions and Article 3 ECHR concerns. The State Secretary confirmed limited resumption of take-back claims for non-vulnerable persons, said no transfer decisions or tickets have been issued yet, and said individual guarantees from Greece will be assessed.
So far, none of the claims already sent have led to a decision that the asylum seeker must be transferred to Greece.
Vooralsnog hebben geen van de al verzonden claims geleid tot een besluit met de strekking dat de asielzoeker overgedragen dient te worden aan Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de uitzending van EenVandaag 'Meer homogeweld en veel zaken komen niet bij Openbaar Ministerie terecht'

MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked the Justice Minister about an EenVandaag report on rising anti-gay violence and low prosecution of such cases, requesting report and prosecution figures for 2016 and 2017. The minister answered with police, ADV, CRM and OM figures, rejected the claim of an increase in anti-gay violence, but acknowledged low reporting willingness and committed to contributing to an action plan against violence towards LHBTI people.
From the police and Public Prosecution Service reports on discrimination, it cannot be concluded that there is an increase in anti-gay violence, as EenVandaag claims.
Uit de rapportages van politie en Openbaar Ministerie over discriminatie kan niet worden afgeleid dat er sprake is van een toename van homogeweld, zoals EenVandaag stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over verstoorde verhoudingen in de top van het Openbaar Ministerie

An MP from D66 asked the Justice Minister about a criminal investigation into a former IAP secretary-general, the role of a prosecutor's attendance at an IAP congress in Bangkok, and whether the Board of Procurators General independently decided to transfer an official. The Minister confirmed the investigation is separate from the congress, said the Functioneel Parket's head attended at the Board's request, and referred the remaining questions to a pending committee inquiry.

Beyond that, the committee I mentioned in the answer to question 2 from MP Groothuizen (D66) on disrupted relations at the top of the Public Prosecution Service (submitted 17 May 2018, number 2018Z08990) can include this matter in its inquiry.

Voor het overige kan de commissie die ik noemde in het antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Groothuizen (D66) over verstoorde verhoudingen in de top van het Openbaar Ministerie (ingezonden op 17 mei 2018, nummer 2018Z08990 ) deze kwestie in haar onderzoek betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over integriteitsschendingen binnen het openbaar ministerie

MP Groothuizen asked whether a former member of the prosecution college's personnel portfolio contracted a firm where his younger sister was project manager, whether there was conflict of interest, who knew of the family tie, what the contract was worth, and whether the integrity commission would examine it. The minister confirmed a possible appearance of conflict of interest, said this should not have happened, and that the college asked the commission to investigate the contract's conclusion and extension, without answering the detailed questions on payments and internal knowledge.

For this reason, the College has asked the commission, as mentioned in the answer to question 2 from MP Groothuizen (D66) on disrupted relations at the top of the Public Prosecution Service (submitted 17 May 2018, number 2018Z08990), to investigate the course of events surrounding the conclusion and extension of the contract.

Daarom heeft het College de commissie, zoals genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Groothuizen (D66) over verstoorde verhoudingen in de top van het Openbaar Ministerie (ingezonden op 17 mei 2018, nummer 2018Z08990 ), gevraagd om de gang van zaken rondom de totstandkoming en de verlenging van de overeenkomst te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over verstoorde verhoudingen in de top van het Openbaar  Ministerie

MP Groothuizen asked the Minister of Justice about an alleged relationship between two senior prosecutors and whether integrity rules were breached and concealed. The Minister said the College of Procurators-General has commissioned an independent investigation, which will address the appointment, the handling of reports, and the integrity questions, and declined to answer substantively until its results are known.
The College of Procurators-General informed me that, following the reports, it has commissioned a broad independent investigation.
Het College van procureurs-generaal heeft mij meegedeeld naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving opdracht te hebben gegeven tot het uitvoeren van een breed onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de strijd tegen corruptie in Oekraïne

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the installation of wiretapping equipment by Ukraine's anti-corruption bureau NABU in the office of the special anti-corruption prosecutor and about threats to Ukraine's anti-corruption institutions. The minister answered that Nederland raises anti-corruption reform bilaterally and multilaterally, that Ukraine itself must prevent damage to its institutions, and that EU macro-financial aid conditions include a special anti-corruption high court.
I do not have sufficient information to form a judgement on this measure.
Ik beschik niet over voldoende informatie om een oordeel te vellen over deze maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over de pushbacks van vluchtelingen door Griekenland

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked whether Greece is pushing refugees back to Turkey without allowing asylum claims, whether this breaches the Refugee Convention, and whether the Netherlands will confront Greece about it. The Secretary of State says the government takes such reports seriously, that Greece denies pushbacks at its borders, and that the Commission is responsible for enforcing EU law, while listing EU and bilateral financial and personnel support to Greece.
Incidentally, it is primarily the responsibility of the European Commission to monitor the application of the EU acquis.
Overigens is het primair aan de Europese Commissie om toe te zien op de toepassing van het EU-acquis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het bericht dat particulieren steeds vaker een privédetective inhuren

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the growing use of private detectives by individuals, the number of private investigation agencies, the police's role in overseeing them, and risks to the rule of law. The minister answered that no objective growth figures exist, that agencies are licensed by Justis and supervised by police and the Data Protection Authority, that sanctions were rare, and that the police bear legal oversight responsibility while balancing capacity against other tasks.
Compliance with the applicable rules is supervised by the police. Self-regulation is therefore only one part of the overall package of control mechanisms for the private investigation sector.

Op het naleven van de gestelde regels wordt door de politie toezicht gehouden. Zelfregulering is derhalve slechts een onderdeel van het totale pakket aan controle mechanismen voor de sector van particuliere recherchebureaus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Groothuizen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik en Kuiken over het rapport van Amnesty over de situatie van migranten in Libië

MPs from five parties asked the government about Amnesty's report on abuses against migrants in Libya, including how to close detention centres, EU/Dutch support to Libyan authorities, UNHCR access, IOM return programmes, and the Libyan coast guard. The government answered that it presses Libya for better conditions and closure of centres, notes four centres closed, defends continued support to stabilise Libya, and says it has urged monitoring improvements while lacking evidence of transponder non-compliance.
The ultimate goal is to close these detention centres and move to alternative reception and transit centres.
Het uiteindelijke doel is deze detentiecentra te sluiten en te komen tot alternatieve ontvangst- en transitcentra.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Dam over de uitzending van Zembla “Zakendoen met justitie”

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice about high and special transactions by the Public Prosecution Service (OM) in 2016-2017, including prosecution of individuals, secrecy, fiscal treatment, equality and judicial review. The ministers answered that the OM prosecutes individuals in many cases, gave figures for 2016-2017, acknowledged that the Rabobank non-admission wording was unfortunate, and said the current practice is being reviewed.
At this moment the current practice is being reviewed.
Op dit moment wordt de huidige praktijk tegen het licht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over het bericht “U-bocht in zaak Poch”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Groothuizen asked about Dutch police and prosecution contacts with Argentine judicial authorities in the Poch case, including an unofficial 2008 trip and the role of intermediaries. The minister answered that two working visits took place in 2008 under the Dutch investigation, with knowledge of both states, that no minutes of the talks exist, and that such exploratory contacts are not unusual in complex cases.
I do not have records of these conversations.
Ik beschik niet over verslaglegging van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over incassofraude bij banken

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about a reported gap in bank direct-debit systems that allows incasso fraud, including whether banks pre-fund transfers from intermediate accounts and whether they warn creditors of possible reversal. The minister replied that the system complies with EU rules, that incasso fraud is very small in value, that police do not register it separately, and that banks will be asked via the MOB to renew attention to the rules.
Via the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer (MOB) I will ask the banks to give renewed attention to this in the coming period.
Via het Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer (MOB) zal ik de banken verzoeken hier de komende tijd hernieuwde aandacht aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Robotrechter e-Court is een groot en niet-transparant zwart gat?’

MPs Groothuizen and Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked about the private digital arbitration firm e-Court, its opaque caseload, algorithm use, publication of awards and arbiter lists, and insurers' arbitration clauses. The minister answered that e-Court's caseload data is confidential, that the courts' review of its awards is pending a Supreme Court referral, that arbitral transparency is not legally required, and that a rights-of-appeal exists for consumers.
This is commercially sensitive information which e-Court therefore did not wish to provide.
Dit is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie die e-Court om die reden niet heeft willen verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de uitvoering van de Wet beëdigde tolken en vertalers

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the implementation of the Wet beëdigde tolken en vertalers, including quality of interpreters, use of non-registered interpreters and the reform based on the ABDTOPConsult report. The Minister answered that quality and price are being balanced, that about half of roughly 475,000 interpreting services in 2016 used a registered interpreter, and that the reform programme is ongoing with rollout expected in 2019.
Annex 1 provides an overview of interpreting services by these so-called obligated organisations, broken down by language, for 2016.
In bijlage 1 is een overzicht gegeven van tolkdiensten van deze zogenoemde afnameplichtige organisaties uitgesplitst per taal over 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Veluwe staat model bij aanpak criminelen’

Opposition MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection how the municipality of Putten's administrative sanction method (last onder dwangsom against criminals) relates to criminal procedure under Article 6 ECHR, whether municipalities bypass prosecutors and judges and consider personal circumstances, and how many municipalities use it and whether fines are collected. The Minister answered that the instrument is a restorative administrative sanction not generally covered by Article 6, that it is subject to Awb proportionality limits and appeal, that the municipality works with police and prosecutors, and that in 90-95% of cases no new violation follows, with the remainder collected effectively, though the Minister lacks data on other municipalities.
I am not aware of how many municipalities use this instrument or what the results are.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten gebruik maken van dit instrumentarium en wat de resultaten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het rapport "Demonstratierecht onder druk"

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Minister of Interior about the Ombudsman's report on the right to demonstrate, including municipal bans on demonstrations, the Wom's adequacy for spontaneous disorder, and the effect of local political colour. The Minister broadly endorses protecting the right to demonstrate, promises a letter before the summer recess after talks with mayors, but declines to investigate municipal ban practices, saying responsibility lies with local authorities.
Respecting freedom of demonstration must take priority for local authorities, even when facilitating or banning a demonstration is politically sensitive.
Het respecteren van de demonstratievrijheid dient voor het lokale gezag voorop te staan, ook als het faciliteren of juist verbieden van een demonstratie politiek gevoelig ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over het bericht dat motorclubs zich naar België verplaatsen

D66 MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about reports that outlaw motorcycle gangs are shifting activities to Belgium to avoid Dutch measures, and about cross-border cooperation, a possible administrative ban, and EU anti-money-laundering tools. Minister Grapperhaus answered that cross-border cooperation with Belgium and Germany exists, that a bill for an administrative ban on legal persons is being prepared, and that further steps depend on operational needs.
As is known to your House, a law with an administrative ban is being prepared on the initiative of MP Kuiken (PvdA).
Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, is er een wet met een bestuurlijk verbod in de maak op initiatief van het lid Kuiken (PvdA).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de uitzending over homo-ontmoetingsplaatsen van ‘Undercover in Nederland’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about crimes at gay meeting places shown in a SBS6 documentary, including the lack of statistics, victims' reluctance to report, preventive measures, and whether municipalities are inconsistent or drive gay men away. The minister condemned all such crimes, said no statistics exist because offences are often covered by other crimes and sites are not designated, expanded Slachtofferhulp Nederland's online services, and said local authorities are responsible for policy, supported by a Movisie handbook.
Local tailoring is appropriate here because conditions can differ from municipality to municipality.
Lokaal maatwerk is hier aangewezen omdat de omstandigheden per gemeente kunnen verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'Marine (19) wil officier van justitie worden, maar waar blijft haar paspoort?'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a news report on a 19-year-old Marine whose naturalisation under the general pardon scheme was delayed, and about the handling of naturalisation applications. The State Secretary answered that 48% of pardon-scheme recipients had become Dutch, that communication channels with municipalities were being reinforced without a firm timeline, and that children cannot be naturalised separately if the parent's application is refused.
I have therefore once again brought to attention the existing instruction for staff of the chain service line to connect to a specialised employee for substantive questions.

Ik heb daarom de – al bestaande – instructie voor medewerkers van de ketenservicelijn om bij inhoudelijke vragen door te verbinden met een gespecialiseerde medewerker nogmaals onder de aandacht gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Groothuizen over het verplichtgestelde pensioenfonds voor notarissen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Groothuizen asked whether there is sufficient support among notaries for the statutory obligation to join the notarial pension fund, given a survey showing the 60% representativeness norm is not met. The government answered that mandatory participation for notaries rests on the Wna itself, that the desirability of compulsory membership is a matter for the profession, and declined to comment on the survey figures.

Given this responsibility of the notaries themselves, I am of the view that the figures from the support survey, their interpretation and any conclusions drawn from them are a matter for the notaries themselves.

Gezien deze verantwoordelijkheid van de beroepsgenoten in het notariaat zelf, ben ik van mening dat de cijfers die uit het draagvlakonderzoek naar voren komen, de interpretatie daarvan alsmede eventuele conclusies naar aanleiding daarvan een zaak van de beroepsgenoten in het notariaat onderling is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Moordonderzoeken West-Brabant stilgelegd door onderbezetting’

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether murder and manslaughter investigations in the Zeeland-West-Brabant police unit have been halted due to very high pressure on detective capacity, and what mutual assistance between police units exists. The Minister acknowledges the report, cites high workloads from counter-terrorism, cyber and high-impact crime, points to extra funding and the Politiewet article 56 mechanism for requesting assistance from other units, and refers to answers given to other MPs.
The Police Act provides that under article 56 the Public Prosecutor may request the Chief of Police to obtain assistance from other units for criminal law enforcement.
In de Politiewet is vastgesteld dat op grond van artikel 56 de Officier van Justitie de Korpschef om bijstand kan verzoeken vanuit andere eenheden voor strafrechtelijke handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Wel hier geboren, maar géén nationaliteit: 112 Amsterdamse kinderen zijn 'staatloos'

MPs Groothuizen and Bergkamp asked about reports that 112 Amsterdam children born in the Netherlands are stateless, including whether parents without lawful residence are denied benefits and whether a procedure to establish statelessness exists. The State Secretary replied that a bill creating a court procedure to establish statelessness and an option right for stateless children is forthcoming, and that the Koppelingsbeginsel bars benefits to unlawfully resident parents while lawfully resident stateless persons remain entitled.
The Cabinet then committed to close this gap and to develop a establishment procedure on a statutory basis.
Het Kabinet heeft daarop toegezegd deze leemte op te vullen en een vaststellingsprocedure te zullen ontwikkelen op wettelijke grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, Groothuizen en Kuiken over de uitzettingen van afgewezen asielzoekers naar Soedan

Four MPs asked whether the Netherlands should investigate the fate of Sudanese asylum seekers deported to Sudan after Belgium opened an inquiry into alleged torture of deportees, whether Sudanese diplomats played a role in deportations, and whether they gather information on asylum seekers in the Netherlands. The Secretary of State refused to start an own investigation or pause deportations, arguing the Dutch situation differs from Belgium's and no concrete signal of irregularities was received, and denied knowledge of diplomats gathering information.

The investigation started by the Belgian government into statements from some Sudanese foreigners expelled by Belgium is for me no reason to conduct an independent investigation into deportation to Sudan or to suspend return to Sudan.

Het onderzoek dat de Belgische regering is gestart naar de verklaring van enkele door België uitgezette Sudanese vreemdelingen vormt voor mij geen reden om een eigenstandig onderzoek te doen naar uitzetting naar Sudan dan wel om terugkeer naar Sudan op te schorten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'The impenetrable program transforming how courts treat DNA evidence'

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch courts and the NFI rely on probabilistic genotyping software with undisclosed algorithms, as reported for US courts, and whether that is acceptable and should be scientifically tested. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the NFI uses open-source probabilistic genotyping software that is transparent and independently checkable, that courts can call experts, and saw no need for further scientific study.
The judge assesses whether the submitted investigation report and the algorithms used are sufficiently reliable to reach a judgment on establishing the truth.
De rechter beoordeelt of het voorgelegde onderzoeksrapport en de daarvoor gebruikte algoritmen voldoende deugdelijk zijn om tot een oordeel omtrent de waarheidsvinding te kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over coldcaseteams

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security how cold cases are selected, how many arise each year, and whether selection criteria and special teams are needed. The Minister answered that cold cases are chosen by OM and police using age and public-interest criteria, that no national registration exists (about 1500 cases now), and that each unit has a dedicated team, so no new elite teams are planned.
The OM and the police have indicated that there is no national registration of cold cases, making it impossible to show the precise development of their number.
Het OM en de politie hebben laten weten dat er geen landelijke registratie van cold cases plaatsvindt, waardoor het niet mogelijk is om de precieze ontwikkeling ervan weer te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Verhoeven en Den Boer over het bericht 'Burger ingezet bij opsporing'

MPs Groothuizen, Verhoeven and Den Boer (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a new OM directive allowing police publicity of suspects' identities to prevent serious crimes, including identifiable victims and witnesses, and about safeguards, subsidiarity, oversight and ECHR compliance. Minister Grapperhaus answered largely in substance, explaining the criteria and safeguards but declining to commit to annual reporting and saying no specific oversight was planned.
I see no reason to specifically exercise oversight over this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding daarop specifiek toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over de vrijspraak van Julio Poch

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Foreign Affairs about the acquittal of Julio Poch in Argentina, his long pre-trial detention, Dutch extradition and legal assistance, compensation, and consular support. The government answered that it sees no reason to revise earlier answers, that the duration of detention is for Argentine courts to decide, that Dutch legal assistance obligations were met, and that consular support was provided, while declining to comment on the unpublished judgment.
It is not appropriate for the government to judge the substance of foreign court rulings.
Het past de regering niet om inhoudelijk te oordelen over buitenlandse rechterlijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over recente ontwikkelingen in de strijd tegen corruptie in Oekraïne

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister about Ukraine's bills 7440 and 7441 creating an independent anti-corruption court, whether they meet Venice Commission advice, and how the Procurator-General's conflict with the NABU anti-corruption bureau and the dismissal of Ihor Soboliev should be addressed. The minister answered that the bills do not fully incorporate Venice Commission advice on judicial selection and case jurisdiction, that the Netherlands shares those concerns and will raise them bilaterally and in the EU and IMF, and that the Netherlands regrets the Soboliev dismissal and will monitor its effects.
The Netherlands will continue to stress, in bilateral contacts and international forums, the importance of a genuinely impartial and independent court and of following the Venice Commission's advice.

Nederland zal in de bilaterale contacten en internationale gremia het belang van een daadwerkelijk onpartijdig en onafhankelijk Hof, en het opvolgen van de adviezen van de Venetië Commissie blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groothuizen over het Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen

MPs Kuiken and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about staffing shortages, a 'spam box' for urgent missing-person alerts, and the handling of missing-person cases at the Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen. The minister denied that alerts were late or sent to a spam box, said the bureau was always reachable and cases were assessed by police officers, and did not track how often urgent cases went unreported to the bureau.
It is not tracked in how many cases no report of an urgent disappearance was made to the LBVP.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden in hoeveel gevallen er geen melding van een urgente vermissing bij het LBVP is gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groothuizen over een gebrek aan capaciteit en kwaliteit bij het Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen

MPs Kuiken and Groothuizen asked the Minister about reports of understaffing and lack of expertise at the national police's Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen, including late alerts, a spam mailbox for urgent reports, and whether an independent investigation is needed. The Minister answers only by referring to a separate letter on improving missing-persons procedures, without addressing the individual questions.

The written questions from MPs Kuiken (PvdA) and Groothuizen (D66), question number 2017Z08797, have been answered by way of the letter 'Approach to bottlenecks in the missing persons process at the police'.

Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kuiken (PvdA) en Groothuizen (D66), vraagnummer 2017Z08797 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Aanpak knelpunten in het proces vermissingen bij de politie» (Kamerstuk 29 628, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Verhoeven over het verstrekken van Europese paspoorten na een investering in de Cypriotische economie

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Cyprus granting EU passports to wealthy investors, whether the Commission is investigating, and whether the Netherlands engages in similar practices. The minister said no Commission investigation exists, that EU states decide their own nationality rules, that Dutch investor residence permits require a five-year legal stay before naturalisation, and that no conflict with international law has been established so no further action is planned.
It is up to the country to establish whether the national (legal) conditions for issuing a passport have been met and to prevent criminals possibly being facilitated thereby.

Het is aan het land om vast te stellen of aan de nationale (wettelijke) voorwaarden voor verstrekking van een paspoort is voldaan en om te voorkomen dat daardoor mogelijkerwijs criminelen worden gefaciliteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Groothuizen over de Nederlandse transporteur die stopt met ritten naar Engeland vanwege problemen met vluchtelingen die als verstekeling meereizen

MPs Jetten and Groothuizen asked the government what it has done about stowaway migrants in Calais threatening Dutch truck drivers, and whether a European approach and insurance measures are in hand. The minister replied that the Calais security situation is the responsibility of the French authorities, that the government raises it in European and bilateral channels, and that it works with the transport sector, without committing to new concrete steps.
The security situation in Calais falls under the responsibility of the French authorities.
De veiligheidssituatie in Calais valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Franse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Oosten, Groothuizen en Segers over het bericht ‘Grote strafzaken verhuizen van rechtbank Almelo naar Zwolle’

MPs asked whether the move of multi-judge Functioneel Parket criminal cases from Almelo to Zwolle follows from the Herziening Gerechtelijke Kaart and whether Almelo keeps enough work. The minister confirmed the move follows from 2012 agreements, that Almelo remains a main location, and gave hour figures showing fewer multi-judge hearings in Almelo in 2018.
The shift of multi-judge Functioneel Parket criminal cases to Zwolle from 1 January 2018 flows directly from agreements made in 2012 within the framework of the Judicial Map Revision Act (HGK).

De verschuiving van meervoudige strafzaken van het Functioneel Parket per 1 januari 2018 naar Zwolle, zijnde de vestigingsplaats van het Functioneel Parket in Overijssel, vloeit direct voort uit afspraken die in 2012 het kader van de Wet Herziening Gerechtelijke Kaart (HGK) zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘IND gelooft (ondanks bewijs) verhalen van gevluchte Egyptenaren niet’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the IND disbelieves political asylum accounts of Egyptians despite evidence, whether comparison material is lacking, whether an updated Egypt country report exists, and whether individual country reports should be used more. The State Secretary answered that credibility is assessed on all evidence with judicial review available, that lack of comparison material is never the sole reason for refusal, that no new Egypt report is planned given limited inflow and other sources, and that individual reports are weighed case by case.
This assessment is reasoned and this reasoning can be reviewed by the judge at the request of the foreign national.
Dit oordeel wordt gemotiveerd uiteen gezet en deze motivering kan op verzoek van de vreemdeling worden getoetst door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Engelshoven en Groothuizen over het in de cel gooien van een Nederlandse journalist

MPs from D66 asked why an NRC photographer was detained and his equipment seized for refusing to hand over photos, and whether this was lawful. The Minister answered that the journalist was wrongly treated as a suspect, the seizure was wrong, the Public Prosecution Service apologised, and the case will be discussed within the OM.
The journalist was wrongly treated as a suspect.
De journalist is ten onrechte als verdachte aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de invloed van salafisten in Nederlandse moskeeën

MPs from D66 asked ministers about Saudi-funded study places at the Islamic University of Medina, salafist takeovers of mosques, violence in mosque power struggles, and whether municipalities monitor foreign funding of religious institutions. The government answered that registration data are incomplete, Saudi scholarships are a voluntary choice not disclosed in Notes Verbales, it lacks data on violent incidents or lecture funding, and it promised a tri-track municipal approach and a further handling framework.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police do not register violent incidents at mosques in the context of the power struggle as referred to in the question.
Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie registreren niet op gewelddadige incidenten bij moskeeën in het kader van de machtsstrijd zoals in de vraag bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de verplichte pensioenleeftijd voor rechters

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the mandatory retirement age of 70 for judges is still justified, given rising life expectancy, age discrimination concerns and judicial shortages. The minister defended the age limit as lawful and legitimate for judicial independence and career flow, but agreed to examine whether the limit should be changed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het EUROPOL-rapport 'From suspicion to action - Converting financial intelligence into greater operational impact'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Europol report on converting financial intelligence into operational impact, including why Dutch reporting raises its share of suspicious transaction reports, what happened to 6,500 FIU dossiers, and whether a uniform EU reporting system and stronger Europol role are needed. The minister answered that Dutch unusual-transaction reporting is a deliberate design, that the report's figures are misleading, that FIU-NL cooperates closely with investigators, and that EU reforms are underway, without committing to a new system.
In view of the foregoing, I see no reason to switch to a uniform European reporting system.
Ik zie gelet op het voorgaande geen reden om over te stappen naar een uniform Europees rapportagesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Meer doden door code voor redders op zee’

An MP asked whether the Italian code of conduct for NGO sea rescues would prohibit switching off transponders, contact with smugglers and rescues in Libyan waters, and whether it would increase drowning deaths. The government confirmed the code's main terms, said it aims to improve cooperation and intelligence against smugglers, and stated that the effect on drownings is not known in advance.
The effect of the code of conduct on the number of people who drown is not known in advance.
Het effect van de gedragscode op het aantal mensen dat verdrinkt, is niet op voorhand bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de bestrijding van synthetische drugscriminaliteit

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Brabant synthetic drugs sweep stopped early, police and LFO capacity, drug-waste dumping trends in Gelderland and Brabant, and cleanup costs. The minister answered that the sweep was successful, that capacity appears adequate but may need expansion, that dumping counts rose modestly with figures by province, and that the offender should bear cleanup costs, with a cofinancing scheme being implemented.
How investigative capacity is deployed is determined in the local triangle (mayor, public prosecution and police).
Hoe de opsporingscapaciteit wordt ingezet, wordt bepaald in de lokale driehoek (burgemeester, OM en politie).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Buitenweg en Jasper van Dijk over tralies bij de vluchtelingenopvang in de voormalige Bijlmerbajes

MPs asked whether the former Bijlmerbajes prison, used as a refugee shelter until December 2017, should have its bars removed given its detention character and the trauma of residents. The State Secretary answered that detention features were largely removed, the bars remain as external shading serving climate control, and COA sees no reason for further changes.
The bars now serve only as external shading and have not been removed, because they play an important role in climate control in the building.
De tralies dienen nu nog louter als externe zonwering en zijn niet verwijderd, omdat deze een belangrijke functie vervullen bij de klimaatbeheersing in het gebouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Verhoeven over anti-corruptie rechtbanken in Oekraïne

Dutch MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed with the European Commission president that a dedicated anti-corruption court in Ukraine was unnecessary and whether the Netherlands would press for one. The minister replied that the EU and IMF demand independent anti-corruption institutions, that the Netherlands supports an independent anti-corruption court and will keep advocating it, while stressing that the independence and transparency of the judicial structure must be guaranteed.
The Netherlands has also actively lobbied the Ukrainian authorities for this.
Nederland heeft hier ook actief bij de Oekraïense autoriteiten voor gepleit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Raemakers over de toegenomen weigeringen van Verklaringen omtrent gedrag

MPs Groothuizen and Raemakers asked why VOG refusals rose from 0.35% to 0.4% in 2016, how many refusals concerned young people and work or internships, and whether a youth information campaign had started. MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked whether the Netherlands is doing enough for LGBTI people persecuted in Chechnya, including whether it funded shelters, how it treated an asylum-seeking journalist, and whether it will press Russia. Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Groothuizen en Bouali over het bericht dat verdachte schepen niet worden gecontroleerd

MPs Jetten, Groothuizen and Bouali (D66) asked whether ships that switched off their AIS signal or changed identification before entering Dutch waters are being properly checked, and what the consequences for security and enforcement are. The government answers that AIS gaps have many legitimate causes, that the Kustwacht and Douane use risk profiling and treat AIS switch-offs as a risk indicator, that the numbers from Winward cannot be confirmed, and that modernisation and EU cooperation are underway.
The Coast Guard does not have the investigation data on which Winward based its conclusions and therefore cannot confirm the numbers Winward cites.

MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked how the Supreme Court's 4 April 2017 ruling on smartphone searches affects criminal investigations, whether it differs from the Computer Crime III bill, and whether a prompt statutory regime is needed. The minister answered that prosecutor authorisation is now generally required for searching seized phones, that the bill covers remote access rather than seizure, and that existing provisions suffice in most cases while new Code of Criminal Procedure rules are under consultation.

Following the Supreme Court ruling, from 4 April 2017 the main rule in criminal investigations is that, where the police seize independently, examining a seized smartphone or other electronic data carrier requires the prosecutor's authorisation.

Motie van de leden Bushoff en Dijk over de winstmarges begrenzen van de categorieën extramurale zorgaanbieders die per AMvB noodzakelijkerwijs worden uitgezonderd van het verbod op een winstoogmerk

requests the government to limit the profit margins of the categories of extramural care providers

Asks the cabinet to find a legal way to ban private-equity firms from general practice care and send legislation to the House before the summer recess.
requests the cabinet to find as quickly as possible a legal route to establish this ban and to send legislation to the House before the summer recess
verzoekt het kabinet zo snel mogelijk een juridische weg te vinden om dit verbod tot stand te brengen en uiterlijk voor het zomerreces wetgeving hiertoe naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen

The own risk is a fine for being ill.
Het eigen risico is een boete op ziek zijn.
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 130 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Shifts 27 million euro within the health budget from unallocated funds to pilot specialised post-COVID outpatient clinics for two years.
With this amendment money is made available for two years, after which the clinics can be financed through the regular funding method
Met dit amendement wordt voor twee jaar geld vrijgemaakt, daarna kunnen deze klinieken volledig gefinancierd worden vanuit de reguliere financieringsmethodiek
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 42 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Moves 27 million euro in 2024 to a budget line for specialised post-COVID outpatient clinics by lowering the undistributed reserve.
This amendment therefore binding lowers the commitment and expenditure amounts in article 11 by 27 million euro.
Met dit amendement worden daarom taakstellend het verplichtingen- en uitgavenbedrag in artikel 11 verlaagd met € 27 miljoen.
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 131 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Shifts 27 million euros from the unallocated article 11 to curative care to fund specialised post-COVID outpatient clinics.
This amendment raises the commitment appropriation in article 2 (Curative Care) by 27 million euros and the expenditure amount by 12 million euros in 2024.
Dit amendement verhoogt het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 2 (Curatieve Zorg) met € 27 miljoen en het uitgavenbedrag met € 12 miljoen in 2024.
Amendement van het lid Dijk over het afschaffen van het eigen risico
Amends the health insurance bill to abolish the mandatory and voluntary deductible (eigen risico) and compensates insurers through state contributions.
The deductible is a fine for being ill.

Motie van het lid Dijk over in het wetsvoorstel Integere bedrijfsvoering zorg- en jeugdhulpaanbieders regelen dat eigenaarschap van private-equitypartijen in de zorg niet meer mogelijk is
Asks the government to take steps in the Integere bedrijfsvoering bill so that private equity ownership in healthcare is phased out.
private equity ownership belongs to the past
eigenaarschap van private-equitypartijen tot het verleden gaat behoren
Motie van het lid Dijk over de financiële tegemoetkoming voor zorgverleners met long covid verhogen naar minimaal €24.010 per persoon

has made available a compensation of 15,000 euro per person
een tegemoetkoming van € 15.000 per persoon beschikbaar heeft gesteld

Asks the cabinet to halt closing hospitals or parts of hospitals to guarantee good care.
requests the cabinet to impose a stop on closing (parts of) hospitals to guarantee good care

requests the government to include dental care in the basic package

Asks the government to make profit distribution in healthcare impossible.
requests the government to make profit distribution in healthcare impossible

Motie van het lid Dijk c.s. over het eigen risico zo snel mogelijk afschaffen
Motion asks the government to abolish the health insurance deductible (eigen risico) as soon as possible.
requests the government to abolish the deductible as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering om het eigen risico zo snel mogelijk af te schaffen
Motie van de leden Bushoff en Dijk over één periodieke controle bij de tandarts per jaar toevoegen aan het basispakket
Motion asks the government to add one yearly dental check-up to the basic insurance package, funded by tightening the expat scheme and earnings stripping measure.
requests the government to add one periodic dental check-up per year, exempt from the deductible from 2025, to the basic package.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 38 over extra middelen voor zorgmedewerkers met langdurige post-COVID klachten
Shifts €21 million from the undistributed budget item to the health budget to extend the scheme for healthcare workers with long-term post-COVID complaints.
The funding for these extra resources is found in article 11 (Undistributed).
De dekking voor deze extra middelen wordt gevonden op artikel 11 (Nog onverdeeld).
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 37 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Shifts 27 million euro within the health budget from unallocated funds to post-COVID specialist outpatient clinics as a two-year pilot.
This amendment raises the commitment amount in article 2 (Curative Care) by 27 million euro

Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Increases the health budget for curative care by 27 million euro, funded from undistributed reserves, to set up post-COVID outpatient clinics.
This amendment increases the commitment amount in article 2 (Curative Care) by 27 million euro

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 20 over extra middelen voor zorgmedewerkers met langdurige post-COVID klachten
Shifts 21 million euro from unallocated funds to the health ministry's budget for an expanded post-COVID scheme for healthcare workers.
This amendment to the 2024 budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport increases the commitment and spending amounts in article 4 (cross-sector health policy) by 21 million euro.
Dit amendement op de begroting van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport 2024 verhoogt het verplichtingen- en uitgavenbedrag in artikel 4 (Zorgbreed beleid) met € 21 miljoen
Motie van de leden Dijk en Paulusma over onderzoek mogelijk maken naar nieuwe vormen van xenotransplantatie

requests the government to commission scientific research into the causes of the absolute and relative rise in euthanasia cases

Motie van het lid Dijk over het zo snel mogelijk afschaffen van de plastictaks
Asks the government to abolish the plastic tax as soon as possible.
requests the government to abolish the plastic tax as soon as possible

Amendement van het lid Erkens c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over aanvullende middelen voor schadeafhandeling Limburgse mijnbouw
Shifts budget within the departmental budget to raise funding for mining damage settlement in Limburg and asks government to set up a regional institute.
With this amendment the submitters propose raising the 2024 budget for mining damage settlement in Limburg from 4 to 9 million euro.
Met dit amendement stellen indiener voor het budget voor 2024 voor de schadeafhandeling Mijnbouw Limburg te verhogen van € 4 miljoen naar € 9 miljoen.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Boucke c.s. ter vervanging van. nr. 13 over dekking voor middelen voor zonnepanelen op scholen
Shifts 40 million euro within the energy budget to subsidise solar panels on schools via a DUMAVA scheme, a budget reallocation without clear checks on the executive.

Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over het hele MVOI-beleid in lijn brengen met de OESO-richlijnen
Asks the government to make the OECD guidelines and UN Guiding Principles the norm for its responsible procurement policy and align all MVO policy with them.
requests the cabinet to align the entire MVO procurement policy with the OECD guidelines

Motie van het lid Dijk over alleen subsidies voor verduurzaming voor de twintig grootste uitstoters bij een doorslaggevende stem van werknemers over het besluit of het bedrijf in Nederland moet blijve
Asks government to subsidise sustainability only for the twenty largest emitters where workers have a decisive vote on whether the company stays in the Netherlands.
requests the government to make subsidies for sustainability available only to the twenty largest emitters

Asks the government to make a social plan drawn up with workers, unions, environmental groups and residents a condition in the Tata Steel tailor-made agreements.

requests the government to include in the tailor-made agreements the condition that the company, together with employees, the union, environmental organisations and local residents, draws up a social plan
verzoekt de regering bij de maatwerkafspraken de voorwaarde op te nemen dat het bedrijf samen met de werknemers, de vakbond, milieuorganisaties en bewoners uit de omgeving een sociaal plan opstelt
Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over advies vragen over wijziging van de Gids Proportionaliteit

Asks the government to have the Adviescommissie Gids Proportionaliteit advise on amending the guide to clarify and raise the threshold for direct contracting with social enterprises and small businesses.
requests the government to ask the Advisory Committee on the Proportionality Guide to advise on an amendment to the Guide
verzoekt de regering de Adviescommissie Gids Proportionaliteit te vragen om te adviseren over een wijziging van de Gids Proportionaliteit
Amendement van het lid Van den Brink c.s. over het verlengen van de fase van vrijwilligheid
Changes the asylum reception distribution timetable so the minister's distribution decisions are postponed to 31 December and interbestuurlijk toezicht is less likely to be needed.

Moreover, the taking of distribution decisions by the Minister after insufficient places are offered is postponed, thereby reducing the chance that interadministrative supervision is used to realise reception facilities.

Bovendien wordt het nemen van verdeelbesluiten na het uitblijven van voldoende plekken door de Minister uitgesteld, waardoor de kans op de inzet van interbestuurlijk toezicht voor het realiseren van opvangfaciliteiten wordt verminderd.
Motie van het lid Dijk over geld dat ge¬bud¬get¬teerd is voor het Stagefonds Zorg inzetten om de salarissen van zorgpersoneel te verhogen
Asks the government to redirect budget earmarked for the Stagefonds Zorg internship fund to raise care staff salaries.
Requests the government to use the money budgeted for the Stagefonds Zorg to raise care staff salaries.
verzoekt de regering om het geld dat gebudgetteerd is voor het Stagefonds Zorg in te zetten om de salarissen van zorgpersoneel te verhogen
Motie van de leden Van den Berg en Dijk over onderzoeken in hoeverre de opkomst van private-equitypartijen in de zorg de publieke waarden van zorg en ondersteuning bedreigt

Asks the government to commission research, with the ACM and the Dutch Healthcare Authority, into whether private equity takeovers in healthcare threaten public values and what measures could protect them.
requests the government to commission research into the extent to which the rise of private equity parties in care threatens the public values of care and support
verzoekt de regering onderzoek te laten doen naar de vraag in hoeverre de opkomst van private-equitypartijen in de zorg de publieke waarden van zorg en ondersteuning
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het verplaatsen van covid-19 van groep A naar groep B2
Moves covid-19 from Wpg group A to group B2, removing the statutory emergency tools (forced admission, quarantine) that the safety-region chair can use for group A diseases.
therefore this amendment proposes to classify covid-19 as an infectious disease belonging to group B2
daarom stelt dit amendement voor covid-19 aan te merken als infectieziekte behorend tot groep B2
Amendement van de leden Dijk en Marijnissen over middelen voor extra plekken in verpleeghuizen
Increases the budget for long-term care by 975 million euro to fund 65,000 additional nursing home places, with funding partly from corporate tax.
With this amendment the submitter aims to structurally increase the Wlz contribution by 975 million euro
Met dit amendement beoogt de indiener de Bijdrage Wlz met € 975 miljoen structureel te verhogen
