Amendement van de leden Dijk en Marijnissen over middelen voor een hoger salaris voor zorgverleners
Adds 2 billion euro to the care-sector budget so care workers' pay and working conditions can be raised structurally.
The submitter uses this amendment to create wage room to structurally raise salaries for care workers and improve their working conditions.
De indiener regelt met dit amendement dat er loonruimte ontstaat om de salarissen voor zorgverleners structureel te verhogen en hun arbeidsvoorwaarden te verbeteren.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jimmy Dijk en Dobbe over één periodieke tandartscontrole per jaar vanuit het basispakket vergoeden

MPs Dijk and Dobbe (SP) asked the Minister of Health why the motion to cover one periodic dental check per year from the basic package had not been implemented, and why the Minister deferred it to the next cabinet. The Minister answered that funding was too uncertain and legally difficult, that the Health Care Institute found preventive dental care does not in principle meet the statutory criteria, and that the next cabinet must decide.
It was not feasible, for the reasons above, to carry out the motion.
Het was om bovengenoemde redenen niet haalbaar om de motie uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jimmy Dijk over het artikel “1 op 6 Nederlanders heeft stressvol werk, vooral in de zorg en het onderwijs.”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about news that one in six Dutch workers have stressful jobs, concentrated in care and education, and whether low pay, low autonomy and understaffing are linked to this. The state secretary replied that stress stems mainly from high workload combined with low autonomy rather than undervaluation of the public sector, pointed to existing prevention plans and workload-reduction funds, and said wages are primarily a matter for employers and unions.
I therefore do not share the analysis that this is related to any undervaluation of the public sector.
Ik deel de analyse dan ook niet dat dit te maken heeft met eventuele onderwaardering van de publieke sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jimmy Dijk over de voortgangsrapportage Hertsteloperatie Toeslagen

MP Jimmy Dijk asked why the government rejects a legal basis for sharing data between UHT and DUO to map student debts of children affected by the childcare benefits scandal, and why alternative methods, including a CBS study, were not pursued. The State Secretary refused the data sharing as disproportionate since no generic debt-relief scheme will be introduced, pointed to the existing children's scheme and DUO facilities, and said no further exploration of alternatives is opportune.

Data sharing between UHT and DUO would only provide insight into the amount and number of student loans of affected young people, not into whether those loans are the result of the childcare benefits scandal.
Gegevensdeling tussen UHT en DUO zou uitsluitend inzicht geven in de hoogte en de aantallen studieleningen van getroffen jongeren, niet over of die leningen het gevolg zijn van de toeslagenaffaire.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over belangenverstrengeling door enkele wetenschappers

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about conflicts of interest among scientists who helped shape the obesity debate with disputed figures, and whether commercial influence on policy is a concern. The minister acknowledged the lapses at UMCG, called transparency essential, said existing codes and registers suffice, and declined to link the manifest to the reimbursement decision, while rejecting a national drug fund as a fix for conflicts of interest.

In this case, the University Medical Center Groningen, where the scientists are affiliated, indicated that the researchers did not adhere to the Dutch Code of Conduct for Research Integrity and that their side positions and possible conflicts of interest should have been disclosed when signing the manifesto.

In dit geval heeft het Universitair Medisch Centrum Groningen (UMCG), waar de wetenschappers aan verbonden zijn, aangegeven dat de onderzoekers zich niet aan de Nederlandse Gedragscode Wetenschappelijke Integriteit (NGWI) hebben gehouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Dijk over het bericht 'Vacatures voor renovatie Binnenhof duiden op schijnzelfstandigheid'

MPs Van Kent and Dijk (SP) asked the government about reports that Binnenhof renovation vacancies point to bogus self-employment, asking about enforcement, contracting, possible tax offences and worker safety. The minister replies that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf does not recognise the reports, that no cases are known, that contractors are bound by contract to follow the law, and that enforcement and the phase-out of bogus self-employment within the state are being pursued.
You will be informed shortly by the Minister of BZK about progress in phasing out the number of (potential) bogus self-employed within central government.
Over de voortgang van het afbouwen van het aantal (potentieel) schijnzelfstandigen bij de Rijksoverheid wordt u op korte termijn geïnformeerd door de Minister van BZK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over de stand van zaken van de uitvoering van de SP motie om te stoppen met de commerciële noodopvang

Two MPs from the SP ask the minister about progress in ending commercial emergency asylum shelter, as required by two adopted motions, including how many places and parties remain and how costs are developing. The minister says COA is expanding regular shelter places and the number of hotel and boat places rose to about 21,000 by 1 November 2025, costs are not expected to fall this year, and the government is pursuing measures to reduce inflow and speed outflow.
The number of regular COA shelter places is rising steadily, from an expected approximately 40,000 on 1 November 2025 to approximately 51,000 by 1 January 2027.
Het aantal reguliere opvangplekken van het COA stijgt gestaag, naar huidige verwachting van circa 40.000 op 1 november 2025 naar circa 51.000 op 1 januari 2027.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht '2325 schuldeisers, tienduizenden gedupeerden en miljoenen euro’s verdwenen: dit is het verhaal van Groupcard'

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs how the government responds to reports that the curator found serious governance and administrative failures at Groupcard, leaving municipalities and thousands of beneficiaries out of pocket, and what will prevent repetition and provide compensation. The state secretary acknowledges the seriousness, says the state is not a creditor, and places contracting and compensation responsibility with municipalities, while sharing guidance on tax and benefit treatment of compensation payouts.
It is the responsibility and competence of municipalities to shape municipal poverty policy.
Het behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheid en bevoegdheid van gemeenten om vorm te geven aan het gemeentelijk armoedebeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de berichten ‘Staalslakken op veel meer plekken gevonden: aantal locaties bijna verdubbeld’ en ‘Waar komen verwijderde staalslakken terecht? “Geen zicht op”’

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how the government responds to press reports of more than a hundred locations where steel slag was used as construction material, whether the ministry knew of them, and what will be done to find and clean up such sites and control reuse of removed slag. The state secretary answers that the ministry had no registration duty and only learned via existing records and an ILT investigation, lists eight measures including a reporting duty from spring 2026, a joint approach with IPO, VNG and water boards, and states that no permit applications have been received.
There is no reporting, information or registration obligation for the application of steel slag.
Er is geen meld-, informatie- of registratieplicht voor het toepassen van staalslakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris, Dijk en Patijn over de Kamerbrief 'Informeren over bouwplaats ID en over inhoudingen op het minimumloon,' d.d. 30 oktober 2025 (kenmerk: 2025-0000214845)

MPs Saris, Dijk and Patijn asked why the minister abandoned the planned phase-out of deductions from the minimum wage for housing, given the migration goal, the Labour Inspectorate's warnings about abuse and the Aanjaagteam recommendations. The minister answered that the 25% cap stays because abolition would currently harm migrant workers more, and pointed to consultation, the Wet Goed Verhuurderschap and planned measures, answering all twelve questions in substance.
The cabinet has therefore decided that employers may for the time being continue to charge up to 25% of the statutory minimum wage for housing costs.
Het kabinet heeft daarom besloten dat werkgevers vooralsnog maximaal 25% van het Wettelijk minimumloon in rekening mogen blijven brengen voor huisvestingskosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het feit dat de vergoeding van vervoerskosten voor een deel van de mensen met een beperking is verlaagd

SP MPs Dobbe and Dijk asked why the tax deduction for medical travel costs was lowered for some people with disabilities, and whether this breaches the UN CRPD standstill principle. The state secretary replied that the flat-rate per-kilometre system simplifies the rules, that some individuals will receive less, that the leefkilometers amount was raised to 925 euro with 1 million extra structurally, and that the change is compatible with the CRPD and will be monitored and evaluated.
The amendment of the scheme does not aim at a deterioration, but at a simplification and clarification of the fiscal support.
De wijziging van de regeling beoogt geen verslechtering, maar een vereenvoudiging en verduidelijking van de fiscale ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de Hersteloperatie Kindertoeslagen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about two court rulings (Rotterdam 2024, Midden-Nederland 2025) that found the Dienst Toeslagen must assess compensation for all years on a parent's file, whether telephone applications are still accepted, and how the government will avoid unnecessary litigation against victims of the childcare benefits scandal. The State Secretary accepted the rulings, said no appeal was lodged, confirmed telephone applications are no longer accepted because the deadline has passed but were confirmed in writing when they were, and stated the aim is generous compensation and avoiding litigation against parents.
The Dienst Toeslagen partly for this reason chose not to lodge an appeal in the two mentioned court cases.
Dienst Toeslagen heeft mede hierom ervoor gekozen om geen hoger beroep in te stellen in de twee genoemde rechtszaken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en van Nispen over het bericht dat commerciële beunhazen tientallen miljoen verdienen door een tekort aan structurele opvangplekken

SP MPs asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration how intermediary René Derkzen earned 44 million euros in emergency asylum reception contracts, whether the prices were market-conform, and how such commercial emergency reception will be ended. The minister acknowledged prices were too high, terminated the intermediary contract, said COA now contracts hotels directly, and pointed to the ongoing FIOD/Public Prosecution investigation as reason not to comment further on the case.
At this moment, pending the investigation by the FIOD and the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot respond further on substance to this matter.
Ik kan op dit moment, hangende het onderzoek van de FIOD en het Openbaar Ministerie, niet verder inhoudelijk reageren op deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over de kansen en risico’s van het gebruik van AI in de zorg

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the risks of AI in healthcare, including reports of clinicians losing skills (deskilling) and whether AI could replace one radiologist in breast cancer screening. The minister acknowledges both opportunities and risks, points to training, inspectorate oversight and AI-literacy duties, and says AI in breast screening is being prepared for use around 2028 with no change to recall intervals.
Healthcare institutions are themselves responsible for choosing and safely deploying AI applications within their organisation.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de keuze voor en veilige inzet van AI toepassingen binnen hun organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat het UMCG voorlopig operaties voor aangeboren hartafwijkingen schrapt

The SP asked the minister about the UMCG's decision to temporarily halt operations for congenital heart defects over concerns about social safety, quality of care and research integrity. The minister called the pause sensible for patients, said the umc arrangements must yield concrete results, and explained that patients are being referred to other centres while the UMCG investigates, though the substance of the concerns is left to the UMCG to disclose.
It is up to the UMCG to share more about the content of the concerns once the investigation has concluded.
Het is aan het UMCG om meer te delen over de inhoud van de zorgen, zodra het onderzoek hierna is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Zorginstituut: ’Prijzen dure geneesmiddelen onnodig lang hoog’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about a Zorginstituut report that prices of expensive medicines stay high too long, including evergreening practices, and whether the state should bring drug development into public hands. The Minister acknowledges concern about evergreening, reports 8 signals in 2025 versus 3 in 2024, says he lacks direct instruments and will respond to motion Thiadens by early 2026, and defends a role for industry while planning a joint advisory report and a fund proposal.
I expect to be able to address the adopted motion in more detail in early 2026.
Ik verwacht begin 2026 nader in te kunnen gaan op de aangenomen motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het artikel ‘Prijs medicijnen omhoog door eis Trump’

An SP MP asked the health minister about US pressure on drug prices and its effects on availability and affordability in the Netherlands, including transparency of pharmaceutical pricing and the possibility of joint EU procurement. The minister answered that effects are still unclear, outlined existing price-control instruments and ongoing work on a new reimbursement system, said confidential price agreements are accepted for access reasons, and committed to inform parliament once more is known.
I value better insight into development costs, pricing and the negotiated and actually paid prices for medicines, but I cannot enforce this.
Ik hecht waarde aan beter inzicht in de ontwikkelkosten, prijsstelling en de onderhandelde en werkelijk betaalde prijzen voor geneesmiddelen, maar kan deze niet afdwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het artikel ‘Acute zorg in Nederland kraakt onder een tekort aan personeel’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about the temporary closure of the acute care unit at Zuyderland hospital in Sittard-Geleen, rising emergency department stops, consequences for patients and regional equality of care. The minister answers that the closure is due to staff shortages, that regional partners and the inspectorate are monitoring, and that the government is preparing regulation and a handreiking on closing acute care, while stating it is not responsible for individual ward decisions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het opstappen van de Staatssecretaris van Financiën (Herstel en Toeslagen)

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister what message toeslagen victims receive when a responsible state secretary resigns, whether restoration will be delayed, and for the planning of each restoration route. The Prime Minister replied that Ms Palmen was sworn in again as state secretary on 5 September and that delays were expected to be kept to a minimum.

I am pleased that she was willing to take on this responsibility again and expect that, despite the political situation that has arisen, delays in the handling of restoration have been limited as much as possible.

Ik ben blij dat zij bereid is geweest om deze verantwoordelijkheid wederom te aanvaarden en verwacht dat hiermee de vertraging op de afhandeling van het herstel, ondanks de ontstane politieke situatie, zo veel mogelijk beperkt is gebleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht ‘Ouderen onnodige lang in het ziekenhuis’

MPs Dijk and Dobbe (SP) asked the health minister about a report that elderly patients stay in hospital unnecessarily long, and about related staffing, funding and care-organisation issues. The ministers answered that they are working with partners on primary care, care coordination, short-term care and a national framework for nursing-home admission, while denying that bureaucratic or financial barriers are the main cause and rejecting a reversal of Wlz budget cuts.
It is important that elderly people receive appropriate care and that a (too long) stay in hospital is prevented.
Het is belangrijk dat ouderen passende zorg ontvangen en dat een (te lang) verblijf in het ziekenhuis voorkomen wordt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de berichten 'Onderzoekers: uitbuiting schoonmakers Saints & Stars staat niet op zich' en 'Saints & Stars was geen incident: ongedocumenteerden houden Nederland draaiende'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of severe exploitation of undocumented workers in cleaning and hospitality, including the low number of prosecutions, the Labour Inspectorate's passive approach, fines, minimum wage and sector rules. The Minister acknowledged the problem, cited new enforcement powers, pending legislation and planned fine indexation, but declined to earmark fine revenue for undocumented workers and rejected a minimum wage hike to 18 euro as a targeted fix.

As indicated in the letter of 9 July 2025, it is therefore my intention to raise the fines under the Eerlijk Werk labour laws by taking into account fictitious indexation of recent years in the new standard amount.

Zoals aangegeven in de brief van 9 juli 2025 10 is het daarom mijn voornemen om de boetes van Eerlijk Werk arbeidswetten te verhogen door bij het nieuwe normbedrag rekening te houden met fictieve indexatie van de afgelopen jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over farmapiraterij en medicijnkaping

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why she does not actively demand transparency on pharma investments, press for lower prices, or take a firmer political stance on drug pricing and profit margins. The Minister answered that the development costs are not decisive in price negotiations, that she is working on societal-acceptability criteria (MAUG) with advisory bodies, and that she has limited ability to steer company profits given their international scope.
I cannot steer the level of company profits, mainly because these are international companies active worldwide.
Ik kan niet sturen op de hoogte van bedrijfswinsten, met name omdat het gaat om internationale bedrijven die wereldwijd actief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht '10 miljard euro aan zorggeld in zak criminelen, slechts handjevol fraudeurs vervolgd: 'Om te huilen''

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about a newspaper report claiming 10 billion euros of care funds ends up with criminals and few fraudsters are prosecuted, asking about prosecution numbers, recovery of funds, enforcement capacity and further measures. The minister disputes the press figures as incorrect, says the 10 billion is an unsubstantiated estimate, describes prosecution priorities and capacity constraints, and lists recent and planned anti-fraud measures.
There are no figures available on this.
Er zijn daarover geen cijfers voor handen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de motie-Dijk met het voorstel om de ACM het mandaat en de middelen te geven om de prijzen van boodschappen te reguleren

SP MP Dijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about implementing a motion to give the ACM competition authority powers to regulate and block grocery prices, and about price levels, ACM powers, market power and possible investigations. The minister replied that the government will not give the ACM price-regulation powers, citing a planned-economy risk and lower Dutch grocery prices than the EU average, while pointing to EU action on territorial supply restrictions and ACM's possible investigations.
Apart from territorial supply restrictions, the cabinet will not regulate grocery prices or give the ACM a power to do so.
Los van territoriale leveringsbeperkingen, gaat het kabinet de boodschappenprijzen niet reguleren, of de ACM hiervoor een bevoegdheid geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Bedrijf achter lokale cadeaupassen failliet: ‘Tienduizenden mensen geld kwijt’’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the bankruptcy of Groupcard, the firm behind local gift cards used by municipalities, covering questions on affected municipalities, procurement, oversight by DNB, recovery of funds and whether poverty policy should be outsourced. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for their own poverty policy and procurement, that the curator is investigating causes and that DNB cannot comment on individual institutions, while giving little concrete detail.
I do not have an overview of the municipalities affected by this bankruptcy and of the amounts involved.
Ik heb geen overzicht van gemeenten die door dit faillissement geraakt zijn en om welke bedragen het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de recente opleving in de overnamemarkt van tandartsketens

MP Dijk (SP) asks the Minister of Health about the 2025 revival of dental chain takeovers by private equity, citing risks to care quality, continuity, patient trust and supervision. The Minister answers that EY research finds no proven quality difference, that private equity can help continuity but financial motives are undesirable, points to the Wibz bill, NZa merger-control tightening, and says ACM cannot yet review series of small takeovers below thresholds, with a bill promised by end-2025.
I am working closely with the NZa to ensure that supervision of these obligations and conditions takes proper shape.
Ik werk nauw samen met de NZa om te zorgen dat het toezicht ten aanzien van deze verplichtingen en randvoorwaarden op een juiste manier vorm krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het uitvoeren van aangenomen voorstellen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why she should carry out motions adopted by the House, including on private equity, Zuyderland hospital departments, specialist employment, Heerlen birth care, and care budget cuts. The Minister replied that motions are taken seriously and implemented where feasible, but that hospitals decide their own service provision, and that unfunded motions cannot be implemented without cover.
Motions adopted by the House of Representatives carry significant weight.
Moties die zijn aangenomen door de Tweede Kamer hebben een belangrijke betekenis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘na Erasmus onderzoek maakt farmabedrijf oud medicijn onbetaalbaar’

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that Egetis raised the price of an old drug (tiratricol) after Erasmus MC research, including how many Dutch children use it, price limits, Erasmus MC's royalties, public control over medicine pricing, and patient involvement. The minister says the drug is not yet reimbursed, defers pricing and reimbursement to the Zorginstituut, notes ACM enforcement powers, and says broader pricing advice is pending, while declining to comment on the investment claims.
I have no insight into what investments the firm has specifically made or still needs to make to bring this medicine to the market everywhere.
Ik heb geen inzicht in welke investeringen de firma precies heeft gedaan of nog moet doen om dit geneesmiddel overal op de markt te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over de scheve verdeling in structurele asielopvangplekken tussen rijke en arme gemeenten

MPs Dijk and Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration why poorer municipalities host about five times more structural asylum reception than richer ones, questioning the Zutphen plan and the lack of contributions from wealthy municipalities. Minister Keijzer replied that the Dispersal Act requires each municipality to meet its allocated quota, that the Zutphen plan was dropped by the council, that the ministry will engage municipalities that fall short through interbestuurlijk toezicht, and that she agrees expensive emergency forms should be phased out.
The Ministry of Asylum and Migration will engage with municipalities that have not yet met their quota. Interadministrative supervision will be exercised over municipalities that do not comply.
Het Ministerie van Asiel en Migratie treedt in gesprek met gemeenten die hun opgave nog niet hebben gerealiseerd. Op gemeenten die hier niet aan voldoen wordt interbestuurlijk toezicht uitgeoefend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht dat chronisch zieken worden opgejaagd door vooringenomen controles van de Belastingdienst

Opposition MPs Dobbe and Dijk asked whether Tax Authority checks on deductions for specific healthcare costs profile chronically ill people with low incomes as high-risk, and how many people must repay amounts wrongly claimed. The State Secretary answered that checks target errors rather than fraud, that the authority does not profile on chronic illness, and that a simplification review of the regulation is underway.
Because of the importance for supervision, I cannot say exactly how the automated selection instruments work.
Vanwege het belang voor het toezicht kan ik niet precies zeggen hoe de geautomatiseerde selectie-instrumenten werken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Antonius Sneek trekt stekker uit plan voor nieuw ziekenhuis in Joure'

An SP MP asked the health minister about Antonius Sneek withdrawing from a planned merger and new hospital in Joure, including concerns about staff and local patients, and whether a moratorium on closing hospital units should be imposed. The minister said the hospital has withdrawn from the merger but remains committed to cooperation, that hospital boards bear responsibility for service provision, and that she declined a moratorium while pointing to existing legal consultation requirements.
I will continue to closely monitor the situation and will ask to be informed about the consequences of these recent developments.
Ik blijf de situatie nauw volgen en zal mij laten informeren over de gevolgen van deze recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht 'Winstnorm kan niet voorkomen dat zorggeld naar Porsches en paarden gaat'

MPs Dijk and Dobbe asked the minister whether profit-making in healthcare should be legally limited, whether a total ban on profit distribution is the answer, and whether oversight and transparency of care providers should be improved. The minister rejects a blanket profit ban, points to the pending Wibz bill, a planned exploration of licensing for subcontractors and solo providers, a Wmo oversight improvement trajectory and expanded annual reporting, while promising further assessment rather than immediate new rules.
I therefore want to carry out an exploration of a licensing requirement for subcontractors and solo practitioners.
Ik wil daarom een verkenning uitvoeren naar een vergunningplicht voor onderaannemers en solisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Dijk, Grinwis en Kouwenhoven over het belastinglek bij Duitse beleggingsfondsen

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a tax leak involving German real estate investment funds, including whether the state can still tax past gains and whether a step-up valuation loophole can be repaired. The State Secretary answered each of the 16 questions, stating that taxing past gains with retroactive effect is not justified and that the loophole will not be repaired.
In this case I currently see insufficient justification for measures to bring untaxed value increases from years before 2025 into the corporate tax base after all, that is, with retroactive effect.

Ik zie in het onderhavige geval vooralsnog onvoldoende rechtvaardiging om maatregelen te nemen die onbelaste waardestijgingen die zien op jaren vóór 2025 alsnog (dat wil zeggen met terugwerkende kracht) in de heffing van vennootschapsbelasting te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht dat ongediplomeerd personeel in dienst is bij zorgverleners

MPs Dijk and Dobbe (SP) asked the minister about reports that unqualified staff, including agency workers, were deployed in care roles requiring diplomas, and about the role of agency Allround Care. The minister said care providers are responsible for checking staff competence, declined to create new routes for unqualified staff, and noted the IGJ lacks nationwide incident data and cannot supervise staffing agencies directly, though it has reported individuals for fraud.
The IGJ has informed me that there have been incidents and calamities due to the deployment of unauthorised and incompetent staff, but that it does not keep figures on this.
De IGJ heeft mij laten weten dat er incidenten en calamiteiten zijn geweest door het inzetten van onbevoegd en onbekwaam personeel, maar dat zij daarover geen aantallen bijhoudt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over “het riante wachtgeld voor de opgestapte PVV-bewindslieden”

SP MPs Dijk and Van Nispen asked the Minister of the Interior whether the lengthy benefit scheme (Appa) for ex-politicians, including the departed PVV ministers, should be abolished or brought under the unemployment benefit rules, including its lack of a fault test. The minister rejected the 'wachtgeld' label, defended the Appa benefit as a safety net needed because of the confidence convention, and declined to abolish it or apply the WW fault test.
No, I am not willing to abolish the benefit scheme for former politicians.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid de uitkeringsregeling voor oud-politici af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Utrechts tandartsechtpaar vecht miljoenenruzie uit met keten die praktijk kocht’

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that a dental practice was bought by a chain (Fresh) that allegedly charged excessive fees, and whether investor ownership of dental practices should be curbed. The minister says the matter is for supervisors, that no signals were received by NZa or IGJ, and points to pending legislation (Wibz, tightened merger test) while rejecting a ban on private equity as disproportionate.
I am not aware of the contractual arrangements made between the parties. Nor is it up to me to judge this.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de contractuele afspraken die tussen partijen zijn gemaakt. Het is ook niet aan mij om hier een oordeel over te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat fysiotherapie buiten het basispakket zal vallen

The SP MP Dijk asked whether physiotherapy would be excluded from the basic health insurance package, with questions on access, costs, and evidence. The Minister answers that no decision has been taken to remove physiotherapy from the basic package, that access is not changing, and that the Health Care Institute has assessed the evidence for several indications.
No, this is not correct. There are no planned changes that would remove physiotherapy from the basic package.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Er zijn geen wijzigingen gepland waarmee fysiotherapie uit het basispakket wordt gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat Sabic verkoop van Chemelot fabrieken overweegt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government reacts to reports that Sabic is considering selling its European plants including Chemelot, and about nationalisation, consultation with authorities, subsidies and dependencies. The minister declined to comment on unconfirmed reports and company strategy, said talks with Sabic are confidential, and pointed to the Industry letter and a Europe-wide chemicals action plan.
It is not for the cabinet to comment on the business operations and strategy of individual companies.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om in te gaan op de bedrijfsvoering en strategie van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Haage over het bericht ‘Bij de hulporganisatie voor toeslagenouders heerst een onveilig werkklimaat’

MPs Dijk and Haage asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report of an unsafe work climate at the Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen (UHT), including shouting, discrimination, unwanted advances, and derogatory remarks about affected parents. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems as unacceptable, described the Berenschot investigation and follow-up measures such as team sessions and workshops, but declined to extend the investigation to other UHT locations.
I deeply regret that in some situations there may have been hurtful talk about the childcare benefits affair and/or the parents concerned.
Ik betreur het zeer dat in enkele situaties mogelijk op een kwetsende wijze is gesproken over de toeslagenaffaire en/of de betreffende ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht 'Na vier maanden strengere zzp-handhaving knelt het vooral nog in de zorg'

SP MPs Dobbe and Dijk asked the Minister of Health about strict enforcement against bogus self-employment in care, and about making employment in care more attractive. The minister said the Tax Authority will not impose fines on 2025 and will talk with businesses first, promised to pursue both tracks, and pointed to existing programmes on autonomy and a new workforce platform, but ruled out extra funds for pay increases.
I do not have figures on the number of self-employed workers who took up employment with care providers last year.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over het aantal zzp'ers dat afgelopen jaar in loondienst is getreden bij zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over de crisis in de ouderenzorg

Two MPs from the SP asked the State Secretary for Health about the crisis in elderly care, including staff problems, rising compulsory admissions, a lack of small-scale alternatives, staff shortages and the pay gap. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing programmes and a forthcoming Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg, and rejected extra pay funding beyond the annual wage-cost contribution due to fiscal constraints.
I am currently in talks with parties in the sector to reach a Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg (HLO).
Ik ben op dit moment met partijen in de sector in gesprek om tot een Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg (HLO) te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Dijk over “het bericht 'Noodfonds Energie slecht bereikbaar voor huishoudens'”

SP MPs Van Kent and Dijk asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that the Temporary Energy Emergency Fund was hard to reach, with queues and overloaded systems, and whether applicants in need could be excluded. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems and regretted that eligible households were turned away, but said the fund was closed due to its limited budget, that the Rijk will not add money, and that a future public energy fund will be developed under the Social Climate Fund.
I deeply regret when residents have called upon it in vain, or were too late, while they do belong to the target group.
Ik betreur ten zeerste als bewoners tevergeefs een beroep hebben gedaan, of te laat waren, terwijl zij wel tot de doelgroep behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Fysio om de hoek redt het vaak niet meer’

An SP MP asked the Minister and State Secretary of Health about reports that around half of self-employed physiotherapists and speech therapists are considering closing their practices, and what measures will prevent this. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, said the NZa has no concrete signals of insufficient care by insurers, and committed to an NZa market study with results expected in autumn 2025, while declining to endorse minimum tariffs or a 20% logopedia tariff increase before that study.
That is why I have asked the NZa to research how the market for paramedical care functions in its entirety.
Daarom heb ik de NZa gevraagd onderzoek te doen naar het functioneren van de markt voor de paramedische zorg in de volle breedte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over DUO-schulden van getroffen kinderen

An SP MP asked how many children recognised as affected by the childcare benefits scandal currently have or have had DUO student debt, their average and total debt, the cost of automatic write-off, and how much maatwerk compensation they received. The State Secretary replied that no data exist because the Wet Hersteloperatie Toeslagen gives no basis for sharing data on affected children, that the cabinet will not create a separate debt scheme, and that a write-off would be complex and maatwerk use by this group is not tracked.
Data on any DUO debts of this specific target group are therefore not available.
Gegevens van eventuele schulden bij DUO van deze specifieke doelgroep zijn daarom niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Ziekenhuisbaas: als we niet oppassen, verdwijnen behandelingen uit Fryslân'

The SP MP Dijk asked the Minister of Health about reports that Frisian hospitals may lose cancer treatments and reduce from four locations to three, including the use of transformation funds and the role of municipalities. The Minister answered that hospitals and insurers must manage the process with regional involvement, that budget financing for the SEH is being prepared, and that the transformation funds are not decisive, though she gave only partial answers and declined to assess some matters.
With this view I am following the decision-making process, which is scheduled for the end of March. I will inform you about it then.
Met deze blik volg ik de besluitvorming die volgens planning eind maart plaatsvindt. Ik zal u hier dan over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat de inflatie in februari is toegenomen

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether the February inflation rise matches expectations, what causes it and the gap with the EU average, whether profit-driven inflation is rising, and how purchasing power losses for 2025 will be corrected. The minister answers that the figure fits the CPB's forecast of 3.2% for 2025, attributes the gap to services inflation, a tight labour market and rent indexation, says profits and wages are economically explained, and states that the purchasing power change is mainly driven by lower pension indexation without new cabinet measures.
The February inflation figure fits the recent inflation forecast in the CPB's Central Economic Plan (CEP).
Het inflatiecijfer van februari past in de recente inflatieraming uit het CEP van het Centraal Planbureau (CPB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat een prijsplafond voor gas wordt overwogen

An MP asked whether the government would support an EU gas price cap, how it views state responsibility for gas security and affordability, the effect of energy taxes, the functioning of the energy emergency fund, and whether gas firms deliberately keep prices high. The minister responded that the Commission has no such proposal, the government is critical of market price caps, gas security is shared with the market, energy taxes are a small part of inflation, the emergency fund reached 110,937 households in 2024, and there is no evidence of deliberate price-raising by the sector.
The government sees no deliberate tactic by the gas sector to keep prices high in order to make more profit.
Het kabinet ziet geen bewuste tactiek van de gassector om de prijzen hoog te houden om zodoende meer winst te behalen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Diederik van Dijk, Van den Hil, Krul, Ceder, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Slagt-Tichelman, Kostić en Eerdmans over een solide toekomstplan voor Kamp Westerbork naar aanleiding van 80 jaar

MPs asked the government to respond to Kamp Westerbork memorial's financial shortfalls, deferred maintenance and the need for a sustainable future plan, and to say what it will do about the memorial's proposed plan and the Moluccan history. The state secretary answers that a solid future plan will be developed with the memorial centres, one-off 2025 funds have been reserved, the memorial's financing plan is under study, and an OHW letter on progress is expected around summer 2025.
I am studying this plan and looking at what role the central government can play in it.
Ik ben dit plan aan het bestuderen en bekijken welke rol de Rijksoverheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk en Haage over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Gelderland ECLI:NL:RBGEL:2024:7601 en het bericht op LinkedIn van 16 januari 2024

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Gelderland court ruling that a toeslagen victim is entitled to free legal aid for broad support, and why the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand appealed. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling, said the Raad filed a pro forma appeal to clarify the legal question, and argued that gemeentelijke brede ondersteuning falls under the normal Wrb income criteria.

On appeal, the question is whether there is an entitlement to free legal aid, regardless of income or assets, under the Subsidieregeling pakket rechtsbijstand herstelregelingen kinderopvangtoeslag 2023.

In hoger beroep staat ter discussie of er aanspraak bestaat op kosteloze rechtsbijstand, ongeacht inkomen of vermogen, op grond van de Subsidieregeling pakket rechtsbijstand herstelregelingen kinderopvangtoeslag 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het interview in de Volkskrant van 22 januari 2025

MP Dijk (SP) asks the State Secretary of Finance to explain and reflect on interview remarks about possible misuse of the childcare benefits scandal recovery operation and a 'real versus unreal victims' framing, and whether changing the law on penalty payments would prolong procedures. The State Secretary stands by her remarks, says she did not use the 'real and unreal victims' framing, commits to sending the underlying documents on possible legal changes, and says the recovery operation's objective is to speed up and improve it.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk, Teunissen en Stultiens over het rapport 'Takers, not makers'

MPs Dijk, Teunissen and Stultiens asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the Oxfam report 'Takers, not makers' on billionaire wealth, inheritance, wealth inequality, tax avoidance, global extraction and wealth taxes. The minister rejected the report's framing, arguing Dutch income inequality is low and stable and wealth inequality has fallen, while pointing to box 3 reform, existing tax measures and a planned review of anti-dividend-stripping options, without committing to higher taxes on wealth or inheritance.
This cabinet is not considering further raising the gift and inheritance tax rates for multi-million euro inheritances.
Dit kabinet overweegt niet de tarieven in schenk- en erfbelasting verder te verhogen voor miljoenenerfenissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht ‘Studenten boos om uitblijven loon bij stages in zorg’

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister whether UMCs excluding certain trainees from internship pay breaches the collective labour agreement, and whether the minister will act. The minister repeatedly answered that interpreting, enforcing and complying with the CAO is for the social partners (NFU and unions), and that she will not intervene.
Responsibility for enforcing and complying with the CAO lies with the CAO parties themselves.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de handhaving en naleving van de cao ligt bij cao-partijen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Ook na de pandemie boekt Pfizer nog een miljardenwinst’

An SP MP asked the health minister and finance state secretary about reports that Pfizer made multi-billion profits after the pandemic, including questions on tax contributions, government payments to Pfizer, pricing and monopoly power, and domestic production. The minister declined to give tax and contract-price details citing secrecy rules and said she cannot steer company profits, but committed to a policy advice on acceptable drug prices, a proposal for a public drug fund, and continued work on domestic production.
I cannot share information on the tax position of an individual taxpayer under the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act.
Ik kan geen informatie delen over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van art. 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het beboeten van supermarkten vanwege te veel ongezond voedsel

MPs asked whether supermarkets should be fined for selling too much unhealthy food, whether advertising and pricing can be restricted, and what the costs of removing VAT on healthy food would be. The state secretary said supermarkets bear a responsibility, that concrete agreements and monitoring of healthy-sales shares will be pursued, that a broad ban on food advertising lacks support while child-directed marketing rules are being prepared, that a bonus-malus scheme is doubtful, and that VAT removal on healthy food is rejected as too costly and legally unworkable.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de mogelijke sluiting van Gezondheidscentrum Kanaleneiland

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the possible closure of the Kanaleneiland health centre and who is responsible for keeping primary care accessible. The Minister answers that the GP, health insurers and municipalities share responsibility, that she will not intervene in this individual case, and points to the national housing handreiking and planned follow-up work.
However, it is not my role to interfere in specific casuistry, such as the matter concerning the health centre in Kanaleneiland.
Het is echter niet mijn rol om mij te mengen in specifieke casuïstiek, zoals de kwestie bij het gezondheidscentrum in Kanaleneiland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Dijk over de artikelen 'Er zijn genoeg leraren, maar ze staan niet voor de klas', 'The hidden reserve of nurses and teachers in the Netherlands' en 'Increasing the working hou

MPs Beckerman and Dijk (SP) asked why the hidden reserve of qualified teachers and nurses exceeds current shortages and what measures the government will take to activate it, including flexible working hours and reducing workload. The Staatssecretaris answered that taking up work is an individual choice, that the government pursues broader labour market policy (salaries, workload funding, a teacher campaign, admin reduction in care), and that several measures such as strategic personnel policy and a Monitor Zeggenschap are underway, but did not commit to a specific plan for the reserve.
Directly approaching or writing to the hidden reserve is technically not possible under the GDPR.
Het direct benaderen en/of aanschrijven van de stille reserve is AVG technisch niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het sluiten van filialen van de Volksbank

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether branch closures at the state-owned Volksbank are a good development, whether reorganisation is necessary, and whether a public deposit bank could protect public interests. The Minister replied that the bank sets its own commercial strategy and the state may not interfere under ACM conditions, that a public deposit bank is not realistic, and pointed to sector-wide measures instead.
Under the ACM measures, NLFI and the state may not interfere with the Volksbank's commercial strategy, such as the number of branches or the choice of brand name.
In het kader van de ACM-maatregelen mogen NLFI en de staat zich niet bemoeien met de commerciële strategie van de Volksbank, zoals het aantal filialen of de keuze voor een merknaam.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden lid Inge van Dijk en Dijk over het bericht ‘Rechter geeft Renate en Jeroen uit Nijverdal gelijk: 'Weer een baanbrekend vonnis voor alle slachtoffers van toeslagenschandaal'’

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why the state litigated against parents seeking independent expert assessment of their childcare-benefit scandal damages, what the court case costs, and whether the inquiry's remit will cover children. The government says it offers several out-of-court routes with independent experts, that it opposed appointing court experts for procedural and causal-link reasons, that it partly lost in court, and that it will consider children's position via the advisory commission but will not amend the remit now.
The State regrets that the parents lost confidence in that independent expert and that this prompted them to submit the request to the court.
De Staat betreurt het dat de ouders het vertrouwen in die onafhankelijke deskundige zijn verloren en dit voor de ouders aanleiding was om dit verzoek bij de rechter in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over private equity die jaagt op corporatiemiljarden

An SP MP asked the Minister about private equity firms acquiring maintenance companies working for housing corporations, and whether this raises costs and prices. The minister replied that such investment fits an open economy, that cost increases cannot be attributed to it, and that the regulator and competition authority will keep monitoring developments.
This development fits within an open economy and I currently see no signals that cause me concern.
Deze ontwikkeling past binnen een open economie en ik zie vooralsnog geen signalen die mij zorgen baren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de deelneming Schiphol Group

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether Schiphol Group, a state holding, lives up to its expected exemplary role on occupational health (exposure to aircraft engine emissions, heavy lifting by baggage handlers) and on the planned security tender. The minister answered that employers and Schiphol bear primary responsibility, that the Labour Inspectorate and the government are monitoring, that Schiphol has committed to more lifting aids and audits, and that the security tender is a legal and organisational matter for Schiphol.
As shareholder of Schiphol, I support Schiphol's initiatives to improve working conditions.
Als aandeelhouder van Schiphol ondersteun ik de initiatieven van Schiphol om de arbeidsomstandigheden te verbeteren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk, Stultiens, Vijlbrief, Koekkoek, Grinwis en Ergin over de brandbrief van enkele fracties inzake voortgang van de Hersteloperatie Toeslagen na het aftreden van Staatssec

Seven MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister to respond to a letter raising concern that the Toeslagen recovery operation was stalling after the resignation of State Secretary Achahbar. The new State Secretary Palmen responded that a rapid-advice commission will report on 23 January, a pilot for bereaved relatives has started, the claims portal opens in late January, and the government commits to finishing Integrale Beoordelingen by end 2025, while acknowledging backlogs in objections and dossier provision.
This commission has the task, with regard to the needs of those affected, of examining how the implementation of the Toeslagen recovery operation can be accelerated and improved.
Deze commissie heeft tot taak om, met oog voor de behoeften van de gedupeerden, te onderzoeken op welke wijze de uitvoering van de hersteloperatie toeslagen kan worden versneld en verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over financiële en zakelijke belangen

An MP asked ministers and state secretaries about their financial and business interests, including whether their holdings are below 25,000 euro, whether these could influence cabinet decisions, and whether they would disclose them. The state secretary confirmed the interests, said a formation procedure safeguarded against conflicts of interest, and declined to share details of the holdings, pointing to the earlier answers.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Toekomst Spaarne Gasthuis Haarlem nog ongewis: "Grote zorg dat Noord verdwijnt"?’

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views reports that Spaarne Gasthuis in Haarlem may close or hollow out its Haarlem Noord site, and whether she will intervene and act on staff shortages and local democratic involvement. The minister replied that the hospital says no locations will close, that the government lacks power to force services at specific sites, and that she will issue a handreiking on acute care consultation in summer 2025 and address staff shortages through planned measures.
The national government also has no authority to keep locations open and cannot force the hospital to provide certain care at certain locations.
De landelijke politiek heeft ook geen bevoegdheid om locaties open te houden en kan het ziekenhuis niet dwingen bepaalde zorg op bepaalde locaties te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Grote prijsverschillen aanvullende zorgverzekering en mes in vergoeding orthodontie’

An SP MP asks the Health Minister about large price differences and waiting periods in supplementary health insurance, including effects on children's orthodontics, competition between insurers, and income-dependent premiums. The minister replies that supplementary insurance is private and outside government control, that insurers set their own terms under DNB and ACM supervision, and that the government will discuss some services' inclusion in the basic package and send a letter on market competition in healthcare.
There is no framework for care in supplementary insurance and there are no statutory rules on waiting times.
Er is geen kader voor de zorg in de aanvullende verzekering en er zijn geen wettelijke regels over wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Ommelander Ziekenhuis vraagt uitstel rente tot 2027, provincie weigert’

MP Dijk (SP) asked the Health Minister how she views the report that Ommelander Ziekenhuis wants interest deferral on a provincial loan until 2027 while the province refuses, and whether the government will financially rescue the hospital, share its plans, and grant democratic control over hospitals. Minister Agema answers that the hospital bears primary responsibility for its finances, that no Early Warning notification has been received, that contracts for 2025 are in place and Menzis is working on a long-term plan due spring 2025, and that she will pursue sector reforms and a guidance document while rejecting direct democratic control of private hospitals.
The hospital first of all bears responsibility itself for the financial situation and business operations.
Het ziekenhuis draagt allereerst zelf verantwoordelijkheid voor de financiële situatie en bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en van Nispen over het nieuws dat veel kinderen in erbarmelijke omstandigheden wonen in de asielnoodopvang in Nederland

MPs Dijk and van Nispen asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the rising number of children living in harsh conditions in emergency asylum shelters, and whether this breaches children's rights, harms education and health care, and what steps will be taken. The minister acknowledges the pressure on reception capacity, admits emergency sites are poorly suited to children, and describes existing measures and ongoing talks, but gives no firm timeline for ending child placements in emergency shelters.
With the current pressure on reception capacity, however, it cannot be said by when children will no longer be housed in emergency shelters.
Met de huidige druk op de opvangcapaciteit is echter niet te zeggen op welke termijn het niet meer voor zal komen dat kinderen op noodopvanglocaties verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de loonruimte voor apotheekmedewerkers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health how much of the government's labour-cost allowance for pharmacy care reached insurers' tariffs, whether the 368 million euro is available for wage negotiations, and who is responsible for failed wage increases for pharmacy staff. The Minister said the OVA index is the starting point for negotiations but cannot verify individual contracts, that the 368 million is an integrated part of the pharmacy-care budget mostly for material costs, and that VWS is not a party to tariff or collective bargaining.
To assess that, insight would be needed into all individual contract negotiations between health insurers and providers in pharmacy care. I do not have that insight.
Daarvoor zou inzicht nodig zijn in alle individuele contractonderhandelingen tussen zorgverzekeraars en aanbieders binnen de apotheekzorg. Dat inzicht heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over private equity in de accountancy

The SP MP Dijk asks the Finance Minister whether private equity ownership of accountancy firms threatens audit quality, independence, and access for small firms and clients, citing expert and AFM concerns. The minister acknowledges the risks and says he is monitoring developments, points to existing Wta independence safeguards and the pending Wijzigingswet accountancysector, but sees no current need for further statutory measures and no signals of harm to small clients.
That is why I am closely monitoring developments regarding private equity in the accountancy sector.
Daarom houd ik de ontwikkelingen van private equity in de accountancysector goed in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Maatoug over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris belangen in bedrijven geheim houdt

MPs Dijk and Maatoug asked the State Secretary for Finance whether his business shareholdings, reported in the formateur's report, could influence his policy and why he has not disclosed them openly. The State Secretary answered that his interests are placed at arm's length under the Landsadvocaat's assessment and that disclosure of company names is a matter for the official to weigh, while not fully committing to publish the holdings.
It is likewise for the official approached to weigh, given the business and financial interests and the arrangement to be made, whether the names of the companies concerned can be reported.

Het is eveneens aan de aangezochte bewindspersoon om te wegen, gelet op de zakelijke en financiële belangen en de te treffen voorziening, of de namen van de betrokken vennootschappen gemeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het einde van het gunstig belastingregime voor private equity in Engeland

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the UK's proposed end to favourable tax treatment of carried interest for private equity and whether the Dutch carried-interest regime, including the partial foreign tax liability option, is fair. The state secretary said the UK is consulting on reform, that the Dutch regime has provided clarity since 2009, that a review of the lucrative-interest scheme is underway with results promised before the Christmas recess, and that the partial foreign tax liability option is being abolished from 2025.
The intention is to share the results of this review with your House before the Christmas recess.
Het voornemen is de resultaten van dit onderzoek vóór het kerstreces met uw Kamer te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Voorrang geven aan mensen in ziekenhuis die er het ergst aan toe zijn: ’Voor andere patiënten is triage een drama''

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about a report that triage in hospitals gives priority to the most urgent patients while others face long waits, with 46 percent of treatments exceeding the Treek waiting-time norm in 2023. The minister says waiting times are a concern, points to agreements with sector parties and a review of triage strengthening, and states there is no room for extra funding beyond the existing wage allowance.
Together with the field parties I am committed to keeping waiting times within the Treek norms, so that people can be helped as quickly as possible.
Samen met de veldpartijen zet ik mij ervoor in de wachttijden binnen de Treeknormen te houden, zodat mensen zo snel mogelijk geholpen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Zorgcowboys worden nog nauwelijks aangepakt: verdacht hoge winst, meer dividend en minder controle’

MP Dijk (SP) asks the health minister about reports of high profits, dividend payouts and weak control among care providers ('zorgcowboys'), and about the Court of Audit's findings on fraud, information sharing and fraud-resistant regulation. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to the Wbsrz information-sharing law effective 1 January 2025, the planned Wibz bill with basic conditions on profit distribution, and new licensing and refusal grounds, but adds no extra inspection funding.
I do want to set limits on excessive profit distributions in healthcare, and protect healthcare against those entrepreneurs who put financial interest above patient interest.
Ik wil wel paal en perk stellen aan excessieve winstuitkeringen in de zorg, en de zorg beschermen tegen die ondernemers die het financieel belang in plaats van het patiënten belang vooropstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Jetten, Dijk, Ouwehand, Bikker, Dassen en Van Baarle over de uitzetting van de elfjarige Mikael

MPs asked the government whether it could grant a residence permit to eleven-year-old Mikael and his mother despite a Council of State ruling, and why the child-amnesty rules required being 'in beeld' with the immigration chain. The minister answered that residence permits require a statutory basis, that the discretionary power was replaced in 2019 and is limited to harsh circumstances in the first application, and that the government will not take measures to prevent harsh outcomes in individual cases.
The cabinet does not intend to take these measures.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om deze maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Lange wachttijden voorkomen? Privé-kliniek aast op ’makkelijke’ patiënt’

An SP MP asked the health minister about private clinics (zbc's) drawing easy, planned care away from hospitals, profit leakage to shareholders, staff poaching, and risks to acute care, and asked for profit data and contacts with clinic representatives. The minister answered that zbc's are a valuable complement, that a balanced care landscape and equal starting positions are the aim, that a Wibz bill against excessive profit distribution will be sent in Q1 2025, that acute care will be moved to fixed budgets, and that a letter on market forces will follow this autumn, but she declined to provide clinic profit figures, saying the ministry does not hold them.
The Ministry of VWS does not have such an overview.
Het Ministerie van VWS beschikt niet over zo'n overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht «Blokkade in Amsterdamse zorgketen door omzetplafonds vvt»

MPs Dobbe and Dijk (SP) asked about Amsterdam care providers halting admissions after reaching turnover caps, and whether caps block access to geriatric rehabilitation and palliative care and conflict with insurers' duty of care. The State Secretary says caps are an insurer tool to allocate scarce capacity, that insurers must arrange alternative timely care under the duty of care supervised by the NZa, and that the government will examine legislative changes to make palliative care a regular part of care.
It is the task of health insurers to allocate this scarce staff capacity and scarce resources as well as possible and ideally to ensure they reach the people who need care most.

Het is de taak van zorgverzekeraars om deze schaarse personele inzet en schaarse middelen zo goed mogelijk te verdelen en idealiter terecht te laten komen bij de mensen die de zorg het hardst nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat zorgzzp’ers de belastingdienst vrezen

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that care freelancers fear the tax authority, whether enforcement will drive them out of care, and whether employers should be steered toward fixed staff and flexible-workforce limits. The minister answers that enforcement against false self-employment is intended to improve care continuity, that she does not expect mass exits, and that she is pursuing a fixed-staff-first approach via a leidraad, a campaign and dialogues with sector bodies, while declining to set a maximum share of flexible workers.
There is no "reasonable percentage" of an external flexible workforce that can be named.
Er is geen «redelijk percentage» van een externe flexibele schil te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de bevoegdheden van de ACM en het beschermen van consumenten voor de gevolgen van marktmacht

An SP MP asked the Economics minister how to respond to ACM warnings that serial small acquisitions ('buy and build') create local market power and harm consumers, and whether the Competition Act should be modernised with a call-in power and a new competition tool. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the government is studying the problem and will send a letter soon, and noted ACM can already act under existing competition law.

For this reason my ministry is examining the possibility of extending the Competition Act with a New Competition Tool, with the aim of formulating remedies after market research specifically aimed at addressing these distortions.
Om die reden onderzoekt mijn ministerie de mogelijkheid om de Mededingingswet uit te breiden met een New Competition Tool, met als doel om na het doen van marktonderzoek remedies te formuleren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht ‘Kwart verzorgenden denkt aan stoppen’

Two MPs from the SP asked the health minister about a survey showing a quarter of care workers considering quitting, covering workload, salaries, administrative burden, budget cuts and the staffing norm in nursing homes. The minister acknowledged the problem, outlined plans on administrative relief, digitalisation and a leidraad on work pleasure, but declined to raise salaries beyond existing OVA funds and said she cannot influence the quality standard's staffing norm.
It is therefore not within my power to carry out the wish to maintain the staffing norm.
Het ligt daarom niet binnen mijn mogelijkheid om de wens de personele bezettingsnorm te handhaven uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Dijk over het advies van NLFI over de toekomstopties voor de Volksbank

An MP asks the Finance Minister how the government responds to NLFI's advice to privatise the Volksbank, and about its effects on banking stability, its public values, market concentration, SME financing, branch access and whether it can stay in public hands. The minister responds that the Volksbank is a commercial bank, that privatisation would not affect stability, that a separate analysis already showed a state bank is not required to secure public interests, and points to other existing instruments and the ongoing accessibility programme.
Neither NLFI nor the state can require the Volksbank to act as an investment bank for SMEs, a regional development bank, or to maintain branches.
NLFI, noch de staat, kunnen van de Volksbank vragen zich op te stellen als investeringsbank voor het mkb, ontwikkelingsbank in de regio of loketten te behouden.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Maatoug, Stultiens, Grinwis, Teunissen, Dijk, Van Baarle, Vijlbrief en Dassen over de kosten van het afschaffen van de belasting op de inkoop van eigen aandelen

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance about a SOMO study criticising the revenue estimate for abolishing the share buyback tax facility, including its data basis, behavioural assumptions and whether a new CPB estimate should be requested. The State Secretary answered that the estimate used the best available data at the time, explained the 70% behavioural discount, noted the cabinet has since kept the facility so no new study is needed, but will discuss updating the research with SOMO and SEO.
I will discuss this with both SOMO and SEO.
Ik zal hiervoor met zowel SOMO als SEO in gesprek treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Kent over het stopzetten van het Programma Schoolmaaltijden

MPs Dijk and Van Kent asked the Prime Minister about halting the School Meals Programme, citing a letter from 2,100 schools, the Red Cross and the Jeugdeducatiefonds, and asked how the government would secure funding. The state secretary replied that the programme will be continued structurally after 2024 with €135 million per year, with details to follow.
That is why the cabinet has decided to continue the programme structurally after 2024.
Daarom heeft het kabinet besloten het programma structureel voort te zetten na 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over het verwijderen van brievenbussen door PostNL

MPs Dijk and Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why PostNL may remove letterboxes, especially outside cities, and how it protects elderly and offline residents, whether it still meets legal distance rules, and whether postal service should be market-based. The minister answered that PostNL may remove boxes within legal distance limits (1 km or 2.5 km), that it must consult consumer and local bodies and respond in writing, that ACM supervises compliance, and that a policy review on postal service improvement is under way.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises this as the regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) houdt hier als toezichthouder toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht 'Zorgen over verkeerde hulp aan eenzame mensen door 'aanbestedingscircus'

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about reports that competitive tendering of loneliness support produces offers that do not really help lonely people and breaks care relationships, and about the status of a motion to abolish mandatory tendering. The Minister answered that municipalities choose how to finance such help, that tendering is not legally mandatory, that continuity can be safeguarded through contract design and monitoring, and that the Ketenbureau will be strengthened to support municipalities.
There is no general statutory obligation in the social domain to tender.
Er is geen algemene wettelijke verplichting in het sociaal domein om aan te besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Veel Nederlandse tandartsen gaan binnenkort met pensioen, alleen in Italië studeren er minder nieuwe af’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that the Netherlands trains fewer dentists than most of Europe, the shortage it creates, and private equity's role. The minister said the government is working towards the Capaciteitsorgaan's minimum advice of 345 places but has capped intake at 259 for 2024, and noted regional shortages and the high share of foreign-trained dentists.
Yes. Work is being done step by step towards the minimum advice of the Capaciteitsorgaan.
Ja. Er wordt stapsgewijs toegewerkt naar het minimumadvies van het Capaciteitsorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Dienst Toeslagen gaat zélf toeslagen verlagen bij foute aanvraag bij burgers die niet reageren op belletjes’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a pilot by Dienst Toeslagen that unilaterally adjusts childcare and income-based benefit advances for people who fail to respond to notifications, and about its risks for vulnerable people. The State Secretary answers that the pilot is a service measure with safeguards, a follow-up evaluation due January 2025, and that the reported 300 million euro saving was not a motive.
I will inform you about this in the semi-annual progress letter on benefits.
Ik zal u hierover informeren in de halfjaarlijkse stand van zakenbrief toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bezoek aan het Zuyderland Ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked Minister Agema about her working visit to Zuyderland hospital in Heerlen, including the consultation process, whether Parkstad was sufficiently involved, the future of the emergency department, intensive care and obstetrics, and market-based financing. The minister answered that she listened to stakeholders, does not decide on the regional care organisation, pointed to the coalition agreement commitment to keep regional hospitals open, and promised further details in forthcoming letters and a meeting with the Limburg governor.
I do not decide on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Bushoff over de problemen bij het aanvragen van de financiële ondersteuning voor zorgmedewerkers met post-COVID

MPs Dijk (SP) and Bushoff (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Health about problems healthcare workers with post-COVID face applying for the one-off financial support, including slow DUS-I handling, missed objection deadlines, lost-looking documents and difficulty obtaining medical statements. Minister Agema largely acknowledges the problems and some delays while defending the scheme, saying the second application round is better resourced and that the Regeling was amended to address earlier gaps.
To my regret, the processing period for these objection cases has in many cases been exceeded.
Tot mijn spijt is de behandeltermijn van deze bezwaarzaken in veel gevallen wel overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Acuut gebrek aan medicijn, probleem bij kinderkanker’

An MP asked the Health Minister about a shortage of etoposide affecting childhood cancer treatment, its patient impact, supply chain vulnerabilities and possible stockpiling or domestic production. The minister answered that alternative treatments and supply measures are in place, that new stocks are expected soon, and that a critical medicines list and possible regulation will follow once finances are clear.
I am certainly willing to make new laws and regulations, or to amend existing ones, if this can prevent shortages.
Ik ben zeker bereid nieuwe wet- en regelgeving te maken, of deze aan te passen als dit tekorten kan voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Opnieuw fors financieel tekort Gelre Ziekenhuizen'

An SP MP asked the Minister about reports of a large financial deficit at Gelre Ziekenhuizen, including the hospital director's remarks on planning more patients, closure of Zutphen maternity and limited ER hours, and the role of insurers. The Minister said hospital management is the providers' responsibility, no Early Warning System report was received, and she will not give detailed financial insight, while noting earlier meetings and committing to no new concrete action beyond existing motions and the coming regeerprogramma.
I do not have detailed insight into the financial situation of Gelre Ziekenhuizen. Moreover, the financial management of an individual hospital organisation is not my responsibility.

Ik heb geen gedetailleerd inzicht in de financiële situatie van Gelre Ziekenhuizen. Daarnaast valt de financiële huishouding van een individuele ziekenhuisorganisatie niet onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat private equity fors investeert in zorg en gezondheid en steeds vaker in gespecialiseerde klinieken investeren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about private equity investment in healthcare, its motives, profit extraction, the Co-Med case, the share of private equity in care, and whether it should be curbed or banned. The minister answered that she sees risks when financial interests outweigh patient interests, will propose legislation in early 2025 on integrity of business operations and give the NZa stronger powers to assess mergers, but judges a full ban disproportionate.
I will present a bill in the first quarter of 2025 to safeguard integrity of business operations.
Ik kom in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 met een wetsvoorstel om integere bedrijfsvoering te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat het Zuid-Hollandse ziekenhuis Alrijne een deel van de spoedzorg sluit en operaties uitstelt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about the temporary closure of parts of acute care and postponement of operations at Alrijne hospital after a laboratory provider switch, and whether government policy was to blame. The minister answered that the cause was operational problems at the new lab supplier Eurofins SCAL, that the IGJ was informed, acute care reopened fully by 23 July, and that the government bears no responsibility.
The problems were not caused by government policy.
De problemen zijn niet veroorzaakt door regeringsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Fysiotherapeuten rennen het vak uit’ en het onderzoek van Fysiovakbond FDV

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that many physiotherapists are leaving first-line care, citing low tariffs, pay gaps, unpaid overtime and holiday pay problems. The Staatssecretaris answered that primary responsibility lies with employers and collective bargaining, that the government will pursue a package of measures and a five-year bundled-payment experiment, and declined to set or ring-fence tariffs.
It is, however, primarily the responsibility of employers to ensure they can attract and retain sufficient staff.
Het is wel primair een verantwoordelijkheid van werkgevers om ervoor te zorgen dat zij voldoende personeel weten aan te trekken én te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de berichten 'Problemen Ommelander Ziekenhuis waren te voorspellen’ en 'Miljoenenverlies voor ziekenhuis Viecurie financiële hulp nodig'
