An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about financial distress at the Ommelander and VieCuri hospitals, including whether hospital closures and public access to care could be prevented. The Minister attributed the losses mainly to price and wage increases, rising sickness absence and staff shortages, said the hospitals were not in an uncontrollable situation according to the NZa and IGJ, and placed primary responsibility for regional care with insurers and providers while promising to keep regional hospitals open.
I have not received an EWS notification about Ommelander Ziekenhuis, nor any informal signals from the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa).
Ik heb over Ommelander Ziekenhuis geen EWS-melding gehad en ook geen informele signalen ontvangen van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het tekort aan het medicijn prednisolon

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about shortages of the drug prednisolone, the risks to patients, emergency domestic production, the reimbursement burden under preferential-drug policy, and a motion on essential medicines. The Minister acknowledged the shortage, pointed to an import-permit decision by the IGJ, said the list of critical medicines and any production plan depend on the list's completion and available funds, and promised a letter after the summer.
I intend to send your House a letter after the summer with a first overview of my ambitions regarding (expensive) medicines and availability.
Ik heb het voornemen om uw Kamer na de zomer een brief te sturen met daarin een eerste overzicht van mijn ambities op het gebied van (dure) geneesmiddelen en beschikbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Vrees voor omvallen van Co-Med in Enschede: wie zouden 9.000 patiënten kunnen overnemen?'

Dutch MP Dijk (SP) asked the minister about the risk of Co-Med GP practices collapsing, leaving about 9,000 patients without a GP, plus related questions on private equity, a motion for a ban and the ministry's contingency plans. The minister said the insurers have terminated Co-Med contracts and offered an alternative, that the IGJ and NZa are monitoring daily, and that the government sees insufficient grounds for a private-equity ban, while promising to send internal documents on Co-Med after the April bankruptcy.
I will send your House the requested internal documents as soon as possible on developments at Co-Med after the bankruptcy on 16 April 2024 of PCC Tele-Services Amsterdam.
Ik zal uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk de gevraagde ambtelijke stukken sturen over ontwikkelingen bij Co-Med na het faillissement op 16 april 2024 van PCC Tele-Services Amsterdam.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dijk over signalen dat een grote groep mensen ten onrechte een brief heeft ontvangen van de IND waarin wordt aangegeven dat zij geen rechtmatig verblijf zouden hebben in Nede

MPs Van Nispen and Dijk asked why Dienst Toeslagen sent letters stopping allowances based on IND residence codes, causing distress and wrongful loss of benefits for some EU citizens, and asked about compensation, legal aid and prevention. The government admits a system design error, says about 800 letters were sent with 180 later reinstated, and defends the approach while promising to reinstate and not claw back benefits where residence is confirmed.
The cabinet finds it highly undesirable that persons who are not lawfully residing in the Netherlands and therefore have no entitlement to allowances receive them.
Het kabinet vindt het zeer onwenselijk dat personen niet rechtmatig in Nederland verblijven en dus geen recht hebben op toeslagen deze ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Ingrijpen zorgverzekeraars duwt huisartsenketen Co-Med nog dieper in de problemen'

The MP Dijk (SP) asks the Minister for Medical Care about the collapse risk of the GP chain Co-Med, the insurers' termination of contracts, reports of an unsafe incident and the rejected private-equity ban motion. The Minister answers that continuity of care is paramount, that insurers and inspectorates are acting first, that some documents will be sent after consulting stakeholders, and that the government sees insufficient grounds for a private-equity ban.
I will send your House the requested official documents on developments at Co-Med after the bankruptcy on 16 April 2024 of PCC Tele-Services Amsterdam, a subsidiary of Co-Med, as soon as possible.

Ik zal uw Kamer de gevraagde ambtelijke stukken over de ontwikkelingen bij Co-Med na het faillissement op 16 april 2024 van PCC Tele-Services Amsterdam, een dochteronderneming van Co-Med, zo spoedig mogelijk sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk, Bushoff en Bikker over het bericht ‘Overheid wilde vooral niet te veel uitgeven aan compensatie ‘zorghelden’ met long covid’

MPs Dijk, Bushoff and Bikker asked whether the government deliberately limited compensation for healthcare workers with long COVID to contain costs, and why the claim process was so burdensome and so few were compensated. The minister answers that the scheme was a gesture of recognition rather than driven by cost or litigation, acknowledges the application process was strict, and announces a reopened application window with a higher amount and wider sick-leave period.
The cost aspect never played a central role in this.
Het kostenaspect heeft hierbij nooit vooropgestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat landen van de Europese Unie (EU) 33 miljoen euro per uur mislopen door de fiscale behandeling van superrijken

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister and State Secretary about reports that EU states lose 33 million euro per hour to the tax treatment of super-rich individuals, including wealth distribution, effective tax burdens, revenue losses and wealth registers. The government answered that it upholds that the strongest shoulders bear the heaviest burden, cited Dutch wealth concentration data, said tax avoidance cannot be precisely measured, and committed to exploring a stepwise EU/OECD approach and improved wealth statistics without committing to a wealth register.
It is therefore currently not possible to estimate how much tax revenue is missed due to a lower tax burden than intended, or to break down which combination of schemes causes this.

Het is daarom nu niet mogelijk een schatting te maken van hoeveel belastinginkomsten er gemist worden door een lagere belastingdruk dan is beoogd en een decompositie te maken door welke (combinatie van) regelingen dit veroorzaakt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het falende communicatiesysteem voor medische noodhulp in Overijssel

An MP asked the ministers whether the new communication system for emergency medical care in Overijssel, which makes ambulances and trauma helicopters unreachable, is acceptable, how many incidents occurred, and why the decentralised system was chosen and not acted on earlier. The minister answered that the IGJ received only two PTT complaints and no incident reports, that the regional ambulance service chose the app, and that a kwartiermaker is working on the broader missiekritische communicatie problem.
Recently, no reports about PTT have been received by the IGJ.
Recent zijn er geen meldingen bij de IGJ over PTT binnengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Maatoug en Dijk over belastingontwijking door de rijkste vrouw van Nederland

MPs Stultiens, Maatoug and Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by the richest woman in the Netherlands, including dividend-free capital repayments, the 5% participation exemption, and micro-company reporting rules. The government condemned tax avoidance but said capital repayments are lawful, declined to quantify or stop the routes, and promised only further study and EU-level work.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Spoedpoli St Jansdal in Lelystad sluit ’s avonds'

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care why the Lelystad St Jansdal emergency department closes in the evenings, whether residents and municipalities can block such decisions, and whether the Minister will intervene. The Minister answers that hospitals and insurers decide on regional acute care, that she will not prevent the change or grant municipalities a binding say, and that the parliamentary motions cannot be executed yet.
I am not going to prevent the opening hours of the Spoedpoli in Lelystad from being changed.
Ik ga niet voorkomen dat de openingstijden van de Spoedpoli in Lelystad worden aangepast.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de berichten 'Bestuurders UMCG declareren voor ton aan autoritten en 15.000 euro voor trip VS' en 'Ziekenhuisbestuurders houden zich niet aan declaratie-afspraken'

MPs Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of very high expense claims by hospital board members (UMCG) and widespread non-compliance with declaration agreements. The Minister said individual expense claims are a matter between supervisory and management boards, called for transparency, relied on self-regulation via the Governancecode Zorg with talks planned, and declined to set caps or legal duties.
I do not have the ability to cap hospital expense claims, because such arrangements fall under self-regulation.
Ik heb niet de mogelijkheid om declaraties van ziekenhuizen te maximeren, omdat zulke afspraken onder zelfregulering vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'MST en ZGT raken hun patiënten niet kwijt en lopen daardoor miljoenen aan omzet mis'

The SP MP Dijk asked the minister about reports that patients stay too long in hospital because discharge to nursing homes, rehabilitation or home care is blocked, and about related costs and capacity. The minister answered all eleven questions, saying the data on the number of affected patients and net savings is not available, and pointing to care coordination and existing agreements.
I have no insight into the net saving per patient because part of the information needed to calculate it is missing.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de netto besparing per patiënt omdat een deel van de informatie, om dit te berekenen, ontbreekt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de berichten ‘Chronisch zieke Anneke uit Buitenpost moet 16.000 euro terugbetalen aan Belastingdienst: “Het vreet me op”’ en ‘Excuses Belastingdienst voor chronisch zieke Bruinsma

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports of a chronically ill woman ordered to repay about 16,000 euros to the Tax Authority over disallowed specific care costs, and asked whether the treatment reflects distrust and harshness. The State Secretary acknowledged the regulation is being reviewed, said the Tax Authority aims to prevent such corrections, explained that refunds follow from statutory rules, declined to comment on the individual case still under objection, and provided figures on corrections and penalties from 2010 to 2022.
I cannot go into individual case details.
Ik kan niet op individuele casuïstiek ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dijk over barrières voor sociaal advocaten om toeslagenouders juridisch bij te staan

SP MPs asked the government why the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand reverted the temporary 0.5 unit weighting for childcare-benefit (toeslagen) cases, lowering the number of parents each lawyer can help, and raised concerns about information withholding, procedural obstacles and the position of children in the restoration scheme. The State Secretary answered that the reversion restores standard policy now that the restoration workload has started, that information sharing has been improved, and that no new independent route for children before the Commissie Werkelijke Schade is planned.
It is not desirable that a different quality standard is applied to the assistance of affected parents than to regular cases.
Het is niet wenselijk dat er voor de bijstand van gedupeerde ouders een andere kwaliteitsstandaard wordt gehanteerd dan voor reguliere zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk en Dijk over de interactieve tablettour van het Nationaal Holocaustmuseum voor groepen leerlingen uit het voortgezet onderwijs

Three MPs asked whether the government recognises the value of school visits to the Holocaust Museum, whether it will push all secondary pupils to visit, and whether free museum admission for all Dutch citizens will be explored. The government agrees Holocaust education matters, says schools must take the initiative, points to existing school funding and a forthcoming national Holocaust education plan, and leaves museum pricing to the museum itself.
However, it is up to schools themselves to take the initiative here and to look at which activity fits the school and target group.
Het is echter aan scholen zelf om hier initiatief toe te nemen en te kijken welke activiteit past bij de school en doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over 100 tot 150 banen die weg gaan bij Batavus

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about 100 to 150 job losses at Batavus, production moves abroad, and private equity takeovers such as KKR's acquisition of Accell Group, and whether the cabinet would act against large investors buying up the economy. The minister answered that restructuring is a company decision, that she prefers firms to stay in the Netherlands, that private equity is a legitimate financing source, and pointed to tax measures on debt financing and a business climate strategy.
It is further not for me to pass judgment on the strategy and policy of an individual company.
Het is verder niet aan mij om uitspraak te doen over de strategie en het beleid van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het grote tekort aan huisartsen

An MP asked the minister about a claimed GP shortage, gemeenten luring doctors with financial incentives, low tariffs and patient registration stops. The minister replied that there is no national shortage but a distribution problem, backed municipal initiatives, promised a study into people unable to register with a GP, and a later review of tariffs.
I have no insight into the current number of GP practices that have introduced a patient registration stop.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het huidige aantal huisartsenpraktijken dat een patiëntenstop heeft ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Dijk over het bericht 'Schadeproces toeslagenaffaire volledig op de schop: 'Het is bij de wilde konijnen af''

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Dijk (SP) asked whether the Commission Werkelijke Schade is reinventing its damage-assessment process for Toeslagenaffaire victims, whether closed cases will be reviewed, and why this was not raised in the parliamentary debate, and asked for a letter within a week. The State Secretary says CWS was asked for a plan on capacity, treatment of parents and backlogs, that CWS denies reviewing closed cases, and that he will inform the House on the final plan as soon as possible after discussing it with CWS, though not within the week.
I will discuss this plan with CWS. Any additional actions that follow from it I will share with your House at the same time as the plan.
Dit plan bespreek ik met CWS. Eventuele aanvullende acties die hieruit volgen, deel ik gelijktijdig met het plan met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Zonder opgeleide werknemers staat de groene staalfabriek in 2030 stil' uit Trouw van 13 februari

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about job losses at Tata Steel, the Sociaal Contract Groen Staal, and how the company's green transition could retain skilled workers and democratise the firm. The minister answered that the job reductions are the company's own choice, that the ministry was not involved in the social contract, and that she is pursuing a tailored agreement with Tata Steel on emissions and health.
It is up to the company to make its own choices and to adapt its operations to changing circumstances.
Het is aan het bedrijf om haar eigen keuzes te maken en om de bedrijfsvoering aan te passen aan veranderende omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Commerciële huisartsenketens groeien hard, maar controle schiet tekort’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that commercial GP chains are growing while oversight lags, and about the powers of the NZa and IGJ, the definition of core values, private equity ownership, and GP administrative burden. The minister answered that the NZa and IGJ have sufficient tools but a report recommends more oversight, that a private equity study is pending, and that concrete follow-up on core values and red tape will be sent to parliament later.
Soon I will send my response to the NZa and IGJ report on the rise of business chains in GP care to the House, and address these two questions in it.
Binnenkort zal ik mijn reactie op het rapport van de NZa en IGJ over «de opkomst van bedrijfsketens in de huisartsenzorg» naar uw Kamer sturen en daarmee ingaan op deze twee vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Langere reistijden naar ziekenhuis buiten Zoetermeer betekent hogere kans op sterfte van babys’

An SP MP asks the health minister how to prevent closure of the maternity acute care ward at a Zoetermeer hospital, citing a GGD report that longer travel times raise infant mortality risk, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answers that hospital boards and insurers decide under current rules, that the municipality must be involved under the AMvB acute care procedure, and that the minister has no instruments to prevent closures in the interim.
Under current laws and regulations, it is up to the care provider, not the Minister for Medical Care, to decide on changes to care provision together with the health insurer.

Binnen de huidige wet- en regelgeving is het aan de zorgaanbieder – en niet aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg – om, samen met de zorgverzekeraar, besluiten te nemen over wijzigingen in het zorgaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over zorgprofessionals die massaal kampen met haperende toevoer van hulpmiddelen.

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that care professionals face repeated supply failures for medical aids, and whether stockpiles or supplier pressure could help. The minister acknowledged the problems, attributed them to varied causes, rejected a broad stockholding obligation as inefficient, and pointed to sector-led action and NZa follow-up by July 2024.
Yes, and this has also been done over the past year.
Ja, en dit is het afgelopen jaar ook gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Jimmy Dijk over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Amsterdam, nr. AMS 23/2601 van 5 februari 2024

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Jimmy Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Rotterdam... no: an Amsterdam district court ruling that waived the notarial deed requirement for an informal debt of a childcare-benefit victim, and whether the government will appeal and change the law. The State Secretary answered that the ruling is exceptional, that the court's evidence of overdue amounts is not in line with the Wht, that no appeal will be lodged for this case, and that no legislative change is needed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over boodschappen die weer duurder worden

MP Dijk (SP) asks the Finance Minister whether grocery prices are rising again, why inflation cannot be curbed, whether profiteering (greedflation) should be tackled, and whether price regulation like in France or Spain should be used. The minister replies that food inflation has peaked, that price setting is up to firms with the competition authority ACM acting on cartels or abuse of market power, that a review of ACM's instruments is underway with a letter due in Q2 2024, and that no further grocery price regulation is intended.
It is now being examined whether the ACM's instruments are still adequate in the current time.
Er wordt nu onderzocht of het instrumentarium van de ACM nog toereikend is in deze huidige tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Westerveld over het bericht 'Tom Klaassen belandde in een ‘zorgvacuüm’ en stierf terwijl nog overlegd werd wie hem moest helpen'

MPs Dijk and Westerveld asked about the lack of care for complex psychiatric patients with addiction, the removal of facilities, palliative care as a suggested solution, a confidential mental health report, and funding. The Minister acknowledges gaps in integrated treatment but disputes many claims, points to existing programmes, rejects palliative care as a substitute for shortfalls, and says the NZa will be asked to look at funding again later.
No national data is collected on the local supply of the various types of shelter places and facilities for people with addiction problems.
Over het lokale aanbod van de verschillende soorten opvangplekken en voorzieningen voor mensen met verslavingsproblematiek wordt geen landelijke data verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat Pfizersgigawinsten in Nederland nog verder zijn gestegen naar 20 miljard euro

An MP from the SP asked the health and finance ministers how they would respond to reports that Pfizer's profits in the Netherlands rose to 20 billion euros, and what steps would prevent large pharmaceutical firms from making excessive profits from care funds and avoiding tax via the Netherlands. The minister said that profit is not something government can steer, that the government will pursue a demand-led medicines policy and wider societal debate on prices, declined to give Pfizer's hypothetical tax figures citing confidentiality, and pointed to existing and planned anti-avoidance measures.
I cannot make statements about the tax position of an individual taxpayer on the basis of the tax confidentiality obligation of art. 67 of the General State Taxes Act.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over de fiscale positie van een individueel belastingplichtige op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van art. 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het WEF en de belasting voor miljonairs en miljardairs

An SP MP asked the government whether it endorses the WEF participation and why taxpayers fund it, what the costs are, whether ministers account for outcomes, and what has been done about taxing millionaires and billionaires after motions on that topic. The minister replied that attendance offers networking and Dutch interests, listed accommodation costs of about 6,000 euros in total and that the government is transparent about its delegation, and referred to earlier studies (Bouwstenen 2020 and 2022, a 2023 letter and an IBO fiche on wealth tax) as the follow-up to the millionaire tax motions.
Besides six cabinet members, ten civil servants from the Netherlands travelled to Davos.
Naast zes kabinetsleden, zijn tien ambtenaren uit Nederland afgereisd naar Davos.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Belastingdienst blijft wet overtreden met mogelijk discriminerende fraude-algoritmen'

The MP asks why the Tax Authority kept using fraud risk models (OBCF, ABN, OB Negatief) that may breach the GDPR, whether they discriminate, and how public trust can be restored. The State Secretary replies that the models were reactivated after a risk assessment, that some were modified and will get impact assessments and transparency registration, and that discrimination checks and monitoring are in place, but gives no firm date or stop for OB Negatief.
The OB Negatief model will be given a data protection impact assessment, and the models are to be entered in the Tax Authority's algorithm register to promote transparency.
Het model OB Negatief wordt voorzien van een GEB en van de modellen wordt voorzien dat zij in het algoritmeregister van de Belastingdienst worden opgenomen ter bevordering van de transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de situatie van de ziekenhuizen in Venlo, Roermond en Zwolle

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about financial pressure on hospitals in Venlo, Roermond and Zwolle, including staff cuts at VieCuri, the closure of a psychiatric unit at Laurentius, and a 23 million euro shortfall at Isala. The minister mostly responded that hospital management and insurers are responsible, that the sector is financially healthy overall, and that the outcome of a motion on acute care financing is left to a future cabinet.
It is not for me to make statements on this; this is the responsibility of the care provider.
Het is niet aan mij om hier uitspraken over te doen, dit is de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat de rechter huisartsen gelijk geeft in zaak over tarieven

MP Dijk asked the minister to react to a court ruling that gave GPs a point in their challenge to the NZa's tariffs, and when tariff clarity and increases would come. The minister says the NZa had to check whether the 2023 and 2024 tariffs were still cost-covering, will redo the cost study with 2022 data, and expects clarity before summer 2024, with tariffs reset from 1 January 2025.
The NZa will have to set the tariffs for 2023 and 2024 again, and I trust that the NZa will implement this.
De NZa zal de tarieven voor 2023 en 2024 opnieuw moeten vaststellen en ik vertrouw erop dat de NZa dit ten uitvoering zal brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Medicijnen van verzekerden bij VGZ volgend jaar mogelijk niet of deels vergoed’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that VGZ insured persons might not or only partly receive reimbursement for medicines in 2024, and whether the minister would talk to VGZ and ZFC. The minister answered that VGZ says the reports are incorrect because a multi-year contract runs to 2025, that the NZa found pharmacies gave patients wrong information and imposed measures, but declined to talk to the parties since contracting is between insurer and provider, which the NZa supervises.
The negotiations between care provider and health insurer are between these two parties. The NZa supervises this.
De onderhandelingen tussen zorgaanbieder en zorgverzekeraar zijn tussen deze twee partijen. De NZa houdt hier toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Moet de spoedeisende hulp in Goes en Terneuzen blijven? Ministerie haalt meningen op'

An MP asked the health minister about public consultation meetings on emergency care in Goes and Terneuzen and whether the emergency departments would close. The minister replied that the meetings feed into a civil-service process on new accessibility norms, that no closure is planned, and that the controversial 45-minute norm decision is left to a next cabinet.
Since the 45-minute norm has been declared controversial by the House, decision-making on a possible alternative to the 45-minute norm is left to a next cabinet.
Aangezien de 45-minutennorm door uw Kamer controversieel verklaard is, wordt besluitvorming over een eventueel alternatief voor de 45-minutennorm aan een volgend kabinet overgelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het artikel 'Stijgende kosten, dalende omzet: kartonfabrikant Solidus sluit vestiging Hoogkerk'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about Solidus closing its Hoogkerk plant, the reasons for it, and what government would do about job losses and worker support. The minister confirmed the plan from media reports, called it a business decision, pointed to UWV, municipal and regional mobility-team support, and said government sees no role in mediation between management and unions.
I see no role for the cabinet in the mediation process between Solidus management and the union(s).
Ik zie geen rol voor het kabinet in het bemiddelingsproces tussen de directie van Solidus en de vakbond(en).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat private equity leidt tot meer medische complicaties

MP Dijk (SP) asks the minister how she responds to reports that private equity causes more medical complications, whether Dutch care differs from the US, and whether she will curb private equity in healthcare and GP practices. The minister says the US study is not directly transferable, that Dutch research on private equity in care is underway with results expected around Q1 2024, and that she will not take specific measures against private equity before those findings are in.

I consider it important to first gain a better view of the extent to which private equity is present in healthcare and of its effects, in order to determine whether, and which, further measures are desirable for the various healthcare sectors.

Ik vind het van belang om eerst beter zicht te krijgen in de mate waarin sprake is van private equity in de zorg en het effect van private equity om te bepalen of, en zo welke, nadere maatregelen gewenst zijn voor de diverse zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat de commerciële huisartsenketens Co-med doorgaat met overnames van nieuwe praktijken

An SP MP asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that the commercial GP chain Co-med continues taking over practices, and whether she would intervene or halt takeovers. The minister answered that she is examining giving the NZa power to temporarily ban takeovers by providers under investigation, that a general ban on chains or profit is not legally feasible, and that a study on private equity in care is due this quarter.
At present I am examining the possibilities of giving the NZa the statutory power to prohibit takeovers by certain providers during investigations, in concrete cases where supervisors act on signals.

Op dit moment onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden om in concrete gevallen, waarin toezichthouders op basis van signalen gericht onderzoek doen naar het handelen van bepaalde zorgaanbieders, de NZa de wettelijke bevoegdheid te geven om gedurende de looptijd van die onderzoeken overnames door betreffende partijen te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over het artikel ''Hollandse Energie Maatschappij verdacht van gesjoemel met prijsplafondmiljoenen''

Two SP MPs asked whether a Volkskrant report that energy supplier HEM may have manipulated the price-cap subsidy is accurate, and how the regulators (RVO and ACM) oversaw it, including whether HEM should have received the subsidy while operating with a supply licence in question. The minister answered that RVO and ACM monitor compliance, that ongoing investigations and procedures cannot be discussed, that ACM tightened HEM's licence conditions in December 2023, and that no evidence yet shows consumers overpaid.
Regarding any ongoing legal procedures directly related to this, I cannot make any statements at this time.
Over eventueel lopende juridische procedures die hier direct mee samenhangen, kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over het artikel 'Hollandse Energie Maatschappij verdacht van gesjoemel met prijsplafondmiljoenen'

MPs Dijk and Beckerman asked how energy supplier HEM obtained a licence despite suspicions about its founders, whether the BIBOB integrity screening applied, and how misuse of the energy price cap could be prevented and recovered. The minister replied that the ACM granted the licence in 2020 under the then-applicable rules, that tightened admission criteria followed in 2022, that BIBOB is not part of licensing but is planned for the Energy Act, that no similar price cap is currently planned, and that a margin test will be applied to subsidies.
I have included in the Energy Act proposal that a licence can be refused or revoked on the basis of the BIBOB Act.
Ik heb in het voorstel voor de Energiewet opgenomen dat een vergunning kan worden geweigerd of ingetrokken op basis van de Wet BIBOB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de verkoop van Intravacc

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether the sale of Intravacc B.V. should proceed given that the parties backing the privatisation now hold fewer than a third of seats, and whether the sale could wait for the new Chamber. The minister said the Chamber already agreed to the sale, the process is in its final stage, completion is required by a signed agreement subject to conditions, and postponing it would harm government reliability and expose the state to financial and legal consequences.
No, I am not willing to do so given the possible financial and legal consequences.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid gezien de mogelijke financiële en juridische gevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over dreigende sluiting van dagbesteding Antoon & Frans in Megen en de verdere verschraling van dagbestedingslocaties als gevolg van zorgconcurrentie

An SP MP asked the minister about the threatened closure of a day-care location in Megen and the wider thinning of day-care provision due to care competition. The minister responded that the provider Dichterbij decided to close the location because too few clients remained, and that the zorgkantoor, not the government, bears responsibility for sufficient day-care provision.
It is the role of the zorgkantoor to ensure there are sufficient locations for suitable day-care for Wlz clients.
Het is de rol van het zorgkantoor om ervoor te zorgen dat er voldoende locaties zijn voor passende dagbesteding voor Wlz-cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over het vertrek van demissionaire ministers

SP MPs asked the Prime Minister why he agreed to early departures of caretaker ministers, whether such exits harm continuity and public trust, and whether pensions continue. The government answered that the PM does not grant or refuse such departures, that staying is generally desirable but a personal decision, and that continuity is handled case by case; it gave no new commitment.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Gegevens HoNOS+ vragenlijst niet met terugwerkende kracht verwijderd' en de bijbehorende radio-uitzending over dit onderwerp van Argos op zaterdag 25 november jongstl

MP Dijk (SP) asked whether the NZa adequately informed mental health patients about the privacy declaration linked to the HoNOS+ data collection, whether the data should be deleted or the database abandoned, and how patient trust is affected. The minister rejects claims of inadequate information, states the NZa is handling the data with strict safeguards while the bodemprocedure is pending, and says the NZa cannot delete individual patients' data retroactively due to administrative burden.

The NZa states that it is also not possible for it to delete data of individual patients because the NZa has taken very strict organisational and technical measures to prevent the supplied data from being traceable to a natural person.

De NZa geeft aan dat het is daarbij voor haar ook niet mogelijk is om data van afzonderlijke patiënten te verwijderen omdat de NZa, zoals bij vraag 5 aangegeven, zeer strenge organisatorische en technische maatregelen genomen heeft om te voorkomen dat de aangeleverde gegevens te herleiden zijn tot een natuurlijke persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over deproblemen bij de commerciële ggz-instelling Mindler in Zweden

An MP asked the minister about reports of short consultations, workload and private equity at the commercial mental health provider Mindler, and whether profit-making in mental health care should be banned. The minister said short consults driven purely by finance are undesirable but that clinicians set consult length within the quality framework, and that a private equity study due in early 2024 will inform whether further measures are needed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het nieuws dat Friesland kampt met vervoersarmoede door verschraald openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure about transport poverty in Friesland caused by reduced public transport, including whether bus routes may be cut, whether a national action plan and legal accessibility norms are needed, and about fares, private takeovers and provincial operators. The State Secretary points to regional deals, a 300 million euro structural boost, the Mobility Vision 2050, and says concession authorities handle service decisions while the Friesland timetable will be published later.
It is up to these concession authorities to enforce if carriers do not keep their promises.
Het is aan deze concessieverleners om te handhaven als vervoerders beloften niet nakomen.
Antwoord op van het lid Dijk over het nieuws dat de treinverbinding Zwolle-Enschede grote problemen kent

An SP MP asked the state secretary about severe train cancellations (10.5% in October 2023) on the Zwolle-Enschede line operated by Keolis, the causes including staff moving to NS, and the province's enforcement options, plus broader questions on regional public transport liberalisation. The secretary answered that the province as concession authority is handling the shortfall, that enforcement via fines and subsidy withholding is available, and that concession-based competition has improved outcomes, while declining to comment on individual staff motives and pointing to the province for operational matters.
The province can fine the operator under the granted concession or withhold subsidies to hold the operator to agreements when it fails to meet them.
De provincie kan de vervoerder op grond van de verleende concessie beboeten of subsidies inhouden om de vervoerder aan afspraken te houden wanneer de vervoerder niet voldoet aan afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de dreigende sluiting van de huisartsenposten in het VUmc en het Erasmus MC

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about threatened closures of out-of-hours GP posts and the spoedeisende hulp at VUmc and Erasmus MC, and whether this would burden other emergency care. The minister said the procedure under the acute care rules must be followed, that VUmc's emergency unit is being reshaped rather than closed, and that parties in each region must decide on changes together.
That is why I consider it very important that for proposed closures the procedure under the Wkkgz Implementing Decree (AMvB acute care) and the Wkkgz Implementing Regulation is followed.
Daarom vind ik het van groot belang dat bij voorgenomen sluitingen de procedure uit het Uitvoeringsbesluit Wkkgz (AMvB acute zorg) en Uitvoeringsregeling Wkkgz wordt gevolgd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de huisartsenzorg in Brunssum

An MP asked the Minister of Health why the suspended GP in Brunssum could keep practising after an initial sexual abuse conviction, why the search for a replacement started late, and how patients left without a nearby GP will be served. The Minister answered that appeal suspended enforcement, the IGJ imposed an immediate practice ban in August 2023, continuity of care lies primarily with the practice holder and insurer, and that the Minister will work with the sector on general access to GP care.
In the first instance, in that situation, it is up to the practice holder, as care provider, to ensure continuity of care.
In eerste instantie is het in die situatie aan de praktijkhouder in zijn hoedanigheid als zorgaanbieder om zorg te dragen voor de continuïteit van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Toename van kinderen met een longontsteking'

MP Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Health whether research is under way into the rise in childhood pneumonia, its possible causes, regional differences, links to air quality and to the COVID-19 pandemic. The minister replied that surveillance is being intensified with RIVM and Nivel, extra research into causes is planned, no clear regional differences were seen, and no firm conclusion on a COVID link can yet be drawn.
In consultation with RIVM and Nivel, an intensification of surveillance at the GP sentinel stations is now being set up through extra sampling and broader testing of pneumonia in children.
In overleg met RIVM en Nivel wordt nu een intensivering van de surveillance bij de huisartsenpeilstations uitgezet door extra bemonstering en uitgebreider testen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat de Consumentenbond het getreuzel contractering door zorgverzekeraars zat is

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about delays in health insurer contracting with care providers and whether verzekerden should be protected if contracts are late. The minister answered that contracting is progressing, that no intervention is planned for 2024, and that the sector will evaluate the process after the year.
For the 2024 contracting season I will not take additional measures.
Voor het contracteerseizoen 2024 ga ik geen aanvullende maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de overname van Tandartspraktijk Kennemerland door een Deens private-equityhuis

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the takeover of a dental practice by a Danish private-equity firm was undesirable, whether private equity's growth in dental care is less harmful than in youth care and GP care, and whether steps would be taken against it. The minister said private ownership of dental practices is permitted within existing regulation, pointed to a sector-wide study of private equity due in early 2024, and deferred any further measures until the study's findings are known.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat verzekerden van Zilveren Kruis en ASR dit jaar niet meer naar het Martini Ziekenhuis kunnen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that insured patients of Zilveren Kruis and ASR can no longer go to the Martini Hospital this year, whether surrounding hospitals can absorb the operations, and whether the minister will talk to the insurers and hospital. The minister replied that insurers have a duty of care to arrange timely, accessible care elsewhere, that the NZa supervises this, and that the insurer and hospital must resolve it, declining to hold a conversation himself.
Health insurers have a duty of care. This duty means the health insurer must provide care that is timely and accessible.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben zorgplicht. Zorgplicht houdt in dat de zorgverzekeraar zorg moet leveren die tijdig en bereikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de ontwikkeling van medicijnen door ziekenhuizen

An SP MP asked the health minister how hospitals could be supported in developing and registering their own medicines as alternatives to expensive industry products, and about IP and cross-border cooperation. The minister answered that academic drug development is encouraged via the FAST expertise centre, that IP follows MVL principles, and that a public research fund is not the preferred route.
FAST will, in close cooperation with VWS and relevant stakeholders, work on an overview of bottlenecks and stimulation options for academic-driven medicine development.
FAST zal, in nauwe samenwerking met VWS en relevante stakeholders, werken aan een overzicht van knelpunten en stimuleringsmogelijkheden voor academisch-gedreven geneesmiddelenontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over bericht datruim twee op de drie huisartsen een patiëntenstop hebben

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about reports that over two-thirds of GPs have patient intake stops, questioning whether GP training is enough, how to support practice takeover, and whether freelance GP tariffs and unused budgets are adequately managed. The Minister responds that GP numbers have grown, outlines planned training increases and the Integrated Care Agreement measures on out-of-hours care, practice ownership and tariff regulation, and promises further information before year-end.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Mohandis over het bericht 'Minder personeel dreigt in ouderenzorg door geldruzie met zorgkantoren'

MPs Van Dijk and Mohandis asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports that staff cuts threaten elderly care due to tariff disputes with care insurers (zorgkantoren) and a court case. The minister responded that layoffs are undesirable, that the court found the tariffs generally reasonable, and listed measures (WOZO, TAZ, budget increase) to protect staffing and quality, while not committing to a specific new legal change.
In response to the Mohandis motion, I will map the extent to which elderly care organisations are threatening to collectively dismiss staff.
Als reactie op de motie Mohandis ga ik dan ook in kaart brengen in welke mate organisaties in de ouderenzorg personeel collectief dreigen te ontslaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over de verkoop van vervoersbedrijf Arriva aan een Amerikaanse investeringsmaatschappij

Two SP MPs asked the Infrastructure minister whether the sale of Arriva to a US investment firm was imminent, what it means for passengers and staff, and whether public ownership of transport operators should be the rule. The minister answered that services and concession terms are expected to be unaffected, that provinces hold consent rights in some concessions, and that public ownership is not a precondition for good public transport, though the government will keep monitoring.
The provinces' process for determining whether consent to the sale can be given is confidential.
Het proces van de provincies om te bepalen of instemming met de verkoop kan worden verleend, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over de verkoop van vervoersbedrijf Arriva aan een Amerikaanse investeringsmaatschappij.

SP MPs Dijk and Beckerman asked about the sale of Arriva to US investor I Squared Capital, including provincial powers to block it, consequences of refusal and public spending on Arriva. The Staatssecretaris answered that most concessions are unaffected, that Limburg and Noord-Brabant have consent clauses, that nationalisation is not warranted, and that public-sector purchase of other operators would be explored if offered.
The provinces' process for determining whether consent to the sale can be given is confidential.
Het proces van de provincies om te bepalen of instemming met de verkoop kan worden verleend, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het sluiten van operatiekamers in het Alrijne Ziekenhuis omdat zorgverzekeraars onvoldoende geld beschikbaar stellen

An SP MP asked the minister whether patients face delayed surgery and extra costs after Alrijne hospital closed operating theatres due to insufficient insurer funding, and what will prevent recurrence. The minister answered that only low-complexity planned operations may be delayed, that patients can seek insurer-mediated transfer, that transport costs are covered only if insurers fail their duty of care, that the financial shortfall figure is not available, and that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care.
I have no information on this.
Hier heb ik geen informatie over.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over antwoord op de vragen inzake de uitzending «Het geheim van de spreekkamer» en het artikel «Zorgverzekeraars hebben groot belang bij de data die toezichthouder verzamelt» en Peilin

An SP MP asks the Minister for Long-term Care about patients not being informed by providers that their data is shared with the NZa, and about privacy declarations, data-sharing errors, and the link between HoNOs+ data and waiting times. The Minister acknowledges patients should be better informed, explains the NZa's safeguards and the reasons the privacy declaration cannot be split, and commits to answering each question separately.
I expect care providers to inform their clients and patients about the privacy declaration well, fully and neutrally, to always leave the choice entirely to the patient and not to influence it.

Ik verwacht van zorgaanbieders dat zij hun cliënten en patiënten over de privacyverklaring goed, volledig en neutraal informeren, de keuze altijd helemaal bij de patiënt laten en daar geen invloed op uitoefenen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het niet komen opdagen van de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport bij de protestbijeenkomst om het Zuyderland ziekenhuis een volwaardig ziekenhuis te houden

An MP asked the health minister why she did not attend a protest meeting in Parkstad against plans to strip the Zuyderland hospital in Heerlen of inpatient beds and emergency care, and whether she would speak out against it. The minister replied she was abroad for the UN General Assembly, rejects the term 'stripping', and says regional restructuring under the Integraal Zorgakkoord and the AMvB acute zorg procedure must ensure equal quality of care while leaving the concrete hospital decisions to the providers and insurers.
I was unable to attend, due to an international trip in connection with the United Nations General Assembly.
Ik was niet in de gelegenheid om hierbij aanwezig te zijn, als gevolg van een internationale reis in verband met de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht "Indonesische verpleegkundigen worden hier uitgeknepen: Ik voel me opgelicht''

MPs Dijk (SP) asked ministers about reports that Indonesian nurses recruited via study permits were being exploited, including questions on labour inspection oversight of recruitment agencies, prior warnings, and working conditions. The minister replied that the Labour Inspectorate has no overview of such agencies, a handhavingstraject is ongoing, the IND has put new applications on hold pending its outcome, and the government will consult the Labour Inspectorate once that process concludes.
The Dutch Labour Inspectorate has no overall picture of such intermediary agencies, nor of their business profitability.
De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie heeft geen overkoepelend beeld van dergelijke bemiddelingsbureaus noch van hun bedrijfseconomische winstgevendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat het ziekenhuis HMC in financiële problemen verkeert

An SP MP asked the health minister about HMC hospital's financial problems, budget caps, external suppliers' profits, delayed discharges, operations driven by finances, and population-based funding. The minister answered that hospitals and insurers are responsible for their own finances, that no continuity-of-care signals were reported, and that the ministry lacks powers to cap supplier profits.
I am not aware of the agreements that individual health insurers and individual healthcare providers make with each other in contracts.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de afspraken die individuele zorgverzekeraars en individuele zorgaanbieders in contracten met elkaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat de kinder-IC in het LUMC dreigt te moeten sluiten

MP Dijk (SP) asked the minister whether closing the paediatric ICU at LUMC would follow from moving congenital heart surgery to other centres, and what compensating measures would be taken. The minister said concentration is a quality decision, that a transition committee (Samsom) and the NFU will work out mitigating measures over 2.5 years, and that the decision will not be revisited unless transition problems require it.
I look forward to the outcome with interest.
Ik zie de uitkomst met belangstelling tegemoet.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Dijk over de uitzending 'Het geheim van de spreekkamer' en het artikel 'Zorgverzekeraars hebben groot belang bij de data die toezichthouder verzamelt'

An MP (Dijk, SP) asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the NZa's collection of HoNOS+ patient data for mental health care, including adequacy of advice from the Dutch DPA, patient awareness of privacy statements, and calls for a temporary halt. The Minister answered that the NZa acts within its legal framework and the DPA's December 2022 opinion, that the data collection is under court review, and that patients are informed via a folder and website, but declined to halt the collection or pause it pending a new DPA opinion.
The data collection for care demand typing by the NZa is currently the subject of legal proceedings.
De data-uitvraag voor zorgvraagtypering door de NZa is op dit moment onderwerp van een gerechtelijke procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de gemeten oversterfte in juni door het CBS

An SP MP asked why excess deaths in June 2023 were not met with activation of the National Heat Plan and what research and changes would follow. The Minister explained that the heat plan's conditions were not met, that a warning was issued to partners, and committed to an evaluation of the plan once new KNMI climate scenarios are published in October 2023.
I will have an evaluation carried out of the National Heat Plan assessing whether the plan is still adequate given climate change.
Ik zal een evaluatie laten uitvoeren van het Nationaal Hitteplan waarin beoordeeld wordt of het plan nog voldoet gezien de klimaatverandering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat er alweer twee huisartsenpraktijken zijn overgenomen door de commerciële keten Co-Med

An SP MP asked the health minister how the government would respond to the takeover of two more GP practices by the commercial chain Co-Med, whether regulators lack tools against such chains, and what options exist to curb them. The minister said that regulators may get power to block takeovers during investigations, that the NZa has no legal basis to stop takeovers where the procedure was properly followed, and that a sector-wide study of private equity in care is under way with a report due by year end.

I am exploring whether, in specific cases where regulators conduct targeted investigations into certain care providers based on signals, the NZa can be given the legal power to prohibit takeovers by those parties for the duration of those investigations.

Ik verken de mogelijkheden om in concrete gevallen, waarin toezichthouders op basis van signalen gericht onderzoek doen naar het handelen van bepaalde zorgaanbieders, de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) de wettelijke bevoegdheid te geven om gedurende de looptijd van die onderzoeken overnames door betreffende partijen te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht “FNV wil 14,3 procent hoger loon in kraamzorg”

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the kraamzorg (maternity care) wage gap contributes to staff shortages, whether the government will support the FNV's 14.3% wage demand, and whether it will take steps to raise wages. The minister answered that a study on the sector's finances and wage development is pending, that collective bargaining is for social partners and the government cannot interfere under international treaties, and that no extra wage room is planned.

No, as stated in the answer to question 4, under international treaties I may not interfere in collective bargaining negotiations and therefore cannot and will not take a position on wage demands in care.

Nee, zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 4 mag ik mij op grond van internationale verdragen niet bemoeien met cao-onderhandelingen en kan en wil ik dus geen positie innemen met betrekking tot looneisen in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de verlenging van de voorwaardelijke vergoeding van de paramedische herstelzorg na COVID-19

An SP MP asked the health minister why a decision to extend the conditional reimbursement of paramedical post-COVID care beyond 1 August 2023 had not been taken despite a June commitment, and about the stress late decision-making causes patients. The minister answered that he waited for parliament's position on the Pakketbrief, then extended the scheme (published 24 July), and that the Zorginstituut had been informed in advance.
Because I did not want to take a decision before your House could express its view on the Pakketbrief.
Omdat ik niet een besluit wilde nemen voordat uw Kamer zich kon uitspreken over de Pakketbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de staat van de spoedeisende hulp in Nederland

An SP MP asked the health minister about closures of emergency departments, staff shortages at the VUmc, consultation of local government and residents, and access to care. The minister answered that the number of emergency departments fell from 89 to 83 since 2018, named three hospitals considering closure, and described the hospital's staffing, consultation and regional coordination measures while stating that the hospital itself is responsible for its personnel policy.
Amsterdam UMC aims to concentrate acute care at the AMC location from May 2024.
Het Amsterdam UMC streeft ernaar om per mei 2024 de acute zorg te concentreren op de locatie van het AMC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Wat voor gevolgen heeft het schrappen van Spoedeisende Hulp in Stadskanaal en Hoogeveen? Waslijst met zaken die slechter gaan'

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about the consequences of converting the emergency departments in Stadskanaal and Hoogeveen into basic emergency posts, including worse access and limited municipal involvement. The minister defended the decision as necessary for care quality and staffing, said the AMvB acute care may be supplemented to strengthen municipal involvement, and refused to reverse the closure, which is a matter for providers and insurers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het sluiten van operatiekamers in het Alrijne Ziekenhuis omdat zorgverzekeraars onvoldoende geld beschikbaar stellen

An SP MP asked the health minister for reaction to reports that Alrijne Hospital would close operating theatres because health insurers allocate too little budget, and what this means for patients' waiting times and whether the closure is avoidable. The minister answered that no operations are being cancelled, urgent care continues, insurers dispute the picture, and the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care and is monitoring the situation.
The NZa supervises that health insurers fulfil their duty of care.
De NZa houdt er toezicht op dat de zorgverzekeraars hun zorgplicht nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat vijftien ziekenhuizen worstelen met knellende zorgplafonds

An SP MP asked the health minister how she will respond to reports that fifteen hospitals face restrictive care ceilings, whether she will map other affected hospitals, what she will do to prevent operating stops, and whether she will talk with hospitals and insurers. The minister answered that insurers have a statutory duty of care and that the NZa supervises it, but declined to map other hospitals or to take a new initiative, leaving communication to hospitals and insurers.
No, as indicated in my previous answer, it is up to the hospitals and the insurers to communicate about this well and in good time.
Nee, het is – zoals in mijn vorige antwoord aangegeven – aan de ziekenhuizen en de verzekeraars om hier goed en tijdig over te communiceren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Ine zit al acht weken zonder huishoudelijke hulp: 'Let niet op de stank'' en de antwoorden op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Tilburg bezuinigt flink op Wmo

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports of personnel shortages and waiting lists for Wmo domestic help, and whether national intervention or supervision of municipalities is warranted. The government answered that no national figures exist, attributed shortages to the tight labour market and the abonnementstarief, pointed to the TAZ programme and dialogue with municipalities, and explained that interbestuurlijk toezicht is used sparingly and only under the intervention ladder.
There are no figures available at national level showing the extent of the personnel shortage for the domestic help provided under the Wmo 2015.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar die op landelijk niveau inzichtelijk maken wat de omvang van het personeelstekort is voor de huishoudelijke hulp die op basis van de Wmo 2015 geleverd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Helder wil maximumnorm zzp’ers en gedragscode bemiddelingsbureaus'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the share of self-employed workers in care, the costs of agency staffing, private equity influence on staffing agencies, and how to reduce reliance on flex workers. The minister answered that data on false self-employment is unavailable, that a code of conduct for intermediaries is being discussed with industry bodies, and that the question of regulating private equity is left to a next cabinet.
How many of those cases involve false self-employment cannot be derived from CBS data or other sources.
Hoeveel gevallen daarvan schijnzelfstandigheid betreffen is niet uit CBS data of andere bronnen te destilleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Doorstart kinderdagcentrum Uithuizen mislukt op laatste moment, ouders zijn ten einde raad'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about the failed rescue of a children's day centre in Uithuizen, asking about adequate provision, acceptable distance, national responsibility, and whether such centres should be protected from bankruptcy. The State Secretary agreed that enough centres should exist, said municipalities are legally responsible for adequate youth care, pointed to planned legislation and the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd, and said the IGJ supervises quality, while declining to say bankruptcies must be prevented.
Municipalities can be held to account by the national government for failing to meet those responsibilities through inter-governmental supervision.
Gemeenten kunnen door het Rijk worden aangesproken bij het niet nakomen van die verantwoordelijkheden via het interbestuurlijk toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat het commerciële huisartsenbedrijf Co-Med een huisartsenpraktijk in Bergen op Zoom wil overnemen

An MP asked the minister about the commercial GP chain Co-Med's plan to take over a practice in Bergen op Zoom, following misconduct at other practices, and whether such takeovers should be halted. The minister said the NZa would be given a power to suspend takeovers during supervisory investigations, to be legislated by year-end, while rejecting a general ban and pointing to existing supervision and regional GP organisations.
I want to create a power for the NZa to halt planned takeovers by parties under investigation by healthcare supervisors for the duration of those investigations.
wil ik een bevoegdheid voor de NZa creëren om voorgenomen overnames door partijen waar een onderzoek door de toezichthouders in de zorg naar loopt, gedurende die onderzoeken stop te kunnen zetten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de eerste resultaten van jaar 2 van het Long COVID onderzoek van het Erasmus MC en C-support

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about first-year-two results of the Long COVID study showing little improvement, that 40% avoided care due to costs, that 54% of participants are highly educated, and whether social security (WIA) is adequate given low-income patients often get no benefit. The Minister acknowledges the results, describes C-support and new national research and expertise programmes, notes access measures and the paramedical care scheme extension, and says the WIA system generally works for post-COVID patients while acknowledging some bottlenecks being addressed by SZW and the Octas commission.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis in Heerlen raakt mogelijk alle bedden voor opnames én spoedeisende hulp kwijt: gemeente reageert verbolgen'

SP MP Dijk asked the Minister of Health about reports that a Heerlen hospital may lose all inpatient and emergency beds, and the municipality's anger at not being consulted early. The minister replied that the hospital must follow the AMvB acute care procedure, that IGJ and NZa oversee compliance, and that residents and municipalities must be informed and heard before a decision, while leaving the sequence of stakeholder consultation to the hospital.
The Zuyderland hospital has assured me that the above procedure will be followed.
Het Zuyderland ziekenhuis heeft mij verzekerd dat bovenstaande procedure zal worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen bezorgd: Personeelsmarkt ontdekt door private investeerders’

MP Dijk (SP) asked the ministers about reports that private investors are entering the hospital staffing market, asking about private equity's effects, agency costs, and steps to improve staff control. Minister Kuipers answered that private equity's effects on care quality and access are not yet clear, that data on agency costs and private equity payouts are lacking, and that the government will promote staff autonomy via existing programmes and may commission further research.
The Ministry of VWS does not have these figures.
Het Ministerie van VWS beschikt niet over deze cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de vertraging omtrent de nieuwe bekostiging van wijkverpleging en het in stand houden van de 5-minutenregistratie

An SP MP asks the minister why the 5-minute time registration in district nursing persists despite its formal abolition in 2018, and whether it should be eliminated immediately. The minister answers that a third of providers still use it due to complex ICT systems, that providers must take the final step themselves, and that Vilans support and a possible experiment are available, but gives no firm date for definitive abolition.
To help care providers with this, they can make use of the support offered by Vilans
Om zorgaanbieders hierbij te helpen, kunnen ze gebruik maken van het ondersteuningsaanbod vanuit Vilans
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Westerveld over het bericht 'Cliënten ggz stappen boos uit overleg: ‘Plan dataverzameling schendt privacy’'

MPs Dijk and Westerveld asked the minister about MIND leaving the zorgvraagtypering advisory committee and the NZa's plan to collect HoNOS+ data from all ggz patients via opt-out, questioning privacy and consent. The minister replied that the NZa has legal authority to request the data, that patients can object via a privacy declaration, that the NZa will talk with MIND, and that the DSM data will be retained for risk equalisation.
The NZa is legally entitled to request the necessary data.
De NZa is wettelijk gelegitimeerd om de benodigde data op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat VGZ mensen extra laat betalen om hun post fysiek te ontvangen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether VGZ may charge customers €1.25 per month to receive paper post, whether other insurers do so, and whether the minister agrees that digitally unskilled people should not pay more. The minister answered that the state cannot dictate insurers' service arrangements, will discuss offline options with insurers and report to parliament this summer, notes VGZ's reasons for the charge, and says vulnerable groups will keep receiving paper post free.

The State Secretary for Kingdom Relations and Digitalisation stated during the committee debate on digital government services on 20 April that she cannot determine how insurers arrange their service to customers, but wants to discuss this with them.

De Staatssecretaris Koninkrijkrelaties en Digitalisering heeft tijdens het commissiedebat over «de digitale dienstverlening door de overheid» op 20 april jl. aangegeven dat zij niet kan bepalen hoe bijvoorbeeld zorgverzekeraars de dienstverlening met hun klanten regelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘’Wanhopige ouders vrezen gedwongen verhuizing gehandicapte zoons’’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports that parents fear the forced relocation of two disabled sons by care provider Middin, questioning its compatibility with children's rights and whether financial motives dominate care decisions. The minister said the move was needed because the room housed two clients in a space meant for eleven, that talks with parents continue and a closer Hague location may be found, and that no national figures on such relocations exist, promising to raise the issue with stakeholders.
Nationally no figures are known. I will discuss this topic in consultations with representatives of client organisations, care providers and care offices, and ask them to share any signals with me.

Landelijk zijn geen cijfers bekend. Ik zal dit onderwerp bespreken in overleggen met vertegenwoordigers van cliëntenorganisaties, zorgaanbieders en zorgkantoren en vragen om eventuele signalen met mij te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat twee Arnhemse zorg-uitzendbureaus strafrechtelijk onderzocht worden wegens valse diploma’s

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports that two Arnhem care staffing agencies are under criminal investigation for fake diplomas, and how such diploma fraud could be prevented. The minister called it serious, said care providers remain responsible for checking diplomas and VOG certificates, and pointed to existing tools such as the Wtza, a screening pilot and reporting to the police and the IGJ, without committing to new sanctions.
Care providers are at all times ultimately responsible for delivering good care and for hiring staff with the right qualifications.
Zorgaanbieders zijn te allen tijde eindverantwoordelijk voor het leveren van goede zorg en zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aannemen van personeel met de juiste kwalificaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Tilburg bezuinigt flink op Wmo, inwoners krijgen minder huishoudelijke hulp: 'Klachten blijven binnenkomen’'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the national government supervises municipalities' implementation of the Wmo 2015 after reports of cuts to home help in Tilburg, and whether shortfalls exist elsewhere. The State Secretary answered that municipalities implement the Wmo on their own authority, that the national government can consider intervention if structural signals arise, that citizens have legal remedies, and that a sustainability study of the Wmo is planned with the VNG.
Municipalities implement the Wmo 2015 on their own legal authority.
Gemeenten voeren de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015 (hierna: Wmo 2015) op eigen juridisch gezag uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Geld in de zorg verdwijnt massaal: Den Haag gaat aan kop’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport how she will respond to reports of large-scale misuse of care funds, including the capacity of supervisors over PGB bureaus, the burden of controls, municipal fining powers, tackling criminal networks, fake diplomas and certificates, and a ban on profit distributions in care. The minister answers that the government opposes misuse, explains the supervisory responsibilities of IGJ, NZa, municipalities and the OM, lists existing measures and a forthcoming letter, and rejects a profit ban while preparing an integrity bill that would allow conditions on profit distributions.
It is absolutely undesirable that unscrupulous care providers misuse care funds and take advantage of people in a vulnerable position.
Het is absoluut ongewenst dat malafide zorgaanbieders misbruik maken van zorggelden en hierbij gebruik maken van mensen in een kwetsbare positie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Ad Melkert wil moratorium op mededingingswet'

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the competition law hinders hospital cooperation and whether it should be suspended in healthcare, following a report that Ad Melkert wanted a moratorium on competition law. The minister denies competition law blocks necessary cooperation, notes ACM guidance and ongoing casuistry work, and states the government does not consider changing the competition rules necessary.
I am convinced that cooperation is necessary to safeguard the quality, accessibility and affordability of care.
Ik ben er van overtuigd dat samenwerking noodzakelijk is om de kwaliteit, toegankelijkheid en betaalbaarheid van zorg te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de opkomst van commerciële huisartsenpraktijken

An SP MP asked the minister about the rise of commercial GP practice chains, including IGJ findings against Centric Health, and about implementing a motion on commercial takeovers. The minister answered that existing rules apply equally to all providers, that enforcement has occurred in the Centric case, and that an IGJ/NZa study of chain formation is pending, after which additional measures will be considered.
I therefore find it unacceptable when care providers do not adhere to the set frameworks and the accessibility, quality and safety of care are at stake.
Ik vind het dan ook niet acceptabel wanneer zorgaanbieders zich niet houden aan de gestelde kaders en de toegankelijkheid, kwaliteit en veiligheid van zorg in het geding komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de sluiting van afdelingen van het Gelre Ziekenhuis Zutphen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the abrupt closure of the maternity ward at Gelre Ziekenhuis Zutphen, including information duties, patient choice, supervision and the financing system. The Minister answered that the closure was due to acute staffing problems, that patients were informed and referred, that the inspectorates had adequate oversight, and that accessibility remains assured.
To date I have received no signals from the IGJ or NZa that the decision-making procedure was not followed properly by Gelre Ziekenhuizen.
Ik heb tot op heden geen signalen vanuit de IGJ of NZa ontvangen dat er sprake zou zijn van het niet op juiste wijze volgen van de besluitvormingsprocedure door Gelre Ziekenhuizen.

Asks the government to abandon the Climate Agreement target of 1.5 million existing homes made gas-free by 2030.
requests the government to abandon the Climate Agreement commitment to have 1.5 million existing homes gas-free by 2030
verzoekt de regering de afspraak uit het Klimaatakkoord om in 2030 1,5 miljoen bestaande woningen aardgasvrij gemaakt te hebben los te laten
Motie van het lid Van der Plas c.s. over het nakomen van de met provincies en gemeenten gemaakte normeringsafspraken
Motion asks the cabinet to honour agreements with provinces and municipalities on fund norming ('samen de trap op, samen de trap af') in all dossiers.
requests the cabinet to abide by the agreements made with provinces and municipalities
verzoekt het kabinet om zich aan de gemaakte afspraken met provincies en gemeenten te houden
Motie van de leden Eerdmans en Van der Staaij over het tegengaan van legale aanwezigheid van betrokkenen bij drugssmokkel op haventerreinen
Asks the government to tackle legal presence of people involved in drug smuggling on port terrain and meanwhile rely on permanent controls.
requests the government to work on measures to counter the legal presence of persons involved in drug smuggling on port grounds
verzoekt de regering, werk te maken van maatregelen om de legale aanwezigheid van betrokkenen bij drugssmokkel op haventerreinen tegen te gaan
Amendement van het lid Vestering c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 13 over een grondslag voor het stellen van brandveiligheidsregels
Creates a statutory basis in the Animal Act so the government can set fire-safety rules protecting farm animals from stable fires by or under a general administrative order (AMvB).
This amendment aims to create the legal basis for setting rules to protect farm animals from the dangers of stable fires by or under a general administrative order

Dit amendement beoogt de wettelijke basis te creëren voor het stellen van regels voor de bescherming van landbouwhuisdieren tegen de gevaren van stalbranden bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Podt, Bromet, Eerdmans, Grinwis, Beckerman, Graus en Dassen over ‘het door de Kamer geëiste verbod op stroomstootapparatuur in de veehouderij, dat de minister nog altijd niet hee

MPs from eight parties asked the minister why the ban on electric shock equipment in livestock farming, which parliament demanded, is still unsigned and may not take effect on 1 January 2026. The minister replied that the final decision steps are ready, that an exception to the standard two-month entry-into-force period may allow 1 January 2026, and that the aim remains entry into force on that date.
Within the cabinet policy on fixed change moments, I see room to use an exception to the standard two-month entry-into-force period, so that entry into force on 1 January 2026 remains possible.

Binnen het kabinetsbeleid over de vaste verandermomenten zie ik ruimte om gebruik te maken van een uitzonderingsgrond op de vaste invoeringstermijn van twee maanden, waardoor inwerkingtreding op 1 januari 2026 een mogelijkheid blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over polariserende advertenties van Oxfam Novib

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Foreign Affairs state secretary whether a government-subsidised organisation should label six parliamentary parties as racists or fascists in an Oxfam Novib advertisement, and how the ministry ensures subsidies are not used for partisan or polarising purposes. The state secretary said such language is not constructive but that civil society may criticise policy, that the campaign was crowdfunded and separate from subsidised projects, and that the ministry monitors projects and would reclaim any subsidy used for unagreed purposes.
The ministry actively monitors the implementation of projects throughout their duration.
Het ministerie monitort de uitvoering van projecten actief gedurende de looptijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boomsma en Eerdmans over het voorstel van Eurocommissaris Brunner voor het verspreiden van asielzoekers over Europa

MPs Boomsma and Eerdmans asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration whether the Netherlands received the Commission's relocation proposal, whether they could see the figures, whether Bulgaria and others get reductions, whether the Netherlands qualifies, what data was supplied, and how the Eerdmans motion was implemented. The minister confirmed receipt, offered the document for confidential inspection, said several states including Bulgaria qualify for reductions, said the Netherlands is flagged at risk of migration pressure, that no extra data was supplied, and that a financial solidarity contribution will be committed to.
The document was made available to your House for confidential inspection on 26 November.
Het stuk is op 26 november aan uw Kamer aangeboden ter vertrouwelijk inzage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de jaarlijkse medische kostenpost na terugkeer

Eerdmans asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how much the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek spends on medical treatment before and after return, and the annual medical cost under article 64 of the Vreemdelingenwet.
