The government answered that DTenV does not separately record medical costs and cannot give an amount, and that costs under article 64 for COA residents were about 4.1 to 7.1 million euro per year from 2020 to 2024, with other costs often covered by the OVV scheme without tracking the article 64 link.
The DTenV systems do not record medical care costs separately.
In de systemen van de DTenV worden de kosten voor medische zorg niet apart bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitvoering van Project Beethoven

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the implementation of Project Beethoven, including municipal capacity, international talent, rail station funding, infrastructure cuts, and nitrogen and grid congestion risks for the Brainport region. Minister Karremans answered mostly by referring to earlier letters and debates, stating that work continues via the Bestuurlijk Overleg Brainport and that infrastructure projects proceed, without providing concrete new figures on several points.
At a next opportunity I will inform you about this.
Bij een volgende gelegenheid zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het datalek bij het Openbaar Ministerie

The MP asks what recovery steps have been taken after the hack of the Public Prosecution Service (OM), how their effectiveness is verified, and whether there are signs that sensitive data such as shelter addresses, witness data and HR files were accessed or misused. The Minister says steps followed the security frameworks, the first technical and forensic investigation found no signs of data manipulation or extraction so far, criminal investigation continues, and an independent investigation commission will be set up, while not giving details on the ongoing criminal probe.
I cannot make any statements about the ongoing criminal investigation.
Over het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Maaike (31) werd door indringer Walid K. thuis verkracht en wil niet langer zwijgen: ‘Ik vrees dat andere vrouwen het slachtoffer worden.‘

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a victim's account of a rape by a man whose residence status, early leave from detention and victim notification were questioned. The State Secretary answered that residence status is reviewed after convictions, early leave is granted case by case with victim protection considered, victims are informed about first leave, and access to psychiatric reports is still being explored.
Access to such reports, however, constitutes an infringement of the right to protection of personal privacy, not only of the suspect but also of third parties.
Inzage in dergelijke rapportages vormt evenwel een inbreuk op het recht op bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, niet alleen van de verdachte, maar ook van derden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Van Vroonhoven en Eerdmans over de toepassing van het Europese solidariteitsmechanisme

MPs Van Hijum, Van Vroonhoven and Eerdmans asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the EU solidarity mechanism under the Migration Pact, including Dutch stance, the 2026 solidarity pool, whether the Netherlands could be designated under migration pressure, and Dublin transfer figures. The minister answered that the Netherlands intends to contribute financially rather than through relocations, that its share is roughly 5-6%, that Dublin transfers depend on a plan of action, and that the Commission's decisions will be published, with the Council's pool proposal kept confidential.
The European Commission's proposal for a Council decision on the solidarity pool is confidential under Article 12(6) of the AMMR and other relevant EU legislation.
Het voorstel van de Europese Commissie voor een raadsbesluit over de solidariteitspool is op grond van artikel 12 lid 6 van de AMMR en andere relevante uniewetgeving vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over De verklaring van het KNAW-bestuur over de situatie in Gaza

Member Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the KNAW board's statement on Gaza, including its call for a boycott of Israeli scientists, its selective sourcing, lack of member consultation, and academic freedom. The Minister stated the KNAW is free to make such calls under the WHW, that consultation of members was not required, that academic freedom must be monitored, but declined to judge the KNAW's reference selection.
It is not for me to judge the way the KNAW board chose its references or the way it arrived at a call.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over de wijze waarop het KNAW-bestuur zijn referenties heeft gekozen of de wijze waarop zij tot een oproep komt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Ook de EU heft economische sancties tegen Syrië op' en het artikel 'Kabinet houdt rapport geheim dat terugkeer van tienduizenden Syriërs kan betekenen'

An MP asks whether Syria readmission talks are underway, whether the new Syria country report allows refusing asylum claims and reassessing granted statuses, and whether ambtsberichten and IND working instructions should be less public. The ministers answer that returns proceed via assisted voluntary return, forced return talks are being prepared, individual assessments continue under the existing country policy, and status revocation is not yet justified.
At this moment it cannot yet be concluded in general terms that the positive changes in the current security and human rights situation in Syria are sufficiently far-reaching and non-temporary.

Op dit moment kan nog niet in algemene zin geconcludeerd worden dat de positieve wijzigingen in de huidige veiligheids- en mensenrechtensituatie in Syrië voldoende ingrijpend en niet-voorbijgaand zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de Spreidingswet, de contourennota tot intrekking hiervan en haar uitspraken over dwang

An MP asked whether the Spreidingswet stays fully in force until its planned repeal after 1 February 2026, and whether the minister's announced abstention from coercion on asylum reception means municipalities need not deliver the allocated places. The minister answers that the law remains binding and enforced via the interventieladder, that no fixed timeline applies, and that repeal is being prepared, but she repeatedly declines to confirm the stated absence of coercion.
Municipalities are bound by their statutory duty for as long as the law is in force.
Gemeenten zijn gehouden aan hun wettelijke taak zolang de wet van kracht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de migratietop die op 18 juli 2025 door Duitsland in Beieren is georganiseerd

An MP from JA21 asked why the Netherlands sent no delegation to Germany's July 2025 migration summit in Bavaria, whether it received an invitation, what steps were taken on a motion about the ECHR letter and on treaty changes, and how it stays aligned with European partners. The minister replied that the Netherlands was not invited like several other EU states, pointed to existing EU initiatives and to later reports, and promised further information on the treaty review before the recess.
The Netherlands, like some other neighbouring countries and EU member states, did not receive an invitation to this meeting and therefore sent no delegation.
Nederland ontving net als enkele andere buurlanden en EU-lidstaten geen uitnodiging voor deze bijeenkomst en stuurde daarom geen afvaardiging.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over iftars op ministeries

An MP asked the Minister of Interior which ministries organised iftar dinners in 2025, on whose initiative, and at what cost, and how facilitating religious gatherings squares with church-state separation and civil servant neutrality. The minister answered that iftars were organised by staff networks or activity committees as part of diversity events, that religion holds no specific place among these, and that this is not contrary to neutrality, with costs listed per ministry.
This approach is not in conflict with the neutrality and/or impartiality of civil servants.
Deze aanpak is niet in strijd met de neutraliteit en/of onpartijdigheid van ambtenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Ambtenaren Buitenlandse Zaken: Veldkamp wilde niet meer doen tegen Israël'

MP Eerdmans asked the government how civil servants of the Foreign Ministry could leak a letter to the media, damaging former minister Veldkamp, and what measures would prevent leaks and restore trust. Minister Van Weel answered that leaking confidential information is not allowed and an investigation is launched, that the letter was internal and not formal advice, and that existing rules and internal debate channels apply.
When there is a suspicion of leaking confidential information, an investigation is launched and the Public Prosecution Service is informed.
Bij (een vermoeden) van lekken van vertrouwelijke informatie wordt onderzoek ingesteld en het Openbaar Ministerie geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de tijdelijke accijnsverlaging op brandstoffen.

An MP from JA21 asked the Finance Minister how the expiry of the temporary fuel excise cut on 1 January 2026 would affect fuel stations, especially in border regions, and whether the government would limit the effects or stop indexation. The government answered that it proposes extending the temporary cut by one year in the Belastingplan 2026, while deferring options for later years and keeping indexation suspended only partly, citing budgetary revenue needs.
As included in the Belastingplan 2026, the cabinet proposes to extend the temporary reduction by another year.
Zoals in het Belastingplan 2026 opgenomen, stelt het kabinet voor om de tijdelijke verlaging nog met een jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'EU-klimaatchef Wopke Hoekstra komt met ambitieus klimaatdoel voor 2040: 90 procent reductie; onbetaalbaar zeggen critici'

An MP from JA21 asked the minister about press reports on an EU proposal for a 90% emissions cut by 2040, including whether the Netherlands supports a new target, the economic and regulatory burden, and what steps the cabinet will take to block it. The demissionary minister answered that the Netherlands supports timely agreement on the 2040 target and the EU NDC, cites the Commission's impact assessment, and states it will not oppose the proposal through concrete steps beyond sharing the BNC-fiche and pressing for an implementation package.
The cabinet contributes to the European goals of achieving climate neutrality by 2050 at the latest and at least 55% net greenhouse gas emission reduction by 2030.
Het kabinet levert zijn bijdrage aan de Europese doelen om uiterlijk in 2050 klimaatneutraliteit te bereiken en ten minste netto 55% broeikasgasemissiereductie te realiseren in 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Eerdmans, Flach en Diederik van Dijk over de uit de hand gelopen bijeenkomst op 22 april in Lelystad

MPs Bikker, Eerdmans, Flach and Van Dijk asked whether a counter-demonstration at a Christians for Israel lecture in Lelystad, which forced attendees to stay inside for about three quarters of an hour, was announced or permitted, what support municipalities get, and how safety will be guaranteed. The minister answers that the municipality was informed only shortly before, that the mayor is responsible for facilitating demonstrations, and that a research study on the legal framework is expected at the end of summer.
In the Netherlands the mayor is responsible for facilitating the right to demonstrate.
In Nederland is de burgemeester verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van het demonstratierecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Bikker over de uit de hand gelopen bijeenkomst op 17 april in Zaltbommel

MPs Eerdmans and Bikker asked whether the government would guarantee safety at a Zaltbommel event after a counter-demonstration intimidated attendees, and why organisers were not warned in advance. The Minister answered that the demonstration was not announced, that safety is a matter for the mayor and police, and that a WODC study on the demonstration right will report later this year.
It is a local matter and the mayor is accountable to the municipal council for it.
Het is een lokale aangelegenheid en de burgemeester legt daarover verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk, Eerdmans, Van der Burg en Ceder over de brief van omstreden VN-rapporteur Albanese aan Christenen voor Israël

MPs from SGP, JA21, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about a letter from UN Special Rapporteur Albanese to Christians for Israel, its mandate limits, and threats of criminal consequences. The minister answered that communicating with non-state actors falls within the mandate, that the government disagrees with her content, that vandalism and intimidation are condemned, and that the mandate is adequately defined and the letter was confidential practice.
The letter itself has not been made public.
De brief zelf is niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het Groningen gasveld

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether the closure of the Groningen gas field has increased import dependence and gas prices, and whether the field should be kept as a strategic reserve despite a report warning against permanent closure. The minister acknowledged rising import dependence but attributed the 2022 price spike to Gazprom's conduct and Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and declined to keep the field as a reserve, citing the statutory end of extraction and the public's trust in that commitment.
No, the cabinet does not share the conclusion that it is unwise to permanently close the Groningen field.
Nee, het kabinet deelt de conclusie niet dat het onverstandig is om het Groningenveld definitief te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de wederom uitgestelde windturbinenormen

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked about the repeatedly postponed wind turbine standards, alleging RIVM omitted foreign research on wind turbine noise nuisance and that an integrity complaint against RIVM was upheld by LOWI. Minister Hermans replied that RIVM does track international literature, that the LOWI only ruled on procedure, that definitive standards are expected by 1 January 2027, and that a moratorium on new permits is refused.
The LOWI did not rule on the substance of the complaint, but only on the procedure.
Het LOWI heeft zich niet over de inhoud van de klacht uitgesproken, maar uitsluitend over de procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de subsidie uitkeringen tijdens het Herdenkingsjaar Slavernijverleden en het slavernijverledenfonds

The MP Eerdmans asks about subsidies from the Herdenkingsjaar Slavernijverleden, including a dance project featuring a Rwandan king, how subsidy payments were checked given Finance Ministry warnings, a full list of subsidies, and whether any underspending of the 200 million euro slavery fund should return to the treasury. The ministers answer that the project fits the scheme's aims, that the funds' annual reports and standard procedures provide verification and accountability, that no underspending is currently foreseen, and that any underspending would be redistributed to the fund's goals rather than returned.
The spending of the subsidy funds has been fully accounted for through the public annual reports of the Mondriaan Fund and the Fund for Cultural Participation.
De bestedingen van de subsidiegelden zijn volledig verantwoord via de openbare jaarverslagen van het Mondriaan Fonds en het Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mohandis, Eerdmans, Kostić en Oostenbrink over ledenwerving van ledenomroep WNL op het VVD-congres

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, JA21, PvdD and BBB asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether it is acceptable that broadcaster WNL recruited members at the VVD party congress while wearing press badges, and how this squares with the integrity code and WNL's statutes. The Minister says such recruitment is undesirable, that broadcasters must be careful to distinguish membership drives from journalism, that the Commissariaat voor de Media is the supervisor of the binding parts of the code, and that the membership criterion will be abolished in the planned reform of the public broadcasting system.
I attach great value to the independence of the media.
Ik hecht zeer grote waarde aan de onafhankelijkheid van de media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de terreurdreiging vanuit Pakistan en de Nederlandse wapenexport naar dat land

An MP asks the government about arms exports to Pakistan, alleged state support for jihadist terrorism, undisclosed radar exports, and India's concerns, and asks for full transparency on exports from 2021 to 2025. The government answers that licences are assessed against EU criteria, that a 27.2 million euro radar export was wrongly not reported to parliament, and it publishes a table of licences but does not comment on diplomatic talks.
The transaction concerned the export of parts of ships being built in Romania by the receiving party, with the Pakistani navy as end user.
De transactie betrof de uitvoer van delen van schepen waarmee in Roemenië door de ontvangende partij schepen werden gebouwd met als eindgebruiker de Pakistaanse marine.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over uitspraken van de Nationaal Coördinator over moslimdiscriminatie

An MP asked whether the national anti-discrimination coordinator's claim that Muslim discrimination costs the Netherlands billions is correct, and if so to explain. The minister answers that the coordinator spoke of discrimination and racism in general, not specifically Muslim discrimination, and that a study on the costs of discrimination in the Netherlands is needed, citing a US study as a basis for assuming substantial costs.
The NCDR calls for research into what discrimination costs society, because little is currently known about the societal costs of discrimination and racism in the Netherlands.
De NCDR pleit voor een onderzoek naar wat discriminatie de samenleving kost, omdat er op dit moment weinig bekend is over de maatschappelijke kosten van discriminatie en racisme in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Universiteit Maastricht verbiedt lezing van Joodse student; pro-Palestijnse activiteiten gaan wel door'

An MP from JA21 asked the Education minister whether a university's cancellation of a lecture by a Jewish student, while pro-Palestinian events went ahead, undermines academic freedom and safety for Jewish students. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for weighing safety and debate, that the university is being very restrictive about political events on Gaza/Israel pending an external investigation, and that a broader safety and anti-antisemitism programme is under way.
It is the responsibility of the institutions to weigh whether or not to let an event go ahead.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instellingen om af te wegen of zij een bijeenkomst wel of niet door laten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Burgemeester weigert Eritrese bijeenkomst in Rijswijk uit vrees voor rellen'

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked ministers about the Rijswijk mayor refusing an Eritrean gathering over fear of riots, and about measures, prosecutions, residence permit revocations, and damages following the February 2024 Hague riots. The government answered that local authorities bear primary responsibility, supported by national knowledge and advice networks; that 34 convictions and one acquittal have occurred with damages largely awarded but not yet final; and that it declined to give case-level or IND figures on several points.
Responsibility for taking measures to prevent and deal with unrest lies primarily with local authorities; the national government supports them with knowledge and advice.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het nemen van maatregelen voor het voorkomen en omgaan met onrust ligt in de eerste plaats bij het lokaal gezag; het rijk ondersteunt met kennis en advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de onrust op Nederlandse universiteiten nadat een pro-Israelische spreker een lezing heeft gehouden

Eerdmans (JA21) asks the Ministers of Education and of Justice about disruption at Radboud and Maastricht universities during a lecture by a pro-Israeli speaker, including risk assessments, security measures, handling of disruptors, and protection of Jewish and Israeli students. Minister Bruins answers that the institutions bear primary responsibility for risk assessment and security, that the ministry has been in contact with them, that the minister has no central data on sanctions or students who stay away, and that the minister will inform parliament before the summer recess on follow-up discussions with the sector.
Assessing the risks of lectures and taking security measures, and involving the competent parties where necessary, is the responsibility of the institution in consultation with the local triangle.

Het beoordelen van de risico's van lezingen en het nemen van veiligheidsmaatregelen en het daarbij waar nodig inschakelen van daartoe bevoegde partijen, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instelling in samenspraak met de lokale driehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over Europese financiering voor de Nedersaksenlijn en de Lelylijn

JA21 MP Eerdmans asked why the government reallocated Lelylijn reserved funds despite a unanimous motion, and whether EU co-financing is at risk. The State Secretary answered that EU funding would only ever cover a limited share, that the funds were moved to the Nedersaksenlijn and other projects, and that the Masterplan Lelylijn continues, while declining to see a breach of trust with the Commission.
Last December the motion to keep the existing Lelylijn budget reserved and not use it for other purposes was adopted with support from the whole chamber; why did you not respect this motion?

Afgelopen december is de motie «het bestaande budget voor de Lelylijn gereserveerd houden en niet aanwenden voor andere doeleinden», kamerbreed aangenomen, waarom heeft u deze motie niet gerespecteerd?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Deze wijk verdwijnt, maar bewoners zijn tegen: 'Dit ga je toch niet slopen?''

JA21 MP Eerdmans asked the minister about the planned demolition of the temporary Mrija housing district for Ukrainian refugees in Vlaardingen to make way for a wastewater treatment plant, and urged reuse for housing seekers. The minister answered that the flexible homes will be transferred to housing corporation Waterweg Wonen after 2026, that there is no demolition, that the matter is primarily local, and that no intervention is planned.
I see no reason to do so. This is primarily a local matter.
Daar zie ik geen aanleiding toe. Dit is primair een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Amerikaanse luchtvaart weer naar de rechter als kabinet krimp Schiphol doorzet’

An MP from JA21 asks the minister whether American airline association A4A's letter threatening legal action has been received, whether the government will reconsider its Schiphol capacity reduction given the risk of foreign countermeasures from the US, China and India, and what those countries have signalled. The minister replies that the balanced approach procedure was followed correctly, that A4A's concerns are known and the case has been referred to the administrative court, that contacts with the US, China and India have taken place, and that countermeasures cannot be fully excluded but were weighed in the decision.
A4A submitted a confidential opinion in the procedure for the airport traffic decision (LVB procedure).
A4A heeft een vertrouwelijke zienswijze in de procedure voor het luchthaven verkeerbesluit (LVB-procedure) ingediend
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de antwoorden op vragen over 'asielopvang in hotels'

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the Vlaardingen municipality is right that earlier answers did not cover short stays in hotels, and whether municipalities can refuse asylum reception beyond public order grounds, and asks if the democratically rejected council proposal to house 100 asylum seekers should be respected. The minister answers that short stays are permitted under current permits, that municipalities must cooperate via the provincial table and the Wet gemeentelijke taak, and that reception is in principle realised only in agreement with local government, without committing to new action.
From an administrative standpoint, the COA always strives to realise reception in good consultation with the municipality.
Vanuit bestuurlijk oogpunt geldt dat het COA er altijd naar streeft om in goed overleg met de gemeente opvang te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Nieuw boek Joran van der Sloot op plek 30 in bestseller 60'

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the government knows about outstanding compensation owed by Joran van der Sloot to victims and relatives, whether his book earnings should go to them, and whether the state should help recover it. The minister said the government has no oversight of these foreign convictions, cannot intervene in another country's jurisdiction, and has no role in enforcing foreign judgments.
Criminal cases, convictions and the enforcement of decisions abroad take place under the laws and regulations of the country concerned.
Strafzaken, veroordelingen en de tenuitvoerlegging van beslissingen in het buitenland vinden plaats volgens de wet- en regelgeving van het betreffende land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Verdachte van UvA-rellen voor rechter: 'Politie was goed beschermd, ik ben onschuldig'

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked whether the government would revoke the residence permit of a Chinese student convicted for riot-related violence at the University of Amsterdam, and how it views such conduct. The minister condemned the violence, said individual cases are for the courts, and explained the IND's general framework for revoking student permits on public-order grounds, without committing to a timeline for this case.
However, I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan echter niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Eerdmans over invoering van importheffingen op Amerikaanse producten

MP Eerdmans asked whether EU countermeasures against US tariffs, which may include food products such as meat and nuts, should be avoided given rising grocery costs, and cited a Rabo report on price effects. Minister Klever confirmed the US steel and aluminium tariffs and the EU list including food, said food should be assessed product by product, and gave no commitment to remove food from the list.
For the Netherlands this is an important point of attention in its efforts in Brussels regarding this list.
Dit is voor Nederland een belangrijk aandachtspunt bij de inzet in Brussel ten aanzien van deze lijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in executive agencies; this answer from the Education minister covers DUO and NWO. The minister says there are no plans to intensify or scale back the policy, explains the budget and training offered, and states that the set of questions concerns internal personnel policy rather than checks on executive power.
OCW has no specific diversity or gender policy.
OCW heeft geen specifiek diversiteits- of genderbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de natuurvergunningproblematiek bij Defensie

An MP asked whether nitrogen (stikstof) nature-permit rules, tightened by the Council of State's December 2024 rulings, are blocking Defence expansion and training, and whether Defence should be exempted. The government confirms the rulings affect Defence (especially retroactive intern salderen), says impact and capacity needs are still being analysed, notes the MCE&N will consider Defence's interests, but does not exempt Defence and points to the planned Wet op de defensiegereedheid instead.
Defence is bound by existing laws and regulations.
Defensie is gehouden aan bestaande wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Tienduizenden huishoudens kunnen energierekening niet betalen: waarom is aardgas zo duur?'

MP Eerdmans asks why gas is expensive, whether energy tax and VAT should be cut, whether the Groningen field closure reduced security of supply, and why a relief fund targets only the poorest households. The minister answers that tax and wholesale prices both drive gas tariffs, the 2025 tax cut is small, the fund reflects that not all households face rising prices, Groningen closure did not cause supply problems, and gas storage is being monitored with an update promised in April.
In April the cabinet will provide a further update on gas security of supply.
In april komt het kabinet met een volgende update over de gasleveringszekerheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder, Van der Burg, Kahraman, Vermeer, Boswijk en Eerdmans over christenvervolging in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the killing of 70 people in a church in the DR Congo, the role of the Special Envoy for Religion, EU terrorist listing of the ADF, foreign support for the ADF, and UN action. The minister condemned the attack, said the Envoy's involvement is not currently of added value, agreed to explore listing the ADF, and described Dutch and EU support for peace and UN human rights mechanisms.
I am willing to examine the possibilities of placing this group on the European terrorism sanctions list or the European ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctions list.
Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze groep op de Europese terrorisme-sanctielijst of de Europese ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctielijst te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Ambulance met spoed steeds langer onderweg: 'In ons dorp bijna nooit op tijd''

MPs Eerdmans and Diederik van Dijk asked the minister about large regional differences in ambulance response times and rising overruns of the 15-minute norm. The minister defended the current regional norm, pointed to a new urgency classification and care coordination, and promised annual transparency on response times at municipal level from 2026, while the 2024 figures are not yet available.
That is why I have formally asked Ambulancezorg Nederland to provide annual transparency on ambulance response times at municipal level from 2026 (reporting year 2025).

Daarom heb ik Ambulancezorg Nederland formeel verzocht om vanaf 2026 (dat wil zeggen rapportagejaar 2025) jaarlijks transparantie te verschaffen over de responstijden van de ambulance op gemeenteniveau
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Wal, Stoffer en Eerdmans over het bericht 'Nederland geeft roofkunst terug aan Nigeria: Herstel van historisch onrecht'

Three MPs (Van der Wal, Stoffer, Eerdmans) asked why the Dutch government returned 113 looted Benin objects to Nigeria without conditions, when their destination is unknown and Nigeria ranks poorly on corruption, and whether restitution was coordinated with parliament. The minister replied that unconditional return is the policy for looted objects, that the receiving government decides where objects go, that no conservation guarantees were required, and that parliament is informed of policy changes but not of individual restitution decisions.
I do not intend to inform the House of intended restitutions when handling specific cases.
Ik heb niet het voornemen de Kamer te informeren over voornemens tot restitutie bij de behandeling van specifieke casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de stand van zaken van de Top X-lijst

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about the Top X list of criminal and nuisance-causing asylum residents, including whether they should be denied residence permits, numbers by province and nationality, detention and restriction status, and deportations and permits granted since a motion. The Minister answered that residence permits can be refused or withdrawn only under strict case law, gave the January 2025 list figures, and could not supply the deportation and permit figures due to lack of systematic records.
Because the requested figures are not systematically recorded in that way, and given the answering deadline, it has not been possible to generate the figures requested in questions 8 and 9.
Omdat de gevraagde cijfers op die manier niet systematisch worden bijgehouden, en gegeven de beantwoordingstermijn, is het niet mogelijk gebleken de in vragen 8 en 9 gevraagde cijfers te genereren.
Antwoord op het lid Eerdmans over het persbericht van 16 januari 2025 met als titel 'Defensie over op 100% duurzame elektriciteit'

MP Eerdmans asked the State Secretary of Defence how the switch to 100% sustainable electricity fits Defence's operational readiness, supply security during crises, back-up systems, contracts for 2026-2027, strategic dependence, costs, and FTE devoted to sustainability. The answers state that only fixed defence sites switch to Dutch-sourced green electricity, that weapon systems keep fossil variants, that emergency generators back up critical processes, that contracts with Eneco and Vattenfall cover 2025-2027, that the extra cost is about 0.3% (details commercially confidential), and that 17 FTE work on sustainability goals.
The content and financial scope of this are commercially confidential.
De inhoud en financiële omvang hiervan is commercieel vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het Nationaal Klimaat Platform

An MP asked how the National Climate Platform (NKP) is funded, why it is not covered by the Open Government Act (Woo), how its finances and salaries are accounted for, and whether its mandate will be extended. The minister replied that it receives up to 2.4 million euro per year via the I&W directorate, that the Woo exclusion was legally wrong and the website adjusted, promised publication of the financial report by 10 March, and said a decision on continuation will follow an evaluation expected in Q2.
The NKP is now preparing publication of the financial accountability for the past two years and will publish it on its website before 10 March.
Het NKP is publicatie van de financiële verantwoording van de afgelopen twee jaar nu aan het voorbereiden en zal deze voor 10 maart op hun website publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Ruim 700 aanhoudingen bij demonstratie Extinction Rebellion op A12'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about mass arrests at an Extinction Rebellion blockade of the A12, whether prosecutions have followed, what preventive measures will stop the next blockade, and how many people faced delayed ambulances. The minister said prosecution decisions await the public prosecutor, that preventive measures are a local matter for the mayor, that a ban on face coverings at demonstrations is being explored, and that ambulance delays were due to several factors.
The public prosecutor is currently investigating possible offences committed during the demonstration and will then assess whether prosecution is appropriate.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) doet op dit moment onderzoek naar mogelijke misdrijven die tijdens de demonstratie zijn gepleegd en zal daarna afwegen of vervolging opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Vermeer over het bericht 'Minister wijst verder onderzoek naar eilanden met zonnepanelen in IJsselmeer definitief van de hand'

MPs Eerdmans and Vermeer asked whether the Wieringerhoek floating solar project in the IJsselmeer can still proceed despite the minister halting it, and whether the Rijk should stop further steps by the province and municipality. The minister answered that no procedures are running, the cabinet refused the Meerlicht B.V. project application, insufficient prospects for permits exist, and the cabinet sees no reason to act on the call to halt local efforts.
Given this, and since the cabinet has already rejected the Meerlicht B.V. application for the project procedure, the cabinet sees no reason at this time to act on your call.

Gezien dit gegeven en het kabinet de aanvraag van Meerlicht B.V. tot toepassing van de projectprocedure reeds heeft afgewezen, ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen aanleiding om gevolg te geven aan uw oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Klap voor ministers: omstreden buitenlandse predikers mogen toch Nederland in van rechter’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked ministers how they would prevent three controversial foreign preachers from entering the Netherlands, whether landing rights could be revoked as in 2017, and what would be done if they had already landed. The ministers answered that a court had suspended the entry ban, so the preachers may enter if they meet entry conditions, that existing law offers no further grounds to refuse them, that landing rights cannot be revoked for migration reasons, and that local authorities are responsible for public order at the event.

On 20 February 2025 the interim relief judge suspended the decision to bar the three speakers from the Netherlands through an alert in the Schengen Information System, until six weeks after the decision on objection is announced.

Op 20 februari 2025 heeft de voorzieningenrechter het besluit om de drie sprekers uit Nederland te weren door signalering in het Schengeninformatiesysteem, geschorst tot zes weken na bekendmaking van de beslissing op bezwaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Diederik van Dijk, Van den Hil, Krul, Ceder, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Slagt-Tichelman, Kostić en Eerdmans over een solide toekomstplan voor Kamp Westerbork naar aanleiding van 80 jaar

MPs asked the government to respond to Kamp Westerbork memorial's financial shortfalls, deferred maintenance and the need for a sustainable future plan, and to say what it will do about the memorial's proposed plan and the Moluccan history. The state secretary answers that a solid future plan will be developed with the memorial centres, one-off 2025 funds have been reserved, the memorial's financing plan is under study, and an OHW letter on progress is expected around summer 2025.
I am studying this plan and looking at what role the central government can play in it.
Ik ben dit plan aan het bestuderen en bekijken welke rol de Rijksoverheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Eerdmans over het nieuws dat Russische geheim agenten met vissersschepen naar Nederland kunnen reizen

MPs asked whether the NVWA can fully inspect Russian fish imports, impose fines or seize cargo, and whether the government will push for a ban on Russian whitefish, sanctions on Norebo, restrictions on Russian crews and measures against financing of Russia via Dutch ports. The minister answered that inspections are risk-based within EU benchmarks, that the NVWA lacks powers over catch quotas, that no fines were issued, and that the government favours exploring a whitefish import ban while leaving options open and withholding details of its negotiating position.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch negotiating position, nor of the surprise effect necessary for sanctions to be effective, to go into more detail on the Dutch negotiating position.

Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en van de voor de effectiviteit van sancties noodzakelijke verrassingseffect om in meer detail op de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het Nationaal Burgerberaad Klimaat

MP Eerdmans asked whether the National Citizens' Climate Assembly is representative given self-registration after a lottery, who formulated its central question, why the new cabinet kept the process, what it costs, what funds exist for implementing its recommendations, and how outcomes are secured. The minister answers that participants were selected on five characteristics, that the question was jointly set with parliament and the previous cabinet and re-confirmed, that the process continues with a 10-15% extra cost claim under review, and that the cabinet commits to a substantive response within six months and a follow-up meeting after twelve months.
This additional claim is currently being assessed by both responsible ministries and will be handled in the regular budget cycle.
Deze aanvullende claim wordt op dit moment beoordeeld door beide verantwoordelijke ministeries en zal meelopen in de reguliere begrotingscyclus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder, Van Zanten, Eerdmans en Ellian over het weigeren van een Israëlische comedian door theaters in Amsterdam

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she views Amsterdam theatres declining to host Israeli comedian Yohay Sponder after threats and reactions, whether local police and municipal bodies were consulted, and what follow-up is planned. The minister condemns the intimidation, says cultural institutions must be free to programme, notes Boom Chicago did not follow the sector protocol, and reports ongoing talks with the alderman and Kunsten '92 to find an alternative venue.
It is intolerable that a cultural institution receives such reactions or is threatened to such an extent that a performance is cancelled.
Het is onverteerbaar dat een culturele instelling zodanige reacties krijgt of zodanig wordt bedreigd dat een voorstelling wordt geannuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Six Dijkstra over het bericht 'De Vonk nodigt omstreden pro-Palestijnse activist Khatib uit voor politiek evenement’

MPs Eerdmans and Six Dijkstra asked whether the government could stop Mohammed Khatib, invited by party De Vonk, from speaking in person or online in the Netherlands. The minister answered that Khatib is flagged for refusal at entry, that online speech can be prosecuted or removed, and that the government will explore broader tools while noting limits set by free speech case law.
I want to explore in the coming period whether there are possibilities within the framework of national security to broaden the scope for action.
Ik wil de komende tijd verkennen of er in het kader van nationale veiligheid mogelijkheden zijn om het handelingsperspectief te verbreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel “’Kanaalkijkers’ zijn vol bewondering over leegpompen, verdiepen en verbreden van Julianakanaal”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about emission-free earthmoving machines on the Julianakanaal project, the cost and delay of Schoon en Emissieloos Bouwen (SEB), diesel generators, the risk of delay to the dike reinforcement programme (HWBP), and safety risks for residents. The minister answered that the project was urgent so no emission-free equipment requirements were set, that SEB costs are only known at programme level and will be evaluated in 2025, and that nitrogen issues and SEB are considered per project without evidence SEB itself causes delays.
Since the calamity had to be resolved urgently, no estimate was made of the additional costs and extra lead time from using emission-free equipment on the Julianakanaal.

Aangezien de calamiteit met spoed moest worden opgelost, is er geen inschatting gemaakt van de meerkosten en extra doorlooptijd als gevolg van de inzet van emissieloos materieel bij het Julianakanaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Ridouan Taghi krijgt schadevergoeding van Staat wegens onterechte beperkingen'

MP Eerdmans asked the Minister of Justice why the state pays damages to Ridouan Taghi for unlawful detention restrictions, whether the amounts were justified, how many other EBI prisoners received damages, and whether rights could be curtailed for such cases. The Minister declined to discuss the individual case, stated in general terms that detainees can claim damages when a court finds restrictions unlawful, did not track EBI compensation figures, and refused to curtail fundamental rights.
Although I cannot go into individual case details, I can provide the following in general terms
Hoewel ik niet kan ingaan op individuele casuïstiek, kan ik u in zijn algemeenheid het volgende meegeven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over klimaatvluchtelingen

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Foreign Minister whether the legal adviser's call for more attention to rights of climate refugees fits the government's 'strictest asylum policy ever' pledge, and about Dutch positions on new rights and on Vanuatu's proposal for climate damage claims. The minister answered that the Dutch submission to the ICJ only notes existing human rights may apply, that no new rights or lead role are planned, and that climate damage claims lack a legal basis, pointing to collective UN-based funding mechanisms instead.
The Netherlands does not intend to give substance to this in its foreign policy.
Nederland is niet voornemens om hier invulling aan te geven in haar buitenlandbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het amendement over middelen voor de ontwikkeling van Small Modular Reactors (SMR’s)

The MP asks the minister about progress on the SMR amendment, including the status of programme lines 1 and 2, the number of provinces involved, and timelines for simulations. The minister reports that five simulations start in February to June 2025 with results mid-2025, that both lines run in parallel, and that most provinces joined via the IPO working group.
The cabinet will soon inform the House further about the steps taken since publication of the SMR programme.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer binnenkort verder informeren over de stappen die gezet zijn sinds publicatie van het SMR programma.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over asielopvang in hotels

MP Eerdmans asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether hotels can be used for asylum reception against a municipality's will, what legal role COA and municipalities have, and how the Vlaardingen Campanile case fits with the Tubbergen precedent. The minister answered that municipal consent is not legally required for hotel placement but COA aims to agree with municipalities, that the Vlaardingen case is different from Tubbergen, and that no ruimtelijke ordening instrument has been threatened there.
Permission from the municipal government is not legally required from a legal standpoint, but COA always strives to realize this in consultation with the municipal government.
Toestemming van het gemeentebestuur is hiervoor vanuit juridisch oogpunt niet vereist, maar het COA streeft er altijd naar om dit in afstemming met het gemeentebestuur te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen vragen de leden Kostić, Ram, Graus, Hirsch, Paternotte, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de wrede jacht op kangoeroes en de Nederlandse betrokkenheid daarbij

MPs from several parties asked the government about the cruel kangaroo hunt, Dutch imports of kangaroo meat and leather, and calls for an import ban. The Staatssecretaris answered that animal welfare concerns are shared, that Australia regulates its own hunting, that an import ban can only be set at EU level and must comply with WTO rules, and that a plan under a prior motion is being prepared; several answers were deferred.
Banning the import of a product from a country outside the European Union, in this case Australia, can only be arranged at European level.
Import van een product verbieden dat uit een land komt van buiten de Europese Unie, in dit geval Australië, kan alleen op Europees niveau geregeld worden.

Antwoord op vragen die het lid Eerdmans over het bericht van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) op 10 december 2024, waarin wordt gemeld dat de inflatie in november is gestegen naar 4,0 procent

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Finance Minister why Dutch HICP inflation (3.8%) exceeds the eurozone average, what measures will be taken, the effects on middle incomes, sectors at risk, fiscal drivers and wage-price entrenchment. The minister answered that inflation is mainly driven by a tighter Dutch economy and wage growth, that the government's role is budget discipline and structural spending restraint, and that most other questions are answered by pointing to existing policy or to social partners and the ECB.
Controlling inflation is the responsibility of the European Central Bank, which focuses on price stability in the eurozone as a whole.
Het beheersen van de inflatie is aan de Europese Centrale Bank, die zich richt op de prijsstabiliteit in de eurozone als geheel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Bikker over het rapport ‘Hamas in Europe’ en het bericht 'Buurlanden komt hij niet in, tóch mag omstreden kopstuk van pro-Palestinaclub spreken op universiteit in Nijmegen'

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the government would investigate persons and organisations linked to Hamas in a report, and whether it would act against the Samidoun coordinator invited to speak at Radboud University. The government replied that the AIVD investigation continues, that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, that the speaker has been flagged for entry refusal, and that talks with the Public Prosecution Service and AIVD on Samidoun-type organisations took place without indications for criminal suspicion.
Naturally, no public statement can be made about whether intelligence and security services are conducting investigations into persons or organisations.
Vanzelfsprekend kan in de openbaarheid geen uitspraak worden gedaan over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten naar personen of organisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het krantenartikel 'Forse verhoging havengelden Schiphol wekt woede in de luchtvaartsector'

An MP asks the minister about a 41% rise in Schiphol airport charges, its fairness to short-haul and Dutch-departing passengers, and whether the government will engage Schiphol. The minister replies that Schiphol sets charges under a legal framework checked by the ACM, that transfer discounts protect the hub, and that the government will report on an airport-tax study in Q2 2025.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is the independent regulator and tests the airport charges against the legal framework, including on reasonableness.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is de onafhankelijke toezichthouder en toetst de luchthavengelden aan het wettelijk kader, op onder andere redelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Flach over de versterkte gebedsoproepen door moskeeën

MPs Eerdmans and Flach asked the Minister of Interior about enhanced call-to-prayer broadcasts from mosques, including their frequency, number of complaints and legal basis. The minister answered that no data on mosques, frequency or complaints is yet available, that a fact-finding trajectory is underway to inform future rules, and that the practice is a constitutionally protected connex right subject to necessity and proportionality.
No, we do not yet have this information at this time.
Nee, wij beschikken op dit moment nog niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de salariskosten per medewerker bij Stichting SGH

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the State Secretary of Finance about high salary costs per employee at Stichting SGH, the restoration foundation for the childcare benefits affair, its non-public annual reports, the 240,000 euro annual transfer to the Number 5 Foundation, paid claims experts, independent oversight of the 100 million euro budget, and whether the operation should avoid becoming a profit model. The State Secretary answered that costs are based on actual expenses checked by an independent accountant with annual reconciliation, that 2023 reports were not drawn up because activities were limited, that the accountant judges the Number 5 transfer, and that paid experts were hired to scale up.
Because SGH's activities in 2023 were limited, no extensive annual account was drawn up for them.
Omdat de werkzaamheden van SGH in 2023 beperkt waren, is hier geen uitgebreide jaarrekening voor opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Eerdmans over het bericht dat gemeenten nauwelijks van elkaar leren over nieuwjaarsgeweld

MPs Van Nispen and Eerdmans asked whether municipalities learn enough from each other about preventing New Year's Eve disorder, and what role the minister sees for herself. The minister replied that knowledge sharing already happens via VNG networks, regional consultations and the Strategic Consultation with mayors, that local preparation is a municipal responsibility, and offered no new concrete step.
Preparing for the New Year's celebration is a local responsibility and runs through the local triangle.
Het voorbereiden van de jaarwisseling is een lokale bevoegdheid en verloopt via de lokale driehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het antwoord op vragen over de oproep van Extinction Rebellion om de A12 te bezetten op 6 juli 2024

An MP from JA21 asked the Justice Minister about Extinction Rebellion's road blockades (A10, A12, A15), police deployment, prosecutions, the scope of the right to demonstrate under Dutch and European law, and whether ANBI status should be revoked. The minister answered that police and prosecution data cannot be broken down per demonstration, that a study on the demonstration framework is under way, and that ANBI status is for the Tax Service to assess.
Research is being carried out into ways to strengthen the room for action within the framework of the above-mentioned case law.
Er wordt onderzoek uitgevoerd naar mogelijkheden om het handelingsperspectief te versterken binnen het kader van bovengenoemde jurisprudentie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans, Rikkers-Oosterkamp en Diederik van Dijk over slechte aanrijtijden in kernen van Nunspeet en het artikel dat een vrouw overleed die na een aanrijding drie kwartier moest wachten o

MPs Eerdmans, Rikkers-Oosterkamp and Diederik van Dijk asked about poor ambulance response times in villages around Nunspeet and a reported death after a woman waited three quarters of an hour for an ambulance. The minister expressed sympathy, defended the regional 15-minute norm, pointed to the new urgency triage and a pending dialogue with AZN on local transparency, but declined to publish local figures or accept location-specific accountability.
Monitoring or accounting at local level does not fit with that.
Monitoren of verantwoorden op lokaal niveau sluit daar niet op aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat het aandeel werkenden in armoede in vijf jaar tijd met liefst 25% is toegenomen

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that the share of working people in poverty rose 25% in five years, and whether work pays more than benefits, with questions on the composition of working poor, benefit-take-up, marginal tax burdens and measures. The State Secretary answered that the rise reflects falling poverty among benefit recipients rather than more working poor, cited data on working poverty and planned measures such as proactive service delivery, though several breakdowns were unavailable.
The cabinet does not currently have figures for all the requested breakdowns within the group of workers.
Het kabinet beschikt op dit moment niet over cijfers voor alle gevraagde uitsplitsingen binnen de groep werkenden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Komst vluchtelingen Weteringsingel zorgt voor grote onrust bij inwoners'

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about a plan to open a second reception location for 80 unaccompanied minors in Papendrecht, its consistency with the government's large-scale reception policy, the lack of consultation with residents and councillors, and how municipal councils can be prevented from being sidelined by COA agreements. The Minister answered that small-scale locations for unaccompanied minors are normal, that large-scale reception is the general policy with small sites still needed, that the municipality is responsible for consultation and the decision process, and that COA-municipality agreements may include safety arrangements.
The decision-making process is a matter for the municipality.
Het proces van besluitvorming is aan de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Aan Oekraïne geleverde NAVO-wapens in beslag genomen die in criminele circuit waren beland'

An MP from JA21 asked the Justice and Defence ministers how NATO weapons supplied to Ukraine could end up in Dutch criminal circles and what safeguards exist. The ministers answered that the risk of diversion is acknowledged and weighed against Ukraine support, citing the EU list of actions, a national Firearms Focal Point and export checks, and gave only general or partial answers on some questions.
The risk of diversion is not in proportion to Ukraine's urgent needs and the Dutch interest in continuing to support Ukraine with military goods.
Het risico op omleiding staat niet in verhouding tot de urgente behoeftes van Oekraïne en het Nederlandse belang Oekraïne met militaire goederen te blijven steunen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen het lid Eerdmans over de instroom en terugkeer van alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the inflow of unaccompanied minors, their acceptance rates, absconding, family reunification, the EU migration pact's exemption from border procedures, and whether adequate reception in origin countries (as in Angola) could enable returns. The minister answers with statistics, acknowledges concerns about sending minors ahead, notes the EU rules apply from 2026, and commits to further research and to pursuing reception partnerships in origin countries.
I find this practice highly undesirable.
Deze praktijk vind ik zeer onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het recente NRC-artikel 'Coalitie vreest dat de staat zelf moet opdraaien voor bouw nieuwe kerncentrales.'

An MP asked the minister about private investor reluctance to finance new nuclear plants, Dutch energy policy credibility, and options such as majority state ownership and guarantees. The minister acknowledged the financing challenge, said a decision on financing is due in 2025, and committed to sending market consultation results to parliament within weeks.
Within a few weeks I will inform the House of Representatives further about these results, accompanied by a cabinet appraisal.
Binnen een aantal weken zal ik de Tweede Kamer nader informeren over deze resultaten vergezeld van een kabinetsappreciatie.
Antwoord op vragen van Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Burgemeester Halsema overwoog activisten op UvA eigen universiteitsgebouw te geven'

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Education about reports that the Amsterdam mayor considered giving occupying activists a university building at the UvA, the damage costs, recovery of damages, student safety, student visas and protest policy. The government answered that the mayor and university boards are responsible for these matters, that damage recovery is for the institution, and that it will study the protest framework and reports by summer 2025.
It is therefore not for me to judge that.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om daarover te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Eerdmans over de houding van het kabinet ten opzichte van UNRWA-financiering

Dutch MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the minister whether Dutch UNRWA funding could have reached Hamas, how UN investigations into staff were weighed in resuming funding, whether neutrality enforcement is adequate, and about future funding and diversification. The minister answered that UNRWA is subject to vetting, audits and the Colonna recommendations, that the staff investigations were inconclusive and led to dismissals, and that funding for 2023-2025 is committed and future budgets are not yet decided.
The cabinet, together with other donors, raised these concerns with both the organisation and the UN Secretary-General.
Het kabinet heeft, samen met andere donoren, deze zorgen aan de orde gesteld bij zowel de organisatie als bij de Secretaris-Generaal van de VN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over zelfmelders

An MP asks the State Secretary about self-reporting (zelfmelders) prisoners, the backlog of unserved sentences, early releases, not pursuing short-sentence arrestees, transfers of tbs patients, and how these measures fit the coalition agreement's call for harsher sentences. The government answers that capacity pressure forces prioritisation and sober-regime measures, while stating it will keep seeking capacity solutions and pilot reduced daytime programmes.
Addressing the capacity problem has the highest priority for me.
Het aanpakken van de capaciteitsproblematiek heeft voor mij de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Gemeenten met azc’s moeten van minister Faber nog vóór 1 september extra plekken vrijmaken’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked whether COA was ordered to place one or two extra asylum seekers in every reception location before 1 September without consulting municipalities, and whether this overrides local agreements and amounts to coercion. Minister Faber answered that COA was asked to place 1 to 2 extra asylum seekers per location as a last-resort measure to relieve Ter Apel, that municipalities could report non-cooperation and a solution would be sought, and that she values keeping agreements while denying any coercion.
Therefore, no consultation with municipalities or the VNG took place prior to this measure.
Derhalve heeft voorafgaand aan deze maatregel geen overleg plaatsgevonden met gemeenten of de VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel “Geen DDA vluchten meer in 2025”

MP Eerdmans asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the end of Dakota flights in 2025 due to the EU lead-fuel ban and general aviation fleet impacts. The minister answered that the ban is EU regulation, no exemption is possible, aviation safety is not affected once certified, and the government awaits the ECHA decision on the request.
This concerns European regulation that applies to all EU member states.
Het betreft hier Europese regelgeving die voor alle EU-lidstaten geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het vernattingsbeleid van de duinstreek van Noord- en Zuid-Holland

MP Eerdmans asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the nature-oriented dune water management policy, which may have caused flooding, should be revised after heavy rainfall, whether residents can be told to waterproof cellars, and why the consultation with the water boards is not brought forward. The minister denied that a national 'vernattingsbeleid' exists, attributed the flooding to an exceptionally wet period, placed responsibility on local and regional water managers and residents, and said no structural measures are yet decided.
However, there is no 'national waterlogging policy' for the dunes and therefore no possibility of revising it.
Er bestaat echter geen «landelijk vernattingsbeleid» voor de duinen en daardoor ook geen mogelijkheid tot herziening ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht «Pro-Palestijnse activisten richten opnieuw vernielingen aan bij Universiteit van Amsterdam»

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the University of Amsterdam would press charges for vandalism of its buildings, and about the costs and visa measures. The minister answered that the UvA did file a police report, that the damage was estimated at €600, and that the IND will withdraw residence permits of non-EU students who threaten public order where proportionate.
The UvA also states that it always files charges for vandalism and that it did so in this case as well.
Ook de UvA geeft aan altijd aangifte van vernielingen te doen en dat ook in dit geval te hebben gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht: ‘Overijsselse gemeenten houden tientallen miljoenen over aan opvang Oekraïners.’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the government about reports that Overijssel municipalities kept tens of millions in surplus funds for Ukrainian refugee reception, asking for total costs, surpluses by province, repayments, supervision, and whether surpluses can be spent freely. The Minister replied that the Rijk lacks insight into per-municipality surpluses, that only 9 municipalities returned unspent 2022 funds, that normbedragen are fixed and surpluses may be spent on public tasks with accountability to the council, and that repayment is voluntary, not reclaimed.
The Rijk has no insight into possible surpluses or shortfalls relative to the standard allowance at the level of individual municipalities or provinces.
Het Rijk heeft geen inzicht in de eventuele overschotten of tekorten ten opzichte van de normvergoeding op het niveau van individuele gemeenten of provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het vullen van de gasopslagen

An MP asks why Dutch gas storage lags behind the EU average, whether commercial motives or the Groningen field closure play a role, how much Russian gas is imported, and whether storage will reach 90% by 1 October 2024. The minister answers that storage is ambitioned at 90% by 1 November, that current fill is already around 90%, that the Groningen revenue drop refers to 2023 rather than 2024, and that an update on supply security will follow before 1 October.
Before 1 October 2024 I will provide an update on gas supply security, setting out a broader picture and addressing ongoing policy.
Voor 1 oktober 2024 kom ik met een update over de gasleveringszekerheid, waarin ik een uitgebreider beeld schets en inga op het lopende beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Groeiend verzet tegen vrij rond laten lopen van veroordeelden: 'Onaanvaardbaar''

An MP from JA21 asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the roughly 2,000 convicted persons (zelfmelders) who remain free while waiting to serve their sentences due to prison capacity shortages, and about measures such as multi-person cells, reuse of empty buildings, rehiring former staff and community service. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, says it is a priority, reports ongoing efforts and promises a progress letter by end of September, but rejects several proposals as infeasible.
I inform the House about the current figures and developments every three months.
Over het actuele cijferbeeld en ontwikkelingen informeer ik uw Kamer iedere drie maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de oproep van Extinction Rebellion om de A12 te bezetten op 6 juli 2024

MP Eerdmans asked the Justice Minister about Extinction Rebellion's road blockades (A12) and planned action on 6 July 2024, covering police capacity, preventive seizure and searches, prosecution for incitement, and whether the group's ANBI charity status should be revoked. The minister answered that police and the Public Prosecution Service are responsible for operational and prosecutorial decisions, outlined the legal limits on seizure and searches, and explained that ANBI status is assessed by the Tax Authority under strict secrecy, with revocation only for serious crimes; the answers came late.
It is not for me to decide on that. Any arrest of people is a matter for the police under the authority of the Public Prosecution Service.
Het is niet aan mij om zoiets te besluiten. Het eventueel aanhouden van mensen is aan de politie onder gezag van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Ban op boa-hoofddoek voorlopig in ijskast gezet'

An MP asked the Justice Minister why legislation requiring neutral appearance for municipal enforcement officers (boa's), including a headscarf ban, has been delayed and is now tied to the new coalition agreement. The minister answered that the neutrality law is being prepared carefully, will be linked to the coalition agreement, that existing guidelines apply in the meantime, and that the Chamber will be informed as soon as possible about the timeline.
Your Chamber will be informed by me as soon as possible about the further course.
Uw Kamer wordt zo spoedig mogelijk door mij geïnformeerd over het verdere traject.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans, Diederik van Dijk en Tuinman over het bericht dat de Europese coördinator van het in Duitsland verboden Samidoun, genaamd Mohammed Khatib, op 10 juni 2024 komt spreken op de Radb

MPs Eerdmans, Diederik van Dijk and Tuinman asked whether the government would engage Germany on Samidoun's Radboud University talk, bar the speaker from entry, ban the organisation, and push for EU terrorist listing. The minister answered that the government will talk with Germany, that the universities bear responsibility for event conditions, that the entry ban law does not allow refusing entry, and that listing is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and the Foreign Ministry, with the motion being investigated.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to consider whether there are grounds to ban an organisation, not for the cabinet.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bezien of er redenen zijn waarom een organisatie verboden moet worden, niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeer en Eerdmans over de zonne-atollen op het IJsselmeer

MPs Vermeer and Eerdmans asked the Minister about opposition to the floating solar 'zonne-atollen' plan on the IJsselmeer, including its Natura 2000 status, defence use, water storage and timing. The Minister answers that the plan is only being explored in an integrated study (Wieringerhoek), with a decision on a formal project procedure targeted for Q4 2024, and that participation will follow in any later procedure.
Only with a positive decision will there be a project procedure for which my department is responsible.
Pas bij een positief besluit zal er sprake zijn van een projectprocedure waarvoor mijn departement verantwoordelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel op de website van De Telegraaf van 24 mei 2024: ‘Luchtvaartsector woest over nieuwe ingreep Schiphol: ‘Harbers regeert over zijn graf’

An MP from JA21 asked the minister about a press report criticising a new Schiphol noise measure, the timing of the consultation, the possible night closure, and the impact on air cargo. The minister defended the balanced approach process, said the night closure is not in the current package, and said the aircraft ban and the LVNL feasibility assessments would be addressed in the ongoing consultation.
The cabinet has previously stated that it wants to take steps as quickly as possible to reduce the noise burden around Schiphol.
Het kabinet heeft eerder aangegeven zo snel mogelijk stappen te willen zetten om de geluidbelasting rondom Schiphol omlaag te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de berichten dat ASML en Boskalis dreigen te vertrekken uit Nederland

MPs Eerdmans asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that ASML and Boskalis threaten to leave the Netherlands, the perceived deterioration of the investment climate, lower returns compared with other countries, the Irish tax model, regulatory burden, and policy predictability. The minister answered that the Dutch business climate is solid but has weakened, pointed to the Strategic Agenda, the Monitor Ondernemingsklimaat, the minimum-tax law and the strengthened impact assessment, and said most of these matters require further study or political decisions.
The Netherlands has a solid business climate, but the art is to maintain this high level and to address bottlenecks timely and effectively.
Nederland beschikt over een solide ondernemingsklimaat, maar de kunst is dit hoge niveau vast te houden en knelpunten tijdig en doeltreffend aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Tuinman over aanbestedingsbureaucratie bij defensieaankopen

MPs Eerdmans and Tuinman asked the Defence Minister about procurement bureaucracy slowing defence acquisitions and whether Article 346 TFEU exemptions are used as promised. The state secretary acknowledged the need to reduce administrative burden, said exemptions may be invoked more often given the threat picture, declined to give frequency figures for Article 346, and promised to inform parliament before summer.
Defence makes no statements about the frequency of applying Article 346(1)(b) TFEU, because of the protection of the security interest for which that provision is applied.

Defensie doet geen uitspraken over de frequentie van het toepassen van artikel 346 lid 1 sub b VWEU, dit vanwege de bescherming van het veiligheidsbelang waar artikel 346 lid 1 sub b VWEU voor wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over mijn gesprek met Gedeputeerde Staten van Zuid-Holland over de woningbouwafspraken

An MP asked the Minister of Interior which legal instruments he could use against Zuid-Holland's housing deadlock (130% plan capacity, extra 3 ha sites, 40% social housing, and affordable purchase price), and whether he would act on Bleizo-West. The minister said he would use an instruction under the Environment and Planning Act only if needed, that the province's revised proposal largely meets his demands so no instrument is needed now, and that he sees no need for legal steps on Bleizo-West, preferring negotiated agreement.
I therefore see insufficient reason to deploy my legal instruments now.
Ik zie daarom onvoldoende aanleiding om mijn juridisch instrumentarium nu in te zetten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Wachtlijst stroomnet explodeert door energietransitie, jaren wachten op stroom geen uitzondering’ en het artikel ‘Huishoudens, scholen en kleinbedrijf van stroomn

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid congestion, waiting lists for connections, numbers affected, average waiting times, grid outages and economic damage. The minister answered that waiting lists exist mainly for large consumers (about 9,400 connection and 10,000 feed-in requests), that waiting times vary too much by region to average, that ACM set connection-term rules in April 2024, and that exact economic damage is hard to quantify, promising a study before summer.
For large consumption, grid operators do not know what function a building behind an existing or requested connection has, or will have.
Voor grootverbruik geldt dat netbeheerders niet weten welke functie een gebouw – achter een bestaande of aangevraagde aansluiting – heeft, of zal krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Eerdmans over puppy-yoga

MPs Kostić and Eerdmans asked the minister about puppy yoga practices shown by Radar, including puppies handled for hours, lack of animal behaviour oversight, and possible welfare violations. The minister agreed the practice is undesirable, reported NVWA inspections finding overtreding with intended fines, and announced preparation of a general administrative order (AMvB) to ban puppy yoga.
I will therefore prepare a general administrative order to prohibit yoga with puppies.
Ik zal dan ook een algemene maatregel van bestuur voorbereiden om yoga met puppy's te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Netbeheerder: na 2030 grotere kans op prijspiekendoor stroomtekorten'

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about TenneT's warning of possible electricity shortages and price spikes after 2030, linked to coal and gas plant phase-outs, rising demand and limited batteries and flexibility. The minister acknowledged the risks, said coal phase-out and gas plant changes stay, promised a supply-security action plan by year-end, and said the wider energy system agenda will follow after summer.
Antwoord op vragen van het het lid Eerdmans over ‘de (cyber)veiligheid van Nederlandse offshore olie- en gasplatforms’

An MP asked about threats to Dutch offshore oil and gas platforms and offshore wind parks, the security measures taken, international cooperation, and cyber risks.
