The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the threat is documented in intelligence reports, outlined sector rules, vital-infrastructure designation, NIS2 and CER implementation, and cooperation with other states, while declining to discuss individual incidents for security reasons.
For security reasons I cannot go into individual cases.
Vanwege veiligheidsredenen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Teunissen over het artikel 'Nederland vormt belangrijke spil in illegale handel bedreigde diersoorten'

MPs Eerdmans and Teunissen asked the ministers how the government responds to a SPOTS/IUCN/Bears in Mind/ELI report that the Netherlands is a hub for illegal trade in endangered species used in traditional Chinese medicine, and what enforcement steps follow. The government answered that one suspect has been arrested by the NVWA investigation service, that enforcement is ongoing, that budgets and capacity are constrained but not quantified, and that it will pursue EU and international coordination while declining to give operational details of ongoing investigations.
In the interest of the investigation, the NVWA-IOD does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
In het belang van de opsporing doet de NVWA-IOD geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Aantal tbs’ers wéér gestegen, maar geen plek in klinieken: krijgen enorme bedragen uitgekeerd.’

An MP asks how the Raad voor Strafrechtstoepassing en Jeugdbescherming sets the passant compensation for tbs patients held in prisons awaiting clinic placement, whether it is binding, whether it can be suspended, and what share of payments goes to victims as damages. The minister explains the amounts follow civil case law and the Hoge Raad/ECHR basis for the four-month limit, that suspending payments would likely fail in court, and gives a table showing 24-51% of payments were withheld for victim damages in 2021-2023.
Deviating downward from the standard amounts is expected to result in passants litigating for higher amounts.
Naar beneden afwijken van de standaardbedragen zal naar verwachting tot gevolg hebben dat passanten zullen procederen voor hogere bedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitermark over het bericht ‘Ook mensen met een paar jaar cel niet in gevangenis door personeelstekort’

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that some offenders with multi-year prison sentences are not being summoned to prison due to staff shortages, including those with sentences near four and five years, and asked for breakdowns by sentence length, offence type, and the self-surrender criteria. The Minister confirmed that twelve outstanding self-surrenders have sentences over three years (highest about 4.5 years), that 87.1% have 90 days or less remaining, explained the CJIB assessment framework and the temporary summons stop for adult male self-surrenders, and said the one-week deadline could not be met.
Due to the potential traceability to individuals, I do not provide information on individual cases.
In verband met de potentiële herleidbaarheid naar personen verstrek ik geen informatie over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat een ME'er in Arnhem zijn taak niet wilde uitvoeren vanwege zijn religie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether it is acceptable that riot police officers may selectively refuse assignments for religious reasons, and what traumatic experiences were meant in an earlier answer. The minister answered that such assignments are carried out under the authority of management, that dilemmas can be discussed with supervisors who may re-roster staff, and that no figures exist on how often this occurs, though the police describe it as exceptional.
No figures are known on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het verbeteren van het bedrijfsklimaat in de defensiesector

An MP from JA21 asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Defence about banks and pension funds reluctant to finance the defence industry and about regulation hampering defence producers. The government answered that it is consulting banks, pension funds and industry on financing bottlenecks, will report in June 2024, and is pursuing EU level-playing-field measures and a sectoral defence-industry law.
In June 2024 the House will be informed about the bottlenecks in financing defence-related companies and the measures that could strengthen this financing.
In juni 2024 zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de knelpunten voor financiering van defensie gerelateerde bedrijven en de maatregelen die deze financiering kunnen versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het gebruik van de handtekeningstempel als volwaardige ondertekening van aktes

An MP asked whether the signature stamp used by people with physical disabilities lacks a legal basis and whether identity documents with a 'not able to sign' notation are valid. The state secretary answered that stamp signatures are legally valid for contracts and deeds, that identity documents with the notation are valid, and that no new measures are planned.
No additional measures therefore need to be taken for this.
Er hoeven hiervoor dus geen aanvullende maatregelen te worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Klimaatactie treft reizigers Eindhoven Airport'

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about XR climate protests at Eindhoven Airport, including prosecutions, whether to ban the 23 March 2024 demonstration, security measures, costs, and civil damages claims. The Minister answered that the mayor is competent to ban demonstrations, that the State suffered no damage warranting civil action, and that prosecution decisions are pending while security details cannot be disclosed.
No statements can be made about the nature of the measures.
Over de aard van de maatregelen kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over jihadistische illegalen in Nederland en de reactie van het kabinet op eerdere vragen hierover

An MP from JA21 asked the government about jihadist illegal residents in the Netherlands, including whether they are being actively tracked, how many failed asylum seekers with jihadist sympathies left with unknown destination, and why a promised letter and national monitoring pilot were delayed. The Justice Minister answered that the letter was sent on 11 March 2024, that data on these groups cannot be automatically extracted, that about 15 denaturalised terrorism convicts are at liberty with some supervision measures, and that a national return coordination pilot starts within weeks.
The number of rejected asylum seekers with jihadist sympathies who pose a threat to national security cannot be automatically derived from the DT&V systems.
Het aantal uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers met jihadistische sympathieën dat een dreiging vormt voor de nationale veiligheid kan niet automatisch aan de systemen van DT&V te worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de campagne íkwilveiligvliegen.nl

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the campaign 'Ikwilveiligvliegen.nl' and the aviation industry's plans for reduced crew operations with one pilot instead of two. The minister answered that the concept is not yet proven safe, that EASA research is pending, that the government will follow developments closely and only accept new technology once shown to be safe, but made no concrete commitments such as a joint statement with other member states.
The Netherlands' starting point is that with the introduction of new concepts at least a safety level equal to that of current flight operations must be guaranteed.
Nederland heeft als uitgangspunt, dat met de introductie van nieuwe concepten er minimaal een veiligheidsniveau wordt gewaarborgd dat gelijk is aan het niveau van de huidige vliegoperatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Aantal tbs’ers wéér gestegen, maar geen plek in klinieken: krijgen enorme bedragen uitgekeerd.'

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that the number of tbs patients rose while clinic places stayed short, and that the state pays compensation to those held in prisons while waiting. Minister Weerwind answers in detail with waiting-time and payout figures, acknowledges staff shortages and capacity strain, and says he has asked WODC to study the effects of prison detention on tbs treatment, but gives no firm capacity commitments.
I have therefore asked the Research and Documentation Centre (WODC) to carry out research into this.
Ik heb daarom het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Datacentrum (WODC) gevraagd hier een onderzoek naar uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de eindstemming onder EU-lidstaten over de Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence-richtlijn

An MP from JA21 asked the minister whether Germany's expected abstention on the CSDDD vote, and Dutch voting intentions, would block the directive and whether the Netherlands would abstain or vote against. The minister answered that the vote was a Coreper decision to forward the text to Parliament rather than a final vote, that the Netherlands intends to support forwarding if its priorities are met, and that the directive harmonises EU rules while the government will assess business burdens.
Before formal decision-making, your House will be informed of the outcome of the trilogue negotiations.
Voorafgaand aan formele besluitvorming wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de uitkomst van de triloog onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Baasje van ‘barbaarse’ bijthond lijkt van aardbodem verdwenen’

An MP asked the ministers whether the owner of a dog that killed a small dog, and who was ordered by a civil court to pay compensation but cannot be found, will be tracked down, and about dog-bite registration, a national reporting point and mandatory dog-owner courses. The minister answered that the case is civil rather than criminal, that enforcement runs through a bailiff, that a national reporting point is planned, and that the detailed bite-prevention measures will be sent to parliament after the summer.
The Judiciary does not keep figures on cases in which owners of a biting dog fail to comply with a court judgment.
Antwoord 4 De Rechtspraak houdt geen cijfers bij over zaken waarbij eigenaren van een bijthond het vonnis van de rechter niet nakomt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Agema over de reactie op de kamerbreed aangenomen motie Eerdmans en Agema over het zo snel mogelijk onderbrengen van psychiatrische patiënten zonder strafblad in een instelling

MPs Eerdmans and Agema asked the health minister how the government responded to a motion to move psychiatric patients without a criminal record out of TBS clinics, and why parliament was not informed earlier. The minister answered that roughly seven people are in a level-4 secure setting without a criminal title, that such placement requires a court-authorised compulsory care order under the Wvggz or Wzd, and that patients keep their legal protections.
Your House is in principle not informed about such individual cases in view of the privacy of all those involved and given the large number of individual cases in which the ministry is involved.
Uw Kamer wordt in principe niet over dergelijke casuïstiek geïnformeerd in verband met de privacy van alle betrokkenen en gelet op het grote aantal individuele gevallen waarbij VWS betrokken is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de straf- en verblijfsrechtelijke consequenties van misdrijven door asielzoekers

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked how many crimes by asylum seekers in COA locations led to forced return, the type of offences, the revocation of asylum permits on public-order grounds, and the legal limits on such revocation, plus a specific case of repeated sexual assault. The State Secretary answered that departures are not registered by offence, gave return figures (about 1,130 VRIS departures from DT&V's caseload in 2023), said a bill on public-order grounds concerns regular residence permits rather than asylum permits, and declined to comment on individual cases while promising further information on public-order policy.
The data on departures cannot be automatically linked in the system to the number of offences of which foreigners are suspected.
De gegevens over vertrek kunnen in het systeem niet automatisch worden gekoppeld aan het aantal misdrijven waarvan vreemdelingen worden verdacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans  over het bericht ‘Productiestop Nyrstar wakkert zorgen elektriciteitintensieve industrie aan’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about reports that Nyrstar's production halt and rising grid tariffs threaten energy-intensive industry, and whether the government will address the uneven playing field, sector outlook, bankruptcies and support. The minister acknowledged the concerns, attributed the tariff increases to the abolition of the volume correction scheme and rising TenneT costs, and said a deeper study of electricity costs and EU level-playing-field measures are underway, without committing to new concrete support.
In addition, I am having an in-depth study carried out into the differences in effective electricity costs for industrial users in the Netherlands, Germany, France and Belgium.
Daarnaast laat ik een verdiepend onderzoek uitvoeren naar de verschillen in effectieve elektriciteitskosten voor industriële gebruikers in Nederland, Duitsland, Frankrijk en België.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat een ME’er in Arnhem zijn taak niet wilde uitvoeren vanwege zijn religie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether it is unacceptable that a riot police officer refused a duty at Arnhem for religious reasons, and what will be done to ensure officers serve the law over personal beliefs. The minister answered that officers must act neutrally under the chain of command, that dilemmas can be discussed with supervisors and reassignment considered, and that the Beroepscode and training already address this.
Employees carry out their tasks subordinate to the competent authority.
Medewerkers voeren hun taak uit ondergeschikt aan het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitzending ‘Vape-industrie heeft lak aan overheid’ van De Hofbar op 23 januari jl.

An MP asks the government about flavoured vapes still being sold despite the flavour ban since 1 January 2024, weak NVWA enforcement, banned vape accessories, and a licensing scheme for tobacco outlets. The state secretary rejects claims of no enforcement, describes NVWA checks at producers and retailers, announces stronger enforcement powers and higher fines, and says the licensing question is addressed by the existing plan to reduce outlets by 2032.
I intend to give the NVWA additional enforcement powers so it can enforce more efficiently.
Ik ben van plan de NVWA extra handhavingsbevoegdheden te geven om zo efficiënter te kunnen handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de demonstratie door Extinction Rebellion op de Ring A10 bij Amsterdam

An MP from JA21 asked the Justice Minister whether the police would facilitate an Extinction Rebellion blockade of the A10 ring road in Amsterdam, which the mayor had banned, and whether police would prevent it. The minister answered that the blockade violated the mayor's restriction and counted as an offence, but declined to commit to police action or extra capacity, saying the mayor and public prosecutor are responsible for police operations.
I cannot and will not make these commitments because the mayor and the public prosecutor are responsible for police operations.
Deze toezeggingen kan en zal ik niet doen omdat de burgemeester en de officier van justitie verantwoordelijk zijn voor het politieoptreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over ‘Kritiek rechters op uitstel celstraffen’

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about judges' criticism that temporarily not summoning male adult self-reporters to prison undermines judicial authority, and about related measures such as electronic monitoring, reduced prison regimes, and easing criteria for the Limited Security Ward. The minister replied that the measure is a temporary emergency response to staff shortages, that sentences will in principle still be executed, and that further measures are being explored with partners, with commitments to inform parliament.
A person sentenced by a judge to a prison term will in principle always actually serve detention.
Een persoon die door de rechter is veroordeeld tot een gevangenisstraf zal in beginsel altijd daadwerkelijk detentie ondergaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen over de voornemens van het kabinet tot asielopvang in Albergen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security to clarify how Tubbergen municipality was informed about the government's plan to use spatial planning powers for the Albergen asylum shelter, the impact on residents and trust, the end date and future of the site, the financial arrangement, and the possibility of a binding third-party clause. The State Secretary answered that contacts with the municipality took place from April 2022, that the coercive instrument was ultimately not used after agreement was reached on 150 residents, that the agreement ends on 1 November 2032 with later decisions left to the then-current bodies, and that a third-party clause was not considered desirable.
It has been agreed with the Tubbergen board that the administrative agreement ends after 10 years.
Met het college van Tubbergen is afgesproken dat de bestuursovereenkomst na 10 jaar eindigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de rechtspositie van slachtoffers van (relationeel) geweld

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Health about victims of intimate terror, including forced contact with abusers in custody and visitation cases, the priority given to offenders' family life over victims' safety, femicide urgency, near-fatal incidents, protection measures, sentencing, specialised centres, and whether to investigate victims' legal position. The ministers answered that the family judge weighs safety risks case by case, that the advisory body RSJ will report in 2024, that a femicide action plan will follow in spring 2024, and that the current criminal law and victims' rights are adequate, so no sentencing increase or new investigation is planned.
In an individual case it will be examined whether the right to safety can be sufficiently guaranteed while at the same time giving the right to contact with both parents the best possible effect.

In een individuele casus zal worden bekeken of het recht op veiligheid voldoende kan worden gewaarborgd terwijl tegelijkertijd zo goed mogelijk invulling wordt gegeven aan het recht op contact met beide ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de ANBI-status van Extinction Rebellion

An MP from JA21 asked whether Extinction Rebellion's ANBI tax status, and the disclosure of tax benefits, should be revoked after unlawful protest actions and whether the group should be banned under the Civil Code. The Secretary of State answered that tax confidentiality prevents disclosure about individual organisations, that ANBI status is tested neutrally and can be revoked only through the integrity test or a court ban, and that the Public Prosecution Service decides on any court ban.
The Tax Administration is bound by the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act and therefore cannot provide further information about individual organisations.

De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) en kan daarom geen nadere informatie verstrekken over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Wilders over de aanwezigheid van een hoge Talibanfunctionaris op het WHO-congres in Den Haag

MPs Eerdmans and Wilders asked how a senior Taliban health official could attend a WHO conference hosted by the Netherlands and receive a Schengen visa, and how the procedure will be tightened. The minister explains the visa was assessed under the EU Visa Code, the person was not on any sanctions list, the government acknowledges it is undesirable and will review visa and invitation procedures, and provides figures on sanctioned Taliban members.
Although the person concerned is not on any of these sanctions lists, the cabinet does draw lessons from these events
Hoewel betrokkene niet op een van deze sanctielijsten staat, trekt het kabinet wel lering uit deze gebeurtenissen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de cijfers van het aantal agressie-en geweldsincidenten in de jeugdgevangenissen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security for figures on aggression and violence incidents in Dutch youth detention institutions from 2020 to August 2023, broken down by type, plus an analysis of the figures and whether earlier measures worked. The Minister provided tables showing incident counts per institution, noted that 2023 figures are preliminary and the years are not directly comparable, and stated that staffing measures offer prospects though the staffing problem persists and monitoring will continue.
DJI does everything it can to prevent violent incidents.
DJI doet er alles aan om geweldsincidenten te voorkomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de voornemens van het kabinet tot asielopvang in Albergen

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why the cabinet used spatial planning powers in August 2022 to force asylum reception in Albergen, why the hotel is still empty nine months later, and whether the decision was inappropriate and harmed local trust. The State Secretary answered that the powers were ultimately not used because agreement was reached with Tubbergen, that the cabinet will not withdraw the plan, and that agreed limits (150 places, end date 2032, no additional construction) will be written into a future administrative agreement.
To prevent use of the spatial planning instruments in the future, I submitted to the House of Representatives the bill 'Wet gemeentelijke taak mogelijk maken asielopvangvoorzieningen'.

Om in de toekomst inzet van het Ruimtelijk Ordening instrumentarium te voorkomen heb ik bij de Tweede Kamer het wetsvoorstel «Wet gemeentelijke taak mogelijk maken asielopvangvoorzieningen» ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Nieuwe studie bom onder piekbelastersbeleid: stikstof slaat amper neer rond stallen'

An MP asked the Minister of Nature and Nitrogen about a study suggesting nitrogen from individual barns barely deposits nearby, questioning the peak-emitter buyout policy, the AERIUS model, NDAs, the NPLG, PAS-notifiers and critical deposition values. The minister replied that the study confirms existing knowledge, that the methodology and policy need no revision, and that a working group is reviewing a possible alternative to the critical deposition value expected by year end.
As indicated in the earlier letter, the study is mainly a confirmation of existing knowledge.
Zoals aangegeven in de eerdere brief is het onderzoek vooral een bevestiging van bestaande kennis.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Wat weegt zwaarder: demonstratierecht of leerplicht? ‘Niet de bedoeling iedere vrijdag vrij te geven’ en het artikel ‘Wegblijven van school om deel te nemen aan k

An MP asks the Education Minister whether pupils may skip school to attend climate demonstrations, whether a school's active promotion of a demonstration undermines compulsory schooling, and how schools' neutrality and missed tests are handled. The minister answers that truancy is never allowed for any reason, attendance may be part of the curriculum subject to works council approval, schools' neutrality is not necessarily compromised, and the Inspectorate can intervene if a school cannot justify its decisions.
Truancy, for whatever reason, is not permitted.
Spijbelen, om wat voor reden dan ook, is niet geoorloofd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de aanhoudende onveiligheid in Budel en Maarheeze

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about persistent nuisance and crime by asylum seekers in Budel and Maarheeze, including shops hiring volunteers and removing benches, and whether the government accepts that residents must protect their own safety. The Staatssecretaris answered that a team of four mobile inspectors, faster processing of low-chance asylum applications and municipal camera funding are being deployed, that police rather than volunteers should enforce order, and that the COA will publish 2023 incident figures only in 2024, while rejecting the claim that policy has failed.
The COA publishes an annual incident overview at location level.
Het COA publiceert jaarlijks een incidentenoverzicht op locatieniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Draagvlak minder door incidenten opvang’

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a series of incidents at a reception centre for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in Papendrecht, including incident counts, whether the situation was untenable, and how the municipal council was informed. The State Secretary acknowledged the incidents, said the COA took measures and that calm had returned, gave no current incident figures (pointing to the annual 2022 overview), and declined to view the situation as untenable.
The COA publishes an annual incident overview at location level.
Het COA publiceert jaarlijks een incidentenoverzicht op locatieniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Yesilgöz: verdedigen dwangwet door Van der Burg ’niet ongeloofwaardig’

An MP from JA21 asked the Prime Minister whether ministers who defend the dispersal law in cabinet can criticise it as lijsttrekker during the election campaign, and whether this is constitutionally sound. The Prime Minister confirmed full cabinet support, said campaigning ministers are customary and raise no constitutional objection, and declined to judge what voters find understandable.
It is customary for sitting office holders to contribute to the election campaign of their political party. There are no constitutional objections to this.
Het is gebruikelijk dat zittende bewindspersonen een bijdrage leveren aan de verkiezingscampagne van hun politieke partij. Hier zijn geen staatsrechtelijke bezwaren tegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitspraken van de minister van Financiën over de voordracht van de huidige minister van Buitenlandse Zaken als Eurocommissaris

An MP from JA21 asked the Prime Minister whether Finance Minister Kaag's media remarks, suggesting she would have preferred a D66 candidate over the cabinet's nominee Hoekstra as EU Commissioner, breached cabinet unity and whether she should be dismissed. The Prime Minister answered that Kaag did not distance herself from the cabinet's nomination, so cabinet unity was not at issue.
Minister Kaag did not distance herself from the cabinet's nomination in her statements.
Minister Kaag heeft in haar uitspraken geen afstand genomen van de voordracht van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Baarle, Eerdmans en Omtzigt over de voordracht van Wopke Hoekstra als Eurocommissaris

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister how Wopke Hoekstra was nominated as Dutch European Commissioner, including the procedure, any candidate profile, whether parliament was informed, and whether his departure leaves the Foreign Ministry without political direction. The government replied that the nomination followed the standard Article 246 TFEU procedure after consultation within cabinet and with the Commission President, that no candidate profile was drawn up, that parliament was not informed beyond the standard procedure, and that ministerial responsibility for the Foreign Ministry is secured.
No. The procedure was followed in line with standing policy on earlier appointments, see the answers to questions 1 and 2.
Nee. De procedure is conform staand beleid van eerdere benoemingen gevolgd, zie de antwoorden op vraag 1 en 2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het artikel 'Faillissementsgolf mkb door corona schulden, Nederland wereldwijd koploper'

Two MPs from JA21 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the rise in bankruptcies among SMEs is caused by unpaid tax and corona debts, and about support, repayment options and tax measures. The minister answered that bankruptcies are currently below pre-pandemic levels and rising towards them, that repayment arrangements (NOW, tax deferral) are available, and that the government will report on debt solutions after the summer recess.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over Bevindingen onderzoek DUO naar fraude met studiefinanciering

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked whether DUO's student-finance fraud findings, which reportedly fall disproportionately on students with a migration background, reflect indirect discrimination and whether the risk-indicator algorithm will be adjusted. The Minister says most DUO decisions survive appeal, will await an external independent investigation of DUO's working method before drawing conclusions, and will not set aside striking outcome patterns in advance.
I am having DUO's working method investigated externally and independently.
Ik laat de werkwijze van DUO extern en onafhankelijk onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Eppink over ‘de Nedcar-fabriek in Born helpen omschakelen naar een fabriek voor militaire voertuigen’

MPs Eerdmans and Eppink asked whether the government would help convert the VDL Nedcar plant in Born to military vehicle production after BMW's Mini production ends in 2024, and about Chinese state-owned involvement in Dutch military vehicles. The minister said the plant is unsuited to military series production, that the government will facilitate contacts and support any viable initiative, and referred to defence procurement screening and a forthcoming investment-screening law.

The cabinet considers employment at VDL Nedcar of great importance for the regional labour market and the liveability of the area, and has therefore pledged its cooperation in finding solutions to preserve it.

Het kabinet acht de werkgelegenheid bij VDL Nedcar van groot belang voor de regionale arbeidsmarkt en de leefbaarheid van het gebied en heeft dan ook haar medewerking toegezegd om oplossingen te vinden voor het behoud ervan.
Uitstel beantwoording vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Speciaal politiekorps voor haven Antwerpen’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Justice and Security ten questions about a special police unit for the port of Antwerp, drug mules, corruption in Rotterdam port and cooperation between Dutch and Belgian port police. The government's response is only a notice that the answers will be delayed because not all necessary information has been received yet, and it promises answers as soon as possible.
because not all necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Pouw-Verweij over het aanpassen van boeken

JA21 MPs Eerdmans and Pouw-Verweij asked whether the government objects to publishers altering classic books such as those by Roald Dahl, Agatha Christie and Ian Fleming after sensitivity readers flagged wording, and about copyright protections for deceased authors. The government replied that word changes are a matter for publishers, writers and translators, that copyright and moral rights (including the author's right to object to harmful changes) are explained, and that designating national heritage is not a government task.
I do not see it as a government task to prescribe which books belong to our national heritage.
Ik zie het niet als een taak van de overheid voor te schrijven welke boeken tot ons nationale erfgoed behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Aboutaleb stopt met dwangsom mesbezit’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a court ruling that blocked Rotterdam's use of an administrative order under penalty (last onder dwangsom) against knife possession, and whether the government would create a legal basis for mayors to impose such orders and what measures it would take against youth knife carrying. The minister answered that the instrument can be useful but depends on local circumstances and an APV provision, which is a municipal matter, and summarised the Actieplan Wapens en Jongeren and follow-up evaluation steps.
However, it depends on the nature and extent of the local problem whether a provision in the municipal general local regulation (APV) supplementing the Weapons and Ammunition Act is needed.
Het is echter afhankelijk van de aard en omvang van de lokale problematiek of een bepaling in de Algemene plaatselijke verordening (APV) als aanvulling op de Wet wapens en munitie (WWM) nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het nieuwe Zweedse asiel- en terugkeerbeleid

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about Sweden's new asylum and return policy, including expanded immigration detention capacity and a claimed 50% rise in removals, and whether the Netherlands should follow suit. The State Secretary said he could not confirm the 50% figure, that Sweden's plans are still being worked out, that the Netherlands is monitoring them, and promised a list of Dutch EU-asylum transpositions before the summer recess.
This overview is still being worked on. I expect to be able to send it to your House before the summer recess.
Aan dit overzicht wordt thans nog gewerkt. Ik verwacht dit zeker nog voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer te kunnen doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de aanpak van pinpasfraude

MP Eerdmans asked the government about losses from pin card fraud, prosecution rates, and whether it would explore technical fixes such as ATMs refusing cash at low recognisability. The minister (Finance, on behalf of Justice) reported losses of 2.7 million euro in 2022, gave prosecution counts for payment fraud generally, and said pin card fraud is being addressed in the MOB working group and an integrated online fraud plan rather than through ATM changes.

The figures on the investigation of pin card fraud are part of the overall figures on fraud cases involving payment products and are published biennially by the Public Prosecution Service in the Fraud Monitor.

De cijfers over de opsporing van pinpasfraude zijn onderdeel van de totale cijfers met betrekking tot fraudezaken met betaalproducten en worden door het Openbaar Ministerie tweejaarlijks in de Fraudemonitor gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over dreigende onteigening van panden als gevolg van de asieldwangwet

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the asylum reception obligation bill opens the door to compulsory expropriation of buildings by municipalities, and whether it should be withdrawn given claimed lack of support and legal problems. The State Secretary said the bill contains no expropriation provisions, so expropriation is not an option under it, and maintained that the government intends to submit the bill to the House soon.
The bill contains no provisions that make expropriation possible.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat geen bepalingen die onteigening mogelijk maken.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Achterlijke situaties bij glastuinders, eerste bedrijven stoppen’

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that high energy prices are forcing greenhouse horticulture firms to close or cut production, and about the consequences for vegetable supply, prices, competitiveness, sustainability and the energy transition. The minister answers that the impact is real but exact figures are unknown, expects some volume declines with imports partly filling gaps, notes limited quantification, and points to extra energy-saving subsidy funding and a planned guarantee scheme for working capital.
Because of the diverse business situations and dependencies within the rest of the chain, it is difficult to make generic statements.
Het is vanwege de uiteenlopende bedrijfssituaties en afhankelijkheden met de rest van de keten moeilijk om generieke uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het inzetten van Rijksvastgoed en provinciaal vastgoed voor asielopvang

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about using national and provincial real estate for asylum reception, including plans in Zwaagdijk-West (Medemblik) and whether the municipality was informed. The government said the spatial planning instrument is not currently being deployed, that a feasibility study is underway with the municipality cooperating, and that the Provincial Executive's compliance with Provinciewet article 167 is for the provincial states to judge.
We would prefer to leave the assessment of that to them.
Oordeelsvorming daarover laten wij graag aan hen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de potentieel desastreuze gevolgen van de gascrisis voor de industrie

An MP from JA21 asked ministers about the risk that the gas crisis could cause uncontrolled industrial shutdowns, including whether gas shortages can be ruled out at a 90 percent storage fill level and what contingency measures apply. The minister answered that the GTS conditions for avoiding shortages are currently met, that the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas is being operationalised, and that a study of the impact of high energy prices on industry will be shared before year-end, though several questions were answered only in part or deferred.
By the end of the year I will come with a new update on the Gas Protection and Recovery Plan.
Voor het einde van het jaar kom ik met een nieuwe update rond het Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de aantallen asielzoekers die gemeenten moeten opvangen als gevolg van de dwangwet

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked whether municipalities had already been told, possibly via the commissaris van de Koning, how many asylum seekers they would have to house under the proposed dwangwet, and asked for per-municipality figures. The State Secretary denied that any such figures had been communicated, said talks on the bill's content were still ongoing, and therefore declined to share numbers.
No, this is not correct. At the time of writing this answer, discussions are still taking place on the content of the bill.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Op het moment van schrijven van deze beantwoording vinden er nog gesprekken plaats over de inhoud van het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Pouw-Verweij over de bedreiging van het wokisme

JA21 MPs asked the education minister whether alarming signs of woke-culture intimidation at universities, such as students at Erasmus University fearing backlash, were being downplayed, and whether the minister would act on academic freedom. The minister found no threat to academic freedom in the cited cases, said debate should be respectful, and promised to report on talks with universities on self-censorship by year end.
I will inform your House of the outcomes before the end of this calendar year.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor het einde van dit kalenderjaar op de hoogte stellen van de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het bericht dat honderden verdwijnstudenten uit het buitenland misbruik maken van studentenvisa

Opposition MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked whether international students using study visas who then disappear from view, and whether a quota and higher fees would help. The minister answered that such misuse is undesirable, that the IND is investigating Bangladeshi student cases, that a quota has no legal basis, and that more monitoring and sector measures will follow.
This gave the IND cause to examine this further.
Dit was voor de IND aanleiding om dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over criminele asielzoekers uit veilige landen

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the State Secretary and Minister of Justice and Security about criminal asylum seekers from safe countries causing nuisance and crime in Amsterdam, and about measures such as detention, returns, and cooperation with countries of origin. The government answered at length, giving incident statistics, stating that police do not register specifically on this group, describing new nuisance-coordination and return measures, and saying detention during the asylum procedure is being explored more broadly while detention is limited by legal conditions.
This cannot be provided. The police do not register specifically on safe-country nationals.
Deze is niet te geven. De politie registreert niet specifiek op veiligelanders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat een slachtoffer erin is geslaagd een hoger beroep af te dwingen na een strafproces

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a victim who forced an appeal after a criminal trial because his victim rights were not guaranteed, and whether the public prosecution service (OM) should be required to appeal when victim rights are clearly breached. The minister answered that the OM has wide policy discretion, that the victim's kort geding succeeded only temporarily and the OM later withdrew the appeal with reasons, that the OM must weigh whether an appeal could lead to a different outcome, and that no instruction or obligation to appeal is planned.
The OM is granted a large degree of policy discretion given its tasks and position in the Dutch legal system.
Het OM komt een grote mate van beleidsvrijheid toe gelet op de taken en de plaats van het OM in het Nederlands rechtsbestel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de aankopen en transacties in het kader van het nieuwe aanmeldcentrum in Bant

An MP asked the State Secretary for a detailed reconstruction of how the COA acquired a plot in Bant for a new reception centre, including total costs, who paid each component, and how values were set. The government described the April-July 2022 sequence of contacts via the Commissaris van de Koning, declined to disclose the purchase price citing private-law confidentiality, and said values were set by an official appraisal.
In general I do not make substantive statements about the content of a private-law agreement with a private owner.
Ik doe in het algemeen geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over de inhoud van een privaatrechtelijke overeenkomst met een particuliere eigenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het optreden van een CdK als Rijksheer ten behoeve van asielopvang

An MP asked whether the Flevoland commissaris van de Koning acted as a Rijksheer (state officer) rather than as a Rijksorgaan when facilitating asylum reception, and what legal basis applied. The Minister answers that the commissaris acted as Rijksorgaan under article 182 Provinciewet and Ambtsinstructie, without decision-making power, and that terminology has been used loosely but has no consequences for legal validity.
We will bring this to the attention of all those involved, to prevent future confusion.
Wij zullen dit bij alle betrokkenen onder de aandacht brengen, om toekomstige verwarring te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de toestroom van asielzoekers naar Nederland via EU-lidstaten

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about asylum seekers arriving via other EU member states, including modes of arrival, Dublin responsibility, returns, border monitoring, and whether a border control or asylum stop should be introduced. The government answered that most arrivals are secondary migration with unknown entry routes, that Dublin transfers are constrained, that most cases are still pending, and that an asylum stop has no legal basis under Article 111 of the Aliens Act, with a legal exploration promised.
The precise number of asylum seekers arriving by land is therefore not known.
Het precieze aantal asielzoekers dat via land aankomt, is dan ook niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het aantal woningtoewijzingen aan statushouders

The MP Eerdmans asked the minister for the share of social housing allocations going to refugee status holders in the first half of 2022, by month, by municipality, and during the six-week accelerated outflow measure. The minister gave estimated figures of about 7.2% for the first half of 2022 (around 5,400 homes, based on assumed vacancy numbers), declined to provide municipal-level data, and said he lacked figures for the accelerated outflow measure.
I do not have the exact number of homes allocated to refugee status holders in the first six months of 2022.
Ik beschik niet over het exacte aantal woningen dat in de eerste zes maanden van 2022 is toegewezen aan statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het hacken van windturbines

An MP asked the minister about cyberattacks on wind turbines, including five turbines along the Oude Maas standing still for months, and how many attacks occurred and how they were handled. The minister answered that the Nordex attack affected office IT rather than turbine control hardware, that no overview of cyberattacks on wind energy exists, and described existing reporting and oversight rules for essential service providers, plus national security conditions for offshore grid contractors.
There is no overall overview of (attempted) cyberattacks on specific sectors such as wind energy.
Er bestaat geen algeheel overzicht van (pogingen tot) cyberaanvallen op specifieke sectoren zoals windenergie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het risico op een overval op tabaksspeciaalzaken

An MP asks the government about a robbery at a tobacco shop, whether NVWA rules force shopkeepers to cover windows, and whether this endangers small retailers given the high robbery risk. The State Secretary answers that NVWA does not require covering windows, only that tobacco products not be visible from outside, that the choice of measures is up to the shop, and that the Centre for Crime Prevention will advise shops on compliance with visibility.
The NVWA does not require shopkeepers to fully cover their windows and front door.
De NVWA eist niet van winkeliers dat zij hun ramen en voordeur volledig afplakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Eerdmans over het bericht 'Inspectie: Stop met aantrekken arbeidsmigranten'

MPs Stoffer and Eerdmans asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Labour Inspectorate's warning that labour migration causes societal costs such as housing shortages and inequality, and about whether the government will curb population growth. The minister acknowledges downsides, stresses EU free movement, treats non-EU labour migration as a last resort, and says the implementation of the Roemer committee recommendations and the population study are ongoing.
The cabinet sees labour migration from outside the EU as the last resort in tackling labour market shortages.
Het kabinet ziet arbeidsmigratie van buiten de EU als sluitstuk van de aanpak van krapte op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Azarkan, Dassen, Van der Plas en Eerdmans over de situatie op Schiphol

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Schiphol's management had lost control of operations, whether shareholders could face claims and dividend losses, and whether shareholders should call an extraordinary meeting, a letter of objection, or an Enterprise Chamber inquiry. The minister attributed the problems to staff shortages and rising demand, pointed to Schiphol's summer action plan and a passenger cap, said operational responsibility lies with the board, and declined to share the confidential AGM documents while rejecting an extraordinary meeting or formal written objection for now.
The minutes of the General Meeting of Shareholders (including the relevant documents) are classified as commercially confidential and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
Het verslag van de Algemene Vergadering van Aandeelhouders (inclusief de relevante stukken) wordt aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Eerdmans over het verplicht aanschaffen van (hybride) warmtepompen door huishoudens

MPs Van der Plas and Eerdmans asked the Minister whether the planned norm requiring heat pumps instead of single CV boilers after 2026 amounts to coercion of homeowners, and questioned subsidies, loans, costs, supply, grid capacity and tenant rent increases. The government answered that the norm applies only where economically, technically and functionally feasible, that heat pump investments generally pay back within their lifetime, and that the matter will be further studied, with commitments to inform the House and address tenant and supply concerns.
Further research will be carried out in the coming period to determine the exact scale and design of the norm and the exceptions described above.
Er zal in de komende periode nader onderzoek worden gedaan om de exacte maatvoering en vormgeving van de norm en de uitzonderingen die hierboven beschreven zijn te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eppink en Eerdmans over het gunnen van een groot offshore windproject aan Chinese staatsbedrijven

JA21 MPs Eppink and Eerdmans asked why TenneT awarded the BorWin6 offshore wind grid connection to a consortium including Chinese state-owned firms and what safeguards exist against Chinese control of critical energy infrastructure. The ministers answered that TenneT retains ownership and control of the grid, that the project is German and not directly linked to Dutch critical infrastructure, that the contract is binding under EU procurement rules, and that the government is working on the Energiewet to give TenneT more tools to exclude suppliers in future tenders.
Organising tenders and then awarding contracts to market parties is the responsibility of TenneT's executive board.
Het organiseren van aanbestedingen en vervolgens de gunning van contracten aan marktpartijen is de verantwoordelijkheid van de raad van bestuur van TenneT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over dwang richting gemeenten om asielzoekers op te vangen

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the government whether there is an asylum crisis, why it previously denied one, and what legal basis exists to force municipalities to provide asylum reception, including the role of safety-region chairs and the Rotterdam letter. The state secretary answered that a crisis exists only for Ukrainian displaced persons, that no binding legal instrument currently compels municipalities on asylum reception, and that the government will explore one and avoid the term 'aanwijzing' in future.
A study is currently underway into the possibilities of arriving at a binding legal instrument to realise asylum reception.
Momenteel vindt een verkenning plaats naar de mogelijkheden om tot een dwingend juridisch instrumentarium te komen om asielopvang te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de start en het effect van handhaving van de Wet DBA

An MP from JA21 asked ministers about signals that clients were already suspending or cancelling contracts with self-employed workers ahead of Wet DBA enforcement, and about the need for clearer criteria and a separate legal status for freelancers. The minister acknowledged the signals, said enforcement continues within existing frameworks and a labour market package including the position of freelancers is being prepared, and promised a letter before summer and engagement with freelancer representatives.
I will send your House a letter of main lines before the summer on the elaboration of the labour market package.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer een hoofdlijnenbrief sturen over de uitwerking van het arbeidsmarktpakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Westerveld, Van Esch, Agema, Sylvana Simons, Koekkoek, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Eerdmans en Den Haan over de gewiste opnames van de OMT-vergaderingen

MPs asked whether recordings of OMT (Outbreak Management Team) meetings fall under the Archiefwet, whether the 14 April 2020 recording was destroyed and by whom, and about COVID-19 hotspot archiving lists. The minister answered that audio recordings are used only to draft minutes, that the minutes are archived while recordings are deleted as standard practice, and that some answers (selection lists, hotspot lists) would follow later.
An audio recording of an OMT meeting is deleted by the secretariat after the minutes are finalised. There is no registration of this.
Een geluidsopname van een OMT-vergadering wordt door het secretariaat verwijderd na het definitief vaststellen van het verslag. Hier is geen registratie van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de criminaliteit en geweldsdelicten door asielzoekers in Budel

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about crime by asylum seekers at the Budel reception centre, including whether convicted residents faced residence-permit withdrawal and transfer under the VRIS protocol, and about asylum rates for Algerians and the closure of the Cranendonck centre. The State Secretary largely referred to forthcoming WODC reports, said the data are not routinely kept and would require manual file review, declined to change the detention rules, and committed to a security package and continued talks with the municipality.
To answer these questions, the files at the various chain partners would have to be reviewed manually and multiple file comparisons made.
Om antwoord te kunnen geven op deze vragen zullen derhalve handmatig de dossiers bij de verschillende ketenpartners moeten worden doorgenomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de geweldsgolf rond het azc in Budel

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the wave of violence around the Budel asylum centre, including the mayor's emergency ordinance, sanctions imposed, the low number of residence permits refused or revoked on public-order grounds, nationality of offenders, and the Algeria safe-country decision. The State Secretary acknowledged the seriousness, reported court and COA sanctions, explained legal limits on revoking protection and ongoing work on public-order options, and agreed joint short- and medium-term safety measures with the municipality and COA while declining to terminate the COA contract.
I am investigating with these parties which options could strengthen the nuisance approach, and will inform the House of the outcomes.
Ik onderzoek samen met deze partijen welke handelingsperspectieven de overlastaanpak meer kracht bij zouden kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de aanbevelingen uit het rapport 'Gender Election Observation Mission The Netherlands 2021' van Gender Concerns International

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would act on recommendations from a Gender Concerns International election observation report, including gender quotas for candidate lists and media monitoring. The Minister said the report was forwarded to relevant departments, that responsibility for most proposals lies with those departments or with political parties, and declined to endorse mandatory gender parity or other systemic changes.
Forwarding such information, where it is relevant to a policy area under another department, is among the responsibilities I have as Minister of the Interior for the electoral process.

Het doorgeleiden daarvan, mits deze informatie relevant is voor een beleidsterrein dat onder een ander departement valt, behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheden die ik als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties heb voor het verkiezingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het bericht 'Verhuren koophuis frustreert starters'

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked about the rise of keep-to-let and buy-to-let housing, its effects on starters, and whether mortgage conditions are being breached. The minister said keep-to-let is stable at about 4% of transactions, outlined measures such as the transfer tax differentiation and a box 3 reform, and declined further research on unreported rental, citing lender estimates below 10%.
I therefore see no reason to commission additional research.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor het laten uitvoeren van aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over reddingsmiddelen bij het te water raken van auto’s

An MP asks ministers about drowning deaths when cars enter water, the adequacy of safety hammers, and the REGS automatic window-breaking system tested on police cars in 2012. The minister acknowledges the deaths and rising concern, notes the pilot was stopped due to spontaneous activations, and declines to pursue further research or implementation.
As indicated in answer 6, the experiences were not such that we would want to proceed to implementation.
Zoals aangegeven bij vraag 6 waren de ervaringen niet zodanig dat we over zouden willen gaan op implementatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat de Franse rechter het windturbinesyndroom erkent

An MP asked whether a French court's recognition of 'wind turbine syndrome' should change Dutch policy, and whether RIVM findings were influenced by the wind lobby. The minister answered that medical science, not courts, decides on recognising a syndrome, that RIVM acted independently, and that the government will set new national wind turbine norms via a planMER and a health research scoping study.
In their research, RIVM is independent and disinterested and works according to standard international publication protocols.
In hun onderzoek is het RIVM onafhankelijk en belangeloos en werkt het volgens standaard internationale protocollen voor publicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het ruimte geven aan jaarmarkten en braderieën

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the COVID-19 ban on annual markets and street fairs, their risk compared with weekly markets, and whether an exemption for stallholders could be considered. The minister acknowledged the hardship, pointed to aid packages and falling bankruptcies, and refused a special exemption, arguing that fairs bring extra travel and contacts unlike necessity-focused weekly markets.
The cabinet is not considering an exception such as the one Mr Eerdmans asks for.
Het kabinet kijkt daarbij niet naar een uitzondering zoals het lid Eerdmans vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het permanente karakter van de hoge asielinstroom

Eerdmans (JA21) asked whether the high asylum inflow of over a thousand per week is permanent, whether there is a limit to what the Netherlands can handle, and what the government will do if it is reached. The State Secretary said the inflow is now a constant factor, cited seasonal and post-COVID effects, and rejected an absolute ceiling on asylum seekers as contrary to international and European law and impractical.
An absolute ceiling on the number of asylum seekers that can be accommodated in the Netherlands does not fit this principle.
Een absolute bovengrens op het aantal asielzoekers dat in Nederland kan worden opgevangen past niet bij dit uitgangspunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Kritiek op hoofddoek bij boa’s barst los: ‘Het vlaggenschip van politieke islam’’

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Justice whether religious headscarves for municipal enforcement officers (boa's) should be allowed, and whether the government would stand for neutrality by banning them. The minister replied that uniform rules for boa's are a local matter for municipalities as employers, that the VNG model uniform excludes religious expression, and that he will await municipal consultations and a VNG evaluation before considering national regulation, reporting to parliament in spring 2022.
I therefore attach importance to first awaiting the conversations between municipalities and with the VNG and following the outcomes.
Ik hecht er daarom aan om eerst de gesprekken tussen gemeenten onderling en met de VNG af te wachten en de uitkomsten te volgen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de asielinstroom en de uitspraken van staatssecretaris Broekers-Knol

An MP from JA21 asked the government about reception shortages at asylum centres, the projected 2021 asylum inflow, and the handling of the Afghanistan-related motion. The State Secretary rejected the term 'asylum crisis', attributed shortages to COVID travel easing, Afghan evacuations and slow outflow of permit holders, and stated that a numerical ceiling on asylum intake is incompatible with Nederland's obligations.
I have asked the ACVZ to broadly map the options for using policy target figures to steer different forms of migration.
Ik heb de ACVZ gevraagd om breed in kaart te brengen welke mogelijkheden bestaan voor het gebruik van beleidsmatige richtgetallen bij sturing van verschillende vormen van migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de besteding van door de ACM opgelegde boetes

MP Eerdmans asks the minister how fines imposed by the ACM on Samsung for inflating online TV prices are spent, and whether consumers should be compensated directly. The minister confirms consumers were harmed, says fine revenue is a regular part of the EZK budget without earmarking, and points to civil damages claims and WAMCA collective actions as the compensation route.
These revenues thus form a regular part of the EZK budget; therefore no specific spending can be pointed to.
Deze ontvangsten vormen daarmee een regulier onderdeel van de EZK-begroting; daarom is er geen specifieke besteding aan te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Dierenbescherming haalt verwaarloosde paarden uit vieze stallen in gemeente Venlo’

An MP asked ministers about a 2021 case in Venlo where neglected horses were removed from a keeper who had earlier had 33 horses seized on Texel, and whether a longer or lifetime animal-keeping ban should apply. The government answered that it cannot discuss individual cases, defended the 10-year maximum ban in the pending bill as proportionate, and said enforcement would follow any new violation.
The bill provides that the criminal judge may, upon conviction for a criminal offence, impose an independent animal-keeping ban for a maximum duration of ten years.
Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet in de mogelijkheid voor de strafrechter om in geval van veroordeling wegens een strafbaar feit een zelfstandig houdverbod voor de maximale duur van tien jaar op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het gastekort en de exploderende gas- en stroomprijzen

An MP from JA21 asked the government whether it would act immediately to halt rising gas and electricity prices, lower household energy taxes, assess risks to gas supply and jobs, and whether the energy transition and climate policy caused the price surge. The state secretary answered that the government is cutting energy taxes for 2022 but rejects price caps, sees supply security as adequate, attributes high gas prices mainly to global supply and demand factors, and argues the energy transition is part of the solution.
The cabinet has no direct influence over supply tariffs; these are set by the market.
Het kabinet heeft geen directe invloed op de leveringstarieven, deze worden door de markt bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over visa voor kort verblijf

Eerdmans asked about short-stay (90-day) visas: annual issuance figures, how overstays are monitored and whether people who should have left are tracked, and how often the EUR 10,000 sponsor guarantee is claimed. The government answered with issuance numbers and inreisverbod counts, said there is no active monitoring of departures until the EES starts around May 2022, and said it has not yet claimed the guarantees, which is costly to enforce civilly.
At present there is no active monitoring of whether foreigners have left the Schengen area within the permitted period.
Op dit moment is nog geen sprake van een actieve monitoring of vreemdelingen het Schengengebied binnen de toegestane termijn hebben verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de invoering van grenscontroles

An MP asked whether border checks for COVID certificates at the Dutch-Belgian border show that border controls can be introduced quickly, and about their costs and effect on other Marechaussee tasks. The government answered that these checks rest on the Public Health Act rather than Schengen border controls, cost about 550,000 euro until end 2021, were staffed by the KMar only until 31 August, and that controls against illegal migration are not currently needed given strict conditions for internal border controls.
These checks are not internal border controls within the legal framework of the Schengen Borders Code.
Deze controles zijn geen binnengrenscontroles in het juridisch kader van de Schengen-grenscode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Mokumse homohater vaak een allochtoon'

MP Eerdmans asked the ministers whether they acknowledge that anti-gay aggression in Amsterdam is often committed by young men of non-Dutch background, and what policy changes would follow. The government answered that the Amsterdam study is limited in scope, that an updated national study on perpetrators is underway, and that repression, prevention and municipal cooperation are part of the approach.
The cited action research, however, relates only to the Amsterdam situation and moreover has limited scope.
Het aangehaalde Actieonderzoek heeft echter alleen betrekking op de Amsterdamse situatie en het heeft bovendien een beperkte reikwijdte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitkeringsafhankelijkheid en huisvesting van statushouders

An MP asks the ministers about rising benefit dependence among refugee status holders, their low education levels, the 2021 housing quota forcing municipalities to house 24,500 status holders, and whether this burdens the welfare state and housing supply. The government answers that benefit dependence falls with length of stay, that it cannot give total welfare costs, that municipalities bear housing duties under the Huisvestingswet, and lists measures to support housing and integration.
Figures are only available from the 2014 cohort onward.
Er zijn alleen cijfers beschikbaar vanaf het cohort 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Pouw-Verweij over het vertrek van Minister van Nieuwenhuizen van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

Two MPs asked the PM whether former Minister Van Nieuwenhuizen's move to lobby for the energy industry association created a conflict of interest with her infrastructure portfolio, and whether a cooling-off period for ministers should be introduced. The government answered that a minister may choose post-ministerial work within legal limits, that a recusal arrangement was agreed, that a binding cooling-off period would conflict with the constitutional right to free choice of work, and that the question of statutory rules is still under deliberation.
Within legal limits, it is up to a minister themselves to decide which positions they take on after serving as minister.
Het is, binnen wettelijke kaders, aan een Minister zelf om te bepalen welke functies hij of zij vervult na het vervullen van het ministersambt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitspraak van de afdeling bestuursrechtsspraak van de Raad van State inzake een milieubeoordeling voor windturbinenormen

MP Eerdmans asked the government how it would respond to a Council of State ruling that Dutch generic wind turbine noise standards required an environmental impact assessment, and whether all wind park decisions should be suspended and what the effects are on existing permits. The Secretary of State answered that projects of three or more turbines can proceed with substantiated norms, municipalities keep their own assessment powers, and existing permits remain valid.
Since that did not happen, these general rules conflict with EU law and may no longer be applied.
Nu dat niet is gebeurd, zijn deze algemene regels strijdig met het EU-recht en mogen ze niet meer worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot de Regionale Energie Strategie (RES)

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about whether the 35 TWh onshore renewable target for 2030 is at risk, whether subsidies and offshore expansion should be halted, offshore costs, data centre demand, health effects of wind turbines, and nuclear energy. The government answered that the 35 TWh target appears within reach, that subsidies will be phased out once it is secured, that further studies on offshore wind health and ecological effects are underway, and that nuclear and cost questions will be addressed in later studies.
For part of it, the information on the costs that wind park developers incur is commercially confidential.
Voor een deel is de informatie over de kosten die windparkontwikkelaars maken bedrijfsvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Justitie wil doodrijder van Fleur niet op verlof in Loosdrecht in belang van nabestaanden’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the public prosecution service should prevent a driver who killed a 19-year-old while drunk from returning to his home village on leave, and how often location and contact bans are imposed and how the new Wet straffen en beschermen will better protect victims. The minister answered that such conditions are assessed case by case, gave rough figures on bans, said the new law explicitly weighs victims' interests, and noted that protection after full release falls under other laws, with no firm targets given.
In that weighing, the victim's or next of kin's need for protection is set against the offender's fundamental rights.
In die afweging wordt de beschermingsbehoefte van het slachtoffer of de nabestaande afgezet tegen de grondrechten van de dader.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de berichten ‘Extra toezicht in winkels ‘asielhoofdstad’ Ter Apel: ‘Het geeft meer rust’’ en ‘Extra beveiliging tegen overlast asielzoekers in winkels Ter Apel’

An MP from JA21 asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about shopfloor security in Ter Apel, reports of shoplifting by asylum seekers from 'safe' countries, the financing of shopkeepers' losses, crime and nuisance statistics, deportation and visa leverage, and house arrest or area bans for nuisance-causing residents. The State Secretary answered that a local approach is taken, that COA funded private security as a pilot, that the government is reluctant to tighten rules while demissionary, and that some measures (area bans, transfers to the HTL location, visa leverage) are being pursued or are legally constrained.
I also refer to my letter earlier this year on progress on the integrated migration agenda.
Ik wijs hier ook op mijn brief eerder dit jaar over de voortgang van de integrale migratieagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de elementen dwang en draagvlak binnen het aardgasvrij maken van de gebouwde omgeving

An MP asked the minister to define 'dwang' (coercion) and 'draagvlak' (public support) in the Aardgasvrije Wijken programme and whether coercion is applied in pilot neighbourhoods and under the new collective heat law. The minister answered that residents cannot currently be forced off gas, that municipalities will later be given a not-yet-defined power to end gas supply with safeguards, that support is a municipal responsibility measured partly via satisfaction surveys, and that the draft collective heat bill contains no coercion.
I therefore cannot yet go into your specific questions.
Op uw specifieke vragen kan ik daarom nog niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Utrecht krijgt Overvecht niet van het gas af en doet dringend beroep op het Rijk’

An MP asks whether the Utrecht Overvecht-Noord natural-gas-free pilot is a failure and how the government reconciles the pilot's planned forced gas disconnection with parliament's motion against dwangsom-based coercion. The minister replies that the pilot is a learning exercise, that Utrecht has committed to voluntary participation, cost neutrality for residents and no fines, and that any future coercive powers are a matter for the next cabinet.
In the December 2020 letter I informed the House, based on Utrecht's commitments, that imposing a penalty payment on residents in Utrecht Overvecht-Noord will not arise.

Antwoord 11 In de brief van december 2020 8 heb ik de Tweede Kamer op basis van de toezeggingen van de gemeente Utrecht gemeld dat het opleggen van een dwangsom aan bewoners in Utrecht Overvecht-Noord niet aan de orde zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Drie kinderen aangerand door tbs’er op onbegeleid verlof’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a 42-year-old TBS patient on unaccompanied leave sexually assaulted three children in Venray, and whether unaccompanied leave should be stopped for sex offenders. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said the clinic is investigating and the outcome awaited, and rejected stopping unaccompanied leave, citing the established risk-assessment procedure.
It does not befit me to go into an individual case.
Het past mij niet om op een individuele casus in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Tussen Zwolle, Hasselt en Kampen een stad zo groot als Lelystad? 'Er is plek voor''

MP Eerdmans asked the Minister of the Interior about an EIB study suggesting a new city of Lelystad's size could be built between Zwolle, Hasselt and Kampen, and about whether wind-energy search areas should yield to housing. The minister replied that sufficient planning capacity exists to 2030, that peripheral building is locally constrained and must be weighed regionally, and that no study of scrapping wind zones is needed.
I therefore see no need for such a study.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak voor een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Asielzoeker met claimgeld betaalt amper mee aan opvang’

An MP asked why only about 65,000 euro in own contributions was collected from asylum seekers under the expanded contribution scheme after their asylum-related penalty payments, and whether the scheme could be tightened. The state secretary answered that the amount is substantial relative to past years, that the scheme's thresholds mirror the welfare rules, and that she sees no reason to lower asset limits or investigate foreign assets further.
The COA has no authority to actively check whether this declaration was made truthfully or to trace any assets.
Het COA heeft geen bevoegdheid om actief te controleren of deze verklaring naar waarheid is afgegeven of eventueel vermogen op te sporen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de berichten ‘Herrie veroorzakende verkeersaso’s worden met een nieuwe techniek aangepakt’, ‘Rotterdam krijgt lawaaiflitser tegen aso-mobilisten’ en ‘Rotterdam wil flitspalen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of a Rotterdam pilot showing thousands of noise-limit violations by loud vehicles and about new noise-enforcement cameras being developed. The minister said existing noise rules and police enforcement apply, that acoustic cameras cannot yet be certified, and that a law change to share vehicle data with police may be needed, to be examined once the technology and funding are clearer.
Depending on the choices made, it will become clear whether a law change is necessary.
Afhankelijk van de keuzes die gemaakt worden, zal duidelijk worden of een wetswijziging noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat Denemarken tijdelijke verblijfsvergunningen van Syriërs niet verlengt vanwege de verbeterde veiligheidssituatie in Syrië

Member Eerdmans (JA21) asked about Denmark not extending temporary residence permits for Syrians due to improved security, and whether the Netherlands should follow.
