The State Secretary reported 46,940 Syrians holding asylum residence permits, said Dutch Syria policy is based on objective ambtsberichten, found the security situation not substantially improved in the latest report, and promised a new ambtsbericht this summer with a policy review.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to prepare a new general country report on the situation in Syria.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heb ik gevraagd een nieuw algemeen ambtsbericht over de situatie in Syrië op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de vrij te geven notulen van de ministerraden

An MP asked the Prime Minister to publish cabinet minutes (ministerraad notulen) on the childcare benefits scandal, including those from November 2019 and those cited by RTL Nieuws. The Prime Minister agreed to publish the minutes provided to the parliamentary inquiry, including anonymised and non-anonymised versions, but stated that other minutes would not be released, citing the need for confidential deliberation and the caretaker cabinet's mandate.
Other than the aforementioned minutes, no minutes will be made public.
Andere dan voorgenoemde notulen worden niet openbaar gemaakt.

m: Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over projectbesluiten voor drinkwaterinfrastructuur aanwijzen als besluiten van "zwaarwegend maatschappelijk belang"
Asks the government to designate drinking water infrastructure project decisions as decisions of overriding public interest, enabling procedural acceleration.
requests the government to designate project decisions for drinking water infrastructure as decisions of overriding public interest
verzoekt de regering projectbesluiten voor de drinkwaterinfrastructuur aan te wijzen als besluiten van «zwaarwegend maatschappelijk belang»
Amendement van de leden Verkuijlen en Bikker ter vervanging van nr. 20 over een aangifteplicht voor het delict van mensenhandel
Extends the statutory duty to report to the police to human trafficking offences, applying it to citizens who know of trafficking, with an equivalent change for the Caribbean Netherlands.

everyone who has knowledge of human trafficking, except victims, their relatives, confidants, care providers and other professions with a right of non-disclosure, must according to the submitters report it to the police.

eenieder die kennis draagt van mensenhandel – behoudens slachtoffers en hun familieleden, vertrouwenspersonen, hulpverleners en andere beroepsgroepen met een verschoningsrecht – moet volgens de indieners dan ook aangifte doen bij de Politie
Motie van het lid Boomsma c.s. over transnationale huwelijkse uitbuiting en huwelijkse gevangenschap erkennen als vorm van mensenhandel

Asks the government to recognise transnational marriage exploitation and marital captivity as a form of human trafficking and to improve prevention, consular and legal support and information at embassies.
requests the government to ensure that transnational marital exploitation and marital captivity are recognised as a form of human trafficking
verzoekt de regering om er zorg voor te dragen dat transnationale huwelijkse uitbuiting en huwelijkse gevangenschap worden erkend als vorm van mensenhandel
Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over niet-bestraffing onder de aandacht brengen bij het OM en de rechtspraak
Motion asks the government to draw the prosecution service and judiciary's attention to the principle of non-punishment for trafficking victims who committed offences under coercion.
requests the government to draw attention to the principle of non-punishment with the prosecution service and judiciary
verzoekt de regering het beginsel van niet-bestraffing nadrukkelijk onder de aandacht te brengen bij het OM en de rechterlijke macht
Motie van het lid Verkuijlen over misbruik van de B8/3-regeling tegengaan
Asks the government to address misuse of the B8/3 residence scheme for suspected trafficking victims within the action plan and to inform the House in the next letter on it.
requests the government to include tackling misuse of the B8/3 scheme in the action plan Together Against Human Trafficking
verzoekt de regering het tegengaan van misbruik van de B8/3-regeling te betrekken bij het actieplan Samen tegen Mensenhandel
Amendement van de leden Verkuijlen en Bikker over een aangifteplicht voor het delict van mensenhandel
Adds the human trafficking offence to the offences for which a duty to report to police applies, including in the Caribbean Netherlands.
In Article 160(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, after 'or in the articles' the text '273f,' is inserted.
In artikel 160, eerste lid, van het Wetboek van Strafvordering wordt na «of in de artikelen» ingevoegd «273f,».
Amendement van het lid Verkuijlen c.s. over het expliciet strafbaar stellen van huwelijkse uitbuiting
Amends the criminal law on human trafficking to explicitly list forced marriage as a form of exploitation within marital relationships.
With Directive 2024/1712, the Netherlands is obliged to make explicit that exploitation also includes a forced marriage.
Met de richtlijn 2024/1712 wordt Nederland verplicht expliciet te maken dat onder uitbuiting ook een gedwongen huwelijk.
Amendement van de leden Verkuijlen en Dral over het spreekrecht bij de delicten van ernstige benadeling, voordeeltrekking en strafbaarheid prostituanten
Adds victims of serious harm, benefiting from exploitation and prosecution of clients under articles 273fa, 273fb and 273g of the Criminal Code to those who may exercise a right to speak at trial.
Therefore the submitters propose to make the right to speak available to victims of the offences in articles 273fa, 273fb and 273g of the Criminal Code.
Daarom stellen de indieners voor het spreekrecht mogelijk te maken voor slachtoffers van de misdrijven in artikelen 273fa, 273fb en 273g Sr.

Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het ook als mensenhandel beschouwen als iemand wordt geworven om in een ander land in de prostitutie te wer
Extends the human trafficking penalty to recruiting or transporting a person with intent to make them offer paid sexual services in another country, without proof of exploitation or coercion.
The same penalty as for human trafficking applies to anyone who recruits a person under the circumstances referred to in the third paragraph
Met dezelfde straf als op mensenhandel is gesteld wordt gestraft degene die een persoon onder de in het derde lid bedoelde omstandigheden werft
Motie van het lid Verkuijlen c.s. over bij de betrokken organisaties de kwaliteit van feitenonderzoeken onder de aandacht brengen
Asks the government to draw organisations including the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming and the courts to the quality of fact-finding reports in child-protection placement requests.
requests the government to emphatically draw the attention of the involved organisations to the quality of fact-finding investigations

verzoekt de regering nadrukkelijk bij de betrokken organisaties (Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, Gl’s, de Raad voor de rechtspraak en de gerechten) de kwaliteit van feitenonderzoeken onder de aandacht te brengen
Amendement van het lid Westerveld c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 18 over vrije toegang tot de vertrouwenspersoon
Gives young people free access to the youth advocate without needing consent from third parties such as parents or institutions.
The young person has free access to the advocate and needs no permission from third parties to speak with the advocate.
De jeugdige heeft vrije toegang tot de vertrouwenspersoon en behoeft geen toestemming van derden om te spreken met de vertrouwenspersoon.
Amendement van het lid Westerveld c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het verruimen van de beroepstermijn
Extends the appeal deadline against decisions of a youth complaints committee from seven days to six weeks.
'on the seventh day' replaced in each case by 'within six weeks'
«op de zevende dag» telkens vervangen door «binnen zes weken»
Motie van het lid Verkuijlen c.s. over nadere regels over de veiligheid van hulpverleners en jeugdigen in gesloten accommodaties
Asks the government to set rules under the Youth Act on physical and social safety of staff and youths in closed youth institutions, in consultation with the sector.
requests the government to set further rules under article 6.2.1 on the physical and social safety of staff and youths in closed accommodations
verzoekt de regering om op basis van artikel 6.2.1 nadere regels te stellen over de fysieke en sociale veiligheid van hulpverleners en jeugdigen in gesloten accommodaties
Motie van het lid Van der Werf c.s. over bestaande effectieve interventies tegen ondermijning gericht op jongeren ook aan kleinere gemeenten beschikbaar stellen
Asks the government to make existing effective prevention interventions against undermining crime for youth available to smaller municipalities, using incidental funds.
requests the government to use part of the incidental funds against undermining in the 2022 Justice and Security budget to make existing effective interventions for children and youth available

verzoekt de regering om met een deel van de incidentele middelen tegen ondermijning in de begroting van Justitie en Veiligheid voor 2022 bestaande effectieve interventies gericht op kinderen en jongeren
qa: Antwoord op vragen van lid Verkuijlen over de binnenvaart

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the inland shipping sector's declining market share, energy transition support, tax parity for electric and hydrogen vessels, crew requirements and smart shipping. The minister answered that modal shift targets are pursued for congestion reasons, that subsidies and EU fund support exist, that the excise exemption on diesel cannot be removed soon, and that crew rules are adequate for now with testing possible.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Fiscaal beleid bedreigt onze weerbaarheid op zee’

Two MPs asked whether the Pillar Two global minimum tax undermines the shipping tonnage regime and what the fiscal and employment impact of Dutch shipping firms leaving would be. The State Secretary answered that the regime may be touched by minimum tax only in specific cases, that the amounts at stake are limited, that no exemption or tax credit is planned, and that the impact will be monitored after first filings in 2026.
Once the filing data are available, the consequences of the minimum tax for the Netherlands will be included in the annual monitoring letter.
Wanneer de aangiftegegevens voorhanden zijn, zullen de gevolgen van de minimumbelasting voor Nederland in de jaarlijkse monitoringsbrief worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Verkuijlen vragen gesteld over de nachtelijke bereikbaarheid van de Waddeneilanden

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about night-time access to the Wadden islands, including the stalled night watertaxi service to Ameland, the status of a motion, the planned MARIN study and a pilot. The minister answered that an independent MARIN study on safe night speeds is due at year-end, the pilot depends on operators and an environmental permit, and night watertaxis remain legally possible at 20 km/h.
That is why an independent study into a safe night-time sailing speed is being carried out by the maritime research bureau MARIN.
Daarom wordt een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitgevoerd naar een veilige vaarsnelheid in de nacht door maritiem onderzoeksbureau MARIN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Reders dreigen Nederlandse vlag vaarwel te zeggen na discriminatie-uitspraak’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling against the country-of-residence principle affects the Dutch maritime sector, flag-state competitiveness, seafarer jobs and strategic autonomy. The minister answers that the ruling could weaken the level playing field and Dutch-flagged shipping, that a study on the effects will be carried out, and that the government remains committed to the sector.
A study will be carried out into the effects for the Dutch maritime sector.
Er zal een onderzoek worden uitgevoerd naar de effecten voor de Nederlandse maritieme sector
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Verkuijlen en Kisteman over de storing bij de radiosystemen van de Kustwacht op 1 juli jl.

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about a July 2025 radio system failure at the Kustwacht, its cause, whether lives were endangered, its link to the 2024 NAFIN outage, backup and cyber protection. The government answered that the radio systems are operational again, the cause was investigated with measures taken, no critical situations arose, but it withheld details on cyber protection for security reasons and gave limited detail on the causes.
For security reasons I cannot go into this any further.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik hierop verder niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Tekort aan drinkwater dreigt, beloofde voorraden komen niet van de grond'

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the status of additional strategic groundwater reserves (ASV) for drinking water, whether the action programme and national groundwater reserves are sufficient, and how to speed up designation. The minister reports that eight provinces have designated ASVs, two are finishing procedures and two (Zeeland, Noord-Brabant) have declined, and promises a progress letter to parliament in early 2026 while stating current policy is sufficient in principle.
In the first quarter of 2026 the House will be informed about the progress of the action programme.
In het eerste kwartaal van 2026 wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over de voortgang van het actieprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Jongeren en hun smartphones een wereldwijde geestelijke giframp'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a press article claiming youth mental health is being driven by smartphones, and about the link to youth care, age limits for social media, and Dutch trends since 2012. The minister answered that the causal link between phone use and youth care is not established, outlined existing research and policy measures, said age verification is being developed, and found no 2012 break in Dutch youth care use.
Nevertheless, it is difficult to demonstrate whether a causal relationship exists between phone use and use of youth care.
Toch is het lastig aan te tonen of een causale relatie bestaat tussen het gebruik van een telefoon en jeugdzorg gebruik.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over de berichten 'Jongeren stellen eigen diagnoses via TikTok: ‘Als je dit herkent heb je ADHD’' en 'De TikTok psycholoog is in opkomst: ‘Als je deze vie

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about news reports on young people self-diagnosing mental health conditions via TikTok and on unreliable 'TikTok psychologist' advice, asking for research on consultations, action against medical misinformation and clearer mental health information for youth. The State Secretary said no data are kept on such consultations and that collecting it would burden professionals, pointed to Digital Services Act obligations on platforms, and announced a study this autumn into a more coherent, findable mental health information offer.
In the RTL Nieuws article, the vice-chair of the NIP states that it is not recorded whether young people more often report to the GP as a result of such videos.
In het artikel van RTL nieuws geeft de vicevoorzitter van het NIP aan dat niet wordt bijgehouden of jongeren zich vaker melden bij de huisarts als gevolg van dergelijke video’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Paul en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Ouders eisen verbod op autismebehandeling voor kinderen'

Three VVD MPs asked the government about reports that parents demand a ban on ABA-based autism treatment for children, including the number of providers, complaints, safety oversight and the evidence base. The government answered that ABA covers many varying treatments, that complaints to the IGJ are limited, that it will commission research into effects on young people, but that it does not support a ban.
I will therefore have research carried out into the impact of ABA and treatments containing ABA elements on young people.
Ik ga daarom onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van ABA en behandelingen waar elementen van ABA in zitten op jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Miljoenen voor actieplan dakloosheid dreigen niet juist te worden uitgegeven: ‘Schandalig’

MPs Van den Hil and Verkuijlen asked the state secretary about a report that municipalities plan to spend the national homelessness action plan funds mainly on prevention rather than housing and financial security, and about youth transition between the Youth Act and Wmo. The state secretary disputed that the report proves misuse, noted that other funding streams and the housing ministry are involved, cited a dashboard and existing policy on youth transition, and committed to ongoing dialogue without a concrete new measure.
Care is needed when drawing conclusions about how municipalities spend the funds and whether this is in line with the National Action Plan on Homelessness or not.
Er is zorgvuldigheid geboden bij het trekken van conclusies over hoe gemeenten de middelen besteden en of dat wel of niet in lijn is met het Nationaal Actieplan Dakloosheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Verkuijlen over het artikel 'Zorgen om online bedreigingen leerlingen: ’Doet een beetje denken aan de kogelbrief’'

MPs Paul and Verkuijlen asked the ministers about online threats against pupils and schools, including how often they occur, how schools should respond, and whether perpetrators are caught. Minister Wiersma answers that no national trend data exists, points to a planned incident-reporting duty in a forthcoming bill, and describes existing protocols and support organisations, without committing to new structural oversight measures.
There is no national picture of how often these kinds of threats occur.
Er is geen landelijk beeld hoe vaak dit soort bedreigingen voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Verkuijlen over het artikel ‘Zorgen om schade aan schoolgebouwen in heel Nederland door geweld hangjongeren’

Two VVD MPs asked about damage to school buildings from youth vandalism, how often damages and parents are held liable, convictions, Halt referrals, and whether cameras on school playgrounds should be promoted. The minister answers that no data on damage, claims, or convictions are kept, cites Halt figures, points to the ongoing exploration of expanding parental liability, and refers to municipalities and schools for camera decisions.
There are no figures available on the extent of damage to school buildings.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de omvang van schade aan schoolgebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Pubers met granaten en tonnen winst door cybercrime: 'Almere visvijver criminelen''

An MP asked why Almere, described as a breeding ground for youth recruited into organised crime, was not included in the 'Preventie met Gezag' programme, and on what criteria municipalities were selected. The minister answered that Almere is being considered for inclusion after a preselection of eight municipalities, that funding per municipality is listed, and that effectiveness will be monitored through a learning approach.
Almere has been selected to be included in the Preventie met Gezag approach.
Almere is geselecteerd om te worden opgenomen binnen de aanpak Preventie met Gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Vaak dakloos na verlaten jeugdzorg'

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary how youths leaving youth care are supported to avoid homelessness at 18, whether data exist on youth becoming homeless, how they are prepared for independence and the transition to the Wmo, how they are informed of options, and whether eligibility for extended youth care can be harmonised with municipalities. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to the Big Five planning approach, the national homelessness action plan and a pending housing bill, said no figures exist for youth homeless at 18, promised a policy-information study due around summer and talks with the VNG.
No figures are available on the number of young people who become homeless or without a permanent home on their eighteenth birthday.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat dak- of thuisloos wordt op hun achttiende verjaardag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘jongeren vaker betrokken bij fraude en cybercrime, politie maakt zicht zorgen’

MPs Rajkowski and Verkuijlen asked the Justice Minister about the rise in youth involvement in fraud and cybercrime, parental liability, school prevention programmes and the uptake of HackShield and Hack_Right. The minister replied that no clear rise in 2022 is evident yet, outlined prevention initiatives involving schools, parents and municipalities, and committed to further study and a prosecution overview.
I consider it important to gain more insight into the role of young people in crime.
Ik vind het belangrijk om meer inzicht te vergaren in de rol van jongeren in criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Bikker en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Centrum tegen Kinderhandel slaat alarm: 'Pa of ma soms pooier eigen kind''

MPs Kuik, Bikker and Verkuijlen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report by the Centre against Child Trafficking (CKM) showing rising, younger victims of exploitation, some exploited by their own parents, and whether official data and support reach them. The State Secretary acknowledges the concern, notes that registered figures underestimate true victim numbers, and promises further talks with partners, a 2023 follow-up on the Samen tegen Mensenhandel programme and a research and reporting process.

I will discuss the research results with the CKM/Fier and other relevant chain partners, such as other victim organisations, the police and the Public Prosecution Service, to interpret each other's information further and reach appropriate follow-up steps together.

Ik zal met het CKM/Fier en andere betrokken ketenpartners, zoals andere slachtofferpartijen, politie en OM, in gesprek gaan over de onderzoeksresultaten om elkaars informatie nader te duiden en samen tot passende vervolgstappen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Richardson, Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Tientallen klachten van misbruik en mishandeling in Gelders jeugddorp’

MPs asked the state secretary about reports of abuse and mistreatment at the Glind youth village, including whether inspectors had prior signals and what is being done about the care provider and former foster children. The government answered that the IGJ received several signals and reports since 2018 and will handle them, that Pluryn set up a helpline and is commissioning research, and that existing complaint channels exist, while declining to disclose details of individual reports citing confidentiality and privacy.
The IGJ never makes statements about the precise content of reports and how they are handled.
Over de precieze inhoud van meldingen en de afhandeling doet de IGJ nooit mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Verkuijlen over het rapport ‘Jonge Nederlandse slachtoffers criminele uitbuiting witte vlek in aanpak ondermijning van Centrum kinderhandel en mensenhandel’

MPs Bikker and Verkuijlen asked the ministers about the CKM report on young Dutch victims of criminal exploitation, its link to organised crime, recognition of victims and the Dutch versus UK definitions. The government acknowledges the report, commits to a broader prevention approach, to working with the UK, and to a follow-up letter on the second report and the modernisation of article 273f Sr.
We endorse the findings of the report and the recommendation to anchor the approach to criminal exploitation and make it part of the approach to organised and undermining crime.

Wij onderschrijven de bevindingen uit het rapport en de aanbeveling om de aanpak van criminele uitbuiting te verankeren en deze onderdeel te maken van de aanpak georganiseerde en ondermijnende criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verkuijlen en De Neef over het artikel ‘Noodkreet kinderrechters: veroordeelde jongeren krijgen niet de hulp die ze nodig hebben’

MPs Verkuijlen and De Neef asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health about reports that convicted youths do not receive timely specialised youth care ordered by juvenile judges, including waiting lists, municipal budget constraints, lighter treatment advice from the Child Protection Council, and priority for these youths. The minister acknowledged the urgency, said regional procurement obligations and a support programme are being pursued, but gave no national figures on waiting lists and stated there is no plan to give these youths priority.
Municipalities are responsible for organising youth care, including youth care for young people in the criminal law context.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van jeugdhulp, waaronder jeugdhulp voor jongeren in het strafrechtelijk kader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Verkuijlen over het bericht dat mogelijk ook een Nederlandse moskee een rol speelt in constructies voor mensenhandel en prostitutie

MPs Becker and Verkuijlen asked the government about reports that Dutch mosques may be involved in sham 'pleasure marriages' linked to sex work and trafficking, and about possible investigation, prosecution and sanctions. The minister answered that no signals of such marriages in the Netherlands have been received, that no investigation is planned, that the OM sees no current signs of crimes, and that the Taskforce cannot investigate individuals, while pointing to the pending Wtmo amendment and other planned instruments.
The OM has indicated that there are currently no signals of criminal offences.
Het OM heeft laten weten dat er op dit moment geen signalen zijn van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verkuijlen over het bericht de helft van de slachtoffers van mensenhandel binnen enkele jaren opnieuw slachtoffer van een misdrijf wordt

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report finding that half of human trafficking victims become victims of another crime within seven years, and about gaps in protection, online surveillance, aid for labour-exploitation victims and youth transition. The government acknowledged the problem, described existing protection and support measures, and promised to address the issues in its policy response to the victim monitor.
I will take this issue into account in my policy response to the Victim Monitor.
Ik zal dit vraagstuk betrekken in mijn beleidsreactie op de Slachtoffermonitor.

m: Motie-Jager over geen elektronische detentie op basis van de noodmaatregel uit 2005
Asks the government to report how it will ensure the Public Prosecution Service can no longer impose electronic detention under the 2005 emergency measure now that there are enough cells.
requests the government to report to the House how it will ensure that electronic detention can no longer be imposed by the Public Prosecution Service under the 2005 emergency measure
verzoekt de regering aan de Kamer te rapporteren hoe ze gaat zorgen dat elektronische detentie niet meer op basis van de noodmaatregel uit 2005 door het Openbaar Ministerie kan worden opgelegd
qa: Vragen van het lid Jager (CDA) aan de minister van Justitie over gegevens van gedetineerden (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether confidential prisoner data found on a discarded computer from the De Berg prison was a sign of lax handling of data on retired computers, and whether protocols and investigation would follow. The minister confirmed the find, described the existing wiping protocol, reported a forensic investigation that could not trace which school received the computer, and saw no reason to change policy beyond an awareness campaign.
I see no reason to change the current Justice policy on handling confidential data.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het huidige Justitiebeleid in de omgang met vertrouwelijke gegevens te wijzigen.
Vragen van de leden Van Bochove, Spies en Jager (allen CDA) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de aangescherpte energieprestatienorm (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about the status of the Northern Netherlands energy agreement and the draft experiment decree allowing a tighter energy performance norm (EPC 0.5) for new homes, and whether preconditions such as market and municipal support were met. The minister answered that the Council of State raised no objections, that the decree is notified to the European Commission, that some market parties still seek clarity on calculation methods, and that the decree will enter into force on 1 October 2010 with informing parliament at publication.
I intend to inform your House upon publication of the decree.
Ik ben voornemens om uw kamer te informeren bij de publicatie van het besluit.
Vragen van de leden Jager en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over te rigoureuze toepassing Natura 2000 (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

MPs Jager and Koppejan (CDA) asked the minister whether the implementation of Natura 2000 is too rigorous, citing press criticism of overly technical ecological precision and its effect on public support. The minister acknowledged the complexity and public-support concern, said the detailed rules stem from EU law, and pointed to flexibility already sought through the Crisis- en herstelwet and management plans, without committing to new structural changes.
I share the concern in the article. The implementation of Natura 2000 is complex, which does not contribute to public support for nature.
Ik deel de zorg in het artikel. De implementatie van Natura 2000 is complex, hetgeen niet bijdraagt aan het draagvlak voor natuur.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Jager (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Menzis legt Refaja wil op» (ingezonden 13 april 2010).

The CDA MPs Smilde and Jager asked the health minister about reports that insurer Menzis wants to reduce hospital capacity in East Groningen, including whether only one hospital should remain near the A7 and the consequences for acute care access. The minister replied that Menzis has no concrete proposals yet, that the government stands behind the insurer's responsibility in consultation with hospitals, and that RIVM is analysing acute care accessibility scenarios, with results to be sent to parliament.
I will inform you in writing about the accessibility of acute care in the region once I receive the outcomes.
Ik zal u na ontvangst van de uitkomsten schriftelijke informeren over de bereikbaarheid van de acute zorg in de regio.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Jager (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Menzis legt Refaja wil op» (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

The CDA MPs ask whether it falls within a health insurer's duty of care to intervene so actively in a hospital's new-build plans and push for a merger with another hospital. The minister answers that securing care is primarily the insurer's responsibility, that contract negotiations are the main tool, and that discussions on mergers and new builds can be necessary for efficient, high-quality care.
Which measures are necessary to ensure the health insurer can meet its duty of care is in principle up to the health insurer itself.
Welke maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn om ervoor te zorgen dat de zorgverzekeraar aan zijn zorgplicht kan voldoen is in principe aan de zorgverzekeraar zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smitskam over het bericht ‘Zedendelinquenten werkten mogelijk in kinderopvang en taxibranche door blunder justitie’

An MP asked why five of six sexual-offence suspicions led to no prosecution, whether parents of children in childcare were informed, which offences lead to refusing a VOG certificate, and whether the 477 possibly still-working staff were screened. The Secretary of State answered that the prosecutor decides independently, that the five cases were technical dismissals, that Justis did not forward three signals and so no parties were informed, that a sexual offence in principle leads to VOG refusal, that individual cases cannot be discussed for privacy reasons, and that all persons were screened with some actions taken.
Due to the protection of the personal privacy of the person concerned, I cannot go into individual case details.
Vanwege de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van betrokkene kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smitskam over het bericht ‘Maccabi-rellen: dubieuze schadevergoeding van gemeente Amsterdam aan agressieve taxichauffeur’

An MP asked whether Amsterdam paid damages to a taxi driver allegedly involved in the Maccabi riots, on what criteria, and what role the mayor played, and whether rules should prevent perpetrators being compensated. The minister replied that Amsterdam paid EUR 3,526 as a goodwill payment handled administratively under delegated authority, that the municipality knew of no criminal involvement, and that individual municipalities decide on such payments.
This was not a claim against the municipality but a payment made as a goodwill gesture.
Het betrof hier geen claim richting de gemeente, maar een betaling uit coulance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smitskam en Crijns over het bericht ‘Malafide jeugdzorgmedewerkers ronselen jongeren voor criminaliteit: ’Ik heb zelfs een huis opgeblazen''

PVV MPs asked the state secretaries about reports that fraudulent youth care workers recruit young people for crime, asking about oversight, a независимый investigation, victim numbers and reforms. The government acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to planned measures such as a vergewisplicht in the Jeugdwet and a Zorgfraudebrief, but declined a new independent investigation and said it does not register how many children were affected.
Given the measures the parties are taking, I currently see no reason for additional investigation.
Gezien bovenstaande maatregelen die partijen nemen, zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullend onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smitskam over de afspraak uit het hoofdlijnenakkoord: ‘Er wordt onderzocht of en hoe nadere vereisten gesteld kunnen worden aan de representativiteit van belangenorganisaties met een ideëel

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security what concrete steps have been taken on the coalition agreement's review of representativeness requirements for idealistic interest organisations under article 3:305a of the Civil Code, and when results will be shared. The government answered that the WAMCA evaluation including a comparative study is underway, with results expected in April and summer 2025 and publication within six weeks, and that it sees no evidence of rising misuse of such collective actions.
The research design is part of the study. According to the current planning, the comparative law component will be delivered at the end of April 2025.
De onderzoeksopzet maakt deel uit van het onderzoek. Het rechtsvergelijkend onderdeel wordt volgens de huidige planning eind april 2025 opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smitskam en Aardema over het bericht ‘Aanpak winkeldieven stokt door gebrekkige medewerking van politie’

MPs Smitskam and Aardema asked whether police will again promptly provide suspects' identity details to shopkeepers so they can claim damages, and what will be done about the reported drop in such disclosures and the possible effect of not prosecuting minor theft. The minister answered that the ministry is mapping bottlenecks with police and business, that police acknowledge fewer disclosures and are working to restore them, and that a national framework will be updated, but declined to pre-empt the outcomes of ongoing talks on the other questions.
The police acknowledges that there has been a decline in the number of disclosures in cases of shoplifting and is trying to restore this in consultation with the parties involved.
De politie erkent dat er sprake is van een terugval in het aantal verstrekkingen bij winkeldiefstal en probeert dit te herstellen in overleg met betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smitskam over het bericht ‘Schoof bedolven met smeekbedes om ontvoerde Insiya te redden’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Insiya child abduction case, in which a child has remained in India for ten years despite a return request, and asked how many children have been abducted from and returned to the Netherlands, which countries abduct most, and whether maximum pressure will be applied to non-cooperating states. The State Secretary answered each question with data, noted that India is not a Hague Convention party so is not bound to return the child, and referred to the escalation protocol for treaty states.
Not all international child abductions are reported to the Central Authority, so the figures do not give a complete picture.
Niet alle internationale kinderontvoeringen worden gemeld bij de Centrale autoriteit, de cijfers geven daarom geen volledig beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tijs van den Brink, Boswijk en Zwinkels over het bericht 'Trollenlegers uit buitenland versterkten politieke en opruiende berichten rond verkiezingen'

CDA MPs asked the government about a RTL Nieuws report that foreign fake accounts (from Nigeria, Ghana and elsewhere, possibly linked to Russia) influenced debate around the Dutch Tweede Kamer election, and what measures will prevent this. The minister answers that the impact was limited, that the government is in talks with platforms and the EU, that FIMI detection capacity is being developed with a report after the summer recess, but that it cannot discuss individual cases or confirm Russian involvement publicly.
In public I cannot go into individual cases.
In het openbaar kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
